jobs.title: Realistic 3D Villa Promo Video
jobs.description:
**Project title:** Villa Tour Video (1–3 min) — AI-Enhanced Walkthrough with Bilingual Room Labels & Location Highlights

**Overview**
I need a polished 1–3 minute cinematic tour video of a villa in [city/district]. I will supply still photographs and raw video clips of the property. The villa is currently unfurnished, and I do **not** want virtual furniture or staging added — the goal is to showcase the space, layout, and finishes as they are.

**Source material I will provide**
- still images (high resolution)
- raw video clips, total minutes
- Floor plan
- Property location and list of nearby landmarks

**Scope of work**

**1. Main walkthrough (approx. 60–90 sec)**
Assemble the stills and clips into a smooth, continuous-feeling tour following a logical path through the villa (entrance → majlis/guest reception → living areas → kitchen → bedrooms → master bedroom → outdoor areas → roof). Use AI-based tools where helpful to generate realistic motion from stills (parallax, camera push-ins, image-to-video), upscale low-quality frames, stabilize shaky footage, and correct lighting and color. The output must look photorealistic and consistent with the actual property — no hallucinated rooms, altered architecture, or invented features.

**2. Bilingual room labels**
Each space must be introduced with a clean animated text overlay naming it in **both Arabic and English** (مجلس / Majlis, غرفة المعيشة / Living Room, المطبخ / Kitchen, غرفة النوم الرئيسية / Master Bedroom, دورة المياه / Bathroom, التراس / Terrace, etc.). Arabic must use proper right-to-left rendering with correct letter joining — no broken or reversed text. Use a professional Arabic font paired with a matching Latin font. Typography should be modern and understated, real estate marketing style, not flashy.

**3. Location & neighborhood segment (approx. 20–40 sec)**
A short animated map sequence showing the villa's position, then highlighting key nearby locations with distance or drive time (schools, mosque, major roads, shopping, hospital, airport). Labels here must also be bilingual. I will provide the list.

**4. Audio**
**No background music.** Deliver the video with no soundtrack. [Choose one: a clean silent track / light ambient room tone only.] The video must communicate entirely through visuals and on-screen text, so pacing and label timing need to carry the piece — allow enough time on each label for a viewer to read both languages comfortably.

**5. Finishing**
Opening frame with the villa name/title in Arabic and English. Closing frame with my contact details (phone / WhatsApp) in both languages, on a clean background. No logo required.

**Deliverables**
- Final video in 4K and 1080p, MP4
- Project files or a means of requesting future edits
- Full commercial usage rights

**Revisions:** [2] rounds of revisions

**What to include in your bid**
- Links to 2–3 similar real estate or architectural videos you have produced
- Confirmation you have experience with Arabic typography in video (samples preferred)
- A simple text-based title design proposal for the opening frame
- Which AI and editing tools you plan to use
- Your total price and delivery timeline

jobs.title: Need Digital Marketing Overhaul for my IT Company
jobs.description:

2. A high-level strategy outline and estimated timeline for the first three months.  
3. The tools you rely on most.  
4. Your availability and whether you prefer hourly or fixed-price billing.  

I’m ready to move once I see a strong plan backed by evidence, so let’s map out how you’ll drive search rankings, elevate social conversations, and deliver the leads we need.

jobs.title: Residential 3D Visualization Model
jobs.description:
I need a fully-developed 3D model of a single-family residence that can stand up to close architectural visualization work. The model has to include both interior and exterior elements—walls, roofs, façade details, room layouts, built-ins, windows, doors, and any key landscape features immediately surrounding the building.  

My primary goal is to generate photorealistic stills and short walk-through clips, so clean geometry, correct scale, and well-organized layers are essential. jobs.title: Interactive PT Course Quiz Creation

I’ll supply the source workbooks, any existing graphics, and the learning outcomes for each module. You’ll structure the questions, draft concise distractors, design or adapt the diagrams, and return everything in a neatly organised folder (editable files plus a learner-ready version).

Accuracy of terminology, clean layout, and an intuitive flow from question to question are essential acceptance criteria. If you’ve built quizzes for health, fitness or medical content before—and can show a sample—that’s a definite plus.

jobs.title: Build 200 relevant SEO backlinks for AskAstro
jobs.description:

Scope:
- Build exactly 200 relevant backlinks within 1 week.
- Prioritize genuine, relevant websites and pages related to astrology, horoscopes, birth charts, numerology, spirituality, wellness, relationships, and Indian audiences.
- Use a natural mix of branded, URL, partial-match, and informational anchor text. Do not use keyword stuffing.
- Target the most relevant Ask Astro pages, including the homepage, birth-chart/personality analysis, horoscope pages, numerology, Panchang, Dasha, Dosha, and Ashtakoota marriage compatibility pages.
- Provide a complete spreadsheet with each backlink URL, target URL, anchor text, link type, website/page topic, placement status, and date published.
- Obtain links through legitimate outreach, contextual placements, niche edits, resource pages, or quality guest contributions. Follow Google Search Essentials and disclose any paid/sponsored placements where required.

Acceptance criteria:
- 200 live, relevant, crawlable backlinks or a clearly documented status for any pending placement.
- Submit the spreadsheet and the outreach/source details used.
- Share sample placements before completing the full batch so quality can be checked.
- No access to production credentials is required; any content must be approved before publication.

Budget: ₹1,500–₹2,000 fixed price. Deadline: maximum 1 week. Please share examples of comparable white-hat backlink campaigns and explain how you will source 200 relevant links within this budget.

jobs.title: Dynamic Character Basemesh Creation
jobs.description:

Key points I need you to cover:  
• Dynamic proportions and edge loops that deform smoothly.  
• Quads only, with even polygon distribution for subdivision.  
• Named, organized layers and groups so I can isolate body parts quickly.  
• A neutral A-pose (or slightly relaxed T-pose) and non-overlapping UVs.  

Style requirement: the baseline look should follow the “3s” direction I specified—feel free to interpret that creatively, but keep it consistent across the entire mesh.  

Please provide the source file (Maya, Blender, or similar), an exported FBX, and a brief note explaining any custom shaders or rigs you include. If you have previous basemesh examples, linking them will help me choose the right person.

jobs.title: Inspirational Podcast Teaser & Reels
jobs.description:

1. Full Episode Edit  
   • Clean cuts, color balance, and smooth audio mixing so the final video plays seamlessly on YouTube in 1080p (or higher if you recommend).  
   • Light motion graphics for chapter titles, lower-thirds, and branded bumpers.  
   • Hard-coded or SRT captions timed accurately throughout.

2. Teaser

   • Hook the viewer in the first few seconds, then maintain energy with upbeat pacing, branded intro/outro, and a quick end screen that points to the full video.

3. Highlight Reels & Shorts

   • Keep the tone uplifting rather than comedic or strictly corporate.

Preferred workflow: send edit drafts via frame-accurate review links (Frame.io, Google Drive, or similar), allow at least one revision round per asset, and deliver final exports in MP4 (H.264) along with the editable project files. I usually work in Premiere Pro, but Final Cut or DaVinci Resolve is fine as long as the export specs match.

Acceptance criteria  
• Consistent color and audio levels across all outputs.  
• Text, logos, and lower-thirds remain inside safe zones.  
• No dead air, jump cuts smoothed with B-roll or light zooms.  
• Delivered on time with files labeled clearly.

If anything here needs clarification, let me know and we can lock in the timeline right away.

jobs.title: Wrap & Launch "jusssmile" PWA on Android Play Store (TWA)
jobs.description:
Hi, 

I am looking for an experienced Android developer to help package our existing web platform (jusssmile.com) as a Progressive Web App (PWA) using a Trusted Web Activity (TWA) and successfully launch it on the Google Play Store.
The web app is already live and functioning, but we need an expert to handle the containerization, build the signed Android App Bundle (.aab), and guide us through the Google Play Console deployment.

Key Responsibilities:
 Ensure jusssmile.com meets all PWA installability requirements (valid Web App Manifest, Service Worker, HTTPS, and icons).
 Generate the TWA wrapper (using tools like Bubblewrap or PWABuilder).
 Configure Digital Asset Links to securely connect the website domain to the Android application.
 Generate the signed Android App Bundle (.aab).
 Set up the Google Play Console store listing, upload assets, and complete mandatory questionnaires (Content Rating, Data Safety, Privacy Policy).

jobs.title: Engineering Assessment for Church Conversion
jobs.description:
# Structural Engineering Feasibility Brief

## Church Conversion Project

### Project Overview

A suitably qualified and experienced Structural Engineer is required to undertake a **structural feasibility assessment** for the proposed conversion and refurbishment of an existing church building in the UK.

The existing building is **not listed** and is to be adapted to accommodate a new use. The project will involve alterations to the existing building fabric and internal arrangement, with the final proposals to be developed in coordination with the wider design team.

Due to the age and existing construction of the building, there may be limited information available regarding the original structural design, foundations and subsequent alterations. The purpose of the commission is therefore to establish the viability of the proposed works and identify any significant structural constraints or further investigations required at an early stage.

### Scope of Services

The Structural Engineer will be required to review the available existing information and undertake an initial site inspection to establish an understanding of the building's existing structural form and condition.

The feasibility assessment should consider, as applicable:

* Existing structural walls, masonry, floors and roof structures.
* Existing foundations and any apparent evidence of settlement or movement.
* The condition and apparent capacity of existing structural elements.
* Proposed alterations to the existing building and their structural implications.
* Formation of new openings and alterations to existing walls.
* Removal or modification of structural elements.
* Proposed new floors, mezzanines, stairs or other structural elements.
* Existing floor capacity in relation to the proposed use and occupancy.
* Additional loading associated with new building services, plant and equipment.
* Roof loading, including any proposed mechanical equipment or photovoltaic panels.
* Requirements for structural strengthening.
* Interfaces between new and existing construction.
* Potential temporary works requirements associated with structural alterations.
* The feasibility of any new foundations or structural elements required.
* Key construction and sequencing considerations.

The assessment should identify any areas where the existing construction cannot be adequately confirmed through the available information and recommend further investigation where necessary. This may include trial pits, opening-up works, roof or floor investigations, timber surveys, masonry investigations or other specialist surveys.

### Structural Approach

Where significant structural interventions are identified, the Structural Engineer should provide an **outline structural solution** and, where appropriate, consider alternative approaches.

The assessment should consider the technical feasibility, constructability, impact on the existing building, likely strengthening requirements and potential implications for project cost and programme.

The Structural Engineer should also coordinate with the wider design team to identify any structural requirements arising from the architectural proposals and proposed mechanical and electrical services.

### Deliverable

The primary deliverable will be a **Structural Engineering Feasibility Report** suitable for informing the developing design and wider project feasibility assessment.

The report should summarise:

* Existing structural form and condition.
* Structural feasibility of the proposed conversion.
* Key structural constraints and risks.
* Proposed structural interventions.
* Potential strengthening requirements.
* Foundation considerations.
* Further surveys or investigations required.
* Key recommendations for progressing the structural design.

The report should be supported by photographs, marked-up drawings and/or sketches where appropriate to clearly communicate the findings and proposed structural approach.

### Project Stage

The assessment is intended to support the project at **RIBA Stage 1/Stage 2** and should provide sufficient information to establish the structural viability of the proposed conversion and inform the subsequent design development.

Detailed structural calculations, construction drawings and detailed temporary works design are not required as part of this initial feasibility commission unless specifically agreed.

### Fee Proposal

The Structural Engineer is requested to provide a fee proposal based on the above scope, including the proposed number of site visits, deliverables, programme, assumptions and exclusions.

Relevant experience in **existing-building refurbishment, adaptive reuse, masonry construction and church or similar buildings** should also be included within the proposal.

Breve presentación.

Competencias y software.
Idiomas.

La web debe ser sencilla, profesional, visual y fácil de mantener, dando prioridad absoluta a la presentación de los proyectos y a mi trayectoria profesional.

jobs.title: Comprehensive Grant/Scholarship Research
jobs.description:
Research Target and Acceptance Criteria

The target is 200 unique potentially relevant grants / scholarships / foundations.

Research Rules

* Target: 200 unique opportunities
* No duplicates
* Exclude only opportunities that are clearly irrelevant
* If eligibility is uncertain, mark it as Unclear and include it
* If grant amount, deadline, MitID requirement, or other information cannot be found quickly, mark it as Unclear
* Do not spend excessive time researching a single opportunity
* When in doubt, include it
* The priority is to minimize missed opportunities rather than to achieve perfect eligibility accuracy
* After reaching 200 opportunities, please tell me if you believe there are still a substantial number of additional relevant opportunities that could be researched

Important

I am intentionally using a broad screening standard.

Some opportunities may later turn out to be ones I cannot apply for. This is acceptable.

I would rather receive some false positives than miss grants that I could potentially have applied for.

However, clearly irrelevant opportunities, fabricated information, duplicates, broken/non-existent grants, or entries with no reasonable connection to my background should not be included.

Delivery Acceptance Standard

The completed research will be considered successfully delivered if it meets a minimum 75% quality threshold.

I may review a random sample of approximately 40 entries from the submitted spreadsheet.

An entry will count as satisfactory if:

1. The grant / foundation actually exists
2. The source or website provided is genuine and reasonably relevant
3. There is a reasonable connection between the opportunity and my background
4. It is not a duplicate
5. Any information entered is reasonably supported by the source
6. Uncertain information has been marked as “Unclear” rather than invented
7. The opportunity is not obviously ineligible based on a clearly stated mandatory condition

At least 75% of the sampled entries must meet these standards for the final delivery to be accepted.

This does NOT mean that 75% of the grants must ultimately be grants I am eligible for.

Eligibility may legitimately remain uncertain.

The 75% threshold measures research quality and relevance, not final grant eligibility.

Track the number of messages sent per hour (minimum 60).
Critical rule – please read carefully:
You must send messages manually using the official WhatsApp app (mobile or desktop).
Using any third-party software, automation tools, bulk senders, scripts, or any unofficial method is strictly forbidden.
We verify sending patterns. If any automated or unauthorized tool is detected, your payment for the entire period will be forfeited – no exceptions. This is to protect deliverability and compliance.
Payment (clear and simple):

The first 60 messages per hour are covered by that base rate.
Every message above 60 → +$0.75 per extra message.
So if you send 70 in an hour, you earn $45 + (10 × $0.75) = $52.50 for that hour.
Why this is a great fit:
Work from anywhere, any time – just need WhatsApp on your phone or computer.
Start within 24 hours of signing up – we onboard quickly.
Zero experience required – we train you in 5 minutes and give you all templates.
No resume, no cover letter, no screening calls.
Perfect for beginners – the work is repetitive but consistent.
Important note:
We are testing a new system and opening only 5 spots for this first batch. The rate above applies exclusively to this initial group – once we have enough responders, we will close applications. This is not a long-term commitment, but a solid, paid activity for as long as the test runs.
If you can follow simple instructions, copy-paste accurately, and stay consistent – all while using only the official WhatsApp app – this is for you. Repetitive? Yes. Simple? Absolutely. Reliable income? That’s the idea.
Apply now – we’ll reach out within 24 hours with full details and your first templates.

Relentless Pacing (The "Never Static" Rule): Apply constant, subtle motion (slow zooms, pans) to every clip. Visuals should change every 3 to 5 seconds to match the micro-loops in the script.

Heavy Sound Design: Audio is 50% of the experience. You must add risers, sub-bass rumbles for tension, impact hits for financial reveals, whooshes for transitions, and appropriate documentary-style background music.

Requirements:

You must understand the YouTube algorithm, specifically how visual pacing impacts Average View Duration (AVD).

Expertise in Premiere Pro, After Effects, or CapCut Desktop.

Proven experience editing highly engaging, documentary-style YouTube videos (please do not apply if you only edit gaming highlights or talking-head vlogs).

To Apply, Please Include:

Links to 2-3 videos you have edited in this exact documentary/business breakdown style.

The word "ILLUSION" at the very top of your proposal so I know you read this brief.

Your rate for a 10-12 minute video.

Note: This is for the first video, but I have a roadmap of 10 videos scheduled (one every two weeks). If this project hits the retention targets, this will become a long-term, ongoing contract.

Skills Required:
Video Editing, After Effects, Motion Graphics, Sound Design, YouTube Strategy

jobs.title: YouTube Thumbnail Creator
jobs.description:
I publish regular content on YouTube and need thumbnails that feel professional, minimalist, and instantly legible even on a phone screen. For every video, I want two to three distinctly different concepts, each followed by a couple of small tweaks so we can A/B test which variation earns the stronger click-through rate.  

Here’s the workflow I have in mind:  
• You deliver the concepts, source files (PSD or AI), and correctly sized PNG exports.  
• I rotate each version for at least two days. If a thumbnail scores below a 5.5 % CTR, we adjust or move to a fresh concept—always within a two-week iteration window.  
• While monitoring CTR, you also keep an eye on average view duration and the first-three-minute retention curve. If the numbers hint that the visual promise of the thumbnail isn’t fulfilled early in the video, flag it so we can realign expectations.  

Title ideas and any overlay copy that strengthens the thumbnail’s hook should come packaged with each set. Clean typography, strong contrast, and plenty of negative space are essential; clutter, comedy graphics, and heavy textures are not a fit for this channel.  

By the end of each cycle I should have:  
1. 2-3 unique thumbnail designs + minor A/B variations  
2. A short line explaining why each concept should resonate with the target viewer  
3. Source files and final exports ready to upload  

If this systematic, data-driven approach to minimalist thumbnail design sounds like your wheelhouse, let’s start on the next upload.

jobs.title: Retail Zoho Books Bookkeeping Support
jobs.description:
I need a detail-oriented bookkeeper who knows Zoho Books inside out to keep my small retail operation’s accounts up to date on an ongoing basis. We average fewer than 100 transactions a month, but they span multiple countries, so you must be comfortable working with multi-currency ledgers—most entries come through in EUR and DKK.

Your core focus will be to:  
• Categorise and post every transaction accurately in Zoho Books  
• Reconcile bank, card and payment-gateway feeds each month  
• Produce clean P&L and balance-sheet reports that I can forward directly to my accountant

I am already set up on Zoho Books; you will receive viewer access first and then full access once we agree on a workflow. Consistency and timeliness matter more than speed, so if you can guarantee books closed within the first week of the new month, we’ll be a great fit.

Please outline your Zoho Books experience with retail businesses and confirm that you are comfortable managing both EUR and DKK ledgers.

Please study below details carefully before applying.

-------------------------------------------------------------------
Detailed job description

We are looking for a reliable and experienced bookkeeper to handle the ongoing bookkeeping for two small companies within the PowerMedic Group.

We operate almost entirely in Zoho, so strong practical experience with Zoho Books is important.

Our setup

The PowerMedic Group currently consists of three companies:

PowerMedic Service – Denmark
PowerMedic US – United States
PowerMedic Worldwide – international operations

Each company has its own Zoho Books organization and bank accounts.

Bookkeeping for PowerMedic US is already handled separately, so this role will primarily cover:

PowerMedic Service (Denmark)
PowerMedic Worldwide

Our Zoho automation and technical development are handled separately. You will not be expected to build Zoho integrations or write code.

The work

The role involves normal ongoing bookkeeping and financial administration in Zoho Books, including:

Recording and categorizing supplier bills and expenses
Issuing and recording customer invoices where required
Matching and categorizing bank transactions
Recording incoming and outgoing payments
Bank and account reconciliations
Maintaining customer and supplier balances
Following up on overdue customer invoices
Checking that transactions are correctly categorized for VAT
Month-end review and reconciliation
Keeping Zoho Books clean, accurate and up to date
Identifying missing documents, incorrect entries or discrepancies and bringing them to our attention
Occasional simple financial reports or information for management

We are looking for someone who is careful and proactive. If something is unclear, we want you to flag it rather than make assumptions.

Danish bookkeeping

Some invoices, receipts and expense descriptions for PowerMedic Service are in Danish.

You do not need to speak fluent Danish, but you must have sufficient understanding — with appropriate translation tools where necessary — to work with ordinary Danish bookkeeping documents and identify information such as:

Supplier and description
Invoice and payment dates
Amounts
Danish VAT (moms)
Payment information
Basic expense categories

If something is unclear, you should be comfortable asking us for clarification.

Please explain in your proposal how you would handle Danish-language invoices and receipts.

Experience with Danish or EU VAT/bookkeeping is an advantage.

What we're looking for

The ideal candidate has:

Strong hands-on experience with Zoho Books
Solid bookkeeping/accounting knowledge
Experience with bank reconciliation, accounts receivable and accounts payable
Good understanding of VAT
Excellent attention to detail
Good written English
Ability to work independently and consistently
A willingness to ask questions rather than guess
Availability for an ongoing working relationship

Experience with multiple companies and/or international businesses is an advantage.

Important

This is not a Zoho development position.

We already have a separate Zoho developer handling CRM, Desk, Books integrations and automation. Your role will be to make sure that the accounting itself is correct and up to date and to work with the automated processes once they are implemented.

When applying

Please briefly answer the following:

How much hands-on experience do you have with Zoho Books?
What types of companies have you handled ongoing bookkeeping for?
What experience do you have with VAT, particularly EU VAT if applicable?
How would you handle invoices and receipts written in Danish?
How do you normally handle transactions where the correct accounting or VAT treatment is unclear?
How many hours per week are you normally available for ongoing work?

Please do not send a generic bookkeeping proposal. We are particularly interested in your Zoho Books experience and your answer regarding Danish documents and VAT.

This is intended to become a long-term working relationship for the right person.

jobs.title: Local First News & Digital Platform Development
jobs.description:
Build a Scalable Local-First News & Digital Platform

Project Overview

We are looking for an experienced Full-Stack Developer or Development Team to build a scalable digital platform focused on Tamil Nadu / local-first news and information.

The platform will combine a modern news portal with several complementary services, creating a single destination where users can discover news, jobs, events, marketplace listings and personalized local information.

This is a production application, not a basic news website or template-based project.

Core Features

News Platform

- Modern responsive news website

- India, World, Politics, Business, Sports, Cinema, Technology, Education, Jobs and other categories
- Breaking news
- Live story updates
- Featured, latest, popular and trending news
- Article pages and author profiles
- Social sharing

Newsroom / CMS

- Advanced admin dashboard
- Article creation and editing
- Draft, review, approval and publishing workflow
- Scheduled publishing
- Reporter → Editor → Approval workflow
- Article revisions

- Canonical URLs
- AI-search/AEO-oriented content structure
- SEO management inside the CMS

Personalized Homepage

- Personalized/local content
- Location-based information
- Daily briefing
- Weather
- Gold price

- Market information

User System

- Location preferences
- Notifications
- Saved/bookmarked content

- Enquiry history
- Newsletter preferences

Marketplace

- Seller/vendor registration
- Seller dashboard
- Product/listing management
- Product search and filtering
- Location-based discovery
- Seller profiles
- Product enquiries

The initial marketplace will be enquiry-based, not a full e-commerce checkout system.

Jobs & Events

- Job discovery
- Categories and location filters
- Featured jobs
- Job expiry

- Location-based events

AI & Third-Party Integrations

The platform will integrate selected external services including AI and information APIs.

Technical Requirements

Backend

- Node.js
- NestJS preferred
- TypeScript
- REST API

Database

- PostgreSQL

Infrastructure

- AWS or comparable production cloud
- Docker
- Redis
- Background job/queue system
- CDN/object storage
- Cloudflare or equivalent

The developer may propose an alternative architecture if there is a strong technical reason.

---

Scalability & Reliability

The system must be designed for significant traffic growth.

Important requirements:

- Caching
- Background processing
- Queue-based external API processing
- Database optimization
- Proper error handling
- API timeouts/retries
- Graceful failure of third-party services
- Automated backups
- Monitoring and logging
- Security best practices
- Scalable deployment architecture

---

Ownership & Handover

Client must retain ownership/control of the following:

- Database
- Cloud infrastructure
- Domain
- Third-party API accounts
- Deployment configuration
- Documentation

The application must not be designed in a way that creates dependency on a particular developer or company.

jobs.title: Samarth Ashok Bharat Archival Research

jobs.title: B2B Lead Generation for AI Receptionist
jobs.description:
About the project

I am building an AI receptionist solution for businesses that handles incoming phone calls and WhatsApp messages 24/7.

The system can answer customer calls, handle approved questions, collect lead information, manage appointment requests, connect with calendars/CRMs, and follow up with customers through WhatsApp.

The initial target markets are:

Dental clinics
Medical/healthcare clinics
Private practices
Restaurants
Other businesses that depend heavily on incoming calls, WhatsApp messages and appointments

We are initially targeting Morocco, with the possibility of expanding internationally.

What I am looking for

I am not looking for someone who only creates posts, runs generic ads, or gives me a list of leads.

I am looking for an experienced B2B lead-generation specialist, sales agency, appointment setter, or marketing team that can help me acquire real businesses that have a genuine need for this solution.

Your job would be to:

Identify businesses that are strong potential customers
Find the actual decision-maker (owner, founder, director, manager, doctor, etc.)
Build qualified prospect lists
Contact prospects through appropriate channels
Start conversations
Qualify their interest
Book meetings/demos with interested decision-makers
Ideally help move qualified prospects toward becoming paying customers

I will handle the product demonstration, sales conversations and closing, unless we later agree that you should also participate in closing.

The most important requirement

I care about customers, not vanity metrics.

I don't need:

No 10,000 random leads
No Fake/low-quality contacts
No Generic email lists
NO Social-media followers
No Reports showing impressions and clicks with no customers

I need:

Qualified businesses → conversations with decision-makers → meetings → paying customers.

A smaller number of highly qualified prospects is much more valuable to me than thousands of irrelevant leads.

Ideal prospects

The best prospects are businesses where missed calls or unanswered WhatsApp messages can realistically mean lost customers or lost revenue.

For example:

Dental/medical clinics

Receive many appointment inquiries
Have busy receptionists
Receive calls outside working hours
Receive WhatsApp inquiries
Have multiple doctors/services
Advertise their services online

Restaurants

Receive reservation calls
Receive WhatsApp inquiries
Have busy periods
Frequently miss calls while serving customers
Depend on reservations and customer inquiries
Apartment/villa rental businesses
Car rental companies
Mechanics & auto repair shops
Hotels & guesthouses
Beauty salons, barbers & spas
Real-estate agencies
Home-service businesses

Your job is to identify businesses with these characteristics rather than simply targeting every business in a category.

Compensation / Partnership

I am open to a performance-based arrangement.

I am particularly interested in working with someone who is confident enough in their ability to generate customers that they are willing to have a significant part of their compensation tied to results.

For qualified customers that you successfully bring to the business, I am willing to discuss a commission/revenue-share arrangement, potentially up to 20% of the revenue generated from customers you acquire, depending on the exact role and agreement.

We can also discuss a hybrid model involving a smaller fixed fee + performance commission if that makes more sense.

The exact commission structure will be agreed upon before starting.

I am not promising guaranteed income or a guaranteed number of customers. I want a genuine performance-based relationship where both sides benefit when customers are acquired.

What I will provide

I will provide:

The AI receptionist product
Product information
Target customer profile
Sales messaging
Demonstrations
Support during sales calls
Information needed to qualify prospects
Fast feedback on leads and campaigns

I am also willing to work closely with the marketing/sales partner to improve the offer based on what prospects are telling us.

What I expect from you

Please don't apply with a generic message saying:

"We are a digital marketing agency and can generate thousands of leads."

I want you to explain exactly how you would get customers for this particular product.

In your proposal, please answer:

1. Have you previously generated B2B customers for SaaS, AI, automation, software, telecom, or similar services?

2. Which market would you target first: dental/medical clinics, restaurants, or another niche? Why?

3. How would you find the decision-makers?

4. Which channels would you use?

For example:

Cold calling
Email
WhatsApp
LinkedIn
Paid advertising
Google Maps/business databases
Other methods

5. How many qualified prospects could you realistically reach per week?

6. What would your expected process be from prospect → meeting → customer?

7. What results have you achieved for previous clients?

Please provide real examples if possible.

8. What compensation model would you propose?

Long-term opportunity

This is not intended to be a one-month marketing experiment.

My goal is to build a long-term business where we continuously acquire new clinics, restaurants and other businesses and deploy the AI receptionist for them.

If you can consistently bring qualified customers, there is an opportunity for an ongoing partnership and recurring commissions rather than simply completing one Freelancer project.

If you have a proven ability to generate paying B2B customers, I want to hear from you.

Tell me how you would get the first 5 customers, what you would need from me, and how you would structure the partnership.

jobs.title: Intact Insurance Claims Specialist Sought
jobs.description:
# Intact Insurance Claims Specialist Needed – Uber Driver Occupational Accident Claim Review

I am looking for an experienced insurance claims professional, medical billing specialist, claims adjuster, paralegal, or case manager who has **previous hands-on experience dealing with Intact Insurance**, preferably involving an Uber/rideshare driver Occupational Accident Insurance claim.

## Project Scope

This project is specifically and exclusively about **Intact Insurance**.

An Uber driver was injured in a motor vehicle accident while working, received substantial medical treatment, underwent surgery, and was unable to work for a significant period.

I need an independent expert to review and explain how the **Intact Insurance claim should have been handled**, particularly regarding:

* Medical expenses
* Medical billing
* Medical records
* Explanation of Benefits (EOBs)
* Payment ledgers
* Required claim forms
* Proof of loss
* Lost wages / disability or income-replacement benefits
* Communication with Intact
* Required documentation
* Claim-processing procedures
* Delayed, rejected, returned, or incorrectly submitted claims

## PRIOR INTACT INSURANCE EXPERIENCE IS HIGHLY PREFERRED

I am particularly interested in someone who has personally dealt with **Intact Insurance claims representatives or adjusters**.

Experience involving Uber, Lyft, rideshare, gig workers, or Occupational Accident Insurance is strongly preferred.

Please do not apply solely based on general medical billing experience if you have no knowledge of Intact Insurance or Occupational Accident claims.

## Work Required

The selected freelancer will review documents and correspondence relating to the Intact claim and prepare an independent written report.

The report should determine:

1. What benefits were potentially available under the applicable Intact coverage.

2. What procedures should normally have been followed to obtain those benefits.

3. What documents Intact required for processing medical expenses.

4. How medical bills, records, EOBs, payment ledgers, and other supporting documentation should have been submitted.

5. What procedures should have been followed for loss-of-income, disability, or similar benefits, if covered.

6. What responsibilities belonged to the claimant, attorney/law firm, medical providers, and Intact.

7. Whether Intact requested additional information or corrections after receiving incomplete or incorrect submissions.

8. Whether there were unnecessary delays in responding to Intact's requests.

9. Whether required documents were submitted correctly and within an appropriate timeframe.

10. Whether any procedural errors may have delayed or affected payment of benefits.

11. Whether Intact provided instructions explaining how deficiencies should be corrected.

12. Whether those instructions appear to have been properly followed.

13. What medical expenses and other benefits Intact actually paid, based on the available documentation.

14. Whether any bills or claimed benefits remain unpaid, unresolved, rejected, or insufficiently documented.

15. What additional documents should now be requested from Intact to establish a complete claim history and accounting.

## Detailed Timeline Required

I want the freelancer to create a chronological timeline based on the actual documents.

For every significant Intact communication, identify:

**Date → Sender → Recipient → Request/Issue → Required Action → Response → Time Taken → Result**

This is an important part of the assignment because I want to determine where delays occurred and who was responsible for completing each required step.

## Medical Billing Analysis

The report should reconcile, as far as the available records permit:

**Medical Provider → Amount Billed → Date Submitted to Intact → Amount Approved → Amount Paid → Amount Denied/Unpaid → Reason → Current Status**

Any discrepancy should be clearly identified.

## Lost-Wage / Disability Benefit Analysis

If the applicable Intact policy provided wage-loss, disability, or income-replacement benefits, explain:

* Eligibility requirements
* Waiting period
* Benefit amount/percentage
* Maximum benefit
* Required medical disability certification
* Required Uber earnings documentation
* Tax/1099 requirements
* Proof-of-income requirements
* Dates claimed
* Amount potentially payable
* Amount actually paid
* Any unpaid or disputed period

Do not assume that a particular benefit was available. The analysis should be based on the actual policy/coverage and Intact documentation.

## Documents to Review

The freelancer may be provided with:

* Emails with Intact
* Emails between Intact and the law firm
* Intact letters
* Claim forms
* Medical bills
* Medical records
* EOBs
* Payment information
* Medical payment ledgers
* Uber earnings records
* Disability/off-work documentation
* Correspondence concerning missing or incorrectly submitted documents
* Other relevant attachments

The freelancer must be willing to **carefully review the complete correspondence and attachments**, rather than relying only on a summary of the case.

## Final Report

The final report should include:

* Executive summary
* Intact coverage/benefit analysis
* Chronological Intact claim timeline
* Medical billing analysis
* Lost-income/disability benefit analysis
* Documentation requested by Intact
* Documentation actually submitted
* Missing/incomplete submissions
* Intact's responses and instructions
* Identified procedural problems
* Identified delays
* Financial/payment reconciliation
* Outstanding questions
* Documents that should now be requested from Intact
* Conclusions supported by the underlying correspondence and documents

Please clearly distinguish between **documented facts, professional opinion, and assumptions**.

## Questions Applicants Must Answer

Please answer the following when submitting your proposal:

1. Have you personally handled a claim involving **Intact Insurance**? If yes, what type?

2. Have you handled an **Occupational Accident Insurance** claim?

3. Have you worked on an Uber, Lyft, rideshare, delivery-driver, or gig-worker injury claim?

4. Have you communicated directly with Intact claims adjusters or representatives?

5. Have you submitted or reviewed medical bills, EOBs, medical records, or payment ledgers for Intact?

6. Have you handled lost-wage or disability documentation for Intact?

7. Have you dealt with a situation where Intact returned a submission, requested additional documentation, or explained that a claim had been submitted incorrectly?

8. Can you review a large collection of emails and attachments and reconstruct the entire Intact claim chronologically?

9. Can you identify which party was responsible for taking action at each stage of the claim?

10. Can you prepare a detailed written report supported by specific emails, documents, dates, and financial records?

**Please describe your actual Intact Insurance experience. Generic proposals will not be considered.**

jobs.title: Senior Data Acquisition & Document Intelligence Engineer
jobs.description:
Project Title: Senior Data Acquisition & Document Intelligence Engineer

We are looking for a highly experienced Senior Data Acquisition & Document Intelligence Engineer to build, operate, and continuously improve a large-scale production data acquisition and document processing system.

Project Type: Long-term / Ongoing
Engagement: Full-time
Experience Required: 5+ years
Location: On-site / Hybrid

About the Project

We collect large volumes of publicly available documents and structured records from hundreds of external web sources every day.

The sources are highly inconsistent and frequently change their website structure, formats, URLs, APIs, and document layouts. A significant portion of the data also comes from scanned PDFs, images, and other difficult-to-process documents.

We need someone who can take end-to-end ownership of the entire data acquisition pipeline, including web scraping, crawling, document downloading, OCR, data extraction, structuring, validation, quality assurance, monitoring, and ongoing maintenance.

This is not a one-time scraping project. We are looking for someone with proven experience building and maintaining production-grade extraction pipelines at scale.

Key Responsibilities

1. Web Scraping & Data Acquisition

Build and maintain large-scale crawlers across hundreds of websites and external data sources.
Handle dynamic websites, JavaScript rendering, pagination, sessions, cookies, tokens, forms, and file downloads.
Work with technologies such as Python, Scrapy, Playwright, Selenium, Puppeteer, Requests/httpx, etc.
Implement rate limiting, retries, backoff, and request management.
Build incremental crawling and change-detection mechanisms.
Detect website/source changes and quickly fix broken extractors.
Ensure data is collected completely, accurately, and on schedule.

2. OCR & Document Processing

Process large volumes of native PDFs, scanned PDFs, images, and other document formats.
Build and optimize OCR pipelines for poor-quality documents.
Handle skewed/rotated pages, faded text, stamps, seals, watermarks, handwriting, and complex layouts.
Apply image preprocessing such as deskewing, denoising, binarization, cropping, and image enhancement.
Extract structured information from complex tables, including merged cells, multi-page tables, borderless tables, and nested headers.
Process multilingual documents, including Indian regional languages.
Benchmark and select appropriate OCR engines based on document type and accuracy.

3. Data Extraction & Structuring

Convert unstructured web/document content into structured datasets.
Design and maintain data schemas.
Use rules, regex, layout-aware extraction, NLP/NER, and LLM-assisted extraction where appropriate.
Normalize dates, amounts, units, names, addresses, identifiers, and other inconsistent values.
Implement deduplication and entity resolution.
Maintain taxonomies, classification logic, and reference/master data.

4. Data Quality & Validation

Build automated quality checks for completeness, accuracy, freshness, consistency, uniqueness, and validity.
Implement validation and anomaly-detection mechanisms.
Maintain gold-standard datasets and benchmark extraction/OCR accuracy.
Create human-in-the-loop review processes for low-confidence results.
Reconcile extracted data against the original source.
Maintain data lineage and audit trails so records can be traced back to the original source document and extraction run.

5. Production Operations

Build and operate reliable, scheduled production pipelines.
Use Airflow, Prefect, Dagster, or similar orchestration tools.
Implement monitoring, logging, alerting, retries, and failure recovery.
Track uptime, throughput, latency, coverage, cost, and data quality.
Use Docker and CI/CD.
Troubleshoot production issues and prevent recurring failures.
Document the system, extraction logic, and operational procedures.
Must-Have Skills
5+ years of hands-on experience in production data extraction, web scraping, document processing, or data acquisition.
Strong Python programming and production engineering practices.
Strong experience with large-scale web scraping/crawling.
Experience with Scrapy, Playwright, Selenium, Puppeteer, Requests/httpx, or equivalent.
Deep practical OCR experience with Tesseract, PaddleOCR, EasyOCR, Google Document AI, AWS Textract, Azure Document Intelligence, or similar.
Strong PDF/document processing experience with PyMuPDF, pdfplumber, pdfminer, Camelot, Tabula, or equivalent.
Strong SQL and relational database knowledge.
PostgreSQL or equivalent database experience.
Experience with Airflow, Prefect, Dagster, or similar workflow orchestration.
Experience with AWS and/or GCP.
Experience with Docker, CI/CD, logging, monitoring, and alerting.
Strong understanding of data quality and automated testing.
Experience maintaining and improving production datasets over time.
Understanding of responsible and lawful web data collection, including robots.txt, terms of service, privacy, and applicable data protection requirements.
Good to Have
OpenCV and image processing
NLP / NER
LLM-based document extraction
Multilingual OCR
Indian regional language OCR
Entity resolution / record linkage
Data lineage and provenance
Great Expectations, Soda, Pandera, or similar
dbt and dbt tests
BigQuery
AWS S3, Lambda, Batch
GCP Cloud Storage
Distributed/batch processing
Experience with government, legal, financial, regulatory, or public-sector documents
Ideal Candidate

We are not looking for someone who has only built basic scraping scripts.

The ideal candidate should have experience operating a production system involving:

Hundreds of Sources → Crawling → Document Acquisition → OCR → Data Extraction → Structuring → Validation → QA → Production Dataset

You should understand common failure points such as website changes, broken selectors, missing documents, OCR errors, duplicate records, incorrect table extraction, silent pipeline failures, source downtime, and data quality degradation—and know how to build systems that detect and recover from these issues.

To Apply

Please send your CV along with a brief description of:

The largest scraping/document extraction pipeline you have personally managed.
Number of sources/websites handled.
Approximate daily/monthly volume of documents or records.
Types of documents processed.
Technologies and frameworks used.
Your measured OCR/extraction accuracy, if available.
How you measured and improved accuracy.
One example where a production pipeline failed silently, how you discovered it, and what you changed to prevent it from happening again.

Please provide specific numbers, technologies, and examples wherever possible. We are particularly interested in candidates with hands-on experience operating large-scale, continuously running production data acquisition systems.

jobs.title: Convert PDF Tables to Sheets

jobs.title: Full-Stack Development for Travel Agency Website, Booking, Quotation & Payment Platform

* Travel packages
* Tour programs
* Honeymoon packages
* Seasonal travel offers

Customers should be able to view, request, and purchase selected services directly from the website.

We need a powerful admin dashboard to manage:

* Products
* Customers
* Orders
* Payments
* Invoices
* Travel offers / quotations
* Destination reports
* Website content
* Media and files
* User roles and permissions

Our staff should be able to create a customized travel offer for a customer by adding:

* Customer details

* Hotels
* Room types
* Ground transportation
* Drivers
* Tours and activities
* Daily itinerary
* Included / excluded services
* Final price
* VAT

`flysmart.sa/offer/XXXXXX`

The customer can open the link, review the full travel offer, approve it, and proceed to payment.

Offer statuses should include:
Draft, Sent, Viewed, Approved, Pending Payment, Paid, Expired, Cancelled.

**5. Online Payments**

https://developers.paymob.com/paymob-docs/integration-paths/apis

The integration must include:

* Webhooks
* HMAC verification
* Transaction validation
* Payment status management
* Sandbox / production environments

We need to manage these reports from the admin dashboard.

Each destination can contain:

* Currency
* Language
* Safety

* Advantages / disadvantages
* Airports
* Airlines
* Transportation
* Trains
* Suggested itineraries

* Recommended hotels
* Images
* Google Maps links
* Travel tips

Each destination should have an SEO-friendly page such as:

`flysmart.sa/destinations/poland`

**8. SEO**
The website must follow Google SEO best practices, including:

* SEO titles and descriptions
* Canonical URLs
* XML Sitemap
* robots.txt
* Structured Data / Schema
* Breadcrumbs
* 301 redirects
* Editable URL slugs
* Image alt text
* Internal linking
* Core Web Vitals
* Mobile performance optimization

**9. Analytics & Advertising Tracking**
Integration with:

* Google Analytics 4
* Google Tag Manager
* Google Search Console
* Google Ads Conversion Tracking
* TikTok Pixel
* X Pixel

The website should also support UTM tracking and conversion events such as:

* Lead submission
* WhatsApp click
* Product view
* Offer view
* Offer approval
* Begin checkout
* Purchase

We want to track the full customer journey from advertising campaign to completed payment.

**10. Scalability**
The system must be database-driven and built with a clean, scalable architecture.

We may later add:

* Customer accounts
* CRM
* Supplier management
* Visa document uploads
* WhatsApp API
* SMS
* Loyalty program
* Hotel APIs
* Airline APIs
* Mobile app

Therefore, we do not want a solution based on manually created HTML pages or a system that will need to be rebuilt later.

### 2. WhatsApp Business Content

Create attractive WhatsApp Business posts/creative materials for our existing followers and audience.

The objective is to:

* Increase awareness of our Herbal Clinic
* Educate our audience
* Keep followers engaged
* Increase enquiries and consultations
* Build familiarity and trust with our brand

Content should not feel like constant sales promotion. The focus should be on useful educational and awareness-based communication.

* Keyword research

* Page titles and meta descriptions
* Heading/content optimization
* Local SEO
* Google Business Profile optimization
* Internal linking
* Basic technical SEO recommendations

The objective is to increase **organic visibility and relevant enquiries**, rather than simply generating traffic.

### 4. Visual & Brand Quality

We want a consistent visual identity across:

* Instagram
* WhatsApp
* Website
* Google Business Profile

The overall look should be **professional, clean, trustworthy, modern and botanical**, suitable for a healthcare brand.

AI tools may be used where appropriate, but the final content should not look obviously AI-generated or generic.

### What We Provide

We will provide:

* Content ideas/topics
* Scripts where required
* Herbal/healthcare subject direction
* Clinic information
* Brand information and materials
* Approval/review of healthcare-related content

### What We Expect From You

Please apply only if you can demonstrate actual work in:

* Instagram Reels
* Educational/social media content
* Video editing
* Canva or similar design tools
* AI-assisted content production where appropriate
* WhatsApp Business marketing
* SEO
* Local SEO / Google Business Profile

### Important

Experience with **healthcare, wellness, herbal, Ayurveda, Unani, nutrition or similar businesses** is preferred.

Because this is a healthcare-related brand, we do not want exaggerated or misleading medical claims such as “guaranteed cure,” “100% safe,” “permanent cure,” etc.

### When Applying, Please Send

1. 3–5 examples of Instagram posts/Reels you have created.
2. Examples of your work
3. Examples of websites you have worked on for SEO.
4. Your experience with local SEO/Google Business Profile.
5. Which tools you use for video editing and design.
6. Whether you use AI video/image tools and which ones.

8. What exactly is included in your monthly package.
9. Expected turnaround time for posts/Reels.


We are looking for someone interested in building a **long-term brand**, not simply producing random social media posts.

jobs.title: GROUND REALITY MARKET RESEARCH AGENT - KENYA
jobs.description:
Summary
Task-Based | Field Research | B2B Sales | Potential Long-Term Opportunity

About Us

We are ZAM ZAM ENTERPRISES, an India-based apparel manufacturer and exporter, and the manufacturer of 5BROS brand.

We manufacture T-shirts, polos, oversized T-shirts, hoodies, sportswear garments for wholesale, private-label, OEM and institutional customers.

We are currently exploring expansion into East African markets, particularly Kenya, Uganda and Ethiopia.

Before making significant steps in these markets, we want to understand the real market situation on the ground.

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for local sales/market research agents who are physically based in Kenya, can conduct genuine field-level research.

This is NOT a desk-research-only project.

You should be able to visit local markets, wholesalers, distributors and potential business customers and collect information directly from the market.

Initial Task – Ground Reality Market Research

The selected agent will be assigned a specific city/market and a defined research task.

Your responsibilities may include:

1. Market Mapping

Identify major T-shirt and apparel wholesale markets
Identify important retail markets
Identify wholesalers, distributors and importers
Identify promotional apparel suppliers
Identify uniform suppliers
Identify institutional apparel buyers

2. Product Research

Identify fast-moving T-shirt styles
Round-neck T-shirts
Polo T-shirts
Oversized T-shirts
Sportswear
Hoodies
Plain/basic T-shirts
School/company/uniform T-shirts

3. Standard Size and Price Research
Collect actual Size Chart and market selling prices for relevant products.

Where possible, RECORD:

Product type
Fabric composition
Approximate GSM
Quality level
Wholesale price
Retail price
Country of origin
Popular brands
Minimum order quantities

4. Buyer Research

Identify genuine potential B2B buyers such as:

Garment wholesalers
Clothing distributors
Retail chains
Apparel shops
Uniform suppliers
Schools and institutions
Corporate uniform suppliers
NGOs
Sportswear dealers

5. Ground Verification
We want real information, not copied internet data.

The agent may be required to:
Visit markets physically
Speak with sellers/buyers
Take permitted photographs of market/product displays
Collect business cards/contact details
Record WhatsApp/phone/email information
Ask basic questions about sourcing and demand
Verify whether a business is genuinely active

6. Competitor Research

Identify:
Local brands
Imported brands
Chinese suppliers
Turkish suppliers
Indian suppliers
Other major sources

Understand what products they sell and their approximate price positioning.

Required Deliverables

At the end of the task, you must provide:

Market Research Report
List of verified potential buyers
Product and price comparison
Competitor information
Photos/evidence from field visits where permitted
Contact details of relevant businesses
Key market observations
Recommendations for our 5BROS brand
Potential opportunities and challenges
Suggested next steps for entering the market

The information should be submitted in Google Sheets/Excel + a concise written report.

Important: This Is a Ground-Level Assignment

We are specifically interested in freelancers who can provide first-hand local market information.

Please do not apply if you intend to complete the entire assignment through Google, social media or online directories without visiting the market.

We want someone who can actually go PHYSICALLY into the market and tell us:

What is selling? Who is buying? At what price? From whom? What quality do they expect? And where is the opportunity for an Indian manufacturer like us?

Preferred Candidate

You should:

Be physically located in Kenya.
Have good knowledge of your local apparel market
Have experience in sales, business development or market research
Be comfortable visiting markets and businesses
Have good communication skills
Be able to communicate in English
Have a smartphone for calls, WhatsApp and photographs
Be comfortable using Google Sheets/Excel
Be honest and accurate with collected information
Be able to work independently

Previous experience in apparel, textiles, uniforms, wholesale, distribution or FMCG sales is a strong advantage.

Compensation

The initial assignment will have a clearly defined scope and milestone.

We are open to discussing the budget based on:

Number of markets covered
Number of verified businesses identified
Number of field visits
Quality of research
Depth of information collected

Strong performers may be offered additional paid assignments and a longer-term Sales & Business Development role.

The long-term opportunity may involve:

Buyer development
Lead generation
Distributor identification
Customer meetings
Sample coordination
Sales follow-up
Order generation
Local market representation
How to Apply

Please answer the following questions in your proposal:

1. Which country and city are you currently based in?

2. Are you physically available to visit wholesale/retail markets?

3. Have you previously worked in apparel, textiles, fashion, uniforms or B2B sales? Explain briefly.

5. How many potential wholesalers/distributors/retailers can you realistically identify and verify during the assignment?

6. Have you previously conducted field market research? Please provide an example.

“I am physically based in [COUNTRY/CITY] and I can conduct ground-level market research.”

Applications that do not clearly mention your current country and city may not be considered.

Potential Long-Term Opportunity

If the research is successful, we would like to build a longer-term relationship with selected agents in Kenya, Uganda and Ethiopia for the expansion of our apparel business.

We are looking for local market knowledge — not just online research.

**Serious inquiries only.**

jobs.title: AI E-Commerce Sales Boost Platform
jobs.description:
My goal is to lift online revenue by building an e-commerce platform that serves each shopper a real-time, AI-driven stream of product suggestions. The entire architecture—from data ingestion to user-facing widgets—should be engineered around this single purpose: increasing sales through highly relevant recommendations.

Core functionality
The heart of the build is a personalised recommendation engine. It should analyse browsing behaviour, purchase history, and contextual signals to deliver on-page and in-email product suggestions that feel hand-picked for every visitor. While dynamic pricing and automated marketing campaigns may follow later, phase one focuses exclusively on perfecting these recommendations.

Technical expectations
•  End-to-end platform or plug-in capable of integrating with common stacks (Shopify, WooCommerce, custom React/Node, etc.).
•  Scalable data pipeline—batch and real-time—to capture events, train models, and serve predictions with low latency.
•  Model layer leveraging proven libraries (TensorFlow, PyTorch, or similar) and techniques such as collaborative filtering and deep learning for cold-start mitigation.
•  Admin dashboard for A/B testing, rule overrides, and performance analytics (CTR, AOV lift, revenue attribution).

Deliverables
1. Deployed, production-ready storefront or extension with live product-suggestion widgets.
2. Source code repository with clean commit history and automated tests.
3. Infrastructure-as-code scripts (Docker/Kubernetes or equivalent) for reproducible deployment.
4. Documentation: setup guide, API spec, data schema, and a short walkthrough video.

Acceptance criteria
•  Recommendation latency under 200 ms at P95.
•  At least a 5 % uplift in click-through rate during pilot A/B test against a static control list.
•  No critical errors in load testing at 5× expected peak traffic.

Timeline is flexible within reason, provided milestones are met and performance targets are verifiable. I’m available throughout for dataset provisioning, brand assets, and iterative feedback.

• The project is entirely hosted in Cloud Run; no App Engine or Compute Engine involved.

• Container logs show the request reaching the revision, yet Cloud Run still surfaces a 404 to the browser.  

I’d like you to jump in, isolate the root cause, and leave me with a clean, reproducible fix. That may involve checking service revisions, URL mapping, IAM or firewall quirks, health checks, Google Cloud Load Balancer settings—whatever gets us to a reliable solution.  

Deliverables  
1. Diagnosis summary explaining why the route fails while others succeed.  
2. Step-by-step remediation instructions (or automated Terraform/YAML changes) that I can re-apply on future deploys.  
3. Confirmation the route now responds with the intended payload in staging and production.  

If you have deep Cloud Run troubleshooting experience and can screen-share or swap through git commits quickly, I’m eager to get this mystery resolved.

• Clean, tested commits (unit or integration as appropriate) for both frontend and backend  
• Updated Docker files or scripts if runtime tweaks are needed

Quality is paramount, so please favour readable code, descriptive commits, and reliable tests over quick hacks. If something blocks progress—whether a library, build pipeline, or infrastructure quirk—flag it early and we’ll resolve it together.

jobs.title: Regulatory Compliant Finance Copywriting
jobs.description:
UK/SA Finance Promotional CopCrafting financial copy for the UK and South African markets requires navigating two distinct, highly rigorous regulatory frameworks. While both jurisdictions prioritize consumer protection and transparency, they are governed by separate regulatory bodies and statutory rules—principally the Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) in the United Kingdom and the Financial Sector Conduct Authority (FSCA) alongside the Financial Advisory and Intermediary Services (FAIS) Act in South Africa.
Key Regulatory Pillars for Copywriters
1. United Kingdom (FCA Regulations)
 * The "Fair, Clear and Not Misleading" Rule: Under COBS 4 and CONC 3 of the FCA Handbook, every communication must be balanced. You cannot highlight potential returns or benefits without giving equal, prominent weight to the associated risks.
 * Section 21 of FSMA: Any financial promotion must be communicated or approved by an FCA-authorised firm. Unauthorised copywriters must ensure their clients or approver firms sign off on text.
 * Risk Warnings: High-risk investments (like cryptoassets or peer-to-peer lending) require standardized, prominent risk warnings (e.g., "Don't invest unless you're prepared to lose all the money you invest").
 * Banned Inducements: The FCA strictly prohibits design elements or copy hooks that create artificial urgency or pressure retail investors to act quickly (e.g., "Act now before this closes!").
2. South Africa (FSCA & FAIS Regulations)
 * Treating Customers Fairly (TCF): Copy must align with the TCF outcomes, ensuring products are marketed transparently to the correct target market without hidden caveats or complex jargon.
 * FAIS Disclosure Requirements: Promotional material must clearly state whether an entity is an authorised Financial Services Provider (FSP), detailing its FSP license category and whether it operates under a binder or intermediary agreement.
 * Avoidance of Misleading Claims: Performance past-returns disclaimers ("Past performance is no guarantee of future results") must be prominent, and fees must be explicitly transparent.
Illustrative Copywriting Examples
The following comparative examples demonstrate how to frame compliant, high-converting financial copy for both markets across different sectors.
Example A: Consumer Credit / Personal Loans
 * UK Version (FCA / CONC Compliant):
   > Clear, Flexible Borrowing Options
   > Need to manage upcoming expenses? Explore our range of personal loans tailored to your budget.
   > Representative Example: Borrowing £5,000 over 36 months at a representative APR of 7.9% fixed, you would pay £154.63 per month. Total amount repayable: £5,566.68.
   > Warning: Late repayment can cause you serious money problems. For help, go to moneyhelper.org.uk.
   > [Check Your Eligibility Risk-Free] (Note: Soft search check)
   > 
 * SA Version (National Credit Act / FAIS Compliant):
   > Transparent Personal Finance Solutions
   > Take control of your financial goals with a personal loan structured around your affordability.
   > Loan Details: Amounts from R10,000 to R250,000 over 12 to 60 months. Interest rates range from 11.5% to max NCA limits, customized to your risk profile. Initiation and monthly service fees apply as regulated by the National Credit Act.
   > Disclaimer: [Registered Credit Provider NCRCPXYZ] / Terms and conditions apply.
   > [Calculate Your Installment]
   > 
Example B: Retail Investment / Wealth Management
 * UK Version (FCA / COBS Compliant):
   > Put Your Capital to Work
   > Discover our Stocks and Shares ISA portfolio options designed for medium-to-long-term growth (5+ years).
   > Capital at risk. The value of investments can go down as well as up, and you may get back less than you invest. Tax rules apply and depend on individual circumstances.
   > [Explore Portfolio Strategies]
   > 
 * SA Version (FSCA / FAIS Compliant):
   > Grow Your Wealth with Expert Guidance
   > Invest in local and global markets through our diversified unit trust portfolios, managed by licensed FSP professionals.
   > Risk Disclosure: Collective Investment Schemes (CIS) are generally medium- to long-term investments. Past performance is not necessarily a guide to future performance. The value of participatory interests may go down as well as up.
   > [Speak to an Authorised Advisor]
   > 
Quick Compliance Checklist for Financial Copywriters
 * Are the disclaimers prominent? They cannot be hidden in microscopic footer text or low-contrast colors.
 * Is the tone objective? Avoid hype words like "guaranteed," "effortless," "unbeatable," or "risk-free" unless legally factual and backed by ironclad compliance proof.
 * Are licensing credentials present? Always feature the correct regulatory identifiers (e.g., FCA firm reference numbers or South African FSP numbers) where mandatory.
 * Is the target audience appropriate? Ensure retail-facing text does not inadvertently cross into restricted wholesale or high-net-worth promotion territory without proper gating.

jobs.title: Identifying & Mitigating Prescription Leakage
jobs.description:
Prescription Leakage: Why Pharmacies Lose Patients (And How to Stop It)

If you run a pharmacy or work anywhere close to the healthcare business, you've probably heard the term "prescription leakage." It sounds technical, but the idea behind it is pretty simple. It just means patients getting a prescription written at one place and then filling it somewhere else. That "somewhere else" could be a competitor pharmacy, an online service, or even a mail-order company. Every time that happens, the original pharmacy loses a sale it should have kept.

It might not sound like a big deal when it happens once. But add it up over months, and it turns into a serious revenue problem. Some studies suggest independent pharmacies lose a noticeable chunk of their potential business this way, without even realizing it's happening.

Why Does It Happen?

There's no single reason. Usually, it's a mix of small gaps that add up.

Convenience is a big one. If a patient's insurance plan pushes them toward a certain pharmacy chain, they'll go there, even if they've been loyal to a local pharmacy for years. Price also plays a role. If a patient sees a lower price at a big chain or an online pharmacy, many will switch without thinking twice.

Sometimes it's simpler than that. A doctor sends the prescription electronically to whichever pharmacy is already saved in the system, and the patient doesn't even choose. Or the patient just forgets to specify their preferred pharmacy when they're at the doctor's office, and the default option wins.

There's also the issue of follow-up. A lot of pharmacies fill the first prescription just fine, but don't have a system to remind patients when a refill is due. So when it's time to renew, the patient just picks whatever pharmacy is closest or easiest, since nobody reached out first.

Why It Matters More Than People Think

Prescription leakage doesn't just cost a single sale. It costs the whole relationship. A patient who fills a prescription somewhere else once might just keep going there for future refills too. And once a patient starts buying other things there, like over-the-counter items or health supplies, that pharmacy has basically become their new default.

For smaller, independent pharmacies, this adds up fast. They're already competing against big chains with more locations and lower prices. Losing patients to leakage on top of that makes it even harder to stay profitable.

What Can Be Done About It

The good news is that prescription leakage isn't something pharmacies just have to accept. There are practical ways to reduce it.

Make refills automatic and easy. If a pharmacy has a system that reminds patients when it's time to refill, or better yet, refills automatically and just notifies the patient, most people will stick with it out of pure convenience.

Stay in touch with patients. A quick text or call when a prescription is close to running out keeps the pharmacy top of mind. Patients are far less likely to switch somewhere else if they've already been reminded.

Work closely with local doctors. When pharmacies build good relationships with nearby clinics and doctors, they're more likely to be the default pharmacy chosen when a new prescription gets sent electronically.

Offer something the big chains don't. This could be faster service, personal advice, home delivery, or just knowing patients by name. People value that kind of personal touch, especially with something as important as their health.

Track where patients are going. Pharmacy software can often show if certain prescriptions aren't being picked up or renewed. That's a signal something is going wrong, and it's worth following up before the patient is gone for good.

The Bottom Line

Prescription leakage happens quietly. Most pharmacies don't notice it until they look closely at their numbers and realize how many patients they're losing without ever losing them "officially." The fix isn't complicated, though. It mostly comes down to staying connected with patients, making refills effortless, and giving people a real reason to keep coming back. Small changes here can make a real difference over time.

Description:
We run two Python trading bots: one on OANDA (FX/CFD), one on Schwab (options). We need infrastructure fixes, NOT a new trading strategy — we already tested and rejected a breakout strategy against real historical data, so please don’t pitch indicators or “high win rate” ideas.
Scope:
1.	Asset lock (OANDA): Restrict the bot to a short instrument allow-list (e.g. NAS100_USD, SPX500_USD, EUR_USD), enforced at the order-request level, not just config.
2.	Permanent trade log: Append-only CSV/SQLite logger recording every order decision (timestamp, instrument, reasoning, size, SL/TP, result) — must survive outside system journald, which currently loses history after ~32 hours.
3.	Schwab options sizing fix: Refactor contract sizing to enforce a $500 minimum trade size (via ceiling math), $300 max per-contract ask, 5-contract cap, with up to $600 total overrun allowed. Include unit tests.

jobs.title: Zirakpur Appliance Repair Technician Needed

jobs.title: Omegle-Style Random Matching Platform
jobs.description:
I’m building a web platform that recreates Omegle’s “talk to a stranger” experience, but with modern polish and mandatory user accounts. The core requirement is a fast, reliable random-matching engine: as soon as a logged-in user clicks “Start,” the system should pair them with another available user and open a private chat room. When either party disconnects, both are returned to the lobby and can start again instantly.

Account flow  
• Email/password registration, secure login and logout  
• Password-reset or “forgot password” path  
• Basic e-mail verification to keep out bots

In-chat experience  
• Clean, responsive chat interface (text by default; we can discuss adding video/WebRTC later)  
• Active session timer and “Next” button  
• Language preference filter so users can choose whom they are matched with

Safety & moderation  
• One-click user reporting from inside the chat window  
• Server-side flagging system that stores chat session data tied to the reported user ID for review  
• Simple admin dashboard to view reports and suspend or delete accounts

User profile  
• Minimal public profile (avatar, short bio, language list) editable after sign-up  
• Private settings page for password change and notification control

Tech stack is flexible, but real-time tools like Node.js, Socket.io, or similar will likely be needed for instant pairing. Please outline your proposed stack, development timeline, and any past work with real-time chat or matching algorithms when you reply.

Acceptance criteria  
1. Random matching works with <2-second average connection time.  
2. Only authenticated users can initiate or receive chats.  
3. Reporting, language filtering, and profile editing all function on production URL.  
4. Code is handed over in a clean Git repo with install instructions.

I’m ready to start as soon as I see a sensible timeline and a quick outline of the tech stack you prefer beyond Bootstrap (plain PHP, Laravel, Node, etc. are all fine—just tell me why you pick one). jobs.title: Vintage Toy Shop Social Boost
jobs.description:
I own a small vintage toy shop with a heavy spotlight on G.I. Joe, Star Wars and other classic action figures, and I’m ready to turn that nostalgia into an engaged online community. The priority is full social media management across Facebook and You tube.  

The mission is straightforward: grow my follower count and spark lively, authentic engagement around every unboxing, restoration tip and rare-figure spotlight I share. I’ll provide product photos, stories and price lists; you turn them into scroll-stopping posts, shorts and behind-the-scenes clips that capture collectors’ imaginations.

Key deliverables  
• A 30-day content plan tailored to Facebook and You tube  
• Custom graphics, captions and hashtags that stay true to vintage-toy culture  
• Two short-form videos or reels per week highlighting G.I. Joe or Star Wars pieces  
• Daily comment and message moderation to keep conversations friendly and on-brand  
• Weekly performance report showing follower growth, reach and engagement rates  

Success will be measured by noticeable upticks in followers and post interactions month over month. If you love retro toys and know how to translate that passion into share-worthy content, let’s bring more collectors through my digital doors.

jobs.title: Social Media Marketing Manager Needed

The visuals should look high-quality and professional, with suitable background music and sound effects. The overall goal is to make the video entertaining, memorable, and shareable, with a style that can attract viewers and potentially become viral.
