jobs.title: Responsive Fitness Tracker Web App
jobs.description:
I’m building a browser-based fitness tracker and I want every screen to feel as informative and detailed as possible while remaining quick to load and easy to navigate. The core stack is straightforward—HTML, CSS and vanilla JavaScript with Chart.js for visualisations and LocalStorage for all client-side persistence—so you should be comfortable working without heavy frameworks.

Scope of work  
• Build a fully responsive interface that adapts gracefully to mobile, tablet and desktop breakpoints.  
• Implement the seven key modules:  
  – BMI calculator that saves each entry and renders a progress chart.  
  – Daily calorie calculator.  
  – Water-intake tracker with daily goal visual.  
  – Mood-based exercise suggestion engine.  
  – Short fitness quiz that records and updates a running score.  
  – Dark / Light mode toggle stored in LocalStorage.  
  – One-click CSV export of all tracked data.  
• Keep the information architecture clear so users can drill into details without feeling lost; tooltips, inline validation and concise labels are encouraged.  
• Code must be clean, commented and organised so future devs can extend modules or swap storage layers easily.

Deliverables  
1. Source code (HTML, CSS, JS) ready to drop into any static hosting service.  
2. Minified production bundle.  
3. Brief setup guide and usage notes.  
4. Screenshot or short screencast demonstrating each feature working across at least three viewport sizes.

I’ll test by running the app locally, checking data persistence after reloads, and reviewing UI behaviour on phone, tablet emulator and desktop. If that sounds up your alley, let me know your timeline and any similar projects you’ve tackled.

jobs.title: Social Media Editing and Management

jobs.title: Technical Docs Creation: System Design & Software
jobs.description:
Proposal: Technical Writers Needed — System Design / Software Engineering Documents 

What I'm looking for:
I need original, professionally-written technical documents in the software engineering / system design space. Examples of acceptable document types:
- System/technical design docs (architecture decisions, trade-offs, constraints, edge cases, failure modes)
- Requirements docs or PRDs
- Runbooks / SOPs (with exact commands, preconditions, failure handling)
- Incident reports / postmortems
- Engineering recommendation memos (weighing options, stating a position, driving a decision)

Important — please read carefully before applying:

This work must be original content you create from scratch for this project — not a document from your current or past job, even if you personally wrote it. Most employment contracts assign ownership of work product to the employer, so even documents you authored yourself likely aren't yours to sell or license. I'm not able to accept:

- Real documents from your actual workplace, even anonymized or lightly edited
- Confidential, proprietary, or trade-secret material of any kind
- Anything publicly available online (published reports, filings, blog posts, etc.)

Requirements:

1. 100% human-written — no AI-generated or AI-assisted content. Submissions are run through AI-detection review before any payment or acceptance.
2. English (US professional context preferred)
3. .docx format only.
4. Minimum 150 words per page.
5. Should reflect real engineering depth: specific trade-offs, quantified assumptions, concrete failure handling — not generic or boilerplate writing.
 
How it works:
1. Apply with a short description of the document you'd propose to write (type + brief scenario).
2. If selected, write the full document and submit as .docx.
3. I review for originality, AI usage, and quality.
4. If it passes: you'll be compensated ₹1,200 for up to 50 pages provided full rights to the document as work-for-hire — please note and accept this in your job acceptance.

jobs.title: Custom Retail POS System Development

I am looking for an experienced **POS software developer or development team** to build a custom retail Point-of-Sale system from the ground up.

The initial system will be used in my own retail stores, but the long-term goal is to develop this into a **commercial POS platform that can eventually be offered to other businesses**.

* Modern, fast retail POS interface

* Customer management

* Reporting and analytics
* Multi-store support
* Cloud-based administration
* Reliable synchronization between locations/registers
* Integration with POS hardware such as barcode scanners, receipt printers, cash drawers and payment terminals

### Payment Processing

A major part of the project will be **integrated credit/debit card processing**.

I want the POS to communicate directly with a compatible payment terminal so the cashier can initiate a transaction from the POS and the customer can tap/insert/swipe their card on the terminal.

The payment architecture should be flexible enough to potentially support **multiple payment processors in the future**.

Long term, I am interested in developing a business model where the platform could potentially generate revenue through:

* POS subscriptions
* Hardware
* Payment processing
* Additional software/services

Experience with payment processors such as **Square, Stripe, Adyen, Fiserv, Worldpay, Global Payments, Clover**, or similar platforms is highly desirable.

### Long-Term Architecture

The system should be designed with future growth in mind, including:

* Multiple businesses/merchants
* Multiple locations
* Multiple registers
* Cloud administration
* Multi-tenant architecture
* Payment integrations
* Merchant onboarding
* Third-party integrations
* Scalable infrastructure

### Development Approach

I would like to begin with a **paid discovery/architecture phase**.

I will provide an existing POS system as a **functional reference** so the developer can understand the type of workflow and functionality I am looking for.

The first phase should determine:

* System architecture
* Technology stack
* Database structure
* Payment architecture
* Hardware integration
* Development roadmap
* Estimated cost and timeline

After the architecture phase, I would like to move into full development with the right developer/team.

### Who I Am Looking For

I am specifically looking for someone with **real-world POS development experience**, not just general web development.

Ideal experience includes:

* Retail POS
* Inventory systems
* Payment processing
* Payment terminals
* POS hardware
* Multi-location systems
* Cloud/SaaS platforms
* APIs
* Multi-tenant applications
* Security and payment compliance

Please provide examples of **POS systems you have personally built or worked on**, including any payment terminal integrations.

I am looking for a **long-term development partner**, not just someone to complete a quick project.

Research and propose a strong, modern, and realistic mission for the company. The mission should consider the future of aerospace engineering, digital engineering, AI-assisted design, simulation, and collaboration between students, engineers, and companies.

Research and identify **modern simulation, engineering, and analysis tools** that the company could use or provide expertise in. This may include:

* CFD
* FEA
* CAD
* System simulation
* Optimization
* Digital twins
* MATLAB/Simulink
* ANSYS
* OpenFOAM
* Python-based engineering tools
* AI-assisted engineering

The candidate should identify which technologies are most relevant and explain how they could contribute to the company's future capabilities.

### 3. Aerospace Engineering Areas

Identify the main aerospace engineering areas the company should cover, such as:

* Aircraft and spacecraft design
* Aerodynamics and CFD
* Propulsion and jet engines
* Structural and mechanical engineering
* Flight dynamics and control
* Avionics and systems engineering
* Guidance, Navigation and Control (GNC)
* UAV and drone engineering
* Thermal and fluid systems
* Aerospace simulation and optimization
* CAD and product development
* Testing and engineering analysis

### 4. Future Industry Ambitions and Company Development

Identify **future aerospace and related industry opportunities** that the company could pursue.

Research emerging technologies, markets, and business opportunities and propose realistic ways for the company to develop its engineering capabilities, create new services, attract talented engineers, collaborate with universities and companies, support students, and eventually participate in larger aerospace projects.

### Final Deliverable

The final deliverable must be a **complete written script suitable for a 5-minute company presentation video**.

The script should clearly explain:

* Who we are
* Our mission and vision
* What we want to achieve
* What services we could provide
* The aerospace engineering fields we cover
* The modern technologies and simulation tools we intend to use
* Who we aim to help
* Our future industry ambitions

jobs.title: B2B Verdanta Naturals Website Development

DESIGN:

Explore Products
Request a Quote

Hero → Products → Why Verdanta → Applications → Processing & Quality → B2B Supply → Catalogue → About → Contact → Final Inquiry CTA.

Vegetables:

Fruits:

ABOUT US:

Do not make medical or health claims unless properly substantiated.

B2B SUPPLY:

Highlight bulk quantities, consistent specifications, suitable packaging, documentation, samples, repeat supply and customized requirements where feasible.

Use CTA:
"Discuss Your Requirement"

INTERNATIONAL BUYERS:

CATALOGUE:

FOOTER:

FINAL REQUIREMENT:

Every page should clearly communicate:
What do we sell?
Who is it for?
What formats are available?
How is it processed?
Why should a buyer trust us?

jobs.title: Experienced Framer Developer for Ongoing Support
jobs.description:
# Framer Website Specialist Needed for Ad Hoc Ongoing Support

We’re looking for an experienced **Framer developer / designer** to provide ongoing, ad hoc support for an existing website built in Framer.

The website is already live and functioning. We are **not looking for a full redesign or rebuild** at this stage.

Instead, we need someone reliable who can assist as required with updates, improvements, troubleshooting and small development/design tasks.

## Scope of Support

Typical tasks may include:

* Updating existing pages and sections
* Creating new pages or landing pages
* Adjusting layouts and responsive behaviour
* Fixing mobile / tablet display issues
* Updating navigation and footer elements
* Improving spacing, typography and visual consistency
* Adding or modifying Framer components
* Creating reusable components
* CMS updates and configuration
* Adding forms and integrations
* Fixing broken interactions or animations
* Improving page transitions and micro-interactions
* Adding new sections based on existing design patterns
* Updating images, icons and content
* Basic SEO configuration
* Meta titles and descriptions
* Redirects and URL changes
* Performance improvements
* General Framer troubleshooting
* Publishing and deployment support

There may also occasionally be slightly larger pieces of work such as creating a new landing page or implementing a new website feature.

## What We’re Looking For

We want someone who is very comfortable working inside **existing Framer projects** and can make changes without unnecessarily rebuilding components or disrupting the existing design system.

Attention to detail is important.

You should be able to look at an existing design and maintain consistency across:

* Typography
* Spacing
* Components
* Colours
* Responsive behaviour
* Interactions
* Overall UI quality

We would also value someone who can make sensible UX recommendations when they notice something that could be improved.

## Working Arrangement

This will be an **ongoing ad hoc engagement** rather than a fixed full-time role.

Some weeks may involve several tasks while other periods may require little or no support.

Tasks will generally be provided individually with clear requirements and priority.

We are open to either:

* Hourly engagement, or
* Agreed pricing for individual larger tasks

We are looking for someone we can work with over the longer term rather than finding a new freelancer for every website update.

## Important

We need someone who is comfortable making both **small quick changes and more involved Framer improvements**.

Examples could range from:

“Update this section and fix the mobile layout”

through to:

“Create a new landing page following the existing website design system.”

We value clean implementation and prefer solutions that are maintainable rather than quick fixes that create problems later.

## Ideal Experience

You should have strong experience with:

* Framer
* Responsive web design
* Framer CMS
* Components and variants
* Breakpoints
* Animations and interactions
* Landing page design
* Basic UX / UI principles
* Website performance
* SEO fundamentals

Experience working with SaaS, technology or startup websites would be a bonus.

Knowledge of custom code, JavaScript or third-party integrations within Framer would also be useful, although it is not required for every task.

## When Applying

Please include:

* 3–5 Framer websites you have worked on
* A brief explanation of what you worked on for each
* Your hourly rate
* Your typical availability
* Your timezone
* Whether you are comfortable working on an ad hoc basis
* Your experience with Framer CMS and custom components
* Whether you can assist with both design and implementation

Please start your application with **“Framer Support”** so we know you have read the brief.

We are looking for someone who is **responsive, detail-oriented and easy to work with**, with the potential for an ongoing working relationship.

jobs.title: SaaS Product Marketing Video Creator Needed for AI Website Platform -- 2
jobs.description:
We’re looking for an experienced SaaS product video creator / motion designer to create a polished, high-impact marketing video for a new AI-powered website platform built for small businesses.

The objective is to produce a compelling 60–90 second product marketing video that quickly communicates the value of the platform, showcases the product experience, and makes viewers want to try it.

This is not a training or tutorial video request for now. The focus is on strong product storytelling, premium UI presentation and marketing impact.

About the Product

The platform helps small businesses create professional websites through a simple, guided AI-powered experience.

Instead of requiring users to understand traditional website builders, templates or web development, the product gathers key information about the business and uses that context to create a professional website tailored to their needs.

Further product details, brand assets and platform access will be provided to shortlisted candidates.

What We Want to Create

We want a modern SaaS product video that combines real product UI with strong motion design and storytelling.

The video should feel closer to a premium technology product launch than a standard screen recording.

The creative approach could include:

Professionally captured product UI
Smooth zooms, pans and transitions
Cursor animation and interaction
Motion graphics
Animated typography and messaging
Feature callouts
Website reveal moments
Clean transitions between product stages
Music and sound design
Voiceover where appropriate
Strong opening hook and closing CTA

The final video should feel:

Modern, premium, intelligent, simple and approachable.

We like the standard of product storytelling seen from modern SaaS and technology companies such as Canva, Framer, Webflow, Stripe and similar brands.

We are not looking to copy these brands, but the overall production quality and attention to UI presentation should be comparable.

The Story We Want to Tell

At a high level, the video should communicate a simple journey:

Tell us about your business → AI creates the website → Review and personalise → Go live.

Rather than showing every screen in sequence, we want the freelancer to identify the strongest moments in the product and turn them into a concise marketing story.

A typical narrative may include:

The Problem

Creating a professional business website can involve too many decisions — templates, copy, design, images, page structures and complicated website builders.

A Simpler Way

Introduce the platform as a smarter way for a small business to create its website.

Understand the Business

Briefly demonstrate the user providing information about their business, services, branding and preferences.

AI Builds the Website

Show the platform transforming this information into a professional website.

This should ideally be one of the strongest visual moments in the video.

Review and Personalise

Show that the generated website can easily be reviewed and adjusted.

Ready to Launch

Finish by demonstrating how quickly the customer can move from providing their business information to having a professional website ready to publish.

Closing CTA

End with a strong branded product moment and clear call to action.

The final script and sequence will be developed collaboratively with the successful freelancer.

Primary Deliverable
60–90 Second Product Marketing Video

The main video should be suitable for:

Product landing pages
Website homepage
LinkedIn
Social media
Paid campaigns
Sales presentations
Product demonstrations

We would also like the project to be structured so parts of the video can be repurposed into shorter marketing assets.

Optional Additional Deliverables

Please let us know if you can also provide:

15–30 second product clips
Social media cut-downs
Vertical 9:16 versions
Website hero animations
Product GIFs
Short UI feature animations
Voiceover
Scriptwriting
Storyboarding
What We Will Provide

For shortlisted / selected candidates we can provide:

Full product walkthrough
Access to the platform
Brand guidelines
Logo and visual assets
Product positioning and messaging
Key features and differentiators
Example websites created using the platform
Feedback throughout production

Some product information will remain confidential during the initial application stage and will be shared once we have identified suitable candidates.

What We Need From You

We’re looking for someone who can take ownership of the creative production — not just someone who can edit supplied screen recordings.

You should be comfortable helping with:

Product storytelling
Creative direction
Script development
Storyboarding
Identifying the strongest product moments
UI capture and presentation
Motion design
Typography
Editing
Sound design
Final production

We are open to your recommendations on how best to present the product.

Ideal Experience

Preference will be given to freelancers with experience producing:

SaaS product marketing videos
Software launch videos
AI product videos
Startup product videos
UI / UX animation
Technology advertisements
Product demo videos

Strong attention to detail is important.

The UI should be presented beautifully, with thoughtful framing, smooth motion, good pacing and professional typography.

When Applying

Please include:

2–4 examples of your best SaaS or software product videos
Examples involving real product UI
Your proposed approach to this project
Whether you can assist with scriptwriting and storyboarding
Whether you can capture the product footage yourself
Whether you provide voiceover options
Tools you typically use
Estimated project cost
Number of revisions included

We are particularly interested in creators who can take a software product and turn it into a short, visually impressive marketing story that makes the audience immediately understand the value and want to try the product.

jobs.title: iOS GPS Tracking & History App
jobs.description:
I’m building an iOS application that lets a user keep tabs on where they’ve been and where they are in real time. The core workflow is straightforward: the app captures the device’s live GPS signal, stores a continuous stream of coordinates on the backend, and makes that trail viewable on demand as a neatly ordered history log.

Key elements I need you to handle:  
• Real-time tracking that updates smoothly even when the app is running in the background.  
• A location history view that can be filtered by date and plotted on Apple Maps.  
• Social media login (Facebook, Google, or Apple Sign-In) as the sole authentication path, with tokens stored securely in the Keychain.  
• Battery-efficient GPS polling so the tracker won’t drain the phone on long trips.  

I’m open to your preferred stack for the backend as long as the API is RESTful and the data is encrypted in transit and at rest. Swift, SwiftUI, and Core Location are the natural choices on the client side, but if you have a compelling alternative I’m all ears.

Acceptance criteria for hand-off:  
1. Xcode project with clean, documented code.  
2. Working build installable via TestFlight.  
3. Postman collection (or similar) showing the live/ history endpoints.  
4. Short README covering setup, environment variables, and how to extend the codebase if we later add Android or web access.

Let me know your timeline, the libraries you’d lean on, and any prior location-based apps you’ve published.

jobs.title: Comprehensive Power BI Sales Dashboard
jobs.description:

From this single data source I need a polished Power BI report that lets me monitor performance at three time resolutions—daily, monthly and yearly—without having to touch the data again.

Key insights I must see front-and-center are revenue, units sold and profit margins. Slicers for date ranges, product categories and regions will help me drill down quickly, while trend lines, variance indicators and a clean KPI card layout will keep the story clear for leadership reviews.

Deliverables  
• Power BI (.pbix) file using my Excel data as the only data source  
• All data transformation steps documented in Power Query  
• Interactive pages for Daily, Monthly and Yearly views, each displaying revenue, units sold and profit margin KPIs  
• One summary page with high-level KPIs and dynamic filters  
• Publishing guidance so the report refreshes automatically when the Excel source is updated

The build should follow best practices for data modelling, use DAX measures instead of calculated columns where possible, and remain performant with incremental refresh if you deem it necessary. I am happy to supply a sample workbook before project start so you can confirm structure and timeline.

jobs.title: Cross Platform GPS History Tracker
jobs.description:
I need a complete solution that records a phone’s location history with high-accuracy GPS on both Android and iOS. Each device should log points with timestamp, latitude, longitude, speed, and battery level, then sync them to a secure cloud back-end in near real time (offline buffering when the signal drops is a must).

I want to view the data two ways: inside the mobile app itself (simple map timeline per day) and through a web dashboard where I can filter by date, export to CSV/KML, and see heat-maps or breadcrumbs for each selected device. Basic account management and role-based access will keep the data private.

You are free to choose the stack—Firebase, AWS Amplify, Supabase, or another cloud service—so long as it scales and keeps costs predictable. If you plan to use Flutter, React Native, or Kotlin/Swift with a shared codebase, let me know; cross-platform speed matters.

Deliverables:
• Android app (Play-ready APK/AAB)
• iOS app (App Store–ready IPA)
• Responsive web dashboard with login
• Documented back-end with REST/GraphQL endpoints
• Setup guide and brief hand-over call

Acceptance Criteria:
• GPS accuracy consistently under 10 m in open sky tests
• Seamless data sync within 30 s of collection when online
• Dashboard loads a 30-day history of 10 000 points in under 5 s
• Code passes a security review for unauthorized data access

jobs.title: Budget Instagram Reels Editing
jobs.description:

Style
The final piece should lean into a trendy, modern aesthetic—fast cuts, upbeat pacing, subtle on-beat zooms or speed ramps where they add energy, and polished color that feels fresh without looking over-filtered.

Core edits I’m after
• Layer in royalty-free background music that matches the vibe (I’ll approve the track you suggest).  
• Tasteful sound effects to accent transitions or key visual moments—nothing cheesy.

• Project file or an .xml/DRP so I can tweak text if needed.

Acceptance criteria
• Video length lands between 25–35 seconds.  
• Audio is balanced, with music sitting comfortably under dialogue or original ambients.  
• No hard cuts that feel jarring; transitions should sync to the beat.  
• File delivered within three days of receiving raw footage.

The overall budget is tight, so efficiency matters—I don’t need heavy VFX, just clean, creative storytelling that feels at home in today’s Explore feed. If this first project clicks, I’ll have a steady stream of Reels every week.

jobs.title: Cross-Platform Location History
jobs.description:
I need a straightforward service that quietly records where a phone has been and lets me pull that history back on demand. The same core codebase—or two lightweight wrappers around a shared API—has to run on both iOS and Android so the behaviour is identical no matter the handset.

Every record must include:

The capture interval will be configurable; storing points every X minutes is fine as long as the data come through in chronological order. I’m happy with a simple REST or GraphQL endpoint for upload and retrieval, and SQLite or any small cloud datastore is acceptable for persistence as long as you explain the choice. The final hand-off should include well-commented source code, a short README that shows how to compile or integrate each mobile module, and a sample request that proves the data format is exactly as outlined above.

jobs.title: Penulisan Artikel Blog Informatif
jobs.description:
Saya sedang mencari seorang penulis konten yang dapat membantu saya menyiapkan artikel-artikel blog yang bersifat informatif. Fokus utama tulisan adalah memberi wawasan yang jelas dan bermanfaat bagi pembaca, bukan sekadar meningkatkan SEO atau hiburan semata.

jobs.title: Phone Location History Service
jobs.description:

jobs.title: Rig & Animate 48 Creatures

If the collaboration goes smoothly I’ll open an extra milestone for attack, hurt and death animations using the same rigs, so designing with future moves in mind is a plus.  

Deliverables for each of the 48 models:

• Run loop (FBX)

Please factor the variety of body plans into your workflow—bipeds, quadrupeds and the odd tentacled nightmare all have to move naturally. I expect non normal movements at least for most of these creatures. If this sounds like your kind of project, let’s get started.

jobs.title: AI Personal File Backup App
jobs.description:
I want to build an AI-powered application that automatically safeguards my personal files—mainly photos and documents—without me having to think about it. The core requirement is smart, continuous backup: the system should recognise new or modified files, decide whether they need versioning or simple duplication, and transfer them to secure storage on a schedule I can adjust.

Deliverables I need  
1. Working cross-platform desktop or web app (proof-of-concept is acceptable for the first milestone)

3. Setup instructions and a concise user guide  

The solution will be accepted once I can install it, run an initial backup, and restore a sample file flawlessly.

jobs.title: Android Enhance MRZ/OCR Accuracy for ID Extraction
jobs.description:
# Freelancer Requirement – MRZ / OCR Accuracy Improvement
 
## Project Requirement
 
We are looking for an experienced **OCR / Computer Vision / Document Recognition developer** to improve the accuracy of our Android application's **MRZ (Machine Readable Zone) / OCR data extraction**.
 
Our application captures identification documents using the device camera. Currently, the OCR/MRZ extraction is not achieving the required accuracy. We need a freelancer who can improve the recognition accuracy and provide a reliable OCR solution.
 
### Primary Requirement
 
The freelancer should be able to:
 
* Detect and extract MRZ/OCR text accurately from ID documents.
* Handle different image qualities, lighting conditions, angles, blur, reflections, and camera distances.
* Perform appropriate image preprocessing before OCR.
* Correct common OCR character recognition errors.
* Reliably recognize MRZ characters such as:
 
  * `0 / O`
  * `1 / I`
  * `2 / Z`
  * `5 / S`
  * `6 / G`
  * `8 / B`
  * `<`
* Validate and parse MRZ data using MRZ standards and check digits.
* Return structured and reliable OCR/MRZ data to our Android application.
 
## Emirates ID Experience – Preferred
 
Experience with **UAE Emirates ID / Emirates Identity documents** is highly preferred.
 
Candidates with previous experience working on:
 
* Emirates ID OCR
* Emirates ID MRZ reading
* UAE identity documents
* UAE passport/ID document recognition
* Government identity document OCR
* KYC / identity verification systems
 
will be given preference.
 
 
## Android Integration
 
The solution must be suitable for integration into our existing **Android application**.
 
Preferred experience:
 
* Android / Java / Kotlin
* Camera-based document capture
* OpenCV or equivalent image-processing libraries
* OCR SDK/API integration
* On-device ML/OCR
* MRZ parsing and validation
 
The solution should preferably support **on-device processing** if accuracy and performance are acceptable. Cloud/API-based solutions can also be considered if they provide substantially better accuracy and acceptable response time/cost.
 
## Image Processing
 
The freelancer should have experience with OCR preprocessing, including where applicable:
 
* Cropping the document/MRZ region
* Perspective correction / document alignment
* Rotation correction
* Resolution enhancement
* Noise removal
* Sharpening
* Contrast adjustment
* Thresholding/binarization
* Glare/reflection handling
* Blur reduction where possible
* Correct image scaling
* Text-region detection
 
## Accuracy & Validation
 
Accuracy is the most important requirement.
 
The freelancer should provide a solution that can be tested against a representative dataset of Emirates IDs and other supported documents.
 
Testing should include:
 
* Different ID cards
* Different print qualities
* Different lighting conditions
* Different camera angles
* Different distances
* Slightly blurred images
* Reflections/glare
* Low/high-resolution images
 
We need **field-level accuracy**, not just an OCR confidence score.
 
Where MRZ is available, the implementation should use **MRZ check digits and format validation** to detect and correct OCR errors wherever possible.
 
## Deliverables
 
The freelancer should provide:
 
1. Working OCR/MRZ solution.
2. Android integration/library/module.
3. Required SDKs/packages/libraries.
4. Source code.
5. Configuration/model files, if applicable.
6. Image preprocessing implementation.
7. MRZ validation/parsing implementation.
8. Integration documentation.
9. Testing results and accuracy report.
10. List of dependencies and licenses.
11. Explanation of any third-party/commercial SDK or API used.
12. Performance information, including approximate processing time.
 
## Candidate Requirements
 
### Must Have
 
* Strong experience in OCR/document recognition.
* Experience with MRZ recognition/parsing.
* Computer vision/image processing knowledge.
* Experience integrating OCR into Android applications.
* Ability to troubleshoot OCR accuracy issues.
* Experience working with real-world camera images rather than only clean scanned documents.
 
 
**Priority:** Accuracy and reliability > implementation simplicity.

jobs.title: Hiring PC Windows/Gamers Testers Before Public Launch For Free To Play Game
jobs.description:

That's where you come in. We are actively looking for people on PC (Windows) computers that can run the game and help us find bugs, explore our world that took 10 years to develop and make the game better for overall all users. We expect to go no a public release globally so all countries will be allowed to play.

The requirements for this job are simple:

- You will need to be able to create a character in game and actually login and test how easy it is to learn to play.
- You will need to be able to join our Discord community and have a staff position as (Tester) title there for other players to recognize you.

The game is less than 20 MB in size (very tiny) and can work for almost any computer so it doesn't have to be one of the fancy gaming computers.

Discord is just a public social app used by many gamers. I don't expect you to have an account but if you do that's just makes it easier to get started at our company.

Compensation:

- You will be paid hourly basically $5 - $25 per hour based on your ability to progress in the game.
- Bonuses will be awarded between $25 - $100 bonuses for bugs, glitches, errors and other compensation will match directly to the vulnerability you find.
- Hourly rate is determined by calculations in game as you progress because our game is a long term progression style, saving (the higher level you get to the more feedback we can expect) so we can pay more for those that are skilled (talent based hires).

If you are idle in the game (meaning you did not explore to find anything wrong or can't progress) you may not be compensated at all. This is because your sole job is to test the game as a playable for all age groups.

jobs.title: Surrogacy Immigration Legal Consultant
jobs.description:
I am seeking an initial consultation with a specialized immigration attorney who possesses dual expertise in U.S. immigration law and international Assisted Reproductive Technology (ART) / surrogacy cases.
My wife and I are currently navigating an international surrogacy journey and require sophisticated legal counsel to structure our document portfolio and ensure the seamless, lawful entry of our child into the United States.

The Fact Pattern
⚬	Intended Parents (IPs): Both my wife and I are U.S. Lawful Permanent Residents (LPRs).
⚬	Birth Country: Nigeria (via a gestational surrogate).
⚬	Genetics & Conception: The child was conceived via ART using my genetic material (sperm) and a donor egg.
⚬	The Complication: My wife has no genetic or gestational link to the child.

The Core Legal Challenge
Our primary objective is to bring our child to the U.S. under the visa waiver rule for children born abroad to LPR mothers (8 CFR § 211.1(b)(1) / INA § 211(a)).
Given that current U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP) and Department of State (DOS) guidelines strictly evaluate genetic and gestational relationships when establishing maternity for immigration purposes, we need strategic counsel on the following:
How can we structure our legal document portfolio (e.g., Nigerian court orders, birth certificates, and declarations) to ensure CBP and USCIS legally recognize my wife as the "mother" for the purpose of the 8 CFR § 211.1 visa waiver upon our return to the U.S.?

Scope of Consultation & Potential Representation
We are looking for counsel to advise on and ultimately manage the following:
	1.	Pre-Birth Strategy: Advising on the necessary legal steps in Nigeria (in coordination with our local Nigerian counsel) to establish undeniable parental rights for my wife prior to or immediately at birth.
	2.	Document Structuring: Creating a foolproof portfolio of legal documentation (birth certificate, passports, custody orders) that satisfies CBP’s scrutiny at the Port of Entry.
	3.	Contingency Planning: Outlining alternative visa application processes (e.g., filing an I-130 or utilizing humanitarian parole) should the visa waiver route be deemed legally unviable due to the lack of a biological/gestational link.
	4.	Border Preparation: Providing a legal brief or letter of counsel to accompany us at the Port of Entry to advocate for the child's admission.

Next Steps
If your firm has specific, proven experience handling international surrogacy immigration matters—particularly involving non-genetic, non-gestational LPR parents—please let me know your availability for a consultation and your standard consulting fee.

jobs.title: Insert Ready Text into PDF
jobs.description:

Please use a professional tool such as Adobe Acrobat Pro, InDesign, or an equivalent PDF editor to keep the file fully editable for future updates. After the text is in, double-check for line breaks, orphaned words, or shifted elements and make sure bookmarks, internal links, and overall file size remain intact.

Deliverable  
• Updated PDF with the new paragraphs perfectly integrated and ready to share.

jobs.title: Creative Tutorial Video Editing
jobs.description:
I publish a steady stream of tutorial content for YouTube and need someone who can turn raw screen-recordings and talking-head footage into tight, friendly, conversational episodes. Each edit should guide the viewer smoothly through the lesson, keeping the pacing upbeat without feeling rushed.

Here’s what I’m looking for in every video:

• Clean, thoughtful cuts that maintain a natural flow of speech  
• On-brand text overlays for key concepts, shortcuts, and calls-to-action  
• Royalty-free background music mixed so my voice stays clear  
• Light-weight graphics or motion animations to highlight steps, menus, or results  

I’m flexible on the tools you use—Premiere Pro, Final Cut, DaVinci Resolve, and After Effects all fit my workflow—as long as the final output is a 1080p (or higher) MP4 plus the editable project file so I can make small tweaks later.

To make sure we’re a good match, please share one or two tutorial edits you’ve completed that showcase a conversational tone, tasteful music beds, and purposeful motion graphics. If you can reliably hit deadlines and have an eye for educational storytelling, we’ll work together on a recurring basis.

jobs.title: Realistic Phoenix 3D Animation
jobs.description:
I have a short-film sequence that follows two golden, majestic phoenixes through a dense forest. The visual language must feel realistic—feathers reacting naturally to light, embers glowing subtly rather than in a cartoon flare—and every beat should underline the theme of family and protection.

The story flow is already locked:
• Opening: mother and daughter phoenix meet in the thick forest canopy.  
• Mid-point: a hunter steps in, fires, the daughter is hit but survives and flees home in panic.  
• Dialogue: a two-minute exchange between mother and daughter in their nest (full lip-sync and nuanced facial movement).  
• Climax: the mother rises dramatically from water, wings spreading, droplets catching the warm forest light.

I will supply the storyboard, reference voice tracks, and ambient SFX. What I need from you is the complete 3D animation—from modeling and rigging both birds in their shimmering gold palette to final rendered shots ready for compositing. You may work in Blender, Maya, Houdini, or any comparable pipeline as long as the exported frames arrive in 4K EXR or ProRes 4444 along with the project files for future tweaks.

Acceptance criteria  
• Photoreal-leaning textures, feather dynamics, and lighting that match a live-action forest plate I will provide.  
• Smooth, emotionally readable performances during the two-minute dialogue.  
• Hunter, forest, water, and splash simulations integrated with consistent scale and physically plausible interaction.  
• Final renders delivered shot-by-shot plus the editable scene files.

Let me know your preferred toolset, any previous creature work you can point me to, and the estimated turnaround so we can lock our schedule.

jobs.title: Cartoonish Dog Caricatures
jobs.description:
I'm looking for a talented artist to create cartoonish caricatures of my two dogs. These illustrations will be used for my dog walking business.

Requirements:
- Style: Fun and playful cartoonish caricatures
- Setting: Dogs should be illustrated in a city park
- Accessories: Include their leash and collar

Ideal Skills:

- Ability to capture dog personalities in a park setting

jobs.title: China Bulk SMS Gateway Needed
jobs.description:
I want to send overseas SMS messages in bulk to mobile phones in mainland China, with delivery rates, compliance, and throughput that can be scaled as needed.  

The core use case involves Chinese-language content that often includes external links, so the character set and URL display must work perfectly.

Interface and technical requirements  
• I prefer integrating with my system via SMPP, with a dedicated username, password, and delivery-receipt port.  
• The sending numbers must support customizable SIDs, allowing each marketing campaign to use its own brand signature.  
• I expect to start with a small daily testing volume and steadily increase it after successful validation; the route must offer elastic throughput and stable delivery rates.  
• You must be familiar with the regulatory requirements of China’s three major telecom operators and be able to provide failure codes, delivery-rate statistics, and callable reporting APIs / delivery-receipt queues.  
• Chinese-language communication is preferred to facilitate the rapid confirmation of technical details and troubleshooting.

Required features already identified  
- Bulk sending  
- Content monitoring and pre-screening  
- Sending reports and logs  

Please briefly address the following in your proposal:  
1. Existing international route resources and reference delivery rates;  
2. Technical implementation of customizable SIDs and any possible limitations;  
3. Minimum order quantity, price range, and subsequent scaling capacity for launching the test;  
4. Available integration documentation, SDKs, or sample code.  

I hope to work with a partner who is familiar with SMS gateways, experienced in international route management, and able to communicate in Chinese, so that testing can begin quickly and volumes can be scaled up reliably.

jobs.title: Gamified English Question Bank
jobs.description:
I’m expanding my English-learning app and need a complete bank of 3 000–5 000 gamified questions that mirror the fun, bite-size flow you see in SpeakX. Every item must feel like a mini-game while still teaching solid language skills.

Scope and audience  
• Lessons to cover Vocabulary, Grammar and Conversational practice.  
• Difficulty must rise smoothly from absolute beginner to advanced so both kids and young adults stay engaged.

Question styles  
I already know I want Multiple-choice, True/False and Fill-in-the-blank. Beyond that, I expect you to research, propose and build another 15-20 interactive patterns—think drag-and-drop ordering, picture prompts, short pronunciation challenges, timed “lightning rounds,” etc.—anything that keeps users tapping. Each new pattern should come with a brief note on why it works for language retention.

Structure I’m looking for  
1. Organise the bank into clear levels (you can follow CEFR or your own tiered labels).  
2. Group questions into thematic “lessons” so I can drop them straight into the app.  
3. For every lesson, supply:  
   • English prompt  
   • Correct answer(s)  
   • Two to four distractors if applicable  
   • A one-line teaching point so my engine can surface hints  
   • JSON or CSV export ready for direct import (key:value format you suggest).

Quality bar / acceptance  
• No repeated stems; wording must be natural, age-appropriate and error-free.  
• Difficulty tagging must match the actual language used.  
• You’ll provide a small demo set first so we can lock format before you scale.  
• Final delivery passes a plagiarism scan and my in-house review for pedagogy.

If you have experience writing ELT content, especially for mobile or with Unity gamification hooks, let me know. Once we hit the right groove, I’m open to ongoing batches.

jobs.title: Telegram Channel Growth via Paid Ads
jobs.description:

jobs.title: Ongoing Business App Development Support
jobs.description:
I’m building a suite of business-management apps and I need a developer who can stay with me for the long haul. The core focus is a virtual CFO service—think real-time cash-flow dashboards, automated budgeting tools, and smart analytics that help managers make faster financial decisions.

The current codebase must run smoothly on iOS, Android and the Web, so experience with cross-platform frameworks such as Flutter or React Native (or the ability to maintain separate Swift/Kotlin/JavaScript stacks) is important. I’ll rely on you to:

• Extend existing features and build new ones around virtual-CFO workflows  
• Integrate secure APIs for banking, invoicing and reporting  
• Keep deployments in App Store, Google Play and web hosting environments up to date  
• Jump in quickly for bug fixes, performance tuning and minor UI tweaks whenever needed  

We’ll work iteratively: I outline the next financial-management feature or optimisation, we agree on milestones, you implement, test and push to production. Clean, well-commented code and clear communication are non-negotiable, as this is an ongoing collaboration rather than a one-off deliverable.

If you have a background in business management systems, cloud back ends (Firebase, AWS or similar) and a knack for translating financial logic into intuitive user interfaces, I’d love to hear how you would approach scaling and maintaining this virtual CFO platform over time.

jobs.title: 2D Animated Preschool Short Video
jobs.description:
I need a bright, engaging 2D animation that runs between three and five minutes and keeps preschoolers (ages 2–5) happily glued to the screen. The core idea is simple early-childhood fun—cheerful characters, clear shapes, bold colours and gentle pacing—so little viewers can follow along without feeling rushed.  

Here’s how I see the workflow:

• Pre-production: we agree on a concise script or outline, rough character designs and a scene-by-scene storyboard.  
• Production: you animate in your preferred 2D toolset (Toon Boom, Adobe Animate, TVPaint—whatever lets you deliver smooth, expressive motion).  
• Post: add basic sound design, music and child-friendly voice-over; then render and supply the final 1080p MP4 along with project files.

Acceptance criteria  
• Final runtime falls within 3–5 minutes.  
• Visual style matches agreed colour palette and character sheets.  
• Audio mix is clear and age-appropriate, with levels balanced for mobile viewing.  

If this aligns with your skill set, let’s talk timing and milestones so we can bring this preschool short to life.

I already have initial design of characters.

jobs.title: Commercial Mechanical AutoCAD Drafting
jobs.description:
I have a commercial building underway and need a skilled hand to convert my mechanical layouts into clear, production-ready AutoCAD drawings. The project is strictly mechanical design—think ductwork, piping runs, and equipment placement—layered over the architectural backgrounds I’ll supply in DWG format.

Here’s how we’ll work together: I’ll send you rough sketches, equipment cut sheets, and the architect’s base plans. You refine everything into properly layered, dimensioned mechanical drawings that match industry standards, complete with legible annotations and a clean title block.

Deliverables
• Coordinated mechanical plans, sections, and details in editable DWG (2018 or newer) plus matching PDFs  
• Legends, general notes, and a concise equipment schedule  
• A brief change log showing each revision

Acceptance criteria include correct scaling, consistent line weights, and symbol use that aligns with common ASHRAE/SMACNA conventions. First draft is needed within five days of kick-off, with up to two revision rounds included.

If you already use AutoCAD Mechanical or productivity plug-ins that speed block management, let me know—that efficiency will be a plus.

jobs.title: Update House CAD for Snow Load

• Openings: adjust window and exterior-door sizes or swing directions where required by the new roof/wall framing and update the schedules accordingly.  
• Sheets & call-outs: reflect all changes in plans, sections, elevations, and material notes so they read cleanly for permitting.

Deliverables  
1. Updated .dwg files with clearly layered revisions.  
2. A printable PDF set ready for permit submission.  
3. Brief calculation summary (or manufacturer tables) showing the chosen I-joist and roof assembly meet the specified load.

Let me know your lead-time and any clarifications you need on local snow-load numbers, and we can get started right away.

jobs.title: Traditional Floral Stained Glass Sign

jobs.title: AI Vulnerability Scanning Harness
jobs.description:
I need an AI-driven security harness whose single focus is vulnerability scanning. The agent should automatically inspect my codebase, exposed and internal APIs, as well as the cloud configuration that supports them, then flag weaknesses with clear, actionable findings.

Here is what matters most to me:  
• A self-contained module or set of scripts that can be dropped into an existing CI/CD pipeline and triggered on every commit or on demand.  
• AI-assisted detection that goes beyond simple signature matching—think pattern recognition and contextual reasoning to uncover insecure coding practices, misconfigured permissions, or outdated components.  
• Coverage across three layers: the repository itself (static code analysis), live or staged endpoints (API interrogation), and infrastructure-as-code / cloud posture (config review).  
• A concise report, preferably in both JSON and human-readable HTML/Markdown, ranking each issue by severity and suggesting remediation steps.  
• Straightforward setup: environment requirements, installation commands, and an example project so I can verify results immediately.

If you plan to tap into tools such as Python, Node, OpenAI functions, or established scanners like Bandit, Semgrep, or Trivy, just outline how they fit into the overall workflow—the end product must still feel like one cohesive harness rather than a loose bundle of scripts. Unit tests and clear documentation will be part of the hand-off.

Once delivered, I will run the harness against a sample repository; acceptance is based on its ability to detect deliberately seeded flaws across code, API definitions, and Terraform-style cloud configs without producing excessive false positives.

Let me know your approach, the high-level architecture you envision, and any assumptions you’ll need from my side before we get started.

jobs.title: Rental Boyfriend Web & App
jobs.description:
I want to launch an online rental-boyfriend service that works seamlessly on both a responsive website and native iOS/Android apps. The core function I need right now is a reliable reviews-and-ratings system so anyone seeking a short-term companion can quickly judge reliability and experience before booking.  

Here’s how I picture the first release:

• A clean, swipe-style catalogue of available “boyfriends” with profile photos, short bios and stated interests.  
• Star ratings and written feedback displayed prominently on each profile, with fraud-proof verification so only completed outings generate reviews.  
• Simple sign-up flows for both renters and companions, tied to email or social logins, plus a lightweight admin dashboard where I can flag or remove flagged content.  

Messaging, advanced booking calendars or payment automation might be future phases, so please structure the codebase with modularity in mind. I’m happy with common stacks such as React / React Native + Node or Flutter + Firebase if they help us move fast and keep a single codebase, but I’m open to your proven toolkit as long as it delivers smooth performance and clean UI on web, iOS and Android.

What will win me over is clear UX thinking, privacy-first data handling, and a plan for publishing the mobile builds to Apple TestFlight and Google Play internal testing so I can iterate quickly. If this sounds like something you can craft end-to-end, let’s talk timelines and hand-off requirements.

jobs.title: Meta Business & Google Ad Account Setup

Please outline your process and timeline, and include any recent examples of successful lead-gen builds on Facebook and Instagram.

jobs.title: SEO Audit & Authority Backlinks
jobs.description:
My site needs a full, expert-level SEO tune-up followed by a push of premium backlinks strong enough to place my core product- and service-based keywords on Google’s first page.  

Here is what I have and what I need:

• The goal is threefold—more organic traffic, higher positions for those keywords, and broader overall visibility.  

What I expect from you:  
1. A concise but thorough SEO audit covering technical, on-page, and content factors, delivered as a report I can keep.  
2. Implementation (or instructions I can hand to my developer) of the priority fixes you identify—meta data, heading structure, internal linking, page speed tweaks, schema, whatever the audit flags.  
3. Sourcing and securing top-quality, white-hat backlinks from reputable, relevant sites (high DA/DR, low spam score). Please outline the domains you propose, expected metrics, and how many links you recommend so I can approve before placement.  
4. Transparent reporting: links placed, anchors used, live URLs, and a basic rank-tracking snapshot after the campaign so we can see movement.  

If you have proven success getting similar keyword sets onto page one, let me know the approach and typical timeframes. Tools such as Ahrefs, SEMrush, Moz, Screaming Frog or equivalent are welcome; just let me know what you’ll use.

jobs.title: Fantasy Video Game Logo Design
jobs.description:
IMPORTANT: All artwork must be entirely original and created by hand. The use of AI-generated content is strictly prohibited.

PROPOSALS: If you have submitted an automated proposal, please resubmit a fully custom response. Please only apply if you are genuinely interested in this project.

DESIGN APPROACH: The selected designer will be granted full creative freedom to interpret and develop the logo concept based on the information provided and the identity of Project: Gorgon.


---

We are seeking an experienced graphic designer to create a bold, distinctive, and visually compelling logo for our indie fantasy MMORPG, Project: Gorgon. The logo should capture the essence of a rich, immersive world filled with adventure, mystery, and discovery, while remaining highly recognizable and adaptable across multiple platforms.

Project: Gorgon is a classless, skill-driven MMORPG inspired by classic sandbox experiences. It emphasizes deep character progression, exploration-focused gameplay, and a unique blend of humor and high fantasy. The logo should reflect both the depth and personality of the game, appealing to players who appreciate modern design sensibilities as well as nostalgic elements from earlier MMORPGs.

Website: https://ProjectGorgon.com


---

Design Requirements

In addition to the primary logo, a secondary version is required for social media use. This version must be optimized for circular formats (e.g., Discord, Steam) while maintaining clarity and strong visual impact at smaller sizes.

The design should thoughtfully combine:

Modern, polished aesthetics

Subtle retro and pixel-inspired influences

Ornate fantasy detailing


The color palette should be vibrant and dynamic, while remaining legible on both light and dark backgrounds. Designers are encouraged to incorporate fantasy-themed elements such as stylized characters, creatures, or symbolic iconography that reflects the world and tone of Project: Gorgon.

The final logo system must scale effectively across all use cases, including marketing materials, website assets, in-game branding, and merchandise.


---

Deliverables

Primary logo in vector format suitable for both print and digital use

Circular social media icon version

Full-color and monochrome variations

All source files and export-ready assets



---

Ideal Candidate

We are seeking a designer with:

Demonstrated experience in fantasy or game-related branding

A strong portfolio showcasing logo design and visual identity work

Excellent understanding of color theory, composition, and visual hierarchy

The ability to create detailed, expressive designs that remain clear at small sizes

Proficiency in industry-standard tools such as Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop



---

Project Vision

We aim to translate the unique identity of Project: Gorgon into a cohesive and memorable visual mark that resonates with both long-time MMORPG players and new audiences. The final design should feel iconic, versatile, and enduring.

We look forward to reviewing your portfolio and creative approach.


---

Reference Note: The current and previous logos are attached for review. The winged version represents the original design, while the non-winged version is the current logo.

jobs.title: High-Retention 10s Luxury Real Estate Reel
jobs.description:
I’m looking for an exceptional short-form video editor to create a very short, high-retention Instagram Reel from footage of a $15M property in Aspen, Colorado.

I will be filming the property tomorrow and will provide all original footage immediately after the shoot.

FINAL VIDEO:
Approximately 10–12 seconds
Vertical 9:16
Instagram Reels / TikTok
Extremely polished
Designed for maximum retention, replays and shares

THIS IS NOT A TRADITIONAL REAL ESTATE VIDEO.

The opening shot will be filmed with the camera positioned outside the house. I will be inside and open the front door toward the camera.

The text should appear immediately:

WHAT $15M GETS YOU IN ASPEN

After the opening, I want a very fast sequence using ONLY the strongest shots of the property.

Most clips will likely be approximately 0.5–1 second, but timing should follow the music rather than a rigid formula.

The edit should feel fast, expensive, clean and effortless.

THE LOOP IS EXTREMELY IMPORTANT.

The final shot will show the exterior of the property.

I want the ending to transition back into the opening shot so naturally that the Reel feels like it NEVER ENDS.

Ideally, viewers should already be watching their second loop before realizing the video restarted.

Think:

DOOR OPENS → PROPERTY → PROPERTY → PROPERTY → EXTERIOR → DOOR OPENS → PROPERTY...

No obvious ending.
No fade-out.
No end card.
No logo outro.

The music/audio should also loop naturally so there is no obvious audio reset.

I care deeply about:
- First 1–2 second retention
- Clip selection
- Precise cuts
- Beat synchronization
- Pacing
- Rewatchability
- Seamless visual + audio looping
- Subtle color correction
- Stabilization if necessary
- Premium taste

DO NOT USE:
- Cheesy real estate transitions
- Generic luxury graphics
- Logo intros
- Property-stat slides
- Slow traditional house-tour editing
- Excessive effects
- AI-generated modifications to the property

The goal is entertainment first, real estate second.

Someone should be able to watch all 10–12 seconds without caring about real estate simply because the edit is satisfying.

DELIVERABLES:
- 1 final 9:16 high-quality Reel
- 2–3 initial pacing/edit variations
- Seamless visual and audio loop
- Basic color correction/stabilization as needed
- Revisions to perfect timing and loop
- Final high-quality export ready for Instagram

BUDGET:
$30 fixed for this first video.

If the work is exceptional, I expect to have additional Aspen luxury property, event and lifestyle content to edit in the future.

IMPORTANT:
Because I am filming tomorrow, I am especially interested in hiring someone quickly.

If selected before the shoot, I may ask you what specific opening/exterior shots or camera movements I should capture tomorrow to give you the best possible material for the seamless loop.

TO APPLY:

Start your proposal with the word ASPEN so I know you read the brief.

Please send 2–3 examples of your BEST short-form work, preferably videos under 20 seconds.

I am NOT looking for your longest or most cinematic real estate video. Show me work that demonstrates retention, pacing, taste and precise editing.

Also answer this in ONE sentence:

How would you make the final exterior shot transition naturally back into the opening door shot so the viewer barely notices the Reel restarted?

jobs.title: Commission Sales for Video Editing

jobs.title: Flutter Revamp & Laravel API
jobs.description:
I already have a live Flutter app backed by a Laravel-PHP server. I need to move fast on a small but important upgrade cycle.

First, the front-end. I want the current screens re-laid out so they feel lighter and more intuitive; that means rearranging widgets, spacing, and visual hierarchy. Alongside this, I’m switching to a refreshed colour palette—so every component that references the old theme will need updating to the new colours, text styles and icon accents. Everything should compile cleanly on both Android and iOS when you are done.

Second, new functionality. I’ll share the exact feature list after we start, but each one will require clean RESTful endpoints. That is where the Laravel side comes in: I need you to create the necessary controllers, routes and eloquent models, then hand those JSON APIs back to the Flutter app with proper request validation and token-based access.

To keep things tidy, please:

• refactor only what you touch,  
• comment your code clearly, and  
• push daily to our private Git repo so I can review progress.

Test that screens render correctly on common devices and that every new API call returns the expected payloads with 200 responses.

If this fits your skill set and schedule, let’s start right away—I’ll provide the Figma files, current source, and server credentials as soon as we agree on milestones.

jobs.title: eLearning Expert needed that is an Expert in using ThingLink & Articulate 360
jobs.description:

I would like my project completed in a week.

•	Articulate Storyline 360 variables, conditions, triggers, questions, branching, drag-and-drop activities, assessments, and publishing
•	Instructional design and professional training workflows

IMPORTANT — Experience Must Be Proven
Do not bid unless you can demonstrate multiple years of real experience with BOTH ThingLink and Articulate Storyline 360.
In your bid, please provide:

•	How many years you have used Articulate Storyline 360

You must be able to communicate and narrate clearly in excellent spoken English.

I will release the full milestone when the lessons, testing, videos, text, images, documents, source files, project files, and all testing work created for me is completed, delivered, and accepted by me.
I do not pay any milestones until the lessons, videos, text, images, documents, source files, project files, and all testing work created for me is completed, all files delivered, and accepted by me.
If your work is High Quality and exactly what I need I would be interested in considering you for Future projects.
I don't communicate on Sundays and I don't expect you to work on Sundays.

jobs.title: Fix SSL Issues on Website
jobs.description:

I need someone to:
- Diagnose and fix the SSL certificate issues
- Ensure the site is accessible without security warnings on all devices

Ideal skills and experience:
- Strong knowledge of SSL certificates and web security
- Experience with popular web hosting services
- Ability to troubleshoot and resolve browser security warnings

Your expertise will help me ensure my website is secure and accessible.

jobs.title: Marathi Rehab Center Brochure Design
jobs.description:
I am launching a new rehabilitation centre and need a 6–7 page brochure created in Marathi right away. The piece is mainly informative, so it must clearly outline our services, weave in a few short patient testimonials and finish with complete contact details.

My own content guidelines and copy are ready; I will pass them along as soon as we connect. Colours and overall look are yours to decide—as long as the final design feels welcoming, professional and easy to read in Marathi.

Because the centre is based in Maharashtra, I would prefer someone from Pune or Mumbai who understands local nuances and can ensure flawless Marathi typography. Experience with Adobe InDesign, Illustrator or CorelDRAW for print-ready output is ideal.

Deliverables
• 6-7 page brochure in print-ready PDF (CMYK, 300 dpi)
• Editable source file
• Web-optimised PDF for online sharing

Turnaround is urgent, so please let me know how quickly you can start and your estimated timeline for first proofs and final delivery.

jobs.title: Translate Two Norwegian Audio Clips
jobs.description:
I have two short video recordings (one is 6 seconds the other is ~30 seconds) of casual conversations in standard Norwegian that I need rendered into clear, idiomatic English. No strong dialects or slang appear, but I still want every nuance captured.

Here’s what I’m expecting:
• An English transcript for each clip, with light time-stamps so I can reference specific moments.
• (Optional but appreciated) A matching Norwegian transcript to sit side-by-side with the translation for quick comparison.

Both files are brief, so a fast turnaround is possible once I share the videos. Let me know your experience with Norwegian-to-English audio translation and how soon you can deliver the completed transcripts.

jobs.title: Cinematic Photo Video Production
jobs.description:
I’m looking to have a polished, film-like video crafted entirely from my existing photos. The goal is to blend still imagery with tasteful motion, subtle transitions, and a fitting soundtrack so the final piece feels like a true cinematic short rather than a simple slideshow. 

Because the intended use, mood, and length are still open, I’m happy to discuss creative direction with you—whether that means leaning into something romantic, dynamic, or more dramatic, and whether it ultimately becomes a brief highlight reel, an extended feature, or both. Your expertise in color grading, pacing, and sound design will be key.

Deliverables  
• Final video in Full-HD (or 4K if feasible) ready for online sharing and archival  
• Source project files so future edits remain possible  
• Two export versions: one mastered for streaming, another optimized for large-screen playback

I’ll provide the photo files and any reference music or visual inspirations once we agree on style. Let me know your typical turnaround time, the software you prefer to work in (Premiere Pro, Final Cut, DaVinci Resolve, or similar), and any sample work that demonstrates your cinematic approach.

jobs.title: HR Consulting Business Setup
jobs.description:
I’m launching an independent Human Resource consulting firm and want a clear, actionable framework in place before I open my doors. The practice will centre on four core services—Recruitment, HR Policy Development, Performance Management, and creation of SOPs—so every deliverable must align with these pillars.

Here’s what I need from you:  

• A concise business plan that translates my vision into specific objectives, target markets, pricing models, and realistic first-year milestones.  
• Service playbooks and ready-to-use templates for each offering (e.g., recruitment workflow, policy handbook outline, performance review guide, SOP checklist).  
• An operating structure covering legal registrations, basic accounting set-up, and data-privacy considerations common to HR consulting.  
• A practical go-to-market strategy highlighting positioning, messaging, and the first three outreach campaigns I can execute on LinkedIn and email.  

I’ll provide background notes on my experience and market focus once we start; you turn them into polished, client-ready assets. If you have proven expertise launching or scaling HR consultancies—and can share samples that show strategic depth rather than just theory—let’s talk.

jobs.title: Professional Etsy Listing Optimization
jobs.description:
I recently launched a new product on Etsy and want to elevate its presence by refining two critical areas: the Description and tags. I’m looking for a specialist who can craft a polished, keyword-rich product narrative in a Professional and formal tone and pair it with an SEO-focused tag set that drives traffic and conversions.

What you’ll deliver
• A compelling, plagiarism-free product description (approx. 150–250 words) written in a clear, Professional and formal style.  
• A fully researched set of up to 13 Etsy tags that target high-intent keywords while remaining aligned with shop branding.  
• A brief rationale outlining the keyword strategy so I understand how each tag supports visibility.

Resources I can supply
• Current draft description and any existing tags.  
• Product images, specs, and background notes.  

Success criteria
• Description reads naturally, highlights key features, and meets Etsy’s formatting best practices.  
• All tags are unique, relevant, and compliant with Etsy character limits.  
• Work is ready for me to copy-paste directly into the listing.

If you have proven results optimizing Etsy listings, especially in my product’s niche, I’d love to see examples. Let’s give this new listing the professional polish it deserves.

jobs.title: End-to-End Shopify Integration

jobs.title: Dali Artwork Essay -- 2
jobs.description:
I need an in-depth essay on Salvador Dali's "The Geopoliticus Child Watching the Birth of the New Man." 

Requirements:
- In-depth visual analysis
- Brief mention of Dali's background and its influence

Ideal skills and experience:
- Strong art analysis skills
- Background in art history, especially Dali
- Excellent writing skills
INTRO PAGE- DO NOT USE WIDE MARGINS, PARTIAL PAGES OR DOUBLE-DOUBLE SPACES BETWEEN PARAGRAPHS!
IN THE FIRST PARAGRAPH (NO MORE THAN 1/3-OF THE FIRST PAGE)

 You will include in your review the name of the Museum, the location, the date of your visit- Who, What, When, Where, Why.

IN THE FOLLOWING PARAGRAPHS (2/3 OF THE FIRST PAGE)-

You will give a BRIEF general overview of the museum including the various collections, the Exhibit currently being presented and any other relevant information about the Museum or Exhibit.

 

BODY OF WORK- MINIMUM OF TWO FULL PAGES -NO WIDE MARGINS, PARTIAL PAGES OR DOUBLE-DOUBLE SPACES BETWEEN PARAGRAPHS! You will choose ONLY-ONE-SINGLE-SPECIFIC-piece of art to Research with “in-depth” detail. You will use a Minimum of SIX (6) acceptable sources for this research (see directions for acceptable sources).
Use proper scholarly art terminology in describing the subject. You must use Parenthetical Citations throughout each and every paragraph while discussing the subject.  Follow all rules and directions for formatting these Research Reviews.

HOW DO YOU WRITE ABOUT ONE SINGLE OBJECT OF ART?

1. Research and discuss the Artist's background for 1-2 paragraphs

2. Research the subject of the Art  (who is in the painting, what is the artwork about, what is the story depicted in the artwork) for 1-2 paragraphs

3. Research and explain the medium used to create the art (painting, photography, sculpture, drawing, lithograph, woodblock, engraving, etc.) for 1-2 paragraphs

4, Research and discuss the materials used to create the art (oil, watercolour, pen and ink, chalk, charcoal, granite, wood, ivory, marble, platinum or silver print, etc.) for 1-2 paragraphs

5. Research and discuss the possible influence on the artist at the time the art was created (War, riots, poverty, family struggles, etc.) for 1-2 paragraphs

6. Research and discuss the Provenance (the life and story) of the artwork itself (Who commissioned it, who was it sold to, what country did it reside in, was it ever stolen, who donated it to the museum, did the museum buy it, etc.) for 1-2 paragraphs

 

CONCLUSION PAGE- A FULL PAGE IS REQUIRED -NO WIDE MARGINS, PARTIAL PAGES OR DOUBLE-DOUBLE SPACES BETWEEN PARAGRAPHS!
YOU WILL DISCUSS WHAT YOU THOUGHT OF THE PIECE OF ART AND WHAT YOU WHAT HAVE DONE DIFFERENTLY HAD YOU BEEN THE ARTIST!!!

 

WORKS CITED PAGE- USE PROPER FORMATTING OF MLA FOR ALL SOURCES. ALL SOURCES MUST BE IN ALPHABETICAL ORDER. DO NOT SIMPLY GIVE A WEBADDRESS. 
 

VERY IMPORTANT! You Must Staple your ticket, receipt, or sticker from the Museum onto the BACK of the LAST PAGE of the Review.  Failure to do so will result in a grade of zero. Paper clips of any kind are Not acceptable. Do Not tape the ticket to the Review. There will be no exceptions.
 

THIS IS THE FORMAT FOR YOUR MUSEUM RESEARCH REVIEW:

The Review must be No Shorter than FOUR-Full-Pages as discussed AND no shorter than 1400 words. (This Minimum word count does NOT include the Works Cited Page).
Use only Times New Roman 12-point font; no others will be accepted.
You must use MLA Style for your parenthetical citations and Works Cited Section. Refer to your ENC textbook, an MLA Handbook, or visit the Writing Center at the HCC Library.
You must use a Minimum of SIX (6) acceptable approved sources (SEE LIST BELOW). You must include Parenthetical Citations extensively throughout the entire paper in each and every paragraph. Include a works cited section at the end. One citation at the end of a paragraph or page is Not enough, use them throughout.
Use only Black ink; no others will be accepted.
It Must be typed with No hand-writing found on it what-so-ever. That includes page numbers.
It Must be Double-spaced, not space and a half. Do Not double-double space between paragraphs.
Use white paper only; no recycled green, etc.
Only one side of each page may be printed on.
Turn in a clean-clear copy only; smeared/smudged/streaked/torn copies will not be accepted-do not ask.
The paper Must be stapled together in the upper left corner. Paper clips of any kind will not be accepted.
Do Not use a cover page. Do Not use foot notes.
PLEASE NOTE: Colloquialisms, slang, vulgar phrases, and contractions are not considered formal writing. Do not use them under any circumstance.
Italicize any ancient, foreign or unusual words.
First, type in the upper LEFT corner of the first page: your name on the first line, HUM 1020 MW 11:00 on the second line, and ‘Museum Research Review’ on the third. (Use single space between these lines)
Do Not use a header or a page number on the first page.
Include a “Title” centered on the first page of the paper below the information in number 15.
On all subsequent pages your last name should appear in the upper left corner and the page number should appear in the upper right corner.
Do not paginate at the bottom of the paper.

jobs.title: Modern-Vintage 3BHK Interior Design
jobs.description:
I have just bought a 3-bedroom apartment and would like every space—living room, all three bedrooms, and the kitchen—to feel crisp, modern and airy, yet softened by tasteful vintage accents. Think clean lines, neutral palettes, contemporary fittings and then a carefully chosen antique chest, a patterned rug, or a retro pendant that adds character without clutter.  

I’m flexible on the exact vintage elements—be it a statement sideboard, period lighting or small décor pieces—so long as they blend seamlessly and are used sparingly. The priority is balance: predominantly modern surfaces and storage solutions with subtle traditional touches.

Here’s what I will need from you:  
• Mood boards showing the overall concept for each room  
• Scaled space planning with furniture layout  
• 3D visualisations or rendered elevations so I can “walk through” the design before committing  
• A detailed specification sheet covering materials, finishes, colour codes, lighting fixtures and any vintage finds you propose  
• Purchasing list with links or sourcing guidance for both modern items and selected vintage pieces  
• On-call clarification during the implementation stage  

Please share examples of similar hybrid-style projects you’ve completed and outline your typical design process. If your portfolio proves you can fuse sleek modern interiors with just-right retro charm, let’s begin.

jobs.title: Flipkart Product Listing & Support
jobs.description:
I manage a growing range of Indian spices and need an extra pair of hands to keep our Flipkart account running smoothly. Your primary focus will be threefold: upload each new spice SKU with accurate titles, images, and SEO-rich descriptions; stay on top of daily order processing so nothing ships late; and promptly handle buyer messages or return requests in a friendly, brand-appropriate tone.

Because we sell only spices, familiarity with grocery or FMCG catalog standards on Flipkart will be a plus. You’ll work directly in the Flipkart Seller Hub, so proven experience with its listing tools, inventory panel, and order dashboard is essential. I’ll supply product photos, basic specs, and pricing—your job is to polish, publish, and keep everything up to date.

Performance will be judged on zero listing errors, on-time order dispatch accuracy, and responsive customer communication (within the SLA Flipkart tracks). If you’re comfortable taking full ownership of these day-to-day tasks and can start right away, let’s talk.

jobs.title: Commission-Based Sales Rep Recruitment
jobs.description:
Title: Recruit Commission-Based Field Sales Representatives

I need an experienced recruiter to source and initially screen commission-based field sales representatives for WeProcess, beginning in New Jersey.

The sales position offers:
- Flexible scheduling
- Upfront commissions
- Performance bonuses

- No salary or hourly wage
