jobs.title: ICAEW Affiliate Reference
jobs.description:
I need a Chartered Accountant who can act as the official referee on my application for ICAEW affiliate status. The Institute’s form asks the referee to confirm that I am a “fit and proper” person for this authorisation, so the signature must come from someone already holding ACA/FCA status and in good standing with the ICAEW.

Deliverable  
• Referee declaration completed and signed (PDF) confirming my suitability to be an affiliate member.

I need to submit the paperwork within the next week, so a quick turnaround would be greatly appreciated.

jobs.title: SAMP iOS Private Server Connector
jobs.description:
I need a solid SAMP-style client for iOS that can reliably log my GTA San Andreas copy into private multiplayer servers. The only feature I care about right now is establishing, maintaining, and cleanly dropping the multiplayer connection; chat, HUD tweaks, and other extras can wait for later milestones.  

The servers I use aren’t stock—they run several custom modifications—so the handshake, packet order, and any opcode quirks those mods introduce must be handled gracefully. I can supply sample IPs and their current pawn scripts for testing once we start.  

Your deliverable is an Xcode project (Swift or Objective-C) that:  
• Detects and lists a given private server’s status (player count, ping).  
• Joins the server, loads the modded resources without crashing, and spawns the player in-game.  
• Reconnects automatically after intermittent drops.  
• Exposes clean hooks so I can layer chat, UI, and control schemes afterwards.  

Please keep third-party libraries lightweight and ensure everything you add is App Store-compliant; I may pursue TestFlight distribution later. Document any custom network handling in plain English so I can maintain it myself.

jobs.title: Edit My Videography Portfolio Reel
jobs.description:
I’m ready to refresh my portfolio with a punchy showreel and need an editor who can shape my scattered clips into a seamless, high-energy story. You’ll be working with a mix of interview bites, event moments, and product shots that I’ll supply via a shared drive; if we see gaps, I’m open to short bursts of royalty-free stock to keep the flow tight.  

My goal is a clean, modern reel that sits comfortably under three minutes—sharp pacing, tasteful motion graphics, smooth transitions, balanced colour, and a soundtrack that lifts the visuals without overpowering them. I cut on Adobe Premiere Pro myself, so keeping the workflow in that ecosystem (or DaVinci Resolve if you prefer) makes future tweaks easier.  

Deliverables  
• Final master in 4K MP4 (H.264) and a web-friendly 1080p copy  
• Premiere (or Resolve) project with all linked media and assets clearly organised  
• Two revision passes included so we can fine-tune pacing, titles, and audio  

When you reply, point me to at least one reel you’ve cut for a creative, agency, or solo filmmaker. If it feels like the right fit, I’ll share the footage immediately so you can start building the story.

jobs.title: SaaS Review Campaign and Online Reputation Management Advice Needed
jobs.description:
My team and I are looking to strengthen our SaaS company's presence on Capterra, G2, and Google Business. We currently have very few reviews across all three directories, so I’m looking for someone who can help us to secure feedback and further assist in providing reputation management advice.

Because I'm anticipating that competitor reputation analysis and reviews will become a factor in the ideal client profile that we pursue in acquisition channels, I've already prepared research briefs on all of our competitors and their reviewer profiles that we can build acquisition strategy on.

When you respond, highlight three things:  
• Your English language proficiency (written only)  
• Past wins in reputation management for SaaS or other tech businesses  

I’ll review proposals as they arrive and will fund milestones tied to delivery. The price is negotiable depending upon the scale of support you're willing to offer my business; as this could become a long-format operation with customer drip campaigns and so on.

jobs.title: Vibrant Children's Book Illustrator

jobs.title: Development of AI-Driven Mobile Application for LPG Gas Distribution
jobs.description:

The purpose of this platform is to integrate with our merger distributors (Afrox, Oryx, EasyGas, Total) and provide consumers nationwide a seamless solution for purchasing LPG gas cylinders (9kg, 19kg, and 48kg) at discounted prices.

Key Features Required:
- User-friendly mobile app interface with responsive design.
- Website complementing app functionality.
- API integration with supplier systems for real-time inventory and pricing updates.
- Customer dashboards for personalized account management.
- Order management from placement to fulfillment, with delivery tracking.
- Payment gateway integrations supporting secure and diverse payment options.
- National delivery mapping and route optimization.
- Intelligent AI automation for enhanced operations and user engagement.
- Finance tools with Xero accounting software integration.
- Partner and admin dashboards for streamlined coordination.
- Analytics and reporting features for decision-making support.

Ideal Candidate:

jobs.title: Finalize Wix Site Design
jobs.description:
My Wix website is sitting at roughly 90 % and the clock is ticking—launch is tomorrow. I’ve done all the heavy lifting in the Wix editor (working through the Symphony flow), but at this point Symphony keeps looping and I can’t nudge the last visual details into place.

Here’s what still needs your touch today:
• Tune the colour scheme and font pairings so they feel cohesive and distinctly classic and traditional.  
• Tidy page layouts—section spacing, alignment, and flow—from the home page through the remaining internal pages.  
• Optimise or swap a handful of images/graphics for sharper resolution, faster load-times and full-width consistency on mobile.

Everything is on Wix, so please be comfortable diving straight into the editor, using built-in design tools, and applying any light custom CSS necessary. The finished site must look polished on desktop, tablet and mobile, with no broken links or off-kilter elements. Once you’ve made the fixes, I’ll review, hit Publish and we go live.

If you have the bandwidth to jump in immediately and can commit to turning this around before the day ends, I’d love your help.

jobs.title: Profitable Roblox Game Development
jobs.description:
I want to launch a polished Roblox experience that can be built quickly, run smoothly on every device, and earn solid revenue from day one. The game must welcome players of all ages, so performance, clarity, and accessibility are key. 

Core requirements  
• Multiplayer that feels seamless—no rubber-banding or long load times.  
• A well-designed in-game purchase system (Developer Products/Passes) that encourages repeat spending without feeling pay-to-win.  

I’m flexible on the specific genre as long as it lends itself to replayability and community engagement; your creative input here is welcome. What matters most is rock-solid code in Lua, efficient use of RemoteEvents/Functions, reliable DataStore saving, and clean UI that scales from phone to console.

Deliverables  
• Complete Roblox place file with all scripts, assets, and monetisation hooks.  
• Optimisation for 60 FPS on mobile.  
• Basic analytics script so I can track retention and purchase behaviour.  
• Clear setup notes so future updates are straightforward.

If this sounds like a sprint you can tackle, let me know how many days you’ll need and what milestones make sense so we can move from idea to live game—and profits—as fast as possible.

jobs.title: Retail Predictive Analytics Data Scientist
jobs.description:
I need a data scientist who can build a robust predictive analytics solution for a retail-focused use case. My datasets include sales transactions, product metadata, marketing campaign logs, customer reviews, and social media chatter, so you will be working with a mix of structured tables and unstructured text.

Your mission is to extract the signals that drive sell-through, forecast demand at SKU and store level, and surface actionable insights for merchandising and marketing. I expect you to handle everything from data ingestion and cleaning through to model deployment, with clear documentation of assumptions and feature engineering steps.

You may use Python (pandas, scikit-learn, XGBoost, Prophet, TensorFlow, or similar), SQL for warehousing, and NLP libraries such as spaCy or transformers for the text components. If you prefer R or another stack, I’m open as long as the final model meets the accuracy and interpretability goals.

Deliverables  
• Cleaned and well-structured datasets ready for modelling  
• Reproducible notebooks / scripts showing EDA, feature engineering, and model training  
• A predictive model (or ensemble) with validated performance metrics  
• Summary report and slide deck translating findings into retail business actions  
• Deployment-ready code or API endpoint for ongoing predictions

Acceptance criteria  
• Minimum MAPE < 10 % on the hold-out test set  
• Code passes peer review for readability and modularity  
• All steps reproducible on my environment using a requirements.txt or environment.yml

Timeline is flexible within reason, but please outline milestones for data prep, modelling, validation, and final delivery when you respond. I’m happy to answer any clarifying questions before we kick off.

jobs.title: Web Farmer Simulation Game
jobs.description:
I’m looking to build a small-scale, browser-based farming simulation that revolves around animal husbandry. Players should be able to buy livestock, feed and breed them, collect products (milk, eggs, wool, etc.), and watch their farm stats grow in real time.  

Key requirements  
• Platform: Web – the game must run smoothly in all modern browsers without extra plugins.

jobs.title: Lead Generation & Customer Acquisition Manager — UK Online Tutoring Business
jobs.description:
We are launching a UK-based online tutoring business focused initially on GCSE students, with plans to expand into A-Level and other education services.

We are looking for an experienced Lead Generation Specialist / Digital Marketer to take responsibility for acquiring new customers.

Start date: 1 October 2026

This is intended to become a long-term ongoing role for the right person.

What we need

Our target customer is primarily:

* Parents/guardians of UK GCSE students
* Year 10 and Year 11 students
* Initially focused on GCSE Maths
* Parents looking for regular online tutoring
* Parents concerned about grades, exams or upcoming assessments

Your job will be to help us consistently generate genuine, qualified enquiries from UK parents who are interested in purchasing tutoring.

We are not looking for purchased lead lists or generic contact databases.

We want someone who understands how to turn marketing activity into actual paying customers.

Your responsibilities

You will be responsible for:

* Developing a lead-generation strategy
* Identifying the best target audiences
* Researching competitors and the UK tutoring market
* Selecting appropriate acquisition channels
* Creating and managing campaigns
* Developing advertising/outreach messaging
* Testing different offers
* Generating and qualifying leads
* Tracking lead sources
* Managing the lead pipeline
* Monitoring conversion rates
* Optimising campaigns
* Providing weekly performance reports
* Recommending how we should scale successful campaigns

Potential acquisition channels include:

* Facebook/Instagram
* Google Ads
* Organic social media
* Local/community marketing
* Parent communities
* Partnerships
* Referral campaigns
* Content marketing
* Other legitimate lead-generation methods you believe would work

You do not need to use all of these. We want you to recommend the channels you believe have the greatest potential.

What we care about

We are much more interested in quality and conversions than simply generating large numbers of leads.

For example:

100 leads → 5 qualified → 1 customer

is potentially less valuable than:

30 leads → 15 qualified → 6 customers.

We therefore want to track:

* Leads generated
* Qualified leads
* Cost per lead
* Cost per qualified lead
* Customer conversion rate
* Customer acquisition cost
* Revenue generated
* Return on advertising spend
* Overall profitability

What you will have available

We are building the business infrastructure before launch, including:

* Brand
* Website/landing pages
* CRM
* Student management
* Tutor management
* Client management
* Pricing and offers
* Online tutoring service
* Internal business management system

Your primary responsibility will be customer acquisition.

Ideal candidate

We would particularly like to hear from candidates who have:

* Proven lead-generation experience
* Experience generating customers for service businesses
* Experience with paid advertising
* Experience with Facebook/Instagram or Google Ads
* Experience with UK audiences
* Experience with education/tutoring businesses
* Strong understanding of conversion funnels
* Strong analytical skills
* Experience managing campaigns independently

Tutoring/education experience is not essential if you can demonstrate strong results in another service-based industry.

Important

We are looking for someone who can think and make recommendations, not someone who simply waits for instructions.

You should be able to look at the business and say:

“This is the audience I would target, this is the offer I would test, this is the channel I would use, this is how I would measure it, and this is how I would improve it.”

The successful freelancer will have considerable autonomy over the lead-generation function.

First 30 days

The first month will focus on:

Research → Strategy → Setup → Testing → Optimisation

You will initially research the market and competitors, establish the acquisition strategy, launch initial campaigns and use the data to determine what works.

We are not expecting a guaranteed number of customers on day one. We want to establish a repeatable and scalable acquisition system.

Long-term opportunity

The initial target is to build a strong base of GCSE students and then expand into:

* GCSE Maths
* GCSE English
* GCSE Science
* Other GCSE subjects
* A-Level
* Exam preparation
* Revision programmes
* Additional education services

If you can successfully build the customer acquisition side of the business, there is significant potential for this to become a long-term management role as the company grows.

⸻

How to Apply

Please do not send a generic proposal.

Start your proposal with:

“GRADERISE”

Then briefly answer:

1. What is your experience generating paying customers?
2. What lead-generation channels would you test first for a UK GCSE tutoring business?
3. What would your first 30 days look like?
4. Give one example of a campaign you have previously managed, including results if possible.
5. If given a £1,000 advertising budget, how would you initially use it?
6. What would you consider a qualified lead for this business?
7. What information would you need from us before starting?

Please include actual results/numbers from previous campaigns where possible.

We are willing to pay for the right person and are not simply looking for the cheapest applicant.

Start date: 1 October 2026

Long-term opportunity for the right candidate.

jobs.title: Certified Asia Industrial Goods Import-Export Consultant
jobs.description:

• Highlighting key free-trade agreements and regional incentives that could improve overall landed cost

Deliverables I expect:
1. A concise roadmap (PDF or Word) detailing the recommended workflow, contacts, and timelines for my first shipment cycle  
2. Templates or checklists for essential documents (commercial invoice, packing list, certificate of origin, import/export permits) ready for me to adapt

Success will be measured by the clarity and practicality of the roadmap, the completeness of the document templates, and my ability to action the plan immediately after our debrief.

Experience with industrial goods and hands-on familiarity with Asian customs procedures are critical. Tools such as trade-data platforms, HS code lookup systems, and standard compliance software are welcome but not required—as long as the final advice is actionable and country-specific.

If this aligns with your expertise, please outline relevant projects you have handled, approximate timelines for the deliverables above, and any additional value you can bring to ensure a smooth launch into these markets.

jobs.title: CE Course Approval & Compliance Coordinator -- 3
jobs.description:
Continuing Education Course Approval & Compliance Coordinator
Location: Remote
Must be a native English speaker from an English speaking country.
Task based
About the Role
We operate continuing education platforms serving licensees across multiple states. We're expanding into new states (Illinois, and others) and need someone to own the entire course-approval lifecycle — from identifying what we need to offer, through getting it approved by the state licensing board, building the actual course, and keeping it compliant and renewed year after year.
This is an end-to-end ownership role. You will be the single point of accountability for each state and each course offering: A to Z.
What You'll Own
Regulatory research
Research each target state's CE requirements: required topics, mandatory hour breakdowns, course categories (e.g., core/mandatory vs. elective), instructor and provider qualifications, and approval pathways.
Track the specific rules of each licensing board (e.g., Illinois, and other state real estate commissions) and translate them into a concrete plan for what we need to submit.
Application & approval
Complete and assemble provider and course approval applications for each state, including all supporting documentation (course outlines, timed agendas, learning objectives, assessments, instructor credentials, certificates of completion samples).
Submit applications, pay/track fees, and manage the back-and-forth with board reviewers — responding to deficiency notices and revision requests until approval is granted.
Course development
Develop the actual course content we'll offer for each approved topic — outlines, slides, written materials, quizzes/exams, and answer keys — built to satisfy the board's requirements and our platform's format.
Coordinate with subject-matter experts, writers, or AI-assisted content tools as needed.
Compliance & renewal
Maintain a master calendar of approval expiration dates and renewal deadlines across all states and courses.
File renewals on time, update content when regulations change, and keep all course materials and records audit-ready.
Monitor regulatory changes in active states and flag anything that affects existing offerings.
What Success Looks Like
New state offerings go from "we want to enter Illinois" to "approved and live" without items falling through the cracks.
No course ever lapses due to a missed renewal.
Applications come back approved with minimal deficiency cycles because submissions are thorough the first time.
Qualifications
Strong project management and organizational skills; comfortable owning many parallel deadlines across different jurisdictions.
Excellent written communication — you'll be drafting applications, course materials, and formal correspondence with state agencies.
Detail-oriented and comfortable reading and interpreting administrative regulations and statutes.
Self-directed; able to run a process end-to-end with minimal hand-holding.
Nice to have
Prior experience with continuing education, professional licensing, accreditation, or regulatory submissions (real estate, insurance, nursing, etc.).
Instructional design or course development background.

jobs.title: Unblock Residential Bathroom Sink Drain
jobs.description:
My residential sewage line has developed a stubborn obstruction that is isolating the bathroom sink only; the toilet and shower remain unaffected. Water now drains extremely slowly, so a straightforward chemical pour-in solution is no longer enough.

What I need is a professional-grade mechanical or hydro solution—whether that is a hand or power auger, mini-jetting, or a small-diameter inspection camera—to locate and clear the clog without damaging existing PVC. Once flow is fully restored I would also like a brief note (photos or a short video clip are fine) confirming the blockage location and probable cause, plus any simple preventative tips I can follow.

Access is easy: the vanity has a removable panel that exposes the trap, and there is a clean-out just outside the bathroom if you prefer to come in from the line. Please bring any protective covers you might need; I’ll have towels ready and can shut off water to the fixture before you arrive.

Completion is accepted when:
• The sink drains freely for at least two consecutive full-basin tests.  
• Visual evidence or a short summary is provided showing the obstruction was cleared and the pipe remains intact.

If scheduling permits, evenings after 5 pm or weekends work best for me, but I can be flexible for a quick same-day slot.

jobs.title: Architect / Designer Needed ASAP – Existing ADU Permit Plan Set – Hawthorne, CA / LA County
jobs.description:
I am looking for an experienced architect, residential designer, or draftsperson who can begin immediately and turn around a permit-ready architectural plan set very quickly for an existing attached ADU in Hawthorne, California. The current “casita” is attached to the main house and I have already obtained permits to remodel the existing house. No plans are needed for the main house-part of the project.

PROJECT BACKGROUND

The ADU structure already exists and was originally permitted and built as an addition in the 1980s. No square footage is being added to or removed from the ADU; I am only seeking to formalize its use. The plans that were submitted at the time of the addition are attached.
When the permitted addition was built in the 80’s it included:
•	Living area
•	Bedroom
•	Bathroom
However, the original permit did not include a formal kitchenette or separate entry configuration, so the space is not currently recognized as an independent dwelling unit. These plans will formalize this.

The goal of this project is to prepare the architectural and supporting plans necessary to formalize the existing space as an ADU.

REQUIRED PLAN SET

Unincorporated LA County has indicated that the submittal will need to include approximately the following:
•	Site plan
•	Existing and proposed floor plans
•	Exterior elevations
•	Framing / structural information as required
•	Electrical plan
•	Plumbing plan
•	Mechanical plan
•	Title 24 documentation
•	Other typical notes/details necessary for permit submission and plan review

WHAT IS ALREADY AVAILABLE

This is not a project starting from a blank sheet of paper.
I already have:
•	The original permitted architectural plans from the 1980s (this gives the dimensions for the site plan and roof line only)
•	A floorplan of the existing main house and addition/ADU that I created in a program called RoomSketcher. 
•	The proposed floorplan that closes the door between the 2 units and shows where the kitchenette will be located. Also drawn in RoomSketcher.
•	Dimensions and photographs of the property
•	The ability to provide additional photographs, measurements, angles, and field information very quickly
•	A clear concept for the final layout

I essentially need someone who can take the information I have already assembled and translate it into a professional, code-appropriate permit plan set that the jurisdiction can review.

Turnaround Is Extremely Important

This is a rush project.

I am specifically looking for someone who has the bandwidth to start immediately, rather than adding the project to a queue for several weeks.
Please include in your proposal:
1.	Your experience preparing residential ADU or conversion plans in California
2.	Any experience working with Los Angeles County or jurisdictions in the Los Angeles area
3.	Whether you can prepare or coordinate Title 24 documentation
4.	Whether you can provide the architectural, electrical, plumbing, mechanical, and framing information needed for a complete submittal
5.	Your earliest possible start date
6.	Your estimated turnaround time for the first permit-ready plan set
7.	Examples of similar permit sets you have completed
8.	Your proposed fixed fee or estimated project cost

I am available to provide the existing plans, proposed floor plan, photographs, measurements, and other project information immediately.
Priority will be given to candidates who have relevant California residential permitting experience and can begin work right away.

jobs.title: Precise Image-Wrapped Cylinder STL
jobs.description:

I will supply a grayscale PNG to use as relief that has to wrap cleanly around the curved surface. Whether you choose displacement, embossing, or simple texture mapping is up to you, as long as the image is clearly reproduced on the print and there are no visible seams or stretching. Relief dimensions must be between 0 mm and 1.2 mm with a maximum of 1.2 mm.

Please:  
• apply the PNG correctly,  
• keep wall thickness within stated dimensions and and 3D print-friendly,  
• verify scale inside the file, and  
• export a STL.

I’ll run the STL through my slicer to confirm fit; if the size is off by more than ±0.1 mm or the image alignment drifts, I’ll ask for a quick tweak. Once everything slices perfectly, we’re done.

jobs.title: Cellular Biology Research Support
jobs.description:
I am assembling a technically rigorous piece on cellular biology that will be read by fellow researchers. To make sure every claim is fully backed by current primary literature and that all graphics convey complex mechanisms unambiguously, I need a cellular-biology specialist who can jump in at a moment’s notice.

Here is how I see the collaboration unfolding:

• Literature integration – pull and summarise the most recent peer-reviewed studies relevant to my outline, then weave them seamlessly into the draft with proper citations (PubMed, Web of Science).  
• Figure refinement – re-draw or enhance pathway diagrams and microscopy images so they meet publication quality (Illustrator or BioRender preferred).  
• Critical review – scrutinise the methodology section for accuracy, reproducibility and statistical soundness, flagging any gaps.  
• Final proof – ensure terminology, gene/protein nomenclature and reference style all match typical researcher expectations (e.g., Cell, Nature Methods guidelines).

Acceptance criteria  
1. All added references published within the past five years unless a seminal paper is required.  
2. Graphics delivered as both editable (AI or SVG) and high-resolution PNG/PDF.  
3. No unverified statements; every data point or claim must trace back to a cited source.  
4. Turnaround on feedback within 48 hours.

If you are fluent in the language of signal transduction, organelle dynamics, or single-cell techniques and you enjoy tightening manuscripts for a critical scientific audience, I’d love to work together.

jobs.title: UE5 Combat Multiplayer Prototype
jobs.description:
I’ve sketched out a fast-paced multiplayer concept and now need a solid Unreal Engine 5 foundation my team can safely expand. The core of this first milestone is a small but fully networked prototype centred on combat mechanics.

What I will hand over  
• A short design brief spelling out movement, weapon feel, and reference videos for pacing and camera.  
• Greybox sketches for the initial arena-style map.

What I need back  
1. A replicated character controller (third-person or first-person is fine as long as it mirrors authority rules you set).  
2. Basic matchmaking: a lightweight listen-server or similar approach that lets 2–8 players find or host a game in one click.  
3. One playable map built from my greybox, optimised for quick rounds and clear sight-lines.  
4. Clean, well-labelled Blueprints or C++ (your choice, but keep the graph or code readable and modular).  
5. A brief implementation document showing where authority resides, how replication is handled, and exactly where to plug in new abilities, weapons, or movement features.  

Acceptance criteria  
• Clients stay in sync under normal latency (tested at 120 ms round-trip).  
• No “owning client” exploits—server validates combat hit events.  
• Joining mid-match reliably spawns the player with correct state.  
• All Blueprint nodes / classes or C++ files are commented enough that a mid-level Unreal dev can extend them without reverse-engineering.  

Key tools & tech: Unreal Engine 5, Online Subsystem (native or Steam sockets), Blueprints and/or C++.

If this pilot build feels stable and readable, I’m ready to commission additional mechanics and maps straight away. Let’s get this prototype running!

jobs.title: U.S. Licensed Customs Broker Needed — HTS Classification & Pre-Import Compliance Review for China-to-USA Retail Kit
jobs.description:
Freelancer job title
U.S. Licensed Customs Broker Needed — HTS Classification & Pre-Import Compliance Review for China-to-USA Retail Kit

Job advertisement
We are a U.S. New Mexico LLC preparing our first commercial import from Qingdao, China, for sale through Amazon FBA in the United States.

We are seeking an active U.S. Customs and Border Protection licensed customs broker—not a general freight forwarder, sourcing agent, or unlicensed consultant—to provide an independent pre-import customs-compliance assessment and written HTSUS classification review.

The first shipment is complete and ready to ship. We plan to import the same product repeatedly, so we want to establish a correct, repeatable compliance process before moving the shipment and before placing future orders.

Product
The product is a sealed, retail-ready, non-food boot-care kit, labelled “Sold as Set.”

Each kit contains:

One finished solid-walnut wooden boot jack with a suede-lined heel cradle

Two finished pine-wood boot brushes

One canvas storage bag

One polyester cleaning cloth

The expected first shipment is:

Origin: Qingdao, China

Quantity: 500 retail kits

Packing: 42 master cartons

Approximate volume: 4.12 CBM

Approximate gross weight: 642 kg

Genuine supplier commercial-invoice value: USD 4,445

Destination: U.S. Amazon FBA warehouse or U.S. 3PL

Intended transport: LCL ocean freight

The manufacturer has confirmed final assembly in Shandong, China. Preliminary wood information is available, including walnut genus Juglans, confirmation that the wood is finished/bark-free, and basic factory/no-Xinjiang statements. However, scientific species, country of harvest, pine data, accessory sourcing, suede composition, and canvas fibre composition are currently incomplete. We need advice on exactly what must be obtained before shipment.

Required scope
Please provide a concise written report or memorandum, not only an HTS code, that covers:

Recommended 10-digit HTSUS classification for the complete retail kit, including analysis of whether it qualifies as a retail set and the essential-character/classification rationale.

Ordinary duty rate and all applicable China-origin tariff exposure, including relevant Chapter 99 / Section 301 treatment.

Initial AD/CVD scope screening and identification of any apparent issue.

Written determination of whether a Lacey Act declaration is likely required for the completed imported retail kit, based on the proposed HTSUS classification and current APHIS implementation schedule.

If a Lacey declaration or other wood-related requirement applies, a clear list of the exact data/documents needed from the supplier—for example, scientific genus/species, country of harvest, wood quantity, value, supplier identity, treatment/processing records, or supporting source documents.

Preliminary screening for USDA/APHIS, animal-product considerations if the suede is genuine animal material, EPA/TSCA, CPSC, country-of-origin marking, wood-packing/ISPM-15, and any other government-agency requirements that appear relevant.

Proportionate UFLPA / forced-labour risk screening and a practical list of records to retain or obtain before shipment.

A prioritised checklist separating:

Mandatory information/documents before shipment

Information recommended but not shipment-critical

Information required only if a particular classification, agency rule, examination, or CBP request applies

Identification of potential product, material, packaging, or kit-composition changes that could reduce compliance complexity or avoid an undesirable classification/tariff outcome for future production.

A concise Go / No-Go recommendation for the ready inventory, including key uncertainties or actions needed before the goods depart China.

Deliverables
Written report in English, preferably PDF or Word, approximately 2–6 pages plus any tables/checklists.

Recommended HTSUS classification with rationale.

Duty/tariff summary based on Chinese origin and declared value of USD 4,445.

Prioritised supplier-document checklist.

One 30–45 minute video/phone call to discuss findings and answer questions.

Optional separate quote for preparing a formal prospective CBP binding classification-ruling request. We are not automatically commissioning a ruling under this job.

Required qualifications
Please apply only if you can provide:

Your full legal name or brokerage firm legal name.

Your active U.S. customs broker licence number.

Your CBP permit/filer code, if applicable.

Confirmation that you are currently permitted to conduct U.S. customs business.

Experience classifying composite consumer goods, retail sets, wood products, home/gift products, footwear accessories, or similar merchandise.

Experience with China-origin tariff analysis and Lacey Act applicability.

Confirmation that you will personally perform or supervise the review.

Confirmation of whether you are willing to provide a separate quote for later entry filing, binding ruling support, or brokerage services.

Please do not apply if you cannot verify your active CBP broker credentials. We will independently verify credentials against CBP’s Permitted Customs Broker Listing before award.

Documents available
The successful applicant will receive:

Product photographs of the complete kit and individual components.

Retail-box and master-carton photos/markings.

Supplier commercial invoice and packing list/pro forma documents.

Product dimensions, weights, carton details, and quantities.

Manufacturer identity and Shandong factory address.

Existing supplier material/compliance information.

A list of unresolved supplier-information gaps.

We are looking for a practical, commercially aware expert who can distinguish between genuine legal requirements and merely “nice to have” documentation, so that we can import correctly without burdening the supplier unnecessarily.

• Source code and unit tests for the claims-processing module  
• Configurable rule library with sample medical edits loaded  
• Persistent audit-trail store and a simple viewer or export function  
• Deployment instructions (Docker or similar) so I can spin it up in my own environment

Send a brief outline of the tech stack you intend to use and how you will handle large batch files, and we can get started.

jobs.title: Desarrollo Web App con IA, Análisis de Cadena de Suministros
jobs.description:
DESARROLLO DE WEB APP B2B BILINGÜE CON IA, MOTOR DE REGLAS Y REPORTES EJECUTIVOS

Busco un desarrollador senior o un equipo pequeño para diseñar y construir el MVP de una Web App B2B enfocada en evaluar y priorizar oportunidades de mejora en decisiones de Supply Chain Planning.

La aplicación soportará una metodología propietaria y combinará recolección de información de varios stakeholders, evaluación de madurez, identificación de oportunidades, cálculos de valor y ROI, comparación multicriterio, análisis con inteligencia artificial, validación humana y reportes ejecutivos.

No se busca una página web, un cuestionario básico ni un chatbot genérico. Debe ser una aplicación con usuarios, organizaciones, engagements, reglas configurables, evidencia, trazabilidad y reportes.

La plataforma está abierta. Se aceptan propuestas con desarrollo tradicional, no-code, low-code o una combinación. El candidato deberá justificar su arquitectura considerando funcionalidad, seguridad, mantenimiento, escalabilidad, propiedad y costo total de operación.

ALCANCE DEL MVP

1. Diagnóstico público

Experiencia bilingüe y responsive de aproximadamente diez minutos:

• Preguntas dinámicas y lógica condicional.
• Captura de participante, empresa y consentimiento.
• Posibilidad de guardar y continuar.
• Resultado preliminar de madurez y señales de oportunidad.
• Presentación del resultado en pantalla y por correo.
• Registro del lead en el panel administrativo.
• Identificación de respuestas incompletas o inconsistentes.
• Scoring y routing interno.

El diagnóstico no produce una recomendación de inversión ni un business case completo.

2. Organizaciones, usuarios y permisos

La parte privada debe administrar organizaciones, engagements, usuarios internos y participantes del cliente. Cada engagement podrá incluir hasta cinco stakeholders.

Roles iniciales: administrador, analista interno, sponsor del cliente y stakeholder participante.

Se requiere autenticación segura, accesos según rol, asignación de secciones, guardado de avances, seguimiento de pendientes, consolidación de respuestas sin perder su fuente e historial de actividad.

3. Assessment guiado

El producto privado no será completamente self-service. El equipo interno facilitará cada engagement, cuya duración típica será cercana a dos semanas.

La aplicación debe permitir:

• Crear el engagement y definir su alcance.
• Seleccionar decisiones o casos de uso.
• Invitar stakeholders y asignar actividades.
• Utilizar un banco configurable de preguntas.
• Aplicar lógica condicional.
• Registrar notas de entrevistas.
• Solicitar aclaraciones.
• Cargar documentos PDF, Word y Excel.
• Asociar evidencia con preguntas, hallazgos u oportunidades.
• Registrar supuestos, vacíos, contradicciones y confianza.
• Controlar el estado y progreso.

No se requieren videoconferencias, grabación de reuniones ni integración con calendarios.

4. Motor de reglas, análisis y priorización

El cliente proporcionará la metodología, preguntas, fórmulas y criterios. El desarrollador deberá convertirlos en una solución configurable y mantenible.

El sistema debe soportar:

• Dimensiones y niveles de madurez.
• Scoring e identificación de brechas.
• Formulación de oportunidades.
• Mecanismos de generación de valor.
• Escenarios bajo, base y alto.
• Cálculos de ROI y payback.
• Criterios, pesos y reglas de exclusión.
• Priorización de hasta cinco oportunidades.
• Dependencias y roadmap inicial.
• Supuestos y niveles de confianza.

Los cálculos y el scoring deben ser determinísticos, versionados y trazables. Los mismos inputs, reglas y versiones deben producir el mismo resultado. La IA no debe inventar cifras ni reemplazar las fórmulas.

5. Integración de inteligencia artificial

Se utilizará una API de IA para resumir y clasificar información, relacionar respuestas de varios stakeholders, detectar vacíos o contradicciones, preparar preguntas de aclaración y crear borradores de oportunidades, explicaciones y narrativas ejecutivas.

Los outputs deben ser estructurados, editables y vinculados con la evidencia. El equipo interno debe poder aprobarlos, rechazarlos o ajustarlos antes de compartirlos.

La solución debe registrar prompts, modelo utilizado, fuentes, confianza, resultados y cambios humanos, además de controlar errores, consumo y costos de API. Las credenciales permanecerán protegidas en el backend y la información de clientes no podrá utilizarse para entrenamiento.

6. Panel administrativo

El equipo interno debe poder administrar:

• Usuarios, organizaciones y engagements.
• Preguntas, respuestas y lógica condicional.
• Contenidos en español e inglés.
• Madurez, scoring, pesos y thresholds.
• Fórmulas y parámetros de valor.
• Catálogo de casos de uso.
• Criterios de priorización.
• Prompts y versiones.
• Textos de resultados y reportes.
• Ajustes manuales, notificaciones, errores y consumo de APIs.

Los cambios de configuración deben conservar fecha, versión y responsable.

7. Resultados y reporte ejecutivo

La aplicación debe generar una vista ejecutiva y un reporte descargable en PDF con:

• Perfil de madurez y principales brechas.
• Mapa de oportunidades.
• Cinco oportunidades priorizadas.
• Business cases de alto nivel.
• Supuestos y nivel de confianza.
• Roadmap inicial.
• Recomendación y siguientes decisiones.

El reporte se generará en español o inglés, utilizará la identidad visual suministrada y requerirá aprobación interna antes de quedar disponible para el cliente.

REQUISITOS TÉCNICOS Y DE SEGURIDAD

• Arquitectura multiempresa con separación segura de datos.
• Acceso basado en roles.
• Cifrado en tránsito y almacenamiento.
• Backups y recuperación.
• Registro de errores y actividad.
• Exportación y eliminación de información.
• Ambientes de desarrollo, pruebas y producción.
• Aplicación privada desktop-first y diagnóstico adaptable a móvil.
• APIs y credenciales protegidas.
• Código y componentes documentados.
• Dependencias, plugins y licencias identificados.

El MVP tendrá inicialmente un uso controlado. No necesita infraestructura masiva, pero la arquitectura no debe impedir su evolución.

ARQUITECTURA PROPUESTA

El candidato deberá explicar:

• Stack, base de datos y hosting.
• Procesos ejecutados en el backend.
• Integración con IA y documentos.
• Generación de reportes.
• Seguridad entre organizaciones.
• Versionamiento de reglas y cálculos.
• Escalabilidad y mantenimiento.
• Costos mensuales de infraestructura, licencias y APIs.
• Riesgos de dependencia tecnológica.
• Forma de transferir la solución al cliente.

La plataforma no se seleccionará solamente por velocidad. También se evaluarán mantenibilidad, seguridad, flexibilidad y costo total de propiedad.

ENTREGABLES

1. Discovery y especificación funcional definitiva.
2. Arquitectura, modelo de datos y flujos.
3. Wireframes y diseño responsive.
4. MVP funcional en ambiente de pruebas.
5. Integraciones de IA, correo y almacenamiento.
6. Pruebas funcionales y soporte para User Acceptance Testing.
7. Correcciones y despliegue en producción.
8. Código, configuración y activos en cuentas del cliente.
9. Documentación técnica y administrativa.
10. Transferencia de conocimiento.
11. Garantía mínima de treinta días para errores.
12. Cotización separada de mantenimiento y evoluciones.

FUERA DEL ALCANCE INICIAL

Página corporativa, aplicación móvil nativa, pagos, integración completa con CRM, gestión de proyectos posteriores, videollamadas, colaboración simultánea, entrenamiento de un modelo propio, OCR avanzado y análisis autónomo de modelos complejos de Excel.

INFORMACIÓN PROPORCIONADA POR EL CLIENTE

El cliente entregará metodología, preguntas iniciales, dimensiones de madurez, fórmulas, criterios de comparación, catálogo de casos de uso, prompts, ejemplos de outputs, contenidos bilingües, identidad visual y acceso a un experto de negocio.

CONFIDENCIALIDAD Y PROPIEDAD

La metodología detallada, preguntas, fórmulas, prompts y templates se compartirán únicamente con candidatos preseleccionados bajo acuerdo de confidencialidad.

La solución, código, configuración, diseños, datos y activos serán propiedad del cliente. El trabajo deberá realizarse en cuentas controladas por el cliente o transferirse completamente antes del cierre. No se permitirá reutilizar o comercializar la metodología ni los componentes específicos del producto.

CONTENIDO OBLIGATORIO DE LA OFERTA

La propuesta debe incluir:

1. Experiencia y ejemplos verificables de Web Apps B2B.
2. Experiencia integrando IA mediante APIs.
3. Arquitectura recomendada y justificación.
4. Equipo y responsabilidad de cada participante.
5. Plan, tiempo y precio por hitos.
6. Precio separado para discovery.
7. Supuestos y exclusiones.
8. Costos mensuales estimados.
9. Estrategia de pruebas, seguridad y respaldo.
10. Soporte posterior al lanzamiento.
11. Riesgos o aspectos que requieren mayor definición.
12. Disponibilidad para entrevista y confidencialidad.

Responder también:

• ¿Cómo implementaría un motor configurable, versionado y trazable?
• ¿Cómo separaría cálculos determinísticos y análisis de IA?
• ¿Cómo impediría el acceso cruzado entre organizaciones?
• ¿Cómo manejaría la revisión humana y el historial de cambios?
• ¿Cuál considera que es la parte más riesgosa?

Se valorará una estimación realista y sustentada. La oferta debe separar el precio de discovery del costo estimado de construcción del MVP.

jobs.title: U.S. Lead Generation – Find Businesses Needing High-Volume Applicants
jobs.description:

Our goal is to find businesses that have genuine hiring needs and are willing to finalize a staffing/recruitment partnership with us.

Target Clients

Insurance
Healthcare
Customer Service
Call Centers / BPO
Sales
Retail
Logistics
Warehouse
Hospitality
Manufacturing
Construction
Administration
Other high-volume hiring industries

Are actively hiring

Are willing to establish a business relationship with us
NOT A DATA-COLLECTION PROJECT

Company lists
Email lists
Phone lists
LinkedIn lists
Generic leads
Job posting spreadsheets

We need someone who can generate genuine business opportunities and help convert them into actual clients.

Candidate qualification
Candidate communication
Candidate submission
Providing candidate details to the client

The ideal client is a U.S. business that says:

We are looking for actual staffing clients, not prospects that simply provide their contact information.

Industries

Insurance | Healthcare | Customer Service | Call Centers | Sales | Logistics | Warehouse | Retail | Hospitality | Manufacturing | Construction | IT | Administration

Recruitment agency client acquisition
U.S. staffing sales
Cold calling
Cold email
LinkedIn outreach
Business development
Client acquisition
Negotiation
Follow-up
Closing
Staffing partnership development

The focus is on closed staffing clients and actual business results, not simply the number of leads or contacts delivered.

Main Objective
Find → Approach → Negotiate → Close → Client Finalization

We need someone who can help us acquire real U.S. staffing clients, not someone who simply provides a database of potential companies.

jobs.title: Forensic Analysis of Digital Evidence
jobs.description:
**Looking for a digital forensics expert — Apple Mail print-to-PDF, truncated attachment (macOS 14.x)**

I am a litigant in civil proceedings in England & Wales and need to instruct an independent expert on a narrow technical point.

In short: I have two PDFs, both produced by Apple Mail's print-to-PDF (Quartz PDFContext, macOS 14.5 and 14.6.1), of the *same* email carrying the *same* single-page PDF attachment. I also have the original `.eml`.

In one, the attachment appears as an icon and its full page is appended. In the other, the attachment is rendered inline and visually cut off after roughly the top eighth, with several centimetres of blank printable page below the cut. The content stream shows a clipping path substantially smaller than the content it clips, and the hidden material is partly still present in the file and partly absent from it.

The question I need answered is whether that truncation is an artefact of Mail's layout — there are published reports of similar behaviour — or whether it required some act by the person who produced it. I want both possibilities tested even-handedly rather than either assumed.

What I am after:

- someone comfortable at PDF content-stream level **and** with macOS internals;
- ideally with access to a machine that can run macOS 14.5 (build 23F79), because reproduction is the crux;


I have already done a fair amount of my own analysis — exact clip and transform values, geometry, font subsetting, image hashing, metadata — and can share a full technical note, along with the files, privately under an appropriate undertaking. I have kept identifying material out of this post deliberately.

Recommendations or expressions of interest very welcome. Happy to take a message.

Мислення, яке я шукаю

Мені потрібна людина, яка після публікації відео не думає:

«Я змонтував — моя робота закінчилась».

А думає:

«Чому це відео отримало такий CTR?»
«На якій секунді почали виходити люди?»
«Чому цей Reels набрав у 10 разів більше?»
«Який hook спрацював?»
«Що потрібно змінити в наступному відео?»

Саме так працюють сильні команди великих каналів: монтаж → публікація → дані → висновки → наступне відео сильніше.

Кого я НЕ шукаю

Не шукаю людину, яка просто вміє поставити відео на timeline, обрізати паузи і додати автоматичні субтитри.

Не шукаю людину, якій потрібно давати точні інструкції на кожну секунду.

Не шукаю людину для разових підробітків.

Я шукаю члена команди на довгострокову співпрацю, який хоче разом із проєктом рости професійно і фінансово.

Що надіслати у відгуку

Прошу одразу надіслати:

1. 3–5 ваших найсильніших відео.
2. Приклади Reels / Shorts.
3. Приклади довгих YouTube-відео.
4. Приклади ваших thumbnails.
5. Канали або акаунти, з якими ви працювали.
6. Що саме ви робили для цих каналів.
7. Якими програмами володієте.
8. Чи маєте досвід самостійної публікації контенту.
9. Чи працювали з YouTube Analytics.
10. Яку кількість довгих відео та Reels можете робити щотижня.
11. Вашу вартість роботи / бажану оплату.
12. Ваш часовий пояс і графік роботи.

І ще прошу відповісти на три питання:

Що найбільше впливає на те, чи набере YouTube-відео багато переглядів?

Що ви перевірите в аналітиці, якщо відео набрало мало переглядів?

Що б ви зробили з 10-хвилинного сирого відео, щоб створити з нього Reels із шансом на вірусне поширення?

Відбір

Після перегляду портфоліо найкращим кандидатам буде запропоновано оплачуване тестове завдання.

Я дам сирий матеріал і мінімум підказок.

Мені важливо побачити не тільки те, як ви монтуєте, а й те, як ви думаєте.

I don’t want an editor who waits for me to provide every visual.

I want someone who can look at a line like:

“France exports billions of dollars of software every year…”

…and think: What should the viewer see right now? Then research and find the best visual evidence to put on screen.

So research ability + visual storytelling is more important to me than fancy transitions.

Style

I’m looking for a modern documentary/YouTube style with strong pacing and storytelling. Think Johnny Harris / modern explanatory journalism rather than a generic talking-head YouTube edit.

What I will provide:

* Raw talking-head footage
* Script/narration
* General direction/topic

What I expect from you:

* Research relevant visual material
* Edit the talking-head footage

I’m looking for someone I can work with long-term, so if you’re good at both research and editing, there is potential for regular work.

jobs.title: Birthday Jukebox PWA Kiosk App

Job Title: Development of a Responsive Web App Kiosk for a Wedding "Birthday Jukebox" (Local Audio Library)
Project Overview: I am launching an event rental business and need a highly reliable, single-page web application designed as a Progressive Web App (PWA). This app will act as a custom "Birthday Jukebox" kiosk.The software will run on a touchscreen tablet (iPad or Android) enclosed inside a physical, retro-style jukebox cabinet at weddings and corporate events. Because wedding venues often have poor or non-existent Wi-Fi, this application must not rely on external streaming services like Spotify or YouTube. Instead, it must play audio tracks from a pre-loaded, local digital music library.
Core User Workflow: 
Welcome Screen: Displays my custom company branding, an elegant wedding theme, and a large call-to-action button: "Find Your Birthday Number 1".
Date Input Screen: The guest is presented with a large, touchscreen-friendly, scrolling date picker (Day / Month / Year).
The Reveal & Playback: Once the guest hits "Submit", the system looks up the UK chart-topper for that exact date, displays the song title, artist name, and album artwork, and instantly starts playing the corresponding audio file.
Auto-Reset: After the song finishes playing (or after 60 seconds of inactivity), the screen smoothly resets back to the Welcome Screen for the next guest.
Technical & Architectural Requirements. 
Front-End & UI Design: Must be a Single-Page Application (SPA) optimized entirely for tablet touchscreen interactions (large tap targets, fluid animations).Clean, elegant, premium visual design suitable for luxury weddings.Must include clear placeholder blocks for my custom business logo and branding.The user interface must hide all default OS and browser elements (no scrollbars, text selection, or right-click menus).

Local Audio Library & Database Architecture Storage: All audio tracks will be provided by the client as standardized audio files (MP3 or WAV format). These files will be stored directly in a local directory on the device or a local web server framework.Database Mapping: You must implement a lightweight local database or JSON mapping file. This file will map calendar dates (from 1952 to the present day) directly to the corresponding local audio file path.Example logic: If user input = 14/11/1952, the application queries the local JSON file, identifies the matching track record, and triggers playback for /audio/tracks/0001.mp3.Headless Audio Controls: Audio playback must use native HTML5 audio or a lightweight web audio framework. No default browser media players, play/pause buttons, or seek bars should be visible to the end user. Playback must trigger instantly with zero buffering.3. Kiosk Lockdown Optimization (PWA)Configure the site as a Progressive Web App (PWA) with a manifest file so it can be added to the tablet's home screen.When launched from the home screen icon, it must open in standalone, borderless, full-screen mode (hiding the browser address bar, search box, and navigation arrows).Strict input validation to ensure guests cannot break out of the application loop or access system settings.4. Fallback Handling: If a guest enters a date that falls outside the limits of our provided music library (e.g., a date before charts began in November 1952), the app should gracefully display a friendly, branded error screen: "Wow! You are a classic! Please ask our event team to look up your special birthday anthem."
Deliverables: Fully functional, bug-free web application source code.Local setup instructions showing how to load the application and the MP3 folder onto an iPad or Android tablet.Easily editable configuration files (JSON) so I can add new songs to the library myself in the future.

jobs.title: English-Speaking Cold Caller – Small Business Outreach
jobs.description:
We are looking for a confident, friendly, and professional English-speaking cold caller to help us contact small businesses throughout the United States.

This is a remote, part-time position with the possibility of becoming a long-term role for the right person.

About the Role

We help small businesses improve their online presence through professional websites and other digital services.

Our team identifies local businesses that may benefit from a website and prepares a website idea/mockup for them.

Your job is to call these businesses, start a friendly conversation, and ask for permission to send them the website idea we've prepared.

This is NOT a high-pressure sales or closing position.

You are NOT expected to sell a website during the initial call.

The primary goal is simply to speak with the business owner or representative and determine whether they are willing to see what we've prepared for them.

What You'll Be Doing

You will be provided with:

A list of businesses to contact
Business names and phone numbers
A calling script
Responses for common objections
Training on our services and outreach process
A Google Sheets system for tracking calls and outcomes

Your responsibilities will include:

Making outbound cold calls to small businesses in the United States
Confirming that you've reached the correct business
Briefly introducing the reason for your call
Asking permission to send the website idea/mockup
Handling basic questions and objections naturally
Knowing when to make one additional attempt and when to politely end the conversation
Asking whether interested businesses prefer to receive the information by text or email
Accurately recording the outcome of every call
Recording important information or notes from conversations
Following the provided outreach process consistently
Example of the Call

"Hi, am I calling [Business Name]?

Great! My name is [Name]. I'm calling because I came across your business and we put together a quick website idea for you—just something that could make it easier for customers to find you and get in contact with you.

There's no cost or obligation. I'd just like to send it over so you can take a look. Would that be okay?"

If the business is interested, your job is primarily to determine where we should send the information and record the outcome so our team can handle the follow-up.

You do NOT need to close the sale during this call.

Who We're Looking For

We're looking for someone who:

Speaks fluent, clear, conversational English
Is confident speaking with business owners over the phone
Is comfortable making cold calls
Sounds natural and conversational rather than simply reading from a script
Can think and respond naturally when a conversation goes off-script
Is comfortable handling basic objections
Has good listening skills
Knows when to continue a conversation and when to politely end it
Is friendly and professional even when someone is not interested
Can follow instructions and a defined calling process
Is reliable and consistent
Can accurately track calls and notes in Google Sheets
Has reliable internet
Has a reliable computer/headset and a quiet environment for making professional calls
Is available to make calls during U.S. Central Time business hours
Experience

Previous experience with cold calling is strongly preferred.

Experience in any of the following is also valuable:

Appointment setting
Outbound sales
Telemarketing
Lead generation
Call centers
Business-to-business (B2B) outreach
Phone-based customer service

We care heavily about how you actually sound and communicate on the phone, not just the number of years of experience listed on your profile.

Paid Trial

We plan to begin with a paid trial period.

During the trial, we'll evaluate things such as:

Reliability
Call quality
Communication skills
Ability to follow the calling process
Comfort handling objections
Quality of notes and call tracking
Ability to have natural conversations with business owners

Strong performance may lead to additional hours and a long-term position.

How to Apply

Please include the following with your application:

Your country and current time zone.
Your previous cold-calling, appointment-setting, telemarketing, sales, or similar experience.
The types of businesses or campaigns you have previously called for, if applicable.
Approximately how many outbound calls you are comfortable making per day.
How many hours per week you are available.
Your desired hourly rate.
A short English voice recording using the script below.

For your voice recording, please read this naturally as if you were actually speaking with a business owner:

"Hi, my name is [Name]. I'm calling because I came across your business and we put together a quick website idea for you. There's no cost or obligation. I'd just like to send it over so you can take a look. Would that be okay?"

Please do not simply read the script as quickly as possible.

We want to hear how you would actually speak with a business owner on the phone.

We're looking for someone who sounds friendly, confident, conversational, clear, and professional.

Please include your voice recording with your application.
