I will keep all work you provide the lessons, text, sound, images, raw files, source files, project files, and all work created for me.
I will release the full milestone when the lessons, testing, videos, text, images, documents, source files, project files, and all testing work created for me is completed, delivered, and accepted by me.
I do not pay any milestones until the lessons, videos, text, images, documents, source files, project files, and all testing work created for me is completed, all files delivered, and accepted by me.
If your work is High Quality and exactly what I need I would be interested in considering you for Future projects.
I don't communicate on Sundays and I don't expect you to work on Sundays.

jobs.title: B2B Lead Generation Expert – Intent Data, LinkedIn Sales Navigator & Apollo
jobs.description:
Project Overview

We are looking for an experienced **B2B Lead Generation & Intent Data Specialist** who can help us build a consistent pipeline of **high-quality, sales-ready prospects**.

The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience with platforms such as **LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo.io**, and other B2B data/enrichment tools. We are not looking for someone who simply collects large lists of contacts. Our priority is identifying **relevant companies and decision-makers showing strong intent or buying signals**.

### What You Will Be Responsible For

You will be responsible for:

* Researching and defining target accounts based on our **Ideal Customer Profile (ICP)**
* Using **LinkedIn Sales Navigator** to identify relevant companies, decision-makers, and buying roles
* Using **Apollo.io** for prospect discovery, contact data, enrichment, and verification
* Identifying **intent signals and buying triggers**, such as:

  * Companies actively hiring for relevant positions
  * Recent funding or investment
  * New product/service launches
  * Expansion into new markets
  * Leadership changes
  * Technology adoption or technology changes
  * Increased hiring activity
  * Recent business announcements
  * Relevant LinkedIn activity
  * Companies potentially evaluating solutions similar to ours
* Building account-level and contact-level prospect lists
* Identifying the appropriate decision-makers and influencers within target organizations
* Enriching prospects with accurate business information
* Validating email addresses and other available contact information
* Removing duplicates, irrelevant companies, and low-quality prospects
* Assigning an **intent/lead-quality score** based on predefined criteria
* Maintaining a clean and structured lead database

### Expected Lead Data

Each qualified prospect should ideally include:

* Company Name
* Company Website
* Industry
* Company Size
* Location
* LinkedIn Company URL
* Contact Name
* Job Title
* Seniority
* LinkedIn Profile URL
* Verified Business Email
* Relevant Intent Signal
* Source of Intent Signal
* Date Intent Signal Was Identified
* Lead/Intent Score
* Reason Why the Prospect Fits Our ICP
* Additional Notes
Key Requirement – Intent Over Volume

Quality is more important than quantity.

We are specifically looking for someone who can answer:

“Why should we contact this company/person right now?

For every high-priority prospect, there should be a clear reason or signal indicating that the company may have a relevant business need.

Simply exporting thousands of contacts from Apollo or Sales Navigator will **not** be considered successful lead generation.

Tools & Platforms

Experience with the following is highly desirable:

* LinkedIn Sales Navigator
* Apollo.io
* LinkedIn
* Google
* Crunchbase or similar company intelligence platforms
* BuiltWith / technology intelligence tools
* Hunter / email verification platforms
* Other B2B intent-data and enrichment platforms

Experience with additional prospecting and data-enrichment tools is a plus.

Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone who:

* Has proven experience in **B2B lead generation**
* Understands ICP definition and account-based prospecting
* Has strong LinkedIn Sales Navigator skills
* Has hands-on experience with Apollo.io
* Understands **intent data and buying signals**
* Can conduct independent company and prospect research
* Has excellent attention to detail
* Can distinguish a genuinely relevant prospect from a generic lead
* Understands B2B decision-making structures
* Can produce clean, organized, and actionable data
* Can explain the reasoning behind their prospect selection

### Initial Assignment

We would like to begin with a **small paid test assignment**.

The selected candidate will be given our target market/ICP and asked to produce an initial batch of qualified prospects.

The test will be evaluated based on:

1. ICP accuracy
2. Quality of companies identified
3. Relevance of decision-makers
4. Strength of intent signals
5. Accuracy of contact information
6. Quality of research
7. Data cleanliness
8. Ability to explain why each prospect is worth contacting

Successful completion of the test can lead to an **ongoing engagement** with recurring lead-generation requirements.

### Application Requirements

When applying, please provide:

1. A brief description of your B2B lead-generation experience
2. Your experience with **LinkedIn Sales Navigator**
3. Your experience with **Apollo.io**
4. Which other intent-data/enrichment tools you use
5. An example of how you identify buying intent
6. One anonymized sample of a lead list you have previously created
7. Your pricing – hourly and/or per qualified lead
8. Your expected weekly lead volume

**Important:** Please do not submit generic proposals such as “I can generate 10,000 leads.” We are specifically interested in **research-driven, intent-based prospecting and qualified B2B opportunities**.

We are looking for a long-term partner who can build a reliable and repeatable lead-generation engine.

jobs.title: UK Hospital Lead Enrichment
jobs.description:
I have a spreadsheet of 74 UK hospitals that currently shows only the facility name and location. I need each record expanded so it becomes immediately usable for outreach. For every hospital on the list, please add:  
• the correct contact person’s full name and current title (ideally someone in administration or procurement)  
• their direct phone number and verified email address  

You may draw primarily on reputable online databases and directories such as NHS Choices, CQC, Gov-UK registers, Health Service Directory, and similar sources. Cross-checking against the hospital’s own site or LinkedIn is fine where it speeds verification, but the master source cited in the sheet should be an online directory.

Deliverables  
1. My original file returned in Excel or Google-Sheet format, enriched with the four new fields for all 74 entries.  
2. A brief “source” column noting the directory or page URL used for each data point so I can trace accuracy if needed.  
3. A final pass to ensure every email is live (no bounces when tested with a validation tool such as ZeroBounce or NeverBounce).

I consider the job finished once every record has a named contact, matching title, phone, and email, and at least 90 % of the emails pass validation.

jobs.title: Apple Wallet/PassKit SaaS Expert
jobs.description:
PROJECT TITLE:

Full-Stack Apple Wallet / PassKit SaaS Developer

PROJECT DESCRIPTION:

We are looking for a senior Full-Stack Developer with proven hands-on experience in Apple Wallet / PassKit to take over and continue developing an existing multi-tenant SaaS platform for digital loyalty cards, memberships, sessions, gift vouchers, and events.

This is an existing platform, not a new build.

The work will be completed in phases. The first engagement is a complete technical audit, project handover verification, and system stabilization. The successful developer may continue with us long-term to implement the remaining roadmap.

Please bid for Phase 1 only. Do not quote the entire roadmap as one fixed-price project before reviewing the existing code.

PHASE 1 — TECHNICAL AUDIT & HANDOVER

The developer must review and verify:

* Full source code and repositories
* Backend
* Database and current production database dump
* Business dashboard and admin dashboard
* APIs
* Hosting and server configuration
* Firebase
* Apple Wallet certificates
* Environment variables and API keys
* Current integrations
* Security and access permissions
* Existing bugs and technical debt

Initial deliverables:

1. Successfully run the project locally or on staging.
2. Verify that all required code, database files, services, and accounts have been handed over.
3. Review the existing database structure and application architecture.
4. Perform a security and code-quality review.
5. Identify bugs, missing components, outdated dependencies, and technical risks.
6. Deliver a written technical audit report.
7. Provide a prioritized action plan for the next milestones.
8. Provide separate time and cost estimates for each approved milestone.

Critical fixes discovered during the audit will be agreed and priced separately before implementation.

CORE DEVELOPMENT ROADMAP

After the audit, the selected developer may continue with the following phases:

1. MULTI-BUSINESS / WALLET STRUCTURE

Required structure:

Business → Customer → Programs / Cards

Each Wallet pass must be connected to:

* business_id
* customer_id
* program_id
* unique serialNumber

Requirements:

* Correct multi-business separation
* Prevent duplicate customers and duplicate cards
* Allow one customer to join multiple programs
* Avoid recreating the same customer for every program
* Correct Subscriber / Customer statuses
* Secure tenant-level data separation
* Update installed Apple Wallet passes without asking customers to add them again

2. CUSTOMER FIELDS & ENROLLMENT PAGE

Each business must be able to configure its customer fields as:

* Required
* Optional
* Hidden

Fields may include:

* Full Name
* Mobile Number
* Email
* Gender
* Birthday
* Custom fields in a future phase

Each business must also be able to customize its enrollment page:

* Logo
* Background
* Welcome text
* Colors
* Form fields
* Button design
* Terms and conditions

After registration, the customer can add the card to Apple Wallet.

3. APPLE WALLET PASS IMPROVEMENTS

* Improved front layout
* Better stamp icon sizing and spacing
* Improved QR/barcode positioning
* Dynamic fields based on the program
* Back of pass information
* Business contact details
* Terms
* Social links
* Location
* Current stamps, points, balance, sessions, or membership information

4. CARD DETAILS / SUBSCRIBER WEB PAGE

A responsive web page separate from the Wallet pass that automatically adapts to the program type.

It should include:

* Card preview
* Add to Apple Wallet
* Latest message
* Current card details
* Rewards, stamps, or points
* Sessions and membership information
* Gift voucher information
* Address and phone number
* Google Maps
* Social media links
* Share option
* Last updated time

The page should include bottom navigation:

Preview | Coupons

Coupons must be separated automatically into:

* Usable
* Redeemed
* Expired

An appropriate empty state must appear when no coupons are available.

FUTURE PRODUCT FEATURES

5. SESSIONS / SUBSCRIPTIONS

* Create session or membership packages
* Set total sessions, start date, and expiry date
* Scan and redeem individual sessions
* Display total, used, and remaining sessions
* Maintain a complete redemption history
* Record the responsible staff member

6. GIFT VOUCHERS

Support two voucher types:

A. Service Voucher

* Multiple separately stored services
* Redeem each service individually
* Support quantities such as Massage ×3
* Partial redemption
* Active, Partially Redeemed, Fully Redeemed, and Expired statuses
* Redeeming one service must not redeem the entire voucher

B. Value Voucher

* Original monetary value
* Staff enters the amount used during each visit
* Automatically calculate the remaining balance
* Allow partial use across multiple visits
* Maintain redemption history, amount, balance, date, and staff member

7. WHATSAPP DELIVERY & COMMUNICATION

WhatsApp will be used as a delivery and communication channel, while the core platform remains responsible for voucher, pass, customer, and redemption management.

Future uses include:

* Send Wallet cards
* Send gift vouchers
* Reward notifications
* Stamp and points updates
* Session reminders
* Membership expiry reminders
* Event invitations and RSVP
* Event reminders and important updates

8. EVENTS SYSTEM

* Event creation
* Guest lists
* Branded invitation pages
* WhatsApp invitations
* RSVP
* Wallet invitation or ticket
* Unique QR code
* Staff scanner accounts
* Event check-in
* Duplicate-entry prevention
* Attendance dashboard

Future additions may include +1 guests, family invitations, tables, seats, VIP groups, parking instructions, and post-event messages.

9. FUTURE INTEGRATIONS

* Foodics
* POS systems
* Automatic transaction-based loyalty
* WhatsApp receipts
* Gym and membership APIs
* NFC
* Enterprise accounts
* White-label solutions
* Government use cases
* Airlines and ticketing
* Advanced analytics

REQUIRED TECHNICAL EXPERIENCE

* PHP and Laravel
* MySQL and database architecture
* Multi-tenant SaaS systems
* REST APIs and authentication
* Apple Wallet passes and .pkpass generation
* Pass Type IDs, certificates, and signing
* Apple Wallet Web Service
* Device registration and pass update notifications
* Firebase
* Server, hosting, deployment, and environment configuration
* Git-based development workflow
* Security reviews, backups, migrations, and audit logging

Experience with WhatsApp Cloud API is a strong advantage.

WORKING REQUIREMENTS

* All code must be committed regularly to our repository.
* All source code, accounts, certificates, and deliverables must remain under our ownership.
* No production changes may be made without an approved backup and testing process.
* Major changes must be tested on staging first.
* All database changes and environment requirements must be documented.
* The developer must be comfortable working with and improving an existing codebase.
* Clear English communication and regular progress updates are required.

HOW TO APPLY

Start your proposal with the words: WALLET PLATFORM

Please answer all the following questions:

1. Have you personally developed Apple Wallet passes? Please share examples, screenshots, or links and explain your exact role.
2. How would you update an installed Apple Wallet pass without asking the customer to add it again?
3. Have you implemented the Apple Wallet device registration web service and push update process?
4. Have you worked on a multi-tenant SaaS platform? Briefly describe its structure.
5. What is your experience with Laravel and MySQL?
6. Are you an individual developer or an agency?
7. What do you require from us to begin the technical audit?
8. What is your estimated time and fixed price for Phase 1 only?
9. What is your weekly availability?
10. Are you available for long-term milestone-based development?

Generic proposals that do not answer these questions will not be considered.

jobs.title: Creación de 10 videos cortos para redes sociales | IA / Edición de video
jobs.description:
En LINKIDS MÉXICO estamos buscando un creador audiovisual para producir un paquete inicial de 10 videos cortos para redes sociales, principalmente Instagram Reels, Facebook y TikTok.

Somos un programa mexicano de estimulación temprana enfocado en el desarrollo infantil, que integra idiomas, música y matemáticas dentro de su metodología.

¿Qué necesitamos?

• 10 videos verticales de aproximadamente 20 a 30 segundos cada uno.
• Contenido educativo dirigido principalmente a madres y padres de bebés y niños pequeños.
• Nosotros proporcionaremos el tema, guion e idea general de cada video.
• Buscamos videos dinámicos, atractivos, cálidos y profesionales, alineados con una marca infantil pero dirigidos visualmente a los padres.
• Se puede utilizar inteligencia artificial para la generación de escenas, personajes o animaciones, aunque estamos abiertos a otras técnicas y propuestas creativas que logren un resultado de alta calidad.
• Los videos deberán incluir edición, música/sonido/voz, textos o subtítulos cuando el contenido lo requiera y entregarse listos para publicar.

Estilo visual que buscamos

Los videos deben tener principalmente una estética de animación 3D estilo Pixar, cálida, moderna, expresiva y de alta calidad visual.

Buscamos representar situaciones relacionadas con bebés, niños pequeños, madres, padres y familias, procurando que los personajes, movimientos y escenarios se sientan naturales y agradables.

La inteligencia artificial puede utilizarse para generar personajes, escenarios, animaciones y diferentes tomas. También estamos abiertos a otras técnicas de producción siempre que permitan conseguir una estética 3D similar y un resultado profesional.

Los videos tendrán una duración aproximada de 20 a 30 segundos, serán en formato vertical para redes sociales y el proyecto inicial contempla 10 videos.

Presupuesto de referencia: $3,000 MXN por los 10 videos.

Buscamos idealmente encontrar a una persona con quien podamos establecer una colaboración recurrente para futuros paquetes de contenido.

Presupuesto inicial

Nuestro presupuesto de referencia es de aproximadamente $2,500 MXN por el paquete de 10 videos. Estamos abiertos a conocer propuestas de acuerdo con la técnica y calidad ofrecida.

Este proyecto puede convertirse en una colaboración recurrente, ya que generamos contenido para redes sociales de manera continua.

Para considerar tu propuesta, nos gustaría que incluyeras:

• Ejemplos de videos similares que hayas realizado.
• Qué herramientas o técnica utilizarías (IA, animación, edición tradicional, stock, etc.).
• Qué incluye tu propuesta.
• Tiempo estimado para entregar los 10 videos.
• Número de revisiones incluidas.

Valoraremos especialmente las propuestas que presenten ejemplos concretos de cómo podrían llevar nuestro tipo de contenido a video.

Idioma y ubicación

Buscamos preferentemente profesionales de habla hispana, ya que todo el contenido, los guiones y la comunicación del proyecto serán en español. Tendrán especial consideración candidatos de México y Latinoamérica, por la afinidad cultural con nuestra audiencia y facilidad de comunicación.

jobs.title: Urgent Websites deployment and  web App Deployment Today
jobs.description: MUST BE WILLING TO START TODAY. A bunch of websites and web apps deployed, immediately on a live server with someone who is willing to work for an extremely reasonable rate in exchange for recognition, a strong portfolio, recommendations, contact with key insiders, an apprenticeship at a major tech company with housing paid for.

jobs.title: AI Image Quality Reviewer
jobs.description:
I need an AI-driven assistant that can examine a batch of images and tell me, with measurable confidence, whether their colour rendition matches the standards I will supply. The focus for this first phase is colour accuracy alone; resolution and sharpness checks may be added later, so please structure the solution with easy extensibility in mind.

The workflow I have in mind is straightforward: drop a folder (or send an API call) and receive a concise report that flags any file whose colours drift beyond an acceptable Delta-E or similar metric, along with a summary CSV/JSON and an optional visual overlay for quick human review. Popular libraries such as Python, OpenCV, Pillow or TensorFlow are welcome if they speed development, but I am open to alternative stacks provided setup remains frictionless on Windows and Linux.

Deliverables  
• Source code or notebook implementing the evaluator  
• Clear installation and run instructions  
• Sample report generated from a small test set I will provide  
• Brief README explaining how thresholds can be tweaked and new quality parameters appended

Acceptance criteria  
The tool must process at least 500 images in under 5 minutes on a modern desktop, output a reproducible colour-accuracy score per file, and pass a spot-check I will run against my calibrated reference images.

If you have prior work in automated colour assessment or robust experience with colour science libraries, that will help us move quickly. I’m ready to supply example images and target profiles as soon as we agree on the approach.

jobs.title: SAP FI Configuration & Support
jobs.description:
My SAP FI landscape needs a clean, best-practice configuration across General Ledger, Accounts Payable, and Accounts Receivable, followed by dependable post-go-live assistance.

Scope of work  
• Review current GL, AP and AR settings, highlight gaps against standard SAP design, and implement agreed corrections in DEV → QA → PRD.  
• Activate and fine-tune standard SAP reports (no custom reports) so end users can reconcile sub-ledgers, tax postings and month-end balances with a single click.  
• Provide knowledge-transfer documents and short walkthrough sessions so finance users understand the new settings.  
• After the initial transport is signed off, stay available on a retainer for issue resolution, month-end support and minor tweaks; I anticipate a steady but low volume of tickets rather than a full-time load.

Acceptance criteria  
1. All transports moved to PRD without errors and fully documented (FB00, OBY6, OB41, OBYC, etc.).  
2. Unit and integration test evidence approved by Finance.  
3. Standard reports (FBL1N, FBL3N, FBL5N, S_ALR* suite) deliver correct figures.  
4. Post-implementation hyper-care period completed with open issues <3.

You should be comfortable in SAP ECC or S/4HANA FI, know SPRO configuration inside out, and communicate clearly during UAT and month-end cycles. Let me know your estimated timeline for the initial configuration and the support cadence you suggest afterwards.

jobs.title: UAE Logistics Lead Generation Campaign -- 3
jobs.description:
I need an experienced outbound specialist to help me fill our UAE pipeline with fresh, qualified leads for our freight-forwarding and warehousing solutions. The task is a full-cycle outreach effort—phone calls first, then email touch-points and timely follow-ups—until a prospect shows genuine interest and agrees to speak with our sales team.

Scope  
• Identify and reach decision-makers within logistics-focused companies operating in or shipping through the middle east.  
• Use persuasive, yet compliant, cold-calling techniques to open the conversation, then reinforce the message by email.  
• Keep light but clear notes on every interaction so I can track progress at a glance.  

Deliverables  
1. A weekly spreadsheet (or CRM export) listing each contacted company, the contact person, call outcome, and next action.  
2. A minimum number of newly interested leads we agree on before you start.  
3. Email templates and call scripts refined after the first round, based on real feedback.  

Success is a calendar full of discovery calls for our in-house team. If you have a proven record of lead generation by phone in the B2B space and are comfortable navigating time zones and languages in the Gulf market, let’s talk about getting started right away.

jobs.title: Sales FB Ads Bengkel
jobs.description:
Saya mencari seorang sales marketing yang mahir mengelola Facebook Ads untuk layanan bengkel mobil saya. Target utamanya jelas: setelah prospek masuk dari iklan, Anda segera menghubungi mereka lewat WhatsApp, membangun hubungan, dan menutup penjualan.

Gambaran tugas:
• Audit singkat kampanye Facebook Ads yang sudah berjalan, lalu merevisi konten iklannya—teks, visual, dan call-to-action—agar lebih terarah pada kebutuhan pemilik mobil.  
• Menyusun ulang segmentasi audiens dan anggaran harian agar lead masuk stabil.  
• Menangani seluruh percakapan WhatsApp: menjawab pertanyaan, menawarkan paket servis, hingga mengonfirmasi jadwal kunjungan bengkel.  
• Menyampaikan laporan mingguan berisi jumlah lead, rasio konversi, dan rekomendasi optimasi berikutnya.

Keahlian yang saya butuhkan mencakup copywriting iklan, manajemen Facebook Ads Manager, serta pendekatan penjualan melalui chat yang persuasif namun sopan. Jika Anda sudah berpengalaman menjalankan funnel iklan-WhatsApp untuk jasa otomotif atau serupa, itu nilai tambah besar.

Silakan jelaskan singkat pengalaman relevan Anda dan contoh hasil yang pernah dicapai. Saya siap berdiskusi lebih lanjut untuk memulai secepatnya.

jobs.title: Elite Strategic Sales Closer
jobs.description:
I’m ready to scale an already validated offer and need a seasoned closer who knows how to move qualified prospects smoothly from curious to committed.  

Here’s the situation: warm leads are coming in daily through inbound funnels, webinar registrations and direct referrals. What’s missing is the extra edge that turns more of those conversations into revenue. You’ll step in right after initial qualification, conduct discovery, present the solution succinctly, and secure the signature—whether the deal happens on the first call or requires a brief follow-up sequence.

Key expectations  
• Handle 4-10 scheduled calls per day (Zoom or phone) and keep show-up rates high through timely reminders.  
• Follow an established, consultative script while adapting on the fly to prospect objections and buying signals.  
• Update our CRM immediately after every interaction so the pipeline data stays accurate.  
• Provide a concise end-of-day report highlighting deals closed, next-step commitments and any red flags that may impact forecasting.  

Success will be measured by closed-won revenue in the first 30 days and a steadily improving close ratio thereafter. If you’re used to high-ticket conversations, live for the thrill of “Yes,” and can back it up with numbers, let’s talk.

jobs.title: Accurate Text Entry to Word
jobs.description:
I have a collection of text that needs to be transferred into a single, neatly organized Word document. You will receive the material in whatever format it currently exists—some of it may be handwritten scans, printed pages, or digital files—and your role is to key everything in accurately.  

Please reproduce the wording exactly as supplied, preserving any obvious paragraph breaks, bullet points, or headings you see so the final .docx file is clear and easy to read. If you notice minor typos while you type, feel free to correct them; otherwise, keep the original language intact.  

Once finished, deliver one editable Word file (.docx) with no additional formatting requirements beyond what I have just described. Let me know if you need sample pages before you start so we can confirm expectations.

jobs.title: Linen Shirt and Pants Designer with Tech Pack Expertise
jobs.description:
I'm seeking an experienced clothing designer to create modern and minimalist linen shirts and pants for my old money brand. 

The focus is on:
- Shirts
- Pants

Ideal candidates should have:
- Expertise in modern, minimalist design
- Experience with high-end, luxury brands
- Strong understanding of fabric and fit, especially linen
- Ability to create precise tech packs with accurate measurements
- Skills to design timeless, sophisticated pieces

Please provide a portfolio showcasing relevant work.

jobs.title: Instagram Automation & Social Media Management
jobs.description:
I need a streamlined ManyChat build that lives natively on Instagram and handles all sales-driven conversations for me. The focus is product recommendations: when someone comments on a post, replies to a Story, or sends a DM with a trigger word, the bot should guide them to the right item, capture their email, and tag them correctly for follow-up.

Here is what I’m aiming for:

• Fully mapped conversation flow in ManyChat tailored to product recommendations, complete with conditional logic, quick-reply buttons, and gallery cards.  
• Beehiiv integration via Zapier so every qualified lead is synced into the exact Beehiiv segment with the right tags for future newsletters.  
• Additional Zaps to update my CRM and ping Slack when a hot prospect completes the flow.  
• Clean documentation of every step so I can tweak copy or offers on my own later.

Once the automation is live, I would like ongoing help managing the socials—planning the content calendar, scheduling reels, monitoring DMs that fall outside the bot, and providing weekly performance snapshots.

Deliverables  
1. Instagram ManyChat flow file and live deployment  
2. Working Beehiiv + Zapier connections (tested)  
3. One-page handoff doc outlining the triggers, tags, and growth tactics  
4. First month’s social media schedule with creative ideas that leverage the new automation

Feel free to suggest additional growth hooks inside Instagram’s latest features if you see an opportunity.

More than Instagram Facebook, tik tok YouTube etc.

jobs.title: Go HighLevel Lendingwise Integration Setup
jobs.description:
I need Go HighLevel fully connected to Lendingwise so that the two systems behave like one seamless workspace. The goal is straightforward: every new or updated record in Lendingwise should appear in HighLevel instantly, trigger the right automated email sequence, and fall neatly into an easy-to-follow lead pipeline.

Here’s what matters most to me:  

• Lead management – contacts, notes, and status changes must mirror each other in real time.  
• Automated email sequences – the nurturing flows I build in HighLevel should launch the moment a prospect hits the defined stage in Lendingwise.  
• Data synchronization – custom fields, documents, and deal details must stay up-to-date in both directions with no manual exports.  

Please keep the interface you create simple and clean; I prefer uncluttered dashboards and logical navigation over flashy graphics. API work, webhooks, Zapier, or native connectors are all fine so long as the end result is reliable and easy for me to maintain. Once everything is wired up, I’ll also need a brief hand-off call or screen-share to walk through the setup and confirm each trigger is firing as expected.

jobs.title: Portfolio Website

- Freelance Services Section
- Featured Projects Portfolio
- Project Category Filtering
- Responsive Contact Form
- CV Download Option

- Mobile Navigation
- SEO-Friendly Structure

Services Showcased

- Web Development
- Full-Stack Development
- Frontend Development
- Backend Development
- UI/UX Development
- Database Integration
- Bug Fixing & Optimization
- Technical Support

jobs.title: Memoir-based Short Film Creation
jobs.description:
I’m looking for someone to help bring a very personal story of mine to life as a professional live-action short film.

I’ve written a memoir about my life, covering my childhood, difficult experiences growing up, and the journey that ultimately changed my life. I believe it has strong emotional and cinematic potential and I’d love to see it adapted for film.

You can read my memoir here:
https://www.wattpad.com/story/414919403

I’m looking for someone who can ideally take the project from:

Memoir → Screenplay → Casting → Filming → Editing → Finished Film

I would provide the memoir and my input on the important elements of the story, but I’m looking for someone who can take responsibility for the creative and practical side of the production. I don’t want to be involved in the day-to-day filming or production myself.

I want a real live-action film with human actors and traditional filmmaking, not AI-generated actors or footage.

I’m initially thinking around 15–25 minutes, but I’m completely open to up to 40 minutes or slightly longer if the story genuinely requires it. I don’t want important parts of the story removed simply to meet a specific runtime.

As this is my first film project, I’m looking for a cost-effective independent production and would really value your professional advice on the best way to achieve this within a realistic budget.

Could you please let me know:

• If this is a project you would be interested in
• Whether you can handle both screenplay and production
• Your recommended running time
• An estimated total cost
• Approximate production timeframe
• Examples of similar work you’ve done

This is a very meaningful story to me, so I’m looking for someone who will treat it seriously and help turn it into something cinematic and emotionally powerful.

Thank you for taking the time to read this. I’d love to hear your thoughts and what you think would be possible.

Fabio

jobs.title: Resolve Windows Startup BSOD

I need a Windows troubleshooting specialist who can remotely isolate the root cause, repair it, and return the system to a normal, clean boot without data loss. Deliverables  
• Stable boot to normal Windows desktop (and Safe Mode) with no BSOD for at least two consecutive restarts  
• Brief summary report of steps taken and the specific fix implemented so I can reference it in the future  

Once the machine restarts cleanly and the report is in hand, the project is complete.

## 1. Project Overview

Develop a modern, responsive, and user-friendly fitness mobile application for **Android and iOS** using a cross-platform technology such as **React Native or Flutter**.

The application will help users track workouts, follow fitness plans, monitor progress, and manage their overall fitness activities from a single platform.

## 2. User Registration & Authentication

* Sign up and login using email/phone
* Social login integration
* Forgot/reset password
* User profile creation
* Basic fitness information such as age, height, weight, gender, fitness goal, and activity level

## 3. User Dashboard

* Personalized fitness dashboard
* Daily workout summary
* Calories burned
* Workout duration
* Progress overview
* Quick access to workout plans
* Daily/weekly fitness goals

## 4. Workout & Exercise Module

* Exercise library with images/videos
* Exercise categories
* Beginner, intermediate, and advanced workouts
* Workout plans/routines
* Exercise instructions
* Sets, reps, weight, and rest timer
* Start/pause/complete workout functionality
* Workout history

## 5. Fitness Goals & Progress Tracking

* Set personal fitness goals
* Weight tracking
* Body measurements
* Workout statistics
* Calories burned tracking
* Weekly/monthly progress
* Charts and visual progress reports

## 6. Nutrition Module

* Daily calorie tracking
* Food/meal logging
* Basic nutrition information
* Meal plans
* Macronutrient tracking (protein, carbs, fats)
* Daily nutrition summary

## 7. Notifications & Reminders

* Workout reminders
* Meal reminders
* Goal reminders
* Progress notifications
* Push notifications
* Custom notification preferences

## 8. Subscription & Payment

If required:

* Free and premium plans
* Monthly/yearly subscriptions
* In-app purchase integration
* Subscription management
* Premium workout/nutrition content

## 9. Admin Panel

A web-based admin dashboard will be provided to manage:

* Users
* Exercises
* Workout programs
* Categories
* Nutrition/meal data
* Subscription plans
* Notifications
* User activity and basic analytics
* Content management

## 10. Backend & API

* Secure REST API/backend development
* Database design and implementation
* User authentication and authorization
* Workout and progress data management
* Push notification services
* Payment/subscription APIs
* Admin APIs
* Secure data handling

## 11. Third-Party Integrations

Depending on project requirements:

* Google/Apple authentication
* Firebase Cloud Messaging
* Apple Health
* Google Fit / Health Connect
* Payment gateways
* Analytics
* Cloud storage for images/videos

## 12. UI/UX

* Modern fitness-focused UI
* Responsive layouts for different mobile screen sizes
* Easy navigation
* Consistent design system
* Interactive charts and progress indicators
* Light/dark mode if required

## 13. Testing & Deployment

* Functional testing
* API testing
* Cross-device testing
* Performance testing
* Bug fixing
* Android build generation
* iOS build generation
* App Store and Google Play deployment assistance

## 14. Deliverables

* Android mobile application
* iOS mobile application
* Backend/API
* Database
* Admin panel
* Source code
* UI implementation
* Third-party integrations
* Production deployment
* Basic technical documentation

## 15. Out of Scope

Unless specifically agreed, the following are excluded:

* AI-based personal trainer
* Live trainer/video calling
* Wearable hardware development
* Advanced medical/health diagnostics
* Custom hardware integrations
* Complex AI nutrition recommendations
* Multi-vendor marketplace functionality
* Ongoing maintenance after the agreed support period

## Recommended Technology Stack

**Mobile:** React Native / Flutter
**Backend:** Node.js / Laravel
**Database:** PostgreSQL / MySQL / MongoDB
**Authentication & Notifications:** Firebase
**Admin Panel:** React / Next.js
**Cloud:** AWS / Firebase / similar cloud platform

### Estimated Development Phases

1. UI/UX Design
2. Mobile App Development
3. Backend & Database Development
4. Admin Panel
5. Third-Party Integrations
6. Testing & QA
7. Deployment
8. Post-launch bug-fix/support period

jobs.title: Premium Habit Tracker Development

I am building a digital productivity brand called Warm Wisdom, focused on habits, consistency, productivity, and personal growth.

The final product will be sold as a paid digital product, so quality, usability, visual design, and reliability are extremely important.

I am looking for someone experienced with Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets, especially someone who can build interactive dashboards, formulas, charts, conditional formatting, and polished spreadsheet interfaces.

I have attached a visual mockup/reference showing the general direction I want. Please use it as inspiration for the layout and overall experience, but do not simply copy the design.

What I Want

I want the final spreadsheet to feel like a premium productivity product, rather than a normal Excel spreadsheet.

The design should be:

Clean
Minimal
Modern
Premium
Easy to understand
Beginner-friendly
Visually satisfying
Fully functional
Branded around Warm Wisdom

The overall visual identity should use a warm, natural, elegant aesthetic with elements such as:

Warm cream/beige backgrounds
Dark green/forest green
Subtle gold/brown accents
Clean typography
Minimal borders
Subtle botanical/nature-inspired elements where appropriate

The design should feel consistent with the Warm Wisdom brand.

Core Functionality

The tracker should allow the user to track multiple habits every day throughout the month.

For example:

Exercise
Reading
Meditation
Drinking water
Sleeping early
Studying
Journaling
Coding
Custom habits

The user should be able to enter their own habits.

Daily Tracking

The user should be able to mark whether they completed each habit for each day.

The tracker should automatically calculate:

Daily completion
Habit completion percentage
Weekly completion
Monthly completion
Overall progress
Remaining goals
Best-performing habits
Weakest habits

The calculations should update automatically when the user changes their checkboxes/status.
Dynamic Calendar

The spreadsheet should have a Year and Month selector.

For example:

Year: 2026
Month: August

When the user changes the month/year, the calendar and relevant calculations should update automatically.

The system should correctly handle:

28-day months
29-day February
30-day months
31-day months
Different starting weekdays

I want the calendar to be as automated as reasonably possible.

Dashboard

The main dashboard is extremely important.

I want a visually impressive overview where the user can immediately understand their progress.

The dashboard should include things such as:

Overall Progress

Example:

67%

with a visual progress indicator.

Monthly Progress

A line/area chart showing how consistency changes throughout the month.

Weekly Progress

Show Week 1, Week 2, Week 3, Week 4 and Week 5 where applicable.

Each week should show:

Completion
Percentage
Progress bar
Daily performance

Habit Performance

Show each habit and its completion percentage.

For example:

Habit	Completion
Exercise	87%
Reading	73%
Meditation	63%
Water	90%

This should update automatically.

Additional Insights

Where practical, include:

Best habit
Weakest habit
Best week
Average completion
Completed days
Missed days
Total completed habits
Visual Progress

I want the spreadsheet to feel rewarding to use.

When users complete habits, they should be able to visually see their progress improving.

For example:

Daily → Weekly → Monthly → Overall

Progress bars, charts, percentages, and other visual indicators should update automatically.

The goal is to create a feeling of:

"I'm actually making progress."

Habit Tracking Interface

The actual tracking section should be extremely easy to use.

Something similar to:

Habit | Goal | 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | ... | 31

But you are encouraged to improve the layout rather than simply copying an existing template.

The user should be able to quickly mark habits without getting confused by the spreadsheet.

Important: Original Design

This is an important requirement.

The final template needs to be built from scratch and have its own visual identity.

I do not want a downloaded template that has simply been modified.

Please do not copy an existing commercial/free habit tracker template.

The layout, formulas, dashboard arrangement, styling, and user experience should be independently created.

I will provide a visual reference/mockup for the direction I want, but the final design should be sufficiently distinct and branded for my product.

Excel + Google Sheets

The final product needs to work in:

1. Microsoft Excel
2. Google Sheets

Ideally, the same core functionality should work in both versions.

If a particular Excel feature does not translate properly to Google Sheets, please design an appropriate alternative.

Please clearly explain any differences between the two versions.

Branding

The product will be sold under:

WARM WISDOM

Brand positioning:

Build consistency. One day at a time.

The spreadsheet should incorporate the Warm Wisdom identity without becoming overly decorative.

I want it to look like a real commercial digital product, not a generic spreadsheet.

User Experience

The spreadsheet should be designed for someone who isn't an Excel expert.

The user should immediately understand:

Where to enter their habits
Where to select the month/year
Where to mark completed habits
Where to view their progress
How to interpret the dashboard

Please avoid unnecessary complexity.

If instructions are needed, include a small "How to Use" / "Getting Started" section.

Technical Requirements

Please make sure:

Formulas are reliable
No broken references
No unnecessary hard-coded calculations
Charts update automatically
Progress percentages update automatically
Month/year changes work correctly
Blank days don't negatively affect calculations
The spreadsheet remains usable after users enter their own habits
Formatting remains consistent
No unnecessary macros unless absolutely required
No external dependencies
No broken links
No hidden functionality that could cause issues for customers

The final spreadsheet should be tested thoroughly before delivery.

Deliverables

I expect:

1. Excel version

.xlsx

2. Google Sheets compatible version
3. A polished dashboard
4. Habit tracking system
5. Automated calculations
6. Charts and progress visualization
7. Instructions / Getting Started section

What I Will Provide

I will provide:

Visual mockup/reference
Examples of the type of habit tracking functionality I want
Existing tracker/reference material where useful

The attached mockup is intended to communicate the visual direction and structure, not to be copied pixel-for-pixel.

Freelancer Requirements

Please apply only if you have experience with:

Advanced Excel
Google Sheets
Excel formulas
Google Sheets formulas
Dashboards
Charts
Conditional formatting
Spreadsheet UX/UI
Productivity templates

Please include examples of previous Excel/Google Sheets dashboards or templates you have created.

Preference will be given to freelancers who have created commercial-quality templates or digital products before.

Final Goal

The end result should feel like something a customer would be happy to pay for, not something they could find as a basic free spreadsheet online.

I want the experience to be:

Open → Understand → Add habits → Track → See progress → Stay consistent.

The spreadsheet should make habit tracking feel simple, satisfying, and motivating.

jobs.title: 50K Mixed-Use Investment Blueprint

Please base the work on realistic market assumptions for comparable mixed-use assets and show exactly how the initial 50K will be deployed, recovered, and grown over time. I’m most interested in three core statements:

• Revenue forecast – broken down by residential and commercial components, including expected rent escalations.  
• Expense forecast – operating costs, vacancy allowances, financing costs, and any reserves.  
• Cash-flow statement – month-to-month for the first year and annual roll-ups for years 2-5.

Use spreadsheet software such as Excel or Google Sheets so I can tweak variables later, and accompany the numbers with a brief narrative that explains your key assumptions. jobs.title: Build Django Website Data Scraper
jobs.description:
I need a Python developer to craft a self-contained scraper inside a lightweight Django app for our client’s own website. Phase 1 is all about reliability and clarity, not bells and whistles.

Scope of work
• Create a fresh Django project with a single command (e.g., python manage.py scrape) that navigates the distributed pages of the site, gathers the required text-based content, and captures any embedded timestamps or IDs that help with later analysis.  
• Persist every record directly to the default SQLite database through Django models—no external queues, no Celery.  
• Make the scraper idempotent: re-running it should update or skip existing entries rather than duplicate them.  
• Keep the code modular and well-commented so we can swap in PostgreSQL and add scheduling in the next phase.  
• Deliver a concise README that covers environment setup, model definitions, and the command’s expected runtime.

Success looks like running one command and ending up with a clean, query-ready dataset our analysts can immediately explore.

If you have proven experience with Django, BeautifulSoup, Requests or similar libraries, and can meet these requirements quickly and cleanly, let’s talk timeline and hand-off details.

jobs.title: Odoo Automotive Workshop Platform – Website, Vehicle Booking, Payments, Technical Forum & Future ERP
jobs.description:
We are building USG Auto, a specialist automotive workshop in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. We need an experienced Odoo techno-functional developer/team, not only a web designer.

Our goal is to use Odoo as the main digital system for the business.

PHASE 1 – REQUIRED NOW
1) Professional bilingual website
Arabic + English
Modern premium automotive design
Responsive on desktop, tablet, iPhone and Android
Main pages: Home, About, Services, Offers, Book Appointment, Technical Knowledge, Forum, Contact, Policies, Customer Portal where appropriate
Content must be editable by our staff without programming
2) Vehicle database and vehicle-specific services

Customer selects:

Make → Model → Year → Engine → Trim/configuration if needed

After selection, customer sees only compatible:

Services
Prices
Durations
Offers

Vehicles, services, prices, durations and compatibility must be editable inside Odoo and preferably importable by Excel/CSV. Do not hard-code this data into website pages.

3) Appointment booking

Each service has a duration and the booking system must prevent overbooking based on available resources such as technicians, bays and future dyno capacity.

Management must be able to:

Change service durations
Change capacity
Set working hours/holidays
Block times/days
Add appointments manually
Reschedule/cancel
Override restrictions

Initial booking rules:

Minimum booking notice: about 1 hour
Normal customers: about 2 days ahead
Outside-Riyadh customers: about 3 days ahead

All rules must be configurable.

4) SAR 100 booking deposit

Appointment is confirmed only after payment of SAR 100.

The deposit should be recorded as an advance and credited toward the final invoice when applicable.

Payment gateway should preferably support:

Mada
Visa/Mastercard
Apple Pay

Developer should recommend the suitable Saudi gateway.

5) Cancellation/rescheduling

Initial rules:

One free reschedule if requested at least 4 hours before appointment
Late cancellation/reschedule may forfeit SAR 100
New appointment requires a new deposit
Management can manually override
Customer must accept policy before payment
Changes must have an audit history

All rules must remain configurable.

6) Tabby and Tamara

Integrate both for eligible larger workshop invoices and/or online orders.

Requirements:

Payment status updates automatically in Odoo
Cancellations/refunds handled correctly
Developer must specify existing Odoo module vs custom API
Clearly list module cost, integration cost and recurring fees
7) Notifications

Initially by email:

Booking confirmation
Payment confirmation
Reminder
Reschedule
Cancellation

System should be ready for future SMS/WhatsApp. Arabic and English templates must be editable.

8) Technical Knowledge / Articles

We will publish original automotive technical articles and real workshop cases such as Ford Taurus front sensor retrofit, SYNC 4 upgrades, 360 camera retrofits, programming and transmission diagnostics.

Articles should support:

Text
Photos/videos
Vehicle information
Categories/tags
Author/date
Related services
Related forum discussions

Public technical content must be search-engine indexable with proper SEO basics: clean URLs, page titles, metadata, sitemap, canonical handling and sensible structured data.

9) Automotive enthusiast forum

Preferably within Odoo if practical.

Possible categories:
Ford, GM, Mopar, German Vehicles, Programming, Retrofits, Electrical Diagnostics, Engines, Transmissions, Performance and Technical Cases.

Users should be able to register, post topics/replies and upload relevant images. Moderators need standard moderation controls. Public discussions should be indexable where appropriate.

10) Online shop readiness

System should support future sale of parts, retrofit kits, electronics, merchandise and prepaid services.

Odoo should remain the main business system. Future Salla integration may be added as a sales channel.

11) Management dashboard

At minimum:

Upcoming appointments
Calendar
Deposits
Cancellations/reschedules/no-shows
Popular services/models
Revenue
Customer booking history
PHASE 2 – FUTURE WORKSHOP MANAGEMENT

Phase 2 is not required to be fully developed now, but Phase 1 must be designed so it can be added later without rebuilding the system.

Future requirements include:

Customer and vehicle records with VIN, plate, mileage, vehicle history, previous visits, quotes, invoices, findings and photos
Reception check-in from phone/tablet with customer complaint, mileage, fuel level, warning lights, existing damage, photos/videos, documents and signature
Mobile-friendly employee interface/PWA for technicians and staff
Technician workflow: view assigned vehicle, complaint/history, add findings, comments, photos/videos, measurements, DTCs, scan reports, recommendations, parts requests, start/stop labor time and update status
Work-order stages such as Received → Inspection → Diagnosis → Estimate → Waiting Approval → Waiting Parts → Work in Progress → QC → Road Test → Ready → Delivered
Remote customer quotation approval/rejection, including individual items and audit trail
Parts/inventory: part numbers, suppliers, cost/selling price, stock locations, vehicle compatibility, reorder levels, purchase orders, receiving, issuing/reserving parts to work orders, returns, transfers, barcodes and serial tracking for major assemblies
Parts reports: monthly/yearly consumption, fast/slow moving stock, turnover, usage by vehicle/manufacturer and suggested reorder quantities
HR: employees, attendance, leave, roles, labor hours, productivity and efficiency
Accounting: Saudi VAT, ZATCA e-invoicing, invoices, supplier bills, deposits, credit notes, expenses, payments and bank reconciliation
Customer portal: vehicles, appointments, repair status, quotes, approvals, photos/findings, invoices, payments and service history
Future dedicated customer/employee apps can be added later, so architecture should remain API-friendly
TECHNICAL / OWNERSHIP REQUIREMENTS
Use standard Odoo functionality whenever practical; custom-code only where needed
System must remain maintainable by another qualified Odoo developer
USG Auto must own/control domain, Odoo admin, hosting, database, Git repository, all custom source code, payment accounts, email accounts and business data
No encrypted or developer-locked custom modules
Custom development must be documented
Staging environment required before production updates
Backups and restore procedure required
Arabic RTL must be properly tested
Important screens must be tested on iPhone, Android, tablet and desktop
Role-based permissions for management, reception, technicians, parts, accounting and customers
Developer should recommend Odoo edition/version and hosting and explain why
ACCEPTANCE TEST

Final Phase 1 milestone is only accepted after this complete workflow works end-to-end:

Select vehicle → see correct compatible services/prices → choose service → system checks duration/capacity → choose available slot → pay SAR 100 → booking confirmed → notification sent → booking appears correctly in Odoo → admin can manage/reschedule/cancel it correctly.

Tabby/Tamara and the agreed Knowledge/Forum functions must also be demonstrated.

PROPOSAL MUST ANSWER

Please start your proposal with:

USG ODOO

Have you built Odoo for an automotive workshop/service center before? Show examples if available.
Which Odoo edition/version and hosting do you recommend?
Which requirements are standard Odoo and which need custom development?
How will you structure Make/Model/Year/Engine/Trim and service compatibility?
How will you prevent appointment overbooking?
Which Saudi payment gateway do you recommend?
Can you integrate Tabby and Tamara?
Have you worked with Saudi ZATCA?
Can you implement the Technical Knowledge and Forum sections?
Will the future employee workflow work well on phones/tablets?
Will all source code and Git repository belong to USG Auto?
What paid third-party modules and recurring costs are required?
What is your fixed Phase 1 price and timeline?
Divide Phase 1 into milestones.
What post-launch bug-fix/support period is included?
What is your hourly/day rate for future work?
Give a rough estimate/approach for Phase 2 separately.

Generic bids will not be considered. Phase 1 is the project being awarded now. Phase 2 is future scope and should be priced separately.

Servidor dedicado Ubuntu 24.04 con Plesk. Nginx delante, Apache + PHP-FPM 8.2 detrás.

Un profesional independiente con experiencia real en producción: Linux, Nginx/Apache, PHP-FPM, MySQL/MariaDB, Docker y Docker Compose, despliegue de APIs propias, Cloudflare/DNS/SSL/WAF, backups y restauraciones, monitorización, hardening y migraciones con mínimo downtime. I have a batch of 2200 per lanuage of pre-annotated audio files in Gujarati, Japanese, korean, Odia, Telugu and Malayalam that now need a careful second set of ears. Your task is to listen through each file, compare what you hear with the existing annotation and make immediate inline fixes wherever the two do not align.  

The primary goal is to be sure the audio quality actually matches every line of text that accompanies it. While doing so, please correct:  
• Grammar and spelling issues  
• Translation slips or mist renders  
• Any contextual or logical mismatches  

All edits must remain inline so that I can track exactly where and why each change was introduced. Notes or short comments beside the affected segment are enough; no separate reports are necessary.  

Because the material spans five languages, feel free to take on the files in the languages you are strongest in just let me know which ones you can confidently cover. This is an hourly engagement, so accuracy and consistency are more important than raw speed.  

If you have solid experience with transcription tools, annotation platforms or QA for multilingual content, you will ramp up quickly. Let me know your language set and typical hourly availability, and we can get started right away.

jobs.title: Manual SEO Backlink Outreach - 28/08/2026 12:13 EDT

You will handle personalised outreach, draft or polish the articles (600–1,000 words, SEO-optimised and plagiarism-free), negotiate publication if needed, and secure do-follow links in the body or author bio, depending on each blog’s policy.

Deliverables

All links must be white-hat, permanent, and indexed by Google. If a placement drops within 30 days, I expect a replacement. Familiarity with tools like Ahrefs or Moz to verify domain metrics is helpful, but the work itself must remain 100 % manual.

jobs.title: Sales Associate Acquisition Tracking App
jobs.description:
I’m building a single mobile product that my field sales team can run on both iOS and Android. The core of the app is a Google-Maps–powered “store acquisition” workflow:

• Territory view  
  – Country → city → small map blocks, each block pin-pointing couple stores pulled from Google places.  
  – Pins colour-coded by Google rating so reps can instantly spot high-potential vs low-potential outlets.

• Deep store profile  
  – Auto-fetch and display name, address, phone, line of business and current Google rating.  
  – Associates can update our own status flags: Visited, Not Visited, Interested, Not Interested, Exited.

• In-field tracking  
  – Live GPS location streaming for every associate while the app is open.  
  – Background activity tracker that timestamps check-ins, distance covered and time on site, feeding a performance dashboard.

• Insight dashboard  
  – Separate tabs for Associates, Store Managers and Admin.  
  – Real-time leaderboards showing top & bottom performers, visit counts, conversion ratios and overall app usage.

The finished build must run smoothly on both platforms, respect native location-permission policies, and use Google Maps (or Places) APIs for the data pull and review ranking logic. Clean UI/UX, secure login and cloud sync are expected.  

Acceptance will be based on:  
1. Accurate map tiling down to small-block level with pins and colour logic.  
2. Live location updating ≤5 sec latency while on cellular or Wi-Fi.  
3. Reliable write-back of status flags even when the device is briefly offline.  
4. Role-based dashboards reflecting live data without manual refresh.  

Code repo, brief setup docs and a test build for iOS & Android are the final deliverables.

jobs.title: Social Short-Form Video Editor
jobs.description:

• Calm, relaxing background tracks that never overpower the voice  
• Smooth transitions, tasteful zooms and punch-ins, and light sound effects to emphasize key moments  
• Basic colour correction and audio levelling so the final export looks and sounds polished on any screen  
• Vertical 9:16 exports, optimised for YouTube Shorts (60 s max), plus resized versions for Reels and TikTok when footage allows

Workflow  
I’ll deliver the raw files via Google Drive along with a rough cut or time-stamped notes. You edit, add motion graphics as needed, and return a draft within three days. One revision round is usually enough before final delivery in .mp4 (h264).

To help me choose quickly, please paste links to at least three short-form edits you’ve done that show crisp pacing and clean caption work. If you have experience lifting multiple platform versions from the same source, highlight that too.

Looking forward to seeing how you can make these shorts binge-worthy.

jobs.title: PR Article for VC Outreach
jobs.description:
I’m preparing a high-impact press release that positions my Indian AI & Robotics startup squarely in front of venture capitalists, and I need help turning that story into coverage on respected tech and business outlets.

The single objective is investor attraction, so every line of the piece must speak the language of growth, scale and return. You’ll need to weave three angles together:  
• our proprietary robotics-driven AI technology and why it is hard to replicate,  
• the size of the market we are already addressing and its projected expansion,  
• my own track record in the field and how it de-risks the investment.

Once the article is approved, I expect you to secure publication on credible platforms frequented by VCs—think TechCrunch, YourStory, Economic Times’ startup desk, VentureBeat, or similarly ranked industry outlets (I’m open to suggestions if you have stronger contacts). Distribution should include full‐text placement plus amplification through their social channels whenever possible.

Deliverables  
1. Draft press release (≈600-800 words) ready for my quick review.  
2. Final polished version incorporating my feedback.  
3. Confirmation of publication with live links on at least one agreed-upon outlet.  
4. A brief post-launch report summarising reach metrics supplied by the publisher.

Acceptance criteria  
• Storyline clearly reflects the three key points above.  
• Outlet must be recognisable and respected by venture capital readers.  
• Live link available within the agreed timeframe.

If you already have established relationships with editors in this space, let me know in your proposal along with previous PR wins you’ve secured for deep-tech startups.

We are a private investigation and asset recovery firm based outside Canada, assisting individuals who have lost funds to cryptocurrency scams and fraudulent investment schemes. Our clients are often skeptical, traumatized, and difficult to reach through remote communication alone.

Manufacturer/Distributor → Create Invoice → Dealer Notification → Dealer Login → Review → Approve & Pay with approved B-Power/ICICI credit → Credit Check/Reservation → Payment Authorization → Invoice Paid → Manufacturer Notification → Dispatch → POD Upload → Dealer Delivery Confirmation → Settlement → Commission → Reconciliation.

Build functional—not static—modules:

- Public website, Marketplace, Login/Signup

- Demo users and realistic demo data

Most important UX:
INVOICES AWAITING APPROVAL → APPROVE & PAY
and manufacturer:
CREATE INVOICE

The complete DEMO MODE must work end-to-end from invoice creation through reconciliation, with no dead-end buttons. Never promise guaranteed credit approval; show “Up to 45 Days Credit*” subject to eligibility and program terms.

jobs.title: Website Overhaul & SEO Optimization

1. Core Web Vitals pass on both desktop and mobile.  
2. All major pages include unique, targeted meta tags and headings.  
3. No critical errors appear in Search Console after re-indexing.  
4. New and updated content is grammatically clean and aligned with our tone of voice.  
5. Visual layout renders consistently across modern browsers and common screen sizes.

Please outline your workflow for combining design edits with SEO implementation and give a realistic timeframe for the full rollout, including any phased milestones for content, technical fixes, and off-page outreach.

jobs.title: Comprehensive QA Audit for ShowManager.pro
jobs.description:
***NOTE: Your bid will be refused if it is not the ACTUAL hourly rate you intend to charge. We don't deal with Bait & Switchers. Our tester needs to have integrity. Your bid is binding. Bid an amount that isn't the same when we chat wit you, we will add you to our growing list of Freelancers we do not hire. Ever.


We are looking for an experienced **QA / Product Tester** to thoroughly test our SaaS platform, ShowManager.pro.

ShowManager.pro is a platform used to manage trade shows, expos, fairs and similar events. It includes functionality for event organizers, exhibitors/vendors, booth management, floor plans, ticketing, attendee experiences, reporting and other event-management workflows.

We are NOT looking for someone who simply clicks buttons and reports obvious bugs.

We need someone who can think like a **product owner, QA engineer and real end user**.

Your job will be to test complete workflows and identify:

* Bugs and technical problems
* Broken or confusing user flows
* Business logic errors
* Missing validation
* Edge cases
* Permissions / role problems
* Inconsistent behaviour
* Poor UX
* Confusing wording or instructions
* Design/layout issues
* Mobile/responsive issues
* Places where users could get stuck
* Features that technically work but do not make sense from a user's perspective

### How the work will be assigned

We will provide specific areas or scenarios to test.

For example:

"Create a new event, configure the show, create booth types, add booths, invite an exhibitor, have the exhibitor register, select a booth and complete the process."

We expect you to explore beyond the exact happy path.

Try different sequences.

Try doing things incorrectly.

Try changing information midway through a process.

Try cancelling, going backward, refreshing the page, using another role, entering unusual data, etc.

Think about what a real customer might do.

### Reports

For each testing assignment, provide a detailed report.

Every issue should include:

**Title**

Short description of the issue.

**Severity**

Critical / High / Medium / Low / Suggestion

**Area**

Example: Exhibitor Registration / Booth Management / Ticketing

**Steps to reproduce**

Exact steps we can follow to reproduce the problem.

**Expected behaviour**

What you believe should happen.

**Actual behaviour**

What actually happened.

**Screenshots or screen recording**

Include visual evidence whenever useful.

**UX / Product Recommendation**

If something technically works but you believe it could be improved, explain why and recommend a better approach.

We also want a summary at the end of each assignment containing:

* Overall impression of the workflow
* Major blockers
* Logic problems
* UX concerns
* Design inconsistencies
* Suggested improvements
* Things that worked particularly well

### Important

We want someone who is comfortable saying:

"This feature technically works, but the workflow doesn't make sense."

or:

"This isn't technically a bug, but users are going to get confused here."

Those observations are extremely valuable to us.

### Ideal Candidate

Experience with some combination of:

* SaaS product testing
* Manual QA
* UX testing
* Product management
* Web application testing
* Complex multi-role platforms
* E-commerce or ticketing systems
* Event management software

Experience writing professional QA reports is strongly preferred.

You should have excellent English communication skills and be able to explain problems clearly.

### Initial Paid Test

We will start shortlisted candidates with a small paid testing assignment.

You will be given one workflow in ShowManager.pro to test.

We will evaluate the quality of your testing based on:

* Depth of testing
* Quality of issues discovered
* Ability to identify logic problems
* UX/product thinking
* Clarity of your report
* Screenshots/video evidence
* Ability to reproduce problems
* Ability to identify edge cases

If the work is strong, this can become ongoing work as the platform continues to develop.

When applying, please tell us:

1. What SaaS/web applications have you tested?
2. How do you approach testing a workflow you've never seen before?
3. Give an example of a UX or logic problem you discovered that was not technically a software bug.
4. What tools do you use for screenshots, screen recording and bug reporting?
5. Please provide an example of a QA/testing report if you have one.

jobs.title: Human-Crafted Informatics Literature Review
jobs.description:
I am preparing the literature review for my PhD in Informatics and need a collaborator who will read the papers, think with me, and write every line by hand—no AI drafting of the actual text. Because I already use the major tools myself, I am looking for the added value of genuine human insight: the ability to trace debates across journals, compare competing models, and help me weave a clear narrative that supports the quantitative methodology I will apply later in the thesis.

Here is how I would like us to work:

• You receive my initial reading list, suggest any missing landmark studies, and justify each addition.  
• We meet (chat or video) to map themes, research gaps, and how they relate to my quantitative design.  
• You share annotated notes and outlines before writing prose, so I can see your reasoning in real time.  
• A short, 300-word sample based on two articles I provide will let me confirm the voice and depth are truly yours.  
• Drafts are delivered in an editable document with tracked changes, reference manager file (Zotero, Mendeley, or EndNote—your choice), and a Turnitin report for transparency.

The final deliverable is a cohesive literature review chapter (approx. 10,000–12,000 words) with correctly formatted citations, a synthesized thematic structure, and a clearly articulated research gap aligned to my forthcoming quantitative study.

If you are comfortable showcasing your process and can commit to genuine, human-crafted scholarship, I look forward to hearing how you would approach this collaboration.

jobs.title: AI Biography Explainer Video Prompts
jobs.description:

jobs.title: Uber Eats Pizza Menu Optimization

jobs.title: AI Article Automation for WordPress
jobs.description:
I run indiaroyalfamilies.com, a WordPress site with more than 700 published pieces on India’s royal dynasties. It is time to scale the content strategy and I want to fold AI-powered automated article writing into the workflow. The goal is twofold: 

• breathe new life into many of the existing posts through fresh angles, richer context, and updated sourcing  
• publish an ongoing stream of brand-new material

The AI must comfortably handle historical analysis, biographical stories, and timely news updates—matching the tone, factual depth, and citation style already established on the site. Cost effectiveness is important, so a solution built on readily available APIs or reputable WordPress plugins (for example OpenAI, Claude, or comparable tools) that keeps usage fees transparent is preferred.

I also need guidance on the entire integration process: choosing or customising the plugin, setting up API keys, defining prompts and templates, creating an editorial review checkpoint, and scheduling posts so they enter WordPress in draft status for manual approval. Clear documentation and a brief hand-off call should round things off.

Acceptance criteria  
• AI integrated and able to generate both new drafts and revisions directly inside WordPress  
• At least three sample outputs—one updated existing post, two fully new articles—covering each content type listed above  
• Workflow and prompt library documented so I can reproduce results without outside help  
• Solution runs within agreed token/usage limits to stay budget friendly

Feel free to suggest incremental roll-outs or other creative, lower-cost approaches that still meet the objectives above.

jobs.title: Manual SEO Backlink Outreach

Alongside the directory work, I also want guest posts placed on industry-specific blogs. I already have a vetted list of target sites, complete with contact details and basic topic ideas. You will handle personalised outreach, draft or polish the articles (600–1,000 words, SEO-optimised and plagiarism-free), negotiate publication if needed, and secure do-follow links in the body or author bio, depending on each blog’s policy.

Deliverables

All links must be white-hat, permanent, and indexed by Google. If a placement drops within 30 days, I expect a replacement. Familiarity with tools like Ahrefs or Moz to verify domain metrics is helpful, but the work itself must remain 100 % manual.

jobs.title: Freelancer Client Web Marketplace
jobs.description:
I plan to launch a web-based marketplace that directly connects freelancers with clients, allowing both sides to post, discover, and complete projects in one place. The core build centres on three must-have capabilities:

• User profiles – Each freelancer and client needs a dedicated page that shows skills, portfolios, ratings, and project history, editable after secure sign-up or social login.  
• Project search system – Fast, filterable browsing by skill, budget, timeline, and keyword so users can quickly match with relevant work or talent.  
• Integrated payments – Escrow-style checkout, fee calculation, and automated payouts once milestones are approved, with basic dispute handling and transaction logs.

Please code it as a responsive web app with clear separation of front-end and back-end. You’re free to choose the stack (React, Vue, or similar for UI; Node, Laravel, Django, etc. for the API) as long as it is well-documented, modular, and easy to maintain.  

Acceptance criteria  
1. All three core features work end-to-end on modern browsers.  
2. New user onboarding takes no more than two minutes from sign-up to completed profile.  
3. Payments run in sandbox mode without errors and record status changes in the database.  
4. Code is pushed to a Git repository with a concise README for local setup and deployment.

That’s the scope for the first release; further enhancements such as messaging and rating analytics will follow once the foundation is solid.

jobs.title: Minimalist Whiteboard Reels Illustrator

Because everything is black and white, you can concentrate on expressive line weight, pacing, and clever reveals rather than color work. If you like working in VideoScribe, Doodly, Adobe Animate, or any comparable tool, that’s fine—just let me know your preference so we’re compatible on exports.

Turnaround is important: I’d like to approve a first reel within a few days of kickoff, then move into a steady weekly batch. Consistency across episodes matters just as much as creativity, so a short style guide will be provided up front to lock in character proportions and stroke thickness.

If minimalist storytelling through whiteboard animation is your specialty, I’m excited to see a sample that proves your lines can speak for themselves.

jobs.title: Daily Instagram Product Demo Videos

jobs.title: Phone Closer for US Law Firm - Warm Leads, No Cold Calling

Need 2+ years phone sales, collections, or US-account BPO, excellent spoken English with a neutral accent, quota experience, and wired internet with a backup. Full-time, long-term, 8:30am-5:30pm US Pacific. Philippines preferred.

jobs.title: Optometry Clinical Research Paper
jobs.description:
I need a comprehensive research paper in optometry that zeroes in on clinical studies. The end goal is a publish-ready manuscript that surveys current evidence, highlights gaps, and suggests future avenues of investigation. Because I’m a beginner, I also want to understand the research journey itself, so please keep explanations clear and jargon-light where possible.

If you have previous academic writing or optometric research experience, let me know—seeing a sample will help me gauge your style. No need for an elaborate proposal; a concise outline of how you plan to tackle the topic and the resources you expect to use is enough.

Deliverables
• 5,000–7,000-word paper (Word or Google Docs) covering abstract, introduction, methods, results, discussion, conclusion, and APA-formatted references  
• Minimum 20 peer-reviewed sources from 2015 onward  
• At least one table or figure that distills key clinical findings  
• A short (1–2 page) explanatory memo that walks me through your research approach in plain language  

Once we agree on the specific clinical sub-topic, I’ll share any background notes I have. Let’s create a solid, insightful piece together and help me learn the ropes of optometric research along the way.

jobs.title: Professional Character Motion Reels

jobs.description:
