The source material is text data—no numbers to calculate—so please focus on flawless transcription: matching spelling, punctuation, and spacing exactly as they appear.

Feel free to create sensible column headers and overall layout as you go; the goal is a clear, consistent structure that makes the information easy to filter and sort later. Once all records are in place, remove any duplicates so the sheet ends up with one clean, unique entry per row.

I would like the final, deduplicated .xlsx file delivered within three days. I will run spot checks for accuracy, so zero typos and consistent formatting are crucial.

jobs.title: 5,000-Word MSc Management Assignment
jobs.description:
I need a well-researched, 5,000-word paper for my MSc Management course, specifically within the Marketing track. The brief from my professor is purposely open, so you and I can agree on a focused topic that sits solidly inside contemporary marketing practice—think digital campaigns, consumer behaviour analytics, branding strategy, or similar themes that can be backed by current journal articles and real-world case studies.

Scope and structure  
• 5,000 words of original content (not including references, tables or appendices)  
• Clear introduction, literature review, analysis/discussion, conclusion and recommendations  
• Minimum of 12 recent academic sources plus credible industry reports  
• Harvard referencing throughout  

Deliverables  
1. Word document (.docx) with all content and references  
2. Turnitin or similar plagiarism report showing ≤10 % similarity  
3. Brief outline (200–300 words) for approval before you write the full paper  

Acceptance criteria  
• Meets the word count within ±5 %  
• Flawless Harvard citation style  
• Arguments flow logically and are supported by evidence, not opinion  
• Language suitable for postgraduate level; no AI-detected red flags  

Timeline is flexible but I prefer the outline in three days and the final draft one week later. Let me know your proposed topic angle and any previous marketing research you have completed so I can gauge fit quickly.

jobs.title: Residential Renovation Permit Coordinator
jobs.description:
I’m looking for an experienced permit specialist who can take full ownership of securing building permits for a series of residential renovation projects I manage. The work centers on preparing complete application packages, tracking each submission through local building departments, and keeping my onsite crew up to date on any plan-checker comments or revisions.

You’ll pull together architectural drawings, structural details, energy forms, and any required neighbourhood notifications, then submit them electronically or in person depending on the jurisdiction. Once the plans are in review, I’ll rely on you to monitor portal updates, respond to correction letters, and schedule inspections so construction stays on timeline.

Success here means each renovation permit is issued without avoidable delays, all documentation is archived neatly in our shared drive, and I receive a concise status report every Friday. If you already know the ins and outs of our city’s online permitting system, IRC and local amendments, you’ll hit the ground running. AutoCAD or Bluebeam skills are a plus for quick mark-ups, but solid communication with planning staff matters most.

If coordinating residential building permits for remodels is second nature to you, let’s talk and get these projects moving.

jobs.title: Schneider TM218 PLC Program Backup
jobs.description:
I need a clean program backup taken from my Schneider Modicon TM218LDA40DRN PLC. The controller is currently powered up, functioning as normal, but it is offline from any engineering workstation. Nothing on the machine can be stopped or altered; the task is strictly to extract the application code for safekeeping.

You will arrive (or connect, if you already have secure remote access to the site) with the correct Schneider cable and use EcoStruxure Machine Expert / SoMachine to communicate with the CPU. Once connected, please read out the complete program, including all symbol tables and comments that reside on the device, then save the archive in Schneider’s native formats (.stu and compressed backup). Afterward, open the file on a separate workstation to confirm its integrity and share it with me along with the connection parameters you used.

Acceptance criteria:
• No interruption of the running process.  
• Verified, restorable backup files (.stu + compressed archive).  
• Brief connection report (IP/port or USB details) so I can reproduce the procedure.

Tell me your earliest availability and any on-site requirements so we can schedule the work.

jobs.title: Samsung Galaxy A35 – Professional Data Recovery Assessment
jobs.description:
I need an experienced Android/Samsung data recovery professional to assess a Samsung Galaxy A35 that belongs to a family member.

The device is currently inaccessible because the screen PIN has been forgotten.

Our primary goal is to preserve and recover the personal data stored on the device before considering any factory reset.

We can provide proof of ownership.

We have also recovered the Google account credentials associated with the device.

The data we would like to preserve includes, where technically possible:

* Photos and videos
* Contacts
* Documents and files
* Messages
* Notes
* Application data
* Other locally stored personal information

We understand that some data may be protected by Android/Samsung encryption and may not be recoverable without the original screen credentials.

Requirements:

1. First perform a non-destructive assessment.
2. Do not factory reset, format, flash, or erase the device without our explicit approval.

jobs.title: Traditional Alpine Resort Architectural Design
jobs.description:

Core program  
• Spa and wellness center (thermal pools, treatment rooms, yoga studio) integrated as the signature guest experience and visually anchored to the landscape.

At this stage I’m looking for:  
1. Conceptual site planning with view corridors, circulation, parking and service routes resolved.  
2. Schematic architectural drawings for all primary structures, including guest lodges, reception, and the spa complex.  
3. 3D exterior massing and a handful of fully textured hero renders so stakeholders can understand scale, materiality, and ambience.  
4. Brief outline of structural approach and suggested local materials to keep the build economical and sustainable in alpine weather conditions.  
5. A phased build strategy that shows how the spa can open first while leaving room to add future amenities like ski lifts or gourmet dining if we decide to expand.

Please work in the CAD/BIM platform you’re most comfortable with—Revit, ArchiCAD, or similar—as long as final files are delivered in DWG and IFC formats for my engineer. I’ll supply a topographic survey and drone imagery once we start.

Show me relevant chalet, lodge, or resort projects you’ve designed in mountainous terrain, note any experience with wellness facilities, and outline how many revision rounds are included in your fee. I’m ready to move quickly and will schedule a kickoff call within a few days of choosing the right partner.

jobs.title: Medical Educational Video Production Assistant
jobs.description:
PROJECT TITLE

Blender + HeyGen Video Production Assistant for Medical Education – Paid Trial

PROJECT DESCRIPTION

I am developing a professional medical education video series for medical, nursing, and allied-health students.

I am looking for an affordable, reliable freelancer who can assist with the technical production side using Blender and HeyGen.

This is not a request to create an entire medical course for $50.

This first project is a small paid trial. If the quality is good, there is potential for ongoing freelance work as we produce more lessons.

WHAT I WILL PROVIDE

I will provide:

Medical/anatomy lesson content and scripts

Professor/presenter direction

Existing visual references and production ideas

Anatomical and medical instructions

Scene instructions

Feedback and corrections

You are not expected to write the medical course or independently determine the medical content.

WHAT I NEED YOU TO DO

I need someone who can assist with:

Blender scene setup

Importing and positioning existing 3D models and assets

Basic character positioning and animation

Basic camera animation

Lighting and rendering

Displaying anatomical organs/models beside the presenter

Simple organ rotation and camera movements

Adding labels and callouts when required

Creating and assembling presenter scenes in HeyGen

Synchronising scenes with the supplied narration/script

Basic video editing

Adding subtitles and on-screen text

Creating clean transitions between scenes

Exporting clean vertical and horizontal educational videos

PAID TEST PROJECT

For the first milestone, I want a short 30–60 second medical education demonstration.

Example sequence:

Establishing shot of a medical university or lecture environment.
Professor/presenter appears and begins teaching.
Camera moves closer to the presenter.
A 3D anatomical heart appears beside the presenter.
The heart rotates slowly or is presented clearly for teaching.
Important anatomical structures are highlighted or labelled.
Presenter continues explaining while the anatomical visual remains visible.
Clean transition and ending shot.

The objective is not advanced Hollywood animation.

I need a clean, professional educational result that can eventually be reproduced efficiently for many medical lessons.

REQUIRED SKILLS

Blender

HeyGen, or ability to learn and use HeyGen quickly

Basic video editing

Camera and lighting fundamentals

Working with existing 3D assets

Basic 3D animation

Ability to follow detailed instructions

Good communication

Attention to detail

Experience producing educational or medical content is helpful but not essential.

IMPORTANT

I am not looking for someone to redesign the entire project from scratch.

I want someone who is comfortable receiving a prepared script, assets, medical instructions, and clear production directions and then handling the technical production efficiently.

You must be willing to make reasonable corrections after feedback.

Medical knowledge is helpful but not required because the medical content and academic direction will be provided.

VIDEO FORMATS

You should be able to produce:

9:16 vertical videos for TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts

16:9 horizontal videos for YouTube and longer educational lessons

BUDGET

Maximum total budget for this initial paid trial: $50 USD.

Please do not bid above $50 for the trial.

This is a fixed-price trial project.

If the trial is successful, we can discuss additional projects separately.

There is potential for ongoing freelance work for the right person.

WHEN APPLYING, PLEASE ANSWER THESE QUESTIONS

How long have you been using Blender?
Have you used HeyGen? If yes, please describe what you have done with it.
Can you import existing anatomical 3D models into Blender and animate them instead of modelling everything from scratch?
Can you create simple camera movements, lighting, organ rotations, and basic animations in Blender?
Which video-editing software do you use?
Can you produce both 9:16 vertical videos and 16:9 horizontal videos?
Please provide examples of your actual previous Blender, animation, or video production work.
Which example from your portfolio best demonstrates your ability to complete this project?
How quickly could you complete a 30–60 second test video after receiving all required assets and instructions?
What is your fixed price for this trial? Maximum budget is $50 USD.

APPLICATION INSTRUCTION

Please start your proposal with the word:

DAMINORA

Proposals that do not start with DAMINORA may not be considered.

This is simply to confirm that you have read the complete project description.

PLEASE NOTE

Do not send a generic proposal without showing relevant previous work.

I am particularly interested in finding a freelancer who is reliable, affordable, willing to learn, able to follow instructions carefully, and interested in a longer-term working relationship if the trial goes well.

Quality, communication, reliability, and ability to follow instructions are more important than having an extensive medical background.

Visually, I’m picturing a blend of sweeping cityscape shots and calmer nature interludes, stitched together so the mood follows the flow of the song. Dynamic lighting should drive key transitions, with tasteful particle effects and occasional slow-motion moments to accent beats or lyrical cues. All animation, compositing and colour work has to look natural rather than stylised or cartoonish.

You’ll receive:
• the mastered audio file  
• the LoRA model / photo set for the character reference  
• any extra style notes or timestamps that highlight musical peaks

I’d like the final piece delivered as a high-quality video file plus the reusable ComfyUI workflow so I can tweak or extend scenes later if needed. A short draft or storyboard pass before full rendering will help us lock timing and visual direction quickly. If you’re comfortable driving ComfyUI, working with LoRA models and syncing visuals tightly to music, I’m ready to start right away.

jobs.title: Modernise Four Landing Pages - WP/Elementor Pro

Here is what I’m after:

• Navigation & header overhaul  
  – A simplified menu structure, prominent logo placement and a discrete search bar should sit in a tighter, more balanced header.  
  – Spacing, section hierarchy and CTA buttons should echo the best-practice reference style I’ll share.

• Typography  
  – Switch all body and heading styles to crisp, readable sans-serif fonts and fine-tune size, weight and line-height for clarity.

Process options  
If you’re comfortable working directly in the site backend, I can supply editor access so you can begin on the first page straight away. If you prefer design first, create a Figma mockup for approval, then roll it out live once signed off—I’m happy with either approach.

Deliverables (per page)  
1. Updated hero, body and CTA imagery  
2. Rebuilt header/navigation that includes the three requested elements  
3. Revised typography and spacing across all sections  
4. Final live page (or approved Figma file if we go the mockup route)

Please confirm which workflow you’d like to follow and your estimated turnaround for each stage.

jobs.title: YouTube & Instagram Video Editing
jobs.description:
I shoot light-hearted entertainment pieces every week and now need a deft hand to turn the raw takes into polished uploads for both YouTube and Instagram Reels. The job is straightforward but detail-driven:

• Trim dead space, tighten pacing, and keep the energy high.  
• Seamlessly connect clips with clean fade transitions.  
• Sync dialogue perfectly, lay in royalty-free background music at the right levels, and ride the audio so speech stays front-and-center.  
• Add burnt-in subtitles plus occasional call-outs that appear and disappear with a subtle fade in/out animation.  
• Apply basic colour correction so tones stay natural and consistent across shoots.  

Once the storytelling feels smooth, I’ll need two masters—16:9 for YouTube and 9:16 for Reels—delivered in 4K (or the highest resolution available in the source), along with the editable project file (Premiere Pro, Final Cut, or DaVinci Resolve all welcome). A single high-impact thumbnail frame would be a useful bonus.

Turnaround: first draft within two days of receiving footage, with quick tweaks after feedback. If you have entertainment-style samples that showcase silky fade transitions and clean text work, attach them when you reply—I’m ready to get the next episode into your timeline.

jobs.title: Fun Vlog Edit With Sound
jobs.description:
I have a batch of raw vlog clips that need to be shaped into a light-hearted, casual video that keeps viewers smiling from start to finish. The core of the job is creative editing—pacing the story, trimming out the dead space, and, most importantly, layering in playful sound effects that accentuate jokes, reactions, or quick cuts. Think of the subtle whooshes, pops, and comedic stingers you often hear in upbeat YouTube vlogs; that’s exactly the energy I’m after.

The footage is already organized chronologically, so you can dive straight into Premiere Pro, Final Cut, DaVinci Resolve, or whichever NLE you prefer. Color tweaks and basic audio balancing are expected so everything looks and sounds consistent, but heavy colour-grading or text overlays aren’t a priority unless you feel they would genuinely elevate the flow. If you do see a moment where an extra transition or overlay could make the sequence shine, let me know—flexibility is welcome as long as the final cut still feels casual and fun.

Deliverables I need from you:  
• One polished vlog video exported in full HD.  
• A version with an embedded timecode (or the project file) so I can request small tweaks if needed.  
• Confirmation that all sound effects used are royalty-free or properly licensed.

Send a quick note describing similar edits you’ve completed and your estimated turnaround once you receive the footage link, and we can get rolling right away.

jobs.title: Hire Purchase Vehicle Web App

Alongside financing, the site must let users sort out insurance on the spot. They should see instant quotes based on the vehicle they choose and then complete the policy purchase and manage their cover from the same portal—all without being bounced to a third-party site.

The content portfolio includes both SFW and NSFW material, covering different formats such as lifestyle, travel, fitness, behind-the-scenes content, interviews, entertainment, and other creator productions.
We are looking for someone who is comfortable working with both types of content and can maintain a consistently professional editing standard regardless of the subject matter.
This is intended to become a long-term collaboration for the right editor.
Role & Responsibilities
The main responsibility will be to transform raw footage into polished, engaging videos for different platforms and purposes.
Typical projects may include:
Long-Form Editing
Edit approximately 30–40 minutes of raw footage into a polished final video, typically around 20–30 minutes, depending on the content.
Editing may include:
•	Selecting the strongest footage
•	Removing unnecessary sections, mistakes, and pauses
•	Improving pacing and storytelling
•	Audio cleanup and enhancement
•	Colour correction
•	Transitions where appropriate
•	Music and sound effects where appropriate
•	Text and graphics
Teaser / Highlight Videos
From longer recordings, create an engaging 5–10-minute teaser/highlight video designed to generate interest in the full production.
The teaser should:
•	Have a strong opening
•	Maintain good pacing
•	Select the most interesting moments
•	Create curiosity without giving away the entire video
•	Feel like a professionally produced standalone piece
Short-Form Content
Where appropriate, extract shorter clips from the original footage for:
•	Instagram
•	YouTube Shorts
•	X
•	Other social media platforms
Typical clips may be 30–90 seconds, depending on the content and platform.
Content Types
The projects may include both SFW and NSFW material and can cover:
•	Lifestyle
•	Travel
•	Fitness & wellness
•	Behind-the-scenes
•	Interviews
•	Entertainment
•	Gaming
•	Cosplay
•	Creator productions
•	Long-form videos
•	Promotional teasers
What We're Looking For
We're looking for an editor who understands storytelling and audience retention, rather than simply cutting footage together.
Important qualities include:
•	Strong sense of pacing
•	Good storytelling ability
•	Attention to detail
•	Creative editing
•	Understanding of audience retention
•	Ability to identify the strongest moments in raw footage
•	Consistent quality
•	Reliability and meeting deadlines
•	Ability to work independently
Software
Experience with professional editing software such as:
•	Adobe Premiere Pro
•	DaVinci Resolve
•	Final Cut Pro
•	After Effects
•	CapCut Pro
Example Project
Input:
30–40 minutes of raw footage
Potential deliverables:
•	1 × Full edited video – approximately 20–30 minutes
•	1 × 5–10 minute teaser
•	3–5 × short-form clips
Confidentiality
Because some projects may contain private or sensitive material, confidentiality is extremely important.
The editor must:
•	Keep all supplied footage confidential
•	Not share, publish, or distribute material
•	Not use footage in a portfolio without explicit permission
•	Securely store project files
•	Delete or return source material when requested
A confidentiality/NDA agreement may be required.
Application
Please provide:
1.	Your portfolio or showreel
2.	Examples of long-form editing
3.	Examples of teaser/highlight editing
4.	Examples of short-form content
5.	Editing software you use
6.	Typical turnaround time
7.	Your pricing structure
Please also tell us whether you are comfortable working with both SFW and NSFW material.
Paid Test Project
Shortlisted candidates may be asked to complete a paid test project using approximately 30–40 minutes of raw footage.
The test would consist of:
•	One 5–10 minute teaser
•	One short-form clip
•	Brief explanation of your editing approach
The test will allow us to evaluate:
•	Storytelling
•	Pacing
•	Editing quality
•	Creativity
•	Understanding of the source material
•	Ability to create a compelling teaser
•	Turnaround time
Successful completion could lead to regular monthly projects and a long-term collaboration.
Pricing
Please provide either:
•	Price per 30-minute finished video
•	Price for a 5–10 minute teaser
•	Price per short-form clip
or alternatively:
•	Hourly rate
•	Monthly retainer
We are open to discussing the most appropriate model based on the expected volume of work.

jobs.title: UI/UX Redesign for Saudi Marketplace
jobs.description:

Main competitors and references:
• Haraj
• Dubizzle
• OLX

We will attach reference designs showing the visual direction and quality we are looking for. These are inspiration only. We want an original design adapted to our brand and product, not a copy.

Key requirements:
• Modern, premium and visually engaging UI
• Strong marketplace UX and information hierarchy
• Image focused listing cards
• Excellent search and category discovery
• Categories and subcategories
• Featured and sponsored listings
• Advertising placements because advertising is an important revenue source
• Seller verification and trust badges
• Buyer and seller messaging
• Seller controlled phone number visibility
• Location based discovery
• Dealer and business listings
• Arabic and English
• Full RTL support
• Responsive Web design
• Mobile app UI
• Reusable Figma components and design system

Core flows include:
• Homepage
• Categories
• Search and filters
• Listing details
• Post an Ad
• Login / Signup

jobs.title: Edit 5 Fun, Energetic Reels
jobs.description:
I’m putting together five short vertical reels, each running somewhere between 30 seconds and a minute, and I need them to burst with energy. You’ll start from my raw footage and turn it into polished, platform-ready content that feels fast-paced and playful.

The vibe

Deliverables  
• 5 fully edited MP4 reels, 1080 × 1920, each 30–60 s  
• Engaging opening hook within the first two seconds  
• Dynamic transitions, animated text overlays, and clean audio mix

Timeline

jobs.title: YouTube Video Revamp

jobs.title: Comedy YouTube Video Creation

jobs.title: Indonesian Telegram Chatbot Responder
jobs.description:
I need a Telegram bot that can take over my channel’s incoming messages and answer them exclusively in Indonesian. Two core functions matter most to me:  

• Automated replies triggered by specific keywords I will supply.  
• Flexible customer-support style responses for questions that don’t match those keywords.  

A clean, maintainable solution built on the official Telegram Bot API is preferred, but I am open to any framework you are comfortable with as long as it runs reliably on a standard VPS. The reply database has to be easy for me to update later—CSV, Google Sheet, or a small web panel, whichever you feel is quickest to set up.

Key expectations  
1. The bot detects the user’s message, matches it against my keyword list, and returns the preset answer instantly.  
2. When no keyword is found, it should switch to a fallback mode that lets me enter a custom reply manually or route the chat to a human operator inside the same Telegram thread.  
3. All messages must be sent in clear, natural Indonesian; for now I do not need any multi-language capability.  
4. Basic analytics—daily count of received questions and answered ones—would be a useful extra if you can add it quickly.  

Once you have a working prototype, please share the bot for testing on my private group. I will sign off once we verify:  
• keywords trigger the correct response every time,  
• non-matching queries reach the fallback queue, and  
• no English text slips through the automated replies.  

Let me know which tech stack you intend to use, your estimated timeline, and any clarifying questions you have.

jobs.title: Enhance SynapseIQ AI Knowledge Platform
jobs.description:
I need a seasoned full-stack developer who can dive straight into SynapseIQ’s codebase and raise the quality bar, starting with our document-processing pipeline. The stack is React + TypeScript on the front end and Node.js/Express with SQLite and the OpenAI API on the back. Everything sits behind a multi-tenant architecture with authentication, role-based permissions, semantic search and RAG already in place.

First priority is a thorough review of the existing platform, then a concerted push to modernise document processing. I want noticeably higher data-extraction accuracy, faster throughput and support for additional file formats without breaking what’s already live. While doing so, keep an eye on AI/RAG optimisation, code cleanliness and production-readiness in general.

Key deliverables I will use to sign off the work:
• A concise code-review report highlighting current bottlenecks and proposed fixes.  
• Refactored document-processing modules that benchmark faster and extract entities more accurately across at least three new document types we define together.  
• Updated automated tests and performance metrics showing the gains.

You’ll collaborate directly with me on GitHub, ship incremental PRs, and document any architectural decisions so they’re easy for the wider engineering team to maintain. If you thrive in TypeScript, love optimising AI workflows and enjoy making complex platforms production-ready, let’s talk.

jobs.title: SWMS Compliance Procedure Overhaul
jobs.description:
My current Safe Work Method Statements and related policy documents have grown inconsistent over time, and several no longer align with the latest workplace safety regulations. I need the entire set re-structured with one clear objective: improving compliance. Legal obligations take precedence over internal preferences or broader industry standards, so every change must be mapped directly to the relevant Acts, Regulations and Codes of Practice that govern workplace safety.

Scope  
• Audit all existing SWMS, policies and procedures to pinpoint gaps against current workplace safety regulations.  
• Redraft or consolidate documents so language is unambiguous, section flow is logical and duplication is removed.  
• Build a concise master register showing each SWMS, its revision date, and the specific legislative references it satisfies.  
• Supply fresh templates that make future updates simple without compromising compliance.  

Acceptance criteria  
1. Each revised document clearly cites the exact workplace safety regulation(s) it satisfies.  
2. No conflicting instructions remain across the document set.  
3. Master register delivered in both Excel and PDF.  

If you have proven experience aligning safety management systems with statutory requirements and can turn dense legal text into user-friendly procedures, I’m ready to move forward straight away.

jobs.title: Spanish Google Ads Specialist Needed

jobs.title: Salesforce Customer Web Portal Build
jobs.description:
I want to launch a Salesforce Experience Cloud web portal that gives our customers a smooth, self-service journey on top of our existing Salesforce org. The portal must rely on Salesforce authentication so users sign up and sign in through the standard Salesforce identity flow we already use internally.

Core functionality I need delivered:

• User Registration  
• Company Contact Management  
• Service Ordering  

Here’s the flow I have in mind: a new visitor reaches the portal, creates an account via Salesforce auth, registers their company and key contacts, then submits service orders that automatically create the right objects and kick off our internal fulfilment processes. Everything should sit natively in Salesforce so we can report, trigger Flows, and extend later with LWC or Apex when required.

Key points to keep in mind:
– Build on Experience Cloud with a clean, responsive Lightning template.  
– Leverage standard sharing where possible; custom Apex only when configuration can’t cover the need.  
– Make the data model and record types easy for internal users to manage.  
– Provide concise documentation and a short hand-off call so my admin team can maintain the portal after go-live.

Acceptance criteria: visible working portal in my sandbox, test users able to complete the three functions above end-to-end, and deployment scripts or change sets ready for production. If questions arise around look-and-feel, I’m happy to provide brand guidelines.

jobs.title: Update “Meet the Team” Page
jobs.description:

The site already runs smoothly, so this is strictly a content swap—no redesign or extra pages. As long as the updated page looks identical in styling to the rest of the site, loads the new images crisply, and shows the new copy without layout breaks on desktop and mobile, the job is done.

jobs.title: ESP32 Firmware for Multi-Tap Water Dispenser
jobs.description:
I have an MQTT backend and basic ESP32 firmware stub and need an experienced developer to complete/rewrite it into a production-ready solution.

Hardware: ESP32 Dev Module, 6× 12V solenoids, 6× YF-S201 flow sensors, MFRC522, MIFARE 1K cards.

Requirements
Accurately dispense user-defined volumes, especially 20L per tap, based on actual flow measurement.
Support all 6 taps simultaneously with non-blocking/real-time firmware.
RFID card authentication and balance deduction.
MQTT price lookup, transaction publishing and balance reconciliation.
Automatic offline mode with encrypted local card balances and pending transactions.
Automatically sync transactions when connectivity returns.
Reliable handling of reboot, Wi-Fi/MQTT disconnection and power interruption.
Configurable tap calibration, pricing, GPIOs, MQTT credentials, etc.
Deliverables
Complete buildable ESP-IDF or Arduino-ESP32 source code
Wiring diagram for flow sensors, solenoids/drivers and MFRC522
Short README for flashing, configuration, calibration and testing
Working demonstration on my current ESP32 development board.

I will provide the existing MQTT topic/payload structure.

Looking for someone experienced with ESP32, MQTT, RFID, flow sensors and concurrent/non-blocking firmware.

jobs.title: Shopify E-Commerce Store Setup
jobs.description:
I’m building an online store and have settled on Shopify as the platform. I’d like a developer who can take my early-stage concept and turn it into a fully functioning e-commerce site that’s ready for customers, payments and marketing from day one.  

Here’s what I already know and where I still need your expertise:

• Platform & hosting: Shopify (no headless set-up needed at this stage).  
• Core objective: a clean, conversion-focused storefront that lets me list products, accept secure payments, and manage orders in one dashboard.  
• Theme direction: modern, mobile-first and lightweight. I haven’t locked in a specific theme, so feel free to recommend a premium or custom option that matches these guidelines.  
• Design assets: brand logo, colour palette and initial product photography are ready; I’ll supply them all in organised folders.  
• Products: an initial catalogue of 25 – 30 physical items, each with 3-5 variants. I will provide titles, descriptions and pricing in CSV; you can advise on the best import workflow.  
• Payments & shipping: Stripe, PayPal and Shopify Payments for checkout; real-time carrier rates for domestic shipping and flat-rate for international.  

Where I need you to add the missing pieces:

• Technical: optimise site speed, implement structured data, set up tax rules and automate order notifications.  
• Logistical: advise on fulfilment app integrations, inventory tracking and a scalable SKU naming convention.  
• Content: create the essential policy pages (privacy, returns, shipping), refine product copy for consistency, and configure email templates to match the brand voice.  

If you see opportunities for proven add-ons—such as product filtering, customer reviews or a wishlist function—please outline the pros, cons and any additional costs before implementation so I can decide.  

Deliverables I’ll use for acceptance:

1. Live Shopify store on my domain with the above functionality fully tested on desktop and mobile.  
2. Theme and code handed over via Shopify’s built-in theme transfer with no residual unpublished edits.  
3. A brief hand-off document (or Loom video) covering store settings, how to update products and where to find key analytics.  

I’m ready to begin as soon as we agree on milestones and timelines.

jobs.title: Manual Vector Tracing for Luxury Leather Brand Logo

jobs.title: Publish Three AI Research Articles

Here is what I expect from you:

• Select appropriate journals, manage the submission process, handle peer-review revisions, and push each manuscript through to final acceptance.

Acceptance criteria  
1. Three distinct AI research articles published in reputable journals indexed by Scopus, Web of Science, or equivalent.  
2. A live DOI and citation details for each.  
3. All source files (Word/LaTeX, figures, supplementary data) returned to me upon completion.

If you already have experience placing AI papers, navigating reviewer comments, and negotiating APCs or waiver options where needed, let’s talk.

jobs.title: Comprehensive Functional & UI Testing
jobs.description:

jobs.title: RV Mobile Spa Interior Redesign
jobs.description:

I’ll be hands-on during reviews, so clear communication and the ability to tweak quickly are important. If you’ve designed boutique spas, wellness trailers or tiny homes before, let’s talk about timelines and your process.

jobs.title: Engaging Social Media Graphics Needed

I value clear communication and quick iteration; expect feedback rounds until each post feels polished and on-brand. Let’s create scroll-stopping visuals together.

jobs.title: Android Photo Enhancement MVP
jobs.description:
I’m building a lean Android proof-of-concept that upscales and enhances photos with AI, then lets the user keep or share the result.

Core user flow  
1. First-time launch: the user enters a phone number, receives an SMS OTP, and confirms it.  
2. After verification, the user chooses an image either from the device gallery or by importing from a cloud drive via the Storage Access Framework.  
3. The photo is uploaded to an AI enhancement endpoint, processed, and the improved version is returned with progress feedback.  
4. The user can immediately download the file to local storage or share it through the native Android share sheet.

Mandatory implementation details  
• Kotlin (preferred) or Java using a clean, easily extensible MVP/MVVM structure.  
• All sensitive actions (storage, network, phone state if needed for OTP) must rely on Android’s runtime permission prompts, requested only at the precise moment of use.  
• SMS OTP is the sole verification method; the backend you build should handle token generation, expiry, resend limits, and basic user bookkeeping.  
• Integrate a single AI-based enhancement technique (e.g., Real-ESRGAN, Remini API, or a custom model you host) – no other filters are required for this milestone.  
• Include a lightweight admin panel (even a simple web page) that lists users, their processed image count, and allows manual OTP resend.  

Deliverables  
• Full Android Studio project, well-commented, ready to compile on API 26+.  
• Backend code (Node, Python, or similar) with README covering deployment and API keys for SMS and AI services.  
• Admin panel source.  
• A short setup guide plus test credentials so I can walk through the flow end-to-end.

Success is a build I can sideload, verify by SMS, pick or import a photo, watch it get AI-enhanced, and save or share— all while every permission request is transparent and confined to its stated purpose.

jobs.title: Multiplayer Okey/Rummikub Mobile Game
jobs.description:
I’m building a mobile version of the classic tile-based game (Okey / Rummikub style) and need an experienced Unity developer who can take it from prototype to App Store and Google Play release.

Core gameplay
The match must run in real-time, not turn-by-turn, so players see each move as it happens. All core rules, tile shuffling, jokers, melding, and scoring need to mirror the traditional tabletop experience.

Cross-platform multiplayer
A single, shared server is essential—players on iOS and Android should sit at the same virtual table. I’m open to Photon, Unity Netcode, or another proven networking stack as long as latency stays low and reconnections are handled gracefully.

Social layer
A built-in friends list with the ability to send and accept invites is required on day one. I don’t need public matchmaking or in-game chat yet, but the architecture should leave room to add those later without rewriting core systems.

Art & UI
I can supply basic tile and table graphics if you prefer to focus on code, but if you have UI/UX strengths it’s a plus. The end result should feel polished on phones and tablets in both portrait and landscape.

Deliverables
• Complete Unity project with clean, well-commented C# scripts  
• Working iOS (.ipa) and Android (.aab) builds ready for TestFlight / internal testing  
• Short setup guide covering server configuration, third-party SDK keys, and build steps  

If you’ve shipped a real-time multiplayer mobile title before—especially a card or board game—please share a link or APK. I’m ready to start as soon as I find the right fit.

jobs.title: EN-IT to PT-GR Translation
jobs.description:
I regularly work with dense, idea-rich material—primarily political-science papers, though philosophy, sociology, and the occasional human-physiology text also land on my desk. These documents arrive in both English and Italian, and I need them rendered just as precisely into Portuguese and Greek; on other occasions, the direction is reversed.  

Every piece must read naturally to lay readers while still satisfying an academic audience that scrutinises terminology and nuance. That means native-level flow, accurate technical vocabulary, and preservation of subtle argumentative shades. Any references, citations, or specialist terms have to stay intact and compliant with common academic style guides in the target languages.  

Deliverables  
• Final translation in an editable file (DOCX or Google Docs)  
• Optional CAT-tool export if you work with Trados, MemoQ, or similar  
• Brief terminology sheet for key political-science concepts  

Acceptance criteria  
• 100 % meaning retention with no false cognates or gloss loss  
• Tone appropriate for both peer-review journals and general readers  
• Consistent, audience-specific localisation across all sections  

If this aligns with your expertise in EN/IT ↔ PT/GR translation, I’m ready to share the first batch of texts.

jobs.title: English Writing Skills Guidance
jobs.description:
I’m Nadish from Malerkotla, Punjab, and I’ve just finished my senior-secondary studies. The next step on my academic journey is to strengthen my command of English—specifically, my writing skills—through targeted educational consultation.

Here’s what I need from you:  
• A clear, step-by-step study plan that suits my current level and goals.  
• Regular feedback on short writing assignments so I can see measurable progress.  
• Recommendations for approachable resources (books, articles, online exercises) that focus on structure, vocabulary, and coherence.  
• Tips on how to practise daily and track improvements, even outside our sessions.

I’m available to meet online and can adjust my schedule to fit mutually convenient times. If you have a proven record of helping students refine their English writing, let’s begin right away so I can move confidently into higher studies and future career opportunities.

jobs.title: Modern Disability Association Logo Design
jobs.description:
I’m rebranding our business association within the disability sector and need a fresh, modern logo that instantly communicates collaboration, trust, unity, inclusion, and support. The primary visual cue must be a clean handshake motif—sleek, minimalistic, yet still recognizable—set in a blue-and-green palette.   

Acceptance criteria:  
• Versatile, contemporary composition featuring a handshake as the central element.  
• Colour variants: full colour (blue/green), single-colour, and reverse/white-out.  
• File package: editable vector (.AI, .EPS), high-res PNG, SVG, and a print-ready PDF.  
• Clear space and minimum-size guidelines included in a brief style sheet.  

I’ll review initial sketches, choose one direction, then request two revision rounds before final sign-off.

jobs.title: Experienced Content Writer Needed
jobs.description:
I’m looking for a dependable writer who can jump in quickly and craft clear, engaging copy on an ongoing basis. Assignments will vary in length and format, but every piece must be well-researched, original, and ready for publication without heavy editing.

Here’s how we’ll work together: I’ll share a brief outlining the target audience, angle, and key points. You’ll return a polished draft that follows the brief, uses credible sources, and flows naturally. Familiarity with basic SEO principles—keyword placement, compelling headings, and meta descriptions—is appreciated, though not mandatory.

Turnaround times are flexible but typically fall between three and five days per assignment. I value open communication, so let me know early if a deadline needs adjusting. All content should pass plagiarism checks and be free of AI-generated fluff; a human, conversational tone is essential.

If you have a strong command of English, a knack for simplifying complex ideas, and a portfolio that demonstrates versatility, I’d love to see your work samples and discuss the first piece.

jobs.title: Windows Service Sales Tracker
jobs.description:
I need a Windows desktop application that streamlines the entire sales cycle for my service-based business. Its core purpose is business productivity: recording each service sale, tracking its status, and giving me a clear picture of revenue in real time.

Key workflow
• Enter a new client or select an existing one.
• Add the service sold, agreed price, delivery date, and payment terms.
• Update progress notes and mark jobs as completed or invoiced.
• Generate simple reports (daily, weekly, monthly) showing total sales, outstanding balances, and top-selling services.

Essential requirements
• Runs on current Windows versions without additional installs.
• Clean, intuitive UI built with any stable framework you prefer (WinForms, WPF, Electron, etc.) as long as it launches quickly and feels lightweight.
• Local data storage is fine—SQLite or another embedded option works—provided it can be easily backed up or exported to CSV.
• Source code delivered, well commented, so future tweaks are straightforward.

Acceptance criteria
1. I can install the app, enter a sale, edit it, and see the change reflected in a summary report without errors.
2. Reports export successfully to both PDF and CSV.
3. Application launches in under five seconds on a standard office PC.

Please include a rough timeline for each milestone (initial prototype, feature-complete build, final polish) with your proposal.

jobs.title: Academic Papers Editing
jobs.description:
I have three research manuscripts that were initially drafted with AI assistance and now need a thorough human overhaul before journal submission. Each week, I will share one paper (≈5,000–7,000 words). Your task is to transform each draft into a polished, formally academic article that will clear Turnitin without triggering AI-generated text flags. Your quote should be based on editing all three papers. 

The work must centre on:
• Grammar and syntax – eliminate awkward phrasing and errors.  
• Structure and flow – reorganise content where necessary so arguments unfold logically.  
• Accuracy and content – verify claims, tighten arguments, and flag any sections that need additional citations or clarification.  
• No AI writing – the final prose should read naturally, reflecting an authentic scholarly voice.

Deliverables for every paper:
1. A clean, publication-ready manuscript in Word.  
2. A tracked-changes file showing all edits and rewrites.  
3. A brief editorial note (≈300 words) explaining major structural or content adjustments.  
4. Confirmation that the document passes a Turnitin originality check.

I expect a one-week turnaround per paper once files are provided. Familiarity with common academic style guides (APA, MLA, or Chicago, as appropriate) and experience editing peer-reviewed work are essential. If you can demonstrate prior success in preparing manuscripts for reputable journals, I’m keen to collaborate.

jobs.title: Conference Note Takers Needed
jobs.description:
Two onsite note takers are required in Singapore on 7–8 October (full-day coverage each day) for a professional conference. The task is to capture everything the speakers present, not just a summary or key points. Accuracy, speed, and an ear for technical terminology are essential because the notes will serve as our internal reference after the event. I will provide the session agenda in advance; seating near the AV desk with power outlets and Wi-Fi will be arranged.

Deliverables  
• Complete, well-formatted transcripts of every talk and panel, organised by session and time stamp, returned in editable Word or Google Docs by 10 a.m. the following morning.  
• A single consolidated file at the end of Day 2 that merges both days, clearly sectioned for quick lookup.

Acceptance Criteria  
• No gaps longer than 30 seconds in any talk.  
• Speaker names, slide titles, and audience questions captured verbatim.  
• Proof-read for spelling and obvious homophone errors before submission.

Please be comfortable working quietly in the room, bringing your own laptop and preferred typing or shorthand tools. Confidentiality is paramount; all material remains internal and must not be shared elsewhere.

jobs.title: Patrones de Pijamas de Bebé
jobs.description:
Busco un patronista con experiencia en ropa infantil para desarrollar un patrón profesional de pijamas enterizas para bebés de 0-24 meses. 

Lo que necesito:
• Patrón base graduado en las tallas clave dentro del rango 0-2 años.  
• Ficha técnica clara con medidas, márgenes de costura y recomendaciones de tela (algodón suave, punto interlock u opciones similares).  
• Instrucciones de confección paso a paso que un taller pueda seguir sin dudas.

Valoraré que utilices software de patronaje digital (Gerber, Optitex, CLO o equivalente) y entregues los archivos en formatos listos para impresión (PDF/A0) junto con el archivo editable. Si tienes propuestas para optimizar comodidad y seguridad —por ejemplo broches libres de níquel o costuras planas— menciónalas.

Espero un resultado que pueda pasar directamente a prototipo; revisaré encaje y proporciones sobre maniquí infantil antes de dar la aprobación final.

jobs.title: Voiceover Artist for Hindi Horror YouTube Channel
jobs.description:

We are starting a YouTube horror animation/storytelling channel focused on Indian horror stories, folk horror, supernatural incidents, mysteries, and scary fictional stories.

- Ability to create fear, suspense, tension, and emotion through voice

jobs.title: YouTube & Reels Video Editing
jobs.description:
I produce short-form content for both YouTube and Instagram Reels and want each clip (typically 1–5 minutes) polished to an engaging, scroll-stopping finish. I already record the footage; what I need is an editor who can take the raw files and:

• Trim out stumbles and dead space  
• Add clean, stylish transitions that suit the pacing of each platform  
• Insert on-brand captions, lower thirds, and occasional motion graphics  
• Balance and enhance audio so speech is crisp and background music sits comfortably  
• Apply consistent colour correction / grading so the final export looks great in 1080p or 4K

Premiere Pro is my preferred tool, so you’ll need solid proficiency there (After Effects skills for graphics are a plus). Please link to a portfolio that shows similar social-media work and let me know your typical turnaround time per video. Meeting agreed deadlines is essential; I batch-record and will send several clips at once.

When we wrap, I expect the project file, any custom graphics templates, and the mastered MP4s ready for immediate upload. If that sounds like a workflow you can nail, I’m ready to start.

jobs.title: High-Risk Payment Gateway Workaround
jobs.description:
My site, sponsorglobal.ai, is classed as high-risk, so PayPal, Stripe, and Square have already declined a direct merchant account. I need a developer who has successfully routed payments for similar businesses by placing a low-risk “front” website between Stripe and the original high-risk site.

Here’s the flow I’m after:  
1. Customer begins checkout on sponsorglobal.ai.  
2. They are silently redirected (or presented with an iFrame/hosted page) on a separate, low-risk domain that can pass Stripe’s underwriting.  
3. Stripe processes the charge on that front site.  
4. A webhook or secure token sends the confirmation back so the order is finalized on sponsorglobal.ai without exposing the customer to any extra steps.  

If you have hands-on experience with:  
• Stripe Connect / Custom Accounts  
• Tokenized redirects, secure webhooks, PCI-compliant server-to-server calls  
• Fraud and chargeback mitigation for high-risk merchants  

…and can deliver a working integration fast, please tell me how you solved a comparable case before. Start your bid with the words “SMM Panel” so I know you read this.  

I’m ready to move ASAP and will provide access to both domains the moment you’re onboard.

jobs.title: English-Speaking Commentator for U20 Games – Remote
jobs.description: We are looking for an English-speaking commentator for our U20 ice hockey games in Finland. Professional broadcasting experience is not required. jobs.title: Set Up Multiplatform Seller Accounts

I’m ready to start as soon as you outline your process and timeline.

jobs.title: Realistic 3D Combatant Characters
jobs.description:
Five playable fighters—three warriors clad in heavy armor and two agile archers—must be modeled in a fully realistic, high-detail style. Each character needs a complete body mesh, form-fitting outfit, and signature weapons or accessories that read clearly in close-up cinematics as well as mid-distance gameplay shots.  

The assets have to be game-ready: clean topology, efficient but high-quality poly counts, UVs laid out logically, and PBR texture sets in 4 K (Base Color, Normal, Roughness, Metallic/AO). All meshes should import seamlessly into Unreal Engine or Unity without scale or orientation issues.

I have set aside a total of $2,000 and a six-week window; I’ll split that budget across milestones for block-out, high-poly sculpt, retopo/UV, texturing, and final polish so feedback can stay quick and focused. 

Deliverables (per character)  
• Final rig-ready .fbx (or .blend)  
• 4 K texture folders, clearly named  
• Turntable or Marmoset viewer render for quick review  

Approval will be based on likeness to provided concept art, adherence to realistic proportions, and zero visible artifacts at native camera distance in-engine. If this fits your pipeline, let’s get started—concept sheets are ready to hand off immediately.

jobs.title: Fire-Damaged Home Structural Assessment

jobs.title: B2B B2C Software Lead Generation & Sales

jobs.title: Aerospace Engineering Enthusiast for Simulation Project
jobs.description:
# Aerospace Engineering Contributors Wanted – Simulations, Design & Technical Projects

## About the Project

I am building an aerospace engineering-focused YouTube channel and online community dedicated to **practical aerospace engineering, aircraft/propulsion design, simulations, and engineering software**.

I am looking for aerospace engineers, mechanical engineers, CFD engineers, propulsion engineers, aircraft designers, and engineering students who would like to **showcase their technical work to a growing aerospace audience**.

The goal is to create a community where engineers can share interesting engineering projects, learn from each other, and potentially generate additional income from their technical work.

## What I Am Looking For

You can submit an original aerospace engineering project such as:

* Aircraft design
* Aerodynamics
* CFD simulations
* Aircraft performance analysis
* Propulsion / jet engine design
* Turbomachinery
* Turbojet / turbofan simulations
* Rocket propulsion
* Combustion simulations
* Structural analysis / FEA
* Flight dynamics
* 6-DOF simulations
* Control systems
* MATLAB / Simulink projects
* Python engineering simulations
* CAD aircraft components
* Optimization studies
* UAV / drone design
* Experimental aircraft concepts
* Other interesting aerospace engineering projects

The project should demonstrate **real engineering work**, rather than simply being a theoretical presentation.

## What You Should Submit

For each project, I would like:

1. **A video showing you working on the project**

   * Screen recording of your software
   * Explain what you are doing
   * Explain the engineering principles behind the project
   * Show the simulation/design/results
   * Voice-over is preferred, but we can discuss alternatives.

2. **The engineering files**

   * MATLAB `.m` files
   * Simulink `.slx` files
   * Python code
   * CAD files
   * CFD files
   * ANSYS/Fluent/CFX files
   * Excel calculations
   * Other relevant project files

3. **A short description**

   * What was designed/simulated
   * Engineering objective
   * Software used
   * Main assumptions
   * Main results
   * Any interesting engineering conclusions

## Important

**All submitted work must be your own original work**, or you must have the necessary rights to submit it.

Do not submit proprietary, confidential, employer-owned, university-restricted, export-controlled, or otherwise restricted engineering material.

You must also have the right to provide the code/files and allow them to be used for the agreed project.

## Payment & Gumroad

Selected projects may be turned into educational aerospace engineering content for the YouTube channel and community.

Where appropriate, the accompanying **code, simulation files, CAD files, templates, or engineering resources may be offered through Gumroad as paid digital engineering resources**.

The engineer who created the project will receive an **agreed payment/revenue share for eligible projects**, with the exact arrangement agreed before the work is accepted.

Payment will depend on factors such as:

* Technical quality
* Complexity of the engineering work
* Quality of the explanation/video
* Usefulness of the files
* Originality
* Educational value
* Potential interest to the aerospace engineering community

## Who I Want

I am especially interested in engineers who can **actually build and demonstrate engineering simulations**, rather than simply writing about them.

You do not need to be a professional aerospace engineer. Students, graduates, researchers, freelancers, and experienced engineers are welcome if you can demonstrate genuine technical ability.

Good candidates might have experience with:

**MATLAB / Simulink | Python | ANSYS | Fluent | CFX | OpenFOAM | CATIA | SolidWorks | Fusion 360 | CAD | CFD | FEA | Flight Dynamics | Propulsion | Turbomachinery | Aerodynamics | Control Systems**

## Example Projects

Some examples of projects that would be particularly interesting:

* "Designing a Turbojet Engine in MATLAB"
* "3D Axial Compressor Mean-Line Design"
* "CFD Analysis of a Supersonic Aircraft Intake"
* "6-DOF Rocket Flight Simulation"
* "Designing a Fighter Aircraft Wing"
* "MATLAB Aircraft Performance Simulation"
* "Turbofan Engine Off-Design Simulation"
* "CFD Optimization of an Aircraft Wing"
* "Rocket Nozzle Design and Analysis"
* "Aircraft Stability & Control Simulation"
* "UAV Concept Design and Performance Analysis"

## Why Join?

This is an opportunity to:

* Showcase your engineering skills
* Have your work presented to an aerospace audience
* Build your engineering portfolio
* Reach potential clients/employers
* Earn money from your technical work
* Help grow an online aerospace engineering community
* Collaborate with other engineers and aerospace enthusiasts

## How to Apply

jobs.title: Runway LED PCB & Firmware
jobs.description:
This project covers the full design cycle for an outdoor runway light: electronic schematic, PCB layout, and embedded firmware. The board must drive a high-brightness LED array and interface with a constant-current regulator that delivers 6.6 A, the standard airfield CCR level.  

Core requirements  
• Reliable 6.6 A current handling without flicker or thermal runaway  
• Weather-proof component selection and track spacing suitable for open-field installation  
• Firmware that recognises and responds to CCR step changes so the lamp can track the mandated brightness levels (typically 6-step dimming)  

Typical workflow  
1. Confirm LED string voltage/current profile and heat dissipation model  
2. Produce schematic and PCB (Altium or KiCad preferred; four-layer board expected)  
3. Develop and document firmware (C/C++ on an MCU of your choice, e.g., STM32 or PIC) that samples the CCR waveform and PWM-dims the LEDs accordingly  
4. Provide gerbers, BOM with manufacturer part numbers, compiled firmware, and source code  

Acceptance  
I will review the design files for compliance with the 6.6 A CCR interface and outdoor durability, then test a prototype for brightness stability across all CCR steps. Payment releases once those checks pass and firmware sources compile without warnings.

Required surrounding engine-bay components.
Wires, hoses and other relevant visible details.
Realistic materials applied to all components.

Hi, I’m from Pakistan. My father’s business is focused on producing high-quality edible Himalayan salt. We extract salt from our own mines and also operate salt processing plants/industries where we refine it into iodized edible salt.

Currently, we supply salt across Pakistan to various major food companies, which sell it under their own brands. We also work with exporters who purchase our salt in bulk and export it to international markets.

We produce several types of salt, including:

* Edible salt (iodized and non-iodized)
* Himalayan pink salt (fine and coarse)
* Salt lamps
* Industrial and livestock salt

Our main challenge is that we do not currently have enough knowledge or experience with international exporting. We want to understand and establish the complete process of exporting our products from Pakistan, including:

* Export registration and legal requirements
* Required documents, certifications, and licenses
* Food safety and international compliance requirements
* Proper packaging and labeling for international markets
* Shipping, customs, and logistics
* Finding and connecting with genuine international buyers/importers
* Payment methods and reducing the risk of fraud
* Identifying the most suitable international markets for our products

We are looking for an experienced export consultant or specialist who can guide us through the complete process and help us establish a proper system for exporting our salt internationally.

We are also open to a **long-term business partnership** with someone who has strong experience in international sales, export business, e-commerce, or B2B marketplaces.

### Partnership Opportunity

If someone is interested in working with us as a business partner rather than only as a consultant, we are open to discussing a partnership arrangement.

Our side would be responsible for:

* Providing the salt and other products
* Managing production and processing
* Providing the required product quantities
* Handling product quality and supply
* Providing product information, samples, photos, and other necessary materials
* Managing the local/Pakistan-side operations

The partner's main responsibility would be to:

* Build and manage the online/international sales platform
* Find genuine international buyers and importers
* Generate export leads
* Handle international customer communication and business development
* Help manage the export sales process
* Develop international markets for our products

The exact partnership structure, responsibilities, and profit-sharing arrangement can be discussed and agreed upon based on the partner's experience and contribution.

We are currently operating offline and supplying customers across Pakistan, and we now want to expand into international markets.

If you are interested, please mention your previous experience with **Pakistan-based exports, international B2B sales, Himalayan salt, food products, or similar businesses**. If you are interested in a partnership, please also explain how you would approach building the international market for our products.

We are looking for someone who can either **guide us through the export process professionally or potentially become a long-term business partner**.

MISSION TITLE
PCB design / layout for a DIY solar tracker (ESP32 mainboard)

PROJECT DESCRIPTION

I'm developing a solar tracker (2-axis, azimuth + tilt) controlled by an ESP32, with a touch TFT screen, SD card, RTC, angle sensors, control of 2 DC motors (azimuth/tilt), management of 48V/24V power rails, and various sensors (wind, LDR, battery voltage, temperature, gyroscope).

The firmware is already developed and functional (Arduino/ESP32 code). A KiCad library of the modules used has already been prepared (schematics + footprints + 3D renders per module). The full GPIO/I2C mapping is documented and ready to share.

I'm looking for a freelancer to design the complete electronic schematic and route the PCB (main board, built around the ESP32), based on the material already provided.

WHAT IS ALREADY PROVIDED
- KiCad library of the modules (schematic + footprint + 3D per block)
- Full GPIO / SPI bus / I2C bus mapping (2 separate I2C buses, addresses documented)
- Design rules to follow (placement of heat-emitting modules, default 2.54mm pin-header connections, 2.54mm screw terminals if needed, silkscreen mirroring if a module is flipped)
- Already validated list of peripherals and functions

TECHNICAL OVERVIEW (summary, full detail provided to the selected freelancer)
- MCU: ESP32 (DevKit)
- Shared SPI bus: TFT screen + SD card (dedicated CS lines)
- Capacitive touch TFT screen (ST7796S controller + FT6336U touch)
- 2 separate I2C buses (Wire / Wire1) carrying: DS1307 RTC + EEPROM, dedicated settings EEPROM, MCP23017 (48V/24V rail relays), PCA9685 (motor PWM + backlight + enclosure fan/heater), 2x AS5600 angle sensor (azimuth/tilt), 3x ADS1115 analog-to-digital converter (4x LDR, battery voltage, anemometer, analog fallbacks), MPU6050 gyroscope, PN532 NFC module
- 2 DC motors driven via BTS7960 drivers (enable signals on native GPIOs)
- 48V and 24V power rail management (relay switching)
- DS18B20 temperature probe (OneWire)
- Rotary encoder (menu navigation)

EXPECTED SCOPE OF WORK
- Review/validation of the electronic schematic based on the provided modules
- Full PCB layout (mainboard)
- Delivery as complete blocks (schematic + footprint + 3D) as already done for the existing library
- Manufacturing files (Gerber, BOM, drill file)
- Complete KiCad project delivered

jobs.title: On-Demand Freelance Solicitor for Retail Business
jobs.description:
Freelance Solicitor - On-Call Commercial and Compliance Support

About the client

A UK retail business selling through online marketplaces and direct channels. The client has an in-house legal and compliance team and is looking for a practising solicitor to provide quick second opinions when they are unavailable.

The role

A practising solicitor to provide short-turnaround advice on a freelance basis, alongside the existing team rather than in place of it.

This is not a role that requires drafting long documents or running matters end to end. It is a second opinion and a sounding board: a short question, a considered answer, usually within a working day. Typical questions run to a few paragraphs of context and need a clear view on where the client stands and what the options are.

Areas to be covered

- Contracts and commercial. Platform terms and merchant agreements, supplier and distribution agreements, addenda and variations, intercompany arrangements between UK and US entities.
- Data protection and compliance. UK GDPR in a B2B context, handling of commercially sensitive and personal data in third-party requests, retention and transfer questions.
- Consumer and regulatory. DMCCA 2025, review and ratings compliance, advertising and pricing claims, distance selling.

What a typical instruction looks like

- A counterparty has not performed obligations under an agreement. Is this a breach, and what are the options?
- A promotional structure is proposed. Does the pricing presentation comply with current guidance?
- Review of a short clause or a proposed variation before signature.

What we are looking for

- Qualified and currently practising in England and Wales, with valid professional indemnity insurance.
- Commercial judgement over exhaustive analysis. A clear view on where the client stands and what the realistic options are, including when a point is not worth pursuing.
- Comfortable giving a provisional view quickly, and clear about when a question needs fuller work.
- Experience of e-commerce, marketplaces or reseller arrangements is an advantage.

Engagement

Open to proposals on structure. A small monthly retainer with an agreed response time, or an ad hoc hourly arrangement, would both be considered. Please indicate your rates, typical availability and turnaround.

Volume is likely to be light and intermittent, concentrated around contract negotiations and periods of higher trading activity.

jobs.title: Develop DarkSword-RCE Security Toolkit

3. Proof-of-concept exploits covering recent iOS versions (research notes provided).  
4. Live monitoring dashboards that track file, process, and network events and export to JSON.  
5. Build scripts and documentation for painless setup, updating, and distribution.

Acceptance criteria
• Source compiles cleanly with current Xcode and clang toolchains.  
• Clear, versioned APIs between modules—no hard-coded paths or secrets.  
• Exploit code gated behind feature flags to avoid accidental triggers.  
• A test suite that walks through reverse-engineering and monitoring on the latest public iOS release.

If you’ve shipped jailbreak-level code, ported exploits across iOS versions, or built LLDB/Ghidra plugins, let me know which parts of the stack you can own and share links or repos that demonstrate it.

jobs.title: Senior Unreal Engine MMO Multiplayer & Dedicated-Server Architect
jobs.description:
I am hiring one highly experienced Unreal Engine developer to build the production-quality Unreal client and dedicated-server foundation for a persistent PC MMO.

Goal

The finished platform must support at least 1,000,000 concurrent players in one shared persistent universe, distributed across many dedicated servers. One million is the minimum operating target, not the ceiling. The architecture must expand to tens of millions or more by adding servers, backend capacity, databases, and machines without rebuilding the Unreal multiplayer foundation.

This contract covers the Unreal client and game-server layer. Production accounts, databases, orchestration, and infrastructure will be operated locally and developed later. The Unreal systems must provide replaceable interfaces for them.

Environment and workload

* Unreal Engine 5.7 source build, PC
* C++ foundation; Blueprints where appropriate
* Headless, strictly authoritative dedicated servers
* Perforce, using a development stream of the real main project
* Initial target: at least 100 concurrent players per server, verified by profiling
* One developer; estimated 450–900 hours

World/server topology

The universe contains:

1. Open-space zones
2. Solar systems
3. Planetary-orbit regions
4. Planetary surface regions

Each is a logical region capable of being divided among multiple adjoining server subdivisions. A logical region, subdivision, running server process, and physical machine must be treated as separate concepts. Gameplay cannot permanently bind a region to one process, address, machine, or fixed server count.

Development and alpha will use only a few servers within each region type, but they must use the production-intended expandable structure. More regions and subdivisions must be addable through configuration as population or simulation load grows.

Required architecture

* No hard-coded global population, region, subdivision, or server limit
* No assumption that one region always uses one server
* Stable global IDs for players and persistent entities across servers and restarts
* No permanent data existing only inside a map or server process
* No single game-server process coordinating the entire universe
* No requirement for every server to communicate directly with every other server
* No hard-coded addresses or machine assignments
* Versioned player/world data suitable for future migrations
* Spatial relevancy and interest management so clients receive only nearby/relevant state
* Configurable replication and server capacities
* Servers authoritative over spawning, movement, inventory, currency, progression, ownership, travel, and other important outcomes
* Persistent regions capable of saving, restoring, restarting, and continuing simulation while empty, subject to future optimization

Travel and handoff

Players must travel between subdivisions of the same region and through this hierarchy:

Planetary surface → orbit → solar system → open space → another solar system.

Controlled loading or reconnect handoffs are acceptable. Every transfer must preserve the same player and character identity and authorized test data, including location, inventory, progression, ownership, faction, and currency.

The system must prevent duplicate characters, lost data, conflicting server ownership, rollback exploits, and simultaneous activity on two servers. It must safely handle retries, timeouts, disconnects, crashes, and unavailable destinations, then reconnect players to the correct region and subdivision.

Define how NPCs, vehicles, possessions, and other authorized persistent entities cross boundaries when required, and how visibility, interaction, movement, combat, and authority operate near boundaries.

Future-backend interfaces

Provide documented, replaceable interfaces for:

* Authentication, accounts, and character identity
* Player and world persistence
* Server registry, discovery, assignment, capacity, and health
* Region/subdivision configuration and orchestration
* Transfer authorization and reconnection routing
* Global factions, ownership, economy, communication, and world events
* Administration, monitoring, and logging

Temporary Unreal-only services may be used for alpha, but gameplay cannot depend directly on them. Identify every temporary component and explain exactly how the future backend replaces it.

Pre-implementation design

Before major implementation, submit an architecture for approval explaining:

1. Client, game-server, and future-backend responsibilities.
2. The four region types and their multi-server subdivisions.
3. Boundaries, entity authority, travel, transfer, reconnection, and failure recovery.
4. Data-loss and duplication prevention.
5. Adding regions, subdivisions, processes, and machines.
6. Handling overcrowded areas and population surges.
7. Scaling from 1 million to tens of millions of concurrent players.
8. Temporary alpha systems, backend integration points, risks, limitations, and unproven assumptions.

Capacity plan

Profile one server and document safe player capacity, CPU, memory, bandwidth, and simulation assumptions. Estimate game-server and infrastructure requirements at 1 million, 10 million, and 50 million concurrent players, including reserve capacity for failures, maintenance, surges, and uneven populations.

Identify bottlenecks, Unreal limitations, overcrowding strategy, and how each bottleneck can be partitioned, expanded, replicated, or replaced. Capacity must be retested as AI, vehicles, combat, and world complexity are added.

For planning only, 100 players per server would require about 10,000 active servers for 1 million players, 100,000 for 10 million, and 500,000 for 50 million. Actual capacity must be established through profiling.

Required alpha demonstration

* Packaged clients and headless servers operating outside the Editor
* Representative open-space, solar-system, orbital, and planetary regions
* Multiple server processes within representative logical regions
* Travel through all region types and between subdivisions of one region
* Identity and test data preserved through every transfer
* Recovery from an interrupted transfer and unavailable destination
* Reconnection to the correct subdivision after closing the client
* Protection against character/inventory duplication
* Server restart without permanent loss of test data
* New region or subdivision added through configuration without rewriting gameplay
* Clear connection, assignment, transfer, save, failure, disconnect, and reconnect logs
* Automated simulated clients where practical, load testing, and profiling results

Deliverables

* Approved architecture and capacity plans
* Complete C++ source, required Blueprints, server targets, and build configuration
* Configurable region/subdivision system
* Multi-server connection, travel, retry, recovery, and duplicate-prevention systems
* Temporary persistence and backend interfaces
* Packaged client/server builds and practical automated tests
* Profiling and load-test results
* Setup, build, launch, test, maintenance, and handover documentation
* Known limitations, temporary components, and future-backend requirements
* All files submitted to Perforce in frequent, clearly described changelists

Acceptance

The work is not accepted merely because a small test works or is called scalable. Acceptance requires packaged multi-server demonstrations, reliable travel and recovery, preserved identity/data, configurable expansion, profiling, documentation, and clean backend interfaces.

The Unreal-only phase cannot prove million-player operation without the production backend and infrastructure. It must demonstrate a credible route to 1 million, expansion to tens of millions, and no known fixed global ceiling requiring reconstruction.

Out of scope unless separately approved: production backend/databases, infrastructure/orchestration, final gameplay/combat/AI/art, production anti-cheat, final economy/chat, live operations, million-player deployment, and full-scale load testing.

Required experience

Advanced Unreal C++, dedicated servers, authoritative networking, replication/relevancy, multi-server architecture, cross-process player handoff, persistent identity, failure recovery, backend-interface design, load testing, Perforce, and technical documentation. MMO or distributed-game experience is strongly preferred.

When applying, answer:

1. What comparable production systems have you personally built?
2. Have you implemented player handoff or divided one logical region among multiple servers?
3. How would you structure these four region types and their boundaries?
4. How would you prevent duplication/data loss and separate Unreal from the future backend?
5. How would this expand from 1 million to tens of millions?
6. What cannot be proven until the backend exists, and what Unreal risks do you anticipate?
7. Provide estimated hours, milestones, rate, availability, portfolio evidence, and references.

Ordinary lobby multiplayer, listen-server, basic-replication, or Blueprint-only experience is insufficient.

jobs.title: Drive Real Sales for Cavenor
jobs.description:

I’m ready to hand the reins to a marketer who cares about revenue, not vanity numbers.

Here’s the challenge  
• Audit what I have in place across Instagram, Facebook and my current paid ads. If the funnel, product pages or checkout flow are leaking sales, patch them.  
• Build or fine-tune conversion-driven campaigns—whether that means fresh creatives, tighter audiences, retargeting sequences, or abandoned-cart recovery.  
• Launch an email/SMS system from scratch; I have none in place but see huge potential for post-purchase flows, win-backs and product-launch blasts.  
• Track every dollar: ad spend, cost-per-sale, ROAS, LTV. I want a clear view of what channels and creatives actually generate profit.  
• Report back with hard numbers: total sales, average order value, and any lift in repeat purchases.

Acceptance criteria  
1. Campaign dashboard showing spend vs. revenue, updated weekly.  
2. Email/SMS flows live and generating first sales within 30 days.  
3. Minimum 3× ROAS on paid traffic after the first full month of optimisations.

If you’ve taken a fashion e-commerce brand from clicks to consistent revenue and can prove it, let’s talk results.

jobs.title: Azure Architect for Backend Improvement

- Azure Container Apps and KEDA autoscaling
- Azure Service Bus batching, prefetching, retries, lock renewal, DLQs, and high-throughput consumers
- Python async backend architecture
- Redis/PostgreSQL performance and distributed-workload design
- Azure OpenAI rate limits and resilient request handling
- Bicep/Terraform, monitoring, load testing, and production hardening

Once finished, deliver a fully editable, searchable PDF that reflects the original content but looks ready for submission or printing in an academic setting. If you prefer to draft in Word or LaTeX first, that’s fine so long as the final hand-off is the polished PDF (an accompanying editable file is a bonus). jobs.title: Automate courses workflow with shareponit xero
jobs.description:
