I already have active Xero and Microsoft 365 accounts; what I need is a set of well-structured flows that move data between the two platforms, apply basic business rules, and post the results back to Xero in real time.

Typical touchpoints will include invoices, payments, bank feeds and expense items, but I would like the flow design to stay flexible so additional triggers or actions can be dropped in later without starting from scratch. All steps must use the official Xero connector or REST API endpoints, respect rate limits, and log their activity for quick troubleshooting inside Power Automate.

Deliverables  
• 1–3 reusable cloud flows built in Power Automate and linked to my Xero tenant  
• Connection setup documentation covering API keys, scopes and security best practices  
• A short video or screen share walkthrough that shows the flows running on live sample data  
• Light-weight handover notes so I can extend the solution on my own

Successful completion means I can press “Run” (or rely on the chosen triggers) and watch transactions appear in Xero with no manual import or spreadsheet juggling. If you have previous Power Automate + Xero experience, please mention a similar scenario you automated and any limitations you encountered with the connector so we can plan around them.

jobs.title: Cinematic Music Video Polish

Every frame must match the vocal track perfectly, so I need the lip-sync tightened across the entire video—verses, choruses, ad-libs, everything. In several handheld shots the motion feels distracting; I’d like smooth, cinematic stabilization that removes jitters while preserving a natural camera movement (no plastic “warp-gel” look).

What I need from you now
1. An existing sample of your calm/soft-spoken narration.
2. Your proposed fee and turnaround time for the 30-minute session.
3. Any questions about the scope or technical specs.

Experienced narrators and newcomers looking to build a portfolio are equally welcome—as long as the read feels nurturing and authentic for children's stories. I'm ready to move quickly once I hear the right voice.

By accepting payment for this project, you agree that the recordings will be used to create an AI voice model, used without limitation, worldwide, in perpetuity.

jobs.title: Shopify Dropship Automation SaaS Build
jobs.description:
E-Store Manager

E-Store Manager is a multi-tenant Shopify app designed to automate product discovery, fulfillment, marketing, and customer service for dropshipping stores operating on an Amazon FBA-style fulfillment model — where products are sold on the merchant’s own Shopify storefront but fulfilled and shipped through Amazon’s fulfillment network rather than traditional slow-ship dropshipping.

What it does

Product Discovery
A discovery engine identifies best-selling products within a given niche — surfacing what’s already proven to sell well, rather than speculative bulk-buy bets. It pulls data from:

	•	CJdropshipping — product search, pricing, order creation, and tracking via their API

	•	AutoDS — automated product search/import, with one-way push to Shopify

	•	DSers — AliExpress-sourced catalog, synced through the DSers UI into Shopify

Products are ranked using signals like sales velocity/demand, margin, trend momentum (Google Trends, public TikTok signals), customer rating, and market saturation within the niche — without scraping restricted sources like Amazon bestseller pages. The goal is to tell the merchant “these are the winning products in your niche right now,” so they can decide which to add to their store.

Product Import & Sync
Once a merchant selects products from the discovery results, they’re imported into their Shopify store via the Shopify Admin API, with supplier metadata (source, cost, shipping time) tagged for later routing.

Fulfillment — Amazon FBA Focused
Instead of routing every order back to the original supplier for one-off shipping, the app treats Amazon as the primary fulfillment warehouse.

	•	Merchant-owned inventory that has been shipped into Amazon’s warehouses is fulfilled via the Amazon SP-API (Multi-Channel Fulfillment / MCF) when a Shopify order comes in — Amazon picks, packs, and ships the order using its own logistics network, even though the sale happened on Shopify.

	•	Products not yet stocked at Amazon can fall back to standard supplier-side fulfillment via CJdropshipping/AutoDS/DSers.

	•	The routing layer decides per-order which path to use based on whether FBA stock exists for that SKU.

Marketing
AI-generated marketing copy (product descriptions, ad copy, social posts) is drafted for each product, but always requires human approval before publishing — no autonomous posting.

Customer Service
AI-drafted responses to common customer inquiries (order status, returns, product questions — including FBA-specific questions like Amazon-handled shipping/tracking), again with a human-in-the-loop review step rather than fully autonomous replies.

Multi-Tenancy
The app is built to manage multiple independent Shopify stores from a single instance, with per-store OAuth sessions, isolated data, and separate supplier/FBA inventory configurations for each tenant.

How it works (architecture)

	1. 	Shopify OAuth — each store installs the app and authorizes access; sessions and tokens are stored per-tenant.

	2. 	Discovery Engine — periodically queries supplier APIs and market-signal sources, identifies top-selling products per niche, scores them, and stores candidates for merchant review.

	3. 	Import Layer — approved products are written to Shopify via the Admin API, with supplier source and FBA-stock status tagged in metadata.

	4. 	Order/Fulfillment Webhooks — Shopify order events trigger routing logic: if the SKU has FBA inventory, the order is dispatched to Amazon via SP-API/MCF; otherwise it falls back to supplier dropship fulfillment.

	5. 	Marketing & CS Modules — generate drafts, hold them in a review queue, and only push/send after merchant approval.

	6. 	Data Layer — a relational schema tracks stores, sessions, discovered products (with niche/bestseller signals), imported products, FBA inventory levels, orders, line items, and fulfillment status/source, enabling reporting and reconciliation across tenants.

jobs.title: Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.description:
Site Reliability Engineer (Contract)
Location: India, remoteHours: 09:00–18:00 UK time, Mon–Fri (13:30–22:30 IST summer, 14:30–23:30 IST winter)Experience: 5–6 yearsCloud: Azure and AWS
We run production infrastructure for UK clients during UK office hours, plus out-of-hours support and fixes for US clients. The platform team is two engineers. This is the reliability seat: you own how we know the platform is healthy, how we find out when it isn't, and how fast we recover. Your counterpart owns delivery pipelines, and you cover each other.
We mean SRE in the substantive sense, writing code to remove operational work rather than only operating things. If that isn't how you want to spend your week, the DevOps seat is the better fit.
Technical
Cloud. Strong depth in either Azure or AWS, working knowledge of the other. We don't expect equal depth in both.
AWS: EC2, S3, IAM, Lambda, CloudWatch, VPC, RDS, EKS/ECS
Azure: VMs, Blob Storage, Entra ID/RBAC, Functions, Azure Monitor, VNet, Azure SQL, AKS
Observability. Design and run logging, metrics, tracing and alerting. Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/OpenSearch, Azure Monitor, Datadog or similar. Dashboards that work during an incident, not just in a review.
Software engineering. Python or Go at production standard: tested, reviewed, maintained by others. Scripting alone isn't enough for this seat.
Kubernetes. Production experience debugging workloads, not only deploying them.
Reliability practice. Defining SLIs and SLOs, capacity forecasting, performance investigation across the application and database boundary, cloud cost efficiency.
Foundations. Strong Linux administration and deep troubleshooting. Solid Terraform. Networking: DNS, TCP/IP, HTTPS, load balancers, security groups, TLS. Enough CI/CD knowledge to cover the other seat.
Useful to have: OpenTelemetry and distributed tracing; formal SLO or error-budget practice; FinOps; database performance tuning; GitOps with ArgoCD or Flux; AZ-305 or AWS Solutions Architect.
Procedural
You lead incidents during UK hours and on your cover weeks, then run the post-incident review. Blameless, with root cause identified and follow-up actions tracked to completion.
Alerting is tuned continuously. Every page should be actionable, and noisy alerts are treated as defects. A rota this small can't absorb false pages.
Production readiness review before new services or clients go live.
Runbooks are deliverables. Whoever picks up a page overnight should be able to work through it without calling the other engineer.
Recurring manual work gets identified and removed with code rather than absorbed.
Infrastructure changes go through code review and pipelines, alongside the DevOps engineer.
The working day
Fixed hours in UK time, so the window follows UK clock changes rather than drifting.
Full overlap with your counterpart and with the UK team, so most work is collaborative rather than solo.
Out-of-hours cover for US clients on alternating weeks, included in the scope of the engagement. Response expectations are set by severity, and we track page volume with the intent of keeping it low.
A real objective of this role is making that rota quieter: better alerting and automated remediation so overnight breakage is caught and where possible fixed without a human.
Agile/Scrum cadence with a distributed team: standups, planning and retros in UK hours.
Written English at CEFR C1 or equivalent (IELTS 7.0+, or comparable professional experience). A large share of communication is asynchronous, and you'll regularly hand a live incident to someone who was asleep when it started.
BYOD. You supply your machine; all production access runs through a managed virtual desktop, with nothing sensitive stored locally. Disk encryption, supported OS, screen lock and endpoint protection required, plus reliable broadband and a backup connection for on-call weeks.

jobs.title: Hydro Excavation Mobile Game
jobs.description:
I’m ready to turn my hydro-excavation concept into a fully playable mobile title for iOS and Android. The player will operate a vacuum truck and high-pressure water lance, carefully uncovering buried cables and pipes without damaging them. I need realistic visuals—wet soil, pressurised water, mud flow, and metallic utilities should all look and behave convincingly on touch screens.

Core gameplay combines three pillars:  
• Time-based missions that reward fast yet careful digging.  
• Puzzle-style decision making—choose where to probe, adjust water pressure, brace trenches, and route suction hoses.  
• Exploration and discovery across procedurally arranged job sites, from quiet suburbs to busy industrial corridors.

Please build with a mobile-friendly engine such as Unity or Unreal, implementing real-time erosion, particle effects, and physics that still run smoothly on mid-range phones. I’ll need:

1. A tutorial yard teaching nozzle control and utility detection.  
2. At least two mission maps featuring varied soil layers and randomly placed electrical, fibre, and gas lines.  
3. UI/UX that works in portrait and landscape, with touch controls for water flow, suction, and camera pan/zoom.  
4. Optimised APK and IPA builds plus full documented source so I can add new levels later.

If you’ve tackled realistic physics, fluid simulation, or construction-themed games on mobile, I’d love to see your work. Let’s dig in!

jobs.title: Adalo App Logic Revamp
jobs.description:
I am looking for an experienced Adalo developer to fix the logic of an existing app.

Important: This is a logic-fixing project, NOT a build-from-scratch project. I already have the database and screens created.

Technical Requirements:

1. Multi-Role Access Control:

I need to implement different behaviors based on user roles (stored in a text field).

Role A: Must only see their own records.

Role B: Must see a dashboard with filtered records based on a specific relationship assigned to their profile.

Role C: Must only see a statistics dashboard (no editing rights).

2. Dynamic PDF Generation:

When Role B approves a record, they must generate a custom PDF.

The PDF must include: User details, a sequential number (auto-generated), and a QR Code for verification.

3. Navigation Logic:

Current navigation is static. I need the login action to direct users to different screens based on their specific role.

Notes for Bidders:

DO NOT propose rebuilding the app from scratch. I need someone to fix the existing logic.

Must have strong experience with Adalo, specifically with Screen Roles and Filters.

Please include a portfolio of previous Adalo projects that show Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) and PDF generation in your bid message.

jobs.title: ROS 2 AMR – Motor, LiDAR SLAM & Autonomous Navigation Integration
jobs.description:

From there the sensing layer comes in: a 2-D LiDAR already mounted and producing good scans. I plan to build the map with SLAM Toolbox, so the integration work must ensure scan topics, transforms and static frames are perfectly aligned for reliable loop-closure.  

The biggest hurdle I anticipate is Nav2 autonomous navigation; path planning, obstacle avoidance and localization must run smoothly on-board with minimal CPU overhead. Once the stack is functional in simulation, we will move to the physical robot for tuning—PID on the FBL2360TE, inflation parameters, recovery behaviors, velocity limits and safety checks.  

Deliverables  
• ROS 2 nodes or launch files that interface the FBL2360TE, publish /cmd_vel and encoder odometry, and broadcast TF frames.  
• SLAM Toolbox configuration producing a consistent map in our warehouse environment.  
• Fully configured Nav2 stack demonstrating live localization, global & local path planning and dynamic obstacle avoidance.  
• Step-by-step test procedure and final real-world validation video or bag files showing a complete autonomous run.  

Hands-on experience with ROS 2, TF2, encoder math, Nav2 tuning and, ideally, the Nidec/FBL2360TE hardware will let you move quickly. If that sounds like your skill set, let’s start building.

jobs.title: AWS Predictive Finance MIS App
jobs.description:
Project Brief: Full-Stack Engineer — Enterprise Planning & Forecasting (EPM) Platform, Production Build on AWS
Overview
We're building an Enterprise Performance Management (EPM) platform — budgeting, forecasting, scenario planning, and consolidation for finance teams — positioned to complement existing ERPs (SAP, Oracle, Dynamics, or others), not replace them. We pull in actuals from a client's system of record and provide the planning, forecasting, and scenario layer ERPs are typically weak at. Think Anaplan, Pigment, or Workday Adaptive Planning as the closest reference points, not SAP or NetSuite.
We have a validated, feature-complete working prototype (React/TypeScript frontend, Postgres/Supabase backend, an AI-grounded analytics copilot) and are rebuilding it as a production-grade, AWS-hosted platform with a dedicated backend, designed so each client's data can be isolated in its own environment.
Required skillsets
Frontend:
•	JavaScript/TypeScript, React — extending an existing, data-dense codebase (editable grids, real-time computed values, dashboards, charting).
Backend:
•	Python (FastAPI preferred) for the API layer.
•	Strong Postgres schema design — versioned/audited data models, row-level access control.
•	Experience designing per-tenant isolated deployments — each client's data in its own database instance (their own cloud account, or a dedicated instance we provision), never shared multi-tenant storage.
AI application layer:
•	Tool-calling/function-calling architecture with LLMs (Claude or GPT-class APIs) — the AI must only ever answer from real database queries, with zero ability to fabricate data or write to financial tables.
•	Comfortable designing guardrails: read-only tool scoping, full logging of every AI query/response, a hard boundary between what AI can read and what only an authenticated human action can change.
Core EPM functionality to build
•	Approval workflows — submission → review → approval → lock, with role-based sign-off (not just binary lock/unlock).
•	Planning-hierarchy RBAC — access scoped to a user's plant, region, or entity, with read-only visibility upward until a submission is approved.
•	Multi-entity consolidation with intercompany eliminations, and FX translation at the consolidation layer (local-currency plans rolling up into a group reporting currency).
•	ERP/accounting-system actuals-ingestion connectors (starting with Tally/Zoho Books; SAP/Oracle-compatible ingestion for larger clients) — this is the platform's core integration point, not a peripheral feature.
•	Planning submission calendar — open/close windows per budget or forecast cycle, with reminders to contributors ahead of deadlines.
Data & cost-efficiency requirements
•	Efficient batch/incremental data ingestion pipelines for financial/ERP-sourced data, optimized for AWS cost — serverless/scale-to-zero patterns (Lambda, Aurora Serverless) where the workload genuinely fits, avoiding always-on over-provisioning.
•	Architecture must keep per-client operational cost low and predictable — this product is explicitly positioned against expensive, heavy enterprise tooling; infrastructure cost directly affects whether that positioning holds.
Deployment model
•	Every client gets an isolated data environment — their own cloud account, or a dedicated instance we manage — never shared multi-tenant hosting.
•	Infrastructure as Code (Terraform or CloudFormation) so new client environments provision repeatably.

This is an MVP, so the priority is functionality and a clean user experience rather than advanced features.

Core features:

1. User can create an exam by entering the exam name, exam date, and available daily study hours.

2. User can add subjects such as Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, etc.

3. User can add chapters/topics under each subject.

4. User can mark each topic as Weak, Okay, or Strong.

5. The system generates a personalized study plan based on the exam date, available study time, number of topics, and topic priority.

6. Users can view their tasks for each day, including subject, topic, and estimated study time.

7. Users can mark tasks as completed.

8. If a user does not complete a task, they should be able to mark it as unfinished and the system should move it to a later available day.

9. A simple progress dashboard should show overall progress and progress by subject.

10. A basic AI assistant can be included for study-related requests such as explaining topics, generating short quizzes, and helping adjust the study schedule.

The app should be mobile responsive and preferably built as a PWA/web app rather than a native Android/iOS application.

The design should be modern, minimal, clean, and student-friendly.

For the MVP, I do not need payment systems, subscriptions, social features, leaderboards, advanced analytics, or a native mobile application.

Budget: ₹5,000

jobs.title: Effects of Ethanolic and Aqueous Extraction Method and Extract Concentration on the Antifungal Activity of Dracaena trifasciata ‘Laurentii’ Leaf Extract Against Saccharomyces Cerevisiae

Our study aims to determine whether the extraction method (aqueous and ethanolic) and extract concentration (25%, 50%, 75%, and 100%) affect the antifungal activity of snake plant leaf extract against Saccharomyces cerevisiae. The plant leaves will undergo preparation and extraction, while the resulting extracts will be evaluated through an appropriate laboratory antifungal susceptibility assay.

We are seeking the assistance of a qualified microbiologist to supervise and provide technical guidance during the microbiological portion of the study. Specifically, we need assistance in verifying the suitability of the S. cerevisiae culture, preparing and standardizing the fungal inoculum, selecting the appropriate culture medium and antifungal testing procedure, establishing suitable controls, ensuring proper aseptic technique and laboratory safety, and interpreting the resulting inhibition data. All microbiological procedures involving the live culture will be conducted under the supervision of the microbiologist and according to the partner laboratory's established protocols.

The expected output of the project is a comparative evaluation of the antifungal activity of the different snake plant extracts based on their measured zones of inhibition, allowing us to determine whether extraction method and concentration influence the observed antifungal activity.

Assistance We Are Looking For

Technical supervision of the microbiological procedures
Verification of Saccharomyces cerevisiae culture
Guidance on appropriate fungal culture medium and assay
Preparation/standardization of the fungal inoculum
Guidance on appropriate positive and negative controls
Supervision of the antifungal assay
Proper measurement and recording of inhibition zones
Guidance on laboratory safety, aseptic technique, and waste disposal
Assistance in interpreting the microbiological results

Ruang lingkup:
• Terjemahkan keseluruhan teks kontrak kerja tanpa mengubah struktur pasal atau penomorannya.
• Pertahankan istilah hukum spesifik; bila ada padanan yang lazim dipakai di Indonesia, sertakan di dalam kurung.
• Simpan tata letak, judul bab, tabel, dan tanda tangan sebagaimana sumber aslinya.

Keluaran yang saya butuhkan:
1. File terjemahan akhir dalam DOCX dan PDF.
2. Daftar istilah kunci Spanyol-Indonesia yang dipakai, sebagai referensi pengecekan.
3. Catatan singkat (maks. 1 halaman) tentang keputusan penerjemahan untuk frasa hukum yang sulit.

Kerahasiaan dokumen sangat penting. Harap lampirkan contoh pekerjaan serupa atau sertifikasi penerjemah hukum jika tersedia. Saya menargetkan penyelesaian dalam waktu cepat namun tetap mengutamakan ketelitian.

jobs.title: State Payroll Tax Calculation
jobs.description:
I need reliable, year-round support calculating the state payroll taxes for my small business for fiscal years 2025 and 2026. My in-house software already handles gross-to-net, but I want an expert to verify every state-level rate change, apply the correct withholding formulas, and produce precise per-pay-period figures that I can plug straight into my system.

Scope  
• Validate current and upcoming 2025–2026 state payroll tax tables.  
• Calculate employer and employee portions for each scheduled pay run (bi-weekly).  
• Flag any mid-year legislative updates so I can adjust on time.  
• Provide a simple spreadsheet (Excel or Google Sheets) summarizing calculations plus an audit trail I can hand to my accountant.

Acceptance criteria  
• Numbers match the official state calculator to the cent.  
• Spreadsheet is delivered at least three business days before each payroll date.  
• All rate changes are documented with source links to the state’s guidance.

I will supply gross wages, benefit deductions, and employee residency details; you return the finished figures and documentation. Accuracy and timeliness are critical, so please be ready to reference current state statutes and keep me posted on any rule shifts throughout 2025 and 2026.

jobs.title: AI Visibility Campaign

• Optimise the key pages for ChatGPT, Google AI and Gemini, adding relevant schema, reinforcing E-E-A-T signals, and weaving in GEO cues where they make sense.

Acceptance criteria

2. All articles delivered in Google Doc format, minimum 1 000 words each, plagiarism-free and fact-checked.
3. Backlink report listing live URLs, DA/DR, anchor text, and placement date; minimum 90 % of links must be from sites with DA 30+ and real traffic.
4. On-page changes documented with before/after snapshots and schema markup snippets.

If you have proven results getting brands referenced by large language models and can hit the deliverables above, let’s talk.

jobs.title: File Management Desktop Utility - 28/08/2026 01:34 EDT
jobs.description:
I’m looking for a skilled developer to create a lightweight desktop utility devoted entirely to smarter, faster file management. The core idea is to give everyday users an intuitive tool for browsing, copying, moving, renaming, and deleting files without the bloat that often comes with full-scale suites. Think of it as a streamlined upgrade to the default OS file explorer, focused on speed and clarity.

Key points I have in mind  
• Runs smoothly on modern Windows machines (cross-platform support is a welcome bonus).  
• Clean, no-nonsense interface that lets people see folder trees, drag-and-drop between panes, and trigger bulk actions with minimal clicks.  
• Reliable handling of large batches—performance should remain snappy even when a user selects thousands of files.  
• Error handling that never leaves data in limbo; every operation needs clear confirmation or rollback messaging.  

Deliverables  
• Ready-to-install executable.  
• Full, well-commented source code.  
• Short user guide covering the main workflows.  

Acceptance criteria  
1. All standard file actions (copy, move, delete, rename) complete without corruption or crashes.  
2. Bulk operations on 10k+ files finish within a reasonable timeframe and show progress feedback.  
3. UI responds in under 200 ms to navigation or selection changes on a typical SSD.  

If you already have a preferred stack—C#, WPF, Electron, QT, or something else—let me know why it fits the brief. I value clear communication and predictable milestones, so shoot me a quick outline of your approach and any questions you have, and let’s build a solid utility together.

jobs.title: ITR & Tax Audit Expertise
jobs.description:
This mandate covers my full FY 2023-24 Indian income-tax return together with the compulsory tax audit triggered by F&O losses. The work is highly specialised because it blends three focus areas—foreign RSU income, F&O taxation, and a possible Section 54F exemption—so every calculation must stand up to scrutiny and comply accurately with both the Income-tax Act and recent CBDT notifications.

Scope of work  
• Reconcile long-term and short-term capital gains arising from multiple rounds of US RSU sales, convert them correctly to INR, and apply the relevant DTAA provisions where required.  
• Compute gains and losses on domestic equity delivery trades.  
• Prepare the tax audit report (Forms 3CA-3CD) for the F&O segment, capturing turnover, carried-forward loss and any section-43(5) nuances.  
• Evaluate my residential apartment purchase—funded partly by the above RSU proceeds and a home loan—against Section 54F conditions and claim the deduction if eligible, with supporting working papers.  
• Draft and e-file the complete ITR (presumably ITR-3), attach the audit report, and provide final XML/PDF copies plus the full computation sheet.

Information already organised and ready for upload: Form 16, consolidated RSU statements, domestic equity P&L, F&O ledger, home-loan interest certificate, and the registered sale-deed/payment schedule for the apartment.

Please respond with a concise, detailed project proposal outlining:  
• Your direct experience with foreign RSUs, F&O audits and 54F claims.  
• The methodology and tools you use (e.g., Winman, ClearTax, Excel with macros, etc.).  
• An expected turnaround time from the moment I share credentials to final e-filing.  
• A fixed professional fee or a milestone-based structure.

Accurate compliance is the overriding goal; aggressive tax positions are off the table. I will be available for prompt clarification and timely document uploads so we can complete the filing well before the due dates.

jobs.title: Educational Software User Manual Creation

jobs.title: Minecraft Bingo Replay Mod
jobs.description:
I run daily TikTok lock-out bingo streams where viewers’ donations fire off timed commands—anything from instant nukes and mass wither spawns to full inventory wipes. I now want players to download a single mod (or plugin) that faithfully re-enacts every one of those events, in the exact order and at the exact timestamps that happened live, on any 26.2 Minecraft instance.

Here is what I need built:

• The mod reads a simple log or data file that I export after each show. That file lists each command with the millisecond it was triggered.  
• When a player loads the plugin a random seed specific 5 × 5 Lock-out Bingo should appear, your code replays every command automatically, including bingo resets, mob spawns, inventory clears, withers, tnt spawns and nukes—everything—so their run mirrors my stream precisely.  
• Creative mode, operator commands and /give must be blocked for all non-ops while the replay is active.  
• A clear on-screen “Bingo Completed – Prize Eligible” message (or similar) appears once the final square is locked, so I can attach cash prizes with confidence.  
• The solution must sit happily either beside the existing Lock-out Bingo mod or a new bingo mod from scratch; either Forge, neo forge or Fabric, underpinning is up to you as long as a 26.2 client can just drop the jar in and press play.  
• I will hand over every mod I already use and can record a sample stream so you can test edge-cases like triple resets or hundreds of simultaneous mobs.

Acceptance criteria  
1. A compiled jar that runs on a clean 26.2 profile with Lock-out Bingo installed.  
2. Source code and build instructions.  
3. A sample log file plus a short video proving that the re-enacted run matches the original stream frame-for-frame.  
4. No creative/command exploits are possible during the game phase.

jobs.title: Cost Efficient Party Popper Plastics
jobs.description:
I’m rolling out a new line of party poppers and need an expert in plastic materials to bring the raw-material costs to an absolute minimum without sacrificing performance or safety. Your mission is two-fold: pinpoint the most suitable resins for the popper body and cap, and lock in reliable, low-price sources for each.

Material Focus  
You’ll concentrate exclusively on plastics—evaluating resin grades, fillers, and recycled options that can handle the stresses of the popping mechanism while meeting any toy-safety or consumer-goods standards. When a cheaper but still compliant alternative exists, I want to know about it.

Cost-Cutting & Sourcing  
Beyond recommending materials, I expect you to handle the sourcing strategy: identify suppliers, compare regional price breaks, and highlight opportunities for volume or co-molding efficiencies. Your insights on tooling implications, additive packages, and shipping considerations will be invaluable in hitting our target unit cost.

Key Deliverables  
• Bill of Materials (BOM) with part numbers, resin specifications, and cost per 1 000 units  
• Supplier details for each line item—contact name, location, MOQ, lead time, and quoted price  
• A concise rationale document explaining why each material and supplier was chosen and how it supports the cost-reduction goals

I’ll provide full CAD files and current design specs. If you spot quick design tweaks that shave off grams or cycle time, include them. Experience with injection-molded consumer goods, cost optimization, and supplier negotiations is a must. Let me know your expected timeline for the initial material shortlist and any information you require from me to get started.

jobs.title: Boost Rankings, Bury Competitor
jobs.description:

You’ll have access to Google Analytics, Search Console, and Ahrefs/SEMrush data so you can benchmark progress. Continuous reporting is important to me, so build that into your plan.

jobs.title: Steel Deck Diaphragm & Stud Design
jobs.description:
For an upcoming industrial facility, a detailed diaphragm design is required for a composite system consisting of a steel metal deck with concrete fill. The foremost objective is load transfer efficiency, with the diaphragm expected to channel seismic loads safely into the lateral force–resisting elements.  

The scope covers:  
• Verifying diaphragm adequacy in accordance with AISC, ASCE 7 and relevant SDI provisions  
• Sizing and spacing welded shear studs so the concrete slab and deck act compositely while meeting strength and serviceability criteria  
• Providing connection details at collectors, chords and boundary elements, including any required drag struts  
• Supplying clear plans that show deck orientation, shear stud layout, required pour stops and reinforcing steel at openings, penetrations or high-stress regions  
• Delivering a concise calculation package (PDF and native files from ETABS or equivalent) plus editable CAD

Acceptance criteria  
1. Calculations demonstrate code compliance with a minimum safety factor as dictated by governing standards.  
2. Drawings are dimensionally coordinated and ready for peer-review submission without further drafting.  
3. All assumptions, material properties and load combinations are explicitly listed in the calculation cover sheet.

Timely coordination responses during review are appreciated so the permit schedule is maintained.

jobs.title: Instagram Client Hunter Needed
jobs.description:
I run a Reels-editing agency and I’m ready to scale. Your mission is simple: bring me paying clients so my editors can do what they do best.

Here’s how it works  
• You prospect exclusively on Instagram, spotting content creators, small businesses and influencers whose feeds would benefit from stronger Reels.  
• You craft a DM that matches each prospect’s tone—formal for a boutique brand, casual for a lifestyle vlogger—so the message feels personal, never spammy.  
• When someone says “yes, I’m interested,” you pass the conversation to me and I’ll close the deal.  

Payment  
I release ₹300 every time your referral converts into a paid order (our packages start at ₹1,200 per Reel). No caps—the more genuine clients you deliver, the more you earn.

What I count as success  
• The lead arrives via your DM outreach.  
• They confirm they want professional Reels editing.  
• They pay for at least one Reel package.

That’s it—no video editing or extra admin on your side. If you’re ready, send a quick message with the words “CLIENT HUNTER” and let’s start filling the pipeline.

jobs.title: Cinematic Travel Vlog Edits
jobs.description:
I’ve returned from several trips with hours of raw footage and I need a skilled editor to shape it into polished, cinematic travel vlogs. These are personal videos, so storytelling and emotion matter just as much as technical flair.  

You’ll receive the clips, a rough chronological outline, and a soundtrack shortlist. From there, please:  
• Craft a flowing narrative that captures the journey and highlights key moments  
• Apply cinematic color grading, tasteful transitions, and light motion graphics for titles or location call-outs  
• Sync and mix audio, adding licensed background music and balancing any ambient sound I provide  
• Deliver the final edit in 4K MP4 (H.264) plus the editable project file (Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve preferred)  

I’m aiming for a finished length of 5–7 minutes per vlog, though I’m open to your creative input on pacing. If you excel at turning travel footage into immersive stories, let’s collaborate and make these memories unforgettable.

jobs.title: Creative Video Editor for Daily Social Media Content
jobs.description:
I’m looking for a professional and creative video editor / motion graphics freelancer who can work with me on a daily, long-term basis to create high-quality short-form social media videos.

This is not basic editing. I’m specifically looking for someone who can take the script, photos, videos, and context I provide and turn them into polished, engaging videos with strong creative direction.

The editing should feel premium, modern, cinematic, and social-media ready.

I expect approximately 3–4 completed videos per day. Most videos will be around 30–40 seconds long.

The content will be for different types of social media pages, so the editing style should adapt depending on the subject. Some videos will need to feel professional, clean, informative, trustworthy, and modern. Other videos will need to feel cinematic, luxury, fast-paced, high-energy, and visually impressive.

I’m looking for someone who can do more than just place photos together with music.

The videos should include professional editing techniques such as motion graphics, creative animations, kinetic typography, smooth transitions, animated captions, dynamic text effects, parallax and photo animation, zoom and camera movement effects, masking, motion tracking, B-roll integration, professional sound design, sound effects, music synchronization, color correction and grading, creative intros and outros, logo animations where required, strong hooks at the beginning, and good visual storytelling.

Even when only photos are provided, I expect the editor to make the final video feel dynamic and professionally produced.

I will provide the content, script, photos, videos, and context. I expect the editor to use their own creativity to decide how the video should visually flow.

I do not want to explain every transition, effect, text animation, or camera movement. You should be able to understand the content and decide how to make the first few seconds attention-grabbing, where animations should be used, how the text should appear, what transitions fit the video, what B-roll or visual elements would improve it, how the sound design should work, and how to make the final result look premium.

I’m looking for someone who can actually work creatively on the videos, not just follow basic instructions.

The videos will mainly be used for Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, Facebook, and LinkedIn where appropriate.

The final videos should be properly formatted and optimized for short-form social media.

Since I expect content every day, reliability is very important. I need someone who can consistently handle approximately 3–4 videos daily while maintaining good quality.

I’m interested in building a long-term working relationship with the right freelancer.

Experience with professional editing and motion graphics tools such as Adobe Premiere Pro, Adobe After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, or similar software is preferred. The exact software is not important as long as the final quality is strong.

Please send me your portfolio, your best short-form video examples, motion graphics or animation examples, cinematic editing examples, professional or corporate editing examples, your daily video capacity, turnaround time, number of revisions included, price per video, and monthly pricing for approximately 3–4 videos per day.

I’m mainly looking for someone who can consistently produce professional, creative, animated, premium-quality videos every day and who can take responsibility for making the content visually engaging.

jobs.title: 0→1 B2B SaaS GTM Launch
jobs.description:
About SignoSI

SignoSI is building a Decision Intelligence platform designed to help organisations improve the quality of important business decisions.

Our approach focuses on making the thinking behind decisions visible:

Evidence → Assumptions → Reasoning → Decision → Outcome

We are at an early commercial stage and are opening a Founding Programme for a small number of organisations.

We are looking for a hands-on GTM / Business Development freelancer to help us move from thought leadership and early positioning to real market conversations, qualified opportunities and our first paying customers.

This is not a generic digital marketing or social media role.

What you'll do

You will help us:

validate our ICP and positioning
identify high-potential customer segments
build targeted prospect lists
identify relevant decision-makers
develop personalised LinkedIn/email outreach
initiate conversations with senior decision-makers
follow up systematically
qualify opportunities
generate Founding Programme applications
arrange qualified meetings
help convert prospects into paid customers
capture objections and market feedback
recommend changes to our GTM based on evidence

We currently have hypotheses around:

marketing/media investment
GTM and launch decisions
pricing
commercial strategy
resource allocation
pharma/life sciences
media/advertising agencies

These are hypotheses, not fixed conclusions.

We want you to help us test them.

The funnel we care about

Target account

↓

Relevant decision-maker

↓

Conversation

↓

Qualified opportunity

↓

Real business decision

↓

SignoSI demonstration / review

↓

Paid customer

The objective is not to generate large volumes of generic leads.

We want relevant organisations with consequential decisions.

Your first 6–8 weeks

Weeks 1–2

review our current positioning
challenge our ICP assumptions
define initial segments
build initial target-account list
identify decision-makers
develop outreach messaging
establish prospecting/CRM process

Weeks 3–4

execute personalised outreach
conduct follow-ups
arrange qualified meetings
capture objections
refine messaging and ICP

Weeks 5–8

continue prospecting
qualify opportunities
support SignoSI demonstrations
help move qualified prospects towards paid engagement
report what is working and what isn't
recommend the next GTM direction based on evidence
Ideal candidate

We are looking for someone who has actually done 0 → 1 B2B business development / GTM.

Strong candidates will have experience with:

B2B SaaS
early-stage technology companies
founder-led sales
outbound prospecting
LinkedIn outreach
cold email
senior decision-makers
enterprise/business services
new or unfamiliar product categories

Experience in pharma, life sciences, marketing, media, commercial strategy or analytics is a plus.

But demonstrated ability to generate the first customers is more important than industry experience.

This is NOT for you if...

Your main expertise is:

social media management
content creation
SEO
graphic design
generic lead generation
mass email blasting
appointment setting without qualification
paid advertising alone

We already have a content/thought-leadership programme underway.

The gap we need to fill is GTM execution and customer acquisition.

Compensation

We want to start with a 6–8 week pilot.

Fixed component: $500/month

Qualified meeting: $25

Paid customer: $100

A qualified meeting must:

involve a relevant ICP organisation
involve an appropriate decision-maker/influencer
be accepted by the prospect in advance
actually take place
result in a substantive business discussion

No payment for irrelevant meetings, no-shows, generic lead lists or mass/spam outreach.

A paid-customer incentive is payable after the customer's payment has been received.

We are deliberately keeping the fixed component modest and tying additional compensation to outcomes.

If the initial engagement produces genuine traction, we are open to increasing the scope and economics.

Application questions

Please do not send a generic proposal.

Answer these:

1. Tell us about one B2B product you helped take from 0 → first customers. What did you personally do?

2. If you joined SignoSI tomorrow, which customer segment would you test first and why?

3. How would you find the first 25 highly relevant prospects?

4. Write a 100-word LinkedIn message to a CMO or commercial leader introducing SignoSI.

5. What would you aim to accomplish in your first 30 days?

Please provide 2–3 relevant examples of previous GTM/business-development work and measurable results where possible.

Your task is to reshape paragraphs where needed, tighten sentences, flag inconsistencies between the two languages, and suggest any re-ordering that strengthens the narrative arc. Please work in Track Changes and leave clear margin comments so I can understand the reasoning behind major adjustments.

Deliverables  
• Edited Indonesian manuscript with Track Changes  
• Edited English manuscript with Track Changes  
• Final clean copies of both versions  
• A brief editorial memo summarising key issues and recommendations

Fluency in Bahasa Indonesia and idiomatic English, plus proven experience editing narrative non-fiction, are essential. If you have samples of similar bilingual work, feel free to share them when you apply so I can see your approach.

jobs.title: PC Action Game Italian Localization
jobs.description:
I’ve wrapped up development on a story-driven action-adventure title for PC and now need every line of in-game text moved from English into idiomatic, genre-appropriate Italian. The current script sits in a single UTF-8 .csv file that contains dialogue, item descriptions, menu strings, and a handful of system messages. Placeholders such as {playerName} and line-feed tags must remain untouched, and line length has to stay close to the source so on-screen text doesn’t break.

What matters most is a natural Italian voice that matches the fast-paced, cinematic tone of the game while preserving key terminology and lore consistency across roughly 25K words. You’re welcome to work in tools like memoQ, Trados, or even Google Sheets—whatever helps you keep context and maintain a clean string ID structure—as long as the final delivery returns to the original .csv format.

Deliverables  
• Fully translated .csv file with all in-game strings in Italian, placeholders intact  
• A short terminology sheet (glossary) for recurring names and phrases  
• One revision round after integration if my QA team spots context issues or typos  

The build is already content-locked, so I’d love to have a first pass within 10-12 days and the polished version shortly after feedback. Let me know your experience with PC titles and, if possible, share a sample from a previous localization project so I can gauge style fit.

jobs.title: Write Educational Cybersecurity Article
jobs.description:
I need an engaging, well-researched article that teaches readers the essentials of modern cybersecurity. The piece should break down complex concepts into clear, actionable insights that a non-expert can grasp while still offering enough depth to satisfy tech-savvy audiences.  

Please base the content on reputable sources, cite statistics or real-world examples where they add value, and maintain a logical flow from introduction to conclusion. A conversational tone is preferred—professional but approachable—avoiding jargon unless you immediately define it.  

Core requirements  
• Topic: Cybersecurity within the broader technology landscape  
• Goal: Educational—readers should finish feeling more informed and confident about best practices and current threats  
• Length: 1,200–1,500 words is ideal; let me know if you think a different range will suit the material better  
• Originality: 100 % unique content that passes plagiarism checks  
• Format: Word or Google Doc with sub-headings, bullet points where helpful, and a short summary or key takeaways section at the end  

If you have firsthand experience in security audits, ethical hacking, or related areas, highlight that in your proposal—it will help me gauge fit. I’m ready to review a brief outline before you dive into the full draft so we’re aligned on structure and emphasis. Looking forward to seeing how you can bring cybersecurity concepts to life for my audience.

jobs.title: Payment Demand Letter Creation
jobs.description:
I need a professional payment demand letter for an unpaid invoice. 

Requirements:
- Address an unpaid invoice
- For a debtor I've contacted multiple times
- To be sent via email

Ideal Skills and Experience:
- Legal writing expertise
- Experience with payment demand letters
- Clear and professional communication

SAMPLE 
Writing
[LAW FIRM LETTERHEAD]
[DATE]
VIA EMAIL AND CERTIFIED MAIL
RETURN RECEIPT REQUESTED
[PROPERTY OWNER NAME(S)]
[MAILING ADDRESS]
[CITY, STATE ZIP CODE]
[EMAIL ADDRESS(ES)]
Re: Formal Demand for Payment
Project Property: [PROJECT ADDRESS]
Invoice No.: [INVOICE NUMBER]
Outstanding Balance: $13,463.75
Dear [PROPERTY OWNER NAME(S)]:
This firm represents [CONTRACTOR NAME] (“Contractor”) concerning the unpaid balance arising from construction and improvement services performed at the property identified above (the “Property”).
Contractor completed the contracted work and subsequently addressed the corrective items the parties agreed Contractor would perform. Contractor notified you that the agreed-upon corrective items had been completed, and your subsequent written communication acknowledged completion of the corrective work.
After accounting for all payments received and adjustments previously authorized by Contractor, the outstanding balance is $13,463.75.
Accordingly, formal demand is hereby made for payment of $13,463.75 no later than 5:00 p.m. Arizona time on [PAYMENT DEADLINE].
Payment should be delivered to:
[CONTRACTOR NAME]
[PAYMENT ADDRESS]
[CITY, STATE ZIP CODE]
Payment may also be coordinated directly with Contractor by contacting [PHONE NUMBER] or [EMAIL ADDRESS].
Contractor will not provide a full release of its mechanic’s lien in exchange for less than the complete balance owed. Upon receipt and clearance of payment in full, Contractor will promptly execute and process the appropriate release of its lien in accordance with Arizona law.
If Contractor does not receive cleared payment in full by the deadline stated above, our client is prepared to pursue the dispute-resolution and collection remedies available under the parties’ agreement and applicable law. Such action may include commencing mediation, pursuing enforcement of Contractor’s mechanic’s lien within the applicable statutory period, asserting a breach-of-contract claim, and seeking all recoverable interest, attorney fees, costs, and other relief.
Nothing in this letter constitutes a waiver, modification, release, or limitation of any claim, lien, remedy, or legal right belonging to Contractor. All such rights and remedies are expressly reserved.
Please direct future communications concerning this demand to the undersigned.
Sincerely,
[ATTORNEY NAME]
[LAW FIRM NAME]
[ADDRESS]
[PHONE]
[EMAIL]
Counsel for [CONTRACTOR NAME]
Enclosures:
Applicable invoice
Copy of recorded mechanic’s lien
Relevant contract and change orders

jobs.title: 5G Wireless System Deployment
jobs.description:
I’m ready to roll out a full-scale 5G wireless communication system and need a telecommunications professional who can drive the entire implementation. The role is hands-on: turning requirements into a working network, guiding teams on-site and remotely, and ensuring that every milestone meets international as well as local compliance standards. 

Because we’re moving straight into deployment, I’m looking for someone with an extensive background—around eighteen years—in both national and cross-border projects, comfortable coordinating multiple vendors while keeping project documentation airtight. A solid history in project management is important, yet the primary focus here is technical implementation: radio planning, core network integration, performance optimisation and final acceptance testing.

Key deliverables:
• End-to-end implementation plan covering RAN, transport and core  
• Detailed site and frequency design ready for regulatory submission  
• Integration, optimisation and hand-over reports that satisfy carrier-grade KPIs  

I will provide existing design assets, licences and vendor contacts; you’ll refine, execute and close. Familiarity with modern toolsets—drive-test suites, OSS/BSS platforms, and cloud-native 5G core components—is expected.

If coordinating complex 5G builds is second nature to you and you can demonstrate successful launches in multiple regions, let’s discuss timelines and your preferred working model.

jobs.title: Recover Office Wi-Fi Password -- 2
jobs.description:
I have misplaced the wireless passphrase for my own office network. The setup uses a Brand B router and I currently have no administrative access, so I cannot simply log in through the web console.  

Because it is my network—confirmed as an office environment rather than public or third-party—I need a network security professional who can guide me remotely (or supply a clear, step-by-step procedure) to regain control. Acceptable approaches include safely extracting or resetting the WPA/WPA2 key, flashing or factory-resetting the router without erasing critical ISP settings, and then helping me configure a new, strong password and basic security best practices.

Your work is finished when:  
• I can reconnect all office devices using the recovered or newly set passphrase.  
• Router settings remain intact (SSID, ISP credentials, DHCP scope) unless explicitly backed up and restored.  
• I receive a concise, one-page memo summarising what was done and any follow-up precautions.

Experience with Brand B firmware, Wi-Fi diagnostics, and remote support tools (e.g., TeamViewer, AnyDesk, SSH) is a plus. Let me know your suggested method and estimated turnaround time; I’m ready to begin right away.

jobs.title: Optometrist Blog on Eye Conditions
jobs.description:
I’m looking for a qualified optometrist who can translate clinical expertise into clear, reader-friendly articles that will live on our eye-health blog. My immediate priority is authoritative, evidence-based advice that dives into specific eye conditions—think glaucoma, cataracts, macular degeneration, and similar topics we’ll agree on together. Each post should balance scientific accuracy with language that a non-specialist can understand, while still satisfying search-intent and SEO best practices.

Beyond the core articles, there will be opportunities to expand into contact-lens prescription guidance and counselling material for our hospital’s patient-education program, but the blog content comes first. If you have experience speaking with patients online or producing clinical write-ups for optometry journals, that background will definitely help.

Deliverables  
• 1,000–1,200-word blog articles on individual eye conditions (initial batch of three, with potential for ongoing work).  
• Practical take-aways, current research references, and up-to-date clinical guidelines embedded naturally in the text.  
• A short meta-description and 3–5 keyword suggestions for each piece.

I’ll supply a style guide, publishing calendar, and quick access for any clarifications you need. Finished drafts should require minimal editing on my end—citation accuracy, clear structure, and original wording are essential acceptance criteria. If this aligns with your expertise, let’s talk and map out the first topics.

jobs.title: Custom Multi-Channel Inventory Software
jobs.description:
I sell across Amazon and Shopify and keep stock in several separate locations, so I’m ready to replace the spreadsheets and mismatched apps with a single, purpose-built inventory management platform.

Core scope  
The software must pull products, orders and stock levels from both Amazon (SP-API) and Shopify, then push automated stock updates back to each channel in near real time. I also need a clear sales-analytics dashboard so I can spot fast movers, slow sellers and margin trends without exporting CSVs. Because my units sit in more than one warehouse, the system has to allocate stock by location, let me transfer it internally and prevent overselling by combining totals where appropriate.

Reporting  
Daily and weekly snapshots should be generated automatically, while a flexible report builder lets me choose custom date ranges, SKUs or warehouses on demand.

Deliverables  
• Fully functional web app (responsive UI)  
• Modules for multi-warehouse management, sales analytics and customizable reporting  
• Source code in a private repo plus a brief hand-over call or video walkthrough

I’m happy to hear your recommendations. Please outline relevant experience with this type of software, proposed timeline and any questions you need answered before starting.

jobs.title: Queensland Height Limit Analysis
jobs.description:
I live beside a sloping block in Queensland that already holds a residential building, and I would like a clear, planning-grade explanation of how high any future redevelopment on that lot could legally rise. My main concern is the potential impact on my views, so I need more than a generic overview—I need the exact height rules that apply on that parcel and, crucially, how “natural ground level” must be measured on a steep site under the relevant planning scheme. (I'm aware that the likely building height limit is 8.5m but from what level is that calculated given there is an existing building on the block for which some "cutting in" may have occurred in the past).

To be useful, your advice must reference the precise sections of the local planning scheme (Shire, City or Regional Plan), State Codes or overlay maps that control building height for this zone. Please include:

• The formal definition of “natural ground level” used by the authority and the accepted surveying method on sloping land.  
• The maximum permitted building height for the lot (in metres and storeys, if both apply).  
• Any exemptions, averaging provisions, or discretionary variations that could allow a higher structure.  
• A short rationale explaining how you arrived at those figures so I can explain them if challenged.

A concise written memo (PDF or Word) with annotated extracts or weblinks to the regulations is perfect; no glossy report required. GIS screenshots or contour sketches are welcome if they make the explanation clearer.

If you have prepared similar height assessments in Queensland before, that experience will be invaluable.

jobs.title: Meta API Integration Setup
jobs.description:
I need a Meta-savvy specialist to finish the full developer account setup and wire Meta’s APIs directly into our proprietary app. The work centres on obtaining the right permissions, generating long-lived tokens, and making sure our app can securely pull and push data across Facebook, Instagram, and any other Meta endpoints we unlock in the future.

Key deliverables  
• End-to-end Meta developer account configuration, including app review steps  
• Clean, well-documented API integration code or scripts that plug into our existing backend  
• Clear hand-off notes explaining token renewal, rate limits, and best-practice security  
• A brief troubleshooting session to confirm everything runs smoothly in production

Success will be measured by our app’s ability to authenticate, retrieve live data, and post updates through the Meta platform without errors. If this sounds straightforward to you, let’s get started right away.

jobs.title: 40m PVC Pipe Thermal Expansion
jobs.description:
I have a 40-metre hydraulic line made of PVC and I need clear, simulation-backed answers on how much it will expand and what that means for supports, joints, and operating safety. My plan is to couple process data generated in Aspen HYSYS with a detailed FEA model in ANSYS so the thermal loading you evaluate is tied directly to real flow-stream temperatures, not generic assumptions.  

Here is what I expect:  
• A HYSYS case (or exported data table) that defines temperature profiles along the pipe under normal operation.  
• An ANSYS Workbench model of the same 40 m PVC run, including restraints or guides I provide, showing displacements, stresses and reaction loads driven by thermal expansion.  
• A concise report interpreting the results and highlighting any sections where expansion or stress limits for PVC may be exceeded, plus your recommendations for mitigation.  

Accuracy matters more than appearance; please keep the mesh, material properties and boundary conditions transparent so I can review and reuse the setup later. If you have questions about operating pressures or ambient conditions, let’s clarify them early so the analysis reflects reality.

jobs.title: Construction Lead Generation Specialist
jobs.description:
I want to keep our pipeline full of quality work, so I need someone who can consistently uncover fresh opportunities in every corner of the construction market—residential builds, commercial jobs, and even subcontractor–level scopes. For commercial leads, it doesn’t matter whether a project is still on the drawing board, midway through the build, or wrapping up; if it’s active and fits our services, I want to hear about it.

What makes a lead useful to me is detail. Each opportunity you pass along must include
• clear project requirements,
• the direct contact information for the decision-maker (no generic info@ emails), and  
• realistic budget and schedule notes.

Use whatever mix of sources works best—LinkedIn Sales Navigator, industry bid boards, Builders Exchange reports, Dodge, cold-call prospecting, email outreach, or smart web-scraping—as long as the data is accurate and current. I’ll provide a simple CRM template in Google Sheets so we stay organized, and we can review results weekly to refine the search criteria.

Deliverables:
1. A shared spreadsheet updated daily with qualified leads.
2. Verification notes that show how you confirmed the decision-maker’s role and the project’s status.
3. A short weekly summary pointing out high-priority prospects and any trends you’re seeing.

If you’ve previously filled construction pipelines and can show response rates or closed-deal stats, let’s talk.

jobs.title: Payroll Tax Specialist for Small Business 2025 and 2026
jobs.description:
I run a small business that still calculates wages and tax withholdings in plain spreadsheets. I now need an experienced employer-side payroll tax specialist who can step in and:  
• Verify every calculation and deduction for federal, state, and local payroll taxes against those amounts shown in my application. 
• Verify help file my monthly, quarterly, and annual payroll tax returns on time 
• Advise me on all compliance matters—rate changes, new regulations, best-practice record-keeping, and potential penalties   

I built a simple app to help me calculate and file report. I need you to provide, a sharp eye for detail and an ability to spot inconsistencies quickly is critical. 

My immediate priority is clean, accurate filings and rock-solid compliance.  Acceptance criteria: every filing must balance to the penny against the underlying payroll records, and confirmations of submission from the relevant tax agencies must be supplied.  

If you have a proven track record handling payroll tax for small businesses and can start right away, let’s talk.

jobs.title: Industrial Dosing Skids Brochure Design
jobs.description:

jobs.title: Skool Academy Design & Community Building
jobs.description:
Skool Community Setup & Design Specialist

The selected freelancer will help us:

* Set up the complete Skool community

* Download available resources
* Understand how to navigate the Academy

Where am I?

What can I learn here?
How do I participate?

* Accountability posts
* Member spotlights
* Challenges and celebrations

 5. Gamification & Member Journey

Configure or recommend the best use of Skool's:

* Member recognition
* Rewards

The gamification should encourage action, implementation, consistency and community participation, not meaningless posting just to earn points.

 6. Graphic Assets

Create branded graphics/templates as needed, including:

* Community cover/banner

* Welcome graphic
* Classroom/course covers
* CEO Mindset Monday
* Implementation Challenge
* Wake-Up CEO
* Friday CEO Wins
* Ask Rachel
* Plan Your Week
* Member Spotlight
* CEO Win/Celebration

Say I’mPossible Academy

Primary Colors:

The design should feel like an academy and leadership movement, not a generic Facebook group.

## IMPORTANT

We already have the intellectual property, programs, frameworks, videos, resources, and brand direction.

We are NOT hiring someone to create our coaching curriculum.

We need someone who can take what already exists and turn it into a beautiful, organized and intuitive Skool experience.

You should be comfortable receiving content from our team and determining the best way to organize and present it within Skool.

IDEAL FREELANCER

You should have experience with:

* Skool community setup
* Skool Classroom
* Online course/community architecture
* Gamification
* Member onboarding
* Canva
* Community engagement

* Organized classroom
* Member levels/access structure

* Calendar/event structure
* Gamification strategy and setup

* Branded Canva graphics/templates
* Basic documentation showing our team how to maintain the community

TO APPLY

Please do not send a generic proposal.

Start your proposal with the words:

“I'mPossible”

Then answer these questions:

1. How many Skool communities have you personally built?
2. Please provide links/screenshots/examples of Skool communities you have designed.

4. How have you used Skool's levels or gamification to increase engagement?
5. Do you create graphics in Canva?

We are looking for someone who understands that we aren't simply building a course.

We are building a community where entrepreneurs learn to become the CEOs capable of leading their businesses, lives, and legacies.

jobs.title: On-Site Mumbai Network Engineer
jobs.description:
I have a two-month engagement at one of our facilities in Mumbai and need a hands-on Network Engineer / System Administrator who can be on site throughout the period. The core environment runs on Windows Server, so solid, independent capability there is non-negotiable. Day-to-day you will be looking after the full network stack—routers, switches and firewalls—while keeping our users productive and the servers healthy.

Your main focus areas:

• Network maintenance & real-time troubleshooting: keep latency low and uptime high, escalate only what you can’t solve on the spot.  
• Windows Server setup, hardening and routine administration.  
• User support and training when new configurations roll out or issues arise.

By the end of the assignment I expect clean documentation of all changes, a knowledge-transfer session with my internal IT lead, and confirmation that the network remains stable under normal load.

If you are ready to spend the next couple of months in Mumbai ensuring everything runs smoothly, I’m keen to lock in dates and start right away.

jobs.title: Stats-Driven M7 Rating Website
jobs.description:
I want to launch “M7 Rating,” a modern, minimalistic site that converts a player’s Premier statistics from Tracker.gg into a single M7 score on a 22.8-point scale. The site must pull data only from Tracker.gg Premier, apply the rating formula, and display the result on each player’s profile.

Account flow is straightforward: new users register with a display name, Discord handle, and their Tracker.gg profile link. Only those who register are tracked. Discord information remains hidden from the public and is visible only to me (the owner) and any users I promote to “team manager.”

Inside my owner dashboard I need to:
• create and edit teams  
• assign or remove players from those teams  
• promote or demote users between “player” and “team manager” roles  

Team managers gain visibility of their roster’s Discord handles but no wider admin rights.

The UI should feel clean and uncluttered—think generous white space, crisp typography, and intuitive navigation that works on desktop and mobile. I’m open on the tech stack; just outline the framework (React, Vue, Next.js, etc.), backend language, database, and how you’ll schedule or cache Tracker.gg API calls while respecting rate limits.

Acceptance criteria  
• Secure sign-up/login capturing the three required fields  
• Automated stat pull and M7 calculation, refreshed on a reasonable schedule  
• Role-based permissions exactly as described  
• Owner dashboard and team-management tools fully functional  
• Responsive, modern/minimal design matching the site theme  

Tell me how you plan to build it, any similar projects you’ve delivered, and an estimated timeline from kickoff to launch.

jobs.title: Documentary Proposal Weekend Video
jobs.description:
I’m planning a surprise proposal weekend and want the entire story told as a warm, documentary-style short film. Rather than a posed, cinematic montage, I’d like you to shadow us and quietly capture the natural flow of the days—travel, small conversations, nervous energy, all of the behind-the-scenes preparation leading up to the big question. Think fly-on-the-wall coverage mixed with a few intentional shots that help stitch the narrative together.

The finished piece should feel authentic and emotionally engaging. I picture a 4- to 6-minute edit set to recognizable, upbeat popular songs that complement the joyful tone. I will secure any necessary song licenses; you just need to build the track into the timeline so the pacing works with the footage.

Deliverables  
• A professionally edited full-HD (or higher) documentary-style video, color-graded and sound-mixed  
• Titles/lower thirds where helpful to mark moments, plus a clean copy without graphics for flexibility  
• All raw footage on a drive or downloadable link so I can archive the memories

Acceptance  
If the final cut seamlessly weaves the candid prep moments with the proposal itself, flows naturally to the chosen songs, and requires no more than one minor revision round, I’ll consider the job complete.

jobs.title: Luxury Hair Brand Digital Launch
jobs.description:

Deliverables

I’ll supply service photos and any existing assets; you bring the strategy, design sensibility, and platform expertise. Once everything is live and the templates are in my Canva account, the project is complete.

jobs.title: Smooth Cinematic YouTube Edit
jobs.description:
I have an entertainment-focused YouTube video that I’m determined to push toward the 10-million-view mark, and I need a talented editor to give it the smooth, cinematic polish viewers love. The raw footage is ready; what’s missing is the seamless storytelling flow that keeps an audience hooked from first frame to last.

Here’s what I’m after: tasteful, well-timed transitions that heighten the pace without feeling flashy, balanced color grading for a film-like finish, and audio that sits perfectly in the mix. No heavy special effects or text overlays—clean, immersive visuals are the priority.

You’ll receive all source clips, reference timestamps, and my notes on tone. I’m happy to work in Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, or DaVinci Resolve—use whichever platform lets you achieve the best cinematic look.

Deliverable:
• Final edit ready for immediate upload to YouTube (3840×2160 preferred, H.264)  
• One revision cycle included to fine-tune pacing or transition choices

If you can elevate the footage into a captivating, cinema-quality cut that invites repeat views, I’d love to see your reel and get started right away.

jobs.title: Mystical Wooden Fortune Booth
jobs.description:
I’m hosting a Halloween party this year and need a small, one-to-two-person fortune teller booth built entirely from wood and styled with a rich, mystical vibe—think deep purples, gold accents, and just the right amount of theatrical flair. It should be sturdy enough to survive a lively evening, yet light enough to move through a standard doorway and store afterward.

• Footprint: roughly 3 ft × 4 ft, interior standing height.  
• Structure: wooden frame and panels, sanded smooth, ready for paint or stain.

• an exterior sign area where I can mount “Fortunes” lettering.

Deliverables  
1. Completed wooden booth, fully assembled or in easy-to-reassemble panels.  
2. Painted
3. A simple setup guide (photos or short video) showing assembly steps and hardware locations.

Timeline is flexible but I’d like the booth on-site at least one week before Halloween so there’s time for final decorating. If transport is an issue, please include options for delivery or a clear breakdown of packing dimensions so I can arrange pickup.

jobs.title: WordPress E-Commerce Maintenance, 3-Month

jobs.title: Halloween Kissing Booth Construction

jobs.title: Vibrant Mineral Water Label
jobs.description:
I need a fresh label for my new line of bottled mineral water that bursts with personality. The company logo, nutritional panel, and barcode can sit secondary; we can adjust placement once the core concept is approved.

Deliverables:

jobs.title: Responsive Crypto Horse Racing Portal
jobs.description:

All of the usual game elements—dynamic race schedule, 3-D or video race visualisation, on-site odds calculation, user account management and leaderboards—have to be there, but the key requirement is a dedicated crypto payment layer that accepts USDT and USDC natively.

Deliverables  
• Responsive front-end for mobile & desktop  
• Horse-racing game engine with admin controls  
• Real-time betting, odds, history tracking and race playback  
• Crypto payment gateway (USDT & USDC) with full wallet integration  

Acceptance criteria include zero critical bugs on launch, successful end-to-end test deposits and payouts in both tokens, and browser compatibility across the latest Chrome, Safari and Firefox versions.

jobs.title: Recruitment Lead Generation Campaigns

I run a specialist recruitment firm and need a freelance partner who can keep our pipeline of medium-sized enterprises consistently warm. The focus is purely on lead generation: finding the right decision-makers, sparking their interest, and handing them over to me once they agree to a discovery call.

Here is what I’m looking for:

jobs.title: Shopify Designer for Nutrition Brand Website

The website was built with a strong emphasis on premium brand presentation, product storytelling, user experience, mobile responsiveness, and e-commerce conversion. • Custom Shopify storefront design and development

Platform: Shopify

Project Type: Custom Shopify E-commerce Website
Role: Shopify Designer & Developer

jobs.title: Jetson AGX AUTOWARE Module Deployment

jobs.title: Landscaping Business Website with Jobber Integration

jobs.title: iPhone Medical Dictation App
jobs.description:
I dictate operative notes on the go and need an iPhone app that can turn those spoken details into a completed Word (.docm) template and a matching PDF, all while meeting medical-grade confidentiality standards.

Core workflow  
• I open the app, authenticate with Face ID, and tap “Record.”  
• While I dictate the patient’s name, date of service, MRN, laterality, devices used, and any other details, the app transcribes in real time.  
• Using the existing .docm form I supply, it must recognise each field and insert the correct value. If I skip a field, the template’s original text should remain untouched.  
• Once I stop recording, the app presents a summary screen showing every field it filled and the values it placed so I can edit or approve before saving.  
• On approval, it stores both the updated .docm and an automatically generated PDF inside the app’s secure file area.

Essential requirements  
• Accurate speech-to-text.  
• Field-matching logic that is flexible when items are dictated out of order.  
• Local, encrypted storage; nothing should ever leave the device.  
• Face ID gate on every launch and when returning from background.  
• Simple interface so I can finish a note in under a minute.

Acceptance criteria  
1. Dictation populates all mapped fields in the supplied template with ≥95 % accuracy. 
2. Skipped fields remain as original placeholder text.  
3. Review screen lists each populated field and its value for confirmation or manual edit.  
4. One-tap export saves both the Word (.docm) file and the generated PDF to a protected in-app folder.  
5. All data stay on-device and are accessible only after Face ID unlock.

Let me know which speech recognition framework and document automation library you plan to use so we can be sure they run smoothly on current iOS versions.

jobs.title: Uni-Uni to Vigo/Sella Integration
