jobs.title: Skilled Meta Media Specialist for DTC Brand
jobs.description:
# Meta Media Buyer for High-Volume, Multi-SKU DTC Brand (Freelancer or Agency)

## About us

We run a DTC ecommerce brand selling primarily to US customers, with European expansion planned for the coming months. We'll share the niche on a call, but the key thing to know is the shape of the business: we are a high-volume, multi-SKU brand. Our catalogue is broad and growing — rather than one hero product, we continuously add new designs and SKUs of the same product type, and our growth depends on reliably finding winners among them. Think of how a fashion, leather goods or home decor brand works: a similar buyer across the range, but hundreds of individual products that each need to be tested, scaled or cut.

The account is established and profitable: we began scaling properly in June 2026 and spent roughly $35k USD on Meta in the last 30 days. Our plan is to roughly double monthly spend each month through the end of the year, and our team is focused on growing the catalogue with artists to support that. We are a small, hands-on team with our own creative, copywriting and landing-page production in place. What we need is someone who owns the media buying side of Meta and turns our inputs into profitable, scalable spend.

## What you'll do

- Own day-to-day management of our Meta ad account: campaign structure, budgets, bidding, audiences, scaling and cutting.
- Take over a working account with existing winners and history. Your first job is to protect what's performing while building a testing engine on top of it, not to rebuild from scratch.
- Plan and execute our expansion into European markets (initially English-language, with localised pages and creative supplied by us as we roll out further countries).
- Run a structured, ongoing creative testing process for new designs and SKUs entering the catalogue — often several per week — and graduate winners into scaling campaigns without destabilising what's already working.
- Test and compare landing page formats — product detail pages vs. listicles vs. advertorials — and tell us which formats win for which product groups.
- Test new creative formats (statics, UGC-style video, carousels, catalog/DPA, etc.) and feed back clear direction on what Meta is rewarding right now.
- Monitor competitors and adjacent niches for creative angles, offers and formats, and translate that into briefs for our team.
- Walk us through your strategy and results on a regular call and in a short written update. We want to understand your thinking, not just see the numbers.
- Optional: produce static image creatives yourself. We can cover both statics and video in-house, so this is a plus, not a requirement.

## How we work together

We supply the pages, creatives and copy. You plug in and run the media buying.

- Our copywriting and listicle content lives in Airtable. You can connect to it directly (we're happy for you to use Claude Code, Codex or similar) and use the copy as-is or adapt your own variations for ads.
- We'll give you access to the ad account, pixel/dataset and creative library.
- Exact cadence, reporting format and scope are flexible and we'll agree them on a call. Ideal minimal-touchpoint setup: we hand over assets, you log in and manage, and we meet weekly for strategy.

## Who we're looking for

- Currently managing multiple Meta ad accounts (please state how many and at what spend levels).
- Direct experience with high-volume, multi-SKU catalogue brands — fashion, apparel, leather goods, jewellery, home decor, print-on-demand or similar — where you've had to structure testing and scaling across many products rather than one offer. Single hero-product experience alone is not a fit.
- A clear, repeatable creative-testing methodology and a track record of scaling ecommerce accounts from ~$35k/month to $150k+/month while holding efficiency.
- Comfortable with landing page split testing and reading the funnel beyond the ad (CTR → CVR → AOV → ROAS).
- Good understanding of current Meta best practices: Advantage+ shopping/sales campaigns, dynamic creative, catalogue ads, attribution and CAPI/pixel hygiene.
- Strong communicator in English who can explain strategy plainly.
- Open to individual freelancers and Meta-specialised agencies. Agencies: tell us who would actually be in the account day to day.

## Engagement and budget

- Current monthly ad spend: ~$35k USD (last 30 days), targeting roughly 2x month-on-month growth through December 2026.
- Engagement: monthly retainer plus a performance bonus tied to hitting a 3x blended ROAS target while scaling. Please quote your retainer and the bonus structure you'd propose.
- Start: as soon as possible. Initial 3-month trial period with a view to a long-term relationship as spend grows.
- Time zone: we're based in Dubai (GMT+4); a few hours of overlap for calls is needed.

## How to apply

Please include:

1. 2–3 multi-SKU ecommerce accounts you've managed (niche, spend level, results, your role). Anonymised is fine.
2. A short description of your creative testing framework — how you test a new SKU and decide when to scale or kill it.
3. One example of a landing page or creative format test you ran and what you learned.
4. Your pricing structure and availability.
5. Whether you offer static creative production.

One thing to be upfront about: the 3x ROAS target applies while doubling spend, so we're looking for someone who has scaled aggressively before and can speak to how they maintain efficiency through it. Applications that only paste a generic portfolio will not be considered. Start your proposal with the word "catalogue" so we know you've read this.

jobs.title: Silver Songs Gifting Website Build
jobs.description:
I’m ready to launch “Silver Songs for Seniors,” an online storefront where every track I’ve written becomes a heartfelt, send-able gift—much like an e-greeting card, but with music. Each song is already a mastered MP3, copyright-registered and professionally demoed in Nashville (a few were polished with Suno AI), so the creative side is complete; what I need now is the digital experience that lets buyers spread the joy.

Here’s the user journey I have in mind:

• Visitors browse a clean, easy-to-navigate catalog of my songs, filtered by occasion or sentiment.  
• They select a favorite, add a short, personal message, and schedule delivery to the recipient’s email for the big day.  
• On the scheduled date, the recipient receives a warm, branded email containing the custom message and a secure link or embedded player to enjoy the MP3.  
• Funds from each purchase flow straight into my bank account through an integrated payment gateway (I’ve seen this work on Wix, but I’m open to your platform recommendation as long as it remains simple and dependable).

The overall feel should be personalized and heart-warming, never cluttered, and intuitive for customers who may not be tech-savvy themselves. A mobile-friendly design and accessible font sizes are essential.

Key functions I need built:

1. Song catalog manager so I can upload, tag, and price tracks on my own.  
2. Checkout with Stripe or PayPal for instant payouts.  
3. Scheduling engine that queues the email gift delivery for the chosen date and time.  
4. Email template that pulls in buyer’s message and a unique download/stream link.  
5. Basic analytics dashboard (sales, most-purchased songs, upcoming deliveries).  

If you have experience creating greeting-card-style e-commerce flows—or better yet, have tackled scheduled digital deliveries before—I’d love to hear how you’d bring this vision to life and keep ongoing maintenance straightforward for a solo songwriter.

jobs.title: NTBSS Real-Time Trainer and Save Editor
jobs.description:
Custom Naruto to Boruto: Shinobi Striker (NTBSS) Steam — Real-Time Trainer & Save Editor

I am looking for an experienced C#/C++ developer with strong knowledge of Windows desktop development, data analysis, binary file manipulation, memory analysis, reverse engineering, game modding, and game save editing.

I would like to commission a custom Windows tool for Naruto to Boruto: Shinobi Striker (NTBSS) on Steam.

The main objective is to have a real-time trainer capable of reading and modifying relevant game data while NTBSS is running, ideally including when connected to online services, where technically possible.

I also want a save editor as a secondary solution for data that cannot be modified directly through the real-time trainer.

The trainer itself must be fully available in French, including menus, buttons, categories, settings, notifications, error messages, and all other user-facing elements.

1. Real-Time Trainer

The trainer should ideally allow me to read and modify relevant game data while NTBSS is running.

I am primarily interested in modifying and customizing my character, inventory, items, appearance, currency, progression, and profile data.

Inventory / Content

* All male clothing
* All female clothing
* All weapons
* All accessories
* All ninja tools
* Unique items
* Other existing inventory items

Character Appearance

* Skin color
* Hair color
* Eye color
* Hairstyles
* Makeup
* Other existing customization options

Modded Skin Colors

An important clarification regarding modded skin colors:

I am not asking for completely new colors or textures to be created.

The idea is to reuse existing color values already present in the game, particularly values from the game’s existing hair-color palette, and apply those values to the skin-color parameter where technically possible.

The developer should determine how these values are stored and whether existing hair-color values can safely be applied to the skin-color field.

Currency / Items

Where technically possible:

* Ryo
* Scrolls
* Exchange tickets
* Upgrade materials
* Shinobi Reformation Seals
* Character customization/change tickets
* Other existing currencies or items

I would ideally like to enter the exact quantity/value I want rather than being limited to predefined values.

2. Profile / Progression

I would like to be able to read and modify, where technically accessible:

* Player level
* Prestige / rank
* Playtime / hours played
* Completed missions
* Progression
* Combat statistics
* Total number of battles
* Number of wins
* Number of losses
* Win/loss ratio
* Other available profile statistics

Ideally, the current values should be displayed in the trainer and directly editable.

3. Existing Content / Unlocks

Important: I do not want completely new game content to be created.

I only want to access, unlock, or modify content that already exists in NTBSS and its game data.

This includes, where technically possible:

* Male clothing
* Female clothing
* Weapons
* Accessories
* Ninja tools
* Jutsu
* Hairstyles
* Makeup
* Animals
* Titles
* Unique items
* Existing DLC content
* Existing paid content
* Other existing game content

I am not looking for new assets, new textures, new weapons, or new items created from scratch.

The goal is strictly to modify or unlock existing content.

4. Inventory Management

The trainer should ideally allow me to view and modify existing inventory data.

I would like the application to display:

* Item name
* Item ID
* Owned / not owned status

so that I do not have to manually enter item IDs whenever possible.

5. Save Editor

In addition to the real-time trainer, I would like a save editor capable of:

* Reading NTBSS saves
* Identifying accessible data
* Editing confirmed editable values
* Editing profile/progression
* Editing inventory
* Editing appearance
* Editing currencies
* Editing items
* Editing unlock-related data
* Importing saves
* Exporting saves

If certain features cannot be implemented through the real-time trainer, I would like the developer to determine whether they can instead be implemented through offline save editing.

Where technically possible, I would like modified saves to remain usable when the game is subsequently connected to online services.

6. Backup / Save Safety

The software must protect the original save.

Required functionality:

* Automatic backup before every modification
* Manual backup
* Restore
* Import
* Export
* Multiple backup versions if possible
* Protection against accidentally overwriting the original save

The original save should never be overwritten without creating a backup first.

7. User Interface

I want a simple, clean and fully French-language Windows GUI.

The entire trainer must be in French, including:

* Menus
* Buttons
* Categories
* Item descriptions
* Settings
* Notifications
* Confirmation messages
* Error messages
* Backup/restore options
* All other user-facing elements

Suggested structure:

TRAINER

* Real-time data
* Profile
* Inventory
* Appearance
* Currency
* Items
* Unlocks

PROFILE

* Level
* Prestige
* Playtime
* Missions
* Statistics

APPEARANCE

* Skin
* Hair
* Eyes
* Hairstyles
* Makeup

INVENTORY

* Male clothing
* Female clothing
* Weapons
* Accessories
* Ninja tools
* Unique items

CURRENCY / ITEMS

* Ryo
* Scrolls
* Exchange tickets
* Upgrade materials
* Shinobi Reformation Seals

UNLOCKS

* Existing content
* Existing DLC
* Jutsu
* Animals
* Titles
* Other existing content

SAVE

* Backup
* Restore
* Import
* Export

8. Compatibility / Updates

* Platform: Windows PC
* Game: Naruto to Boruto: Shinobi Striker
* Version: Steam

The application should be designed in a modular and maintainable way so that game-version-specific data can be updated when NTBSS receives updates.

Where possible, data such as:

* Offsets
* Addresses
* Structures
* Item IDs
* Signatures / patterns
* Other version-specific information

should be organized so they can be updated without rebuilding the entire application.

9. Development Process

I would prefer the project to be developed in stages.

Stage 1 — Analysis / Proof of Concept

Analyze the game/save structure and determine which requested data is actually accessible and editable.

I can provide test saves, including a legitimate save and a modified save, to assist with the analysis.

Stage 2 — Application Foundation

* Windows application
* Fully French interface
* General architecture
* Backup / Restore

Stage 3 — Real-Time Trainer

* Game detection
* Reading accessible data
* Identifying relevant data
* Modifying confirmed editable data

Stage 4 — Profile / Progression

* Level
* Prestige
* Playtime
* Missions
* Statistics

Stage 5 — Appearance

* Skin
* Hair
* Eyes
* Hairstyles
* Makeup
* Existing color values that can be reused where technically possible

Stage 6 — Inventory

* Clothing
* Weapons
* Accessories
* Ninja tools
* Unique items

Stage 7 — Currency / Items / Content

* Ryo
* Scrolls
* Exchange tickets
* Upgrade materials
* Shinobi Reformation Seals
* Existing content
* Existing DLC
* Animals
* Titles
* Jutsu

Stage 8 — Save Editor

Add save-editing functionality for features that cannot be implemented directly through the trainer.

Stage 9 — Testing / Finalization

* Extensive testing
* Bug fixing
* Compatibility testing
* Documentation
* Final build

10. Technical Feasibility

I understand that not every requested feature may be technically possible.

I therefore want the developer to analyze the game’s structure and save data before guaranteeing specific features.

I would like to determine:

* Which data is accessible
* Which data can be modified
* Which data is persistent
* Which data can be modified in real time
* Which data can be modified through the save
* Which modifications remain functional when connected to online services
* Which features require additional research

I prefer a feature to be clearly identified as not guaranteed after analysis rather than receiving an unrealistic promise.

11. Final Delivery

At the end of the project, I want to receive:

* Fully functional final build
* .exe application
* Complete source code
* Complete project files
* Required configuration files
* Documentation
* Installation instructions
* Usage instructions
* Compilation instructions
* Explanation of the main systems

I want to be able to compile, modify, and maintain the project myself after delivery.

12. Information Requested From the Developer

Please provide:

1. Total estimated price
2. Estimated development time
3. Features you can confidently implement
4. Features requiring additional research
5. Your experience with C#/C++
6. Your experience with memory analysis, binary files, and save editing
7. Your experience with game modding or reverse engineering
8. Examples of similar projects
9. GitHub / portfolio if available
10. Confirmation that the complete source code will be delivered
11. Confirmation that the complete project files will be delivered
12. Confirmation that development can be divided into milestones
13. What you propose for the initial Proof of Concept

I am particularly interested in developers who are comfortable analyzing an unfamiliar game’s data structures rather than relying exclusively on existing offsets or previously available tools.

jobs.title: Enterprise SaaS Product Design & React Implementation
jobs.description:
We are building an enterprise B2B SaaS product used by insurance organizations and their frontline agents.

The core application, backend services and product functionality already exist.

We are looking for an experienced Product Designer / Design Engineer who can take an existing functional application and turn it into a polished enterprise product.

What We Need

The engagement will happen in two clear stages.

Stage 1: Product UI/UX and Design Freeze

You will:

Audit the existing application and workflows
Understand the major user personas and journeys
Improve information architecture where required
Establish the visual direction for the product
Design the application in Figma
Create a reusable design system
Define typography, spacing, navigation, forms, tables, cards, status states, dialogs, filters and other components
Design loading, empty, error and success states
Ensure consistency across the complete product
Produce developer-ready Figma files
Work with us until we reach a formal UI Freeze

The product should feel like a serious enterprise SaaS application, not a startup template or an AI-generated dashboard.

We value products with the level of clarity and polish seen in modern enterprise SaaS platforms such as Linear, Stripe, Ramp, Rippling, Datadog and similar products.

We are not asking you to copy these products. They are references for quality.

Stage 2: React Frontend Implementation

After UI Freeze, you will:

Implement the approved design in React
Build reusable production-quality components
Connect the frontend to existing backend APIs
Handle responsive layouts
Implement loading, empty and error states
Maintain consistent design tokens and components
Keep the frontend clean and maintainable
Work with the existing engineering architecture rather than rewriting backend functionality

Backend development is largely outside the scope of this role.

Product Areas

The application contains areas such as:

Enterprise administration dashboard
Organization configuration
Users / agents
Teams
Sales playbooks
Playbook versions and publishing
Agent assignments
Knowledge management
Configuration and policies
Usage and operational dashboards
Desktop-agent configuration
Session/call information
Settings and governance

There is also a desktop application used by frontline agents.

The Admin Console acts as the centralized control plane and the desktop application acts as the runtime/execution experience.

Consistency between these experiences is important.

What We Are Looking For

You should have strong experience designing actual B2B SaaS products.

Please do not apply if most of your portfolio consists of:

Landing pages
Marketing websites
Dribbble concepts
Mobile-only consumer applications
WordPress themes
Dashboard templates
AI-generated UI concepts

We specifically want to see:

Enterprise SaaS
Admin consoles
Data-heavy applications
Complex workflows
Design systems
Production React applications
Required Skills
Figma
Product Design
UI/UX
Design Systems
B2B SaaS
React
TypeScript
Responsive Web Design
Component-based frontend architecture

Experience with Tailwind, shadcn/ui or similar component systems is useful, but the final product must not look like an out-of-the-box component library.

Application Instructions

Please send:

Your 3 best B2B SaaS projects
Links to live products where possible
Figma examples showing your design system/component work
Which parts you personally designed
Which parts you personally coded
Your proposed fixed-price quote
Your availability

Please start your proposal with:

ENTERPRISE PRODUCT

so we know you have read the complete requirement.

Generic proposals will be ignored.

Selection Process

We will judge primarily on:

Product thinking
Information hierarchy
Enterprise visual quality
Attention to detail
Component/design-system thinking
Ability to translate Figma accurately into React

Code and design files created as part of the engagement must be fully handed over to us.

jobs.description:

Your day-to-day focus will be:

• Circuit design for the BMS daughter-boards, including cell-balancing, current-sense, protection FETs and all supporting analog/digital interfaces.
• Thermal analysis of the pack and its integrated cold-plate, using your calculations to specify sensors, heaters, interface materials and control loops before committing them to hardware.

Once the schematics and thermal stack-up are frozen, you’ll drive the board spins, source parts, assemble the prototypes and bring them up in the lab. I already have a small test rig with programmable loads and an environmental chamber; you’ll script the characterisation runs, capture the data and recommend the next round of tweaks.

Acceptance criteria
– Functional BMS prototype that communicates over CAN and handles balancing / protection within spec

jobs.title: Create AI Film-making website -- 2
jobs.description:
Upgrade my existing platform: https://rustling-motion-magic-labs.base44.app/ I need a production-grade AI filmmaking website, not a demo or basic prompt-to-video generator. The system must generate high-quality AI films from 5 seconds up to 2 minutes (120 seconds) and support multiple productions/jobs at the same time.

CORE WORKFLOW: Users must be able to create a project, enter a story/script/commercial concept/prompt, create or upload characters and reference images, create locations, generate/edit a screenplay, automatically create scenes/shots, generate storyboards, approve shots, run Production Preflight, submit production, generate video segments using GPU workers, automatically assemble segments, add dialogue/music/SFX/captions/audio, produce the final MP4 and download the completed film. Support 5/10/15/30/45/60/90/120 seconds and custom durations up to 120 seconds.

LONG-VIDEO ARCHITECTURE: DO NOT attempt to generate a 120-second diffusion video in one request. Automatically divide movies into controlled shots/segments. Example: 120-second film → screenplay → scenes → shots → 5–10 second segments → QC → assembly → audio → upscale/post-processing → final master. A 120-second movie could contain approximately 12–24 segments. Users should not manually assemble them.

BASE44 + GPU BACKEND: Base44 should handle users/login, projects, productions, characters, locations, scripts, storyboards, shots, assets, settings, job status, admin and database. Actual AI generation must run on a dedicated GPU backend. Architecture: Base44 Website → ROLLCALL API → Job Queue → GPU Workers → Storage → QC/Assembly → Final Video. The browser must not be responsible for keeping generation alive.

JOB QUEUE: Implement a real queue using Redis/Celery, Redis/RQ, BullMQ or another production solution. Hierarchy: Production ID → Scene ID → Shot ID → Segment ID → Generation Job ID. Statuses: QUEUED, ASSIGNED, RUNNING, UPLOADING, QC, COMPLETED, RETRYING, FAILED, CANCELLED. Every job must save settings, model, prompt, references, seed, GPU, start/end time, retries, errors and output.

MULTIPLE PRODUCTIONS: Mandatory. I need to submit Production A/B/C/D without waiting for one movie to finish. With one GPU, jobs queue. With multiple GPUs, jobs automatically distribute across GPU-01/GPU-02/GPU-03/GPU-04. Additional GPUs must be addable without rebuilding the website.

GPU WORKERS: Do not hard-code one provider. Support architecture for RunPod, Vast.ai, Lambda, CoreWeave, AWS and local/dedicated servers. Workers register capabilities, GPU model, VRAM, installed models, status and heartbeat. States: ONLINE/BUSY/DRAINING/OFFLINE/ERROR. If a worker crashes, unfinished jobs return to the queue. Completed segments must survive.

VIDEO MODELS: Start with Wan 2.2 or the best appropriate self-hosted model. Support text-to-video, image-to-video and reference-image generation. Build a Model Registry so additional models/APIs can be added without rebuilding the platform. Do not hard-code the database around one model.

CHARACTER IDENTITY LOCK: Character consistency is critical. Each character needs ONE canonical Character ID. Example CAMBELL = CHAR_CAMBELL_001. Every screenplay, scene, shot, storyboard and production must reference this ID rather than typed name variations. Store face/front/left/right/3/4/full-body references, wardrobe, appearance description, approved plates and identity-lock status. Never create duplicate characters. Approved references automatically follow the character into every required generation.

LOCATIONS/WARDROBE/PROPS: Use canonical IDs for locations, wardrobe, props, vehicles and sets. Location records store references, lighting, room/set characteristics, important objects and continuity information. References automatically follow relevant shots.

STORYBOARD + SHOTS: Create storyboard frames before expensive video generation. Allow Approve/Edit/Regenerate/Delete/Reorder. Every shot contains duration, Character IDs, Location ID, action, camera/framing, movement, lighting, wardrobe, props, dialogue, audio, prompt, negative prompt, seed, references and previous/next-shot continuity. Where possible use a previous shot's ending frame as reference for the next shot.

PRODUCTION PREFLIGHT: Before rendering validate characters, character locks, locations, references, storyboards, durations, prompts, GPU worker, model, storage and audio settings. Show READY TO PRODUCE or specific errors explaining what must be fixed. Never silently fail.

QUALITY: Support DRAFT (fast testing), STANDARD (balanced), CINEMA (high quality), MASTER (maximum quality/post-processing). Support 480p draft, 720p generation/preview, 1080p final/upscale and future 4K. Do not falsely call upscaled footage native 4K. Support 16:9, 9:16, 1:1, 4:5 and 2.39:1.

SHOT REGENERATION: If Shot 17 of a 24-shot movie is bad, do NOT regenerate the movie. Allow Regenerate Shot, Change Prompt, Seed, Camera, Motion, Reference or Model. Replace the shot and rebuild the master.

QC + RETRIES: Automatically verify file existence, duration, resolution, FPS, corruption, black/frozen output and where practical AI-check identity, anatomy, unwanted people, wardrobe and location continuity. Failed jobs retry automatically. Attempt 1 FAIL → retry → Attempt 2 → retry → Attempt 3 NEEDS ATTENTION. Never restart an entire production because one shot fails.

CHECKPOINTING: Continuously save production state. If 18/24 shots are completed and a server restarts, continue unfinished work. Never unnecessarily regenerate completed segments.

VIDEO/AUDIO ASSEMBLY: Use FFmpeg or equivalent. Support clip assembly, trimming, transitions, FPS/resolution normalization, dialogue, voice-over, music, SFX, ambience, captions, loudness normalization and final encoding. Architecture must allow future lip-sync/facial performance.

PRODUCTION DASHBOARD: Show production runtime, total shots, completed/rendering/queued/failed shots and overall progress. Show individual shot statuses. Users must be able to pause/cancel production and regenerate individual shots.

ADMIN/GPU DASHBOARD: Show active/queued/failed/completed productions, queue depth, GPU workers, GPU model/VRAM, current jobs, loaded models, worker health, generation time, storage, errors and costs. Track GPU time and estimated cost for each production so I know actual cost for 30/60/90/120-second productions.

API: Create a versioned ROLLCALL API including GET /v1/health, GET /v1/certify, POST /v1/jobs, GET /v1/jobs/{id}, POST /v1/jobs/{id}/cancel, GET /v1/workers, GET /v1/models and POST /v1/worker/heartbeat. Website communicates with the ROLLCALL API, not directly with random Python scripts/ComfyUI workflows. Secure GPU endpoints using server-side API keys/service authentication. Never expose GPU/API secrets in browser code.

STORAGE + DATABASE: Use S3-compatible storage such as S3/R2/B2 for large video/image/audio assets. Database entities should include Users, Projects, Productions, Scenes, Shots, Segments, Characters, CharacterReferences, Locations, Storyboards, Assets, RenderJobs, GPUWorkers, Models, AudioTracks, QCReports, ProductionVersions and Logs. Use resumable/multipart uploads for large media.

NO FAKE FUNCTIONALITY: Every visible Generate, Lock Character, Preflight, Render, Regenerate, Cancel, Pause, Resume, Connect Worker, Test GPU and Download button must perform a real backend action. No placeholders. Do not patch errors individually while leaving broken architecture underneath. Inspect the existing application first and preserve/migrate valid existing data.

ACCEPTANCE TESTS: Before completion demonstrate: (1) real 5-second AI video, (2) assembled 30-second film, (3) 60-second film, (4) complete 120-second film, (5) at least 3 productions submitted simultaneously, (6) queue management, (7) two workers/GPUs processing jobs in parallel, (8) intentionally fail one segment and prove automatic retry, (9) restart worker and prove completed segments survive, (10) regenerate one bad shot without regenerating movie, (11) character references follow every relevant shot, (12) final video/audio synchronization.

DEFINITION OF DONE: This project is NOT complete because a 120-second option appears in a dropdown. It is complete when the platform can reliably go IDEA → SCRIPT → CHARACTERS → STORYBOARD → SHOTS → PREFLIGHT → GPU QUEUE → AI GENERATION → QC → ASSEMBLY → AUDIO → FINAL FILM and return a playable downloadable 30–120 second high-quality AI-generated film. Architecture must support multiple simultaneous productions and multiple GPU workers. Build this as a scalable AI film-production system, not a prototype.

jobs.title: Zero-Downtime Docker Swarm Cluster

jobs.title: Fix VICIdial System Lagging and Heartbeat Issue
jobs.description: We have a self-hosted VICIdial system where agents are incorrectly becoming LAGGED/PAUSED because the agent heartbeat and last_update_time are not being refreshed reliably. We have already traced the issue significantly and do not want the troubleshooting restarted from scratch. The established chain is: Browser JavaScript refresh timer → AJAX request → conf_exten_check.php → PHP processing → agent heartbeat/refresh → last_update_time → VICIdial background processes → LAGGED status. We identified that the browser is repeatedly calling conf_exten_check.php, and the request returns HTTP 200 but an incorrect/blank response, which causes JavaScript processing to fail. We also found PHP warnings related to an undefined $DB variable in functions.php. Current investigation shows that vicidial.php mainly sets last_update_time when the vicidial_live_agents record is initially created, while the continuous heartbeat update mechanism still needs to be traced and repaired. Goal: identify the exact root cause of the failed agent heartbeat, restore reliable continuous last_update_time updates, ensure agents remain properly active/READY without falsely becoming LAGGED, and verify that autodialing works normally. The solution must be a permanent code/configuration fix, not a workaround such as manually updating MySQL timestamps, disabling LAGGED detection, or masking the symptom. The freelancer should be experienced with VICIdial, PHP, MySQL/MariaDB, JavaScript/AJAX, Asterisk and VICIdial background Perl processes and should document exactly what was changed and why.

CORE WORKFLOW: Users must be able to create a project, enter a story/script/commercial concept/prompt, create or upload characters and reference images, create locations, generate/edit a screenplay, automatically create scenes/shots, generate storyboards, approve shots, run Production Preflight, submit production, generate video segments using GPU workers, automatically assemble segments, add dialogue/music/SFX/captions/audio, produce the final MP4 and download the completed film. LONG-VIDEO ARCHITECTURE: DO NOT attempt to generate a 120-second diffusion video in one request. Automatically divide movies into controlled shots/segments. Example: 120-second film → screenplay → scenes → shots → 5–10 second segments → QC → assembly → audio → upscale/post-processing → final master. A 120-second movie could contain approximately 12–24 segments. Users should not manually assemble them.

BASE44 + GPU BACKEND: Base44 should handle users/login, projects, productions, characters, locations, scripts, storyboards, shots, assets, settings, job status, admin and database. Actual AI generation must run on a dedicated GPU backend. Architecture: Base44 Website → ROLLCALL API → Job Queue → GPU Workers → Storage → QC/Assembly → Final Video. The browser must not be responsible for keeping generation alive.

JOB QUEUE: Implement a real queue using Redis/Celery, Redis/RQ, BullMQ or another production solution. Hierarchy: Production ID → Scene ID → Shot ID → Segment ID → Generation Job ID. Statuses: QUEUED, ASSIGNED, RUNNING, UPLOADING, QC, COMPLETED, RETRYING, FAILED, CANCELLED. Every job must save settings, model, prompt, references, seed, GPU, start/end time, retries, errors and output.

MULTIPLE PRODUCTIONS: Mandatory. I need to submit Production A/B/C/D without waiting for one movie to finish. With one GPU, jobs queue. With multiple GPUs, jobs automatically distribute across GPU-01/GPU-02/GPU-03/GPU-04. Additional GPUs must be addable without rebuilding the website.

GPU WORKERS: Do not hard-code one provider. Support architecture for RunPod, Vast.ai, Lambda, CoreWeave, AWS and local/dedicated servers. Workers register capabilities, GPU model, VRAM, installed models, status and heartbeat. States: ONLINE/BUSY/DRAINING/OFFLINE/ERROR. If a worker crashes, unfinished jobs return to the queue. Completed segments must survive.

VIDEO MODELS: Start with Wan 2.2 or the best appropriate self-hosted model. Support text-to-video, image-to-video and reference-image generation. Build a Model Registry so additional models/APIs can be added without rebuilding the platform. Do not hard-code the database around one model.

CHARACTER IDENTITY LOCK: Character consistency is critical. Each character needs ONE canonical Character ID. Example CAMBELL = CHAR_CAMBELL_001. Every screenplay, scene, shot, storyboard and production must reference this ID rather than typed name variations. Store face/front/left/right/3/4/full-body references, wardrobe, appearance description, approved plates and identity-lock status. Never create duplicate characters. Approved references automatically follow the character into every required generation.

LOCATIONS/WARDROBE/PROPS: Use canonical IDs for locations, wardrobe, props, vehicles and sets. Location records store references, lighting, room/set characteristics, important objects and continuity information. References automatically follow relevant shots.

STORYBOARD + SHOTS: Create storyboard frames before expensive video generation. Allow Approve/Edit/Regenerate/Delete/Reorder. Every shot contains duration, Character IDs, Location ID, action, camera/framing, movement, lighting, wardrobe, props, dialogue, audio, prompt, negative prompt, seed, references and previous/next-shot continuity. Where possible use a previous shot's ending frame as reference for the next shot.

PRODUCTION PREFLIGHT: Before rendering validate characters, character locks, locations, references, storyboards, durations, prompts, GPU worker, model, storage and audio settings. Show READY TO PRODUCE or specific errors explaining what must be fixed. Never silently fail.

QUALITY: Support DRAFT (fast testing), STANDARD (balanced), CINEMA (high quality), MASTER (maximum quality/post-processing). Support 480p draft, 720p generation/preview, 1080p final/upscale and future 4K. Do not falsely call upscaled footage native 4K. Support 16:9, 9:16, 1:1, 4:5 and 2.39:1.

SHOT REGENERATION: If Shot 17 of a 24-shot movie is bad, do NOT regenerate the movie. Allow Regenerate Shot, Change Prompt, Seed, Camera, Motion, Reference or Model. Replace the shot and rebuild the master.

QC + RETRIES: Automatically verify file existence, duration, resolution, FPS, corruption, black/frozen output and where practical AI-check identity, anatomy, unwanted people, wardrobe and location continuity. Failed jobs retry automatically. Attempt 1 FAIL → retry → Attempt 2 → retry → Attempt 3 NEEDS ATTENTION. Never restart an entire production because one shot fails.

CHECKPOINTING: Continuously save production state. If 18/24 shots are completed and a server restarts, continue unfinished work. Never unnecessarily regenerate completed segments.

VIDEO/AUDIO ASSEMBLY: Use FFmpeg or equivalent. Support clip assembly, trimming, transitions, FPS/resolution normalization, dialogue, voice-over, music, SFX, ambience, captions, loudness normalization and final encoding. Architecture must allow future lip-sync/facial performance.

PRODUCTION DASHBOARD: Show production runtime, total shots, completed/rendering/queued/failed shots and overall progress. Show individual shot statuses. Users must be able to pause/cancel production and regenerate individual shots.

ADMIN/GPU DASHBOARD: Show active/queued/failed/completed productions, queue depth, GPU workers, GPU model/VRAM, current jobs, loaded models, worker health, generation time, storage, errors and costs. Track GPU time and estimated cost for each production so I know actual cost for 30/60/90/120-second productions.

API: Create a versioned ROLLCALL API including GET /v1/health, GET /v1/certify, POST /v1/jobs, GET /v1/jobs/{id}, POST /v1/jobs/{id}/cancel, GET /v1/workers, GET /v1/models and POST /v1/worker/heartbeat. Website communicates with the ROLLCALL API, not directly with random Python scripts/ComfyUI workflows. Secure GPU endpoints using server-side API keys/service authentication. Never expose GPU/API secrets in browser code.

STORAGE + DATABASE: Use S3-compatible storage such as S3/R2/B2 for large video/image/audio assets. Database entities should include Users, Projects, Productions, Scenes, Shots, Segments, Characters, CharacterReferences, Locations, Storyboards, Assets, RenderJobs, GPUWorkers, Models, AudioTracks, QCReports, ProductionVersions and Logs. Use resumable/multipart uploads for large media.

NO FAKE FUNCTIONALITY: Every visible Generate, Lock Character, Preflight, Render, Regenerate, Cancel, Pause, Resume, Connect Worker, Test GPU and Download button must perform a real backend action. No placeholders. Do not patch errors individually while leaving broken architecture underneath. Inspect the existing application first and preserve/migrate valid existing data.

ACCEPTANCE TESTS: Before completion demonstrate: (1) real 5-second AI video, (2) assembled 30-second film, (3) 60-second film, (4) complete 120-second film, (5) at least 3 productions submitted simultaneously, (6) queue management, (7) two workers/GPUs processing jobs in parallel, (8) intentionally fail one segment and prove automatic retry, (9) restart worker and prove completed segments survive, (10) regenerate one bad shot without regenerating movie, (11) character references follow every relevant shot, (12) final video/audio synchronization.

DEFINITION OF DONE: This project is NOT complete because a 120-second option appears in a dropdown. It is complete when the platform can reliably go IDEA → SCRIPT → CHARACTERS → STORYBOARD → SHOTS → PREFLIGHT → GPU QUEUE → AI GENERATION → QC → ASSEMBLY → AUDIO → FINAL FILM and return a playable downloadable 30–120 second high-quality AI-generated film. Architecture must support multiple simultaneous productions and multiple GPU workers. Build this as a scalable AI film-production system, not a prototype.

AI Video ← most important
AI App Development
AI Model Development
AI Workflow Automation
Python
Machine Learning (ML)
API Development
Cloud Computing
Full Stack Development
Video Processing

I am looking for an experienced **Adobe Illustrator designer specialized in sublimation printing and garment print patterns**.

I have a reference image of a specific clothing model/design. I need the designer to carefully recreate the printed artwork/pattern from the reference image and prepare it professionally for **direct sublimation printing on fabric**.

### Scope of Work

* Recreate the exact print/design shown on the clothing reference.
* Correct perspective distortion, fabric folds, stretching, and any deformation caused by the model wearing the garment.
* Rebuild any hidden or unclear parts of the artwork naturally and accurately.
* The final artwork must be **flat, clean, straight, and print-ready** — not a mockup and not an image of clothing on a model.
* Work must be created professionally in **Adobe Illustrator**.
* I already have the **garment cutting pattern/template in 5 different sizes**.
* The designer will place and adapt the recreated artwork correctly onto my cutting-pattern templates.
* Pattern placement and scale must remain consistent across all 5 sizes.
* Important design elements must align correctly between garment pieces and seams.
* After the first design/color is approved, approximately **12 color variations** will be required.
* All 12 versions use **the same artwork/design**; only the colors change according to the reference images I will provide.

### Deliverables

For each color variation:

* Adobe Illustrator source file (**AI**)
* Print-ready high-resolution file
* Correct artwork placement on all **5 garment sizes**
* All garment pieces correctly prepared for cutting and sublimation printing
* Clean layers and organized files
* Correct colors based on the supplied reference
* No shadows, models, fabric wrinkles, mockups, or photographic backgrounds

### Budget

**The budget for this project is $15.**

Please apply only if this budget is suitable for you.

We have **continuous and long-term work available** for the right designer, with many similar designs to be completed in the future.

If **$15 is acceptable** and you are confident you can complete the work accurately, please **send me a message or leave a comment**, and we can start immediately.

### Important

Accuracy is extremely important. I do not want an approximate or loosely inspired design. The artwork should match the original reference as closely as possible while correcting all distortions caused by the photographed garment.

The first design will be used as the master artwork. Once it is approved, the remaining color versions should follow exactly the same layout and pattern placement.

I am looking for someone experienced in **textile printing, sublimation, garment pattern placement, and Adobe Illustrator**.

If the quality is good, there will be **continuous similar work in the future**.

jobs.title: Luxury Fashion Shopify Store Setup
jobs.description:
I’m launching a high-end fashion label on Shopify and need a partner who can translate a luxury brand feel into a fast, conversion-focused storefront. The brief is open on individual product categories and visual style for now; I want to explore what looks and features will resonate best with my audience before we lock anything in. That said, I’m leaning toward a clean, elegant presentation with room for bold moments—think refined typography, generous white space and editorial-quality imagery.

Core objectives  
• Design and build a fully responsive Shopify theme that immediately signals “luxury” on desktop and mobile.  
• Structure intuitive collection and product pages so shoppers can browse effortlessly.  
• Configure payments, shipping, taxes and basic SEO so the store is ready to transact from day one.  
• Integrate best-practice apps or native features for essentials such as custom product options, customer reviews or a wishlist—happy to take your guidance on which of these will add real value.  
• Set up key content pages (About, Contact, Returns, Size Guide) and a footer mega-menu to keep everything tidy.  
• Provide a concise hand-off guide or short call so I can manage products, orders and basic theme edits myself.

Acceptance criteria  
1. Store passes Shopify speed and mobile-friendliness checks.  
2. All menu links, checkout, email notifications and payment gateways function without errors.  
3. Brand colours, fonts and imagery align with the premium aesthetic we define together.  
4. Up to five sample products are loaded so I can see the full customer journey end-to-end.

Timeline is flexible within reason, but I’d like to see initial wireframes or a staging link early so we can iterate quickly. If you have a portfolio of previous luxury, fashion or beauty stores, please include links—seeing real examples helps me decide fast.

Looking forward to collaborating and creating something exceptional.

jobs.title: Modern Elegant Interior Design Conceptualisation
jobs.description:
We are looking for an interior designer to develop the interior design and lighting concept for an existing, currently occupied living space consisting of a living room, dining area and kitchen.
This is a renovation and redesign of an existing home, not a completely new interior. The existing architectural layout and several major elements will remain and must be incorporated into the new design. The existing walls, floor tiles and kitchen cabinetry will remain and cannot be replaced. Several existing pieces of furniture and other elements will also be retained.
The goal is to transform and elevate the existing space into a cohesive, modern, elegant and warm interior, while working creatively within these existing constraints.
The living room, dining area and kitchen should be designed as one coherent interior, rather than as three separate spaces.
The project is not intended to be a full architectural or technical construction design. We are primarily looking for well-considered design solutions and practical recommendations. 

The designer will be responsible for developing the overall design concept, including the lighting, colours, materials, wall finishes, furniture and accessories. Where appropriate, we would like to receive specific, purchasable products, preferably with alternative options where appropriate.
We will provide a separate document containing the existing floor plan, dimensions, photographs of the current space, and details of the furniture and other elements that need to be retained.
A previously created 3D visualization will also be provided. This should be considered a reference for the desired mood and visual direction only, and not as a final or technically accurate design.
Important
The designer does not need to prepare a complete architectural or construction documentation package. The renovation will be carried out in several stages, and the technical details of the actual installation will be handled by the respective contractors.
What we are looking for is a well-developed and cohesive interior design concept, 3D visualizations, and specific implementation and product recommendations that we can use as a practical basis for renovating and subsequently furnishing the existing space.

jobs.title: Multi Platform ERP Suite Development
jobs.description:
I’m ready to commission a full-featured ERP that brings Accounting, Inventory Management, Human Resources, Online Sales and a POS front together under one roof. The system must run smoothly in a browser, as a desktop application, and on native iOS / Android devices so that every team member—from warehouse staff to accountants—can work on their preferred platform.

Only part of our legacy data needs to come across (customer lists and product catalogs, mainly). I will supply clean exports and will rely on you to script and validate the import so that accuracy stays high and downtime stays low.

Core workflow requirements include:  
• Real-time stock visibility spanning warehouse, retail and e-commerce channels  
• Double-entry accounting with localized tax handling, journals and audit trails  
• Employee records, leave management and payroll parameters  
• A unified product catalog that feeds both the online store and the in-house POS  
• Role-based permissions and robust reporting dashboards

I’m open to the exact stack—Laravel, Django, Node, or a comparable framework for the API layer paired with React, Vue or Angular on the front end. A relational database such as PostgreSQL or MySQL is preferred, and the code must be fully version-controlled.

Deliverables  
1. Complete, well-documented source code in a private Git repository  
2. Deployed instances: cloud-hosted web app, desktop installers, signed Android & iOS builds  
3. Data-migration scripts plus one successful test migration using my sample exports  
4. Technical and user documentation, capped by a brief hand-over workshop

Acceptance criteria: the system runs bug-free through a full purchase-to-pay and hire-to-payroll cycle on web, desktop and mobile; migrated records show at least 95 % accuracy; and automated tests pass on your CI pipeline.

Share your proposed milestones and timeline so we can move ahead.

jobs.title: BEV Controller Thermal Design
jobs.description:
I have a power-board inverter destined for a modern battery-electric vehicle and I need a complete thermal solution developed around it. The work starts with accurate 3-D modelling of the board, then moves into designing an aluminium heatsink that houses an internal liquid-coolant channel. Every design decision must be validated in ANSYS, as that is the simulation environment we use in-house.

The study has three inseparable goals: maximise heat-dissipation efficiency, keep every critical component within its target temperature window, and optimise the coolant flow path so pressure drop stays reasonable. You are free to choose the most suitable ANSYS modules—Icepak, Fluent, Mechanical, or Workbench—as long as the final package covers both conjugate heat transfer and CFD.

Deliverables
• Parametric CAD model of the aluminium heatsink with embedded coolant channel  
• ANSYS project files, meshes and boundary-condition setups ready for peer review  
• A concise report (PDF) detailing assumptions, material data, simulation results, thermal maps, flow visualisations, and design recommendations  

Acceptance will be based on meeting the temperature limits I provide after kickoff, achieving a verified pressure drop below our target, and supplying files that reproduce all results without errors on our workstation.

jobs.title: LoRa IoT Telemetry System Development
jobs.description:
Embedded hardware & firwmare engineer - LoRa IoT Telemetry System (ESP32-S3 / nRF52840)

Description

Overview

We're a start-up company building a ruggedized wireless sensor network for remote field monitoring. We're looking for an experienced embedded engineer (or a small shop) to design, assemble, flash, and bench-test production-ready sensor nodes and a cellular gateway, built to a detailed technical spec we provide after NDA.

This is a build-to-spec engagement: you own hardware sourcing/assembly and firmware implementation/validation. Cloud infrastructure, field deployment, and end-customer work are out of scope and handled in-house.

What you'll build (high level)

Battery- and solar-powered wireless sensor nodes with proximity, motion, and vibration sensing
Long-range sub-GHz (LoRa / SX1262) communication with GPS-based time synchronization
A cellular (LTE) gateway node that publishes to our cloud over MQTT
Weatherproof (IP65) field-ready enclosures with validated power and RF performance

Strong experience required with

Embedded C/C++ for ESP32-S3 and nRF52840 (RAK WisBlock) in the Arduino framework
LoRa radio work on the SX1262 (RadioLib or similar), including RF tuning
Sensor integration over I2C/UART/GPIO (PIR, accelerometer, GPS)
Cellular modems (SIM7600 / LTE) and MQTT
Li-ion / LiPo + solar charging design and validation
Antenna matching and VSWR validation (NanoVNA or antenna analyzer)
Implementing device AES-128 encryption
Clean documentation: traceable BOM, as-built wiring diagrams, bench-test logs

Deliverables

Fully assembled, firmware-flashed, bench-tested units that pass a defined acceptance checklist
Source firmware (all IP assigned to us), BOM, wiring diagrams, and QA/test documentation

Terms

Milestone-based, delivered as work-made-for-hire; all designs, source, and docs are our exclusive IP
NDA required before we share the full technical spec; standard confidentiality terms apply

jobs.title: ProDentalConnect Developer Needed
jobs.description:
# Project Description

We are looking for an experienced developer to help complete **ProDentalConnect**, a cloud-based Dental Practice Management System designed for the **UK dental market**.

The main focus of this project is the **Interactive Dental Tooth Chart / Odontogram and Clinical Workflow**.

We are specifically looking for someone who has previously worked on **dental software, odontograms, dental charting systems, treatment planning systems, or Dental Practice Management Software**. Previous UK dental software experience is highly desirable.

The dental chart must support:

* Adult and deciduous dentition
* Interactive 2D tooth chart
* Individual tooth and tooth-surface selection
* Mesial, distal, occlusal/incisal, buccal/facial and lingual/palatal surfaces
* Multi-surface restorations
* Existing conditions and historical treatment
* Proposed/open treatment
* Completed treatment
* Treatment history
* Crowns
* Bridges
* Implants
* Root canal treatment
* Fillings including amalgam and composite
* Extractions
* Missing teeth
* Dentures
* Other common dental conditions and treatments

The clinical workflow must correctly separate:

**Base Chart** – Existing conditions and historical dental work.

**Open Treatment** – Proposed or planned treatment that has not yet been completed.

**Completed Treatment** – Treatment carried out by the clinician which must update the patient's permanent clinical chart while preserving the full treatment history.

The developer should have strong experience with:

* React
* TypeScript
* Next.js
* SVG / interactive graphics
* API integration
* Clinical workflow logic

Knowledge of **UK dentistry, NHS dental workflows, FP17, NHS treatment bands, courses of treatment and private dentistry** would be a major advantage.

We are not looking for someone who has only general web development experience. We strongly prefer a developer who has **already built a dental odontogram, dental chart or Dental PMS**.

When applying, please provide screenshots, videos, links or examples of previous dental software you have developed and explain your experience with dental charting and UK dental workflows.

jobs.title: Guest Post Sales Specialist for Wedio | Paid Pilot + 25% Commission
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for an experienced guest post and link placement sales specialist who can generate leads, conduct outreach, negotiate deals and close paid orders for Wedio.com.

This is not a general lead generation role.

We need someone who already understands the guest post market, knows how SEO agencies and link buyers operate, and can take responsibility for the full outbound sales process.

ABOUT WEDIO

Wedio.com is an established international platform for filmmakers, photographers, creators and digital professionals.

Unlike many websites selling placements, Wedio is a real editorial brand with substantial organic traffic and an established audience.

Key figures:

Approximately 2.97 million users between 1 January and 22 July 2026
Approximately 440,000 users per month
Approximately 84% of traffic comes from organic search
The top 100 pages generated approximately 973,000 Google Search Console clicks during a six-month period
Ahrefs DR: 56 
More than €7,000 in direct placement revenue generated between February and July 2026 without a dedicated salesperson (all Inbound)
One existing client purchased approximately €3,000 across 12 placements

We already know that agencies and advertisers are willing to buy placements. Your job is to turn this proven demand into a scalable outbound sales channel.

WHAT YOU WILL SELL

Our products include:

Contextual link insertions in relevant existing articles
New editorial guest posts with one link
New editorial guest posts with two links
Bulk placement packages
Higher-value placements for selected platform-permitted industries, subject to prior approval

Current rates for new standard clients:

Link insertion: €120
Guest post with one link: €150
Guest post with two links: €200

Selected higher-value verticals have higher rates:

Link insertion: €300
Guest post with one link: €400
Guest post with two links: €600

Bulk discounts are possible within predefined limits but must be approved.

You may not offer unapproved prices, discounts, guarantees or placement terms.


YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

You will:

Identify qualified SEO agencies, link-building agencies, affiliate companies, digital PR agencies, brands and other relevant buyers
Find the correct decision-makers and contact information
Conduct personalised outreach through approved channels
Follow up consistently with interested prospects
Explain the commercial value of Wedio and its audience
Use approved, page-specific traffic and relevance data when selling placements
Negotiate within the approved rate card
Close orders and collect the required placement details
Maintain an accurate shared sales pipeline
Hand approved orders over to the Wedio team for final review and publication
Provide a short weekly report covering outreach, replies, opportunities and closed revenue

Wedio handles editorial approval, publication and invoicing. You will not need to publish content or make changes to the website.

COMPENSATION

We will begin with a 30-day pilot consisting of:

A $50 fixed-price pilot milestone covering onboarding, an approved prospecting plan, sales activity, pipeline documentation and weekly reporting
25% gross commission on collected net sales revenue from new clients you source and close
Commission on repeat orders from those clients for six months after their first paid order, provided you remain actively involved in managing the account
No earnings ceiling

Commission examples:

€150 guest post = €37.50 gross commission
€200 guest post = €50 gross commission
€400 placement = €100 gross commission
€600 placement = €150 gross commission
€2,000 agency package = €500 gross commission

The 25% commission is calculated before freelancer’s freelancer fees.

Commission is calculated on collected revenue excluding VAT, refunds, discounts and chargebacks.

Existing Wedio customers, existing leads and inbound enquiries are excluded unless explicitly assigned to you in writing.

Commission is paid through Freelancer after the customer’s payment has cleared.

INITIAL PILOT

Our target is at least €1,000 in collected revenue during the first 30 days, combined with a qualified and documented pipeline.

Strong performers can continue in an ongoing role and potentially take responsibility for a larger part of Wedio’s partnership and placement sales.

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

You should have:

- Documented experience selling guest posts, backlinks, media placements or similar SEO products
- Existing knowledge of SEO agencies, link buyers and affiliate businesses
- Strong written English
- Experience with cold email, LinkedIn outreach or direct agency relationships
- The ability to handle the full process from prospecting to closing
- A commercial mindset and the confidence to protect our pricing
- A structured approach to lead tracking and follow-up
- A willingness to work primarily on performance-based compensation

Experience selling placements to regulated or higher-value industries is an advantage, provided the work is permitted by Freelancer and approved by Wedio.

IMPORTANT BOUNDARIES

You may not:

- Send mass spam or use unapproved automation
- Make false claims about traffic, rankings, indexing or results
- Guarantee SEO performance
- Offer discounts or custom terms without approval
- Contact existing Wedio clients without permission
- Sell placements involving illegal, deceptive, exploitative or otherwise prohibited content
- Commit Wedio to publishing content before editorial approval

All content and advertisers remain subject to final approval by Wedio.

HOW TO APPLY

Start your proposal with “WEDIO SALES” and answer every question below:

- What experience do you have selling guest posts, backlinks or media placements?
- What sales revenue or number of placements have you personally generated?
- Which types of buyers do you already know or have experience contacting?
- How would you build your prospect list for Wedio?
- Which outreach channels and tools would you use?
- Write a short example email you would send to an SEO or link-building agency.
- What revenue do you realistically expect to close during the first 30 days?
- Are you comfortable with a small fixed pilot payment plus 25% commission and no ongoing hourly salary?
- Do you have experience selling placements to regulated or higher-value industries?

Generic applications that do not answer these questions will not be considered.

jobs.title: Full-Stack Dev for AI-Integrated CRM
jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced **Full-Stack Developer / AI Automation Specialist** to build a simple and scalable **Customer Management & Automation System**.

### Project Overview

We need a web-based system that helps a small team manage customers, automate repetitive customer-management tasks, and monitor the customer journey from initial contact through onboarding, active usage, follow-up, and renewal.

The system should be designed with **automation and AI integration in mind**, but the first version should remain simple, reliable, and easy to use.

### Core Requirements

The system should include:

* Customer management
* Employee/user management
* Customer assignment to employees
* Customer journey/status tracking
* Tasks and follow-ups
* Customer activity tracking
* Communication history
* Notifications and reminders
* Customer status and health indicators
* Basic dashboard and reports
* Role-based access and permissions

### Customer Journey

The system should allow us to define and track customizable customer stages, for example:

**New Lead → Questionnaire → Proposal → Contract → Payment → Account Setup → Training → Activation → Active Customer → Follow-up → Renewal**

Each customer should have a clear timeline showing their current stage, completed steps, pending actions, and next required action.

### Automation

The system should automatically perform repetitive tasks such as:

* Sending reminders
* Following up with customers
* Creating tasks for employees
* Detecting pending actions
* Notifying employees about important customer activities
* Identifying inactive customers
* Sending renewal reminders
* Updating customer status based on system events

### AI Integration

The architecture should allow future integration with an AI Agent.

The AI should eventually be able to:

* Analyze customer messages
* Identify customer intent
* Detect customers requiring attention
* Create follow-up tasks
* Summarize conversations
* Recommend the next action
* Answer basic customer questions using an approved knowledge base
* Escalate complex or sensitive cases to a human employee

The AI must not make high-risk decisions without human approval.

### Communication Integration

The system should be designed to integrate with external communication channels such as:

* WhatsApp
* Email
* Internal chat

Customer communications should be linked to the relevant customer profile and used as a source for automation and follow-up.

### Dashboard

The dashboard should provide a simple overview of:

* Total customers
* Active customers
* Customers requiring attention
* Pending tasks
* Overdue follow-ups
* Customer journey distribution
* Employee workload
* Customer activity
* Upcoming renewals

The goal is to make the system easy to understand and operate without unnecessary complexity.

### Technical Expectations

The solution should be:

* Modern web application
* Responsive
* Secure
* Scalable
* API-ready
* Modular
* Easy to maintain
* Suitable for future AI integration

The developer should provide a clean architecture with well-documented APIs and database structure.

### Important

We are **not looking for an overly complicated CRM**.

The priority is to build a **simple operational system that automates repetitive customer-management tasks and gives employees clear visibility into what needs to be done.**

The project should be developed in phases, starting with the core customer-management and automation features, followed by AI and communication integrations.

Please include in your proposal:

1. Recommended technology stack
2. Proposed architecture
3. Development timeline
4. Estimated cost
5. Relevant experience with AI agents and automation
6. Experience integrating WhatsApp/Email APIs
7. Examples of similar projects
8. What you recommend for the MVP phase

jobs.title: Employee Reimbursement Automation System
jobs.description:
MICROSOFT POWER AUTOMATE FINAL PROJECT 

Employee Expense Reimbursement Automation 

Final Training Assignment | Completion Window: 20th Aug 2026 

 

1. Project Objective 

Build end-to-end employee reimbursement automation using Microsoft Forms, Power Automate, Dataverse, Outlook, AI Builder Prompt, AI Builder Document Processing, Approvals, and reusable Child Flows. 

The solution should receive reimbursement requests, validate the submission, process the supporting document, use AI to evaluate the request, route it through the appropriate approval process, update Dataverse throughout its lifecycle, and notify relevant users. 

Excel must not be used as part of the solution. Supporting documents may include PDF, JPG, PNG, or DOCX files, but Excel files must not be processed. 

2. Employee Request Form 

Create a Microsoft Form named Employee Reimbursement Request. 

Employee Name 

Employee Email 

Employee ID 

Expense Category 

Expense Date 

Claimed Amount 

Currency 

Business Justification 

Manager Email 

Supporting Document 

Expense categories: Travel, Hotel, Meals, Transportation, Training, Other. 

The employee must be able to upload a supporting document. 

3. Dataverse Requirements 

Create a Dataverse table for reimbursement requests containing, at minimum: 

Request ID 

Employee Name 

Employee Email 

Employee ID 

Expense Category 

Expense Date 

Claimed Amount 

Currency 

Business Justification 

Manager Email 

AI Validation Result 

AI Confidence Score 

Status 

Rejection Reason 

Submitted Date 

Create a second table for processed documents containing: 

Document ID 

Request ID 

File Name 

Document Type 

Vendor 

Document Date 

Extracted Amount 

Confidence Score 

Processing Status 

Create a third table for Approval History containing, at minimum: 

Approval ID 

Request ID 

Approver 

Decision 

Comments 

Approval Date 

4. Request Validation 

Validate each new request before normal processing. The solution must identify: 

Missing Employee ID 

Missing Manager Email 

Zero or negative claimed amount 

Expense date in the future 

Missing supporting document 

Invalid requests must be recorded in Dataverse with an appropriate status and the employee must be notified through Outlook. 

5. Duplicate Detection 

Check Dataverse for an existing request where Employee ID, Expense Date, and Claimed Amount match the new request. Duplicate requests must not proceed through normal processing. 

Record the duplicate status and notify the employee. 

6. Document Processing 

Process the uploaded supporting document using AI Builder Document Processing. 

Extract relevant information such as: 

Vendor name 

Document/receipt number, if available 

Document date 

Total amount 

Currency 

Document type 

Store the extracted information in Dataverse and compare the extracted amount with the employee's claimed amount. 

7. AI Builder Prompt 

Create an AI Builder Prompt to evaluate the reimbursement request. 

The prompt should consider: 

Business justification 

Expense category 

Claimed amount 

Extracted amount 

Vendor 

Document date 

Document type 

The prompt should determine: 

Whether the document appears relevant to the request 

Whether the claimed amount matches the document 

Whether the expense category is appropriate 

Whether there are inconsistencies 

Risk level 

Recommendation 

Confidence score 

Reason for the recommendation 

The prompt output must be structured so that Power Automate can reliably consume it. 

8. Business Rules 

Expense age: If the expense is more than 60 days old, automatically reject the request. 

Amount: If the claimed amount is ₹5,000 or less, require manager approval. If it is greater than ₹5,000, require manager approval followed by Finance approval. 

Amount mismatch: If the claimed amount does not match the extracted document amount, send the request for manual review. 

AI confidence: If AI validation confidence is below 80%, send the request for manual review. 

Successful validation: If validation passes, proceed to the appropriate approval process. 

9. Approval 

Use Power Automate Approvals. 

Requests of ₹5,000 or less require Manager approval. 

Requests above ₹5,000 require Manager approval followed by Finance approval. 

Approvers should be able to see employee details, category, date, claimed amount, extracted amount, AI validation result, AI confidence, and business justification. 

10. Dataverse Status Management 

Maintain an appropriate status throughout the request lifecycle. Suggested statuses: 

Submitted 

Validation Failed 

Processing 

Manual Review 

Awaiting Manager Approval 

Awaiting Finance Approval 

Approved 

Rejected 

Duplicate 

Failed 

Update the Dataverse record whenever the request moves to a new stage. 

11. Outlook Notifications 

Submission confirmation to the employee 

Validation failure notification to the employee 

Manual review notification to the employee 

Approval request notification to the manager 

Finance approval notification where applicable 

Approval confirmation to the employee 

Rejection notification to the employee with the reason where available 

12. Child Flows 

The solution must contain at least two reusable Child Flows. Child Flows should have clearly defined inputs and outputs and should provide reusable functionality rather than simply splitting one large flow. 

13. Error Handling 

Implement proper error handling for failures involving Dataverse, Document Processing, AI Prompt, Outlook, or Approvals. 

Update the Dataverse record with an appropriate failure status 

Capture useful error information 

Notify the support/automation team 

Avoid leaving requests stuck indefinitely in an intermediate state 

14. Solution Management 

The entire project must be created inside a Power Platform Solution. 

Use appropriate Connection References 

Use Environment Variables where appropriate 

Follow consistent naming conventions 

Avoid hard-coding configurable values such as email addresses where an environment variable or configuration approach is appropriate 

15. Testing Requirements 

Test at least the following scenarios: 

Valid request under ₹5,000 

Valid request above ₹5,000 

Missing mandatory information 

Missing attachment 

Duplicate request 

Expense older than 60 days 

Amount mismatch 

AI confidence below 80% 

Manager rejection 

Finance rejection 

Successful approval 

Document-processing failure 

Document the expected result, actual result, Pass/Fail status, and screenshots where useful. 

16. Deliverables 

Power Platform Solution containing all required components 

Architecture diagram showing major components and data flow 

Dataverse design including tables, columns, relationships, and choices 

Final AI Builder Prompt and a brief explanation of its purpose 

Test document containing test cases, inputs, expected results, actual results, Pass/Fail status, and relevant screenshots 

README explaining architecture, flow responsibilities, Child Flows, Dataverse design, AI implementation, error handling, assumptions, and limitations 

17. Completion Timeline 

You will have one week to complete the project. The one-week window is intentional so that the assignment can be completed alongside regular project responsibilities. 

Expected hands-on effort: approximately 14–20 hours depending on prior experience with Dataverse, AI Builder, and Power Automate. 

You are expected to design the solution yourself. You may use Microsoft documentation and other learning resources, but the final implementation should be your own. 

18. Evaluation Focus 

The project will be evaluated on: 

Correctness and completeness of the requirements 

Solution architecture and separation of responsibilities 

Dataverse design and data relationships 

Effective use of Child Flows 

Quality and reliability of AI Prompt implementation 

Document-processing implementation 

Business-rule implementation 

Error handling and resilience 

Maintainability, naming, and use of Solutions/Connection References/Environment Variables 

Testing coverage 

Overall quality of the final solution
