jobs.title: Employee Expense Reimbursement Automation
jobs.description:
POWER AUTOMATE FINAL PROJECT 

Employee Expense Reimbursement Automation 

Final Training Assignment | Completion Window: 20th Aug 2026 

 

1. Project Objective 

Build end-to-end employee reimbursement automation using Microsoft Forms, Power Automate, Dataverse, Outlook, AI Builder Prompt, AI Builder Document Processing, Approvals, and reusable Child Flows. 

The solution should receive reimbursement requests, validate the submission, process the supporting document, use AI to evaluate the request, route it through the appropriate approval process, update Dataverse throughout its lifecycle, and notify relevant users. 

Excel must not be used as part of the solution. Supporting documents may include PDF, JPG, PNG, or DOCX files, but Excel files must not be processed. 

2. Employee Request Form 

Create a Microsoft Form named Employee Reimbursement Request. 

Employee Name 

Employee Email 

Employee ID 

Expense Category 

Expense Date 

Claimed Amount 

Currency 

Business Justification 

Manager Email 

Supporting Document 

Expense categories: Travel, Hotel, Meals, Transportation, Training, Other. 

The employee must be able to upload a supporting document. 

3. Dataverse Requirements 

Create a Dataverse table for reimbursement requests containing, at minimum: 

Request ID 

Employee Name 

Employee Email 

Employee ID 

Expense Category 

Expense Date 

Claimed Amount 

Currency 

Business Justification 

Manager Email 

AI Validation Result 

AI Confidence Score 

Status 

Rejection Reason 

Submitted Date 

Create a second table for processed documents containing: 

Document ID 

Request ID 

File Name 

Document Type 

Vendor 

Document Date 

Extracted Amount 

Confidence Score 

Processing Status 

Create a third table for Approval History containing, at minimum: 

Approval ID 

Request ID 

Approver 

Decision 

Comments 

Approval Date 

4. Request Validation 

Validate each new request before normal processing. The solution must identify: 

Missing Employee ID 

Missing Manager Email 

Zero or negative claimed amount 

Expense date in the future 

Missing supporting document 

Invalid requests must be recorded in Dataverse with an appropriate status and the employee must be notified through Outlook. 

5. Duplicate Detection 

Check Dataverse for an existing request where Employee ID, Expense Date, and Claimed Amount match the new request. Duplicate requests must not proceed through normal processing. 

Record the duplicate status and notify the employee. 

6. Document Processing 

Process the uploaded supporting document using AI Builder Document Processing. 

Extract relevant information such as: 

Vendor name 

Document/receipt number, if available 

Document date 

Total amount 

Currency 

Document type 

Store the extracted information in Dataverse and compare the extracted amount with the employee's claimed amount. 

7. AI Builder Prompt 

Create an AI Builder Prompt to evaluate the reimbursement request. 

The prompt should consider: 

Business justification 

Expense category 

Claimed amount 

Extracted amount 

Vendor 

Document date 

Document type 

The prompt should determine: 

Whether the document appears relevant to the request 

Whether the claimed amount matches the document 

Whether the expense category is appropriate 

Whether there are inconsistencies 

Risk level 

Recommendation 

Confidence score 

Reason for the recommendation 

The prompt output must be structured so that Power Automate can reliably consume it. 

8. Business Rules 

Expense age: If the expense is more than 60 days old, automatically reject the request. 

Amount: If the claimed amount is ₹5,000 or less, require manager approval. If it is greater than ₹5,000, require manager approval followed by Finance approval. 

Amount mismatch: If the claimed amount does not match the extracted document amount, send the request for manual review. 

AI confidence: If AI validation confidence is below 80%, send the request for manual review. 

Successful validation: If validation passes, proceed to the appropriate approval process. 

9. Approval 

Use Power Automate Approvals. 

Requests of ₹5,000 or less require Manager approval. 

Requests above ₹5,000 require Manager approval followed by Finance approval. 

Approvers should be able to see employee details, category, date, claimed amount, extracted amount, AI validation result, AI confidence, and business justification. 

10. Dataverse Status Management 

Maintain an appropriate status throughout the request lifecycle. Suggested statuses: 

Submitted 

Validation Failed 

Processing 

Manual Review 

Awaiting Manager Approval 

Awaiting Finance Approval 

Approved 

Rejected 

Duplicate 

Failed 

Update the Dataverse record whenever the request moves to a new stage. 

11. Outlook Notifications 

Submission confirmation to the employee 

Validation failure notification to the employee 

Manual review notification to the employee 

Approval request notification to the manager 

Finance approval notification where applicable 

Approval confirmation to the employee 

Rejection notification to the employee with the reason where available 

12. Child Flows 

The solution must contain at least two reusable Child Flows. Child Flows should have clearly defined inputs and outputs and should provide reusable functionality rather than simply splitting one large flow. 

13. Error Handling 

Implement proper error handling for failures involving Dataverse, Document Processing, AI Prompt, Outlook, or Approvals. 

Update the Dataverse record with an appropriate failure status 

Capture useful error information 

Notify the support/automation team 

Avoid leaving requests stuck indefinitely in an intermediate state 

14. Solution Management 

The entire project must be created inside a Power Platform Solution. 

Use appropriate Connection References 

Use Environment Variables where appropriate 

Follow consistent naming conventions 

Avoid hard-coding configurable values such as email addresses where an environment variable or configuration approach is appropriate 

15. Testing Requirements 

Test at least the following scenarios: 

Valid request under ₹5,000 

Valid request above ₹5,000 

Missing mandatory information 

Missing attachment 

Duplicate request 

Expense older than 60 days 

Amount mismatch 

AI confidence below 80% 

Manager rejection 

Finance rejection 

Successful approval 

Document-processing failure 

Document the expected result, actual result, Pass/Fail status, and screenshots where useful. 

16. Deliverables 

Power Platform Solution containing all required components 

Architecture diagram showing major components and data flow 

Dataverse design including tables, columns, relationships, and choices 

Final AI Builder Prompt and a brief explanation of its purpose 

Test document containing test cases, inputs, expected results, actual results, Pass/Fail status, and relevant screenshots 

README explaining architecture, flow responsibilities, Child Flows, Dataverse design, AI implementation, error handling, assumptions, and limitations 

17. Completion Timeline 

You will have one week to complete the project. The one-week window is intentional so that the assignment can be completed alongside regular project responsibilities. 

Expected hands-on effort: approximately 14–20 hours depending on prior experience with Dataverse, AI Builder, and Power Automate. 

You are expected to design the solution yourself. You may use Microsoft documentation and other learning resources, but the final implementation should be your own. 

18. Evaluation Focus 

The project will be evaluated on: 

Correctness and completeness of the requirements 

Solution architecture and separation of responsibilities 

Dataverse design and data relationships 

Effective use of Child Flows 

Quality and reliability of AI Prompt implementation 

Document-processing implementation 

Business-rule implementation 

Error handling and resilience 

Maintainability, naming, and use of Solutions/Connection References/Environment Variables 

Testing coverage 

Overall quality of the final solution

Deliverables  
1. A 20–30 second 1920 × 1080 (or higher) master in MP4/H.264.  
2. Clean version without supers or music for future re-cuts.  
3. Source project files with textures and lighting rigs organised.  
4. Up to three stills at print resolution pulled from key moments.  

Acceptance criteria: the shoe’s materials must faithfully match the real sample we provide via reference photos; camera moves remain smooth with no visible mesh artefacts; and turn-around time for the first WIP is one week from project start.  

Let me know your preferred software, any previous footwear or product-promo work you’ve done, and an estimated schedule for milestones and revisions.

jobs.title: Chimney Removal Calculation
jobs.description:
I need a professional to calculate the structural implications and provide a detailed plan for removing a non-functional chimney on a party wall of a residential house. 

Key requirements:
- Assess structural integrity and provide safety recommendations
- Detail necessary supports or reinforcements
- Ensure compliance with local building codes
- Provide a comprehensive, easy-to-understand report

Ideal skills and experience:
- Structural engineering background
- Experience with residential renovations
- Knowledge of local building regulations
- Strong analytical and report-writing skills

Please share relevant qualifications and experience.

jobs.title: PLAXIS Geotechnical Engineering Training
jobs.description:
I want to move beyond textbook knowledge and become fully productive with PLAXIS on real geotechnical problems. The priority is practical, software-driven learning, so each session should revolve around the tool itself while weaving in just enough theory to show why every choice in the model matters.  


We will stay inside PLAXIS for most of the course, covering:  
• Building and validating 2D/3D models from borehole data and site reports  
• Running staged construction simulations, interpreting the results, and troubleshooting convergence  
• Unlocking advanced options—user-defined soil models, scripting, parameter sensitivity studies, and output customization  
- Spanish Language only

Along the way, please anchor the lessons to one complete project (for example, a deep excavation, embankment, or foundation system) so I can see the entire workflow from raw data to design decisions and final report. I am open to quick detours into GeoStudio or STAAD.Pro comparisons if that helps explain a concept, but PLAXIS remains the core platform.  

Deliverables  
- Live, interactive training sessions (screen-share or classroom style) totaling 12–15 hours  
- Model files, datasets, and step-by-step notes for every exercise  
- Brief theoretical handouts that connect soil mechanics principles to the software actions  
- Post-session assignments with your written feedback  
- A wrap-up Q&A and a completion certificate or summary letter I can share with my employer  

Acceptance criteria: the final exercise must reproduce a published case history or site investigation of comparable complexity, with results that fall within the documented range for displacements, factors of safety, and pore pressures.  

If this structured, application-first approach fits your expertise, let’s schedule a quick call and outline the timetable.

jobs.title: Recruitment Trainee for Candidate Sourcing
jobs.description:
Our short-term rental portfolio is growing and a new Co-Listing Agent role has opened. I need help generating a steady pipeline of suitable applicants, and this assignment is designed for someone who wants hands-on experience in talent sourcing.

What you will do  
You will focus on LinkedIn search to uncover professionals who match the profile I will outline. The single non-negotiable criterion is strong communication skills; prior short-term rental experience or flexible availability are nice bonuses but not mandatory. Once you have identified prospects, send a concise, friendly email (template supplied) that introduces the opportunity, answers basic questions, and requests a current CV.

I will stay close during the first few days to provide feedback on target keywords, seniority level, and geographic focus, then give you room to work independently while still checking progress together.

Deliverables  
• Google Sheet (or Excel) listing each approached candidate with LinkedIn URL, email address, outreach date, and response status  
• Folder containing every CV received  
• Final recap showing number of messages sent, replies, and qualified, interested candidates

Acceptance criteria  
A candidate is counted as qualified when the sheet shows: communication skill evidence on their profile, positive email reply, and CV attached.

If you are reliable, organised, and comfortable navigating LinkedIn, this project will give you practical recruitment experience while helping me fill a key role quickly.

jobs.title: Long-term Inhouse-SEO Expert/ Fulfillment Partner — Website SEO + Google Maps
jobs.description:
We are an established digital marketing agency with 15+ years of experience, currently expanding a new brand focused specifically on the Spanish-speaking Hispanic business market in the United States.

We are looking for an experienced SEO professional or fulfillment partner to work with us long-term as we scale.

This is **not an entry-level SEO position**, and we are not looking for someone who simply knows how to run audits, install plugins, build reports, or send generic monthly updates.

**We need someone who can rank businesses.**


What We Need:
Ideally, we want one expert who is highly experienced in both:

* Local SEO / Google Maps / Google Business Profile
* Website SEO / Organic Rankings

However, we are open to hiring **two separate specialists** if necessary — one dedicated to organic SEO and another dedicated specifically to Google Maps.


Minimum Requirements:
* **5+ years of proven SEO experience**
* Strong Local SEO / Google Maps experience
* Strong organic website SEO experience
* Proven experience ranking local service businesses
* Technical SEO
* On-page SEO
* Local landing page optimization
* Google Business Profile optimization
* Citation and authority building
* Link building
* Competitor analysis
* Keyword research and tracking
* Ability to diagnose ranking problems quickly
* Strong understanding of what actually moves rankings — not just theory

Performance Expectations:

Our agency operates with **strict performance guarantees**, so fulfillment and execution are extremely important.

We need to be able to demonstrate **measurable movement within the first 30 days**.

Over the following **60–90 days**, depending on the market and competition, our objective is to achieve meaningful first-page organic rankings and Top 3 Google Map Pack visibility for targeted keywords.

We understand SEO is not magic and every market is different.

However, we are **not looking for an SEO provider who needs 6 months before anything measurable happens.**

We need a partner who understands how to identify the highest-impact opportunities quickly, execute aggressively, and produce measurable progress.

Compensation & Opportunity

Our SEO packages begin at approximately **$997 per client**, with higher packages depending on the campaign. Our Average AOV: is $1997/mo

We are interested in structuring this as a **volume-based partnership**, where compensation can be based on an agreed percentage or fulfillment rate depending on the number of active clients.

The opportunity can become significant.

Our current acquisition system is generating approximately **3–5 booked sales calls per day**, and we are building this side of the agency specifically for long-term scale.

We are not looking for someone to handle two projects and disappear.

**We are looking for a long-term SEO partner who can grow with our client volume.**

DO NOT Send a Generic Upwork Proposal

If you're interested, prove that you can rank businesses.

Please begin your proposal with:

**"I CAN RANK "**

Then send us **2–3 REAL examples** of campaigns you've personally worked on.

For at least one **Google Maps / Local SEO campaign**, tell us:

**Business/Niche:**
**City/Market:**
**Starting Position:**
**Keywords Targeted:**
**Position After Your Work:**
**How Long It Took:**
**What You Did to Achieve It:**

For at least one **organic website SEO campaign**, tell us:

**Business/Niche:**
**Starting Organic Position/Traffic:**
**Target Keywords:**
**Results Achieved:**
**Timeframe:**
**What You Did to Achieve It:**

Screenshots from ranking trackers, Search Console, Analytics, GBP performance, or other verifiable case-study data are strongly preferred.

**Do not just send us your agency website or a list of services.**

We want to see **before → after → timeframe → what you actually did.**

If you cannot demonstrate previous ranking results, this partnership probably isn't the right fit.

We have been in digital marketing for more than 15 years. This is a new market and brand expansion for us — **not our first rodeo in digital marketing.**

We're looking for someone who knows SEO at a very high level, understands accountability, and wants to build a profitable long-term partnership as our client volume grows.

jobs.title: הטמעת מדור חדשות עולמיות
jobs.description:
יש לי לוח מודעות קיים ואני מעוניין להעשיר אותו במדור חדשות מהעולם כדי להגדיל תנועה ולשפר את הקידום האורגני. המדור צריך למשוך כותרות ותקצירים עדכניים שעוסקים בכלכלה, טכנולוגיה ואירועים מרכזיים ברחבי העולם – בלי ספורט ובלי חדשות בידור.

jobs.title: Elegant Event Poster Design
jobs.description:
I’m ready to commission the first piece of a larger visual campaign: an elegant, classy poster that will promote an upcoming event. The look has to feel premium—clean typography, balanced negative space, and a sophisticated colour palette that stands out both in print and on-screen.

Please share a portfolio that showcases event promotion work with an elegant or upscale aesthetic, along with your pricing and typical turnaround times. If you have package rates for multi-asset projects, let me know—clear, upfront numbers will help me schedule the rest of the campaign quickly.

jobs.title: Home TT Earthing Design Consultation
jobs.description:
My new house is almost ready and I now need a complete earthing design before any circuits go live. I have already decided on a TT system, so the assignment is strictly design-and-planning: no on-site installation work, just a clear, code-compliant plan that my electrician can follow.

What I expect back from you:
• A schematic showing earth electrode layout, conductor sizing, and connection points  
• Calculations that justify electrode quantity, spacing, and conductor cross-sections  
• A concise materials list so I can price everything locally  
• Brief installation notes and testing values that my electrician should aim for  

I am in no rush, but I do want the design to adhere to the relevant national wiring regulations and any best-practice references you normally follow. Please outline your approach, the standards you design to, and an estimated turnaround time when you respond.

jobs.title: Pediatric Ultrasound DICOM Lump Review
jobs.description:
I have a high-resolution DICOM file from an ultrasound of my baby, taken because a small lump has appeared just above the bridge of the nose. I need a qualified radiologist to open the study in your preferred DICOM viewer (RadiAnt, OsiriX, Horos, or equivalent), analyse every slice, and tell me plainly:

• What exactly does the image suggest this lump is?
• Could it be cancerous or otherwise serious?
• Any observations about its borders, vascularity, relation to surrounding structures, or other red flags I should bring to my paediatrician immediately.

Please include precise measurements, relevant screenshots if needed, and a short written report in everyday language alongside standard radiology terminology. I will deliver the DICOM via a secure transfer link as soon as we start. Turnaround within 24–48 hours would be ideal because local appointments take weeks.

Let me know your credentials and estimated timeframe, and I’ll send the file right away.

jobs.title: Marketplace Integrations Configuration Project
jobs.description:
I’m building the BlueWay statewide marketplace and need an experienced hand to connect five off-the-shelf platforms—Shopify, Simvoly, Storepoint, Webkul MultiVendor Marketplace, and BixGrow—into one smooth experience. No custom coding or new APIs are required; this is a focused configuration job expected to take roughly 8–10 hours.

The heart of the project is a highly searchable Storepoint directory with category filters, hours, and custom buttons, so your first priority will be getting that live and looking great. Behind the scenes, businesses must be able to create and manage their own listings on Shopify through Webkul’s Automated self-registration flow.  

Once those two pieces talk to each other, you’ll:

• Install and configure Webkul in Shopify so merchants can self-onboard, edit profiles, and publish immediately.  
• Build a single Simvoly landing page that collects payments, then embeds the live Storepoint directory.  
• Configure BixGrow so community groups can track affiliate referrals from day one.  
• Run end-to-end tests on every customer path—from a visitor using the directory search to a merchant updating a product—to be sure nothing breaks.

I’m looking for someone who has set up these specific apps before and can move quickly. When you reply, let me know your hourly rate and give me a concise rundown of similar integrations you’ve completed. If everything aligns, we’ll lock in the timeline and get you access so you can start right away.

jobs.title: API Testing & Teams SSO Training
jobs.description:
Job Title: API Testing & Auth/Integration Trainer (Training-Only Role)

jobs.title: Logo and Packaging Update
jobs.description:

jobs.title: Natural-Look Photo Retouching
jobs.description:
I have a batch of images that need thoughtful, professional attention in Photoshop so they look their best while still feeling completely natural. The final result should enhance what is already there rather than transform the photos into something artificial.  

You are free to decide which combination of colour correction, subtle skin work, or background clean-up will achieve that result; my priority is that nothing appears over-edited. Please work non-destructively, keep textures intact, and return both flattened JPEGs (ready for web and print) and layered PSDs so I can make tiny tweaks later if needed.

Deliverables
• One high-resolution JPEG and one layered PSD for each supplied image  
• Consistent natural-looking colour, balanced tones, and believable skin texture across the entire set  
• All edits organised in clearly named layers

I will supply the raw files as soon as we start. Let me know your turnaround time and any questions you have about maintaining the natural look.

jobs.title: Scientific atom teleportation Animation
jobs.description:
I have written a detailed, scene-by-scene outline that visualises a theoretical process for transporting atoms: analysis of their information, transmission (with room for potential data loss), and precise reconstruction at a distant point. I now need that script turned into a short, simple 2D animation that mirrors my notes exactly.

Throughout the video I want clear on-screen text to highlight key scientific terms, a formal, authoritative voiceover that matches the tone of an academic lecture, and a subtle bed of background music to keep the pacing steady. Please synchronise the audio with the visual cues I specify so the flow feels seamless.

I will supply:
• A written storyboard with timing, camera directions, colour cues, and any diagrams I have sketched.  
• The exact wording for all on-screen text and the narration script.  
• References for the scientific concepts so you can illustrate them accurately.

What I need from you:
• A polished 2D animation (1080p preferred) that adheres closely to my storyboard.  
• Professional-quality voiceover delivered in a formal, scientific style—either record it yourself or manage a VO talent.  
• Background music mixed at a level that never competes with the narration.  
• Source project files (After Effects, Toon Boom, or similar) plus the final rendered video.  
• Two feedback rounds to fine-tune timing or graphics if required.

If you have experience illustrating scientific concepts, motion-graphics-driven explanations, or whiteboard-style clarity in a 2D environment, your expertise will be ideal here. Let me know what software you prefer, how you handle VO and music licensing, and an estimated turnaround once you receive my materials.

jobs.title: Skincare D2C Marketing Consultant for Indian Market

jobs.title: Print-Ready FDM Product CAD

jobs.title: Meta Ads Coaching & Kampagnenführung

jobs.title: Fusion 360 Mesh-to-Gcode
jobs.description:
I have a finished 3D mesh that now needs to become real. Your job is to bring it into Fusion 360, prep it for cutting on a 3-axis router, and hand back clean, ready-to-run G-code.

Material & machine context  
The stock we work with is EVA foam, occasionally laminated to a thin composite backer. Everything will be cut on a standard 3-axis setup, so please keep the toolpaths strictly 2D/3-axis friendly—no simultaneous 5-axis moves.

What I will supply  
• The mesh file (OBJ/STL).  
• Overall dimensions and any hold-down constraints.  
• Reference photos for colour-accurate rendering.

What I need back  
• A fully parametric Fusion 360 file with bodies, setups, tools, and operations organised in the browser.  
• Verified G-code that respects my machine’s post (I’ll provide the post file).  
• One or two high-quality renders so I can show the client a visual before we cut.

Key points  
• Optimise roughing and finishing passes for foam: shallow step-downs, high feed, minimal dwell.  
• Dog-bone or ramped entry where suitable to avoid foam tear-out.  
• Name and comment operations clearly; I want to see your logic at a glance.  
• No proprietary plugins—everything must be reproducible in vanilla Fusion 360.

Once I confirm the toolpaths simulate without collision, I release final approval. If that sounds straightforward, let’s get the spindle turning.

jobs.title: Logo & Branding Design Contest

jobs.title: Culinary Branding & Content Creation

jobs.title: Academic Content Writer Needed Remotely - 27/08/2026 07:36 EDT

jobs.title: Viết Caption Truyền Cảm Hứng -- 2
jobs.description:
Tôi muốn hợp tác với một bạn chuyên viết caption truyền cảm hứng cho bài đăng mạng xã hội. Công việc rất đơn giản: nhận chủ đề, ý tưởng hoặc hình ảnh từ tôi và chuyển chúng thành những dòng caption cuốn hút, lan tỏa năng lượng tích cực.

Bạn phù hợp nếu:
• Có lối viết súc tích, giàu cảm hứng nhưng vẫn tự nhiên, không khoa trương.  
• Hiểu tâm lý người dùng mạng xã hội và nắm bắt xu hướng ngôn ngữ hiện tại.  
• Sẵn sàng chỉnh sửa nhanh khi cần thay đổi giọng điệu hoặc độ dài.  

Tôi sẽ trao đổi cụ thể về:
• Số lượng caption mỗi lần giao việc.

jobs.title: Agric Drone Service Portal & Admin System
jobs.description:
# Custom Client Portal & Work Order Management System for Agricultural Drone Services

## Project Overview

We are looking for an experienced **full-stack developer or development team** to design and build a modern customer portal and internal administration system for an Australian agricultural drone services business.

The platform will be used by **farmers, agricultural businesses, councils and commercial clients** to create accounts, submit work orders, request/book jobs, upload property information and maps, track jobs, access quotes, invoices and completed job reports.

We will also require a separate **Admin Portal** where our team can manage customers, work orders, bookings, schedules, quotes, jobs, invoices and reports.

This needs to be a professional, scalable system — **not simply a WordPress contact/booking form**.

## Customer Portal

Customers should be able to:

* Register and log into a secure account
* Create a company/farm/organisation profile
* Add multiple users under one organisation
* Add and save multiple properties/sites
* Submit new work orders
* Enter their own Purchase Order / Work Order number
* Request/book drone services
* Select service type
* Enter hectares/area
* Enter preferred service dates
* Add site contacts
* Enter chemical/fertiliser/product information
* Enter application/spreading rates
* Add job instructions
* Upload photos and documents
* Upload property/paddock maps
* Upload KML/KMZ and relevant mapping files
* View current and previous jobs
* Track job status
* View upcoming scheduled work
* Receive notifications when job status changes
* View, accept or decline quotes
* View/download invoices
* See invoice/payment status
* Access completed job/application reports
* Contact support through the portal

## Job Status Workflow

We would like a clear workflow such as:

**Request Submitted → Under Review → Quote Sent → Quote Accepted → Scheduled → In Progress → Completed → Invoiced → Paid**

Administrators must be able to change statuses and customers should see relevant updates from their account.

## Mapping / Property Functionality

Mapping is an important part of this project.

We would like customers to be able to:

* Search for their property/location
* View satellite imagery
* Drop a pin on the property
* Draw paddock/working-area boundaries
* Automatically calculate hectares from the selected boundary
* Save paddocks/properties to their account
* Upload existing KML/KMZ mapping files
* Attach selected paddocks to a work order

Experience with **Google Maps, Mapbox or similar GIS/mapping APIs** would be highly regarded.

## Admin Portal

Our staff need a separate administration dashboard where we can:

* View incoming work orders
* Approve/review job requests
* Manage customers and organisations
* Manage multiple contacts/users under organisations
* Manage properties and paddocks
* Create and send quotes
* Schedule jobs
* Assign operators/teams
* View jobs on a calendar
* Update job status
* Manage services and pricing
* Record hectares completed
* Record chemicals/products and application rates
* Add internal notes
* Upload job documents/photos
* Generate completion/application reports
* Create/manage invoices
* Record payment status
* View outstanding accounts
* Search/filter previous jobs
* View basic business reporting

## Customer Dashboard

The customer dashboard should provide a simple overview showing:

* Active Jobs
* Upcoming Jobs
* Completed Jobs
* Outstanding Invoices
* Recent Work Orders
* Upcoming Schedule
* Account Status
* Quick button to Book/Request a New Job

The interface needs to be **clean, modern, fast and extremely easy to use on desktop, tablet and mobile**.

## Job Completion Reports

Once a job is completed, we want the ability to generate a professional report containing information such as:

* Customer
* Property/site
* Work order number
* Date
* Operator
* Drone/equipment
* Service performed
* Total hectares completed
* Product/chemical/fertiliser
* Application rate
* Weather information
* Job notes
* Before/after photos where applicable
* Application/flight map where available

Customers should be able to download completed reports from their account.

## Invoicing & Accounts

Each organisation may have different payment terms such as:

**7 Days / 14 Days / 30 Days**

Customers should be able to see their invoices, due dates, outstanding balance and payment status.

Ideally the system should be designed so that accounting software/API integration can be added.

Experience integrating platforms such as **Xero** would be beneficial.

## Notifications

We would like the ability to send automated email notifications for events such as:

* Work order received
* Quote available
* Quote accepted
* Job scheduled
* Schedule changed
* Job completed
* Invoice issued
* Invoice overdue

SMS notification integration may also be required.

## User Permissions

The system should support different permissions.

For example, a commercial organisation may have:

**Administrator** – Full company account access
**Operations Manager** – Jobs/work orders
**Site Manager** – Assigned properties/jobs
**Accounts** – Quotes/invoices/payments only

## Technical Requirements

We are open to recommendations regarding the technology stack.

The successful developer should have experience with:

* Full-stack web application development
* Secure authentication
* Role-based permissions
* SaaS/customer portals
* Database architecture
* REST APIs/API integrations
* Mapping/GIS functionality
* File uploads/storage
* Responsive/mobile-first UI
* Automated emails
* PDF/document generation
* Security and backups

The system should be built with clean, maintainable code and structured so additional functionality can be introduced later.

## Future Development

We want this platform to grow with the business.

Future features may include:

* Automated pricing based on hectares
* Travel calculations
* Weather API integration
* Drone/operator scheduling
* Customer online payments
* Xero integration
* SMS notifications
* Digital signatures
* Chemical inventory
* Equipment/drone management
* Operator mobile interface
* GPS/job tracking
* Advanced reporting
* Council/commercial contract management
* Recurring work orders

## What We Will Provide

We will provide:

* Business branding/logo
* Examples of the desired dashboard design
* Services and workflow information
* Required form fields
* Feedback throughout development
* Hosting/domain information where required

## When Applying

Please include:

1. Examples of customer portals, SaaS platforms or job-management systems you have previously developed.
2. Examples of mapping/GIS functionality you have built.
3. Your recommended technology stack and why.
4. Whether you will develop the frontend and backend yourself.
5. Estimated development timeframe.
6. Your proposed fixed project price.
7. What is included in your price.
8. Your warranty/bug-fix period after launch.
9. Whether you provide ongoing maintenance/support.
10. Confirmation that all source code and intellectual property will be transferred to us upon final payment.

**Important:** Please do not apply with only generic website/WordPress examples. We are specifically looking for developers with experience building **custom portals, dashboards, SaaS systems or job-management applications**.

jobs.title: Structural Design for New Building
jobs.description:
I’m preparing to move forward with a civil-engineering project focused entirely on the structural design of a new building. I already have the architectural concept and site information; what I need now is a seasoned structural engineer who can turn those concepts into safe, code-compliant structural documents.

Your role will cover the full structural package—analytical modeling in ETABS or SAP2000, detailed reinforcement schedules, and clear construction drawings in AutoCAD or Revit. I will rely on you to justify all load assumptions, meet the applicable local building code, and optimise material use without compromising safety.

Deliverables I expect:
• Complete calculation report (PDF) with all assumptions, load paths, and checks  
• Editable structural drawings (DWG or RVT) plus printable PDF set  
• Material and connection schedules ready for contractors  
• Brief design summary that highlights key decisions and any open items

I’ll provide architectural plans, soil data, and any municipal guidelines the moment we start. If anything is unclear along the way, let me know—I’m happy to clarify quickly so you can stay productive.

jobs.title: Farmhouse Survey and Rustic 3D Design
jobs.description:
I recently completed the structure of my weekend farmhouse and now need a design-only partner to take it from bare shell to a fully detailed, build-ready package.

Phase 1 – Site Verification  
Start with an on-site measurement survey. I need precise As-Built drawings in AutoCAD showing every wall, opening, floor-to-ceiling height, beam, column, and every existing electrical or plumbing point. Accuracy here is critical, as all later work hinges on these files.

Phase 2 – Concept to Photoreal  
Using the verified plans, develop detailed 2D layouts and furniture planning for the interiors, the detached gazebo, and the complete landscape. Photorealistic 3D renders are required for all three areas so I can visualise the final look before sign-off. The aesthetic is a premium rustic farmhouse: think warm natural finishes, exposed timber, and especially traditional hand-carved teak furniture anchoring the interiors.

Phase 3 – Build-Ready Documentation  
Translate the approved design into working drawings—joinery details, reflected ceiling plans, electrical & plumbing overlays, landscape hardscape/softscape sheets, and a material specification schedule. Everything should be ready for local craftsmen and contractors to price and execute without guesswork.

To move forward, please share:  
• A portfolio link highlighting similar rustic or farmhouse work  
• Your fixed design-only fee or a milestone breakdown  
• What you include in the deliverable set (drawings, renders, material board, etc.)  
• Number of revisions covered  
• Estimated timeline from survey to final issue

I will shortlist based on relevant experience, clarity of deliverables, and ability to capture that timeless rustic feel with authentic teak craftsmanship. Looking forward to collaborating.

jobs.title: Entry-Level Sales & Marketing Recruitment -- 2

jobs.title: Complete Shopify Store Setup
jobs.description:
I’m ready to launch a Shopify store dedicated to selling physical products and I want it to look polished, run smoothly, and convert visitors into customers from day one. The core of the job is to build the storefront and make sure three features work flawlessly together: product-review functionality, secure customer accounts, and solid inventory management that updates in real time.

Here’s how I picture the flow: visitors land on an engaging, brand-matched homepage, browse collections, read authentic reviews, create an account with a single click, and check out without friction while stock levels stay perfectly in sync across all channels. I already have my product data and visual assets organised; what I need is your expertise in Shopify themes, Liquid customisation, and the right mix of first-party and third-party apps to pull everything together.

Deliverables I can sign off on:
• A fully configured Shopify theme (mobile-responsive, SEO-friendly, branded to my guidelines).  
• Product review system installed and styled so reviews look native to the theme.  
• Customer account functionality that lets shoppers track orders and manage details easily.  
• Inventory management setup, including SKU mapping and automated low-stock alerts.  
• Payment, tax, and shipping settings tested and ready for launch.

Once the build is complete, a quick walkthrough or Loom video will help me handle day-to-day updates on my own. If you’ve set up similar stores before and can demonstrate clean, efficient code and an eye for conversion-focused design, I’d love to work together and get this store live soon.

jobs.title: Phonk Production Coaching Sessions
jobs.description:
I already understand the basics of a DAW and some general music-making workflows, but I want to master authentic Phonk from the ground up. I’m after live, practical tuition—not AI-generated tips—so I can confidently craft my own Memphis-style drums, eerie samples, and gritty, tape-saturated mixes.

Here’s what I’d like us to cover during our sessions:  
• Beat making and drum programming that nails the signature Phonk swing and cowbell accents.  
• Creative sampling and sound selection techniques, from crate-digging to chopping and pitching for that vintage feel.  
• Mixing and mastering approaches that glue everything together with the right dust, drive, and stereo width.

My current setup is flexible; I can switch between FL Studio, Ableton Live, or Logic Pro, so feel free to lead in whichever environment you teach best. Screen-share lessons, downloadable project files, and practical homework exercises are the kind of resources that will help me progress fastest.

Success for me means walking away with at least one fully mixed original Phonk track we’ve built together, plus the knowledge and templates to replicate the process solo. If you’re an experienced producer who can break concepts down clearly and demonstrate them in real time, I’m ready to start right away and compensate you well for your expertise.

jobs.title: PDF Tables to Excel Sheets
jobs.description:

Please capture every table exactly as it appears—maintaining column order, row alignment, and any headings—then place each one on a separate worksheet inside a single .xlsx file. If totals or calculated fields are present, just copy the raw figures; no formulas are required on my side. A quick visual check that the transferred data matches the source will be the main acceptance criterion.

Feel free to use whichever method you prefer (manual entry, Power Query, Acrobat export, or any reliable OCR) as long as the final spreadsheet is clean and error-free. Let me know your turnaround time and any questions you have about the PDF layout, and we can get started right away.

jobs.title: SEO – High-Quality Manual BackLink Building
jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced SEO freelancer specializing in manual, high-quality link building to improve our website’s authority, Google trust, rankings, and organic traffic.

Our target is approximately 500 backlinks, but quality, relevance, and sustainability are more important than simply reaching the number.

Build backlinks through manual outreach and genuine link-building methods.
Focus on relevant, authoritative websites with real organic traffic.
Prioritize contextual/editorial backlinks and natural anchor text.
Conduct competitor backlink research to identify quality opportunities.
Use white-hat SEO practices and follow Google guidelines.

jobs.title: Python Developer — Ongoing Role for AI Agent Fleet (Self-Correcting Agents + Landing-Page Quality) -- 3
jobs.description:
We run a fleet of autonomous AI agents (Python, FastAPI, Celery, PostgreSQL, Docker) operating
roughly 10 small-business platforms in Saudi Arabia (e-commerce store builder, logistics/booking,
tutoring/education, personal & business finance tracking, real estate, and a few more), aimed at
real paying customers, not a demo. We recently ran a small paid test task with a developer. It
went well — real findings, independently verified — and it surfaced exactly what the real,
ongoing work actually is. This posting describes that work in full, openly, so anyone qualified
can propose their own approach and price. It is not a continuation reserved for one person.

**The honest current state (so you know what you're bidding on, not a sales pitch):**
- Our flagship platform (automated merchant landing-page builder) has 1,559 merchant records in
  the pipeline. Exactly 1 page has ever been published live, and it was a free gift to a family
  member, not a sale. ~1,530 records are stuck one step before any revenue-generating action.
- We had an 8-day period where every agent stopped doing real work while our own automated health
  checks kept reporting "healthy" the entire time, because those checks never actually exercised
  the AI layer — only a human manually noticing ended it. Likely cause: the whole fleet shares one
  subscription-based inference pool with a weekly usage ceiling; we don't yet have proper usage
  telemetry to prove it, and that's part of the ask below.
- An internal technical audit (self-run by the agent fleet, ~34 sub-investigations, reviewed by a
  human) found real, unglamorous technical debt across the fleet: duplicated/redundant scheduled
  jobs burning API budget for no functional gain, internal documentation that disagrees with what
  is actually deployed and running (in several places), the same third-party integration installed
  as multiple diverging copies instead of one shared version, at least one background job silently
  failing to persist real customer submissions with no alerting, and general drift between what
  the docs say is live/frozen and what's actually running. None of this is exotic — it's the
  normal accumulated debt of a fast-moving small operation, and we'd rather describe it honestly
  than pretend the fleet is pristine.
- Token/cost accounting exists but is only partially trustworthy — a real total is trackable, but
  a meaningful chunk of individual run records don't carry usable cost data, so anyone doing
  cost-optimization work here needs to fix the measurement before trusting it.

**Two concrete, currently-unstaffed work items (this is the actual core of the role):**

**1) Agents that actually learn from how we work with them.**
Our agents do not currently read their own conversation history with the business owner to
extract how he thinks, what he repeats, and how he follows up — and feed that back into
correcting their own automated workflows ("loops") and pipelines. Today that correction is
manual and inconsistent, entirely dependent on a human noticing and re-explaining the same thing
repeatedly. We need someone to design and build a real mechanism: what session/conversation data
to use, how to extract durable patterns vs. noise, what confidence bar before a correction is
applied automatically vs. flagged for review, and what it should actually feed into (loop
configs, prompts, escalation rules, standing decisions). This is acknowledged up front as
product-scale build work, not a quick script — come with a design proposal, not just an hourly
rate.

**2) Landing pages that actually sell.**
The store-builder platform above auto-generates merchant landing pages. They render correctly and
pass technical QA, but they don't clear a "sells itself to a real visitor in the first few
seconds" bar — a previous contractor also attempted and did not fix this. We need someone who can
actually diagnose and fix the generation pipeline (content strategy, structural layout, or model
prompting — your call, defend your approach in your proposal) against a real, already-existing
internal quality gate, proven on a real live store with a genuine before/after, not a mockup.

**Also realistically in scope over time, lower priority than 1 & 2 but real:**
cost/token telemetry that can actually be trusted, de-duplicating redundant scheduled automation,
reconciling documentation against live reality on an ongoing basis, and generally raising the
engineering hygiene bar across ~10 projects run by a fleet of AI agents with light human
oversight. We'd rather a good hire absorb this over time than pretend it isn't there.

**What is intentionally NOT in this public posting, and why:** exact infrastructure topology,
credentials, internal network/container details, and specific unpatched technical issues. This is
a public listing anyone can read, including people with no relationship to us — publishing
exploitable specifics here would be actively irresponsible, not "hiding scope." Nothing about the
SIZE, NATURE, or SEVERITY of the work above is being softened or hidden; a detailed internal
technical report exists and will be shared privately with serious, shortlisted candidates once
we're discussing real pricing.

Real programming experience required: Python, REST/OAuth APIs, task queues (Celery or similar),
PostgreSQL, Docker. LLM/agent-tooling experience (prompting, evals, RAG, tool-calling agents) is a
strong plus for item 1 specifically. Comfort reading and improving someone else's live production
codebase is required — this is not a greenfield project. Remote, any location. Clear written
English required, since day-to-day communication and written proposals will be in English even
though the end product serves Arabic-speaking customers.

We will start with a well-defined, paid opening phase on one of the two core items above — your
choice which, argue for it in your proposal — then move to an ongoing arrangement (hourly or
milestone-based, your preference) if it's a good fit on both sides. Every proposal will be
reviewed on its actual approach and reasoning, not just the number attached to it.

• Take pictures of the residence and its vicinity per Confirmis’ standard operating guidelines. 

• Take picture of the surrounding area and provide observation about the residence 

  

REQUIREMENTS: 

• Must be living in (or nearby)  Perikleous Street, Drosia, Thermi, Thessaloniki, Greece 

 

• Has a camera or phone/tablet of quality with a camera, internet access 

• Must be available during business hours (9 AM - 4 PM) on working days 

  

Please see the attached file for the site visit guidelines. You are only required to deliver the pictures, video & observations and are not expected to assemble a report like the Sample Report. 

  

Note: 

- 1 city can only be taken by one freelancer (on a first-come, first-served basis) 

- The milestone will be released the following week (Monday) after the site visit to give us time to organize the report and contact you if we need additional clarification.

jobs.title: Email Contact Data Entry
jobs.description:
I have a series of plain-text emails from which I need every contact’s name and email address transferred into a neatly organized spreadsheet (Excel or Google Sheets—whichever you prefer). Accuracy is critical: each row should contain the exact spelling of the name and the corresponding email with no duplicates or typos.  

Once the extraction is finished, please run a quick pass to deduplicate entries and flag anything that looks incomplete so I can verify it. When you hand the file back, I should be able to upload it directly into my mailing platform without further cleanup.  

If you’re comfortable working swiftly and with great attention to detail, this should be a straightforward data-entry task.

jobs.title: Local Meta Ads Lead Generation
jobs.description:
I run a car-detailing service and want a steady flow of new inquiries from people right here in town. I already have a modest monthly ad budget set aside; what I need now is an experienced Meta Ads manager who can turn that spend into booked jobs.

The mandate is clear: build and optimise Facebook and Instagram campaigns whose sole purpose is to generate leads. You’ll focus on tight, city-level targeting, lean into video creatives (that’s the format that converts best for us), and continually tweak audiences, placements and copy to keep cost-per-lead as low as possible.

Here’s how I picture our collaboration working:  
• Campaign set-up, including pixel events and lead objectives  
• Ongoing optimisation and creative testing throughout the month  
• Brief weekly check-ins so I know what’s happening  
• End-of-month report covering spend, leads generated and CPL

I’m not looking for website fixes, SEO work or organic content—strictly paid ads management. If you’ve scaled local or service-based businesses before and can share past results, I’d love to see them. Let’s chat about the first month and start booking more cars.

jobs.title: Hyper-Local SEO for Dealership
jobs.description:
I run skjaintvs.com, an authorized TVS dealership, and I’m ready to ramp up our visibility in Google’s local results so we can pull more qualified visitors to the site and, ultimately, the showroom. The single-minded objective is to increase website traffic; every tactic must serve that metric.

The geographic focus is our city plus the neighboring towns that feed customers to us. I’ll share a precise list of those places once we start; please be ready to weave each location naturally into headings, copy, alt text, and—where it makes sense—schema. Citations in high-authority local directories should carry the same NAP details you find on the site and in GMB.

Acceptance criteria: visible ranking improvement for at least three priority keywords in the neighboring-town cluster within the first reporting cycle and a clear uptick in organic sessions from those locations.

If your skill set covers Google Search Console, local keyword research, citation building, and on-page SEO best practices—and you can show results for similar projects—let’s talk.

jobs.title: Instagram & Facebook Video Posts
jobs.description:
I manage several brand accounts and now need a reliable creative partner to turn my storyboards and raw clips into polished, scroll-stopping videos tailored specifically for Instagram and Facebook. Social media posts are the sole focus of this brief, and every asset we deliver will be video-based—nothing static, no photo carousels.

Here is the flow I have in mind. I share the brand guidelines, a rough content calendar, and any existing footage or product imagery. You handle editing, light motion graphics, captioning, and basic sound design so the final files are ready to upload as Reels, feed videos, or Facebook posts. Each piece should feel native to the platform: vertical (1080×1920) where appropriate, punchy hooks in the first three seconds, on-screen text for silent viewers, and colour-grading that stays true to the brand palette.

Key deliverables  
• Upload-ready MP4 video for Instagram and Facebook  
• Separate .srt caption file (or burned-in captions if preferred)  
• Thumbnail/frame selection that works for both feeds  

Turnaround: once we’ve approved the first concept, I’ll need a consistent cadence we can both commit to (weekly or fortnightly depending on the campaign). Edits and revisions should be quick—usually one main round plus a final polish.

Preferred tools include Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, or comparable software; if you work in CapCut or Canva for lighter edits, that’s fine as long as the quality holds up. Good communication and on-time delivery matter more than the exact toolset.

If you love crafting short-form video that connects, converts, and builds community, let’s start with a test clip and grow the collaboration from there.

jobs.title: Custom Furniture Modeling in TopSolid
jobs.description:
I have several one-off furniture concepts sketched out that now need to be turned into fully-detailed, manufacture-ready models inside TopSolid Wood. Your task is purely design and modeling: translate my hand sketches and dimensional notes into clean, parametric TopSolid assemblies that a cabinet shop can take straight to CNC.

We are talking unique, custom pieces—not stock tables or chairs—so every joint, fitting and panel must be created from scratch. I’ll supply the rough drawings, preferred materials and any hardware references up front. You return the complete .Top files along with exploded views, cut lists and 2D shop drawings generated in TopSolid.

Acceptance criteria
• Models remain fully editable and parameter-driven (no imported geometry).  
• All components are named logically and organised in the tree.  
• Drawings carry correct dimensions, material call-outs and automatic BOMs.  
• File set opens error-free in TopSolid Wood 2023.

If you know TopSolid’s furniture module inside out and can model efficiently while keeping everything production-ready, I’d like to see a brief portfolio piece or screenshot demonstrating similar work. Looking forward to collaborating.

jobs.title: 12.6 m Hysucat Drawing,,!
jobs.description: I need a complete set of approval drawings for a 12.6 m Hysucat (hydrofoil-supported catamaran). The end goal is a clean, review-ready package I can forward to the yard and relevant authorities without extra touch-ups.

jobs.title: WordPress Developer (Shopify Store Rebuild)
jobs.description:
Our current Shopify store needs a complete rebuild on WordPress/WooCommerce with a premium custom storefront and strong e-commerce automation.

Key requirements:

* Payment gateway and shiprocket integrated
* Abandoned cart recovery via email, SMS and WhatsApp
* Capture customer contact details early in checkout
* Automated recovery messages with discount codes
* Customer analytics dashboard: AOV, repeat purchases, top customers, cohorts and segments
* Customer tagging: trade buyers, DIY, inactive 90+ days, etc.
* Post-purchase automation: confirmations, review requests and win-back campaigns
* Full SEO setup: schema, clean URLs, sitemap, blog and Core Web Vitals
* Fully custom, premium, mobile-first storefront — no generic themes or page-builder templates
* Product pages with technical specifications and downloadable PDF datasheets
* Reviews with photo uploads and social sharing
* Instagram/Facebook feed/reels
* Custom kit/bundle calculator for doors, windows and furniture that recommends quantities and adds the complete bundle to cart
* Security hardening, firewall, malware scanning and login protection
* Automated daily backups, SSL, cookie/privacy compliance
* Staging environment before launch
* Lean, well-justified plugin stack

To Apply, Please Include:

1. Links to 4-5 live WooCommerce/WordPress stores you've built
2. Fixed-price quote and timeline

jobs.title: Elegant Logo & Packaging Redesign
jobs.description:
I am getting ready to launch a French dietary-supplement brand and want our visual identity to feel unmistakably elegant and luxurious. I already have a basic logo and a first draft of the product packaging, but they need refinement so they genuinely convey premium quality.

Here’s what I am looking for:
• A refreshed logo that keeps the brand name prominently displayed, set in a black-and-ivory palette.  
• A coordinated packaging design for our inaugural supplement, echoing the same refined style.  
• Several photorealistic mock-ups showing the design on bottles, cartons, and flat artworks so I can share them with printers and retailers.  
• Final logo supplied on a transparent background (PNG + vector source), along with print-ready packaging files (AI or PSD plus PDF).  

I will provide the current logo, copy, mandatory regulatory text, and dielines as soon as we start. If you have experience working with premium nutrition, cosmetics, or French-market packaging standards, that’s a plus, but a keen eye for sophisticated typography and detail is essential.

Please tell me how you would approach elevating the design and include a link to relevant portfolio pieces. I’m ready to begin as soon as I find the right creative partner.

jobs.title: Instagram Brand Boost Campaign - 27/08/2026 06:36 EDT
jobs.description:
I’m looking for ongoing support focused squarely on Instagram. My main objective is to grow brand awareness, so everything you create should reinforce a consistent visual identity and voice. Day to day, I’ll rely on you for eye-catching image posts, short captions with well-researched hashtags, and light community engagement that keeps the feed active.  

Beyond the grid, I’d like you to weave in basic on-page SEO whenever new website content is involved, ensuring each article or landing page you touch is optimized for keywords, title tags, and meta descriptions that amplify our online visibility.  

To help me choose the right partner, please share:  
• A quick summary of your Instagram successes—follower growth, reach, or engagement metrics you’ve driven.  
• 2-3 examples of image-centric posts or campaigns you designed (links or screenshots are fine).  
• Your pricing structure—hourly or per-package—and what’s included at each level.  

Deliverables I expect during the first month:  
1. Content calendar covering 12–15 image posts (photo, graphic, or carousel).  
2. Draft captions and hashtag sets for each post.  
3. Weekly analytics recap highlighting reach, impressions, and top-performing content.  
4. Basic SEO tweaks for any related blog or product pages we publish together.  

Familiarity with tools such as Canva, Adobe Photoshop, Hootsuite/Later, and Google Analytics is a plus. If this sounds like a great fit, let me know how soon you can start and how you prefer to structure milestones.

jobs.title: Part-Time Accountant with Excel Proficiency
jobs.description:
I’m looking for a reliable accountant to step in on a part-time basis and keep my books clean and my numbers clear. Your core focus will be straightforward bookkeeping in QuickBooks and preparing concise financial reports. Excel will mainly be used for tidy data entry, basic formulas, and simple summaries that feed those reports—no macros or VBA required.

Typical rhythm: record and reconcile transactions in QuickBooks a few times each week, then turn that data into monthly P&L and balance-sheet snapshots in Excel. Because the workload is light and predictable, hours can be flexible as long as deadlines are met and statements stay current.

Key deliverables
• QuickBooks file kept fully up to date  
• Monthly financial statements exported or recreated in Excel using basic formulas  
• Clear, well-labeled Excel sheets that I can review at a glance  

If you have solid accounting fundamentals, comfort with QuickBooks, and attention to detail in Excel, let’s talk.

jobs.title: Pickleball Event Photographer Needed
jobs.description:
I’m hosting a friendly pickleball session with just 12 people for 3 hours (8 AM to 11 AM). The focus is on three kinds of images: fast-paced action shots while we play, candid social moments between matches, and a few cleanly posed group photos. After the shoot I’ll need the files edited for a true-to-life, natural look—no heavy filters—then delivered as high-resolution digital images I can download.

Deliverables
• A curated set of fully edited, high-resolution JPEGs (exact count to be agreed)  
• Colour-corrected, naturally balanced images suitable for web
• Private online gallery or secure download link for easy access

Acceptance Criteria
• Sharp, well-timed action frames that clearly show gameplay  
• Genuine candid interactions captured without staging  
• Few properly lit group photos with everyone visible  
• Consistent, natural colour grading across the gallery

Bring gear that freezes motion cleanly and handles mixed lighting; the courts may shift from sun to shade. Once we confirm the event date and schedule, we can sort the shot list and any logistical details. The courts are outdoor and it will be sunny, so please user gear appropriately.

jobs.title: Marathi Love Shayari Needed
jobs.description:
I’m putting together a small collection of heartfelt, Marathi love shayari and want each piece to feel as warm and genuine as the lines below:

“रात्री आकाशात चांदण्या मोजत असतो,  
चमकणाऱ्या प्रत्येक ताऱ्याकडे तुलाच मागत असतो.  
जिथे तू असशील तिथेच मी असेन,  
तूच माझ्या जीवनाची पहिली आणि शेवटची ओळ आहे.”

Here’s exactly what I’m after:  

• Format – pure text only; no images or video.  
• Length – short shayari (लघु शायरी): think 2-4 lines per piece.  
• Mood – प्रेमळ; it should feel affectionate and tender rather than overtly dramatic or sad.

I’ll share a theme or prompt for each batch, then you craft original verses in simple, lyrical Marathi. Please keep the language authentic (avoid Hinglish), maintain a smooth rhythm, and ensure every line is unique—no recycled snippets from the internet.

Deliverables: a document containing 25 freshly written, short love shayari, ready for me to review and publish. I’ll check the flow, emotion, and originality with plagiarism tools before releasing payment.

If you’re comfortable writing in clean Devanagari script and can capture that gentle, romantic pulse, let’s get started.

jobs.title: Dutch Marketing
jobs.description:
SUM-IT
Growth & Outreach Associate
Parttime / freelance · Nederland

Over Sum-IT
Sum-IT is een nieuw platform dat vakmensen in heel Nederland helpt bij hun boekhouding en hen in contact brengt met anderen in hun vak. Het is gebouwd door een jonge Nederlandse ondernemer die zelf een vakbedrijf begon en precies dit hulpmiddel miste — iets dat de dagelijkse administratie meteen op orde houdt, in plaats van dat het zich ophoopt tot het laatste moment. We zitten in de laatste testfase voor de lancering.
De functie
We zoeken een scherpe, sociale, Nederlandstalige self-starter die ons helpt in contact te komen met de mensen die er nu het meest toe doen: de vakmensen die Sum-IT gaan gebruiken, en de partners die ons aan hen kunnen voorstellen. Het is een hybride functie — voor de helft telefonische acquisitie, voor de helft promotie op straat.
Wat je gaat doen
(FASE 1) Bel bouwmarkten en vakhandels (Rexel, Boels, Bouwmaat en vergelijkbare) en lokale boekhoudkantoren om gesprekken te openen over partnerships en verwijzingsregelingen, en zorg dat we bij de juiste persoon terechtkomen wanneer e-mail alleen niet werkt
(FASE 2) Vertegenwoordig Sum-IT bij activaties op locatie — denk aan koffie pop-ups bij bouwmarkten, flyeren en vergelijkbare promotie op straat
(FASE 2) Praat rechtstreeks met vakmensen, leg in gewone taal uit wat Sum-IT doet, en overtuig hen de app te downloaden en zich aan te melden
(FASE 1 EN 2) Houd bij met wie je hebt gesproken, wat er is gezegd en wat de vervolgstappen zijn, en koppel dit terug aan het team zodat we goed kunnen opvolgen
(FASE 2) Signaleer wat wel en niet werkt op straat, en laat het ons weten — jij hoort het vaak als eerste
Wat we zoeken
Jong, scherp en gedreven — net zo op je gemak met het bellen van een onbekende als met een gesprek in persoon
Moedertaalspreker Nederlands, aangezien de meeste gesprekken met Nederlandse bedrijven en vakmensen zijn
Oprecht sociaal — dit is een overtuigingsrol, geen rol waarin je een script voorleest
Georganiseerd genoeg om de acquisitie op koers te houden zonder nauwlettend toezicht
Nieuwsgierig naar startups en op je gemak bij een beetje onzekerheid — we bouwen dit terwijl we gaan
Eigen vervoer is een pré, aangezien het werk het bezoeken van meerdere locaties inhoudt — maar geen probleem als dat er niet is, dan regelen we iets
Vergoeding
Nog te bepalen — we bespreken de structuur graag in overleg.
Hoe te solliciteren
Reageer op deze vacature of neem rechtstreeks contact op met Payam Edalat, Chief Marketing Officer bij Sum-IT. payam.edalat@ sum-it.eu

jobs.title: Crypto Analytics Dashboard Prototype
jobs.description:
I need a working web-based prototype for a crypto analytics platform I’ve branded MARKETPULSE. The goal is to pull live BTC and ETH data from the Binance public API only, then transform that feed into a clean, trading-terminal style dashboard. Think of it as the analytical layer of an exchange—no trade execution, wallets, or order placement for now.

What has to be on screen  
• Real-time price and volume ticker  
• Depth-of-market order book with an order-flow/footprint view  
• Large trade (block order) detection stream  

The visual style should stay simple and uncluttered; advanced metrics can sit behind expandable panels or tooltips so the interface never feels busy. A dark theme similar to pro charting platforms is preferred, but I’m flexible if another palette helps readability.

Behind the scenes  
• Source every figure from the Binance REST/WebSocket endpoints.  
• Parse the raw JSON into lightweight, snappy charts—TradingView, Plotly, ECharts, or any framework you trust is fine as long as performance holds at 1-second refresh or faster.  
• Structure the code so that future modules (Liquidity Heatmap, Volume Profile, OI, Funding Rate, Liquidation analytics, CVD/Delta) can drop in without a rethink of the core.

Delivery expectations  
1. A runnable prototype (local dev server or Docker) that I can spin up, point to Binance, and see live charts.  
2. Clean, commented source code pushed to a private repo-of-my-choice.  
3. A brief README outlining setup, key modules, and where the data transforms occur.

I’ll test by running it on my own machine and checking that each required panel updates in real time without noticeable lag. Once those three core views perform smoothly, the milestone is complete and we can talk about the next analytics layers.

jobs.title: Cosmetic Brand Photoshoot
jobs.description:
I'm launching a cosmetic brand and need a versatile photoshoot. The shoot should include:

- A mix of indoor, outdoor, nature, and studio settings
- Creative freedom based on professional ideas
- High-quality photos and videos/reels for product launch
- Focus on a limited range of makeup products

Ideal skills and experience:
- Proven portfolio in beauty and cosmetic shoots
- Experience in creating engaging promotional videos and reels
- Ability to work in diverse settings and adapt to creative concepts

jobs.title: SaaS Sales Specialist: Commission-Based Role
jobs.description:
Business Development Executive (Commission-Based) – SaaS / Software Sales.

jobs.title: Full Spectrum SEO Optimization
jobs.description:
I already have the codebase and hosting nailed down—I’m a full-stack developer—so access to the CMS, server logs, and analytics will be quick and painless. What I need now is a holistic SEO push that covers on-page, off-page, and deep-dive technical work with the single purpose of lifting our search-engine rankings.

You’ll start by auditing the current site, then refine the keyword ideas I’ve gathered into a focused set of primary and secondary terms. From there, meta data optimisation, content tweaks, internal-link-flow fixes, schema markup, and core-web-vitals improvements all need to be queued up alongside a sustainable backlink strategy.

Deliverables:
• Initial audit with prioritised action plan  
• Finalised keyword list (showing search intent and difficulty)  
• Implemented on-page updates across all template types  
• Technical fixes pushed via Git (I’ll handle merges)  
• Month-one authority-building campaign with progress report  
• Tracking dashboards in Google Search Console & Analytics

Clear before/after metrics—indexation status, ranking shifts, and crawl-error counts—will serve as the acceptance criteria. If you’re comfortable working through Ahrefs, SEMrush, Screaming Frog, and the usual Google toolkit, let’s get started.

jobs.title: Dance Costume Fit Video Edit
jobs.description:
I have a finished dance performance video where the costume looks loose and shifts awkwardly during certain moves. I need those moments cleaned up so the outfit appears to sit perfectly on the dancer’s body throughout the routine. This is purely a post-production fix—no reshoots—so I’m counting on precise masking, motion tracking, and subtle warping in Premiere Pro, After Effects, Mocha, or whatever toolset you’re most comfortable with, as long as the final result is seamless.

Please send a detailed project proposal that outlines your approach, the software you’ll rely on, an estimated turnaround, and how you plan to keep texture and lighting consistent while tightening the costume frame by frame.  

Deliverables:  
• Fully corrected video at the original resolution, codec, and run-time  
• All working project files so I can make future tweaks if needed  

I’m ready to get started as soon as I review a proposal that convinces me the costume will look like it always fit perfectly.

jobs.title: Excel Text Reformat Update
jobs.description:
I have a single Excel workbook containing between 100 – 500 rows of pure text data that needs a clean, consistent look. Your task is to open the file and manually re-format every entry—nothing numerical or date related, just the words themselves.

Once I share the style guide you will:
• apply the agreed capitalisation (e.g., Title Case or sentence case),
• trim extra spaces or line breaks,
• ensure punctuation is consistent, and
• keep each record in its original row so formulas and references stay intact.

No automated global replace, please—each cell should be reviewed by eye to avoid accidental changes.

Deliverables
1. The updated Excel file with all text entries formatted to spec.
2. A brief “before vs after” sheet or note highlighting any non-obvious adjustments you made.

If you work comfortably with Excel tools such as Find/Replace, PROPER, TRIM, and basic filters, this will be a quick, tidy project. I’m ready to send the file and style guide as soon as you’re available.

jobs.title: Digitization Expert Needed for Machine Embroidery Designs
jobs.description:
I'm looking for a skilled and experienced digitization professional to convert specific designs into stitch-ready files for machine embroidery. I will provide the designs and details about the intended material, size, and embroidery preferences.

Requirements:
- Expertise in digitizing embroidery designs compatible with multi-needle and single-needle machines.
- Proficiency in software like Wilcom, Hatch, or similar tools.
- Understanding of garment-specific digitization techniques, thread palettes, stitch types, and stabilizer compatibility.
- Ability to provide clear file formats (DST or PES preferred), and actionable recommendations.

Deliverables should include ready-to-run embroidery design files optimized for smooth production.

If this fits your expertise, I’m looking forward to working with you to bring these designs to life!

jobs.description:

You will receive:

• smooth navigation with no broken links or crashes
