jobs.title: Modern Barber Transformation Slideshow
jobs.description:
I need a short, visually striking slideshow that feels modern and sleek from the very first frame. Its sole aim is to promote my barbershop by highlighting dramatic before-and-after transformations of recent clients. I will supply the high-resolution photos; you weave them into a tight narrative that keeps the momentum high and the branding unmistakable.

Clean typography, subtle motion graphics, and on-beat music are essential to match the urban, premium vibe of my shop. No dated wipes or gimmicky effects—think smooth fades, crisp masking, and tasteful parallax to let each cut speak for itself. Color-grading the images so that both “before” and “after” sit in the same visual space is key to a polished finish.

Deliverables
• Editable project file in your preferred tool (Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, Final Cut, or DaVinci Resolve)  
• 1080p (and, if possible, 4K) export in MP4/H.264 ready for social and in-store looping  
• One square or vertical crop for Instagram or TikTok reels  
• Simple end-card that flashes my logo, location, and booking link for 3–4 seconds

Acceptance criteria: total runtime 45-60 seconds, smooth pacing, audio levels normalized, and no noticeable compression artifacts.

If you normally like to add testimonials or interior shots, keep them in mind for future iterations, but for this version let’s stay laser-focused on the transformative cuts themselves. I’m ready to get started as soon as you are—send over any asset list you need and your estimated turnaround time.

jobs.title: Develop Multi Surface Cleaner Formula
jobs.description:
I’m creating a high-performance, eco-minded surface cleaner that can tackle glass and mirrors, wood furniture, as well as floors and tiles without leaving residue or harming finishes. To get there, I need an organic chemist who can translate my performance goals into a complete, lab-ready formulation.

You will help me:

• Select and justify surfactants, solvents, chelating agents, fragrance systems (if any), preservatives, and pH buffers that work across the three surface groups named above.  
• Fine-tune percentages so the formula stays clear on glass yet gentle enough for sealed wood, while still cutting through oily soil on tile and grout.  
• Outline the precise mixing order, temperatures, and equipment needed for a 1-litre bench batch that I can scale later.  
• Supply a brief stability and performance test protocol (clarity, phase separation, streak test on glass, sheen retention on wood, slip resistance on floors).  
• Draft an ingredient disclosure/SDS framework that will ease compliance with REACH and (ideally) EPA Safer Choice criteria.

Green-chemistry insight, cost-effective ingredient swaps, and practical sourcing tips for the US/EU market will weigh heavily in my selection. I’m ready to begin small-scale trials immediately and will share real-time feedback so we can iterate quickly toward a production-ready recipe.

jobs.title: SEO Specialist for Leads 1-Month Trial
jobs.description:
# One-Month SEO Trial – Lead-Focused SEO Specialist for Rivava

We are looking for an experienced **SEO & Organic Growth Freelancer** for a **1-month trial project** with Rivava.

This trial will help us identify the right person for a **long-term SEO contract worth approximately ₹20,000–₹30,000 per month**, depending on performance and results.

Our focus is not just on increasing traffic. We want a **lead-centric SEO strategy** that brings relevant users who may eventually become customers.

## What We Need During the Trial Month

The selected freelancer will be responsible for:

* Creating a complete **lead-focused SEO strategy** for Rivava.
* Improving the SEO of our website and working toward ranking for important **finance-related keywords**.
* Researching realistic high-intent, long-tail, and commercial finance keywords that can generate qualified traffic.
* Building a proper SEO structure around the Rivava website.
* Improving technical SEO, on-page SEO, internal linking, metadata, indexing, and content structure.

### Reddit & Community SEO

A major part of this project will be **Reddit-focused SEO and organic promotion**.

We want someone who understands how platforms such as:

* Reddit
* Quora
* Finance forums
* Relevant online communities

can be used to generate both **organic visibility and qualified leads**.

The goal is to create useful, non-spammy posts and answers around relevant finance topics, participate in existing discussions, and strategically create backlinks or references to Rivava where genuinely relevant.

We do **not** want mass posting, fake accounts, spam comments, or low-quality link building.

### Blog & Content SEO

We also want to build a strong **blog section on the Rivava website**.

You will be expected to:

* Research finance topics with ranking and lead-generation potential.
* Create SEO-friendly blog topics and content.
* Publish or help upload blogs to our website.
* Build topic clusters around finance, investing, wealth creation, financial education, market research, and related subjects.
* Add internal links and relevant external links.
* Use blogs to target long-tail keywords before moving toward more competitive finance keywords.
* Create content that can actually attract potential customers rather than blogs written only for traffic numbers.

### Backlink Strategy

You will also be expected to build relevant backlinks through:

* Reddit discussions
* Quora answers
* Finance communities
* Guest posts
* Relevant blogs
* Resource pages
* Finance/fintech websites
* Organic outreach and mentions

We care more about **relevance and quality than the number of backlinks**.

## Our Main Objective

Our long-term goal is to establish Rivava as a strong finance brand in organic search and progressively compete for major keywords around **finance, investing, wealth creation, and financial education**.

However, the primary KPI will be:

**Organic Traffic → Relevant Visitors → Qualified Leads**

We are not looking for someone who only sends monthly ranking screenshots. We want someone who understands how SEO can contribute directly to business growth and lead generation.

## One-Month Trial

This first month is effectively a **paid trial period**.

We will evaluate:

* Quality of SEO strategy
* Improvement in search visibility
* Organic traffic growth
* Quality of traffic
* Leads generated through organic channels
* Keyword movement
* Blog quality
* Reddit and Quora execution
* Backlink quality
* Communication and reporting
* Overall initiative and execution

If we are satisfied with the work, we intend to offer the freelancer a **long-term SEO contract of approximately ₹20,000–₹30,000 per month for SEO alone**.

We are therefore looking for someone interested in becoming a **long-term growth partner**, not someone looking for only a one-month project.

## When Applying

Please include:

1. Your previous SEO results or case studies.
2. Experience with finance, fintech, investing, or similar competitive niches.
3. Your experience with Reddit SEO and Quora marketing.
4. Examples of backlinks you have built.
5. How you would generate leads using SEO rather than just traffic.
6. What you would achieve during the first 30 days.
7. Your expected number of blogs, backlinks, Reddit/Quora activities, and SEO improvements during the trial.
8. The SEO tools you use.
9. Any websites you have helped rank for competitive keywords.

Please apply only if you are comfortable being evaluated based on **execution, organic growth, lead potential, and overall SEO quality**.

**Strong performance during this one-month trial can lead directly to a ₹20,000–₹30,000/month long-term SEO contract with Rivava.**

jobs.title: Technical Manual Translation to Oromo
jobs.description:
I need a fluent Oromo linguist to translate several English technical manuals. These are full-length documents, not snippets or marketing copy, so accuracy, consistent terminology, and a clear, reader-friendly style are critical.  

Expect to handle standard elements you would find in a technical reference—procedures, step-by-step instructions, safety notes, tables, and the usual diagrams or captions. If you already work with translation memory tools such as SDL Trados or memoQ, that’s a plus because it helps keep terminology consistent across all sections.  

Deliverables  
• A clean, fully translated Oromo version of each manual in the same layout and file format as the source (mostly Word and PDF).  
• A glossary of key technical terms you standardised during the translation.  
• One round of minor revisions after my internal review.  

Please include a brief note on your experience with technical documentation in Oromo, the tools you use, and your estimated turnaround time for roughly 10,000 words.

jobs.title: Vue3 & Node Web App
jobs.description:
I’m building a web application from the ground up and have settled on a Vue 3 front-end, a Node.js (Express) back-end, and a MySQL database. The first milestone is a solid foundation that includes secure user authentication and the ability to handle several distinct user roles, each with its own set of permissions.

Here’s what I need from you: craft the schema in MySQL, build the REST (or GraphQL if you prefer) layer in Node.js, and wire it to a clean, component-based Vue 3 interface. The authentication flow should cover registration, email-verified login, password reset, and role-based access control that cleanly gates routes and API endpoints. I’d like the code organised so new features—such as real-time updates or payment integration later—drop in smoothly.

To keep us aligned, please deliver:  
• a Git repo with well-commented source for Vue, Node, and SQL migrations  
• a short README that explains local setup, env variables, and build scripts  
• a quick loom or screenshot walkthrough proving each role sees only its permitted views/actions  
• automated tests for the auth and role middleware (Jest or similar)

If you favour particular libraries (Pinia, TypeORM, Prisma, Passport, etc.) just say why; I’m open as long as they’re actively maintained. Let me know your estimated timeline for the first production-ready release and any questions you need answered before we kick off.

jobs.title: Insurance Sales Associates Wanted
jobs.description:

Your core focus will be client acquisition and sales, introducing prospects to our full portfolio of insurance solutions—yes, all type of insurance plans, from life and health to property-related coverages and beyond.  

If you have strong communication skills, a genuine interest in helping clients protect their futures, and the drive to meet measurable sales targets, you’ll thrive here. I provide comprehensive product training, mentorship, and the support structures you need to hit the ground running and grow your own book of business while contributing to the team’s collective success.  

I’m ready to move quickly, so tell me about your background, how you connect with customers, and why you’re interested in an insurance sales path. Let’s build something great together.

jobs.title: Hatha Yoga Asana Website Guide
jobs.description:
I’m building a web-only reference for intermediate Hatha yoga practitioners and need a seasoned writer-creator who can turn every pose into a clear, usable lesson. Each asana page should walk users through the posture in precise, progressive steps, highlighting alignment cues, common mistakes, breath timing, and recommended hold length. Because the audience already knows the basics, explanations can go straight to the finer points that help them refine technique and avoid plateaus.

You’ll structure the content so visitors can browse by body region, energetic focus, or Sanskrit name, and the layout must read well on desktop and mobile alike. If you work in WordPress, static HTML/CSS, or another lightweight CMS, just let me know; I’m flexible on the underlying stack as long as the final site is fast, responsive, and easy for me to update.

Deliverables  
• A content map outlining pose categories and page hierarchy  
• Step-by-step written instructions for each selected asana (initial batch of 25–30 poses)  
• High-resolution supporting images or clear guidance on sourcing/creating them  
• Fully built, ready-to-publish web pages styled for readability and SEO basics  

I’ll review one sample pose page first; once that’s approved you can complete the set. If you practice yoga yourself and can demonstrate poses for photography, mention it—it’s a bonus but not mandatory.

jobs.title: Kafka to Azure Migration Expert Needed
jobs.description:

•

jobs.title: Plattformübergreifendes Terminbuchungssystem entwickeln
jobs.description:
Ich plane ein Terminbuchungssystem speziell für geschäftliche Meetings. Damit meine Nutzer ihre Termine reibungslos verwalten können, soll die Lösung auf drei Plattformen laufen: als Webanwendung, als Mobile App und als Desktop-Software.

Folgende Kernfunktionen sind zwingend erforderlich:  
• Kalendersynchronisation – idealerweise mit gängigen Diensten wie Google Calendar, Outlook 365 oder iCal, damit Termine automatisch abgeglichen werden.  
• Automatische Buchungsbestätigung direkt nach erfolgreicher Reservierung.  
• Erinnerungen per E-Mail, die sich zeitlich konfigurieren lassen.

Mir ist wichtig, dass die Oberfläche klar strukturiert ist und Administratoren Einstellungen wie Pufferzeiten, Verfügbarkeitsfenster und Benachrichtigungstexte selbst anpassen können. Ein einfacher Reporting-Bereich (z. B. gebuchte Slots pro Woche) wäre ein Plus, ist aber kein Muss.

Ergebnis, das ich erwarte:  
1. Funktionsfähiger Code für Web, iOS/Android und Desktop (Framework nach Wahl, z. B. React + Electron oder Flutter).  
2. Kurze Installations-/Deployment-Anleitung.  
3. Übersichtliche Dokumentation der wichtigsten Module sowie Hinweise, wie weitere Integrationen ergänzt werden können.

Bitte gib in deinem Angebot an, auf welchem Tech-Stack du aufbauen möchtest, wie du die Synchronisation realisierst und welchen Zeitrahmen du für einen ersten nutzbaren Prototypen siehst. Ich beantworte Rückfragen zeitnah und freue mich auf deine Idee, dieses Projekt effizient umzusetzen.

jobs.title: what do you need

jobs.title: AI Video Creator / AI Filmmaker
jobs.description:
About the Role
 
We are looking for a *freelance AI Video Creator / AI Filmmaker* who can use generative AI as a filmmaking tool to create high-quality visual content for brands, advertising and social media.
 
The ideal person is not just someone who knows AI tools. They should have a strong visual and storytelling sensibility, understand filmmaking and editing, and know how to turn a creative brief into a finished piece of content.
 
*An important requirement for this role is that you already have active paid subscriptions to the AI tools you use. We are specifically looking for someone who has their own AI tool stack and can work independently.*
 
This is a freelance, project-based role, with the potential for ongoing work.
 
 What You'll Do
 
* Take a creative brief and develop the visual approach, story, shots and overall execution.

* Conceptualize, storyboard and create AI-generated or AI-assisted films, videos and social content.

* Use AI video, image, voice and music generation tools to create original visual content.

* Combine AI-generated material with traditional video editing, compositing, motion graphics and post-production.

* Create multiple shots that maintain *visual consistency, character continuity, environments, lighting and overall film language*.

* Experiment with different AI workflows to achieve the desired creative outcome rather than relying on a single tool or preset.

* Handle the process from *concept → prompting → generation → selection → editing → sound → colour → final output*.

* Adapt content for different formats such as Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts and other social platforms.

* Work closely with the creative/directing team to understand the brief, take feedback and iterate on the work.

* Keep AI-generated assets, prompts and project files organised so that projects can be revisited or adapted when required.

* Stay updated with new AI video and image generation tools and continuously explore better ways of creating film-quality work.
 
 AI Tools
 
You should already be actively using and have *paid subscriptions to relevant AI tools*.
 
This could include tools such as:
 
*Video:* Runway, Kling, Luma, Sora, Pika or similar

*Image:* Midjourney, Stable Diffusion, Flux or similar

*Voice / Audio:* ElevenLabs, Suno or similar

*Other:* HeyGen and other relevant generative AI tools
 
You do *not* need to know every tool listed above.
 
What matters is that you have a strong working knowledge of a few tools and know how to get consistently good creative results from them.
 
 Required Skills & Experience
 
* 1–3+ years of experience in video production, editing, motion design, content creation or a related creative field.

* Strong hands-on experience creating *AI-generated or AI-assisted video*.

* Active paid subscriptions to at least *2–3 relevant AI tools*.

* Strong understanding of prompting and the ability to refine prompts through experimentation.

* Good understanding of filmmaking fundamentals: *composition, camera movement, lighting, framing, pacing, continuity and visual storytelling*.

* Proficiency in at least one professional editing/post-production tool such as Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve or CapCut.

* Ability to take a creative idea and execute it independently.

* Strong visual taste and attention to detail.

* Understanding of social-first content and different aspect ratios/formats.

* Ability to work with feedback and make multiple iterations quickly.

* A portfolio/reel demonstrating *actual AI video work*, not just static AI images.
 
 A Big Plus
 
* Experience creating in advertising and branded content.

* Experience combining AI-generated footage with live-action footage, stock, motion graphics or traditional VFX.

* Experience with AI character consistency and multi-shot storytelling.

* Experience with AI voice generation, lip-sync or character animation.

* Familiarity with sound design and AI-generated music.

* Basic understanding of copyright, licensing and responsible use of AI-generated content.
 
### What We'd Like to See
 
Please share:
 
1. Your portfolio/reel, particularly your *AI video work*.

2. A list of the AI tools you currently use.

3. Which of those tools you have *active paid subscriptions* to.

4. 2–3 examples of projects where you have taken an idea from concept to finished video.

5. Your freelance/project-based rates or preferred way of working.

jobs.title: Blender  expert needed
jobs.description:
I’m working on a short sequence that calls for a fully realized 3-D character brought to life in Blender. The task begins with character modeling—sculpting, retopology, UVs, and a clean, animation-ready topology—then moves straight into animation.  

Once the model is complete, I’ll need it rigged and skinned so that expressive body and facial motions are possible. From there, please create the core animation pass for the scene (walk cycle, gestures, and any secondary motion). I’ll handle final compositing, so feel free to work in either Eevee or Cycles; just keep the file organized with clearly named collections and non-destructive modifiers.  

Deliverables:  
• .blend file with the finished, rigged character  
• All textures packed or linked with a readable folder structure  
• Animation baked or left editable on keyframes (no lost constraints)  
• One playblast or viewport preview so I can review timing quickly  

Let me know up front if you prefer specific add-ons (Rigify, Auto-Rig Pro, etc.) so I can keep my pipeline compatible. I’m ready to get started as soon as you are and will be available for quick feedback rounds to keep things moving smoothly.

jobs.title: B2B Cold Calling Leads

jobs.title: Drive Website Traffic via Reddit

The current Lovable build lets users browse a catalogue, open a text file or chapter, and read it—nothing fancy, just a clean, page-by-page reading experience. I want that exact behaviour reproduced first. After that, I’m open to suggestions for improvements; I haven’t decided whether extra features such as bookmarking, highlighting or night-mode should make it into this first release, so your input on effort versus benefit will help me decide.

jobs.title: Comprehensive Shahem UI/UX Design
jobs.description:
Shahm UI/UX Design Proposal Request

We are looking for a professional UI/UX designer or design agency to design the complete customer, service provider, and driver experience for Shahm across responsive web and mobile applications.

The entire project must be completed and delivered within a maximum of 10 days from the official start date.

About Shahm

Shahm is a digital platform that allows customers to request services and products through one simple interface.

The customer deals directly with Shahm, while Shahm manages service providers, suppliers, drivers, purchasing, pricing, fulfillment, payments, and operations in the background.

Shahm may include services such as water tankers, vehicle towing, sewage services, waste containers, transportation, equipment rental, building materials, suppliers, factories, contractors, and other operational services.

The customer should not need to search for suppliers, negotiate with multiple providers, or understand Shahm’s internal sourcing process.

The customer experience should be simple:

Select Service, Enter Details, Select Location, Review Price, Submit Order, Track Order, Receive Service.

In most services, the customer should only see simple statuses such as:

Order Received
Order Confirmed
In Progress
On the Way
Arrived
Completed

Internal supplier searching, provider rejection, dispatch rounds, and operational processes should generally remain hidden from the customer.

Project Scope

The design should cover three main experiences:

1. Shahm Customer
2. Shahm Service Provider and Supplier
3. Shahm Driver

Our immediate priority is a mobile-first Responsive Web App that works extremely well on smartphone browsers.

The same UX architecture and Design System should later be reusable for iOS and Android applications.

Customer Experience

The customer journey should include:

Mobile Login, OTP Verification, Home, Select Service, Order Form, Location, Attachments, Order Summary, Price, Payment, Submit Order, Track Order, Communicate with Shahm, Completion, and Rating.

Main customer screens should include:

- Login and OTP
- Home
- Services
- Service details
- Create order
- Location selection
- Map and location-link options
- Image, video, voice note, and PDF attachments
- Order summary
- Pricing
- Payment
- Order confirmation
- Active orders
- Order history
- Order details and timeline
- Notifications
- Chat with Shahm
- Profile
- Saved addresses
- Support

Communication is a major part of Shahm.

There should be strong communication between the customer and Shahm through in-app messages, notifications, and WhatsApp when required.

The objective is to maintain good follow-up, prevent missed deliveries, resolve delays, answer customer questions, and ensure successful order completion.

Service Provider Experience

A Shahm provider may be a driver, vehicle owner, fleet owner, supplier, store, factory, contractor, company, or service team.

The design therefore must be flexible and should not be built around only one provider type.

Provider onboarding should include:

Mobile Number, OTP, Name Confirmation, Provider Type, Activity, Business Details, Assets, Documents, Bank Account, Coverage Area, Services, Approval, and Start Receiving Orders.

Provider screens should include:

- Registration
- Provider type and activity
- Business information
- Documents
- Asset registration
- Asset photos
- Driver assignment
- Coverage area
- Bank account
- Account review
- Home dashboard
- Receiving Orders On or Off
- Operating capacity
- New orders
- Order details
- Accept or Reject
- Submit quotation
- Active orders
- Completed orders
- Assets
- Drivers
- Messages
- Notifications
- Wallet
- Earnings
- Transactions
- Withdrawals
- Support

Order cards should clearly display the service type, approximate location or distance, provider earnings, response countdown, and required action.

Some orders will use Accept or Reject, while quotation-based services will use View Details and Submit Quotation.

Operating Capacity

The provider interface should clearly show operational capacity.

For example:

Operating Capacity: 0 / 1

or

Operating Capacity: 3 / 5

When capacity is full, the provider should stop receiving new eligible orders until capacity becomes available again.

Driver Experience

The driver experience should be simpler and focused on execution.

Main screens should include:

- Availability
- Current task
- Task details
- Pickup location
- Delivery location
- Open navigation
- Start task
- Arrived at pickup
- Loading completed
- Heading to customer
- Arrived at customer
- Start delivery
- Delivery completed
- Proof of completion
- Unable to complete task
- Contact Shahm
- Notifications
- Task history

Provider Wallet and Payments

Initially, new providers may receive fast payments after completing orders.

A clear banner should communicate this, for example:

Fast Payment Active

Your earnings will be processed quickly after each completed order during your first 10 days.

Later, providers should transition to the Shahm Wallet.

The wallet should display:

Current Balance
Available Balance
Pending Balance
Total Earnings
Transaction History

Providers should be able to request withdrawal to an approved bank account.

Withdrawal statuses should include:

Under Review
Approved
Transfer in Progress
Transferred
Rejected or Needs Modification

Communication

Communication must also exist between Shahm and the service provider, and between Shahm and the driver.

The platform should support:

- In-app messaging
- Notifications
- Text messages
- Voice messages
- Images
- Files
- WhatsApp communication when required

This communication is essential for order execution, delivery coordination, issue resolution, customer follow-up, provider follow-up, and successful order completion.

Design Requirements

The design should be modern, professional, simple, mobile-first, suitable for the Saudi market, excellent in Arabic RTL, adaptable to English LTR, easy for non-technical users, and scalable for future services.

A complete Design System is required, including:

- Typography
- Colors
- Buttons
- Cards
- Inputs
- Navigation
- Status components
- Dialogs
- Alerts
- Upload components
- Order cards
- Empty states
- Error states
- Loading states

Deliverables

The final delivery must include:

- UX Architecture
- User Flows
- Sitemap
- Screen Map
- Wireframes
- High-Fidelity UI
- Responsive Web Designs
- Required Mobile App Screens
- Design System
- Component Library
- Interactive Figma Prototype
- Error and edge cases
- Developer Handoff
- Organized Figma files
- Arabic-first design with an English-ready structure

10-Day Delivery Requirement

The project must be fully completed within 10 days.

We expect continuous progress sharing throughout the project rather than receiving everything on the final day.

The proposal should include the total cost, estimated screen count, number of revision rounds, team size, relevant previous work, delivery approach, and confirmation of the 10-day delivery commitment.

The final objective is to create a product where customers can request services as easily as ordering a ride, while providers and drivers receive a clear operational system for receiving, executing, tracking, and getting paid for orders.

The result must be a complete, scalable, developer-ready UI/UX experience, not simply a collection of attractive screens.

We are looking for an experienced CNC/CAD designer or joinery shop-drawing specialist to convert our existing reception feature-wall concept into complete fabrication-ready drawings for CNC production.

Required Work
The designer should:
• Recreate the decorative pattern accurately from our reference images.
• Develop the design into practical CNC-manufacturable panels.
• Determine suitable panel divisions for fabrication, transportation and installation.
• Detail all CNC routing paths.
• Specify groove widths and depths.
• Detail joints between panels.
• Detail the approximately 100 mm wall build-up/support structure.

• Ensure that panel joints are positioned intelligently and do not negatively affect the decorative pattern.
Required Deliverables

9. LED recess/channel details
10. Metal trim details
11. Fixing/installation details
12. Exploded 3D assembly view

The final CNC files should be clean, properly layered and ready for production without the fabrication company having to redraw the design.
Freelancer Requirements

jobs.title: Remote React & Angular Front-End Developers

jobs.title: Search Engine Optimized Content for Shopify Collection Pages
jobs.description:

✔ Research and naturally incorporate primary, secondary, and semantic keywords.
✔ Create compelling collection descriptions that match search intent.
✔ Optimize content for readability, conversions, and organic rankings.

✔ Familiarity with eCommerce terminology, and Shopify collections.

We are looking for a long-term freelancer who can consistently produce high-quality Shopify collection content. Please apply only if you have relevant SEO and eCommerce writing experience.

jobs.title: Modern A4 Elderly Care Booklet
jobs.description:
I need a bilingual, four-page A4 booklet to promote our elderly care services, and I want every spread to feel modern, trustworthy, and calm. The overall look must stay minimalistic: generous white space, clear typography and a cool, soothing colour palette that reassures older readers and their families.

Visual mix  
Within that restrained framework, please weave together three visual elements—authentic photos of seniors engaged in everyday moments, simple line-icons that highlight key benefits, and light abstract patterns that add gentle texture without clutter. Balance is important: imagery should feel genuine and respectful, icons purposeful, patterns subtle.

Content flow

3) Care philosophy  
4) Contact details and call-to-action

jobs.title: Locate Buyer for Shopify Startup with Custom Features
jobs.description:

jobs.title: Freelance Digital Offline Marketing Lead

jobs.title: Vietnam Baijiu Market Development Partner

jobs.title: Complete Brand Identity Implementation for MCPL

jobs.title: European Tourist Visa Assistance

jobs.title: شعار وهوية وموقع إلكتروني

jobs.title: Sabre API Integration for Australian Travel Agency
jobs.description:
We are an established Australian travel agency seeking an experienced Sabre API developer to integrate Sabre with our existing Lovable back-office and CRM application.

The integration must allow consultants to enter a Sabre PNR reference and automatically:

* Create or update a back-office booking
* Import all passengers and contact details
* Match or create clients in the CRM
* Import the complete flight itinerary
* Retrieve issued ticket information
* Retrieve saved Price Quotes for unticketed PNRs
* Create editable draft costings
* Add multiple PNRs to an existing booking
* Refresh PNRs to identify schedule, ticketing and fare changes
* Prevent duplicate bookings, passengers, clients and tickets

We already have Sabre EPR credentials, CERT and Production credentials, and successful CERT access-token authentication. Our Sabre PCC is W57B.

The selected developer must have specific experience with Sabre PNR retrieval, ticket-document APIs, Price Quote APIs, OAuth authentication and secure server-side integrations. Experience with Lovable, Supabase, PostgreSQL, EDIFACT and NDC bookings is preferred.

Sabre credentials must be stored securely and must never be exposed in frontend code.

Please review the attached detailed project scope before applying.

In your proposal, provide:

1. Details of your previous Sabre API projects
2. Experience retrieving live agency PNRs, tickets and saved fares
3. Relevant Lovable or Supabase experience
4. Estimated delivery timeframe
5. Fixed price by milestone
6. Post-deployment support included

Please apply only if you have demonstrable Sabre API experience. General REST API experience alone is not sufficient.

jobs.title: Modern Custom Wood Carpentry Designs

jobs.title: Avionics PCB Design for Lightweight Drone
jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced Embedded Hardware/PCB Design Engineer to design a custom, compact AIO avionics board for a sub-250 g light-show drone. The board will combine the flight-controller hardware and RTK-GNSS positioning system into a single lightweight PCB.

The engineer will be responsible for taking the hardware from requirements to a complete, manufacturing-ready PCB design, including component selection, system architecture, schematic design, PCB layout, and design-for-manufacturing.

Key requirements:

Strong embedded hardware and schematic design experience
Experience designing STM32H7-based hardware
Advanced multilayer PCB design using Altium Designer or KiCad
Experience with GNSS/RTK integration, RF layout and EMI/noise management
Strong BOM/component selection and DFM knowledge
UAV/flight-controller hardware experience is highly preferred

Expected deliverables: Complete system architecture, finalized BOM, schematic source files, PCB layout source files, Gerbers/ODB++, pick-and-place and manufacturing/assembly documentation.

Applicants who have previously designed flight controllers, UAV avionics, GNSS/RTK hardware or similar compact sensor-heavy embedded boards will be strongly preferred. Please include examples of relevant boards you have personally designed.

jobs.title: Medium-Poly Blender Character Animation
jobs.description:
I’m looking for someone fluent in Blender who can take a medium-poly character from concept to a finished, fully animated scene. The goal is to produce expressive, game-ready motion—not a hyper-real cinematic—so the mesh should sit comfortably in the medium-poly range while still reading well on close-ups.

Here’s what I need done:

• Model a single humanoid character at a medium level of detail (clean topology, subdivision-friendly, sensible UVs).  
• Rig it for standard biped movement plus facial controls for basic dialogue and emotion.  
• Animate a short performance loop (around 10–15 seconds) that shows personality—think idle shift, turn, wave, or a simple interaction.  
• Hand off the native .blend file along with an FBX export so I can drop it straight into my real-time environment.

For acceptance, I’ll be checking deformation on extreme poses, that the polycount is kept reasonable for a medium-poly asset, and that the animation plays smoothly at 24 fps without foot sliding or popping.

If this sounds like your sweet spot in Blender, let’s talk timing and any references you’ll need from me.

jobs.title: Amazon & Flipkart Listing Specialist

You will create each listing inside Amazon Seller Central and Flipkart Seller Hub, writing compelling titles, bullet points and descriptions that weave the right keywords naturally while highlighting fragrance notes, burn time, ingredients and safety information. Thorough keyword research is essential: I expect backend search terms, competitor gap analysis and strategic use of long-tail phrases so the candles appear on relevant searches quickly.  

Once the listings go live, the catalogue must stay healthy. Variations for size or scent need to be grouped correctly, imagery must meet platform standards, and any suppressed or stranded listings cleared fast. jobs.title: Compile Surgical Error Timelines
jobs.description:
I have a set of surgical-error malpractice files that need to be turned into clear, chronological timelines. For every case, I only need the surgical-procedure component, with an emphasis on the exact start-to-finish duration of the operation.  

The source material is already organised by patient, but the operative reports, nurses’ notes, and anaesthesia records still have to be sifted and distilled. Your job is to pull those key time stamps, confirm their consistency across the chart, calculate the total time the patient was in the theatre, and present that information in an easy-to-scan format I can drop straight into legal briefs.

Deliverable  
• One timeline per case (Word table or Excel sheet is fine) showing:  
  – Date of surgery  
  – Time patient entered and exited the operating room  
  – Total surgery duration (calculated)  
  – Citations to the specific page or line in the record where each time stamp was found  

Acceptance Criteria  
• All times cross-verified against at least two chart sources  
• Durations accurate to the minute  
• No patient identifiers included—case numbers only  

If you are comfortable navigating medical records, understand surgical documentation, and can move quickly while staying meticulous, this should be a straightforward assignment.

jobs.title: Expert Rubric Task Author Needed  $30 per task -- 3
jobs.description:
Rubric Task Author — Project Bulls Eye (Contract, Paid Per Task)
About the Role

AI models are already being used for real professional work — writing reports, answering questions, building analyses. But they're not reliable enough yet: they still get things wrong in ways that matter, and right now nobody can consistently find out where.

We're looking for domain experts to help find those breaking points. You'll build realistic, professional-grade deliverables in your area of expertise, then build the rubric that grades them — creating prompts hard enough that today's best AI models still get wrong, but realistic enough that a working professional would genuinely need them answered correctly.

This work spans 67 occupations across 16 domain groups, including Healthcare, Finance & Accounting, Legal & Compliance, Engineering, Supply Chain & Procurement, and Business Operations.

What You'll Do
Design a realistic professional task from your field — the kind of question, report, or analysis a working professional would actually be asked to produce.
Write the prompt itself: the realistic, hard question or scenario a professional would need answered.
Build the deliverable yourself, to the standard a qualified professional would expect.
Build a rubric that precisely and objectively grades that deliverable — capturing exactly what separates a correct, professional-quality answer from a flawed one.

jobs.title: Rive Animator Required – Bring Nuno to Life for a Kids’ Learning App
jobs.description:
We already have a static illustration of Nuno, the friendly guide who appears on every screen of our learning app for children aged 6–12 years.

Your job is to replace that still image with a single, lightweight Rive rig that feels genuinely alive — always curious, expressive and engaging, but **never uncanny**.

What I Need From You

1. One `.riv` file**, under **400 KB**, built in **Rive Web (Canvas)**.
2. A **single state machine** driven by a handful of **boolean/number inputs** that I will wire up from code.
3. Perfectly crisp rendering from **52 px avatars up to full-screen 480 px** on both **Web and Android**.
4. The rig must work consistently across both platforms using the same file and runtime.

Animation Focus

Nuno’s default emotional tone should be **curiosity**.

When he breathes, looks around, listens or reacts, the feeling should be: “I’m interested in what you’re doing.”**

It should NOT feel like manic excitement, excessive animation, or total calm.

We want a subtle, believable sense of life.

## Required States

The rig must include the following states:
1. **Rest** – static pose shown briefly at load
2. **Idle** – subtle breathing and natural eye darts
3. **Listening**
4. **Thinking**
5. **Talking**
6. **Celebrate**
7. **Encourage**
8. **Smile**

## Eyes Are the Priority

Nuno’s **eyes are the anchor of the character**.

They must remain expressive, blink naturally, and track targets smoothly without stutter or mechanical movement.

If you ever have to choose between adding another limb movement and improving believable eye motion, **choose the eyes**.

### Blinking

Blinking must be handled **entirely inside the Rive rig**.

* Do **not** expose blinking as an input.
* Do **not** tie blinking to audio.
* Blinking should run on a **randomised internal timer**.
* Natural spacing should be roughly **every 3–6 seconds**, with variation.
* An occasional **double blink** is welcome.

A blink that happens exactly on a loud syllable can look like a flinch, so blinking must be independent of audio.

### Eye Movement

Beyond blinking, subtle eye movement is where much of Nuno’s perceived life will come from.

Please focus on:

* Slight natural drift of gaze
* Smooth eye movement
* Natural-looking focus changes
* **Widening of the eyes during Celebrate**
* **Softening of the eyes during Encourage**
* Subtle variations that prevent the character from feeling frozen

**Important:** Nuno’s pupils must NOT track anything the child does.

We will not provide a cursor position or face-tracking input. A mascot whose eyes follow a child’s finger or face can feel unsettling for children in this age group.

### 52 px Readability — Mandatory

**Eyes and eyebrows must remain readable at 52 px.**

At this size, Nuno’s entire face is approximately the size of a fingernail.

Please test the animation at **52 px** before considering the eye/brow work finished.

## Technical Constraints — Non-Negotiable

These constraints are important because of where the animation will run.

### File Size

* **One `.riv` file**
* Maximum: **400 KB**
* **Under 250 KB is strongly preferred**

The current implementation uses four PNGs totalling approximately **1.1 MB**, so there is significant headroom to improve this.

### Vector / Raster

Use **vector artwork wherever possible**.

We render Nuno from **52 px to 480 px**, so a raster-based rig would require multiple resolutions and would quickly blow the file-size budget.

If any element absolutely needs to be raster:

* Flag it clearly.
* Keep it as small as possible.
* Explain why raster is necessary.

### Runtime / Platform

* **Rive Web runtime (Canvas)**
* Our Android app is a **web app inside a native shell**.
* Therefore, the **same `.riv` file and same runtime** will serve both Web and Android.
* Nothing should be platform-specific.

### Performance

Target performance:

* **60 FPS**
* On a **mid-range Android phone**
* With Nuno rendered at approximately **360 px**

Our minimum supported Android version is **Android 7**.

Please therefore keep:

* Bone counts modest
* Per-frame computation modest
* State-machine logic efficient
* Simultaneous animations limited

We strongly prefer **a few well-observed, believable movements** over many movements happening simultaneously.

## Background / Rendering Requirements

The background must be **transparent**.

Nuno will appear on several different coloured surfaces, including:

* White cards
* Pale purple backgrounds/washes
* A dark gradient stage

Therefore:

* **No baked-in background**
* **No drop shadow painted into the artwork**
* Nuno must remain readable on both light and dark surfaces.
* Please specifically test him against **white** and **deep purple-black** backgrounds.

If his outline or any important facial feature disappears against either background, it needs to be adjusted.

## Acceptance Criteria

We will run all of the following tests before accepting the work.

### 1. Resolution Test

Nuno must render cleanly at both:

* **52 px**
* **480 px**

There should be no visible artefacts, distortion, or mushiness.

### 2. Idle Test

Idle must run continuously for **three minutes** without:

* A visible loop seam
* An obvious repetition
* A movement that gradually becomes irritating or distracting

### 3. Rest Test

Rest must be **genuinely motionless**.

A screenshot taken at any two moments while Rest is active must be identical.

### 4. Talking / Mouth Test

When the state is **not Talking**, the mouth must **never move**, even while other state parameters are changing.

In other words, if the character is Listening, Thinking, Celebrate, Encourage, Smile, etc., the mouth should remain appropriately controlled and should not accidentally animate.

### 5. Performance Test

The rig must maintain **60 FPS on a mid-range Android phone** with Nuno rendered at approximately **360 px**.

### 6. File / Background Test

The final file must:

* Stay within the agreed file-size budget
* Work correctly on both light and dark backgrounds
* Maintain transparent background rendering
* Work on both Web and Android

### 7. The Most Important Test — The Child Test

We will have a child watch Nuno while he talks and reacts.

The question is simple:

> **Does Nuno feel naturally alive, or does he feel strange?**

This is the real test.

Everything above is **necessary**.

Only this is **sufficient**.

## What I’m Looking For

I’m specifically looking for someone who understands **character animation in Rive**, not just someone who can make objects move.

You should be comfortable with:

* Rive Web / Canvas
* State machines
* Boolean and number inputs
* Efficient vector rigs
* Character rigging
* Eye and facial animation
* Natural blinking
* Subtle idle animation
* Performance optimisation
* Designing for very small display sizes

Experience animating **mascots, children's products, educational apps or character-based UI** would be a strong advantage.

Please share relevant **Rive examples**, particularly character/mascot work, when applying.

If this sounds straightforward, let’s give **Nuno the curious spark he’s been missing.**

jobs.title: Medical Malpractice Timeline Slides
jobs.description:
I need a clear, litigation-ready timeline that maps every critical event in a malpractice case onto a set of presentation slides. You will work from three primary evidence pools I will supply: the complete medical record set, sworn witness statements, and filed legal documents. Within the medical files, the emphasis is on lab reports and imaging studies; those are the records that must anchor the dates, times, and clinical facts you place on the chronology.

Your job is to read each document, extract the event data, arrange it in strict chronological order, and build a slide deck (PowerPoint or Google Slides is fine) that lets a trial team see the entire case unfold at a glance. Each slide should note:  
• Event date and time  
• One-sentence description of what occurred  
• Source reference (e.g., “MRI — 12 Mar 22,” “Deposition of Nurse Smith, p. 47”)  

Keep design clean and courtroom-appropriate; no animation, minimal color, large readable fonts. I’ll supply a template if you prefer.

Deliverable acceptance criteria:  
• Complete slide deck covering every event found in the supplied materials  
• All dates verified against the original documents  
• No unsupported inferences—only facts contained in the sources  
• File delivered in .pptx (and shared link if built in Google Slides)  

Confidentiality is critical; a signed NDA is required before I can release the files. Let me know your relevant experience and how quickly you can turn the first draft once the evidence package arrives.

Saya mengharapkan panduan langkah demi langkah, template yang bisa langsung dipakai, serta satu sesi tanya-jawab daring untuk memastikan saya mengeksekusi strategi dengan benar. Jika Anda berpengalaman membesarkan channel YouTube dengan pendekatan edukatif dan inspiratif, saya siap bekerja sama.

I’m looking for a skilled copywriter who can craft clear, compelling text that speaks to a broad, general-public audience. At this stage I need concise, persuasive copy for a small set of materials—think short website sections, brief product blurbs, or a one-page flyer.

jobs.title: Asesoría en Gestión de Servicios TI, ITIL, KPIs y Mejora Operativa
jobs.description:
Busco un consultor con experiencia en gestión de servicios TI, ITIL, operación de mesas o torres de soporte, gestión de incidentes, capacidad, productividad, indicadores y mejora continua.

Actualmente me encuentro gestionando un servicio TI y requiero asesoría para revisar y fortalecer el modelo operativo del equipo.

A alto nivel, necesito apoyo en los siguientes frentes:

Definición y mejora de indicadores de gestión del servicio.
Análisis de capacidad y dimensionamiento de recursos.
Evaluación de productividad y carga de trabajo del equipo.
Reducción de tickets reabiertos y mejora de la calidad de atención.
Gestión y transferencia de conocimiento entre analistas.
Definición de funciones entre supervisores, líder técnico y equipos senior.
Elaboración o revisión de matriz RACI.
Gestión de incidentes críticos y escalamiento.
Identificación de oportunidades de automatización.

Evaluación de posibles casos de uso de Inteligencia Artificial aplicada a la gestión de incidentes.
Aprovechamiento de información disponible en Power BI para mejorar la toma de decisiones.
Identificación de oportunidades de mejora continua alineadas a buenas prácticas de ITIL/ITSM.

El objetivo principal es contar con una visión externa y especializada que permita identificar brechas, ordenar el modelo de gestión actual y establecer acciones concretas que ayuden a mejorar los indicadores, la eficiencia operativa y el control del servicio.

Busco preferentemente una persona con experiencia real gestionando servicios TI, Service Desk, NOC, operaciones TI o equipos de soporte, y que pueda aportar no solo conocimiento teórico, sino también recomendaciones prácticas y aplicables.

Los detalles específicos del servicio, problemática actual, indicadores y estructura del equipo serán explicados durante la coordinación con los candidatos seleccionados.

jobs.title: Precision Ag E-commerce SEO Overhaul
jobs.description:

• On-page optimisation for category and product pages—titles, meta descriptions, internal linking, schema.

No black-hat shortcuts—case studies demonstrating past e-commerce or agricultural SEO wins will be requested before hire.

I’m open to a one-time audit plus strategy document or a longer-term retainer if we’re a good fit. Let me know how you would approach the audit, which quick wins you anticipate, and how soon you can start.

jobs.title: Fix & Document Web App
jobs.description:
My web application is failing to run reliably, and I want to get to the bottom of it with an experienced developer working in real time alongside me. We will pair-debug over a shared session, isolate the breaking points, and turn the codebase into a clean, consistently runnable build.  

While we work, I also need brief screen-capture videos of each fix so I can review the steps later and update our internal documentation. Any lightweight tool such as OBS, Loom, or a built-in recorder is fine—as long as the resolution is clear and the clips are saved in an easily shareable format (MP4 or WebM).  

Deliverables  
• A fully functioning, locally and remotely runnable version of the web app, committed to our Git repo.  
• Short video snippets (one per issue resolved) clearly showing the problem, the code change, and the successful retest.  

Acceptance criteria  
1. I can install dependencies with one command and launch the app without runtime errors.  
2. All recorded clips play back smoothly and cover the entire troubleshooting sequence.  

If you’re comfortable diagnosing web-stack issues and can narrate your fixes as you go, let’s get started today.

jobs.title: Minimalist Skincare Standee Design
jobs.description:

The aesthetic is strictly minimalist and should rely on neutral tones—think soft whites, muted greys and gentle beige accents—to convey calm and sophistication. Rather than crowding the surface with logos or multiple product shots, I want the key benefits of the range to be the focal point. Short, punchy copy paired with a smart typographic hierarchy will do the talking.  

Final artwork must be delivered print-ready (300 dpi, CMYK PDF) alongside the working file in Adobe Illustrator or InDesign so I can adjust text if needed later. A quick 3-D mock-up or realistic render showing the piece in a retail environment will help me visualise proportions and approve the design faster.

jobs.title: Kreator Konten TikTok Ahli

jobs.title: Java Programming Skills Tutor Needed
jobs.description:
I am currently enrolled in a professional education track and want to sharpen my technical skills by learning Java in depth. My goal is to move confidently from the basics—syntax, object-oriented principles, and standard libraries—through to practical topics such as multithreading, JDBC, and simple Spring–based projects.

I’m interested only in Java right now rather than Python or JavaScript, so the material can stay tightly focused. I learn best through short explanations followed by hands-on coding tasks and real-world mini-projects, so please be prepared to supply example code, exercises, and detailed feedback on my solutions.

Deliverables  
• A structured lesson plan (introductory, intermediate, and advanced modules)  
• Source-code examples and annotated solutions for each module  
• Weekly live or recorded walkthroughs with Q&A  
• A capstone mini-project that ties the concepts together and shows I can apply them independently  

Acceptance criteria: lessons must compile and run without errors in a current JDK; explanations should be clear enough for me to reproduce results solo; and feedback on assignments returned within two days.

If you enjoy teaching and have professional Java experience, I’d love to team up and start as soon as possible.

jobs.title: Odoo Modules Customization Expert Needed
jobs.description:
Our in-house Odoo instance needs targeted module customization so workflows match the way we actually sell, stock and book revenue. The focus is purely on tailoring three standard apps—Sales, Inventory and Accounting—without disturbing stability or the upgrade path.

Scope of work  
• Sales: build several custom reports, tweak the default workflow to fit our quoting-to-invoice sequence, and polish the user interface so key data shows up in fewer clicks.  
• Inventory: align stock moves with the revised Sales flow and expose real-time availability indicators on the Sales order screen.  
• Accounting: ensure every custom transaction maps to the correct journals and that the new Sales documents feed cleanly into our financial statements.

Deliverables & acceptance  
1. Fully installable custom modules or studio changes that pass Odoo upgrade tests.  
2. Source code documented inline plus a short change log.  
3. Demo database showing each new report, UI change and workflow path functioning end-to-end.  
4. Handover session (screenshare) so our team can reproduce results on staging.

Please keep development within Odoo best-practice frameworks (ORM, XML views, qWeb) and avoid hacks that block future updates.

jobs.title: Automated HR Metrics Dashboard Build
jobs.description:
I need a complete HR analytics dashboard built from the ground up.  The raw data currently arrives as Excel exports and the finished tool has to transform those sheets into clear, interactive visuals that I can refresh with a single click.

Metrics in scope  
– Employee turnover rate  
– Performance indicators (rating distributions, high-potential flags, etc.)  
– Attendance and leave trends  
– Recruitment pipeline tracking (time-to-hire, open vs. filled roles) automated CV parsing from a folder 
feedback - For CV processing, add Python-based parsing to extract candidate details from a watched folder and feed them into the recruitment pipeline automatically)
– Requisition Tracker
– Financial Budget (Whole Organization such as salary, annual package and etc)
- HR Internal Record (Manager remarks, salary range, JD links)
- Recruiter View (Pivot summaries by recruiter)
- Dashboard
- Consolidated management metrics

Core functions  
1. Data visualisation & reporting – charts, heat-maps and summary cards that make patterns obvious at a glance.  
2. Automated data updates – Power Query / VBA / Python (I’m flexible) so that dropping a new Excel extract triggers a full refresh without manual re-mapping.

Technical notes  
• Source today is Excel; the structure should stay modular so I can later swap in SAP SuccessFactors exports without redesigning everything.  
• I work in Microsoft 365, so solutions leveraging Power Pivot, Power BI, or advanced Excel dashboards are all acceptable as long as they run locally.  
• Clean, well-commented formulas or code are essential; I want to understand and maintain the logic after hand-over.

Deliverables  
• Fully functional dashboard file(s) with automated refresh  
• A brief setup/maintenance guide (PDF or doc)  
• One live walk-through call to verify everything works on my end

Acceptance criteria  
The dashboard must load the latest Excel extracts, refresh in under two minutes, and display all four metric groups with slicers or filters for department, location and date range.

If you’ve built similar HR analytics tools, especially ones that later connected to SuccessFactors, I’d love to see an example. Let’s discuss your proposed approach and timeline.

Here’s exactly what I need from you:
• Provide your Australian mobile number so I can enter it during sign-up.
• Forward the one-time SMS code that Id4me sends (usually arrives within a minute) as much time as needed until i complete the sign up process.

That’s it—no voice calls, no ongoing access, just the initial SMS. I’ve already tried my VoIP line and even contacted Id4me support, but they insist on a real carrier number. Once the code is confirmed, the task is complete and your number is never shown publicly inside the account.

jobs.title: Python Web Stream Processing
jobs.description:
I’m building a Python-powered web application focused on data processing—specifically stream data processing—and I need your help to get the first working version online.

What I need
• A server-side component in Python that accepts a live data stream, performs on-the-fly transformations (filtering, aggregation, enrichment, etc.), and publishes the processed results immediately. I’m comfortable with FastAPI, Flask, or Django Channels as long as the final code is clean and documented.  
• A lightweight browser client that connects over WebSocket (or comparable real-time transport), receives the processed events, and displays them—raw JSON is fine for now, but a minimal chart or table helps confirm everything is flowing.  
• Clear separation between ingestion, processing, and broadcasting layers so I can swap in production sources later (Kafka, MQTT, or another broker).  
• Containerisation with a Dockerfile plus a concise README so I can spin the whole stack up quickly.  
• Unit tests covering the main processing functions and a sample script that fires 100 events per second to demonstrate end-to-end latency below 200 ms.

Deliverables
1. Python server code with real-time processing pipeline.  
2. Simple HTML/JS client to visualise live output.  
3. Dockerfile, README, and test suite.  
4. Git repository hand-over.

If you’ve built real-time data pipelines or WebSocket services in Python before, I’d love to see a quick note on your chosen framework and any similar projects.

jobs.title: UK/SA Writers Ongoing Assignments
jobs.description:
I need one or two dependable writers currently based in the UK or South Africa who can join me for a long-term collaboration. The workload is flexible: some weeks you might handle just a handful of short pieces; other weeks you could opt in for a near full-time schedule. Everything is remote and deadline-driven, so solid time management and a quick, clear writing style are essential.

Typical briefs range from blog posts and evergreen articles to product descriptions and lightly technical explainers. Tone will vary by client but usually sits in that middle ground—professional yet conversational—so the copy feels trustworthy without sounding stiff.

Here’s how we’ll work together:
• I send a brief with word count, keywords, angle, and deadline.  
• You confirm within a couple of hours, ask any clarifying questions, then deliver clean copy in Google Docs (or Word if you prefer).  
• I review within 24 hours and either approve or request minor tweaks.  

What I value:
• Native-level command of UK English (spelling and idiom).  
• Ability to adapt voice quickly to match different brand guidelines.  
• Reliable turnaround—if you commit to Tuesday, I’ll see it Tuesday.  
• Openness to ongoing, constructive feedback so we keep improving.

Please tell me:
1. Your typical capacity per week in words or articles.  
2. Topics you’re most comfortable covering.  
3. One short paragraph (100–150 words) that showcases your natural voice—any subject is fine.

This is a rolling engagement and I’m looking to build a small, steady team, so feel free to indicate whether you prefer part-time consistency or are open to fuller-time volume when it’s available.

jobs.title: Facebook, Instagram & YouTube Scheduler

jobs.title: APISetu PDF Sharing API
jobs.description:
I need an experienced developer who has already worked with the APISetu platform to create a reliable document-sharing API focused on PDF files. The goal is to plug directly into APISetu’s workflow so that authorised consumer applications can request, fetch, and display my organisation’s PDFs with the same ease that DigiLocker-style services provide.

Here’s what I expect:
• Build and expose the endpoints required by APISetu for publishing documents, fetching them on demand, and checking their status.  
• Ensure the solution follows the standard consent, token and callback sequence mandated by APISetu so onboarding later with MeitY is straightforward.  
• Handle PDF formatting nuances—page orientation, file size limits, MIME types—so that every file returned is immediately usable without post-processing.  
• Provide concise setup notes, Postman collections (or similar) for quick testing, and a small read-me that outlines any environment variables or secrets I need to set.

Right now my only mandatory format is PDF, but I’m open to features such as encryption or digital signatures if you feel they add value and fit naturally into the same flow.

Please share a brief note on similar APISetu integrations you have delivered and how quickly you can have a staging version ready so I can start the compliance paperwork.

Tiêu chí hoàn thành:
1. Cài đặt và cấu hình module trên môi trường Odoo hiện tại.  
2. Code rõ ràng, tuân thủ chuẩn Odoo, có phần README hướng dẫn cài đặt & sử dụng.

Nếu bạn đã từng phát triển các module Odoo liên quan tới kế toán hay email automation, rất mong được hợp tác. Tôi sẵn sàng trao đổi thêm để bạn nắm rõ quy trình và dữ liệu mẫu trước khi bắt tay vào triển khai.
