jobs.title: PDF Statements to Xero CSV
jobs.description:
I have more than ten PDF bank statements, all sharing the exact same layout, and each one lists every transaction with its date, narrative and amount. I need every statement converted into clean, perfectly-formatted CSV files that Xero will accept without extra tweaking on my side.

Accuracy is critical: the dates must stay in their original order, the descriptions untouched, and the debit/credit values placed in the correct columns so Xero recognises them instantly. If you already work with tools such as Excel, Google Sheets, or specialised OCR/bank-statement converters and can spot common parsing errors before they land in my ledger, that’s ideal.

Deliverable  
• One Xero-ready CSV file per PDF provided

I’ll forward the first batch as soon as we agree to proceed and will validate the import in Xero as the acceptance test. Let me know your turnaround time and any questions you need answered before starting.

jobs.title: The Final Battle of my series, a man taking down the anti-christ (Will pay anywhere from 200 to 275)
jobs.description:
I'm seeking a skilled 2D animator to create a few very short animations featuring human characters. 
I need 3 total character models, 2 humans, and the beast
Background can just be a grayish-white gradient or any of the backgrounds I have listed here
The animations are as follows (may be subject to change)
1.Scene of an older man stumbling on another, slightly older, man transforming into a terrifying beast (this will be the trickiest animation by far) ~7-10 seconds (I picture it as the camera quickly zooming in on the slightly older man’s face as he sits and rises from a throne and cutting to at least three different sections of transformation animation. These would consist of an arm changing into a hoof, horns growing from his head, and dragon-like wings emerging from his back, all while his shape takes on a more beastly appearance, ending with a full shot of the creature) Here's another animator's animation to give an idea on kinda what I'm looking for, although it doesn't have to be as detailed as this https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9TBYI_OUS1g
2.Scene of the aforementioned creature attacking the older man by lunging and biting him in the chest, sinking his teeth into him ~2-3 seconds
3. Scene of the same older man stabbing the creature in its eye ~3-4 seconds (the older man is on the floor after being bitten, but rises up and stabs the creature in the eye, the man is ok because of special armor he has beneath his Cardinal Cassock)
4. Scene of the same older man slicing off the tongue of the creature with a blade of some kind ~2.5 seconds (I picture it as not a POV shot, but of him grabbing the tongue and slicing it, the creature is also bloody from being stabbed by the man offscreen)

Ideal skills and experience (not that picky quite honestly):
- Proficiency in 2D animation software (e.g., Adobe Animate, Toon Boom)
- Strong storytelling and character design abilities
- Experience in creating engaging animations for entertainment purposes

jobs.title: Daily Website Scraper Tool
jobs.description:
Every day I need to pull multiple tables that comes from links on a single web page, save it to an Excel file, and keep exactly the same column order and formatting as my uploaded sample file. The site is protected by bot-blocking measures, so the script must get through those barriers reliably without triggering bans, today or months from now.

The website is:   https://www.timeform.com/greyhound-racing/runners-and-results-a-z/today

This page has a different list of links each day, to do this manually, I currently click on the name of each dog and then copy the table with performance data into my master sheet.

Here is what matters to me:

• The program runs on Windows, starts from a simple click or scheduled task, fetches all the tables, and writes an .xlsx file ready for immediate use—column widths, numeric formats, and text alignment preserved exactly as in my sample upload.  
• All scraping logic, whether it relies on rotating user agents, residential proxies, headless browsers, CAPTCHA solving, or another tested method, is up to you; I only care that it works consistently and can be adjusted if the site tightens security.  
• Code should be clean Python (requests, Selenium, Playwright, or equivalent libraries) with clear comments and a short README so I can update credentials, proxy lists, or schedule settings myself.  
• Before awarding the project, I need a quick live demonstration proving the scraper can run several times in a row without being blocked and that the resulting spreadsheet mirrors the website table perfectly.

Please deliver the runnable script, any auxiliary files (proxy list, requirements.txt, etc.), and concise setup instructions.

jobs.title: Driver’s License Photo Update
jobs.description:
I have my current driver’s license saved as a high-resolution JPEG and I need it retouched so it reflects my latest headshot and updated personal details (name, address, date of birth). The layout, state-issued graphics and security features must remain untouched and perfectly aligned, so the end result looks completely authentic and print-ready.

Please swap in the new photo I’ll supply, replace the outdated text fields with the information I’ll provide, and keep the overall file size and resolution consistent with the original. Deliver the finished file back to me in both layered PSD (so I can make minor future tweaks if required) and a flattened JPEG suitable for printing or digital use.

jobs.title: AI Promotional Video Creation
jobs.description:
I’m planning a run of short promotional ads and want them produced end-to-end with AI. The goal is to generate scroll-stopping clips that speak equally well to consumers and business decision-makers, so each video must balance an energetic, user-friendly tone with clear commercial authority.

Here’s what I need from you:

• Ideate and script concise ad concepts (15–45 seconds) that highlight key value points.  
• Generate the visuals with AI tools you’re comfortable with—whether that’s Midjourney for imagery, Runway or Pika for animation, Synthesia for avatars, or similar.  
• Layer in voice-over (AI or human, whichever fits best) plus music and on-screen text that’s platform-ready for Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, and YouTube Shorts.  
• Deliver final exports in 1080×1920 (vertical) and 1920×1080 (horizontal) along with original project files so I can tweak future iterations in-house.  

Acceptance criteria  
1. Each ad clearly conveys the product’s core benefit within the first three seconds.  
2. Visuals and copy remain brand-consistent across consumer-facing and business-facing versions.  
3. Ready-to-upload MP4 files pass platform quality checks (no black bars, crisp audio, legible text).  

If you’re experienced in rapid AI video workflows and have examples of promotional spots you’ve built, I’m ready to review them and move quickly.

jobs.title: Modern 3BHK Luxury Interior Plans
jobs.description:
I have a newly built 3-bedroom apartment that needs a complete, execution-ready interior package. The look I’m after is unmistakably Modern yet Luxurious and sophisticated in feel, and every zone—living-dining, all bedrooms, kitchen and both bathrooms—must carry that thread consistently.

What I need from you  
• Dimensioned 2D layouts, elevations and detailed carpentry/shop drawings that a local carpenter can follow without guesswork (units in mm, tolerance ±5 mm).  
• Photorealistic 3D renders and/or SketchUp or 3ds Max views illustrating material finishes, lighting and colour palette so the team and I can visualise the space before fabrication.  
• Modular kitchen and wardrobe details, false-ceiling plans, lighting and switch layouts, veneer/laminate or PU schedules, and a consolidated material & hardware sheet.  
• Final files in PDF for easy sharing plus editable DWG (AutoCAD) and the native 3D model.

Workflow & expectations  
I’ll share the architectural floor plan in DWG at kickoff. We’ll iterate through two design review rounds to lock the concept, then advance to the fully annotated working drawings. Please factor in quick turnarounds; the carpenter starts in five weeks.

Acceptance criteria  
1. All drawings align with the issued floor plan and Indian carpentry standards.  
2. Renders accurately depict the specified finishes and lighting temperature.  
3. Complete drawing set ready for site hand-over, no missing dimensions or call-outs.

If you’ve delivered similar modern luxury apartments and can supply both stunning visuals and contractor-friendly documentation, I’d love to see your portfolio and timeframe.

jobs.title: Next.js Web & Mobile App Development
jobs.description:
I’m building a full-stack product that will launch simultaneously on the web (Next.js + React + Tailwind CSS) and on native mobile (iOS and Android via React Native or Expo—open to your preferred workflow).  

Core features required from day one:  
• Secure user authentication with profile management  
• Seamless Stripe payment processing, ready for subscriptions and one-off charges 
• Profile creation and search of individual from the built up directory

Data will live in PostgreSQL for production, though I keep a small MySQL instance for legacy import scripts, so the schema needs to remain portable between the two. Everything is hosted on AWS (EC2, RDS, S3, CloudFront). You’ll set up the CI/CD pipeline, handle environment variables, and make sure staging and production deployments are painless.

After launch I’d like you to stay on for iterative feature work, performance tuning, and general maintenance, so the codebase must be clean, documented, and test-covered from the outset.

Deliverables:  
1. Responsive Next.js web app with Tailwind styling  
2. Companion mobile app compiled for both iOS and Android  
3. AWS infrastructure as code (preferably Terraform or CDK)  
4. Stripe integration in test and live modes  
5. Documentation and a hand-off walkthrough

If this stack matches your expertise and you’re interested in a long-term collaboration, let’s get started.

jobs.title: Animated Tutorial Video Edit
jobs.description:
I’m producing an educational tutorial and need a skilled video editor who can bring it to life with animated graphics.  

Scope  
• Edit raw footage (≈10–15 minutes) into a concise, engaging tutorial.  
• Integrate dynamic animated sequences that visually reinforce key teaching points.  
• Design and insert clear, on-brand infographics where concepts need visual clarification.  
• Add clean transitions, royalty-free background music, and subtle sound design to maintain viewer engagement.  
• Deliver both the final 1080p/4K MP4 and the editable project files (Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve preferred).

What I’ll provide  
– Script and voice-over tracks.  
– Branding guidelines (fonts, colors, logo).  
– Any reference materials or rough timings for the infographic sections.

What I’m looking for  
Someone experienced in educational content who can match a modern, friendly tone; has a solid grasp of motion graphics; and communicates clearly about revisions and deadlines.

If this sounds like your wheelhouse, please share:  
1. One or two links to similar animated tutorials you’ve edited.  
2. Your typical turnaround time for a project of this length.  
3. Any questions or suggestions you have to make the lesson even clearer.

Let’s craft an engaging tutorial that keeps learners glued to the screen.

jobs.title: Ganesh Event Videos & Flyers
jobs.description:
Our residential society is gearing up for this year’s Ganesh festivities and I need a creative partner to help me spread the word. I’m looking for 10-15 short invitation videos, each 10–30 seconds long, plus five to six modern-style flyers.

Videos  
• Purpose: friendly invitations that residents can forward on WhatsApp, Instagram Reels, and similar channels.  
• Feel: upbeat and festive without being overly traditional. Lord Ganesha visuals, society logo, date, and a short call-to-action will be supplied.  
• Must-haves: dynamic text animations, suitable background music or sound effects, and tasteful visual effects that keep the message clear.  
• Formats: portrait (1080×1920) is essential; square (1080×1080) would be a bonus if it doesn’t add much extra work.

Flyers  
• Style: clean, modern layouts with bright colours that still nod to the spiritual theme.  
• Usage: print on A4 and share digitally (JPEG/PDF). I’ll provide the exact copy and any sponsor logos.

Acceptance  
I’ll review the first video and one flyer as a sample; once approved, you can roll out the rest. Final files should come in editable formats (Premiere Pro/After Effects + PSD/AI) along with the exported MP4s and high-resolution images.

If this sounds like your kind of festive project, let’s talk timing and kick things off right away.

jobs.title: Premium Android App UX/UI and Logo Design
jobs.description: I want to redesign ui ux animation part of my android app. Also logo design mascot design and everything that can make my app look premium

jobs.title: Quick Industrial Lifting Mechanism Concept
jobs.description:
I need a concise, proof-of-concept design for a heavy-lifting module that will be built into new manufacturing equipment on our shop floor. The goal is to capture the idea, not produce production drawings, so speed and clarity matter more than polish—think 30 minutes of focused creativity.

Here is what I’m looking for:
• One or two annotated sketches or a lightweight 3D model (Fusion 360, SolidWorks, or comparable) that shows the overall mechanism, load path, and motion sequence.  
• Brief notes on key dimensions, stroke, and estimated load capacity so I can sanity-check the concept against our 1-ton lift requirement.  
• A short paragraph on materials and actuation choices (hydraulic ram, screw jack, etc.) with any off-the-shelf components you’d lean on.  
• PDF or PNG export plus the native CAD or sketch file so I can tweak internally.

Keep safety factors and CE/ISO norms in mind; serviceability and straightforward fabrication from standard steel profiles are must-haves. If you can turn this around quickly—ideally within a few hours of acceptance—you’re the right fit.

jobs.title: Lead-Generating Social Ads Campaign -- 2
jobs.description:
I need a results-driven performance marketing push aimed squarely at generating qualified leads and sales. The entire effort will live on social media, with campaigns running across Facebook, Instagram, and LinkedIn.  

You’ll take care of the strategy, audience segmentation, creative recommendations, ad set-up, daily optimisation, and clear weekly reporting so I can see CPL, ROAS, and any learning you uncover. Pixel installation, event tracking, and look-a-like audience creation should be second nature to you, and you’ll be comfortable juggling the nuances of B2C tactics on Facebook and Instagram while shifting tone for the professional environment of LinkedIn.  

I’m open on ad formats—single image, carousel, video—so long as they convert. Copy must stay on-brand and comply with each platform’s policies. By the end of the first month I expect a stable, scalable campaign structure delivering cost-efficient leads, with recommendations for budget allocation and creative refresh cycles based on real data.

jobs.title: Home Renovation Matchmaking App
jobs.description:
I need a clean, intuitive mobile app that runs natively on both iOS and Android. On the customer side, the core flow is a single, well-structured form where homeowners enter every detail of their renovation or design project. That data should travel straight to the backend for storage and later matching—no manual hand-offs.

For architects and interior designers, I already have a separate form drafted that covers profile basics plus a portfolio upload section. Once a professional completes that form, their profile goes live inside the app. A transparent ranking algorithm must sit behind the scenes so the most suitable architect surfaces first when a new customer brief arrives.

Key pieces I expect from you:  
• Cross-platform app build (shared codebase preferred for efficiency).  
• Simple, elegant UI that keeps both forms front-and-center.  
• Secure backend and database to capture every submission.  
• Ranking logic that automatically pairs customers with the right architect or designer.  
• Basic admin view so I can oversee submissions and fine-tune rankings.

I have the copy and field lists for both the customer and architect forms ready to hand over, so you’ll start with a clear blueprint. Let me know the framework you’d use—Flutter, React Native, or another modern stack—and a rough outline of milestones for build, testing, and launch.

jobs.title: Create Company Wikipedia Page
jobs.description:
I need a Wikipedia article that captures our company history in a clear, neutral-tone narrative. The emphasis is solely on our past: how we started, the turning points along the way, and the milestones that shaped us into who we are today. I will supply a set of briefs containing dates, events, press mentions, and any other supporting material you may need; feel free to guide me if additional third-party sources are required to satisfy Wikipedia’s notability and verifiability guidelines.

I am looking for a moderately detailed treatment—something richer than a bare timeline yet still concise enough to keep readers engaged. No sections on products, services, or the executive team are needed at this stage unless you advise that they help meet policy requirements.

Key deliverables:
• Draft the article in your sandbox, fully formatted in Wiki markup.  
• Integrate reliable, third-party citations that pass WP:RS.  
• Address any issues raised by community reviewers until the page is live.  
• Provide a final link and a copy of the wikitext for our records.

Experience with Wikipedia editing policies, AfC submissions, and page maintenance is essential.

jobs.title: Hindi Lip-Sync Dubbing Needed
jobs.description:
I have a short video—exactly 1 minute 5 seconds—that needs a flawless Hindi dub aimed at an adult audience. All four on-screen characters must sound natural and stay in perfect sync with their lip movements.

Voices required  
• 3 distinct female voices  
• 1 distinct male voice  

Please deliver the final mix in high-quality WAV. If you prefer to send separate stems for each character, that’s fine as long as timing remains tight.

Time is critical, so only reply if you can turn the project around quickly. Send a link to recent Hindi lip-sync work that shows multiple characters, and include your fee and estimated delivery time in the same message. I will review samples immediately and award as soon as I find the right match.

jobs.title: YouTube Livestream Highlights Editing
jobs.description:
I run daily YouTube livestreams and need someone who can jump in right after each session, spot the standout moments, and shape them into share-ready highlight clips. Turnaround speed is important because the clips go live the same day, ideally within a few hours of the stream ending.

Each highlight should:
• Run 30 – 120 seconds, 1080p, 60 fps.  
• Include concise hook text in the first three seconds and clean end-screen space.  
• Keep my original branding assets (logo sting, lower-third, background track) exactly as provided.

I record in OBS and store VODs on a Google Drive folder you will have immediate access to. You are welcome to work in Premiere Pro, Final Cut, DaVinci Resolve, or any NLE you are comfortable with, as long as the final MP4 meets YouTube’s recommended settings.

When you apply, focus on your experience cutting highlight reels from livestream or long-form footage—tell me how many you have produced, the average turnaround time you maintain, and link to two or three examples that best show your pacing and storytelling.

Consistent, on-time delivery and a good eye for moments that hook viewers will be the key factors I use when awarding the project.

jobs.title: Develop & Host 4-Page Website
jobs.description:
I have finalised all layouts, copy, and imagery for a small business website and now need a developer who can turn those assets into a fast-loading, fully responsive four-page site. The pages are already designed for both desktop and mobile breakpoints; you’ll simply translate the visuals into clean HTML5, CSS3, and lightweight JavaScript, test across modern browsers, and publish everything to my GoDaddy hosting account.

Key elements I expect:  
• Pixel-accurate build that matches the supplied Figma/PSD files  
• Mobile-first responsiveness without breaking points on phones, tablets, or large screens  
• A working contact form that sends submissions to my email (reCAPTCHA or similar basic spam protection is a plus)  
• SSL enabled, domain connected, and live on GoDaddy with any required DNS tweaks handled  
• Basic on-page SEO setup: semantic tags, meta titles, descriptions, and alt text from the content I provide  
• Handover of all source files, clearly commented code, and a short read-me that explains any build steps

Once the site is live and I’ve confirmed every link, form, and breakpoint works, the job is done. If you’re comfortable deploying on GoDaddy and can deliver a neat, standards-compliant build, let’s get started.

jobs.title: Trendy EU Social Media Graphics
jobs.description:
I’m refreshing my TikTok, Instagram and LinkedIn presence across the European market and need a graphic designer who can deliver eye-catching, on-brand visuals fast. The immediate tasks on my plate are:

• Scroll-stopping social media posts ready to publish in the correct sizes for each platform.  
• Matching video thumbnails that tease the content and boost click-through.

I’m after a distinctly trendy look—think bold typography, playful layouts and modern colour choices that feel at home in today’s feeds. You won’t be hemmed in by strict brand guidelines; I’m giving you full creative license to experiment with palettes, gradients and effects until the visuals pop.  

Here’s how we’ll work:  
1. You receive the raw copy, footage grabs or product shots.  
2. You propose a quick style direction (mood board or sample frame).  
3. Once approved, you roll out the final assets, supplying layered source files (PSD/AI or Figma) plus ready-to-upload PNG/JPEG/MP4 exports.  

Turnaround needs to be quick but quality can’t slip—I’m targeting end-of-week delivery for the first batch and will have recurring requests if we click. If you thrive in Adobe Creative Cloud or Canva and understand platform-specific specs (1080×1920, 1080×1350, 1280×720, etc.), let’s talk.

jobs.title: Shopify-Amazon & Google Sync
jobs.description:
I need a Shopify specialist to connect my store to Amazon and Google Shopping so products flow smoothly to each marketplace without manual uploads. My accounts on both platforms are already active; what’s missing is a reliable product-level sync that keeps titles, descriptions, images, pricing, and stock in lockstep with Shopify.

The scope is limited to product feeds and catalog synchronisation—no inventory or order routing for now—so the job centres on configuring the right apps or custom API settings, mapping all fields correctly, and confirming that every SKU publishes error-free. Expect a mix of bulk and variant items.

Success looks like this: feeds refresh automatically on the schedule you recommend; all required attributes pass Amazon and Google validation; and I can see live listings that match my Shopify catalog one-for-one. If a product is edited or unpublished in Shopify, the change must reflect in both channels within the expected update window.

Please share examples of similar multi-channel feeds you have deployed, the primary tools or apps you prefer, and any hurdles you solved along the way.

jobs.title: Print-to-Word Data Entry
jobs.description:
I have a set of printed documents that I need re-typed into Microsoft Word. The task is straightforward data entry―no tables, images, or complex layouts―but accuracy is essential. Please replicate the text exactly as it appears on the pages, using the font family and size I will supply at the outset so everything remains consistent throughout the file. Apart from that font specification, standard Word formatting is all that’s required.

Deliverable: a single, clean .docx file with every page from the printed source fully transcribed and proofread for typos. Let me know your turnaround time and any questions you might have about the font guidelines before you begin.

jobs.title: Modello 3D sedia ufficio
jobs.description:
Devo realizzare il modello 3D di una sedia da ufficio dal design minimalista, pensata per essere prodotta in plastica bianca. Il progetto deve suddividere la sedia in 5 pezzi distinti che possano essere montati senza attrezzi speciali, grazie a incastri o agganci semplici.

Cosa mi serve:
• File 3D nativo creato in un software comune (Blender, Fusion 360, SolidWorks o similare).  
• Esportazioni in STEP e STL pronte per la stampa o per l’iniezione plastica.  
• Un breve schema o tavola che mostri l’ordine di assemblaggio e i punti di incastro.  
• Due render realistici (vista frontale e prospettica) per presentazione.

Preferisco un modello pulito, con geometrie ottimizzate e misure in millimetri. Mantieni linee essenziali coerenti con lo stile minimalista, evitando dettagli superflui che complicherebbero la produzione.

Consegna: link per il download dei file, più PDF/immagine con le istruzioni di montaggio.  
Resto disponibile per chiarire dimensioni o tolleranze prima di iniziare.

jobs.title: Uber-Style Ride App Build
jobs.description:
My goal is to launch a clean, reliable ride-hailing application that works seamlessly on both iOS and Android. At this stage I am concentrating on the essentials: riders must be able to request a trip, drivers must be able to receive and accept those requests, and both user types need separate, intuitive profile areas to manage their details.  

You are free to choose the most suitable tech stack—whether that is native Swift/Kotlin, Flutter, React Native, or another proven approach—as long as the final builds feel buttery-smooth and pass App Store / Google Play submission guidelines.  

Deliverables  
• Rider app (iOS + Android) with real-time ride-booking workflow  
• Driver app (iOS + Android) that receives the same requests  
• Source code and compiled binaries ready for store upload  
• Brief hand-off documentation covering environment setup and build steps  

Payment integration and live tracking are out of scope for this first release; I may commission them as a follow-up once the core flow runs faultlessly.

jobs.title: Translate Romance Novel to Simplified Chinese
jobs.description:
I have a 10,000-word English romance manuscript that needs to be rendered faithfully into Simplified Chinese. The story is contemporary, light-hearted, and dialogue-driven; I want readers in Mainland China to feel as though the novel was originally written for them. Expect idiomatic phrasing, culturally appropriate references, and natural-sounding conversations rather than a literal, word-for-word conversion.

You will receive the complete English file in Word. Return the finished Simplified Chinese version in the same format, keeping all chapter headings and paragraph breaks intact so I can drop it straight into layout.

Deliverables  
• One Word document containing the full 10,000-word translation in Simplified Chinese  
• A brief translator’s note flagging any passages that required localisation choices or cultural adaptation

Acceptance criteria  
• Smooth, error-free prose that reads like native fiction  
• Consistent character voices and romantic tone preserved  
• No machine-translation residue; I will run spot checks for style consistency

Please let me know your estimated turnaround time and any relevant romance or literary samples you have translated before we begin.

jobs.title: Server Overload Fix & PHP Optimization
jobs.description:
My newly-redesigned product catalogue site has been crashing the virtual cloud server it lives on. The load climbs rapidly until the kernel’s OOM-killer steps in, MySQL gets shot down, and Apache stops responding. Early digging points to two likely culprits: MySQL’s OOM score is too high, making it the first service killed, and suPHP is adding unnecessary overhead as our current PHP handler.

What I need is a concise rescue and hardening job:
STEP 1.
• Diagnose the precise cause of the memory spikes and 100 % CPU events.  
• Re-tune (or override) the OOM score so MySQL stays alive under pressure.  

STEP 2. 
• Migrate the site from suPHP to a more efficient handler such as PHP-FPM or FastCGI, with zero downtime.  
• Verify database settings and query cache to be sure MySQL itself is not the bottleneck.  
• Hand back a short report describing what was changed and why, plus any follow-up recommendations.

The stack is standard LAMP on a virtual cloud server, MySQL is the only database, and the site is code-based—no cPanel wizards. SSH root access is ready when we agree on the plan. Success is the server running steadily for 48 hours under simulated peak traffic without MySQL getting killed or the site slowing to a crawl.

jobs.title: Comprehensive Casino Platform QA Testing
jobs.description:
I need a dedicated QA specialist to give our online casino platform full end-to-end coverage. For now the work is entirely on the web version, and I will provide access to production, staging, and all documentation once we onboard you.

Scope of attention  
• User interface and overall player experience  
• Security and compliance flows, including payment and KYC paths  
• Core gameplay functionality across our current catalogue  

Testing mix  
The job combines structured manual test passes with your own automated suites, plus focused performance runs to keep page loads and game spins within our targets. Right now the priority environment is desktop browsers; mobile can follow once we have rock-solid desktop results.

Hours & cadence  
Plan on 20–30 hours a week for the first fortnight while you learn the system and cover the immediate release cycle. If everything clicks, I’ll open the throttle to 30–40 hours weekly for continuous release support.

Deliverables  
1. Detailed test plan outlining manual, automated, and performance checkpoints  
2. Defect logs in our chosen tracker with clear repro steps, severity, and environment tags  
3. Daily Slack updates and a concise weekly quality report so the dev team can act fast

Acceptance criteria  
• Zero critical or high-severity bugs slip into production during your rounds  
• Automated smoke suite runs clean on every desktop build  
• Performance metrics stay within the SLA we’ll agree on together

If you love digging into casino products and can balance exploratory instincts with methodical reporting, I’d like to work long term. Access details will be shared right after we sign.

jobs.title: Terjemahkan Artikel Sains Teknologi
jobs.description:
Saya memiliki sebuah artikel akademis di bidang sains dan teknologi yang saat ini ditulis dalam bahasa Indonesia. Klien utama saya kesulitan berbahasa Inggris, jadi saya membutuhkan penerjemahan dokumen yang rapi dan akurat ke dalam bahasa Inggris akademis.

Ruang lingkup:
• Menerjemahkan seluruh artikel (sekitar 5.000–6.000 kata) ke bahasa Inggris dengan gaya penulisan jurnal ilmiah.  
• Memastikan istilah teknis dan terminologi sains serta teknologi digunakan secara tepat.  
• Melakukan penyelarasan kutipan, referensi, dan format sesuai pedoman akademis umum (APA/IEEE, disesuaikan dengan konten).  
• Melakukan pemeriksaan tata bahasa dan proof-reading akhir agar naskah siap kirim ke jurnal atau konferensi.

Saya akan menyediakan:
– File artikel dalam format Word.  
– Catatan singkat mengenai jurnal sasaran dan kata kunci utama.

Harap lampirkan contoh terjemahan serupa—khususnya tulisan ilmiah—agar saya bisa menilai konsistensi istilah dan gaya. Terima kasih, saya menantikan kolaborasi yang membantu klien saya memublikasikan risetnya secara internasional!

jobs.title: Oracle Retail MFCS Trainer Required
jobs.description:
Need trainer for Oracle retail MFCS (Oracle retail merchandising foundation cloud system)


I’m looking for an experienced professional who can provide hands-on, real-time project-based training on Oracle Retail MFCS >v19.

Trainer Requirements:
• Strong hands-on experience in Oracle Retail MFCS >v19
• Functional + Technical expertise
• MFCS Foundation Data, Items, Suppliers, Locations & Merchandising
• Inventory, Purchasing, Pricing & Replenishment
• Stock Ledger and financial processes
• POM / Batch processing
• SQL / PL-SQL and MFCS data model
• RIB/RICS, REST APIs and integrations
• Data migration / validation
• Real-time implementation and production support experience
• Ability to explain concepts with actual project scenarios and hands-on demonstrations

Training Focus:
The objective is to provide participants with practical knowledge that can help them understand how MFCS works in real projects, rather than only covering theoretical concepts.

Engagement: Part-Time Only
Training Mode: Online

If you are an experienced Oracle Retail MFCS Functional/Technical Consultant interested in contributing as a trainer, please DM me with your profile, MFCS versions worked on, training experience and availability.

jobs.title: Auto-Book Amazon Shifts Tool -- 2
jobs.description:
I need a Windows-compatible application that continuously watches Amazon warehouse shift postings the moment they go live, snaps them up before they disappear, and lets me know once a slot is secured. Speed is everything—shifts currently vanish within seconds—so the tool must poll the site or API in real time, then execute the booking automatically with minimal latency.

Key functions I must see working:  
• Real-time monitoring of new shift availability  
• Fully automated booking as soon as a chosen slot appears  
• Immediate notification (desktop pop-up, email, or SMS—open to your suggestion) confirming each successful grab  

Interface is flexible: a simple GUI or even a CLI is fine as long as it’s stable and intuitive. Behind the scenes you can leverage Python with Selenium, C# with HTTP requests, or any stack you believe offers the fastest response and easiest future maintenance. Just document setup clearly so I can run it on my own Windows machine.

Deliverables:  
1. Compiled executable and source code  
2. Config file or panel where I can set login credentials, preferred warehouse, dates, and shift lengths  
3. Short README or video walkthrough covering installation, usage, and troubleshooting  

Acceptance criteria: on a test account the program must detect a newly released shift and reserve it within the first refresh cycle, then send the confirmation alert.

Let me know the core technology you plan to use, estimated turnaround, and any API or captcha considerations you anticipate.

jobs.title: Mixed-Use Chief Architect Drawings
jobs.description:

The native .plan file is ready; what I am missing is a set of presentation-quality PDFs that pull all the critical views together—floor plans, elevations and sections—styled in a contemporary graphic language.

The task is straightforward: start from my Chief Architect files, refine line-weights, hatches, annotations and page layouts, then export press-ready sheets that read clearly at A1 and A3 sizes. Keep title blocks, north points and scales consistent across every sheet and organise the set so council reviewers can follow the story from site context through to building sections. Source layers must stay intact so I can revise later if needed.

Deliverables  
• Editable Chief Architect file with updated annotation layers  
• PDF drawing set (floor plans, elevations, sections) ready for client and council submission  
• A brief change log noting any adjustments made to my original model

Completion files will be considered accepted once dimensions register accurately, sheet naming aligns with council conventions and graphic style matches the contemporary look shown in my reference sample.

This project will be based on an hourly rate of $30–$40 AUD per hour for competent freelancers.

• Final artwork supplied in vector (AI/SVG) plus high-res PNG and PDF versions.

Acceptance criteria  
1. Logo clearly reads “CHR Mortgages” and visually conveys the iceberg narrative at a glance.  
2. Design remains legible and recognisable from business-card to billboard size.  
3. Palette respects the stated colour limitations.  
4. All files are supplied print-ready and digitally optimised.

If you love distilling complex stories into elegant marks and can bring a dash of innovation to a classic financial brand, I’d love to see your concept sketches and hear how you’d approach this project.

jobs.title: Shopify–Odoo Multichannel Integration
jobs.description:
I’m ready to connect my existing Shopify store with our Odoo (sh) so that every part of our multichannel operation—Website, in-store POS, and CRM—runs from a single source of truth.

Inventory & stock  
• Real-time stock synchronisation between Shopify and Odoo, including multi-location levels.  
• Automated replenishment rules pulled from Odoo so low-stock items in Shopify trigger purchase/ manufacturing orders.  
• Inventory reporting inside Odoo that reflects all sales activity, including POS transactions.

Sales channels  
Both the online storefront and the physical POS need to push orders straight into Odoo Sales while updating customers and payments automatically. CRM records must be created or updated at the same time.

Website-specific needs  
• Full order-management loop: confirmed orders arrive in Odoo, fulfilment updates return to Shopify and notify customers.  
• Product-catalogue syncing: titles, descriptions, images, variants, and prices flow bi-directionally.  
• Customer data syncing: names, emails, addresses, and purchase history align in both systems.  
• Inventory views on the site must always reflect Odoo’s live quantities.

Tech stack expectations  
You’ll likely rely on Shopify API, Odoo XML-RPC / JSON-RPC, webhooks, and PostgreSQL. If you prefer an off-the-shelf connector, that’s fine as long as custom logic can still be added.

Acceptance criteria  
1. Zero-error sync in a sandbox, then production.  
2. Latency between a POS sale and stock update under two minutes.  
3. No duplicate customers or products after migration.  
4. Clear deployment and rollback documentation.

Let me know your approach, estimated timeline, and any prior examples of Shopify ↔ Odoo work so we can get started.

jobs.title: Replace 14-Meter Roof Guttering
jobs.description:
I need the existing 14 m stretch of roof guttering on my single-storey home completely removed and replaced with new aluminum guttering in a matte finish. The run is straight with two corners and feeds into one main downpipe on the ground floor.  

Along with the gutter swap, I want matching aluminum downspout extensions installed so rainwater is carried at least 1 m clear of the foundation. The fascia is sound and the current brackets are spaced correctly, but replace any that are bent or incompatible with the new profile.

Deliverables  
• Supply and install ±14 m matte-finish aluminum guttering  
• Fit new brackets as needed and seal all joints to prevent leaks  
• Attach aluminum downspout extensions, directing water away from the house  
• Remove and dispose of old guttering and job-related debris  
• Final water test showing a clean, even flow with no drips or sagging  

Please factor in labour, materials, and cleanup. Work can be done any weekday; let me know your earliest available date and estimated duration. Photos of similar aluminum installs you’ve completed will help me choose quickly.

jobs.title: Professional Window & Door Brochure
jobs.description: I need a professional sales brochure that will be attached to a quote sent to the customer. It will detail our main products with photos and descriptions. It will be of our suppliers products, Stegbar. I have attached a mockup I had Claude make. The photos will change and I want it to look cleaner, with JMG and Stegbar logo bigger and better blended on the cover page. The wording may also change.

jobs.title: Professional Business Website Design
jobs.description:
I'm seeking an experienced web designer to create an informational/business profile website.

Key Requirements:
- Design and implement a professional, user-friendly website
- Incorporate a contact form and testimonials sections
- Follow basic branding guidelines and color schemes

Ideal Skills and Experience:
- Proven portfolio in business website design
- Strong understanding of user experience (UX)
- Ability to work with basic branding concepts

jobs.title: Men’s Haircut Transformation Slideshow
jobs.description:
I need a polished, eye-catching slideshow that strings together several men’s haircut transformations—each frame moving smoothly from the raw “before” shot to the sharpened “after.” Every cut must clearly spotlight the three key elements I rely on in the shop: clean fades, sharp line-ups, and textured styles. Please include the beard work as part of the makeover so the finished look feels complete and market-ready.

The goal is to end up with a single, shareable file I can post straight to Instagram, TikTok, and the screens inside my barbershop. I’m looking for tight timing, crisp transitions, and color correction that keeps skin tones natural while letting the fades pop.

Acceptance criteria  
• 8–10 full HD slides, each pairing a “before” and “after” of the same client  
• Subtle motion or cross-fade that makes the change instantly obvious (no harsh cuts)  
• Final delivery in MP4 (1080×1920 vertical) plus the working project file  

If you have a proven knack for dynamic grooming reels or photo compilations, I’m ready to see it and get started right away.

jobs.title: Student Graphic Design Help
jobs.description:
I’m working on a graphic design piece for one of my university courses and need an experienced designer to guide me from concept to final artwork. The brief is already approved by my professor, but I’m struggling to refine the visual direction, choose a cohesive colour palette, and prepare the files correctly for submission.

Here’s what I’m hoping you can do with me:  
• Review my current sketches and mood board, then suggest improvements or alternative approaches that still meet the brief.  
• Walk me through best-practice layout, typography, and colour choices so I understand the reasoning behind each change.  
• Help me translate the final concept into polished assets using Adobe Illustrator or Photoshop (whichever you’re most comfortable with).  
• Package everything into print-ready PDFs along with the editable source files so I can both submit the project and learn from the layers you build.

Acceptance criteria  
• At least two refined concept options, each with clear notes on design choices.  
• One fully developed final design delivered in high-resolution PDF plus the layered .ai or .psd file.  
• A short explanatory document (or annotated layers) outlining key techniques used, so I can reference them in my reflection paper.

If you’re patient, enjoy teaching while designing, and can turn feedback around quickly, I’d love to collaborate.

jobs.title: Android Closed Beta Testers Needed
jobs.description:
I’ve just opened a Google Play Closed Test for my new Android app and need at least twelve testers to satisfy Google’s requirements. If you use an Android phone running version 10 or newer, I’d appreciate your help.

What you’ll do  
• Accept the invitation link I’ll send and opt into the Closed Test on Google Play.  
• Install the app and keep it on your device for the full test window (Google checks participation).  
• Use the app now and then, paying particular attention to its user interface, overall performance, and most importantly its main functionality.  
• Send me brief notes or screenshots whenever you spot a bug, slowdown, or visual glitch.  
• Stay enrolled until I confirm the testing period has officially ended.

There are no known issues at the moment, so your feedback will directly shape the release version. Once you confirm participation I’ll forward the Play Store link and a simple template for reporting findings.

If you’re happy to remain opted in for the required duration, let’s get started.

jobs.title: On-Device Mobile AI Assistant
jobs.description:
I need a small-footprint AI that actually lives inside my phone’s internal storage and works without sending data to the cloud. Through voice or text I will say things like “open WhatsApp”, “start a new Python file”, “edit this photo”, or “type this paragraph” and the assistant should carry out the request on the spot.

Scope of control  
• Mobile applications – launching, switching, closing, and basic in-app navigation  
• System-level functions – toggling Wi-Fi/Bluetooth, adjusting settings, saving screenshots, etc.  
• Coding and programming tasks – opening an editor, creating files, inserting sample code snippets, compiling where possible  
• Typing, data entry, and general content creation or editing within any text field

Core requirements  
• Runs fully on-device (Android preferred), no constant Internet dependency  
• Natural-language understanding for Hindi and English commands  
• Secure permission model: it must ask for any new privilege once, then remember it  
• Modular design so I can add new skills later without reinstalling the whole package  
• Clear documentation plus an installable APK or similar package that I can sideload

Acceptance criteria  
1. Voice/text command executed within two seconds on a mid-range Android phone, offline.  
2. At least 10 demo commands covering app launch, navigation, typing, and a simple code snippet insertion.  
3. Source code, build instructions, and a brief video showing the assistant in action.

If you have experience with on-device NLP (e.g., TensorFlow Lite, whisper.cpp, Rasa, or similar) and Android automation APIs like Accessibility Service, I’d love to see your approach and previous work.

jobs.title: Daily Gmail Response & Cleanup
jobs.description:
I need a reliable hand to jump into my Gmail inbox once each day, sweep out the spam and junk, and take care of replies that only require our already-written standard messages or a simple follow-up.  

Here’s what the routine looks like:  
• Log in at roughly the same time every day.  
• Archive or delete anything clearly unwanted.  
• Use my library of pre-approved templates for quick, standard responses.  
• If a thread needs a polite nudge, send the follow-up and note the date.  
• Flag anything outside those boundaries so I can handle it personally.

You’ll have clear labels, canned responses, and priority rules waiting for you, so the workflow stays fast and consistent. All activity happens inside Gmail; no extra tools are required beyond basic Google Workspace features.

Consistency and clear communication matter more than sheer speed—if you can keep the inbox tidy and the standard replies rolling, this will be a smooth, ongoing part-time role.

jobs.title: Narrative Storytelling Interview
jobs.description:
I'm looking for a skilled interviewer to conduct a small interview with one person. The interview will be used for educational purposes and will be in the form of a narrative storytelling. The goal is to raise awareness on a specific topic. 

Key requirements:
- Conduct a narrative-style interview
- Focus on educational content
- Evoke awareness through storytelling

Ideal skills and experience:
- Experience in conducting interviews
- Strong storytelling ability
- Background in educational content creation

jobs.title: Creative Corporate Deck Design
jobs.description:
I need a fresh, visually striking corporate deck that I can take straight into client meetings. The look and feel should be creative and colorful—something that still reads professional but instantly differentiates us from the usual template-driven presentations.

Core content to include:
• Company overview  
• Services and products  
• Client testimonials  

I will supply the raw copy and any existing brand assets once we get started; you turn them into a cohesive, on-brand slide deck (PowerPoint, Google Slides, or Keynote—whichever you prefer, as long as the file is fully editable). Please incorporate thoughtful layout, consistent iconography, and a color palette that supports our story without overwhelming it.

Final deliverables:
1. Editable slide deck with all graphics embedded  
2. Exported PDF ready for sharing  
3. One round of revisions for polish and tweaks  

If this matches your skill set and you can inject real creative flair while keeping the message crystal clear, let’s talk timelines and get moving.

jobs.title: HL7 Healthcare Integration Software Engineer Needed
jobs.description:
We are looking for more than a normal software developer.

We need someone like an HL7 / healthcare integration engineer who can understand an old system, clean it up, and rebuild it safely in the new environment.

We want someone who can do these things:

- Understand HL7 — ADT, ORM, ORU, fields, routing, transforms.
- Understand Mirth / BridgeLink — channels, sources, filters, transformers, destinations.
- Read old code and old configuration and figure out what it really does.
- Document the current system instead of guessing.
- Find bad, duplicate, or dead rules and decide what should stay or go. The project specifically says every old channel/filter/transform must be inventoried, then mapped to a new cloud-Mirth version or retired.
- Build the new cloud Mirth system with one clean standard model instead of many messy site-specific rules.
- Work with Laurel Bridge Compass and Navigator for HL7/DICOM routing and image prefetch.
- Test very carefully before changing production. Our plan is to run the old and new systems together, compare messages field by field, and cut over only after validation.
-Troubleshoot independently.

jobs.title: Project for Shan Sai
jobs.description: online language teachers needed, BUDGET SENSITIVE PROJECT, mainly looking for vietnamese, chinese, indonesian, thai, but others also needed such as arabic, spanish, bengali, hindi, russian, french and german, portuguese, urdu, farsi, turkish, korean, tamil, cambodian, burmese, polish, mongolian, nepali, dutch, swedish, greek, czech, will favour cheapest bids. growing start-up project, possibility for on-going work (hence multiple ads). indicate languages can teach, quals (optional, none essential, but desirable), rough available times (very approx "evenings" "mornings" "weekends" etc. write 'read it all' at the end. will favour cheaper bids.

jobs.title: Android CRM App via Capacitor
jobs.description:
My WhatsApp-based CRM SaaS already runs smoothly on the web; now I need a focused Android companion built with Capacitor. The initial scope is intentionally lean so we can ship fast and learn from users.  

Core functionality for this first release:  
• Email-and-password login with new-user registration linked to my existing back-end.  
• Contact management: fetch, add, edit, archive and sync contacts that already live in the SaaS database.  
• Message broadcasting: pick contacts or lists, compose a WhatsApp message and trigger the existing server-side send endpoint.  

I have sketches and a clear idea of the key screens but no polished UI kit, so I’ll rely on you to translate those ideas into a clean, intuitive interface that feels at home on modern Android. Capacitor and (Ionic/React/Angular/Vue—your choice) must be the foundation so we can share code with a future iOS build.  

Deliverables  
1. Source code in a Git repo with concise README for local setup.  
2. Signed release-ready APK plus a debug build for testing.  
3. Basic unit or integration tests around authentication and API calls.  
4. Short Loom walkthrough of the app and code structure.  

Acceptance criteria  
• Successful login/registration flows, with JWT stored securely and refreshed.  
• All three feature areas operate against staging APIs I will provide.  
• App builds without errors using Capacitor CLI and runs on Android 11+.  
• UI matches the agreed wireframes and passes a simple usability check I’ll schedule.  

Timeline can be flexible within reason, but I’d like a functional MVP in hand within three weeks so I can start internal testing. Let’s keep communication clear; I’ll answer API or design questions fast to keep momentum high.

jobs.title: Interactive Programmatic Campaign Presentation
jobs.description:
I’ve wrapped up a multi-channel programmatic campaign and now I need its story told in a way that wows senior stakeholders as well as data-savvy teammates. The deck should move viewers smoothly from strategy to results, using rich, interactive elements rather than static slides.

Here’s the narrative I want surfaced: how we defined and scaled the target audience, which publishers and placements carried the weight, what creative formats we tested, and—most importantly—the performance metrics and KPIs that prove success. Think clickable charts, drill-down graphs, hover-over callouts, or embedded dashboards that let a viewer explore numbers without ever leaving the presentation.

I’m comfortable with PowerPoint, Google Slides, or Keynote, so choose whichever platform will best support interactivity. If you work with tools like Data Studio, Tableau, or Power BI for live charts, all the better; just be sure the final file can travel offline when needed.

Deliverables  
• A fully-designed slide deck (8–10 slides) with interactive elements in place  
• Source files plus any linked data sets  
• Two revision rounds to fine-tune visuals or copy  

I’ll supply raw reports, creative assets, and audience definitions as soon as we start. Let’s turn those numbers into a presentation that makes the campaign’s journey instantly clear and undeniably impressive.

jobs.title: WordPress Content Refresh Needed
jobs.description:
I need a quick refresh on my existing WordPress site. The job is strictly content–focused: replace outdated text, swap in a handful of new images, and make sure everything displays cleanly across desktop and mobile. You’ll have full editor-level access, so the work should be limited to the WordPress dashboard—no theme or plugin work is planned right now, though I’m open to small styling tweaks if that helps the new content sit naturally on the page.

Deliverables:
• Updated text on the specified pages or posts, formatted consistently with current styles  
• Optimised images (correct size, compression, alt tags) uploaded and placed in context  
• A brief changelog outlining which sections were modified

I’ll supply the final copy and imagery; you handle upload, formatting, and QA so the site looks polished the moment we hit “publish.”

jobs.title: Transcribe Handwritten Notes to Google Docs
jobs.description:
I have a stack of handwritten pages that I need entered verbatim into a single Google Docs file. No special styling is necessary—plain text is fine—but there are a few occasional symbols scattered throughout, so accuracy on those is critical.

You’ll receive clear scans of each page. Simply transfer the content line-for-line into Google Docs, double-checking that every character, word, and symbol matches the original. When finished, share the document back with editing rights enabled so I can review and sign off.

Deliverable:
• One Google Docs file containing the full, error-free transcription of all provided pages.

jobs.title: Urgent 21+ Page Notes Typing
jobs.description: I have more than twenty-one handwritten pages of personal notes that I need transcribed as soon as possible. The final file must be delivered in Plain Text only—no DOCX, PDF, or other formats—and I do not require any special formatting beyond clean line breaks. Accuracy is critical; every word, number, and symbol should be captured exactly as written. Once the text is complete, simply send me the .txt file so I can review and confirm everything matches my originals. If you can start immediately and work quickly without sacrificing precision, I’m ready to move forward right away.

jobs.title: Proof Read 77 pages From Hindi To Assamese Language -- 3
jobs.description:
I have a 77-pages of spiritual manuscript that has already been translated from Hindi into Assamese, and I need a meticulous technical proofread before it moves to layout. Your task is to verify that every Assamese line reflects the original hindi meaning while maintaining flawless accuracy and consistency.

The text leans heavily on spiritual terminology, so I want special attention paid to consistent use of key terms, cultural relevance for Assamese readers, and overall readability. If you spot any section where the translation drifts from the source or a phrase sounds awkward in Assamese, flag it and suggest a precise alternative rather than altering the tone.

You will receive a Word file with the Hindi and Assamese texts side by side. Please use Track Changes and margin comments to record every correction or query.

Deliverables:
• Clean, error-free Assamese manuscript ready for publishing
• Version with all changes tracked and annotated
• Brief summary of recurring issues or terminology decisions

Native-level Assamese, strong English comprehension, and prior experience proofreading faith-based or spiritual content are essential. Let me know your estimated turnaround time for 77 pages, and we can get started right away.

jobs.title: पुन: प्रयोज्य दुश्मन AI सिस्टम
jobs.description:
मैं अपने गेम के लिए एक लचीला, डेटा-ड्रिवन दुश्मन AI तैयार कराना चाहता हूँ। लक्ष्य यह है कि एक ही मूल कोडबेस से अलग-अलग दुश्मन प्रकार बन सकें—सिर्फ पैरामीटर बदलते ही नया व्यवहार तैयार हो जाए, मुझे हर बार स्क्रिप्ट दोबारा न लिखनी पड़े।  

मुख्य आवश्यकताएँ  
• दुश्मन शैली: मानव-जैसे दुश्मन।  
• मूवमेंट: NavMesh-आधारित पाथफाइंडिंग।  
• व्यवहार संरचना: Behavior Tree या State Machine—जो भी समाधान अधिक मॉड्यूलर साबित हो।  
• कोर स्टेट्स: Patrol, Chase, Attack और Retreat, सभी सहज ट्रांज़िशन के साथ।  
• पेट्रोल मोड: दुश्मन खिलाड़ी की गतिविधियों पर प्रतिक्रिया करते हुए गश्त करे, न कि तय या यादृच्छिक मार्ग पर।  
• रिएक्शन ट्रिगर्स (इन-गेम इवेंट्स)  
  - खिलाड़ी के हमले  
  - खिलाड़ी के स्थान परिवर्तन  
  - खिलाड़ी की स्वास्थ्य स्थिति  

क्यों ज़रूरी है  
मैं दुश्मन के कई प्रकार और अलग-अलग मुठभेड़ के लक्ष्य शेयर करूँगा। हर प्रकार की गति, आक्रामकता, दृष्टि-दूरी, स्वास्थ्य आदि को बाहरी कॉन्फ़िगरेशन (JSON, Scriptable Object, या आपकी सुझाई किसी भी डेटा फ़ॉर्मैट) से नियंत्रित किया जा सके; इससे लेवल-डिज़ाइनर बिना कोड छुए दुश्मन का व्यवहार ट्वीक कर सकें।  

आपसे अपेक्षित डिलिवरेबल  
1. स्वच्छ, टिप्पणी-युक्त सोर्स कोड और फ़ोल्डर स्ट्रक्चर।  
2. डेटा फाइलें / एसेट्स जिनसे पैरामीटर बदले जा सकें।  
3. एक छोटा नमूना सीन या प्रोजेक्ट जहाँ मैं तुरंत परीक्षण कर सकूँ।  
4. README या लघु टेक्निकल डॉक्यूमेंटेशन—सेट-अप, नई टाइप जोड़ने की प्रक्रिया, तथा व्यवहार ट्री/स्टेट डायग्राम का संक्षिप्त अवलोकन।  

यदि आपके पास पहले से व्यवहार ट्री एडिटर, FSM फ्रेमवर्क, या कोई कस्टम टूलकिट है, तो बताइए; मैं खुले-स्रोत या लाइसेंस शर्तों पर लचीला हूँ, बस अंतिम समाधान री-यूज़ेबल और सुव्यवस्थित होना चाहिए। 

समयसीमा और अगले कदम  
अपनी अनुमानित समयरेखा, जिन तकनीकों/इंजन पर आप काम करेंगे, और पूर्व के समान काम के उदाहरण साझा करें। मिलकर एक छोटा प्रूफ़-ऑफ़-काँसेप्ट तय करेंगे; संतुष्ट होने पर आप पूरा सिस्टम बढ़ाएँगे।

jobs.title: Portada Abstracta Generada con IA
jobs.description:
Necesito una ilustración estilo abstracto creada con inteligencia artificial para la portada de mi próximo libro. Quiero que el diseño combine:

• Colores vivos que capten la atención de inmediato  
• Formas geométricas que aporten ritmo y equilibrio visual  
• Texturas complejas que añadan profundidad y un aire contemporáneo  

Entrego la idea general y el título, y cuento contigo para transformar ese concepto en una pieza impactante. 

Entrega esperada:  
1. Archivo final listo para impresión (300 dpi, PDF o TIFF)  
2. Archivo editable en capas (PSD, AI o equivalente) para ajustes futuros  
3. Versión optimizada para vista previa digital (JPEG/PNG)  

Valoro la comunicación clara y las revisiones rápidas. Si dominas herramientas como Midjourney, Stable Diffusion o DALL·E, menciónalo: me interesa entender tu flujo de trabajo. ¡Hagamos que esta portada destaque en la estantería!

jobs.title: WordPress News Blog Build
jobs.description:
I’m setting up a WordPress-based blog dedicated to publishing timely news and long-form articles. The site needs to look professional, load quickly, and make it easy for readers to move between categories and individual stories.

Core requirements
• Design or customise a clean, responsive theme that suits a news portal  
• Configure and style WordPress’s native comment sections so readers can discuss each post easily (spam-protection plugins welcome)  
• Build an intuitive menu and category structure for articles, archives, and featured stories  
• Set up essential plugins for SEO, security, and performance without bloating the site  
• Deliver a ready-to-publish site with clear documentation on how I can add or edit content

I already have hosting and a fresh WordPress install waiting; you’ll receive full admin access once we agree on the approach. If you’ve previously built editorial or magazine-style WordPress sites and can point me to live examples, that will help us move quickly.

Acceptance criteria: the homepage and one sample article page match the approved design, comments work flawlessly on desktop and mobile, and Lighthouse scores stay in the green.

jobs.title: Minimalist Luxury townhouse Interior Design
jobs.description:
I have a multi unit development.

I require interior design done to 1 unit.
This needs to include kitchen, bathroom, living area, powder room, master bedroom only.

The design needs to be minimalist, all neutral colours, natural stone, linear mosaic tiles etc.
Flooring throughout house to be Engineered timber flooring, and bedrooms to be carpet.

I can provide some inspiration images, but happy for you to amend and design as you see fit and we coordinate to understand the inspiration.

Requirement to provide 2D PDF drawings and 3D renders.

jobs.title: Local Lead-Driving Social Posts
jobs.description:
I run a small, service-based business that depends on steady, local foot traffic and enquiries. To make that happen online, I need a creative partner who can consistently plan, create and publish both Reels and static posters across Facebook and Instagram.  

The mission is simple: every piece of content should move local viewers one step closer to calling, booking or walking through the door. I can supply raw photos, short video clips and basic brand guidelines; you turn them into thumb-stopping Reels and eye-catching posters, add location-focused captions, hashtags and calls-to-action, then schedule them for the best local reach.  

Deliverables each month:  
• A content calendar outlining posting dates, themes and objectives  
• Professionally edited Reels (vertical, music-synced, 1080×1920)  
• Branded static posters optimised for feed and story ratios  
• Timely publishing directly through Meta Business Suite  
• A short performance summary highlighting reach, engagement and, most importantly, lead-generating actions  

If you’re comfortable juggling both creative production and consistent scheduling—and you know how to turn local views into real-world leads—let’s talk.

jobs.title: Warehouse Layout to 3D Model
jobs.description:
I’m working with a 2-D layout of a warehouse and need it transformed into a clean, professional 3-D workspace model. Only the basic structural elements are required—walls, columns, doors, and any key partitions shown on the plan—so there’s no need to place furniture, racking, machinery, or equipment.

Once the model is complete, I’d like high-resolution exports in PDF or JPEG so I can drop them straight into presentations and reports. Please include:

• A top (plan) view render  
• An isometric view render

jobs.title: AI WhatsApp Message Parser
jobs.description:
My existing scraper is already funneling every post from more than 500 WhatsApp groups into a single “raw_messages” table.  Each row carries the full text, a group-id, timestamp, and sender phone, but that is where the structure ends.  

I now need a new script that will read each incoming row, pass the text to an AI model (OpenAI GPT-4 or a comparable LLM), and pull out three kinds of information: product details, customer inquiries, and any sales data mentioned.  The extracted pieces must then be normalised and inserted into a well-designed relational schema, separate from the raw table, so that I can query products, track enquiries, and generate sales reports without wading through free-form chat logs.

Key points  
• High throughput: the flow can spike to thousands of messages per hour; the solution needs batching or async processing so the backlog never grows.  
• Accuracy matters more than sentiment; mis-classified fields should remain traceable to the original message id for quick correction.  
• Use standard tech—Python with SQLAlchemy, Node + Prisma, or anything equally maintainable—and keep prompts, parsing rules, and DB migrations in the repo.  

Deliverables  
1. Clean, documented source code that consumes the “raw_messages” table, performs AI-driven information extraction, and writes to the new relational schema.  
2. DDL for the target tables (products, enquiries, sales, plus a mapping to the raw message id).  
3. A short README showing environment variables (API keys, DB creds), setup steps, and a CLI or cron sample command.  
4. Test run on a sample dataset proving that product names, quantities, prices, enquiry text, and sales figures are captured correctly.  

Acceptance criteria: on a provided batch of 1,000 real messages the script should populate the new tables with at least 90 % field-level accuracy and process the batch in under five minutes on a mid-tier VPS.

Once everything works end-to-end I’ll point it at the live stream and take over maintenance myself, so clarity and simplicity of the code are crucial.

jobs.title: Asociado en Marketing Digital y Expansión
jobs.description:
Proyecto: Partner de Marketing y Crecimiento — Proyecto desde cero

Sobre el proyecto

Estamos poniendo en marcha un nuevo proyecto profesional que parte de cero a nivel de presencia digital y marketing, pero que cuenta detrás con profesionales con una trayectoria reconocida dentro de su sector.

Buscamos a un profesional o pequeño equipo de marketing que quiera participar en el proyecto desde sus primeras etapas y ayudarnos a construir toda la estrategia de marca, captación y crecimiento.

No buscamos simplemente contratar servicios puntuales, sino encontrar un perfil con el que podamos establecer una colaboración a medio/largo plazo.

¿Qué necesitamos?

En esta primera etapa necesitamos desarrollar prácticamente todo el ecosistema de marketing:

- Creación y desarrollo de la página web.
- Definición de la estrategia de marketing inicial.
- Creación y gestión de redes sociales.
- Creación, edición y adaptación de vídeos.
- Generación de contenido.
- Gestión y optimización de campañas publicitarias.
- Estrategia de captación de clientes.
- Diseño de embudos y procesos de conversión.
- Analítica y seguimiento de resultados.
- Posicionamiento y construcción de marca.
- Y, en general, todo aquello que sea necesario para poner en marcha y hacer crecer el proyecto.

No esperamos necesariamente que una única persona domine todas estas áreas. Valoraremos tanto perfiles multidisciplinares como profesionales que puedan aportar experiencia en las áreas más importantes y, si fuera necesario, coordinar otros perfiles.

Un modelo de colaboración diferente

Hay un aspecto especialmente importante del proyecto:

No estamos buscando una colaboración basada exclusivamente en tarifas por hora o presupuestos cerrados.

Nuestra intención es establecer un modelo de colaboración 100% variable, vinculado a las ventas o al beneficio generado por el proyecto.

Queremos que la persona que participe en el proyecto tenga un incentivo real para que las acciones de marketing funcionen y para que el proyecto crezca.

Por eso, estamos especialmente interesados en profesionales que tengan una mentalidad de partner, no únicamente de proveedor de servicios.

¿Por qué puede ser interesante?

Aunque el proyecto parte de cero en términos de marketing, no parte de cero en cuanto a conocimiento y experiencia del sector.

Contamos con profesionales con experiencia y reconocimiento dentro de nuestra actividad, por lo que el objetivo es construir una propuesta sólida y posteriormente escalarla.

Buscamos a alguien que quiera involucrarse desde el principio y que pueda crecer junto al proyecto.

Si el proyecto funciona y los resultados acompañan, nuestra intención es que la colaboración pueda convertirse en una relación estable y de largo recorrido, aumentando progresivamente el volumen de trabajo y la remuneración en función de los resultados.

Perfil que buscamos

Valoraremos especialmente:

- Experiencia demostrable en marketing digital.
- Capacidad para plantear una estrategia desde cero.
- Experiencia en captación y conversión.
- Conocimientos de publicidad online y gestión de campañas.
- Experiencia en redes sociales y creación de contenido.
- Capacidad de edición de vídeo.
- Experiencia en creación o coordinación de páginas web.
- Mentalidad orientada a resultados.
- Capacidad para trabajar de forma autónoma.
- Interés por construir una relación profesional a medio/largo plazo.

No buscamos necesariamente al profesional más barato, sino a alguien que pueda aportar valor real y tenga confianza en su capacidad para generar resultados.

Propuesta

Si eres un profesional del marketing y te interesa participar en un proyecto desde su fase inicial, nos gustaría conocer:

1. Tu experiencia y especialización.
2. Algunos proyectos o trabajos anteriores.
3. Qué áreas podrías cubrir directamente.
4. Cómo plantearías el lanzamiento de un proyecto que parte de cero.
5. Si estarías interesado en un modelo de colaboración 100% variable vinculado a resultados.

Si existe encaje por ambas partes, podemos explicar con más detalle el proyecto, el sector, el modelo de negocio y cómo plantearíamos la colaboración.

Buscamos construir algo a largo plazo, no contratar un trabajo puntual.

jobs.title: WordPress Divi Mobile Layout Fix
jobs.description:
Project Overview:
I run a WordPress site built with the Divi theme/builder, hosted on SiteGround. On mobile devices (confirmed on real iPhones, both Safari and Chrome), the first heading on every content page is invisible or missing, and this appears to be a consistent, site-wide issue affecting most/all interior pages (the homepage is unaffected).

What's confirmed so far:

The bug is NOT caused by browser cache, CDN cache, or the specific device — reproduced on multiple real phones, in Safari's real WebKit engine via Responsive Design Mode, and persists after clearing all caching layers (SiteGround/SG Optimizer, Divi's Static CSS, browser cache).
The bug does NOT reproduce in Chrome's desktop device-emulation mode or Divi's own Phone Preview — it's specifically a WebKit rendering issue, only visible in real Safari/iOS environments.
The affected <h1> heading elements (and some surrounding paragraph text) contain leftover foreign CSS classes that don't belong to Divi's theme — they look like Tailwind-style utility classes (e.g., text-text-100, mt-3, -mb-1, text-[1.125rem]) and classes referencing an AI writing tool (font-claude-response-body). These were likely introduced when content was pasted into Divi's text editor from an external source without stripping formatting.
We haven't yet confirmed the exact computed CSS property (display/visibility/opacity/color) causing the element to disappear specifically in WebKit — that diagnostic step is still open.
Separately, we found and fixed two related header-layout issues (a negative top margin on the mobile menu row and the header section, which was also breaking the logo's home link) — these fixes appear to work correctly.

What I need:

Diagnose and permanently fix why headings/text with these leftover classes fail to render on real Safari/iOS WebKit, across all affected pages.
Clean up the leftover foreign CSS classes from existing page content (site-wide) so this doesn't recur — likely by stripping formatting and reapplying clean Divi-native text/heading styles.
Verify the fix works on real iOS devices (Safari and Chrome), not just desktop browser simulation — this is critical, since desktop testing has repeatedly failed to catch this bug.
Confirm no regressions to the header (logo link, mobile menu) or homepage.

Tech stack: WordPress, Divi theme/builder (v4.27.4), SiteGround hosting with SG Optimizer.

Scope note: This is a diagnosis + fix job, not a redesign — please don't touch unrelated site content, styling, or copy.

Deliverable: Confirmed working fix, tested on at least one real iOS device, with a brief written summary of the root cause and what was changed.

jobs.title: Daily Data & Admin Assistant

jobs.title: 3d cad designer
jobs.description:
3D CAD Designer Required — 1:6 Scale Honda CB350RS Model

I am looking for a 3D CAD designer/mechanical designer to create a highly detailed 1:6 scale Honda CB350RS motorcycle model for 3D printing.

Project Requirements

The model should accurately reproduce the real motorcycle’s:

* Overall proportions and dimensions
* Main frame
* Fuel tank with HONDA branding
* Seat
* Front and rear mudguards/fenders
* Front and rear wheels
* Tyres
* Front forks
* Handlebar
* Brake and clutch levers
* Brake master cylinder/caliper
* Brake discs
* Rear sprocket
* Chain
* Swingarm
* Rear suspension/shocks
* Engine
* Exhaust
* Side panels
* Headlight
* Indicators
* Foot pegs and controls
* Cables/wires where practical
* Other important visible components

The goal is a model that looks very close to the real Honda CB350RS, while keeping the geometry practical for 1:6 scale.

Functional Parts

Where practical, the following should be functional:

* Steering/handlebar movement
* Front wheel rotation
* Rear wheel rotation
* Swingarm movement
* Rear suspension movement
* Front fork movement
* Brake discs
* Chain/sprocket system
* Foot controls and levers where feasible

The model does not need to reproduce every microscopic mechanism of the real motorcycle, but the major mechanical features should be represented accurately.

3D Printing Requirements

The design must be suitable for FDM 3D printing.

The designer should account for:

* Minimum printable wall thickness
* Print orientation
* Support requirements
* Assembly tolerances
* Rotating clearances
* Press fits
* Pin/axle clearances
* Part strength
* Warping
* Small-scale details
* Splitting large parts into printable sections

Some components may need slight dimensional adjustments from exact 1:6 scale when necessary for reliable printing.

jobs.title: Android Lab-Environment RAT PoC Solution
jobs.description:
# Android Cybersecurity Laboratory — RAT Proof of Concept

I am looking for an already-developed solution, or an existing implementation that can be adapted, for a **practical Android cybersecurity demonstration**.

The objective is to have a **RAT-style remote-access proof of concept designed exclusively for an isolated laboratory environment**, using an Android test device or emulator that is fully owned and controlled for the purposes of the research.

The purpose of the project is to demonstrate, in a controlled and educational environment, how this type of threat can operate and subsequently analyze its communications, behavior, indicators of compromise, and possible detection and mitigation mechanisms.

### What I Need

The solution should provide a controlled demonstration of the main capabilities typically studied when analyzing this type of Android threat.

Ideally, it should include:

* A test Android application.
* A laboratory control component.
* Communication between the two components.
* Visualization of the test device's status.
* Ability to conduct the demonstration from a controlled environment.
* Event and communication logging for subsequent analysis.
* Installation and configuration documentation.
* Source code, preferably.
* A reproducible Android Studio project.
* Compatibility with an Android test device or emulator.

### Existing Development Preferred

**If you already have a functional PoC developed for cybersecurity research, training, CTFs, demonstrations, or laboratory use, that would be strongly preferred.**

I am specifically interested in reducing development time. Therefore, if you already have a working implementation that can be legally and safely adapted to this project, please indicate what is already available and what modifications would be required.

There is no need to develop everything from scratch if you already have a suitable laboratory implementation.

### Testing Environment

The demonstration will be conducted exclusively using:

* Owned/test Android devices.
* Android emulators.
* Laboratory servers.
* Controlled networks.
* Dedicated test accounts.

The project is **not intended for accessing third-party devices, collecting third-party information, or deploying the software outside an authorized testing environment**.

### Proposal Information

If you already have an existing implementation, please provide:

1. What parts of the project are already developed.
2. What capabilities are currently available.
3. What modifications would be required.
4. Estimated time to adapt it to the laboratory environment.
5. Total project cost.
6. Whether the source code and documentation can be provided.
7. Whether you can demonstrate the existing implementation in a controlled environment before proceeding.

**Preference will be given to existing, functional solutions that can be adapted quickly rather than projects that require complete development from the ground up.**

The project is strictly intended for **authorized cybersecurity research, education, and controlled laboratory demonstration**.
