jobs.title: B2B Cold Calling / Appointment Setters Needed
jobs.description:
# B2B Cold Caller & Appointment Setter

### Commission-Only | Remote | Zyvanta Digital

**Company:** Zyvanta Digital
**Role:** B2B Cold Caller / Appointment Setter
**Location:** Remote / Work From Home
**Calling Days:** Monday–Friday
**Permitted Calling Window:** 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM
**Pay:** Commission Only — **30% per confirmed deal**

---

## About the Role

We're looking for experienced **B2B sales professionals, cold callers and appointment setters** to join Zyvanta Digital on a commission-only basis.

Your role is straightforward: **make outbound calls to businesses, introduce Zyvanta Digital, identify potential opportunities and book qualified demonstrations for our owners to conduct.**

You will **not be expected to conduct the sales meetings yourself**. Once you've successfully booked an appointment, the Zyvanta owners will take over the demonstration and closing process.

If the prospect becomes a confirmed customer, **you receive 30% commission on the deal.**

---

##  Calling Expectations

Calls can be made **Monday to Friday between 9:00 AM and 6:00 PM.**

**9am–6pm is the permitted calling window, not fixed working hours.**

We are **not  measuring or paying based on hours worked**. We care about activity, conversations, appointments and ultimately results.

Our starting performance benchmark is an **average of approximately 50 outbound calls per day**.

This is an average target rather than a strict hourly quota. Some days may involve more calls, while others may involve longer conversations, follow-ups or booked appointments.

The principle is simple:

> **The more quality calls you make, the more opportunities you create.**

High performers who consistently exceed the starting target will naturally create more opportunities to earn commission.

---

## What You'll Be Doing

You will:

* Make B2B cold calls
* Use leads provided by Zyvanta Digital
* Source your own prospects where appropriate
* Speak with business owners and decision-makers
* Introduce our website and CRM solutions
* Identify businesses that could benefit from our services
* Qualify interested prospects
* Handle common objections
* Build rapport and create interest
* Book qualified demonstrations
* Record relevant prospect information
* Follow up with prospects where appropriate

You **book the appointment — we conduct the meeting and handle the close.**

---

## Commission

This is a **commission-only position**.

You receive **30% commission on every confirmed deal that you generate and which is successfully signed and confirmed by Zyvanta Digital.**

### Example 1 — 12-Month Contract

Customer signs for:

**£75/month × 12 months = £900 total contract value**

Your commission:

**30% = £270**

The £270 commission is paid in monthly instalments alongside the customer's payments.

### Example 2 — 24-Month Contract

Customer signs for:

**£65/month × 24 months = £1,560 total contract value**

Your commission:

**30% = £468**

Again, this is paid in monthly instalments alongside the customer's payments.

As Zyvanta is a growing business, this structure allows us to manage cash flow responsibly. As we scale, we intend to introduce **additional incentives and improved commission structures for high-performing salespeople who consistently generate multiple deals.**

---

## Who We're Looking For

We're looking for people with existing experience in:

* B2B sales
* Cold calling
* Appointment setting
* Telemarketing
* Lead generation
* Business development
* Speaking with business owners
* Handling objections
* Converting conversations into appointments
* Fluent English speaking

Previous sales experience is **strongly preferred**.

You should be confident, resilient, self-motivated and comfortable picking up the phone and speaking to businesses you've never contacted before.

### Key Skills

*Communication — Fluent spoken English and professional communication are essential.

*Confidence — Comfortable approaching business owners and decision-makers.

*Persuasion — Able to communicate value without being overly pushy.

*Objection Handling — Comfortable responding to common objections and keeping conversations productive.

*Resilience — Able to handle rejection and move confidently onto the next opportunity.

*Organisation — Able to keep track of prospects, follow-ups and appointments.

*Self-Motivation — Able to work independently without constant supervision.

---

## Remote Working

This is a **fully remote work-from-home position**.

You can organise your own calling schedule during the permitted **9am–6pm Monday–Friday calling window**, provided you are consistently making calls and working towards the expected average of approximately **50 calls per day**.

There is currently **no fixed number of hours you are required to work each day**.

We are focused on **performance rather than clocking hours**.

You will need:

* Reliable internet
* Computer/laptop
* Suitable headset/microphone
* Quiet environment for professional calls
* Ability to make outbound calls
* Good organisational skills
* Able to contact UK numbers (+44)

Zyvanta will provide the **leads, service information, scripts, training, guidance and resources** needed to get started.

---

## Opportunity to Grow

Zyvanta Digital is still growing, and we're building the foundations of a much larger company.

As we expand, we're planning opportunities across:

* Sales
* Senior Sales
* Sales Management
* Business Development
* Account Management
* Recruitment
* Recruitment Management
* Lead Generation
* Strategic Business Services

High-performing individuals will have the opportunity to take on **greater responsibility and potentially progress into senior positions** as the company expands.

We're looking for people who want to **grow with Zyvanta**, not simply make a few sales and move on.

---

## The Opportunity

We're giving experienced salespeople the opportunity to focus on what they do best:

*Make the calls.

*Start the conversations.

*Book the meetings.

*We handle the demonstrations and closing.

*You earn 30% of every confirmed deal you generate.

If you're confident on the phone, experienced in B2B sales and motivated by performance-based earning, **we want to hear from you.**

jobs.title: Multi-Tenant VoIP Platform Development

Web portal  
The portal must support true multi-tenant separation. Each tenant should manage its own users, assign available numbers, view usage and CDRs, run real-time analytics, and download invoices. A flexible billing engine is essential, with automated invoicing and payment collection as well as dashboards that surface calling, SMS and WhatsApp metrics at a glance.

Mobile apps  
I need companion apps for both iOS and Android. They should register to the same Telnyx back-end so end users can place and receive VoIP calls, send and receive SMS, and handle WhatsApp messaging from their assigned DID, all with push notifications and reliable background VoIP handling.

IP phone compatibility  
Standard SIP phones on the same tenant account must offer identical functionality—high-quality calling plus SMS and WhatsApp message syncing—so an office can move seamlessly between desk phone and mobile.

Primary deliverables  
• Responsive multi-tenant web portal with user management, billing/invoicing, and reporting/analytics  
• Native or high-performance cross-platform apps for iOS & Android providing calling, SMS and WhatsApp features  
• SIP provisioning and documentation so common IP phones can be auto-configured  
• Clean, well-documented code that wraps Telnyx APIs and exposes any extra micro-services you create  
• End-to-end test plan proving call quality, messaging reliability, tenant isolation and correct billing calculations  
• Deployment scripts/instructions so the stack can be rolled out to cloud infrastructure of my choice

If the scope is clear to you and you have demonstrable experience with VoIP, Telnyx (or similar providers), push notifications, and multi-tenant SaaS architecture, let’s discuss timelines and milestones.

jobs.title: برمجة بوت تداول آلي بايثون

• تنفيذ التداولات تلقائياً بمجرد توافر الشروط.  
• الاحتفاظ بسجل مفصل لكل صفقة (تاريخ، سبب الدخول، سعر التنفيذ، الربح/الخسارة).  

تسعدني رؤية الكود منظماً وواضح التعليقات، مع إمكانية تغيير الإعدادات الرئيسية (حجم الصفقة، المؤشرات، فواصل الزمن) من ملف ‎.env‎ أو قسم إعداد داخل السكربت. يهمني أيضاً اختبار البوت أولاً على حساب تجريبي للتأكد من أن أوامره تصل إلى المنصة كما ينبغي.

قبول المشروع يكون عند:
1. نجاح الاتصال بالـAPI وإظهار رصيد الحساب.  
2. تنفيذ صفقة تجريبية تلبي شروط إحدى استراتيجيات التحليل الفني المتفق عليها.  
3. تسجيل البيانات المطلوبة في ملف ‎CSV‎ أو قاعدة بيانات خفيفة.  

استخدم ما تراه مناسباً من مكتبات مثل ‎ccxt‎‏، ‎pandas‎، ‎TA-Lib‎ أو غيرها، شرط أن يكون التثبيت بسيطاً عبر ‎requirements.txt‎ وأن يعمل السكربت على ‎Python 3.10+‎.

jobs.title: Shopify Expert — Multi-Store Tracking Audit + Full Site Redesign (Turkey & International)
jobs.description:
Shopify Expert — Multi-Store Tracking Audit + Full Site Redesign (Turkey & International)

About the project
We manage a heritage jewelry brand on Shopify with both a Turkish store and a separate international store, plus in-person POS sales. Before we move into a full site redesign, we need an expert to first make sense of the current setup — architecture, Markets configuration, POS integration, and tracking — and flag anything that needs fixing before we build on top of it.

Phase 1 — Audit & Diagnosis

Map the current Shopify architecture: confirm whether the Turkish store and the international store are two separate Shopify instances or connected through Shopify Markets, and clarify what each one is actually set up to do
Review the Markets configuration for Turkey vs. international (domains, currencies, languages, taxes) and identify any overlap, redundancy, or misconfiguration between the two stores
Audit the POS integration — how in-store sales are recorded and how (or whether) they reconcile with online order data
Review the tracking setup: GA4, Meta Pixel and Conversions API (server-side), deduplication between pixel and CAPI, attribution window consistency, and how POS revenue is or isn't reflected in ad platform reporting
Deliver a written report of findings, gaps, and a recommended path forward before redesign work begins

Phase 2 — Full Site Redesign

1. Foundation & Theme Setup
Shopify store setup and configuration; installation and licensing of the selected pre-built theme; full brand identity application (colors, typography, buttons, spacing, styling); global layout configuration; header and footer setup.

2. Storefront & Homepage
Homepage with hero/banner, featured collections, product showcases, brand story, video section, Instagram feed, trust elements, newsletter signup; desktop multi-column mega menu; responsive mobile drawer navigation; fully responsive storefront.

3. Catalogue & Product Setup
Setup/migration of up to 10 collections and 10 products; collection functionality (grids, cards, filtering, sorting, pagination, responsive behavior); site search across desktop and mobile; product page template with image galleries, zoom, variants/swatches, reviews, recommendations, and standard conversion elements; size guides and info accordions; stock/availability messaging.

4. Supporting Pages & Content
About, Contact, FAQ, Size Guide, Shipping & Returns, Privacy Policy/Terms of Service, Store Locator, blog setup with 2 starter posts, 404 page, Sale/Offers page.

5. Conversion & Customer Experience
Live chat/chatbot widget with greeting messages, business hours, and offline contact form; sticky add-to-cart; cart drawer; customer account pages; checkout branding within plan capabilities; Instagram feed/widget.

6. SEO, Analytics & Launch Readiness
Meta titles/descriptions, image alt text, structured data; Google Search Console and GA4 setup; sitemap and indexation checks; URL/redirect review; payment, shipping, tax, and currency configuration review; multi-currency support; mobile and cross-browser testing; test orders and final launch checks.

7. Post-Launch Support
One month of complimentary post-launch support from go-live, covering troubleshooting within the agreed scope (not new features or content changes).

What we're looking for

Proven Shopify expertise, ideally including Shopify Markets, POS, and multi-store/multi-market setups
Strong tracking and analytics background: GA4, Meta Pixel/Conversions API, server-side tracking, deduplication
Real theme customization/development experience, not just app installs
SEO fundamentals
Portfolio of similar ecommerce redesigns, ideally in fashion, jewelry, or DTC

To apply, please share

Relevant past work (similar audits and/or redesigns)
Your approach to the Phase 1 audit
Your estimated cost and timeline for each phase separately

jobs.title: Programmatic Retail Onboard Tracking
jobs.description:

Accuracy in every cell is non-negotiable; a single digit out of place pushes ads to the wrong store. While speed and clear communication certainly help, I measure success first by pristine data.

Day to day you will log into the media software, upload or remove locations, tag each record correctly using the location classification tool, audit the output, and confirm that the final IDs and tags match before I release the campaigns. When ads or campaigns are ready for review, you will scan the creative, approve it against the checklist I provide, and set the campaign live.

You’ll do well here if you have previous ad-ops or campaign-ops experience and are already comfortable navigating media platforms and classification tools. Spreadsheet skills are useful but the heavy lifting happens inside those two core systems.

Philippines

Taiwan

Identify potential local ambassadors, community leaders, moderators, small creators, streamers, tournament hosts, and highly connected players

Track results after ambassadors begin hosting games

Ideal Ambassador Candidates

Already participate in active gaming communities
Are comfortable using Discord
Can communicate naturally with gamers

Are comfortable hosting online game nights

Success is ultimately measured by:

What We Are NOT Looking For

This is not primarily a role for:

Creating Canva graphics

Increasing follower counts
Posting generic promotional messages

We want thoughtful, personalized outreach and genuine community relationships.

Candidate Requirements

Community recruiting
Gaming communities
Discord
Creator or influencer outreach
Partnership outreach
Lead generation
Online research
Community management
Gaming, poker, card games, esports, or tabletop games

Excellent written English is required.

Experience working internationally is strongly preferred.

Experience recruiting creators or community ambassadors is a major plus.

Reporting	Monthly reports showing progress and recommendations.
Accountability	Deliver high-quality, error-free content and maintain professional communication.
10. Freelancer Requirements
Requirement	Description
Expertise	Proven experience in social media management, preferably in home services or construction.
Tool Proficiency	Proficient in SEMRUSH, Ahrefs, Google Keyword Planner, Meta Audience Insights, and Meta Ad Library.

Term	Agreement

Aspect	Details

jobs.title: Advanced Audio MIR & ML Pipeline for DJ Metadata Export
jobs.description:
Looking to hire an experienced Audio DSP / Machine Learning Engineer to build an AI-driven Music Information Retrieval (MIR) engine. The system will extract production-focused audio features from finished tracks and export them directly into Rekordbox-compatible metadata.
​Beyond basic tempo and key, the system must leverage Machine Learning models and DSP to automatically calculate deeper sound engineering metrics—sub-bass pressure, full-spectrum RMS density, transient impact, and dynamic punch—and categorize tracks based on acoustic weight and structural energy.
​Scope of Work:
​Develop an autonomous pipeline/script (Python using Librosa/Essentia/PyTorch, or C++/JUCE) that ingests WAV, AIFF, and MP3 files.
​Automatically extract BPM, musical key, and advanced production metrics (sub-bass vs. kick, RMS density, transients, dynamic punch).
​Detect structural shifts (drops, breakdowns, high-energy sections) and calculate macro/micro energy levels automatically.
​Export analysis results into a fully valid Rekordbox XML structure (or ID3 tags) ready for direct library import.
​Acceptance Criteria:
The developer will run the engine on a sample set of audio files. The system must autonomously calculate all production metrics, assign energy levels, and successfully populate custom Rekordbox fields (e.g., Comments, My Tags) upon XML import without requiring manual training data from the user.
​Deliverables:
Clean, well-documented code with concise setup instructions so the feature extraction set can be extended in future iterations.

jobs.title: Monthly Bookkeeping & Reporting Management

jobs.title: Personal Statement Essay Writing
jobs.description:
College Application Essay Ghostwriter Wanted — Personal Statement + Supplemental Essays

I’m looking for an exceptional college application essay writer/ghostwriter to help me develop my Common App personal statement and supplemental essays for highly selective U.S. universities.

I’m not looking for a generic “college essay writer” who simply makes an essay sound impressive. I want someone who understands what makes an admissions essay genuinely memorable: strong storytelling, emotional depth, specificity, reflection, an authentic voice, and a clear sense of who the student is beyond grades and achievements.

What I’m looking for

I need someone who can:

* Help me identify and develop the strongest stories and themes from my own experiences
* Turn my ideas and rough writing into compelling, polished essays without making them sound artificial or AI-generated
* Preserve my personality and voice rather than replacing it with overly sophisticated or cliché language
* Create powerful openings/hooks that immediately draw the reader in
* Build essays around meaningful moments rather than simply listing accomplishments
* Show growth, self-awareness, character, and perspective through storytelling
* Help me avoid common admissions-essay clichés and predictable “immigrant/student overcame adversity” narratives
* Give honest feedback when an idea is weak, overused, or not revealing enough about me
* Help with both the Common App personal statement (650 words) and multiple supplemental essays, while making each one reveal a different side of me
* Understand the expectations and nuances of highly selective U.S. college admissions, especially schools such as Columbia, Cornell, Fordham, and Stony Brook

Most importantly…

I want my essays to make an admissions officer feel like they’ve actually met me by the end of the essay.

I don’t want an essay that says, “I am hardworking, resilient, and passionate about healthcare.”

I want the reader to experience those qualities through the story and come to those conclusions themselves.

I’m also very particular about quality. I’m looking for someone who is willing to brainstorm, ask thoughtful questions, challenge weak ideas, and revise until the essay feels genuinely powerful — not someone who simply takes a paragraph and “makes it sound better.”

Ideal writer

You would be a great fit if you:

* Have significant experience with U.S. college admissions essays
* Have worked with competitive applicants
* Understand the Common App and supplemental essay formats
* Have excellent storytelling and editing skills
* Know how to write emotionally powerful essays without becoming melodramatic
* Can recognize and eliminate clichés
* Are comfortable doing multiple rounds of revision
* Can preserve a teenager’s authentic voice instead of making the writing sound like it came from a 35-year-old professional writer
* Are willing to collaborate closely rather than simply deliver a finished essay

Please do not send a generic proposal.

In your response, tell me:

1. Your experience with U.S. college admissions essays
2. Examples of successful essays/applications you have worked on (while respecting client privacy)
3. Which types of universities/applicants you typically work with
4. Your approach to developing a personal statement from a student’s experiences
5. How many rounds of revisions are included
6. Your availability over the next few weeks
7. Your pricing

I’m looking for someone who genuinely cares about storytelling and authenticity, not just someone who knows how to use impressive vocabulary.

If you can help me turn my experiences into essays that are emotionally resonant, distinctive, beautifully written, and unmistakably mine, I’d love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Shopify E-Commerce Site Build

jobs.title: Modern Restaurant CAD & Floorplan -- 2
jobs.description:

jobs.title: SMS Appointment Setter for UK warm leads

- No cold prospecting and no lead sourcing. The list exists.

jobs.title: Social Media Sales Representative
jobs.description:

​About Us:

​The Role:
We are looking for a hungry, task-driven Freelance Sales Representative to find customers and sell our discount subscription plans. Customers love our panel because our base services are already incredibly cheap, and our subscriptions give them an even bigger lifetime discount (up to 40% off).
​Your task is simple: Find leads, pitch our low prices, and convince them to buy a subscription.

​Basic (₹49): Gives the user a 10% discount on all services.
​Pro (₹99): Gives the user a 25% discount on all services.
​Premium (₹199): Gives the user a 40% discount on all services.

​Sell a Pro plan -> You earn ₹49.50

jobs.title: Cinematic Scripture Narrative Video
jobs.description:
ROMANS:  BUMPER
Creative Brief & Storyboard
Runtime: Approximately 30–35 seconds
 Style: Cinematic, dramatic, reverent, awe-inspiring
 Narration: Deep, authoritative male voice — Scripture only, ESV
 Music: Cinematic instrumental beginning minimal and atmospheric, building steadily into a powerful orchestral crescendo
 Primary Themes: God's sovereignty, providence, faithfulness, and the smallness of man in light of an infinite God.
CREATIVE DIRECTION
The video should begin in complete darkness and near silence, confronting the viewer with the question:
“But who are you, O man, to answer back to God?”
From there, the visuals should progressively expand in scale—from one small human life, to the forces of nature, to the vastness of creation.
The emotional journey should move from:
Human uncertainty → God's sovereignty → God's providence → God's faithfulness → Awe and worship.
The goal is not merely to make God feel powerful. The audience should come away with the sense that:
Though we are small and cannot fully understand His ways, the God who sovereignly rules all things is faithful and purposeful in all things.



TIMED STORYBOARD
0:00–0:05 — DARKNESS / THE QUESTION
Visual
Complete black screen.
No imagery at first.
Possibly an extremely subtle low rumble or atmospheric sound, but no music yet.
Voiceover — Romans 9:20 (ESV)
“But who are you, O man, to answer back to God?”
Direction
The voice should be slow, deep, and authoritative.
Allow space between:
“But who are you…”
and:
“…O man…”
Then:
“…to answer back to God?”
The viewer should feel confronted by the question.




0:05–0:10 — THE SMALLNESS OF MAN
Visual
As the final words of the verse are spoken, a faint image begins emerging from darkness.
Reveal a single human figure, alone.
The human should appear visually small and insignificant within the frame.
Potential environments:
Standing beneath massive storm clouds
Standing before an enormous mountain range
Standing on a vast shoreline
Standing beneath an expansive night sky
The camera should slowly pull farther away, emphasizing the scale difference between man and creation.
Voiceover — Romans 9:20 (ESV)
“Will what is molded say to its molder, ‘Why have you made me like this?’”
Music
A low cinematic tone begins underneath the narration.















0:10–0:15 — THE CREATOR / THE CREATED
Visual
Cut from the human figure to close, detailed imagery of a potter's hands shaping clay.
The imagery should feel cinematic and organic—not overly literal or staged.
Intercut briefly between:
Hands shaping clay
The small human figure
Natural forces such as waves, wind, or clouds
The visual idea is:
The Creator is distinct from the created.
No additional narration beyond Scripture.









0:15–0:22 — PROVIDENCE / PURPOSE
Visual
Transition into the uncertainty and complexity of human life.
Show a progression of contrasting imagery:
A storm moving across the landscape
Someone alone or waiting
A long road disappearing into the distance
Rain
Darkness
A child or human hand
Changing seasons
A sunrise beginning to break through
The visuals should communicate that human beings experience only individual moments and circumstances, while God's purpose extends beyond what we can see or understand.
Voiceover — Romans 8:28 (ESV)
“And we know that for those who love God all things work together for good, for those who are called according to his purpose.”
Music
The score begins to build.
The words “all things” should coincide with a widening of the visual scale and a quicker progression of imagery.








0:22–0:26 — FAITHFULNESS
Visual
The darkness and uncertainty begin transitioning toward light.
Storm clouds begin to break.
The camera moves toward an expanding horizon.
Potential imagery:
Sunlight breaking through clouds
A river continuing its course
A sunrise over mountains
The human figure now facing the light
Voiceover — Romans 11:29 (ESV)
“For the gifts and the calling of God are irrevocable.”
Direction
Give particular emphasis to:
“…are irrevocable.”
This should be a moment of certainty and confidence.
The visual transition from darkness to light should reinforce the faithfulness of God.







0:26–0:30 — AWE
Visual
The camera and imagery now expand beyond the individual human experience.
Move into increasingly vast imagery:
Mountains
Oceans
Clouds moving across the earth
Stars
Galaxies
The earth from above
The scale should now feel overwhelming.
Voiceover — Romans 11:33 (ESV)
“Oh, the depth of the riches and wisdom and knowledge of God!”
Music
The orchestral score begins its final ascent.



















0:30–0:35 — THE CRESCENDO
Visual
A rapid but beautiful montage of creation and humanity:
Ocean
Mountains
Storms
Light
Stars
Human figures
The gathered church / people worshiping (WE CAN USE THE FOOTAGE THAT TYLER DANNER CAPTURES FOR THIS - SBC ORIGINAL CONTENT/VIDEO!!!)
The imagery should communicate that everything exists within God's sovereign rule and ultimately for His glory.
Voiceover — Romans 11:36 (ESV)
“For from him and through him and to him are all things.”
Brief pause as the music continues rising.
“To him be glory forever. Amen.”
Music
Full orchestral crescendo.
The final word:
“Amen.”
lands with the musical climax.



FINAL TITLE CARD
ROMANS
Hold briefly over the final sustained musical impact.










NOTES FOR THE PRODUCER
Overall Visual Progression
The video should progressively expand in scale:
Darkness
 ↓
 One Man
 ↓
 Human Life
 ↓
 Creation
 ↓
 The Vastness of God
The audience should visually experience the truth that man is small, limited, and unable to see the whole picture, while God is infinite, sovereign, purposeful, and faithful.
Important Creative Notes
Avoid making the video feel like a generic "nature montage."
The visuals should intentionally communicate scale and contrast.
Human figures should generally be small within the frame rather than prominently featured.
Avoid depicting God physically.
The potter/clay imagery should be used as a powerful visual metaphor but should not dominate the entire video.
The transition from darkness/storm/uncertainty to light/scale/awe is essential.
The ending should not merely communicate God is powerful. It should communicate: because He is sovereign, purposeful, and faithful, He is worthy of all glory.

jobs.title: Results-Driven Amazon PPC Expert Needed
jobs.description:
Amazon PPC Expert / VA – Results-Driven Seller Central Management

I’m looking for a proven Amazon PPC expert—not a beginner or someone who needs to learn on my account—who can take full ownership of my Amazon advertising and turn PPC into a consistent, profitable sales engine.

If you have a track record of managing significant Amazon PPC budgets, lowering ACOS, increasing sales, improving ROAS, and scaling profitable campaigns, I want to hear from you.

The objective is simple: increase daily sales and profitability—not vanity metrics like impressions or clicks.

I need someone who can jump directly into Seller Central, understand the existing account structure, identify what is working and what is wasting money, and start making meaningful improvements within days, not weeks.

What I Expect From You
1. Campaign Strategy & Management
Take ownership of the overall Amazon PPC strategy and execution.
Audit the existing PPC account and identify immediate opportunities, inefficiencies, wasted spend, and scaling opportunities.
Build and manage Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, and Sponsored Display campaigns where appropriate.
Create highly organized campaign structures based on product hierarchy, keyword intent, match types, ASIN targeting, and profitability.
Work within defined budgets while aggressively pursuing profitable sales growth.
Develop strategies for both scaling winning products and fixing underperforming products.
2. Advanced Keyword & Product Research

I expect real keyword research—not generic keyword lists.

Use whatever professional tools you are experienced with, including:

Helium 10 / Xray
Jungle Scout
Data Dive
Amazon Brand Analytics
Search Query Performance
Competitor research
Amazon PPC reporting
Other advanced PPC research tools

Identify:

High-converting keywords
High-volume opportunities
Long-tail keywords
Low-competition opportunities
Competitor ASINs
Product/category targeting opportunities
Search terms generating sales
Search terms wasting spend

Keywords must be strategically organized and properly implemented into campaigns and ad groups.

3. Aggressive Ongoing Optimization

PPC management is not a once-a-week task.

I expect continuous optimization of:

Bids
Budgets
Placement multipliers
Match types
Search terms
Negative keywords
Product targeting
Keyword harvesting
Campaign structure
Dayparting, where data supports it
Scaling of profitable campaigns
Reduction or elimination of wasted spend

You should be constantly asking:

Where can we increase sales? Where are we wasting money? What can we scale? What needs to be cut?

4. Profitability Comes First

I am not looking for someone who can generate sales by simply spending more money.

Every decision needs to be evaluated against:

ACOS
TACOS
ROAS
Conversion Rate
Cost per Sale
Advertising-attributed sales
Organic sales impact
Overall product profitability

The goal is profitable growth.

If a campaign is generating sales but destroying margin, I expect you to identify it and take action.

If a campaign is highly profitable and has room to scale, I expect you to recognize it and aggressively capitalize on it.

5. Analytics & Reporting

I want someone who can read the data and make decisions—not just export spreadsheets.

You will be responsible for:

Daily/ongoing performance monitoring
Weekly performance reporting
Identifying trends and opportunities
Tracking campaign-level profitability
Identifying wasted spend
Measuring sales growth
Monitoring ACOS, TACOS, ROAS, CTR, CVR, CPC, and conversion trends
Competitor advertising analysis

jobs.title: Cold Callers/Appointment Setters Wanted
jobs.description:
# AX Media — Remote Cold Caller / Appointment Setter

AX Media is looking for motivated people to join our remote sales team as Cold Callers / Appointment Setters.

Students can also apply. Previous experience is not mandatory.

## About the Role

Your main responsibility will be to contact clinics and businesses, introduce AX Media, explain our website service briefly, identify interested prospects, and book a demo or meeting for our sales team.

You will not be expected to handle the complete sales process. Your primary goal is to generate genuine interest and arrange a qualified appointment.

## Work Requirements

* Remote / Work from Home
* Approximately 3–5 hours of work per day
* 26 working days per month
* Daily target: approximately 50–150 calls
* Initial 5–7 days: you may need to find relevant business leads yourself and make calls from your own phone number.
* After the initial training and evaluation period, AX Media will provide a dedicated Telegram communication channel and lead sheets for your work.
* Calling scripts, training material, objection-handling resources, and work instructions will be provided.

## Payment

This is a performance-based commission role.

You will receive **20% of the agreed commissionable amount for every successfully closed deal generated through your qualified appointment**, according to AX Media's deal and attribution terms.

For example, if your successful deals generate an average commission of ₹4,000 per deal for you, then 10 successful deals would result in approximately ₹40,000 in earnings.

Actual earnings depend on the number of qualified appointments, successful conversions, and the value of the deals. There is no fixed earning guarantee.

## Training

Selected candidates will receive structured training covering:

* Cold calling fundamentals
* AX Media and our services
* Calling script
* Communication and confidence
* How to start a conversation
* Qualification and appointment booking
* Objection handling
* Follow-up process
* Lead sheet / CRM updates
* Professional calling behaviour

The initial training period will be used to understand your communication, consistency, and ability to follow the process.

## Skills We Look For

There are no specific educational qualifications required.

You should have:

* Clear communication skills
* Basic Hindi/Hinglish communication ability
* Basic understanding of English
* Confidence while speaking on the phone
* Willingness to learn
* Consistency and discipline
* A professional attitude
* Smartphone and a stable internet connection

Students, freshers, and people without previous sales experience can apply if they are willing to learn.

## Important Rules

* Be respectful and professional with every prospect.
* Do not make false promises or guarantee business results.
* Do not offer discounts or change pricing without authorization.
* Do not misrepresent AX Media or its services.
* Update the status of every call accurately.
* Keep all company, lead, and client information confidential.
* Do not spam or repeatedly contact anyone who has clearly asked not to be contacted.
* Commission is applicable only to deals that can be properly attributed to your qualified appointment according to AX Media's tracking process.

## Who Should Apply?

This role is suitable for someone who is comfortable speaking with business owners, wants to learn sales, and is interested in earning based on performance rather than a fixed salary.

If you are confident, consistent, and willing to put in the work, you are welcome to apply.

## To Apply

Send the following details by DM:

1. Full Name
2. Age
3. City
4. Student / Working
5. Previous Calling or Sales Experience, if any
6. Languages Known
7. Daily Availability
8. Why you think you would be a good fit for this role

**Company: AX Media**
**Role: Remote Cold Caller / Appointment Setter**
**Work Type: Performance-Based / Commission**

jobs.title: Troubleshoot VoIP/SIP Deskphone Issues

1. Grandstream GXP2170
2. Polycom VVX 311

Both phones do the exact same thing:

- They register successfully
- They can make outbound calls through our GoHighLevel phone number
- Outbound caller ID works
- BUT neither desk phone will ring for incoming calls

The only way we can currently receive incoming calls is by forwarding the GoHighLevel number to a cell phone.

At this point, since two completely different SIP phones are doing the exact same thing, this does not appear to be a bad phone issue. It looks much more like a GoHighLevel inbound routing, SIP, NAT, or desk phone configuration issue.

- Keep Alive enabled on the SIP phone
- Keep Alive Type set to OPTIONS
- Correct user assigned to the phone number
- Deskphone enabled in the user's Call & Voicemail settings
- Deskphone included in Ring All / Ring Multiple Team Members if applicable
- No IVR, Voice AI, workflow, or forwarding rule intercepting the call
- GoHighLevel's Inbound Test Call under:
  Settings → Phone Numbers → Advanced Settings → VoIP Deskphone (SIP) → Test Calls

The important part is this:

TWO DIFFERENT PHONES CAN CALL OUT BUT NEITHER WILL RING INBOUND.

We are looking for someone who has actually set up physical SIP desk phones with GoHighLevel and has both incoming and outgoing calls working correctly.

If you specialize in VoIP/SIP and GoHighLevel and know how to troubleshoot this, please reach out.

jobs.title: HIPAA-Ready EC2 & S3 Optimization
jobs.description:

The scope covers three intertwined streams of work: first-time setup and configuration, ongoing scaling and performance tuning, and a rock-solid security and monitoring layer.

For EC2, you will design the instance strategy, build Auto Scaling Groups, craft launch templates, and tune networking, storage, and AMIs so workloads can grow predictably without runaway costs.  On S3, I want buckets structured for data segregation, lifecycle rules, intelligent tiering, versioning, server-side encryption (SSE-KMS), and cross-region replication where it makes sense.

The security mandate is non-negotiable.  Every piece must map to HIPAA safeguards: IAM roles with least privilege, VPC subnet isolation, security groups and NACLs, GuardDuty, CloudTrail, Config, and end-to-end logging to a central, immutable store.  I’ll also rely on your guidance to document the controls and produce audit-ready evidence.

Deliverables  
• Architecture diagram highlighting EC2, S3, networking, and security flow  
• Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform or CloudFormation) with clear variables and README  
• Hardened AMI build or pipeline scripts (Packer, EC2 Image Builder)  
• Monitoring stack (CloudWatch dashboards, alarms, SNS notifications)  
• Compliance report mapping implemented controls to HIPAA citations  
• Knowledge-transfer session and step-by-step runbook

Acceptance criteria  
All code deploys cleanly in my AWS account, passes spot checks with AWS Trusted Advisor and the HIPAA Security Checklist, and demonstrates sustained performance under a controlled load test.

If you’re comfortable working hands-on with EC2, S3, IAM, VPC, CloudWatch, GuardDuty, and Terraform/CloudFormation—all through a HIPAA lens—let’s get started.

jobs.title: GTM / Growth Operator for AI App
jobs.description:
We’re building a new mobile AI product that lets anyone create and share mini-apps simply by chatting with AI.

Think personal tools, trackers, planners, games, calculators, interactive utilities, and other small apps created without coding.

The product is built and we are now looking for a hands-on GTM / Growth Operator to help us go from early product → first active users → first paying customers.

This is not a strategy-only consulting role.

We need someone who can actually execute.

What You'll Own

Your job is to help us discover who wants this product, what they use it for, and how we repeatedly acquire those users.

You will:

- Identify and test our highest-potential initial user segments/use cases
- Recruit our first batches of real users in the U.S. and Canada
- Personally reach out to and onboard early adopters
- Find relevant Reddit, Discord, X, TikTok, creator and niche communities
- Run scrappy acquisition experiments
- Test messaging, positioning and landing-page concepts
- Develop organic/content distribution experiments
- Identify potential creators and micro-influencers for partnerships
- Talk to users and feed insights back into product decisions
- Measure activation, sharing, retention, and conversion
- Help determine which acquisition channel we should scale
- Help us convert our first users into paying customers
- Initial Goals

We want to work toward:

- Phase 1: First 50–100 genuinely active users
- Phase 2: Identify 1–2 repeatable acquisition channels
- Phase 3: First 100 paying customers
- Phase 4: Scale toward 10,000+ users/waitlist

We care much more about active users and learning than vanity signups.

Who We're Looking For

Ideally, you've previously worked on 0→1 growth for an early-stage consumer, prosumer, creator, AI, mobile, or SaaS startup.

You should be comfortable doing things manually before trying to scale them.

Examples:

Finding 30 potential users → DMing them → getting 10 into the product → watching what they do → changing the pitch → trying another community → measuring results.

We DON'T need someone whose main answer is:

- SEO
- Google Ads
- Facebook Ads
- "Increase brand awareness"
- Generic social media management
- Buying leads
- Creating a 50-page marketing strategy

Paid acquisition may come later. Right now we need someone who knows how to find product-market pull from zero.

Geography

Our initial target market is the United States and Canada, so you should be comfortable recruiting and marketing to North American users.

When Applying

Start your proposal with:

"0 TO 1 GTM"

Then answer these 4 questions:

1. You start Monday with our product and zero users. What exactly would you do during your first 14 days?

2. Give us 3 specific user segments you would test first for a product that lets people create mini-apps by chatting with AI. Why those three?

3. How would you personally acquire our first 50 active users without relying primarily on paid advertising? Be specific about channels and tactics.

4. Tell us about one product where you personally helped acquire the first users. What did YOU actually do and what were the results?

Please don't send a generic marketing proposal. We're specifically looking for someone with hands-on early-stage GTM experience.

Engagement

We'd like to begin with a paid 2–4 week trial project.

If we work well together and find traction, this can become an ongoing engagement as we work toward our first 100 paying customers and beyond.

jobs.title: Data Entry, Transcription & Annotation
jobs.description:

First, I will forward batches of raw information that has to be copy-pasted, typed, and reorganised into a single, tidy spreadsheet. Every column needs clear headings, and I expect basic data-validation rules (duplicates removed, formats unified, obvious typos fixed). You may use Excel, Google Sheets or a similar tool—whichever lets you move fastest while keeping version control.

Second, I have a growing library of audio recordings that must be converted to text. Accuracy is more important than speed: timestamps every 30 seconds, speaker labels whenever they are clear, and a consistent spelling style throughout. You are free to run an AI engine such as Whisper or Otter.ai for the first pass as long as you proof-read every line before delivery.

Finally, each audio file then needs a light layer of annotation. I will provide a tag list (speaker change, laughter, keyword mentions, long pause) and you will return a companion CSV or JSON with the timecode and the selected tag. If you already use tools like Audacity, Audionote or LabelStudio, that is a plus.

Deliverables  
• A cleaned and validated master spreadsheet (xlsx or Google Sheet)  
• Word-perfect transcripts in .docx or .txt, one per audio file  
• A tag-level annotation file (CSV/JSON) aligned with each transcript

I release milestones once each batch passes a quick spot-check for accuracy and correct formatting. If this fits your skill set and you can start within 24 hours, let me know your estimated turnaround time per hour of audio and the spreadsheet tools you prefer.

jobs.title: Cross-Platform Medical Simulation Application — Android and iOS -- 2
jobs.description:
I am looking for a developer to create a cross-platform medical simulation and training application for Android and iOS using a shared codebase.

This application is intended for medical education and simulation. It will simulate the operation of a patient monitor, AED and defibrillator. It is not intended to control a real medical device unless physical-device integration is separately agreed in writing.

I have an existing detailed project specification and additional requirements. The final scope consists of the attached specification together with the requirements described below.

MOST IMPORTANT REQUIREMENTS

1. SMOOTH ECG AND PATIENT-MONITOR WAVEFORMS

The most important part of this project is the smooth and realistic display of ECG and other patient-monitor waveforms.

The application should support:

- ECG waveforms.
- 12-lead ECG.
- SpO2 waveform.
- EtCO2 waveform.
- Respiratory-rate waveform where applicable.
- Heart rate, QTc, blood pressure/MAP, pulse and temperature values.
- Real-time changes to patient parameters.
- Alarm events and emergency-procedure actions.

The waveforms must not freeze, visibly stutter, restart or jump whenever the user changes a parameter or when data is received from another device.

The communication layer must not block the user interface or interrupt waveform rendering. The developer must explain how the simulation engine, communication layer and rendering layer will be separated. Please also document the update rate, buffering and interpolation strategy.

The developer must demonstrate waveform smoothness on real Android and iOS devices, not only in an emulator.

2. COMMUNICATION THROUGH BOTH WI-FI AND BLUETOOTH

The application must support communication between devices through both:

- Wi-Fi.
- Bluetooth.

Bluetooth is a required communication method. It must not be omitted and must not be used only for device discovery.

The application should support:

- Nearby-device discovery.
- Device selection.
- Connection status.
- Connection errors.
- Temporary connection interruption.
- Reconnection where technically possible.
- Safe disconnection.

The developer must test both Wi-Fi and Bluetooth on real devices. During communication, the ECG and other waveforms must continue to work smoothly.

APPLICATION MODES

The application must include three operating modes:

1. INSTRUCTOR MODE

The instructor uses one phone or tablet to connect to a patient monitor, select or create a scenario, configure the patient and control the simulation in real time.

Instructor Mode must include:

- Connecting to a Patient Monitor.
- Selecting or creating a scenario.
- Selecting the monitor layout.
- Configuring the initial patient condition.
- Changing HR, QTc, ECG rhythm, BP/MAP, SpO2, EtCO2, RR, pulse and temperature.
- Triggering and configuring alarms.
- Starting, pausing/stopping and ending the simulation.
- Displaying a 12-lead ECG on the monitor.
- Uploading an image or animation to the monitor.
- Enabling ECG artifacts.
- Configuring after how many defibrillator shocks the rhythm changes.
- Selecting which rhythm is displayed after the specified number of shocks.
- Synchronizing relevant changes with the connected monitor in real time.

2. MONITOR MODE

The device operates as a realistic Patient Monitor and receives the instructor’s changes.

It should display, where applicable:

- ECG waveforms.
- 12-lead ECG.
- HR and QTc.
- SpO2 and waveform.
- EtCO2 and waveform.
- BP/MAP and recent measurement history.
- RR.
- Pulse.
- Temperature.
- Alarm indicators and audible alarms.
- Simulation status.
- Connection status.

When the instructor starts the simulation, the monitor should automatically open the live-monitor screen.

3. STANDALONE MONITOR MODE

The user can operate the simulation completely on one device without connecting to a remote controller.

The user must be able to:

- Select or create a scenario.
- Configure the patient.
- Start and stop the simulation.
- Change patient parameters directly.
- Change the ECG rhythm directly.
- Configure alarms.
- Use AED functions.
- Use Defibrillator functions.
- Use Cardioversion functions.
- Use Pacing functions.
- Use the CPR Metronome.

AED AND DEFIBRILLATOR REQUIREMENTS

AED Mode and Defibrillator Mode must work in both:

- Monitor Mode.
- Standalone Monitor Mode.

Defibrillator Mode must include:

- Switching the defibrillator on.
- Selecting the energy level.
- Pressing the Charge button.
- Displaying the charging state.
- Delivering a simulated shock.
- Updating the simulation state after the shock.
- Synchronizing the event with the monitor during a remote session.
- Cardioversion as a function within Defibrillator Mode.
- Pacing as a function within Defibrillator Mode.

The CPR Metronome must be available as a function within both AED Mode and Defibrillator Mode.

The user must be able to complete the following simulated sequence:

1. Activate the defibrillator.
2. Set the energy level.
3. Press Charge.
4. Press Discharge
4. Deliver a simulated shock.
5. Display the result of the shock in the simulation.
6. Set Cardioversion function
7. Set- Pacing function

In Instructor Mode, the instructor must be able to define after how many shocks the rhythm changes and which rhythm is selected afterwards.

These are simulation functions. Physical AED or defibrillator hardware integration is excluded unless separately agreed in writing.

REFERENCE APPLICATIONS

The developer should review the SIM-MON and free Simple Monitor applications to understand the expected interaction and behavior of monitor, AED and defibrillator functions.

The final interface may have a different visual design or layout. It does not need to copy the reference applications graphically. However, the relevant functions and logical behavior should be comparable. No protected code or graphic assets may be copied.

ADDITIONAL FEATURES

The application should also include:

- Three monitor layouts: Basic, Extended and Vital Signs.
- Scenario creation, editing, deletion, saving and loading.
- Local storage of settings and scenarios.
- Alarm thresholds for HR, BP, SpO2, RR and EtCO2.
- Oxygen/air selection.
- Consciousness states and NEWS score as specified in the attached documentation.
- Seven languages: English, Polish, Spanish, German, French, Portuguese and Italian.

- Paywall after Demo expiration.
- One-time in-app purchase to unlock the Full Version.
- No subscription is required under the current scope.

- User-friendly error and recovery messages.

DEVELOPMENT AND PAYMENT METHOD

The project must be completed through fixed-price milestones on Freelancer.

The project must not be treated as one single payment for the entire application.

Each milestone must include:

- A list of completed functions.

A milestone will be released only after the client has tested and accepted the result against the agreed acceptance criteria.

PROPOSED MILESTONES

2. Wi-Fi and Bluetooth communication.

ACCEPTANCE PRIORITIES

The first acceptance priorities are:

SOURCE CODE AND FINAL HANDOVER

The client will own and administer the Apple Developer and Google Play accounts. App Store, Google Play and third-party account fees are paid directly by the client. Technical publication support is included in the agreed project scope and is not an optional extra.

Each week you’ll pick up tickets from Jira, push well-documented commits to our private Git repo, and open small pull requests that pass the CI pipeline. Typical work ranges from patching a crash to extending a Retrofit interface for a new endpoint, then wiring up the UI so it looks great on both phone and tablet layouts. After your code merges, a short release note summarizing changes completes the cycle.

Deliverables  
• Merged pull requests that compile cleanly and pass automated tests  
• Brief release notes for each completed ticket  

Please include one or two examples that highlight your Retrofit work and let me know roughly how many hours you can commit per week.

jobs.title: Frontier-Style Task Creator $30 per task -- 4
jobs.description:
Software Engineering Task Author (Contract)
About the Role

We're looking for an experienced software engineer to design and build Frontier-style software engineering tasks — long-horizon, repository-based coding challenges used to train and evaluate AI coding agents. You'll take real engineering problems from your own area of expertise and turn them into rigorous, verifiable tasks: a seeded repository, a clear public specification, and an automated grader that checks observable behavior (builds, hidden test suites, protocol conformance, concurrency/recovery scenarios, deterministic replay, numeric budgets, etc.).

This is deep, research-grade work — closer to writing a hard systems/algorithms exam with an autograder than to typical QA or content work.

What You'll Do
Design non-trivial engineering problems grounded in real-world systems (e.g., concurrency bugs, recovery/consistency issues, legacy modernization, protocol implementation, performance-constrained rewrites).
Build a starter repository, write a complete public specification (instruction.md), and implement a reference solution that solves the task correctly.
Write automated grading code that measures exactly what the instructions ask for — no hidden requirements, no LLM judges, no shortcuts.
Produce a no-op/naive baseline to confirm the task has real difficulty, and adversarial "attack" submissions to confirm the grader can't be gamed.
Validate, iterate, and submit tasks via pull request through a structured review pipeline.
Use AI tools to accelerate parts of your workflow (explaining code, debugging validation errors, reviewing your own logic) — but the engineering judgment and task design must be your own.
What We're Looking For
Strong professional software engineering background (backend systems, distributed systems, compilers, low-level/systems programming, or similar) — ideally in an area where you have real depth and war stories, not just familiarity.
Comfort with concurrency, correctness, and testing — the ability to reason precisely about what a grader should and shouldn't check.
Experience writing clear technical specifications and/or authoring hard technical interview problems, coding challenges, or test suites.
Git/GitHub workflow fluency (branches, PRs, CI).
Self-directed: comfortable working from written guidelines, validating your own work, and iterating based on automated feedback and review.
Bonus: experience with reinforcement learning, model evaluation, or "reward hacking" adversarial thinking (i.e., trying to break your own grader before someone else does).
Nice to Have
A specific technical niche you know cold (e.g., database internals, network protocols, embedded systems, compilers/language runtimes, numerical computing) that would make for a compelling, hard-to-fake task.
Prior experience creating technical assessments, benchmarks, or eval datasets.
Engagement Details
Contract / freelance, task-based.
Deliverables are reviewed against defined structure, CI, and quality checks before acceptance.
Ongoing support and clarification provided via a shared Discord community.

To apply, please share examples of complex systems you've built or debugged, any prior experience authoring technical assessments or benchmarks, and a brief note on what kind of engineering problem you'd want to turn into a task.

jobs.title: Mixed Data Entry From Websites
jobs.description:

• Consistent formatting choices throughout the file, even though the sources differ.  
• A brief log of any ambiguity you encounter (e.g., unreadable sections, duplicate entries) so I can verify them quickly.

Let me know your turnaround time for, say, an initial batch of 500 entries, and we can iterate from there. I look forward to working together.

jobs.title: PS5 Gaming Content Creator Needed

jobs.title: Urgent 3D Bathroom Visualisation

jobs.title: Lead-Focused Google Ads Revamp

jobs.title: Travel Booking Website Development Needed
jobs.description:

Key deliverables  
• Responsive front-end pages for hotel, tour and flight searches, each with filters, pricing and calendar views  
• A unified cart / checkout that accepts major cards and popular wallets, plus voucher or coupon codes

jobs.title: Fix Google Ads Disapproval

jobs.title: WordPress Fluent Suite Expert – GoalOasis Mentorship Platform -- 2
jobs.description:
We are building GoalOasis, a mentorship community for gamers, on WordPress. We need an experienced WordPress configurator who knows the WPManageNinja (Fluent) plugin suite deeply and can assemble a fully functional mentorship and booking platform — cleanly, quickly, and in a way a non-technical team can operate afterward.

This is a configuration job, not a development job. You will not be building custom plugins. You may write occasional small PHP snippets (shortcodes, conditional redirects, role checks), but the entire build runs on native Fluent tools assembled correctly.

Requirements:
- Demonstrated hands-on experience with FluentCommunity, FluentBooking Pro, Fluent Forms Pro, FluentCRM, and FluentSMTP
- FluentCommunity: spaces, roles, permissions, onboarding flows, member directories
- FluentBooking Pro: multi-host setups, scoped host permissions, availability management, Stripe payments, calendar sync
- Fluent Forms Pro: conditional logic, multi-step forms, notifications, integration feeds
- FluentCRM: tag-based segmentation, automations, sequences, and triggers
- Comfortable writing small PHP snippets safely using a code-snippets plugin
- Solid HTML/CSS for layout and styling adjustments on top of plugin UIs
- Staging-first discipline, backups before changes, clear written communication

Deliverables:
- FluentCommunity setup: spaces, feeds, member profiles, mentor directory (filterable by game and skill), role-based permissions, onboarding flow, and preservation of existing 18+ age-confirmation gate
- FluentBooking Pro: each mentor configured as an independent host managing their own calendar, availability, and payments via a frontend-only panel — no wp-admin access required
- Stripe payment flows with confirmations, reminders, reschedule and cancellation handling, and a member-facing "My Sessions" page
- Negotiation-to-contract flow using Fluent Forms and FluentCRM: coaching request form, terms-confirmation form, CRM sequence triggering booking at the agreed price
- Lifecycle email automations via FluentCRM and FluentSMTP covering signup, request, terms, booking, completion, and follow-up stages
- Handover runbook (written) covering how to add a mentor, process a deal, and troubleshoot common issues — Loom walkthroughs welcome

Work arrangement: This is a milestone-based contract beginning with a paid 2–3 hour performance task. Ongoing work is async-first with regular video check-ins 2–3 times per week. Tools used include Mattermost, Notion, Figma, and Google Docs.

About the project: GoalOasis is the first version of a gamer mentorship community where mentors coach members through paid one-on-one video sessions. The architecture decisions are already made — we need someone who can execute them precisely and hand off a system a non-technical team can run independently.

jobs.title: Diseñador Gráfico para Piezas Corporativas

Plazo aproximado de desarrollo.
Cantidad de revisiones incluidas.
Portafolio o ejemplos de trabajos similares.
Confirmación de entrega de los archivos editables originales.

jobs.title: Urgent Digital Text Data Entry

jobs.title: AI-Driven Shopify SEO Implementation
jobs.description:

Here’s what I need handled:

• Keyword work: research at least 20 highly relevant long-tail terms, then integrate them naturally with an AI-assisted approach.

Deliver the updated theme files (or snippets), the AI connection setup with clear documentation, a keyword list with placement notes, and a short post-launch report. Let me know your estimated timeline and any questions you have about the tech stack.

jobs.title: Overseas Immigration Counsellor Needed
jobs.description:
I’m launching a new education and immigration advisory and our Meta Ads are already producing a steady stream of enquiries each day. Most prospects want to relocate to Canada for permanent residence, though a few still consider study-to-settle pathways. I’d like a mid-level counsellor who can jump straight into discovery calls, build rapport quickly and map out realistic routes for each prospect.

Here’s what the work looks like:
• Receive warm leads in our CRM, review the prospect’s background, and schedule a 15-20-minute call.

• Flag complex or high-potential files and hand them over to our licensed RCIC partner with well-structured notes.  
• Maintain concise call summaries and weekly conversion reports so we can track what’s working and refine our Meta targeting.

I handle marketing and compliance on my side; you focus entirely on counselling and client care. Previous success guiding applicants through Express Entry, PNPs or student-to-PR transitions for Canada is essential, and comfort using simple tools like Zoom, Google Sheets and a lightweight CRM will keep everything running smoothly.

The role starts freelance/part-time with flexible hours. As volume grows there’s plenty of room to expand into a longer-term, possibly full-time position. If you have the Canadian expertise and enjoy helping people turn immigration plans into action, let’s talk.

jobs.title: Luxury Handbag Technical Pack Creation

jobs.title: Refining Scripted Crime Drama - Video Editor Needed
jobs.description:
Freelance Video Editor – Scripted Crime Drama Series

Project: 219
Format: Scripted Crime Drama Series
Production Company: The New Black Entertainment

The New Black Entertainment is seeking an experienced freelance video editor to assist with the final editing and refinement of the first two episodes of our scripted crime drama series, 219.

This is not a request to edit an eight-episode series from scratch. The series has already been filmed, the footage is organized, and substantial editing work has already been completed.

Current Priority

Our immediate goal is to perfect Episode 1 and Episode 2 and bring both episodes to a polished, professional, presentation-ready cut.

Episode 1 is already edited and primarily requires revisions, refinement, and additional finesse.

Episode 2 is also substantially edited and is very close to completion.

We are looking for an editor who can work with the existing cuts, understand the director's creative vision, identify areas that can be strengthened, and help bring these episodes across the finish line.

Editing Needs May Include
Refining pacing and scene transitions
Tightening or extending specific moments where needed
Improving continuity and overall flow
Selecting or adjusting alternate takes when necessary
Smoothing existing edits and addressing distracting cuts
Strengthening emotional and dramatic moments
Reviewing the episodes with a fresh editorial eye
Incorporating detailed director revision notes
Preparing the picture edit for the next stages of post-production
Helping ensure each completed episode feels cohesive, intentional, and professionally presented
Important

We are not looking for someone to completely re-edit the episodes or replace the director's vision. We are looking for an experienced collaborative editor who can take what already exists and help elevate it.

The director will remain actively involved in the editing process and will provide clear notes and creative direction.

Strong communication, patience, attention to detail, storytelling instincts, and the ability to work collaboratively are extremely important.

Experience editing scripted television, narrative films, crime dramas, or dramatic content is strongly preferred.

Experience with DaVinci Resolve is also strongly preferred.

Episode-by-Episode Approach

For now, the assignment is specifically focused on Episodes 1 and 2.

Once those episodes are completely finished and we are satisfied with the collaboration, we would like to move forward to Episode 3, followed by subsequent episodes individually.

Our goal is quality over speed. We want to complete one episode at a time, making sure each episode is truly ready before moving to the next.

This means there is potential for an ongoing relationship with the right editor, but we are not asking applicants to quote or commit to all eight episodes at this stage.

jobs.title: AI Automation Engineer Full Time
jobs.description:
**The Role**

You inherit a system someone else built, work out how it behaves, extend it, and leave
it working. Most of the work here is not greenfield.

In your first months you would own features inside one of our production systems: a
video ad assembler, a static ad generator, a pre-lander builder, or the media buying
engine. You read code you did not write, extend it without breaking the parts already
shipping every day, and keep the cost per generated asset visible.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
**Essential**

- Strong TypeScript. You have shipped and maintained a Next.js application in production.
- Comfortable with a Postgres schema and an ORM (Prisma in most of our systems), and with

  the request path of a real web app.

- Practical experience calling AI APIs from production code (Anthropic, OpenAI or similar),

  including error handling, retries, and cost per call.

- You read the code before trusting the documentation, and you extend rather than rebuild.
- You write your own tests, and you prove a change did not break what already shipped.
- Working written English. The team spans several countries, and most communication is written.
- Self-directed. You unblock yourself, and you flag a blocker early.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

 Valued, not required

- Python and FastAPI. One of our systems is a Python research backend.
- Vercel, Supabase, Clerk, database migrations.
- Media generation APIs (image, video, voice), and reasoning about credits and spend.
- Ecommerce or performance marketing background, Meta Ads, Shopify.
- Experience owning a system end-to-end rather than working a ticket queue.

jobs.title: Resort Booking E-Commerce Website (Design and build/develop an modern e-commerce hospitality website with online booking and content management system)
jobs.description:
I need a modern, mobile-first website that lets guests explore our rooms, lock in a reservation through an embedded, API-driven hotel-booking engine, and pay securely with Paystack— all without ever leaving the site.  

Core experience  
• Guests must be able to browse real-time room availability, choose dates, and receive instant confirmation.  
• A seamless Paystack checkout flow is essential; no redirect to external pages.  
• The site must scale beyond rooms should we add villas or suites later, so please structure the database and CMS with future inventory types in mind.  

Back-office needs  
An intuitive dashboard should let my team:  
– Add or edit rooms, photos, rates, and packages  
– See and manage every booking at a glance  
– Launch and retire promotions or events  
– Update resort articles, menus, and galleries without calling a developer  

Technical expectations  
• Any CMS or framework is fine as long as it supports the API-based booking engine and stays lightweight for fast page loads.  
• Clean, secure code ready for future integrations (loyalty programs, channel managers, etc.).  
• Device Responsive UI, SEO-friendly markup, and GDPR-compliant data handling from day one.  

Deliverables  
1. Fully deployed website on our hosting environment  
2. Admin credentials with documentation covering booking, payment, and content workflows  
3. Source code in a version-controlled repository  

If you have recent hospitality e-commerce builds or live demos that showcase an embedded engine and Paystack, I’d love to see them. Let’s create a digital experience that drives more direct bookings and reflects the quality of our resort.

jobs.title: Instagram Video Traffic Ads
jobs.description:
I’m looking for someone who can craft scroll-stopping video ads for my dropshipping store, specifically for Instagram. I will be running the campaign exclusively on that platform and the sole objective is to push qualified traffic straight to my product page.  

You’ll take the raw product details I provide—images, short clips, selling points—and turn them into a punchy vertical video that fits Instagram’s feed and Reels specs. Strong hooks in the first seconds, clear value props throughout, and a call-to-action that drives clicks are a must.  

Please handle the full creative process: editing, motion graphics, royalty-free music, captions, and export in high-quality MP4 ready to upload. If you already know the quirks of dropshipping audiences and have proven results with Instagram video ads that boosted website visits, that experience will be invaluable.  

Deliverables:  
• 1 polished 15-30 sec video ad (9:16)  
• Source project file for future tweaks  
• A brief text doc with suggested primary text, headline, and call-to-action wording I can paste straight into Ads Manager  

I’ll give prompt feedback so we can iterate quickly and get the ad live. If this first video performs, I’m happy to commission more. Send over a couple of Instagram ad samples you’ve produced along with your turnaround time, and let’s get this moving.

* Student/education sales

You may use your **existing network, social media audience, communities, websites, email lists or other legitimate marketing channels**.

**Find interested students → promote the right course → generate paid enrollment → earn commission.**

* Engineering students
* Electronics students

* VLSI learners
* Embedded systems enthusiasts
* IoT developers
* Arduino/robotics learners

This is a **results-driven partnership**.

There is no ceiling on the number of enrollments you can generate. High-performing partners will have the opportunity to continue working with us and potentially receive **higher commission rates / performance bonuses** based on results.

No spam, fake leads, misleading advertising, bots or fraudulent transactions.

### To Apply

jobs.title: 10k Responsive Tour Booking Website
jobs.description:
I’m ready to invest up to 10 k to build a clean, mobile-first travel site that lets visitors browse and book our tour packages with ease. Flights and hotels are not part of the scope; the entire focus is on curated tours.

Core experience  
• Fully responsive design that looks and performs flawlessly on phones, tablets, and desktops.  
• A simple booking flow: select a tour, choose dates/party size, enter traveller details, and pay (Stripe or PayPal—whichever you can integrate fastest and most securely).  
• Tour listings organised by destination rather than generic categories or popularity, so users can land on a country or city page and immediately see every available itinerary there.  
• No global search bar is needed; navigation and destination pages should do all the heavy lifting.  
• Admin panel where I can add, edit, or retire tours, adjust pricing, upload images, and export bookings to CSV.  

Tech preferences  
I’m flexible: WordPress + WooCommerce, Laravel, or a modern JavaScript stack (Next.js with a headless CMS) will all work so long as performance scores stay high and future maintenance is straightforward.

Deliverables  
1. Fully deployed site on my hosting account with SSL.  
2. Source code in Git, well-documented.  
3. Admin credentials and a short screen-recorded walkthrough.  
4. Post-launch support for 30 days to squash any bugs.

Acceptance criteria  
• Google Lighthouse mobile performance ≥ 90.  
• End-to-end booking tested and confirmed for at least two live tours.  
• Responsive layouts verified on Chrome, Safari, and Firefox at common breakpoints.  

I’m ready to move quickly—show me examples of previous responsive booking sites you’ve built and let’s lock in a timeline and milestone plan that keeps us on budget.

jobs.title: Shopify Inventory & Product Listing Assistant
jobs.description:
Part-Time Shopify Product Listing & Inventory Assistant

We are looking for a reliable Part-Time Shopify Product Listing & Inventory Assistant to support our e-commerce business.

Main Responsibilities

* Add and update products in Shopify
* Upload product images
* Enter product title, description, price, SKU and barcode
* Assign products to the correct collections/categories
* Add and update product tags
* Update inventory/stock quantities accurately

* Check product information for errors before publishing
* Maintain accurate and organized product data

* Good knowledge of product listing and inventory management

* Good attention to detail
* Able to follow instructions and SOPs
* Reliable and responsive
* Good English communication
* Experience with e-commerce products is preferred

Workload & Budget

This is a part-time, ongoing position.

Monthly budget: up to USD $50

Expected workload: approximately 15–16 hours per month. Monthly budget is strictly limited to USD $50. Any work beyond the approved monthly hours must receive prior approval.

jobs.title: Cardboard Apparel Box Packaging Design
jobs.description:
I’m preparing to ship a new line of apparel and need a custom box that feels premium the moment it’s in a customer’s hands. The format is a classic two-piece cardboard box; sturdy enough for mailing, yet elegant enough to double as a keepsake on a wardrobe shelf.  

Here’s what I’d like from you:  

• A print-ready dieline sized to my garment dimensions, with clear bleed, fold and glue areas.  
• CMYK artwork that conveys a minimal, fashion-forward look while leaving room for the shipping label.  
• A 3D mock-up (PNG or PDF) so I can visualise how the box will appear on store shelves and in lifestyle photos.  
• Final source files in AI or PSD along with outlined fonts and linked images.  

Please keep the design compatible with standard cardboard printing techniques—no spot UV or exotic foils for this run. Sustainability is important, so any suggestions on eco-friendly coatings or inks are welcome. Once I approve the mock-up, I’ll need the production files packaged and ready for the printer.  

If you’ve created apparel packaging before, feel free to share a snippet; I’m eager to move quickly and get these boxes on the production line.

jobs.title: Corporate Portfolio Website Build
jobs.description:
I’d like you to create a clean, responsive website that presents our company at a glance and, more importantly, showcases our work. A streamlined content-management setup is essential; I need to add new projects or swap out testimonial quotes without touching code. Feel free to suggest the most suitable CMS—WordPress, Webflow, or another platform—as long as editing stays simple for a non-technical team.

Design should reflect a polished corporate presence without feeling stiff. Think generous white space, sharp imagery, and subtle animation that supports the story rather than distracts from it. Performance on mobile matters just as much as on desktop, so fast loading and flawless responsiveness are non-negotiable.

Deliverables  
• Fully functional website hosted on our domain  
• Admin dashboard for easy content updates (projects, testimonials, team bios)  
• Optimised images, basic on-page SEO, and analytics integration

I’m ready to supply copy, logos, and raw project photos; you’ll handle layout, styling, and any lightweight graphic clean-up needed. Let me know your preferred build stack, estimated timeline, and any clarifying questions so we can get started.

jobs.title: Consolidate Contacts Across Google Sheets
jobs.description:
There are currently several Google Sheets in my Drive holding the same kind of information—people’s full names, phone numbers, and email addresses—but the rows are scattered across different files and sometimes repeated. I need everything combined into one clean master Sheet.

Here is what I want done:  
• Pull every row from all the existing Sheets.  
• Identify duplicate people and merge their details so each person is represented once, preserving every unique phone number or email that might appear across files.  
• Standardise the columns (Full Name | Phone Number | Email Address), fix obvious typos in headings, and apply consistent formatting for numbers and addresses.  
• Deliver one Google Sheet, neatly sorted (alphabetically by last name is fine), ready for immediate use and easy future maintenance.  

Feel free to use formulas, Google Apps Script, Add-ons, or a short Python script with the Google Sheets API—whatever is fastest and safest for the data. I’ll share view-only links first, then grant edit access once we agree on the approach. A quick screen-share walk-through of the final result will serve as the hand-off and acceptance check.

jobs.title: Monthly Field Lead Generation Promoter
jobs.description:

jobs.title: Minnesota PE Stamp for SWPPP

All I need is your review and professional engineering stamp, issued under your active Minnesota Civil P.E. license, so the package can be submitted during the pre-construction permitting stage.

Please confirm your Minnesota licensure number and estimated turnaround when you reply.
