jobs.title: Warehouse CCTV 3D Coverage Model
jobs.description:
I am supplying a clean JPEG/PNG floor plan layout of a warehouse facility ("BUILDING-1 G.FLOOR PROPOSED LAYOUT C. STORE"). I need this layout transformed into a 3D model presentation that lets my client easily visualize our complete CCTV strategy and security coverage.

SCOPE OF WORK:
• Recreate the building’s layout geometry from the 2D plan, keeping walkways, entry points, and storage racking positions true to scale.
• Place nine cameras (C1-C9) exactly where marked on the layout drawing, pointing in the direction of the reference arrows.
• Generate realistic field-of-view (FOV) coverage cones for all 9 cameras (assuming standard wide-angle warehouse lenses, e.g., 2.8mm/4mm focal length, mounted at typical ceiling height).
• Highlight every blind spot clearly in the model using a contrasting color/shading technique so the client can instantly spot uncovered security gaps.
• Label each camera zone clearly (C1 to C9) for quick reference.

DETAIL LEVEL REQUIRED:
High detail simulation – Not just flat 2D lines, but 3D volumetric light cones, clear blind-spot shading, and identifiable camera specification markers.

SOFTWARE & ACCESSIBILITY:
I am flexible on what 3D software you use to create this (AutoCAD, SketchUp, Blender, or dedicated CCTV tools like JVSG). However, please note that I do not use advanced 3D engineering software on my computer. Therefore, the deliverables must be easily accessible to me and my client without requiring paid software licenses. 

DELIVERABLES:
1. High-resolution rendered 3D perspective images (4–6 angles) from high, overhead, wide-angle viewpoints that clearly show layout coverage and blind-spots.
2. A lightweight, easily accessible interactive viewer format (such as an interactive WebGL/HTML link that opens in any normal web browser, an export to Google Earth, or a lightweight mobile 3D viewer format).
3. A short walk-through animation or fly-through screen recording video (30-60 seconds) panning across the 3D model to showcase the layout dynamically to the client.
4. A brief PDF summary sheet listing the 9 cameras and highlighting the major blind-spot zones discovered in the simulation.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA:
The rendered visuals must look professional, accurately display all nine coverage cones aligned with the floor plan layout, and visually differentiate protected areas from blind spots at a glance.

If anything in my attached layout image needs clarification regarding warehouse zones or dimensions, please let me know and I will assist you right away. Looking forward to your proposals!

jobs.title: مونتاج فيديوهات تسويقية احترافي
jobs.description:
لدي مجموعة من المقاطع الخام الخاصة بحملة تسويقية جديدة، بالإضافة إلى بعض الصور الثابتة المرتبطة بها. المطلوب هو إخراج فيديوهات جذابة ومهيأة للنشر على المنصات الرقمية، مع تحسين الصور لتتماشى بصرياً مع نفس الهوية.

في الفيديو سأحتاج إلى:
• ضبط الألوان والإضاءة لإبراز المنتج وإعطاء لمسة سينمائية متوازنة.  
• إضافة نصوص ورسومات (شعارات، عناوين فرعية، أيقونات توضيحية) بشكل متحرك يناسب روح العلامة.  
• مونتاج وتقطيع ديناميكي يحافظ على الإيقاع السريع ويزيل اللقطات غير الضرورية.

أما الصور فتحتاج إلى معالجة ألوان بسيطة، تنعيم عيوب الإضاءة، وقص أو تفريغ الخلفية عند الحاجة لتتلاءم مع الإعلانات الممولة والشبكات الاجتماعية.

التسليم المرن ضروري:
- فيديو نهائي بصيغ MP4 (Full HD) مع نسخة عمودية أو مربعة إذا لزم الأمر.  
- الملفات المفتوحة (Premiere Pro/After Effects أو ما يماثلهما) لضمان سهولة التعديل مستقبلاً.  
- صور محسّنة بجودة عالية بصيغة PNG أو JPG، وأي نسخ معدّلة للمقاسات الإعلانية المطلوبة.

سأوفر اللقطات والصور والشعار والخطوط، وأحتاج جدولاً زمنياً واضحاً للتنفيذ مع معاينات أولية قبل الإخراج النهائي لضمان تطابق النتيجة مع هوية الحملة.

jobs.title: Wikipedia Company Profile Creation
jobs.description:
I'm looking for an experienced Wikipedia editor to create a detailed company profile for us. The page should include our company history and achievements and milestones.

Requirements:
- Comprehensive company history
- Notable achievements and milestones
- Must use our official website and news articles as sources

Ideal Skills & Experience:
- Proven Wikipedia page creation experience
- Strong writing and research skills
- Familiarity with Wikipedia's content guidelines and citation standards
- Ability to ensure the page meets Wikipedia's notability requirements

Please provide samples of prior work.

jobs.title: CCTV Footage Enhancement Needed
jobs.description:
I have a single CCTV clip that I need cleaned up so the person (or possibly an object they are carrying) can be clearly identified. At the moment the recording is noticeably blurred and shows some shakiness whenever the camera auto-adjusts, which is what is blocking a positive ID. 

The job is straightforward: take the original file I supply and return a version that is as sharp and stable as technically possible. I am open to whatever combination of de-blur, motion-stabilisation, denoise and colour/contrast correction you feel will give the best result, provided the final export preserves the time-stamp and any other on-screen metadata. 

Deliverables
• Cleaned, stabilised video in the same resolution and a common playback format (MP4 preferred)  
• A short note (bullet points are fine) outlining the key steps or filters used, so I can document the chain of custody if required later

Acceptance will be based on visual clarity: the face, clothing or carried item in the key frames must be discernibly sharper than in the source file, with minimal new artefacts introduced. Fast turnaround is appreciated; let me know your expected timeline when you bid.

jobs.title: Content Editing for Written Work
jobs.description:
I have a draft that is complete in terms of ideas, but it still needs a thoughtful content edit to tighten structure, sharpen messaging, and ensure overall coherence. I’m looking for someone who can read the text holistically, spot gaps in logic or flow, and suggest concrete improvements—not just fix grammar.

Please work directly in Microsoft Word (Track Changes on) or Google Docs, leaving in-line suggestions and a brief summary of the bigger thematic or structural adjustments you recommend.  

Deliverables:  
• Edited file with visible revisions  
• Clean, ready-to-publish version  
• Short editor’s memo (key changes, next-step recommendations)

If you have a strong eye for narrative flow and can turn this around promptly, let’s get started.

jobs.title: Eliminar objetos de fotos
jobs.description:
Tengo entre una y cinco fotos caseras que quiero mejorar mediante edición: necesito la eliminación impecable de ciertos objetos o personas que aparecen en segundo plano. 

Busco un resultado limpio y natural que conserve la iluminación, la textura y la nitidez original de cada imagen. Acepto sugerencias de retoque adicional siempre que no alteren el look realista ni los colores auténticos.

Entregar:
• Cada foto retocada en el mismo formato y resolución que el archivo original.  
• Una versión antes/después para comparar el cambio.  

Si trabajas con herramientas como Photoshop o Lightroom y dominas técnicas de clonación, tampón y relleno según contenido, me encantaría ver tu propuesta y un par de ejemplos previos.

jobs.title: Senior Full-Stack + Flutter Developer for Healthcare/CRM Platform
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Senior Full-Stack + Flutter Developer or a small experienced development team to complete and take an existing healthcare/CRM platform to production.

This is NOT a project from scratch. Approximately 80% of the web platform is already developed using Next.js, Turborepo, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Prisma, Supabase, and existing APIs/CRM modules. Important mobile pages and functionality have also already been created and are currently running through the existing WebView implementation.

The first step is to audit the existing codebase, understand what is completed, identify remaining gaps and bugs, and create a practical completion roadmap.

The main remaining work includes:
• Complete end-to-end booking and scheduling workflows
• Verify and complete payment integration, transaction handling, webhooks, cancellations and refunds
• Complete Google Maps/location integration
• Complete CRM/Admin workflows
• Complete partner assignment and service lifecycle
• Complete notifications and status synchronization
• Fix API, database, authentication and business-logic issues
• Complete testing across all critical workflows
• Prepare the platform for production

### Flutter Applications

The existing mobile functionality currently needs to be separated into TWO proper production Flutter applications:

1. MediBookHome User App
   For patients/customers — registration, OTP, profile, addresses, service discovery, booking, scheduling, patient details, payment, booking tracking/history, cancellation/refunds, notifications, documents, Google Maps, support and settings.

2. MediBookHome Partners App
   For nursing staff, lab partners/technicians, doctors, physiotherapists and other healthcare service providers — registration, OTP, profile, KYC/documents, verification, availability, booking requests, accept/reject, assigned jobs, patient details, location/navigation, service status, completion, earnings, payment status, history, notifications, documents, support and settings.

The developer should reuse existing working functionality wherever appropriate rather than rebuilding the entire project from scratch.

### End-to-End Requirement

The complete workflow must work reliably:

User App → Backend/API → Database → CRM → Partner Assignment → Partner App → Service Completion → Payment/Earnings → Notifications → Booking History

All data and status changes must remain synchronized across Web, CRM, User App and Partner App.

### Production Deployment

The developer will be responsible for final production readiness and deployment, including:

• Web/Vercel production deployment
• Database/environment configuration
• Payment, SMS/OTP, Google Maps and storage configuration
• Security and authentication
• GitHub/GitHub Actions CI/CD
• Android production builds and Google Play submission
• iOS production builds and App Store Connect submission
• Real-device testing and production debugging

### Required Experience

Strong production experience is required with:

• Next.js / React / TypeScript
• Turborepo / pnpm
• PostgreSQL / Prisma / Supabase
• Flutter / Dart
• REST APIs
• JWT/OTP/RBAC
• Payment gateways
• Google Maps
• AWS S3
• Push notifications
• GitHub Actions / CI/CD
• Vercel
• Android & iOS production deployment

We are specifically looking for someone capable of taking ownership of an existing complex codebase, understanding it quickly, independently debugging issues, completing missing workflows, and taking the project from its current ~80% state to a stable production release.

Please include your experience, similar projects, published Flutter apps, GitHub/GitHub Actions experience, payment/Google Maps experience, availability, hourly or fixed rate, estimated timeline, and number of developers involved if applying as a team.

This is a completion and productionization project — not a simple UI development task and not a from-scratch project.

jobs.title: Online reklámszöveg készítése
jobs.description:
Hirdetési kampányt indítok, és ehhez ütős, online reklámszövegekre van szükségem. Olyan copywritert keresek, aki gyorsan átlátja a termékem előnyeit, célzott üzeneteket fogalmaz, és azonnal cselekvésre ösztönzi az olvasót.

Feladat:
• Írj több, A/B tesztelésre alkalmas reklámszöveget (rövid, max. 50-70 karakteres headline + 1-2 mondatos leírás).  
• Hangvétel legyen lendületes, barátságos, online környezethez igazított.  
• Átadd szerkeszthető formátumban (Google Docs vagy Word).

Előnyt jelent, ha:
• Van tapasztalatod Facebook- vagy Google-hirdetések szövegezésében.  
• Tudsz javasolni kulcsszavakat vagy call-to-action változatokat.

Kérlek, csatolj 1-2 rövid példa-munkát vagy portfólió-linket, hogy lássam a stílusod. Várom a jelentkezésed!

jobs.title: Romantic Love Song Lyrics Wanted
jobs.description:
I’m creating a new track built entirely around a tender, heartfelt love theme and need original lyrics that speak directly from a first-person point of view. Picture an intimate, modern romance ballad—something that could comfortably sit in today’s pop playlists yet feel timeless enough to be performed acoustically.

Here’s what I’m after:
• A full set of lyrics (verses, chorus, bridge and optional pre-chorus/outro) written in “I / we” perspective so the listener feels the story is unfolding in real time.  
• Language that captures genuine emotion without clichés, balancing poetic imagery with relatable moments.  
• Meter and phrasing that can be sung over a mid-tempo romantic groove; think smooth melodic lines with room for vocal expression.

Your draft can be delivered as a simple lyric sheet (Word, Google Doc or PDF). Please let me know if you need a reference melody guide or any additional context about the track’s arrangement.

I’ll review for flow, emotional impact and sing-ability, then suggest any tweaks before final approval. Looking forward to bringing this love story to life together.

jobs.title: Proyecto: edición de 5 videos de casos de éxito con motion graphics
jobs.description:
Tengo cinco casos de éxito que hoy existen solo como pistas de audio y quiero transformarlos en piezas de video dinámicas y memorables.  

Lo que espero:  
• Escuchar cada testimonio, estructurar la narrativa y proponer un guion visual breve.  
• Diseñar motion graphics originales que aporten ritmo y energía, evitando el estilo corporativo rígido; busco algo creativo e innovador.  
• Incluir iconografía, transiciones y tipografía animada que acompañen las frases más potentes y refuercen la historia.  
• Entregar cada video en 1080p (MP4 H.264) junto con los archivos editables (Premiere Pro / After Effects o la herramienta que uses).  

Flujo de trabajo: primera versión, recibes mis comentarios, aplicas hasta dos rondas de ajustes ligeros y entregas la versión final. Si manejas audio cleaning y sincronización, menciónalo: es un plus.  

Si disfrutas contando historias con gráficos en movimiento y te motiva convertir testimonios en piezas visuales frescas, me encantará revisar tu propuesta y portafolio.

Se busca relación de colaboración de largo plazo

jobs.title: Modern Logo Design Contest
jobs.description:
I’m looking for a fresh, modern logo that instantly communicates professionalism while staying clean and memorable. The style should lean contemporary—think simple lines, balanced typography, and an icon that scales well from social-media avatars to large banners.

You have complete creative freedom on color and composition; surprise me with palettes and concepts that feel current and versatile. I’ll give the exact brand name and any taglines once the contest is live so you can integrate them seamlessly.

What I’ll need from the winning entry:
• Primary logo in vector format (AI or SVG)  
• High-resolution PNG with transparent background  
• A monochrome version for single-color applications  
• Quick mock-up showing the logo on a website header and a business card  

I’ll provide prompt feedback during the contest so you can refine your submission, and I’m open to two quick rounds of tweaks once a winner is chosen. Bring your best modern ideas—can’t wait to see what you create!

jobs.title: Excel Customer Data Cleanup -- 2
jobs.description:
मेरे पास एक customer information फ़ाइल है जिसे Excel में पूरी तरह साफ़ और व्यवस्थित करना है। मुख्य काम exact duplicates हटाना, अधूरी या गलत entries को सुधारना, और ख़ास तौर पर Names column का formatting ठीक करना रहेगा। साथ-साथ blank cells और किसी भी तरह के unwanted entries को भी सही जगह या मानक फ़ॉर्मेट में लाना ज़रूरी है। मैं उम्मीद करता हूँ कि Power Query, advanced filters, या आपके पसंदीदा Excel automation टूल्स का उपयोग करके काम जल्दी और सटीक तरीके से पूरा होगा। 

Deliverables:
• अपडेटेड Excel फ़ाइल—duplicates हटाए हुए, Names column standardized, सभी blanks/अनचाहे डेटा व्यवस्थित  
• एक छोटा सा change-log या summary जिससे पता चले कहाँ-कहाँ सुधार हुआ  

फ़ाइनल फ़ाइल error-free होनी चाहिए ताकि आगे CRM में सीधे इम्पोर्ट किया जा सके।

jobs.title: Playful 20-Second Logo Reveal
jobs.description:
I need a short, punchy brand-reveal video—around 20 seconds—that captures the boho-meets-fusion spirit of my jewellery line. Think bold colours, organic textures, subtle sparkle, and a playful, creative rhythm that feels totally on-trend. Clean, high-quality motion graphics are essential; the end result should be crisp when shown on Instagram Reels and website headers alike.

To move quickly (I’m aiming for delivery ASAP), please send links to past logo or brand-reveal work so I can gauge your visual style right away. A quick outline of how you’d tackle the project—preferred software such as After Effects, Premiere Pro, Blender, or similar—is helpful but not mandatory if your reel already speaks for itself.

Deliverables  
• 1920×1080 MP4 (H.264) master, plus a transparent-background MOV/PNG sequence of the final animation  
• One square and one vertical cut (1080×1080 & 1080×1920) for social media  
• Editable project files so future colour tweaks are easy

Acceptance criteria  
• Logo animates fluidly, ending fully legible with no pixelation  
• Visual style stays playful and creative while matching a boho/fusion aesthetic  
• Overall runtime 18–22 seconds  
• First review draft within two days of award
Should be willing to make changes as per our request 


I’m ready to choose quickly—show me your best past work and let’s get started!

jobs.title: Targeted Guest Post Link Building in Indonesia Area to boost Page Authority
jobs.description:
I’m ready to scale my off-page SEO with high-quality guest post backlinks in Indonesia area only. I already have a refined list of keywords; what I need now is an experienced link builder who can place them naturally on the right sites.

The posts should land on:
• Industry-specific blogs that attract a relevant audience  
• Reputable news websites for added authority  
• Well-known, high-authority general sites to round out the profile  

Every link must be do-follow, contextually placed within fresh, original content that matches each publisher’s tone. I’ll supply the anchors, target URLs, and any brand guidelines you need; you handle outreach, topic pitching, content creation, and live link reporting.

Please outline your usual outreach process, example placements you’ve secured, and typical turnaround times when you submit your proposal.

jobs.title: Female Possessed Horror Voiceover (English/Hindi/Bengali)
jobs.description:
I’m creating a horror sequence that pivots on the chilling power of a single voice, and I need a female artist who can sound like an adult host taken over by something truly vile. Bengali, English and Hindi lines are in the script, so a native-level command of each language—and the ability to switch between them seamlessly—is essential.

The performance must feel utterly possessed: furious, menacing, often screaming, always aggressive. Think guttural growls, sudden pitch shifts, breathy whispers that erupt into rage—all delivered with clean diction and perfect timing. You’ll be voicing a character under demonic control, so intensity and commitment are everything.

Deliverables
• Separate, raw WAV or 24-bit/48 kHz MP3 files for every scripted line  
• Recorded on a high-quality, noise-free microphone (no room echo, no hiss, no compression or FX)  
• File naming that matches the line numbers in my script

I’ll review demos that already showcase horror, anger, or dark character work first, so send any reel that lets me hear your most terrifying side. Turnaround is flexible; I’m more interested in getting the perfect take than rushing the process.

If you love pushing your voice to its darkest limits, I’m excited to hear what you can do.

jobs.title: CorelDRAW Acrylic Signage Designer Needed
jobs.description:
I mainly need help producing acrylic letter designs for my LED sign board and CO₂-laser-cutting workshop. Every job centres on 3D raised letters and must be ready for cutting on acrylic, MDF or wood, so precision in outlining, kerf allowance and node cleaning is critical.

Here is how we will work together:

• I send you the brief with dimensions, font or logo references, illumination notes and material thickness.  
• You return a fully editable CorelDRAW (.CDR) file plus a print-/laser-ready PDF. All cutting paths must be properly colour-coded and set to hairline, with inside counters bridged where necessary.  
• Files have to open cleanly on CorelDRAW 2021 without missing fonts or broken links.

Acceptance criteria  
1. Exact sizes match the brief to the millimetre.  
2. No overlapping or open curves; test cut preview passes without errors.  
3. Layers are logically named (Cut, Engrave, Etch, Guide).  
4. All text converted to curves unless otherwise requested.

This is ongoing work; a typical week includes two to four new name boards or shopfront signs. Please share a link to your portfolio that highlights signage or laser-cut projects, along with your price per design (flat rate preferred).

If you are fast, detail-oriented and comfortable working in CorelDRAW for fabrication, I’d love to keep you busy.

jobs.title: Experienced Odoo Expert Needed – Onsite in Noida
jobs.description:

Odoo implementation/customization/configuration (please specify exact modules if applicable — Sales, Inventory, Accounting, HR, CRM, etc.)

Prior experience in similar implementation/support projects (please share relevant work samples)

To Apply, Please Share:

Your relevant Odoo project experience
Confirmation of availability for onsite work in Noida

Earliest possible start date


Odoo version and specific modules needed
Start date 27/08/2026

jobs.title: iOS GPS Transmitter App
jobs.description:
I need an Android GPS transmitter app ported to iOS. 

Essential features:
- Real-time location tracking


Additional requirements:
- Integration with other apps (specifics to be discussed)
- Loaded and controlled by a web page PWA

Ideal skills and experience:
- Proficient in iOS app development
- Experience with GPS and location-based services
- Familiarity with web technologies for PWA integration
- Strong background in app integration with third-party services

jobs.title: Android Gacha Game Setup
jobs.description:
I have access to a Chinese-language, open-source codebase for a mobile gacha title and want to get it running completely on my side—client and server—before thinking about wider distribution. Your first goal is to walk me through compiling and launching the game locally, choosing whatever public repositories or forks you feel are most stable. I’m open to any stack you recommend, so whether that means spinning up containers on AWS, a managed instance on Google Cloud, or even a bare-metal box at home, I’ll follow your lead.

Once the game is standing up, I’d like an ongoing relationship for live-ops style maintenance: squash crashes, keep the gacha tables and events editable, roll security patches, and package incremental updates without downtime. If you already have tooling for hot-patching or A/B testing banners, that’s a major bonus.

To get started, tell me exactly what assets, keys, or build-time resources you’ll need from me so we can fire up an emulator and see the first playable build. My acceptance milestone will be a signed APK that connects to a self-hosted server, lets me log in, and performs a test pull from the gacha pool without errors. After that we can schedule regular sprints for fixes and feature tweaks.

Please outline:
• the open-source packages you intend to use,
• your preferred hosting or orchestration approach,
• and the rough steps you’ll follow to reach the first playable build.

If you have past examples of similar decompiled or self-hosted mobile games, let me know; it will help me gauge the best path forward.

I have no experience in this field, so the proper guidance is needed

jobs.title: iOS App Upload Specialist
jobs.description:
I need an experienced freelancer to upload my iOS app, which is ready for release, to the App Store. 

Ideal skills and experience:
- Proven track record of successfully uploading iOS apps
- Familiarity with App Store guidelines and requirements
- Attention to detail to ensure a smooth upload process

Please share relevant experience in your application.

jobs.title: 15-Second Educational Reel Production
jobs.description:
I’m putting together a snappy 15-second reel that teaches something useful while still feeling fun and light-hearted. The clip needs to land squarely in the sweet spot where entertainment meets education, and it has to speak to viewers of every age.  

Here’s what I need from you:  

• A concise concept that hooks the audience within the first second and clearly delivers one educational takeaway.  
• Full edit of a vertical 1080 × 1920 reel, colour-graded, with upbeat music or sound design that’s license-cleared.  
• Engaging on-screen text or graphics so the message is understood even on mute.  
• Final delivery in MP4, ready for immediate upload to Instagram Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts.  

If this first reel pops, I’ll be looking to roll the same style out across future topics, so consider this a paid trial run. Drop a quick outline of your idea and—if you have them—a link to any short-form educational pieces you’ve already crafted.

jobs.title: Employee Induction Session Facilitator Needed
jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced HR professional, corporate trainer, or employee induction specialist to prepare and conduct an engaging online company induction session for our newly joined employees.

The objective is to welcome new employees, introduce them to the organization, and ensure they understand the company’s culture, structure, policies, expectations, and communication processes.

Topics to Be Covered
Company introduction, history, vision, and mission
Company services and business operations
Organizational structure and departments
Company culture and core values
HR policies and workplace guidelines
Reporting structure and communication process
Roles, responsibilities, and performance expectations
Attendance, leave, professional conduct, and confidentiality
Employee support and escalation process
Questions and answers with new employees
Project Scope
Review the company information provided by us.
Develop or organize a professional induction presentation.
Conduct one online induction session.
Keep the session interactive, welcoming, and professional.
Address basic questions raised by new employees.
Share the final presentation with the company.
Session Details
Mode: Online
Duration: Approximately 60–90 minutes
Expected Participants: 10–15 new employees
Company Material: Basic company information will be provided.
Additional Requirement: The selected professional should organize the information into a polished induction presentation.
Preferred Experience
Previous experience conducting employee induction or onboarding sessions
Background in HR, Learning and Development, corporate training, or employee engagement
Strong English communication and presentation skills
Ability to interact confidently with new employees
Experience preparing professional PowerPoint presentations
Understanding of corporate policies and workplace culture
Deliverables
Professional company induction presentation
One 60–90-minute online induction session
Interactive employee question-and-answer session
Final editable copy of the induction presentation
How to Apply

Please include the following in your proposal:

Relevant HR or corporate training experience
Previous experience conducting employee inductions
Sample presentation or training material, if available
Earliest availability
Professional fee for preparing and conducting the session

We are looking for someone who can create a positive first impression and deliver a clear, professional, and engaging induction experience for our new employees.

jobs.title: Tamil Reel Video Editor Needed
jobs.description:
My client’s Instagram presence is built around punchy personal-branding videos, and I need a skilled video editor who can turn raw clips into energetic, fast-paced reels that land in roughly 45 seconds each. The vibe we’re after is lively and engaging—not the slow, cinematic or ultra-minimal look—so quick cuts, rhythmic pacing, on-beat transitions, and attention-grabbing text overlays will be central to every edit.

Because the spokesperson speaks in Tamil, a native or fluent Tamil-speaking editor is strongly preferred; it makes trimming dialogue, adding on-screen Tamil/English captions, and choosing culturally relevant music far smoother.

Here’s what you’ll be doing:  
• Receive a folder of source footage, brand color codes, and a short style reference.  
• Edit each piece down to a 45-second reel, adding captions, basic motion graphics, sound design, and light color correction.  
• Export in vertical 1080×1920 MP4, optimized for Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts, and deliver the project file (Premiere Pro, Final Cut, or DaVinci—your choice).  
• Turnaround: 24–48 hours per reel once assets land in your inbox.

I’m looking for consistency, crisp storytelling, and the confidence to inject flair without losing the brand’s professional tone. If this sounds like your wheelhouse, send over a short reel portfolio—especially anything in Tamil or with a similarly upbeat style—and let’s discuss the first batch.

jobs.title: Game-Ready Hair & Indian Garments
jobs.description:
I’m preparing a real-time character and need two things built to a consistently professional standard: realistic hair cards and traditional Indian clothing.

Hair  
• Workflow: Please generate the hair in Blender using curves; that is my preferred grooming tool.  
• Result: High-fidelity hair cards only—no sculpted “clay” strands. I expect a tidy, game-ready FBX/Blend with organized collections, non-destructive modifiers, clean UVs, and packed PBR textures (albedo, normal, alpha, roughness).  

Clothing  
• Garments: Saree, Dhoti, and Lehenga.  
• Detail level: Medium—these pieces will be viewed from mid-range, so major folds, drape, and trim must hold up, but micro-stitching can be implied in texture rather than modeled.  
• Requirements: Even quad topology suitable for cloth simulation, single UDIM or 0-1 UV layout, and 4K PBR texture sets. Please keep polycounts sensible for UE5 or Unity but do not sacrifice silhouette flow.

Acceptance  
1. Assets import into UE5 with zero shading errors.  
2. No visible stretching or distortion on extreme cloth poses.  
3. Hair alpha blends cleanly against varied HDR lighting.  

Send a link to your portfolio that clearly shows previous game-ready hair card work and Indian (or similarly draped) cloth simulations. I will review mesh wireframes and texture sheets before awarding.

jobs.title: Zoho Creator Commerce App
jobs.description:
I want to roll out a full-fledged customer commerce application built entirely in Zoho Creator. The core objective is to let my customers browse products, place and track orders, and manage their own ledgers and profiles through a single web-/mobile-ready interface.

Key elements I need inside the app:  
• Secure sign-up / sign-in flow tied to a customer profile

 (Zero Code Duplication). This unified codebase must dynamically serve two distinct domains (egyptmart.com for Arabic/RTL and arab-mart.com for English/LTR).

### Key Architectural Requirements:
1. Dynamic Routing & Core Unification: Implement a centralized routing mechanism to detect the incoming domain and dynamically switch languages, database configurations, and UI directions using a SINGLE set of core files.

2. Dynamic Database Mapping: The platform utilizes parallel tables for different languages (e.g., 'business_profile' for Arabic and 'business_profile_arabyos' for English). You must implement a centralized SQL rewrite layer/mapping logic in the configuration so that all existing database queries automatically route to the correct table based on the active domain without duplicating the query paths across files.

3. Internationalization (I18n): Cleanly extract all hardcoded UI strings from the core Arabic files into dedicated language files ('lang/ar.php'). You will extract the English translation strings from our legacy English files and place them into 'lang/en.php'.

4. Modern CSS Mirroring (Strict): You must refactor the stylesheet using "CSS Logical Properties" (e.g., margin-inline, padding-inline, start/end) so one single stylesheet dynamically handles both LTR and RTL layouts. Creating separate RTL overlay files or manual "page flipping" is strictly prohibited.

5. Preservation of Core Logic: Existing functional logic, background scripts, and automation cron-jobs in the root directory must remain fully operational.

### Security, Testing & Delivery Terms
1. Isolated Staging Environment: All deployment and testing will happen inside an isolated staging directory on our Hostinger server. Restricted FTP access will be provided. No live/primary database access will be shared; you must provide the SQL alteration scripts for us to execute on our end.

This milestone remains UNFUNDED (no escrow) at the start. It will be funded in the dashboard only after Phase 1 is deployed and visually verified. Once funded, it will NOT be released. jobs.title: Onsite React Backend Completion
jobs.description:

Here is what’s left to build:  
• User authentication powered by JSON Web Tokens (JWT) – sign-up, login, protected routes, token refresh and secure storage.  
• Database management – the schema and a few tables are already in place, but the structure is only partially set up. You will need to review what exists, complete the missing collections/tables, write the remaining queries or ORM models, and seed initial data where required.  
• API integration – wire the finished front-end components to clean, well-documented REST endpoints, handle errors gracefully and ensure the responses line up with the UI expectations.

All front-end calls are already stubbed; you will mainly be creating or completing the controllers, middleware and data layer, then testing everything end-to-end on the local network before we push to staging.

Tech you should be comfortable with: Node.js, Express (or a comparable framework), JWT, whichever database you prefer to finish the current setup (it’s running on SQL right now, but I’m open to a quick migration to Postgres or MySQL if that speeds things up), Git and basic Docker commands for local containers.

This is a strictly onsite engagement. You’ll have a dedicated workstation, immediate access to the designer and me for quick feedback loops, and we can clear blockers in real time. My goal is to wrap the backend in no more than one intense working week, including tests and a quick security review.

Deliverables will be:  
1. Fully functional backend repository pushed to our Git server  
2. Postman (or Thunder Client) collection covering every new endpoint  
3. A short hand-off document outlining the database schema, JWT secret rotation steps and any environment variables

If you’re confident you can walk in, own these tasks and leave the project deployment-ready, let’s lock dates and get started.

jobs.title: US Healthcare Google Ads Expert

Our primary objective is maximizing booked patient appointments and qualified inbound phone inquiries while maintaining strict HIPAA compliance and adhering to Google’s healthcare advertising regulations. We are not looking for vanity metrics (clicks or traffic) — success will be measured strictly by Cost Per Acquisition (CPA) and verified appointment volume.  

Core Responsibilities
High-Intent Search Campaigns: Build and scale targeted Search, Call-Only, and Local Service Ads targeting patients actively looking for treatment.  

HIPAA-Safe Tracking & Attribution: Configure server-side tracking, GTM, GA4, and call tracking (CallRail/WhatConverts) to attribute appointment bookings back to specific ad groups without transmitting Protected Health Information (PHI).  

Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO): Audit and optimize landing pages to increase form completions, online scheduling flow, and click-to-call conversions.  

Negative Keyword & Intent Filtering: Actively manage search terms to eliminate irrelevant traffic, price-shoppers, Medicaid inquiries (if applicable), and non-commercial searches.  

Ad Copy & Policy Compliance: Write high-converting, compliant ad copy that avoids policy disapprovals, restricted remarketing violations, and misleading claim penalties.  

Bid & Budget Management: Implement smart bidding strategies (Target CPA / Maximize Conversions) aligned with appointment value.  

Required Skills & Qualifications
3+ years of hands-on experience running Google Ads specifically for US healthcare, medical practices, or wellness clinics.  

Demonstrated understanding of HIPAA rules in digital tracking (handling pixels without PHI leakage, BAA requirements, restricted audiences).  

Familiarity with healthcare booking platforms / EHR systems and tracking their scheduling funnels.  

Deep knowledge of Google's Healthcare & Medicines Advertising Policies.  

Ad Copywriting & Compliance: Write compelling, high-converting ad copy that strictly adheres to Google Healthcare and Medicines policies.

Conversion Tracking & Analytics: Set up and audit HIPAA-compliant tracking (GA4, Google Tag Manager, server-side tracking, and call tracking platforms like CallRail).

Landing Page Recommendations: Collaborate on CRO (Conversion Rate Optimization) to improve landing page quality scores and appointment booking rates.

Routine Optimization & Reporting: Provide weekly performance insights, bid/budget adjustments, and A/B test ad variations.

jobs.title: create website

5. Deployment & CI/CD

Hosting: Deploy on cloud platforms like Vercel, AWS, DigitalOcean, or Render.

Automation: Set up a CI/CD pipeline using GitHub Actions for seamless continuous integration and deployment.

jobs.title: Appointment Setter
jobs.description:
Job description

I run an online coaching business for natural bodybuilders and physique athletes. We run Meta ads into Instagram DMs, qualify the lead, book them onto a Calendly consultation call, and I close on the call.

I need a full time setter to live in the DMs so no lead goes cold. Speed and follow up is the whole job.

What you will do

	•	Work inbound Instagram DM leads from our paid ads (UK and US ad sets), plus organic enquiries
	•	Respond to every new lead fast. Target is under 10 minutes in coverage hours
	•	Run our 6 question qualification sequence, one question at a time, human tone, no copy paste blasts
	•	Never discuss pricing in the DMs. Your job is to get the qualified lead booked
	•	Book qualified leads into Calendly and confirm the slot
	•	Send a pre call reminder sequence so they show up: 24 hours before, 2 hours before, 10 minutes before
	•	Work a structured follow up sequence on every unbooked lead across 7 to 10 days, then move them to weekly nurture
	•	Rebook every no show within 24 hours
	•	After my sales calls, chase any lead where cash was not collected on the call. Same day, day 2, day 4, day 7
	•	Update the lead tracker after every touch so pipeline status is always accurate
	•	Send an end of day report every day

End of day report must include

	•	New leads in, by ad set
	•	Leads contacted and average response time
	•	Qualified conversations
	•	Calls booked, with names and times
	•	Shows, no shows, rebooks
	•	Post call chases sent and where each unclosed lead sits
	•	Leads at risk of going cold and what you are doing about it

KPIs you will be measured on

	•	100% of new leads contacted the same day
	•	Average first response under 10 minutes in coverage hours
	•	Qualified conversation to booking rate of 35% or higher
	•	Show rate of 70% or higher
	•	Agreed number of booked calls per week
	•	Zero leads sitting untouched for more than 48 hours

Requirements

	•	Proven appointment setting experience in fitness, health or coaching. Tell me the offer and the price point you set for
	•	Native or near native written English. Casual, natural DM tone, not corporate
	•	Comfortable with Instagram DMs, Calendly, Google Sheets, WhatsApp
	•	Available across UK and US hours. Weekend cover needed as ads run daily
	•	Organised and consistent. This role lives or dies on follow up

Bonus if you have

	•	Bodybuilding, powerlifting or physique competition knowledge. You need to speak the language of prep, offseason, macros and stage weight
	•	ManyChat or similar automation experience

To apply, send me

	1.	A 60 second voice note or short video introducing yourself
	2.	A mock DM opener and your first two qualifying questions for someone who commented on an ad about competing natural
	3.	Your setting numbers from your last role: leads worked, calls booked, show rate
	4.	Your available hours in UK time

Applications without the mock DM will be ignored.

jobs.title: Creative Video Editing Intern Needed
jobs.description:
**Video Editing Intern – YouTube, Reels & Shorts | Remote | Monthly Stipend**

I’m looking for a creative **Video Editing Intern** to work with me on an ongoing basis across YouTube and short-form social content.

I’m not looking for someone who simply cuts footage and adds transitions.

I’m looking for someone who understands **storytelling, pacing and attention** — and can take raw footage and turn it into content people actually want to watch.

### What You’ll Work On

You’ll primarily help with:

- YouTube long-form video editing
- Instagram Reels & YouTube Shorts
- Finding and adding relevant B-roll
- Visual storytelling and creative transitions
- Motion graphics and text animation
- Subtitles and on-screen text
- Audio cleanup, music and sound design
- Repurposing long-form videos into multiple Shorts/Reels
- Improving pacing and removing unnecessary sections
- Using AI tools where they can make the content better
- Creating simple AI-generated visuals or B-roll when required

The content will primarily be **talking-head, educational, professional and storytelling-led**, so good judgment is more important than flashy editing.

### What I’m Looking For

You **do not need years of professional experience**.

A talented student, beginner editor or someone building their portfolio is absolutely welcome to apply.

But you should have:

- A strong sense of pacing and storytelling
- An understanding of what makes viewers keep watching
- A good eye for B-roll and visual selection
- Understanding of YouTube Shorts and Instagram Reels
- Good sense of music, typography and transitions
- Familiarity with Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut, CapCut, VN, After Effects or similar
- Curiosity about AI video and creative tools
- Ability to take feedback and improve quickly
- Attention to detail
- Ability to deliver work consistently

### One Thing That Matters to Me

**Don't over-edit.**

I don't want every sentence covered with an animation, zoom, sound effect or stock video.

The editing should support the **idea and story**, not compete with it.

Knowing **when not to add something** is as important as knowing how to add it.

### Compensation

This is a **remote internship with a fixed monthly stipend**.

Compensation will depend on your current skill level, portfolio and availability. Paid for the content output hours.

This is intended to be an **ongoing engagement**, not a one-off editing project.

If we work well together, there is potential for the role to grow over time.

### How to Apply

Please include:

1. A short introduction about yourself
2. Links to your **3 best edits**
3. Which editing software you primarily use
4. Any AI video/image tools you know
5. Your **expected monthly stipend**
6. Your weekly availability
7. How soon you can start

**Don't have a big portfolio? That's okay.**

Send me one piece of work that best demonstrates your editing ability and creative judgment.

Then answer this in **one sentence**:

**What makes a well-edited video different from an over-edited video?**

I'm much more interested in your answer to that question — and the quality of your work — than the number of years you've been editing.

jobs.title: Custom Website Server Migration
jobs.description:
# Custom Website Migration to New Server

We are looking for an experienced **Web Developer / Server Migration Specialist** to migrate our existing **custom-built website** to a new server.

### Scope of Work

The freelancer will be responsible for:

* Taking a complete backup of the existing website and database.
* Migrating the complete custom website to the new server.
* Migrating all website files, database, media and required configurations.
* Properly configuring the website and server environment.
* Connecting the domain and DNS to the new server.
* Setting up SSL/HTTPS.
* Ensuring all existing features and functionality continue to work correctly.
* Checking forms, pages, images, links and other website functions.
* Testing the website on desktop and mobile.
* Fixing any errors or compatibility issues after migration.
* Minimizing downtime during the migration.
* Fully testing the website before final handover.

### Important

**This is NOT a new website development project.**

The website is **custom-built**, and we only need the existing website migrated to a new server without changing its design or functionality.

The freelancer should first identify the **technology/framework, database and server requirements** of the existing website and confirm that they can successfully migrate it.

### Future Work

If the migration is completed successfully, we may require the freelancer for ongoing:

* Website maintenance
* Technical support
* Bug fixing
* Website modifications
* Feature development
* Server support
* Development work for our future clients

We are looking for a **reliable freelancer for a long-term working relationship**, not just a one-time project.

### To Apply

Please provide:

1. Your experience with custom website migrations.
2. Examples of custom websites you have worked on.
3. Your experience with server migration and DNS configuration.
4. Your fixed price for this project.
5. Estimated completion time.
6. What access/information you will require from us.
7. Your charges for ongoing maintenance and support.
8. Your availability for future projects.

**Budget:** Please provide your best economical fixed-price quote.

Preference will be given to freelancers who can offer **reasonable pricing, quick communication and reliable long-term support**.

I’m happy to answer technical questions quickly so you can move fast; just outline your proposed tech stack, past Matka or gaming work, and an estimated timeline in your bid.

jobs.title: Linux C Line Hider - 26/08/2026 07:15 EDT
jobs.description:
I want a lightweight, straight-C console tool that I can compile with a single  
gcc call on both Ubuntu 26.04 LTS Server and Desktop.  
When I launch it the program must:

• Prompt for the full path of the target text file (≈100 lines).  
• Ask whether I intend to hide or unhide lines.  
• Request how many lines to process (1–5).

In hide mode the utility must randomly choose that exact count of distinct line numbers (no manual picking) and make them invisible inside the file. In unhide mode it must put every previously hidden line back into its original position, effectively restoring the file exactly as it was.  

If the chosen file already carries a set of hidden markers, the program should warn me and exit without touching anything—no merging or overwriting.  

I also need:

• The .c source file, cleanly commented.  
• A short README showing the gcc command (e.g., gcc -std=c11 -O2 linehider.c -o linehider) and a couple of usage examples.  
• Any helper script or Makefile if you prefer.  

Keep the solution portable, using only standard C and the usual GNU tools that ship with Ubuntu. Once I have the executable, I must be able to run it at will to hide or reveal lines as described.

jobs.title: ArtX v2 ERP System

# Development & Enhancement of a Complete ERP System for a Garment Factory

I have an existing ERP system called **ArtX ERP v2**, designed specifically to manage the operations of a garment manufacturing factory.

The system is already developed and available online. I am looking for an experienced developer or development team to review the existing system, improve it, fix issues, complete unfinished features, and transform it into a professional, reliable, and production-ready ERP solution.

**Live Demo / System Preview:**
https://artx-factory-erp.vercel.app/

## System Overview

The ERP is designed to manage the complete workflow of a garment factory, from raw materials and inventory through production, quality control, and delivery.

### Main Modules

* Dashboard & Analytics
* Warehouse & Inventory Management
* Fabric & Raw Materials Management
* Models / Products Management
* Cutting Department
* Design Department
* Production & Tailor Management
* Material Consumption Tracking
* Waste & Scrap Recording
* Quality Control
* Receiving & Delivery
* Returns Management
* User Management & Roles
* Permissions & Access Control
* Reports & Statistics
* Excel Export
* Notifications
* Advanced Search & Filtering
* Barcode / QR Code integration
* Future AI Assistant integration

## What I Need

I need the developer to review the current project and understand its existing architecture and workflow, then:

1. Improve and enhance the existing features.
2. Complete unfinished or partially implemented functionality.
3. Fix existing bugs and technical issues.
4. Improve the database structure and backend architecture.
5. Optimize system performance and loading speed.
6. Improve the UI/UX and make the interface more professional and intuitive.
7. Ensure full responsiveness across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.
8. Implement a professional role-based permissions system.
9. Develop and improve reports and analytics.
10. Ensure reliable and secure data storage.
11. Prepare the system architecture for future expansion.
12. Maintain the existing business logic and workflow unless improvements are clearly required.

## Important

**This is NOT a project that needs to be built from scratch.**

The ERP system already exists, and the main goal is to **understand the current codebase, improve it, fix problems, complete missing functionality, and take the project to a professional production-ready level.**

The developer should be comfortable working with existing code and databases rather than simply replacing the entire project with a new one.

## Preferred Skills & Experience

Experience with the following is highly preferred:

* ERP Systems
* Manufacturing Management Systems
* Inventory Management
* Production Management
* PostgreSQL / SQL
* React / Next.js
* TypeScript
* Backend Development
* REST APIs
* Modern UI/UX
* Role-Based Access Control
* Data Reporting & Analytics

Experience with **garment manufacturing, factory management, inventory, or production systems** will be a strong advantage.

When applying, please provide examples of previous ERP, manufacturing, inventory, or business management systems you have developed.

### Final Goal

The goal is to transform **ArtX ERP v2** into a **professional, stable, scalable, and production-ready ERP system for managing a complete garment manufacturing operation.**

jobs.title: 2D/2.5D Animator Needed for a 75-Minute Christmas Film
jobs.description:
We are making a 75-minute animated film based on Christmas.

The script, character artwork and storyboards are already prepared. We are now looking for an experienced and passionate 2D/2.5D animator who can bring the film to life.

We are open to different animation workflows and would like to hear what workflow you think would work best for our project.

This is likely to be a long-term project with intended sequels. You must have a passion for Christmas and be responsive via Chat. 

I want to see your personality in our interactions & in your work. Use of A.I for responses or creative choices will remove you as a candidate (though it is understood A.I may be necessary to speed up unimportant tasks). Failure to answer straight questions means we will lose interest immediately.

TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS

The animator should be able to:

1. Create smooth and good-quality 2D or 2.5D animation based on our storyboards and character artwork.

2. Work with a suitable animation workflow, such as:

- Toon Boom Harmony
- Moho
- Adobe After Effects
- Blender
- OpenToonz

or another suitable 2D/2.5D software.

3. Make sure the characters look naturally connected with the backgrounds and do not look like they have simply been pasted onto the scene.

4. Create good camera movements and framing according to each scene.

5. Make the animation smooth, with the correct frame rate, resolution and aspect ratio.

COMPOSITING & FINAL LOOK

Compositing and final visual effects are important for this film.

The final scenes should have:

- Proper lighting and shadows
- Good colour correction and colour grading
- Characters matching the lighting of the background
- Soft and cast shadows where needed
- Highlights and glow
- Warm and cosy Christmas lighting
- Night-time lighting
- Snow and fire effects
- Candlelight and Christmas light glow
- Atmospheric effects
- Other effects needed to make the scenes look natural and cinematic

Ultimately, all elements in each scene should feel like they belong together.

What we already have:

- Completed script
- Character artwork
- Storyboards

Note:

We are not looking for AI-generated animation videos. Animation should be properly rigging based or manual frame by frame based.

Please send us:

- Your animation portfolio or showreel, and note 2 particular clips which best demonstrate your distinct style that could apply to this project
- Examples of your 2D/2.5D character animation
- Examples of compositing, lighting or visual effects, if available
- The software/workflow you normally use
- Your estimated production timeline (this is likely to be a longterm project over months, not completed in a week)
- Your rate or quotation structure
- Whether you work alone or with a small team

A small test scene of 15 seconds will be required before starting the full project, which you will be reimbursed for at an agreed price.

Is this your breakthrough job?

jobs.title: Chrome Download Flag Issue Fix

jobs.title: Cross-Platform Medical Simulation Application — Android and iOS
jobs.description:
I am looking for a developer to create a cross-platform medical simulation and training application for Android and iOS using a shared codebase.

This application is intended for medical education and simulation. It will simulate the operation of a patient monitor, AED and defibrillator. It is not intended to control a real medical device unless physical-device integration is separately agreed in writing.

I have an existing detailed project specification and additional requirements. The final scope consists of the attached specification together with the requirements described below.

MOST IMPORTANT REQUIREMENTS

1. SMOOTH ECG AND PATIENT-MONITOR WAVEFORMS

The most important part of this project is the smooth and realistic display of ECG and other patient-monitor waveforms.

The application should support:

- ECG waveforms.
- 12-lead ECG.
- SpO2 waveform.
- EtCO2 waveform.
- Respiratory-rate waveform where applicable.
- Heart rate, QTc, blood pressure/MAP, pulse and temperature values.
- Real-time changes to patient parameters.
- Alarm events and emergency-procedure actions.

The waveforms must not freeze, visibly stutter, restart or jump whenever the user changes a parameter or when data is received from another device.

The communication layer must not block the user interface or interrupt waveform rendering. The developer must explain how the simulation engine, communication layer and rendering layer will be separated. Please also document the update rate, buffering and interpolation strategy.

The developer must demonstrate waveform smoothness on real Android and iOS devices, not only in an emulator.

2. COMMUNICATION THROUGH BOTH WI-FI AND BLUETOOTH

The application must support communication between devices through both:

- Wi-Fi.
- Bluetooth.

Bluetooth is a required communication method. It must not be omitted and must not be used only for device discovery.

The application should support:

- Nearby-device discovery.
- Device selection.
- Connection status.
- Connection errors.
- Temporary connection interruption.
- Reconnection where technically possible.
- Safe disconnection.

The developer must test both Wi-Fi and Bluetooth on real devices. During communication, the ECG and other waveforms must continue to work smoothly.

APPLICATION MODES

The application must include three operating modes:

1. INSTRUCTOR MODE

The instructor uses one phone or tablet to connect to a patient monitor, select or create a scenario, configure the patient and control the simulation in real time.

Instructor Mode must include:

- Connecting to a Patient Monitor.
- Selecting or creating a scenario.
- Selecting the monitor layout.
- Configuring the initial patient condition.
- Changing HR, QTc, ECG rhythm, BP/MAP, SpO2, EtCO2, RR, pulse and temperature.
- Triggering and configuring alarms.
- Starting, pausing/stopping and ending the simulation.
- Displaying a 12-lead ECG on the monitor.
- Uploading an image or animation to the monitor.
- Enabling ECG artifacts.
- Configuring after how many defibrillator shocks the rhythm changes.
- Selecting which rhythm is displayed after the specified number of shocks.
- Synchronizing relevant changes with the connected monitor in real time.

2. MONITOR MODE

The device operates as a realistic Patient Monitor and receives the instructor’s changes.

It should display, where applicable:

- ECG waveforms.
- 12-lead ECG.
- HR and QTc.
- SpO2 and waveform.
- EtCO2 and waveform.
- BP/MAP and recent measurement history.
- RR.
- Pulse.
- Temperature.
- Alarm indicators and audible alarms.
- Simulation status.
- Connection status.

When the instructor starts the simulation, the monitor should automatically open the live-monitor screen.

3. STANDALONE MONITOR MODE

The user can operate the simulation completely on one device without connecting to a remote controller.

The user must be able to:

- Select or create a scenario.
- Configure the patient.
- Start and stop the simulation.
- Change patient parameters directly.
- Change the ECG rhythm directly.
- Configure alarms.
- Use AED functions.
- Use Defibrillator functions.
- Use Cardioversion functions.
- Use Pacing functions.
- Use the CPR Metronome.

AED AND DEFIBRILLATOR REQUIREMENTS

AED Mode and Defibrillator Mode must work in both:

- Monitor Mode.
- Standalone Monitor Mode.

Defibrillator Mode must include:

- Switching the defibrillator on.
- Selecting the energy level.
- Pressing the Charge button.
- Displaying the charging state.
- Delivering a simulated shock.
- Updating the simulation state after the shock.
- Synchronizing the event with the monitor during a remote session.
- Cardioversion as a function within Defibrillator Mode.
- Pacing as a function within Defibrillator Mode.

The CPR Metronome must be available as a function within both AED Mode and Defibrillator Mode.

The user must be able to complete the following simulated sequence:

1. Activate the defibrillator.
2. Set the energy level.
3. Press Charge.
4. Press Discharge
4. Deliver a simulated shock.
5. Display the result of the shock in the simulation.
6. Set Cardioversion function
7. Set- Pacing  function 

In Instructor Mode, the instructor must be able to define after how many shocks the rhythm changes and which rhythm is selected afterwards.

These are simulation functions. Physical AED or defibrillator hardware integration is excluded unless separately agreed in writing.

REFERENCE APPLICATIONS

The developer should review the SIM-MON and free Simple Monitor applications to understand the expected interaction and behavior of monitor, AED and defibrillator functions.

The final interface may have a different visual design or layout. It does not need to copy the reference applications graphically. However, the relevant functions and logical behavior should be comparable. No protected code or graphic assets may be copied.

ADDITIONAL FEATURES

The application should also include:

- Three monitor layouts: Basic, Extended and Vital Signs.
- Scenario creation, editing, deletion, saving and loading.
- Local storage of settings and scenarios.
- Alarm thresholds for HR, BP, SpO2, RR and EtCO2.
- Oxygen/air selection.
- Consciousness states and NEWS score as specified in the attached documentation.
- Seven languages: English, Polish, Spanish, German, French, Portuguese and Italian.
- Free Demo Version with full simulation functionality during an active 15-minute session.
- Paywall after Demo expiration.
- One-time in-app purchase to unlock the Full Version.
- No subscription is required under the current scope.
- Settings for communication preferences, EtCO2 unit, device name, session duration and BP display behavior.
- User-friendly error and recovery messages.

DEVELOPMENT AND PAYMENT METHOD

The project must be completed through fixed-price milestones on Freelancer.

The project must not be treated as one single payment for the entire application.

Each milestone must include:

- A working test build.
- A list of completed functions.
- A list of known issues.
- Updated source code in the project repository.
- A short description of how the result was tested.

A milestone will be released only after the client has tested and accepted the result against the agreed acceptance criteria.

PROPOSED MILESTONES

1. Technical analysis, architecture and waveform prototype.
2. Wi-Fi and Bluetooth communication.
3. Smooth ECG and vital-sign waveform engine.
4. Live Patient Monitor and monitor layouts.
5. Instructor Mode and real-time control.
6. AED, Defibrillator, Cardioversion, Pacing and CPR Metronome.
7. Scenario Management, local storage and Standalone Monitor Mode.
8. Demo Mode, Paywall and one-time purchase.
9. Seven-language localization and Settings.
10. Final testing, bug fixing, documentation and handover.

ACCEPTANCE PRIORITIES

The first acceptance priorities are:

- Smooth and realistic waveforms.
- Reliable Wi-Fi communication.
- Reliable Bluetooth communication.
- No freezing or stuttering during communication or parameter changes.
- Correct behavior on real devices.
- Correct synchronization between the Instructor device and the Monitor device.

SOURCE CODE AND FINAL HANDOVER

The final delivery must include:

- Complete source code.
- Git repository or complete repository export.
- Project and configuration files.
- Build and installation instructions.
- Localization files.
- Scenario and test data.
- List of external libraries and licenses.
- Android and iOS build instructions.
- App Store and Google Play preparation materials.
- All project-specific graphics and audio files created for this project.

The client must own or control the Apple Developer and Google Play accounts used for publication. The developer must not retain exclusive control over the source code, repository or publishing accounts after completion.

The developer must also help prepare and publish the application on both the Apple App Store and Google Play. This includes preparing the Android and iOS release builds, configuring the required signing and store settings, uploading the builds, assisting with the submission process, and responding to technical rejection messages from Apple or Google.

The client will own and administer the Apple Developer and Google Play accounts. App Store, Google Play and third-party account fees are paid directly by the client. Technical publication support is included in the agreed project scope and is not an optional extra.

WEEKLY COMMUNICATION

The developer must provide a weekly update containing:

- Completed work.
- Work currently in progress.
- Planned work for the next week.
- Problems and risks.
- Link to the current test build.
- List of known bugs.
- Confirmation whether the schedule and budget remain vali

jobs.title: Holding Company Website Design
jobs.description:
PROJECT TITLE

Design and Build a Sophisticated Two-Three-Page Website for an Abu Dhabi Holding Company

PROJECT OVERVIEW

We are seeking an experienced web designer to design, build and launch a simple but highly polished two-to-three-page website for a privately owned holding company based in Abu Dhabi, UAE.

The holding company will have interests in several businesses. The website’s primary purpose is to provide a discreet institutional presence and direct visitors to the individual portfolio companies through their logos or names.

SCOPE

The website will contain:

• Holding company name and understated introductory statement
• A short paragraph describing the company’s broad purpose
• A clean portfolio section displaying the companies in which the HoldCo has interests
• Each portfolio company’s name or logo linking to its own external website
• Abu Dhabi location and general contact details
• Basic privacy notice or footer
• Responsive desktop, tablet and mobile layouts
• Must make sure that emails are connected to the site 
• Full technical handling of launching the website, including domain connection and ensuring SSL/HTTPS functionality 

DESIGN DIRECTION

The website should feel:

• Sophisticated and understated
• Contemporary but not fashionable or trend-driven
• Institutional and credible without overstating the company’s size
• Editorial, spacious and typographically strong
• Appropriate for a privately owned Abu Dhabi investment and operating group 
We do not want a conventional Dubai-style corporate website, elaborate animations, financial clichés, stock-market graphics, skyscraper photographs, handshakes or generic “global investment” imagery.
The quality of the typography, proportions, spacing and presentation will be particularly important.
PLATFORM AND FUTURE EDITING 
Our preference is Framer, although we will consider another managed platform if there is a compelling reason.
The website will need to be updated periodically as the holding company acquires interests in additional businesses. It must therefore be built so that we can easily:
Add or remove portfolio companies 
Change company logos and descriptions 
Update links to portfolio-company websites 
Amend the introductory copy and contact information 
The completed website must be transferred into an account owned and controlled by us. We should not require the original designer—or an ongoing maintenance contract—to make ordinary content changes.
The designer must provide a short written or recorded handover showing us how to make these updates.
DOMAIN CONNECTION 
We already own the relevant .ae domain.
The selected designer will be expected either to connect the completed website to this domain or guide us clearly through the process. The domain must remain registered in and controlled through our own account; it should not be transferred into the designer’s ownership.
The designer should identify any information or DNS changes required from our domain provider and confirm that SSL/HTTPS is working correctly before completion.
DELIVERABLES 
Two initial visual directions Final approved one-page design Complete website development Responsive mobile and tablet versions Basic copy refinement Portfolio-company link configuration Contact link or simple enquiry form Basic SEO titles and descriptions Connection to our existing .ae domain, or live guidance to complete it SSL/HTTPS and domain testing Testing across current desktop and mobile browsers Transfer of all design files, website ownership and intellectual property Written or recorded instructions explaining how to update the site Two rounds of revisions The domain and final company information will be provided to the selected designer. The company name may remain a placeholder during the initial design stage.
TIMING AND BUDGET Target completion: two to three weeks from appointment. Indicative fixed budget: US$800–1,500, depending on portfolio quality and the proposed approach. WHEN APPLYING Please provide: Three live websites that you personally designed and built One example most closely matching the understated aesthetic described above Confirmation that you can complete both the design and development yourself Your fixed price and proposed timetable Confirmation that the completed website will be transferred into our account Confirmation that we will be able to update company logos, links and text ourselves Confirmation that you can connect the website to our existing .ae domain A brief description of the visual direction you would recommend.

jobs.title: 360 SCAN-TO-BIM
jobs.description:
PROJECT TITLE

Scan-to-BIM / Revit Expert Needed – Convert 360° Survey Data into an Editable As-Built Revit Model

PROJECT OVERVIEW

We are looking for an experienced Scan-to-BIM specialist or Revit BIM modeler to help us convert our existing 360° building survey data into accurate, editable as-built models in Autodesk Revit.

This project will begin with a paid pilot using one completed building survey. If the pilot is successful, there is potential for ongoing work involving multiple properties.

OUR CURRENT SURVEY PROCESS

We document buildings using a 360° camera mounted on a tripod.

A 360° panorama is captured approximately every 1.5–2.5 metres throughout the property. The images are then stitched and connected to create a complete virtual walkthrough of the building.

After post-production, we currently have:

* Stitched 360° panoramic images
* A connected virtual walkthrough
* A measured 2D floor plan
* Individual panorama positions
* X, Y and Z coordinates for each panorama
* Rotation/orientation values for each panorama
* A simplified 3D scene or proxy geometry created during post-production
* Visual documentation of both internal and external areas

The current 3D information appears to be used for positioning, navigation and visualisation. It may not be a conventional LiDAR point cloud or a complete metric 3D mesh.

The available export formats have not yet been fully confirmed. Part of the initial assignment is therefore to inspect our source data and determine what can be used directly.

OUR OBJECTIVE

We want to create an accurate as-built BIM model of the surveyed property in Autodesk Revit.

The final Revit model must consist of native, editable Revit elements. We do not only want a point cloud, imported mesh or static 3D object placed inside Revit.

Depending on what is visible and measurable in the source material, the model should include:

* Building levels and storeys
* External and internal walls
* Floors and floor structures
* Ceilings
* Roof geometry
* Doors
* Windows
* Stairs
* Openings
* Columns and other visible structural elements
* Relevant fixed building components
* Correct room dimensions and heights
* Basic room names or classifications where available

The intended model level is approximately LOD 200–300, but the final level of detail and achievable accuracy must be agreed upon after the source data has been reviewed.

SCOPE OF WORK

The selected freelancer will be responsible for:

1. Reviewing a sample dataset from one completed survey.

2. Determining what geometric and measurement data is available.

3. Identifying whether the system can export any of the following:

* E57
* RCP or RCS
* PTS, XYZ or LAS point cloud
* OBJ, FBX, GLB or another mesh format
* DWG, DXF, SVG or another floor-plan format
* Original equirectangular 360° images
* Camera coordinates and orientation data
* Depth maps or other depth information

4. Recommending the most reliable workflow for creating the Revit model.

5. Importing or linking usable point-cloud, mesh, floor-plan or coordinate data.

6. Creating the building as native Revit elements.

7. Using the 360° walkthrough as visual reference throughout the modeling process.

8. Checking dimensions, elevations, alignment and coordinate consistency.

9. Clearly identifying any areas that cannot be modeled accurately from the available source data.

10. Documenting the expected model tolerance and any assumptions made.

IMPORTANT TECHNICAL DISTINCTION

We currently refer to our projects as “3D scans,” but the source material may primarily consist of spatially positioned 360° panoramas, a measured 2D floor plan and simplified 3D navigation geometry.

We therefore do not expect applicants to assume that an automatic one-click conversion to Revit is possible.

If a usable point cloud is available, it may be processed through Autodesk ReCap and used as the geometric reference in Revit.

If no point cloud or detailed mesh is available, the model may need to be created manually using the measured floor plan, panorama positions, known dimensions and visual information from the 360° walkthrough.

The freelancer must be able to explain which parts of the process can be automated and which parts require manual Revit modeling.

PILOT DELIVERABLES

For the first pilot property, we expect:

* A technical assessment of the supplied dataset
* A written recommendation for the best Scan-to-BIM workflow
* One complete native and editable Autodesk Revit model
* Delivery as an RVT file in an agreed Revit version
* IFC export
* Relevant floor plans, elevations and sections
* A list of assumptions and unidentified elements
* A short quality-control report
* Documentation of the expected dimensional accuracy
* All linked source files required to open and use the model

The Revit model must not contain unresolved or unavailable external file references.

WHAT WE DO NOT WANT

* A simple 3D mesh imported into Revit and presented as a completed BIM model
* A point cloud without native Revit elements
* An uneditable model
* Dimensions estimated without being clearly marked
* Hidden building structures invented from visual information
* A generic automated conversion without manual quality control
* Applicants claiming full automation before reviewing the actual data

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

Applicants should have documented experience with:

* Autodesk Revit
* Scan-to-BIM workflows
* As-built BIM modeling
* Autodesk ReCap or similar reality-capture software
* Point clouds and 3D mesh data
* 360° panoramic building documentation
* Creating accurate Revit models from imperfect or combined source data
* IFC export and BIM quality control

Experience with photogrammetry, computer vision, Revit API development or automated BIM workflows will be considered an advantage.

POTENTIAL LONG-TERM OPPORTUNITY

The pilot is intended to establish a repeatable production process.

After a successful pilot, the assignment may develop into:

* Ongoing conversion of building surveys into Revit models
* Development of templates and modeling standards
* Optimisation of the Scan-to-BIM workflow
* Partial automation of repetitive tasks
* Integration between our existing platform and Revit
* Revit API or IFC-based development

APPLICATION REQUIREMENTS

Please include the following information in your proposal:

1. Examples of similar Scan-to-BIM or as-built Revit projects.

2. A description of the source data used in those projects.

3. Your proposed workflow for our type of dataset.

4. How you would proceed if no LiDAR point cloud is available.

5. Which files and exports you would need from us.

6. Which Revit version you normally use.

7. Your estimated time and fixed price for the pilot.

8. The expected level of detail and accuracy you believe can be achieved.

9. Which parts of the workflow you believe can be automated.

10. Confirmation that you can deliver native, editable Revit elements.

Please begin your proposal with the words “360 SCAN-TO-BIM” so we know you have read the complete project description.

CONFIDENTIALITY AND DATA SECURITY

The survey material may contain sensitive visual information from private or commercial properties.

The selected freelancer must:

* Treat all supplied information as confidential
* Sign a non-disclosure agreement if required
* Store the files securely
* Not share or reuse the data
* Not upload the material to public platforms or third-party AI services without written approval
* Delete or return the source material when the assignment is completed

We are looking for a professional who can both produce the pilot model and help us establish a technically reliable, scalable Scan-to-BIM workflow for future projects.
