jobs.title: Instagram Reels Creator for Personal Brand
jobs.description:
# Personal Brand Content Creator — Bangalore

I’m looking for a creative **Content Creator / Videographer-Editor** to work closely with me and help me build my personal brand on Instagram.

My content will revolve around **fitness, self-improvement, entrepreneurship, lifestyle and building my business in Bangalore** — including documenting the process of designing and building office spaces for clients.

I’m looking for someone who can be around me regularly, capture things as they naturally happen, and turn those moments into engaging Instagram Reels.

This isn't a traditional “sit down and film a video” role. I want someone who can **spot content in everyday life, understand my personality, suggest ideas and help turn my actual experiences into good content.**

## What You'll Be Doing

* Shoot Instagram Reels and short-form videos regularly
* Capture my fitness journey — gym, workouts, routines and lifestyle
* Document my entrepreneurial journey and day-to-day business
* Film the process of **building and designing office spaces for clients**
* Capture office visits, site visits, client meetings, transformations and behind-the-scenes moments
* Film talking-to-camera videos, POVs, B-roll and storytelling content
* Capture natural, spontaneous moments rather than only staged content
* Edit Reels with strong hooks, captions, music, pacing and transitions
* Suggest content ideas based on what's happening in my life and what's trending
* Help plan weekly content and maintain consistency
* Organise and manage all video/content files
* Occasionally travel locally with me for shoots — gyms, office sites, meetings, restaurants, activities, etc.

## The Kind of Content I Want to Create

The goal is to make my content feel **real, aspirational and entertaining**, rather than overly polished or “influencer-like.”

For example:

**Fitness**

* My workouts and fitness journey
* What I eat / daily routines
* Progress and challenges
* Gym content and fitness-related experiences

**Entrepreneurship**

* Building and running my business
* Lessons from working with clients
* Behind the scenes of running a business
* Wins, failures and things I'm learning

**Office / Design / Business**

* Building office spaces from scratch
* Before & after transformations
* Office design decisions
* Site visits
* Client projects
* Behind the scenes of creating a workspace
* “Come with me while I build this office” style content

**Lifestyle**

* My life in Bangalore
* Restaurants, experiences, travel and activities
* Morning/evening routines
* Personal growth and self-improvement
* The journey of building a new life and business

## What I'm Looking For

You don't need to be a professional cinematographer.

More important to me is that you:

* **Understand Instagram and Reels**
* Have a good eye for framing, lighting and angles
* Know how to make content feel natural and engaging
* Can shoot confidently on a phone
* Are good at editing on **CapCut, Premiere Pro or similar**
* Understand hooks, retention and storytelling
* Have a strong sense of what's currently working on Instagram
* Can proactively suggest ideas instead of waiting for instructions
* Are reliable and consistent
* Are comfortable being around me regularly and capturing real-life moments
* Have a good eye for aesthetically pleasing content

## Equipment

We will primarily be shooting on an **iPhone 17 Pro Max**, so you should be comfortable creating high-quality content using a smartphone.

You don't need to own expensive camera equipment.

## Bonus — Not Mandatory

It would be great if you have experience with:

* Fitness content
* Lifestyle content
* Business/entrepreneurship content
* Interior/design/architecture content
* Photography
* Growing Instagram pages
* Creating viral/short-form content
* Shooting and editing personal-brand content

## Who Should Apply

I'm looking for someone who **genuinely loves Instagram, understands content and wants to build something together from Day 1.**

If you're someone who sees a situation and immediately thinks, *“That could be a great Reel,”* you'll probably be a good fit.

This is an opportunity to work closely with me, understand my journey and **help shape how my personal brand grows from the beginning.**

### To Apply

Please send:

1. Your Instagram / portfolio
2. 3–5 Reels you've shot and/or edited
3. A short introduction about yourself
4. Your experience with personal brands / social media
5. Your expected monthly fee or per-shoot rate
6. Your availability in Bangalore

**Location:** Bangalore
**Role:** Content Creator + Videographer + Editor
**Type:** Part-time / Freelance initially, with potential for a longer-term role

jobs.title: Numerical Data Classification Model
jobs.description:
I have a structured numerical dataset ready for a clean, reproducible classification workflow. The goal is to build, tune, and evaluate two models—Support Vector Machine and logistic regression—then present the results in a way that lets me decide which approach to take to production.

Here’s the flow I have in mind:
• Pre-process and explore the data (handle missing values, scale where needed, visualise key relationships).  
• Implement both classifiers in Python with scikit-learn, using cross-validation and grid/random search for hyper-parameter tuning.  
• Produce clear metrics (accuracy, precision-recall, ROC-AUC) and concise plots that compare the two models side-by-side.  
• Package everything in a well-commented Jupyter notebook plus a short summary report (PDF or Markdown) that explains findings, chosen parameters, and next steps.

Acceptance criteria
1. Notebook runs end-to-end on my machine with a single cell execution (conda / pip requirements listed).  
2. Both Support Vector Machine and logistic regression results are reported using the same validation splits.  
3. Code is PEP-8 compliant and functions are logically modular.  
4. Summary report highlights why one model might outperform the other and suggests any further improvements.

If you see value in optionally adding a third algorithm such as Random Forest or a Neural Network for comparison, mention it in your proposal—flexibility is welcome as long as the two core models remain the focus.

Preferred stack: Python 3.x, scikit-learn, pandas, NumPy, matplotlib or seaborn.

jobs.title: Offline Android Inventory Management App
jobs.description:
I need a simple, fully-offline Android application that helps me control stock inside my godown. The app should let an Admin user (no other roles are required) perform three key jobs:

• Stock tracking – add new items, record inward and outward movement, and view current quantities at a glance.  
• Credit & deposit management – log every party’s credit sales, record deposits they make against those balances, and see each party’s running statement.  
• Reporting & analytics – generate on-device summaries such as daily stock position, outstanding credits by party, and basic trend charts so I can make quick decisions without exporting data.

Because the warehouse often has no internet access, everything must work offline with data stored locally on the device. I am not looking to integrate it with any ERP or accounting package right now; the app should run as a completely standalone solution.

Deliverables I expect:  
1. Installable APK for testing and final release  
2. Complete, well-commented source code (Android Studio / Kotlin or Java)  
3. A brief setup & user guide that shows how to add items, manage party credits, and pull each report  

Please keep the interface straightforward so that warehouse staff can learn it quickly, and optimise it for phones with 6-inch screens and above.

My timeline is tight—2 to 3 days for the entire set—and I have set aside A$60–100 for the job, so smart syncing is welcome as long as you still eye-check each shot.

Deliverables

If you can meet the pace while keeping the edits subtle and professional, let’s get started—send me your Lightroom Classic catalog settings or workflow notes and I’ll forward the download link to the samples.

jobs.title: Nginx Pro for DDoS Protection & Googlebot Access
jobs.description:
URGENT] Nginx Expert Needed: Implement Googlebot Whitelisting & Smart Rate Limiting without Dropping Connections
​Job Type: Fixed-Price / Hourly (Urgent)
Category: Server Administration / DevOps / Nginx Security
​Project Overview:
We are experiencing DDoS attacks on our production server. Recently, strict Nginx blocking rules were applied to mitigate the attack, but this caused our Google Search Console (GSC) Server Connectivity failure rate to spike to 35%, drastically putting our organic rankings at risk.
​The immediate blocking rules were temporarily removed to restore crawling, but as a result, DDoS attacks have resumed.
​We need a seasoned Nginx / Systems Administrator to design and implement a robust, automated solution that protects our server from DDoS attacks while guaranteeing 100% uninterrupted access for official Google crawlers.
​Scope of Work & Requirements:
​Automated Googlebot IP Whitelisting / Dynamic Updating:
​Fetch and parse Google's official JSON IP ranges automatically via a custom cron script:
​Googlebot IPs: [https://developers.google.com/search/apis/ipranges/googlebot.json](https://developers.google.com/search/apis/ipranges/googlebot.json)
​Special Crawlers: [https://developers.google.com/search/apis/ipranges/special-crawlers.json](https://developers.google.com/search/apis/ipranges/special-crawlers.json)
​Automatically sync these IPs into the Nginx access control rules (or geo block/ipset) and safely reload Nginx.
​Alternately, implement verified Reverse DNS lookups (.googlebot.com / .google.com) alongside the CIDR range whitelisting for strict verification.
​Targeted Rate Limiting & Bot Protection:
​Do NOT apply blanket rate-limiting across the entire domain or drop connections at the network level for search bots.
​Apply strict rate limiting specifically to sensitive endpoints (e.g., POST requests on /login, /wp-login.php, API endpoints, registration forms).
​Ensure legitimate GET requests for search crawlers pass through without throttling or timeouts.
​Proper HTTP Status Handling (No Connection Drops):
​Ensure Nginx never abruptly drops TCP connections (drop, reset), hangs requests, or triggers connection timeouts.
​If a non-whitelisted IP hits a restricted or blocked path, Nginx must return a proper HTTP 403 Forbidden (or 429 Too Many Requests) header instead of closing the connection silently. This ensures Google Search Console does not log "Server Connectivity Failures".
​Testing, Log Verification, & Handover:
​Verify configuration using dry runs and log checks: grep -i "googlebot" /var/log/nginx/access.log and error.log.
​Test simulated Googlebot user-agents/IPs to ensure zero false positives.
​Provide brief documentation for the custom sync script and Nginx rules implemented.
​Required Skills:
​Advanced Nginx configuration (Rate Limiting, geo blocks, map directives, limit_req).
​Bash / Python Scripting (Cron jobs for dynamic JSON parsing & firewalls/Nginx reloads).
​Deep understanding of Googlebot Crawling Infrastructure & SEO technical health.
​Linux Server Security (iptables, fail2ban, ipset experience is a plus).
​To Apply:
​Please briefly outline your experience with Nginx rate-limiting strategies and dynamic IP whitelisting. Mention "NGINX-GOOGLEBOT" at the top of your proposal to show you have read the complete project description.

jobs.title: Android Payment App Development
jobs.description:
A native Android application that turns the sales phone into a card terminal, embedding SumUp's Tap to Pay SDK to read contactless cards over NFC. No separate card reader.

How it fits. Two applications on one device. The Odoo POS is a Progressive Web App, built separately, and launches this app when the operator selects the card payment method.

How the flow works. A PWA cannot receive an Android activity result, so the two apps never exchange the outcome directly. The POS passes a transaction identifier by intent. The app fetches the authoritative amount from the Odoo server over its own authenticated call, runs the payment through the SDK, and posts the result back to the server — which then updates the payment line in the POS. The amount never travels in the intent, so nothing on the device can set the price.

What it does. Seven areas of work:

Provisioning and terminal identity — one-time device binding with backend service credentials, encrypted device token, terminal status screen, guarded deprovisioning
SDK lifecycle and token supply — single initialisation, a non-blocking token provider, proactive background refresh
Request validation and amount conversion — caller signature verification, payload fetch, BigDecimal conversion to minor units
Payment execution and transaction UI — starting the transaction, driving present-card and PIN screens from the SDK event stream, mapping errors to actionable operator messages
Outcome reporting — four terminal outcomes handled distinctly, written to a durable local queue and retried until the server acknowledges
Market neutrality — currency, locale and formatting driven by configuration rather than hard-coded
Diagnostics — log redaction and batched diagnostic upload

Deliverables. A production application, an attestation-compliant release build, unit tests covering the payment path, a technical readme, a provisioning procedure for IT operations, and support through the single-till pilot.

jobs.title: Build a FiveM ENHANCED/qbox realistic RP server

# FiveM Enhanced qbox Server Development

## Fixed-Price Project — Maximum Budget: $1,300 USD

⚠️ **Important — Read Before Submitting a Proposal** ⚠️

Generic, automated and placeholder proposals will not be considered. Your bid must cover the complete agreed scope and must not exceed **$1,300 USD fixed price**. We are not offering hourly work or milestone payments.

We are building a premium FiveM roleplay server for **GTA V Enhanced**, using **qbox** and our existing **L2S-based foundation**.

We already own most of the required scripts, MLOs, YMAPs, vehicles, weapons, EUP and UI assets. The developer’s responsibility is to review, clean, configure, merge, integrate and optimize these resources while custom-developing selected missing functionality.

The goal is not to install many disconnected scripts. We want one immersive, stable and scalable ecosystem where inventory, housing, hotels, vehicles, businesses, jobs, police, EMS, prison, crime, NPCs, UI and world assets communicate through shared logic, clean exports, events, callbacks and metadata.

## Project Direction

The server should move away from traditional menu-based roleplay and toward a more physical and interactive world.

Examples include:

* Visible, placeable and interactable item props
* Realistic weapon storage, cases, slings and vehicle transport
* Persistent vehicles with keys, damage, fuel, storage and history
* Businesses requiring stock, deliveries, employees and equipment
* Dealerships ordering and preparing vehicles before sale
* Houses with access, security, storage and robbery risks
* Criminal systems involving planning, heat, evidence and consequences
* Police and EMS responding to crimes, injuries, NPC reports and investigations
* NPCs, MLOs, streets and public spaces having meaningful gameplay purposes

Realism must create roleplay opportunities without becoming a repetitive or frustrating simulator.

## Scope of Work

The developer will be responsible for:

* Reviewing and configuring the complete QBCore/L2S server to fit qbox
* Cleaning, repairing and optimizing existing Lua, JavaScript and NUI resources
* Removing unused files, duplicate systems, debug code and unnecessary loops
* Rewriting weak, unstable or unreadable logic
* Fixing exports, callbacks, permissions, database queries and resource dependencies
* Adding strong server-side validation, logging and exploit protection
* Merging related functionality into organized core resources
* Standardizing all interfaces around the existing L2S UI, colors, fonts and interaction style
* Developing selected missing features and integrations
* Creating reusable shared logic instead of duplicating the same functionality across resources
* Testing all work personally in GTA V Enhanced and FiveM

Major systems include:

* Inventory and physical item system
* Housing and hotel systems
* Police, EMS and prison systems
* Vehicle system
* Criminal and drug systems
* Jobs and business systems
* NPC and world-interaction system
* Shared UI system
* Staff, administration and development tools

## In-Game Creator Tools

Authorized staff should be able to manage content in-game without editing multiple configuration files.

Creator tools may include:

* Job and Business Creator
* House and Hotel Creator
* Drug and Robbery Creator
* Door, Elevator and Garage Creator
* Shop and Crafting Creator
* NPC and Interaction Creator
* Mission and Contract Creator
* Stash and Storage Creator
* Blip and Zone Creator

These tools must use the L2S UI style, proper permissions, server-side validation, database persistence and audit logging.

## Asset Integration

The developer must install, organize, test and optimize supplied assets.

### MLOs and YMAPs

Fix and review collisions, portals, rooms, YTYPs, lighting, missing props, LODs, duplicate assets, map conflicts, texture loss, streaming problems and client crashes.

### EUP

Organize clothing packs, fix drawable and texture conflicts, remove broken or duplicate assets, configure job and rank access, integrate wardrobes and test male and female compatibility.

### Vehicles

Configure metadata, categories, dealerships, garages, keys, fuel, handling, liveries, extras, collisions, persistence, textures and model optimization.

### Weapons

Configure metadata, ammunition, attachments, animations, inventory, evidence, physical storage, first-person and third-person models, textures and conflicts.

All supplied scripts and assets must be reviewed for **GTA V Enhanced compatibility**.

## Quality and Acceptance Requirements

All systems must include:

* Clean and readable code
* Strong server-side validation
* Low client and server overhead
* Proper permissions and logging
* No duplication exploits
* Database-safe persistence
* Consistent UI
* Clean exports and events
* Stable resource restarts
* Scalable and reusable architecture

Acceptance requires:

* No persistent server-console or F8 errors
* No unexplained warnings
* No broken dependencies
* No reproducible duplication exploits
* No major texture or streaming issues
* No crashes caused by the delivered work
* Smooth in-game operation
* Clean and organized source files

The preferred idle performance target is **well below 0.4 ms per script**, where technically reasonable.

## Developer Requirements

You must have:

* GTA V Enhanced and FiveM installed
* Strong QBCore/qbox and Lua experience
* Experience with NUI, HTML, CSS and JavaScript
* Experience with MLOs, YMAPs, EUP, vehicles and weapons
* CodeWalker and OpenIV
* The ability to test everything personally in-game
* Reliable communication and availability for regular progress calls

AI may be used as a development assistant, but relying entirely on untested AI-generated code is not acceptable.

jobs.title: Monthly YouTube SEO Growth Strategy
jobs.description:
My immediate focus is the organic expansion of a single YouTube channel on a rolling monthly basis. Facebook and Instagram may follow later, yet every task in the first phase revolves around YouTube alone: making each upload easier to discover, improving click-through and watch-time, and gradually strengthening overall channel authority.

What I will hand over:
• Full access (manager level) to YouTube Studio.
• A content calendar outlining planned videos for the upcoming month.
• Existing analytics exports so you can benchmark current performance.

What I need from you each month:
1. A channel audit outlining quick wins and longer-term structural fixes.  
2. Keyword research and competitive mapping for every scheduled video, with recommended titles, descriptions, tags, and hashtag sets.  
3. On-page implementation: metadata updates, playlist restructuring, cards, end-screen sequencing, and thumbnail direction aimed at raising CTR.  
4. A concise end-of-month report summarising what was changed, the impact on impressions, views, and average view duration, plus next-step recommendations.

Preferred tool-chain includes TubeBuddy, VidIQ, Google Keyword Planner, and native YouTube Studio analytics—use whatever combination delivers the clearest data and results.

KPIs and growth targets can be refined together once you have reviewed baseline metrics; your insight on realistic subscriber, view, and engagement milestones will help set the pace.

Communication runs through a shared Google Sheet for task tracking and a weekly 15-minute check-in call (Zoom or Google Meet). If this sounds workable, let me know the soonest you can start with the audit and we’ll line up access credentials right away.

jobs.title: Odoo Implementation for Manufacturing Firm
jobs.description:
I want to replace our current Microsoft Dynamics setup with a fully-functioning Odoo environment tailored to a small-batch manufacturing company. The scope covers configuring the Inventory Management, Manufacturing and Sales modules so that day-to-day operations—raw-material receipt, work-order execution, finished-goods dispatch and order invoicing—flow seamlessly in one system.

Key points you should be comfortable with  
• Migrating master data, BOMs, routings, open production orders and customer history from Microsoft Dynamics into Odoo without loss of traceability.  
• Mapping our existing process steps to Odoo’s workflows, adjusting work centers, lead times and costing logic where needed.  
• Setting up real-time inventory valuation and barcode scanning on the shop floor.  
• Training a core user group (approx. 12 people) so they can create items, generate MOs, issue components and raise sales quotations confidently.  
• Providing go-live support and a short hyper-care window to iron out post-launch issues.

Deliverables  
1. Configured Odoo instance (Inventory, Manufacturing, Sales) ready for production use.  
2. Data-migration scripts with documented field mapping.  
3. User acceptance test sign-off and training materials.  
4. Post-deployment support report summarising resolved tickets.

Acceptance will be based on our team’s ability to run one complete make-to-stock and one make-to-order cycle in Odoo with correct inventory movements, cost roll-ups and automatic sales invoice generation. If this aligns with your expertise, please outline your proposed timeline and any similar migrations you have handled.

jobs.title: Elegant Product Showcase Posts

jobs.title: AWS Linux EC2 - Add Stable Remote GUI for remote connectivity
jobs.description:
I have multiple AWS EC2 Linux instance where I have configured a GUI/remote desktop setup that I access from my Mac using a Windows/remote desktop application.

The setup works fine initially, but after approximately **2 days, the remote desktop connection stops working**. Restarting the EC2 instance fixes the issue, and it works again for another couple of days.

I am looking for someone with strong **AWS + Linux + remote desktop/GUI infrastructure** experience to help with one of the following:

### Option 1: Root cause and fix my existing setup

* I can provide my existing AMI/setup.
* Investigate why the remote desktop service becomes unavailable after a couple of days.
* Identify the root cause and implement a permanent fix.

### Option 2: Provide a clean, stable AMI/setup

* Create or provide a Linux-based AMI with a stable GUI environment.
* I should be able to connect remotely using a standard remote desktop client by providing the hostname/IP and credentials.
* The setup should remain stable for long-term use without requiring periodic EC2 restarts.

### How I will evaluate the work

The task itself is relatively simple—I just don't have deep expertise in this specific area.

Once the setup is ready:

1. I will connect to the machine and run my scripts/workload.
2. I will check the remote connection periodically (approximately once per day).
3. If the setup remains stable and accessible for **6 consecutive days**, I will make the payment.

### When applying

Please provide a **clear technical plan**, including:

* What you think might be causing the current issue.
* How you plan to debug or solve it.
* Which remote desktop/GUI technology you recommend and why.
* How you will ensure the setup remains stable over time.
* Any assumptions or requirements from my side.

**Important:** Please do not send a generic AI-generated proposal listing common solutions that are readily available online. I have already tried several standard approaches. Generic proposals without understanding the problem will be ignored.

If you have relevant experience and a concrete technical approach, please reach out. Happy to discuss the details and finalize quickly.

jobs.title: Pengembangan Game Strategi Gems

jobs.title: iOS App Store Upload Help

jobs.title: Accelerate ROLLCALL A100 Pipeline
jobs.description:
I need an experienced PyTorch/CUDA engineer to squeeze every practical second out of our ROLLCALL Wan 2.2 I2V A14B inference pipeline running on an A100 80 GB while keeping the pictures looking exactly the same. Reducing processing time is the prime objective; any change that simply trades speed for a worse image will be rejected.

The first job is a deep profile. Please time each phase separately—model loading, T5/text encoding, VAE, diffusion, decoding, FFmpeg, and all inter-segment overhead—so I can see exactly where the pipeline stalls. From my own sampling it looks as if models may be re-opened for every 5-second chunk, so post-processing and segment overhead are the first areas I’d like you to attack.

Once the slow spots are confirmed, create a persistent warm-model worker where it makes sense, tune attention kernels and precision flags that are safe for this installation, and benchmark 20/24/30-step schedules against visual fidelity. Investigate torch.compile, FlashAttention, or similar only if the versions we use are stable today—no experimental branches in production.

All optimizations must preserve:
• The existing ROLLCALL API contract  
• Current segment checkpoint/recovery logic  

When you finish, deliver:
• A profiling report with the per-stage timings above  
• An optimized branch or patch set with clear toggles for your changes  
• End-to-end seconds-per-5-second-segment numbers for A100 plus an A100 vs H100/H200 cost-per-usable-second comparison (include GPU rental prices you used)  
• A short readme so another engineer can reproduce your results with the same Docker image

Acceptance is based on measured wall-clock improvement and maintained Gold-quality output, not synthetic benchmarks.
This video im including took 2.5 hours to make

Leverabler

Databas och backend konfigurerade
Administrationsgränssnitt för att hantera innehållet
Integration av min befintliga React-prototyp/design
Publicering på min domän
Grundläggande SEO och teknisk optimering

Källkod och full kontroll över projektet

Jag söker främst någon som är van vid React/Next.js, databaser och moderna webbapplikationer, och som kan hjälpa till att göra prototypen till en stabil, färdig produkt.

jobs.title: Site Verifier Needed in Dubai-UAE -- 4
jobs.description:
Confirmis (www.confirmis.com) is a Singapore-based business information provider specializing in connecting businesses with global capabilities; comprised of industry veterans, Confirmis's business model is designed to overcome perennial lack of data (let alone quality data) to support effective decision-making, particularly in developing economies. 

  

As a Site Verifier, you will be responsible for verifying a residence existence through visual data by conducting a site visit to ensure that we provide reliable and accurate information to our client. 

  

JOB DESCRIPTION: 

• Take pictures of the residence and its vicinity per Confirmis’ standard operating guidelines. 

• Take picture of the surrounding area and provide observation about the residence 

  

REQUIREMENTS: 

• Must be living in (or nearby) Al Fahidi Street, Dubai, United Arab Emirates 

 

• Has a camera or phone/tablet of quality with a camera, internet access 

• Must be available during business hours (9 AM - 4 PM) on working days 

  

Please see the attached file for the site visit guidelines. You are only required to deliver the pictures, video & observations and are not expected to assemble a report like the Sample Report. 

  

Note: 

- 1 city can only be taken by one freelancer (on a first-come, first-served basis) 

- The milestone will be released the following week (Monday) after the site visit to give us time to organize the report and contact you if we need additional clarification.

jobs.title: Basic JPEG Photo Touch-Ups
jobs.description:
I have a small set of JPEG photos—no more than ten—that simply need clean, consistent presentation. The job is limited to classic, “basic touch-up” work: cropping for better framing, straightening when needed, and resizing to the exact pixel dimensions I’ll provide once we start. No colour grading, skin retouching, or special effects are required; the images already look good, they just have to fit neatly into their new layout.

Photoshop, Affinity Photo, or any comparable editor that keeps JPEG quality intact is fine. Please save final files with minimal compression artefacts and keep the original filenames, adding “_edited” before the file extension.

Deliverables
• Up to 10 JPEGs, cropped, straightened, and resized to spec  
• Same images supplied at original resolution but uncropped, in case of later tweaks  
• A brief note outlining the steps taken (helps me replicate settings if more images come in)

I’ll share a cloud link to the source files the moment we agree. Turnaround within 24 hours would be ideal, but let me know realistically how fast you can deliver polished results.

jobs.title: Maintenance préventive IT complète
jobs.description:
J’ai besoin de mettre en place un programme de maintenance préventive pour l’ensemble de mon parc : ordinateurs de bureau, serveurs ainsi que le réseau et son infrastructure. L’objectif est simple : prévenir les pannes, garantir la disponibilité des services et prolonger la durée de vie du matériel.

Voici ce que j’attends :
• Élaboration d’un planning d’interventions régulières (contrôles, mises à jour système et sécurité, nettoyage matériel, vérification des sauvegardes).  
• Supervision proactive avec alertes en cas d’anomalie repérée.  
• Rapports synthétiques après chaque passage : opérations effectuées, état constaté, recommandations d’amélioration ou de remplacement.  
• Documentation claire pour que je puisse suivre l’historique des actions réalisées.

Votre expérience en maintenance préventive sur des environnements multi-équipements est le critère principal ; indiquez des exemples concrets de parcs comparables que vous avez déjà gérés. Une familiarité avec les bonnes pratiques ITIL, les scripts d’automatisation et les outils de monitoring courants sera un atout.

Je privilégie une collaboration à long terme : si la première phase se passe bien, nous pourrons étendre la mission et planifier des évolutions plus poussées.

jobs.title: Instagram Impersonation Investigator Needed
jobs.description:
Someone has set up a fake Instagram profile that uses my name, photos and bio. I need a seasoned online investigator who can quickly unmask whoever is running it and provide everything required for a platform takedown and, if feasible, potential legal action.

Here is what I expect:

• A clear investigation plan outlining the open-source intelligence, digital forensics or subpoena-ready methods you will apply. Common tools such as Maltego, Spiderfoot, reverse-image search engines, WHOIS/IP look-ups or any proprietary databases are welcome—explain which apply and why.

• Ongoing status updates so I know what leads are being followed, what data has been preserved, and where you need my input (screenshots, profile links, correspondence, etc.).

• A concise final bundle that includes:
  – A narrative report of your findings (timeline, linked accounts, probable real-world identity if discovered, confidence level).
  – Verifiable evidence files: screenshots with URLs/time stamps, archived HTML, metadata exports, and any traceable IP or device information.
  – Step-by-step guidance for filing the official impersonation complaint with Instagram and, if desired, law-enforcement or legal counsel.

The job is complete once the report and evidence package are delivered in a format suitable for court or platform review, and I can proceed confidently with the takedown.

Please tell me how soon you can start, estimated turnaround, and any similar cases you have successfully closed.

jobs.title: Launch MSLC Germany WordPress Site
jobs.description:
I already have the licensed WordPress theme, branding files, page mock-ups, and finalised English copy for MSLC Germany—now I need everything put together into a live, polished .de website.

What I will hand over:
• Figma/PSD page designs for every template
• Theme package with all required plugins
• Logo, colour palette, typography guidelines
• Approved English text for each section

What I need from you:
1. Register or connect a .de domain, set up hosting, point DNS, and install an SSL certificate. I’m flexible on provider—feel free to recommend the best balance of reliability, speed, and price (GoDaddy, SiteGround, Bluehost, or another you trust).
2. Install WordPress, apply the supplied theme, and reproduce my layouts pixel-perfectly across all breakpoints. No creative redesign; accuracy to the mocks is essential.
3. Build an SEO-friendly structure (clean permalinks, H-tag hierarchy, meta fields ready for Yoast/RankMath).  
4. Configure and style two forms—Contact and Quotation—so that submissions arrive in our mailbox and are stored in the dashboard.
5. Optimise performance (caching, image compression, security hardening) and confirm the site scores well on Google Lighthouse mobile and desktop.
6. Provide a short handover guide covering backups, updates, and how to edit content safely.

Acceptance criteria
• Every page matches the supplied design within a 5-pixel tolerance on desktop, tablet, and mobile.  
• Green padlock present and no mixed-content warnings.  
• Forms send confirmation emails to both admin and user.  
• Core Web Vitals in the green zone.  
• Site indexed correctly by Google Search Console after launch.

If this sounds straightforward for you, let me know your timeline, recommended host, and any questions about the assets.

jobs.title: Software Testing Consultant/Technical Mentor
jobs.description:
I’m putting together an intensive, live knowledge-transfer series for my QA and engineering teams and need a seasoned software-testing professional to guide us. Across several online sessions you will:

• Break down the full Software Testing Life Cycle and show how each phase works in the real world.  
• Deep-dive into the three areas that matter most to us right now—manual testing, automation testing and performance testing—using practical, team-ready examples.  
• Teach Selenium end-to-end: writing robust test scripts, weaving those scripts into a CI/CD pipeline, and sharing best-practice patterns that keep an automation suite maintainable.  
• Walk through requirement analysis, test planning, test-case design, execution and defect reporting inside an Agile/Scrum context, illustrating how you track everything in Jira.  
• Demonstrate essential tools: Postman for APIs, TestNG/JUnit for framework structure, and touch on Cypress or Playwright where it helps compare approaches.  
• Show at least one complete project—from first requirement to final report—so my team can see the entire flow in action.  
• Outline the typical QA team hierarchy, the skills each role needs, and give us a hiring and upskilling roadmap so we can ramp new testers quickly.  
• Finish with a Q&A that includes both management and hands-on engineers.

Deliverables  
1. Session agenda and slide deck.  
2. Recording of each live session.  
3. Sample Selenium framework with scripts and CI/CD config.  
4. Written roadmap for team structure, training and deployment.

If you have a track record of mentoring teams and can communicate complex testing concepts with clarity and energy, I’d love to collaborate and get these sessions scheduled.

jobs.title: Customized Sharetribe Marketplace Setup
jobs.description:
# Sharetribe Expert Needed — Poshmark-Style Marketplace

I am looking for an **experienced Sharetribe specialist** to configure and customize a niche product resale marketplace.

This is NOT a standard ecommerce website and I am NOT looking for a general WordPress, Shopify, or web designer.

I specifically want someone with **extensive hands-on Sharetribe marketplace experience** who understands its buyer/seller architecture, transaction processes, payments, commissions, profiles, listings, messaging, search and customization capabilities.

For purposes of describing the project publicly, assume the marketplace is for **watches**. The actual niche and complete specifications will be disclosed to the selected developer.

## Marketplace Concept

The marketplace should function similarly in concept to Poshmark:

Users can both **buy and sell** products.

A seller should be able to create an account, establish their own personal **Closet/Storefront**, upload products, manage listings, communicate with buyers, complete transactions and receive payouts.

Buyers should be able to browse the overall marketplace, search and filter products, view individual listings, visit a seller's Closet, communicate with sellers and purchase securely.

## Core Requirements

### Seller

A seller must be able to:

* Register/login
* Create a profile
* Have a public Closet/Storefront
* Upload multiple product photographs
* Create, edit and remove listings
* Enter custom product attributes
* Set prices
* Manage available and sold listings
* Receive buyer messages
* Manage orders/transactions
* Receive payouts
* Build ratings/reviews where supported

### Buyer

A buyer must be able to:

* Browse without necessarily registering first
* Search the marketplace
* Use multiple filters simultaneously
* View individual listings
* View seller profiles/Closets
* Message sellers
* Purchase securely
* View orders
* Leave ratings/reviews

Where practical within Sharetribe, I would also like:

* Favorites/likes
* Offers or price negotiation

## Seller Closet

This is important.

Every seller should have a public profile that functions like a small personal store or "Closet."

It should display:

* Seller profile
* Rating/reviews
* Current listings
* Sold/history information where appropriate

A buyer viewing an individual product should be able to click the seller and browse the seller's other available products.

## Listings and Search

The marketplace must support **custom listing fields and strong filtering**.

Using watches only as the public example, fields might include:

* Brand
* Model
* Category
* Size
* Style
* Color
* Condition
* Price

Buyers must be able to combine multiple filters.

The actual custom fields for the real marketplace will be supplied after selection.

## Marketplace Transactions

This must operate as a genuine multi-vendor marketplace.

I need:

* Buyer payments
* Seller transactions
* Platform commission
* Seller payouts
* Order/transaction status
* Transaction records
* Cancellation/refund process
* Marketplace messaging
* Reviews/ratings where supported

Please explain exactly how you would implement the payment, commission and payout flow using Sharetribe and Stripe.

## Homepage

The homepage should be modern, clean, highly visual and mobile-first.

It should contain approximately:

* Logo/navigation
* Large marketplace search
* Browse
* Sell
* How It Works
* Login/Signup
* Messages when logged in
* Favorites where supported
* Hero section
* Product categories
* Featured/new listings
* How the marketplace works
* Seller recruitment call-to-action
* Trust/payment information

The marketplace should feel like a modern consumer resale platform rather than a traditional online store.

## Mobile

Mobile usability is extremely important.

The complete buyer journey must work smoothly:

**Browse → Search → Listing → Seller Closet → Purchase**

The complete seller journey must also work smoothly:

**Sign Up → Create Profile → Upload Product → Publish Listing → Manage Sale → Receive Payout**

## Administration

I need appropriate Sharetribe administration capabilities for:

* Users
* Listings
* Transactions
* Commissions
* Reviews
* Marketplace content
* Problem/reported listings

## Future Expansion

The first version should remain economical.

However, I want an experienced Sharetribe developer who understands how the marketplace could later be extended with features such as:

* Likes/favorites
* Following sellers
* Offers/counteroffers
* Saved searches
* Bundles
* Notifications
* Featured/promoted listings
* Additional social marketplace functionality
* AI integrations
* Mobile applications

These advanced features are NOT necessarily part of the initial quotation.

I want the first version built correctly so the marketplace can be extended as it proves itself.

# WHO I AM LOOKING FOR

**Sharetribe expertise is the most important qualification.**

Please do NOT apply simply because you are an experienced general web developer.

When applying, please answer:

1. How many Sharetribe marketplaces have you personally built?
2. Please provide links to 2–3 LIVE Sharetribe marketplaces you personally worked on.
3. What exactly did you develop/customize on those marketplaces?
4. How many years have you worked with Sharetribe?
5. Have you implemented Sharetribe + Stripe marketplace transactions and seller payouts?
6. Have you created custom listing fields and advanced filters?
7. Have you customized Sharetribe's frontend/template?
8. Have you customized Sharetribe transaction processes?
9. Have you implemented offers/price negotiation?
10. Have you created or customized seller profile/storefront pages?
11. Can you extend Sharetribe using its APIs/custom code when necessary?
12. What Sharetribe plan would you recommend for this MVP and why?
13. Which requirements above are native Sharetribe, which require configuration, and which require custom development?
14. What would you estimate for development time and cost?

**Please begin your proposal with the words "SHARETRIBE EXPERT" and include links to your Sharetribe work.**

Generic proposals without demonstrated Sharetribe marketplace experience will not be considered.

The complete product niche, branding, domain and detailed specifications will be disclosed only to the selected developer.

jobs.title: Power Plant Drawings Consultation
jobs.description:
I am midway through constructing a power-generation facility and need a seasoned engineer to sit with me (virtually) and go over the working drawings. The focus spans mechanical systems, civil works, and instrumentation layouts, so broad plant experience is essential.  

My immediate need is twofold:  
• Review the issued-for-construction drawings and flag anything that could compromise operability, safety, or compliance.  
• Engage in live technical discussions—screen-sharing or red-lined PDFs are fine—so I can understand the rationale behind any recommended changes.

Typical sessions will cover piping and equipment GA’s, structural foundations, cable routing, loop diagrams, and interface points with existing utilities. 

Acceptance will be based on the clarity of comments, practical feasibility of your solutions, and how well they align with common plant codes (ASME, AISC, IEC/ISA, etc.).

If this matches your skill set and schedule, let’s arrange an initial session to set priorities and cadence.

jobs.title: 3D Earth Educational Animation
jobs.description:
I want to create a polished 3-dimensional animation of the Earth that serves a clear, adult-focused educational purpose. The video will be used in an online learning module, so scientific accuracy, smooth motion, and professional visual style are critical.  

You will take my outline of teaching points—planetary layers, rotation, orbit, and climate zones—and translate them into an engaging animation complete with clean text call-outs and subtle infographic overlays. Feel free to recommend pacing, camera moves, and visual motifs that keep a mature audience interested without feeling gimmicky.

The final deliverable should include:
• A full-resolution 3D animation file ready for streaming (1080p or better)  
• All project assets and source files so I can update facts later  
• A version with and without embedded voice-over so narration can be added in post

Please keep renders optimized for smooth playback on standard web platforms, and use industry-standard tools such as Blender, Cinema 4D, Maya, or equivalent—whichever you prefer. If you need clarification on the teaching outline, message me early so we can lock the storyboard before production begins.

jobs.title: Excel Text Data Entry
jobs.description:
I have a collection of Excel files that contain purely textual information. I need every record transferred into a single master workbook, keeping the existing column structure and formatting consistent across all sheets. The task is straightforward: open each source file, copy the text into the correct columns of the master file I’ll provide, and tidy up as you go—remove blank rows, fix obvious typos, and flag any missing or unclear entries.

Accuracy is non-negotiable, so please work carefully and double-check before saving. I will run random spot-checks, and payment will be released once the final workbook passes those checks.

Deliverables
• Completed master Excel workbook with all text records correctly placed and uniformly formatted  
• Brief summary of any anomalies, duplicates, or gaps you discovered during the process

If you have solid experience with Excel data entry and can turn this around quickly, I’d love to get started right away.

jobs.title: Enchanté Company Logo Design
jobs.description:
I’m launching a new brand called “Enchanté” and need a versatile, memorable logo that captures its refined yet welcoming spirit. I haven’t locked myself into a particular style, colour palette, or symbol, so you’ll have genuine creative freedom—surprise me with something fresh that still feels elegant and timeless.

What matters most is a mark that works just as well on a storefront sign as it does on stationery, social media avatars, and product packaging. Please supply the finished logo in  • vector formats (AI & SVG) for scalability  • PNG/JPEG for quick use  • a version that holds up in black-and-white

If you’d like to add a brief style guide (typefaces, colours, spacing) for consistency, that’s a plus.

I’m ready to review concepts quickly and give clear feedback so we can iterate toward a final design that both of us will be proud of.

jobs.title: Minimalist Haider Logo
jobs.description:
I’m after a clean, understated logo that pairs the word “Haider” with a simple, memorable icon. The overall feel should be minimalist—no clutter, no unnecessary flourishes—just a smart combination mark that works at any size, from a website header down to a social-media avatar.

Style  
• The design must be a true combination of text and icon, with both elements able to stand alone when needed.  
• Please keep line weights balanced and avoid gradients or complex shading so the mark reproduces flawlessly in one-color applications.

Color  
I’m wide open on palette. If black-and-white suits the concept best, go for it; if a subtle accent hue elevates the icon, I’m happy to explore options. Just make sure the logo remains strong and recognisable even when converted to pure monochrome.

Deliverables  
• Editable vector file (AI or SVG)  
• High-resolution PNG on transparent background  
• A quick style sheet showing color codes and typeface used

I’ll provide prompt feedback on sketches, so feel free to share early roughs before polishing the final artwork. Looking forward to seeing your minimalist take on the Haider identity.

jobs.title: Victorian Tragic Romance Story
jobs.description:
I need an original romance set firmly in the Victorian era, steeped in the social restraints, class distinctions, and atmospheric settings of the period. The plot should build toward a genuinely tragic, emotionally charged conclusion rather than a happy ending, so I expect dramatic stakes, nuanced characters, and period-authentic detail woven naturally into dialogue, customs, and scenery.

Please craft a complete short story (roughly 6 000–8 000 words is ideal, though I’m flexible if the narrative demands slightly more or less). The focus should stay on the central love story, yet supporting characters and subplots are welcome so long as they heighten the inevitable calamity. I value historical accuracy—think proper etiquette, clothing, transportation, and social issues of the 19th-century United Kingdom—without slowing the pacing.

Deliverable:
• Polished manuscript in Word or Google Doc, ready for a light copy-edit only.  
• Brief, one-paragraph synopsis highlighting setting, protagonists, and the tragic climax.

Acceptance criteria:
• Victorian setting feels authentic; no anachronisms.  
• Romance is the clear spine of the story and ends tragically.  
• Tone remains dramatic throughout, without veering into comedy or modern slang.  
• Original work; I will check for plagiarism.

If previous samples of historical fiction are available, sharing one will help me gauge style, but it’s optional. I’m eager to collaborate quickly and will provide timely feedback on outlines or drafts.

jobs.title: SEO Traffic Growth Management
jobs.description:
My top priority is bringing a steady stream of new visitors to my site, and I’m ready to hand the SEO workload to a specialist who can make that happen. The focus begins with solid keyword research that will underpin every optimisation move we take next.  

Scope  
• Conduct deep keyword research specifically aimed at traffic growth, covering all three engines I rely on—Google, Bing and Yahoo.  
• Deliver an organised keyword list that includes search volume, difficulty, intent classification and quick-win opportunities.  
• Provide a concise strategic brief explaining how these terms can be integrated into current pages and future content.

Acceptance criteria  
1. At least 150 actionable keywords, segmented by intent (informational, commercial, transactional).  
2. Data source for search volume and difficulty clearly cited for each term.  
3. Recommendations submitted in an editable spreadsheet plus a one-page summary outlining next steps to turn research into traffic gains.

Once this foundation is in place, I’m open to continuing collaboration for on-page work, but the immediate deliverable is the keyword research package described above.

jobs.title: Educational Notes Rewriting Project
jobs.description:
I have a collection of more than fifty educational notes that need a fresh, polished rewrite. The originals are already organized by topic, but the language is uneven and occasionally repetitive. Your task is to transform each note into clear, concise prose that is easy to read and free of grammatical errors while preserving every key idea and fact.

The material is strictly educational, so accuracy matters more than style flair; however, I still want an engaging tone that keeps readers interested. Citations, figures, or formulas—when they appear—must stay intact and correctly formatted.  

Here is what I’ll deliver to you:
• A folder containing all current notes in Word format  
• A simple naming convention so drafts never get mixed up  

And here is what I expect back:
• Fifty-plus rewritten files, returned in the same format and naming structure  
• Consistent voice and terminology throughout the set  
• Final content that passes both Grammarly and a standard plagiarism scan  

If you have experience rewriting textbooks, lesson plans, or study guides, that will help you move quickly through the material. Let me know your turnaround time for the first ten notes so I can gauge pace before we proceed with the rest.

jobs.title: Plain Text Email Data Entry
jobs.description:
I have a backlog of plain-text emails that need to be turned into clean, structured records. For every message you’ll copy the required fields—names, dates, reference numbers, and any other key details—into a shared spreadsheet, then run a quick web search whenever information is missing or needs confirmation. Accuracy and consistency matter more than speed, but I’d still like to see steady daily progress so we can wrap this up on schedule.

Deliverables
• A spreadsheet (Excel or Google Sheets) with one fully completed row per email  
• Verified data points for each entry, cross-checked via web search  
• A brief status note at the end of each workday highlighting issues or ambiguities

Acceptance criteria
All emails processed, no empty mandatory fields, and every web-verified fact linked to its public source.

If you’re comfortable navigating large volumes of text-only email threads and double-checking details online, I’m ready to get started right away.

jobs.title: Financial Reporting Controls Audit
jobs.description:
I am looking for a qualified auditor to independently test the design and operating effectiveness of our internal controls over financial reporting (ICFR). The entire engagement will be handled remotely through a secure portal, so you must be comfortable collaborating online, requesting evidence, and maintaining strict confidentiality throughout the process.

Scope of work
We have already mapped our key processes and drafted a risk-control matrix. Your task is to:
• Validate those controls through walkthroughs and sample-based testing  
• Prepare clear working papers that meet SOX/PCAOB documentation standards  
• Highlight control gaps, quantify potential misstatement risk, and propose practical remediation steps  
• Deliver a concise final report that management can share with our external auditors

Although this assignment centres on financial-reporting controls, the ability to comment on adjacent operational or compliance controls is a plus.

Tools & frameworks you should know
COSO, SOX-404, GAAP/IFRS, and common ERP environments (e.g., SAP, Oracle). Proficiency with Excel, ACL/IDEA, or similar data-analysis tools will help you work efficiently with our datasets.

What to include in your bid
Tell me about your experience performing ICFR or SOX audits—industry, company size, and any successful remediation projects. Please focus on relevant engagements rather than generic résumés; I want to see a brief snapshot of comparable work and the value you added.

Deliverables will be accepted once working papers are complete, findings are agreed upon, and the final report is signed off by management. I’m ready to start as soon as I find the right expertise, so let me know how quickly you can mobilise.

jobs.title: Klaviyo Campaign & Workflow Expert - 23/08/2026 07:22 EDT
jobs.description:
Our Klaviyo account is already live, but I want to take it further. I need a specialist who can jump straight in, set up high-converting promotional email campaigns, build (or refine) the accompanying automation workflows, and make sure our data flows cleanly so we can track revenue and engagement with confidence.

Here is what I’m looking for:

• Email Campaign Setup – From concept to final send, including segmenting the right audiences and creating reusable templates that feel on-brand.  
• Automation Workflows – Welcome, browse-abandon, win-back, and any other sequences you believe will lift our sales.  
• Data Integration & Analytics – Ensure events, custom properties, and ecommerce data are mapped correctly, then surface clear metrics so I can see performance at a glance.

Everything is already connected inside Klaviyo, so there’s no need for account creation—just optimisation and execution. If you’re comfortable diving straight into an existing setup and can show proven wins with promotional campaigns, let’s talk deliverables and timelines.

jobs.title: Professional UGC Photographer Needed
jobs.description:
I'm looking for a skilled photographer to create high-quality product review content for our brand. 

Requirements:
- Focused on product reviews
- Style should be professional and polished
- Ability to work from a rough outline and develop a detailed guideline

Ideal Skills and Experience:
- Experience in UGC content creation
- Strong photography skills with a professional touch
- Ability to translate rough outlines into detailed, engaging content
- Previous work in lifestyle or product review photography

Please share your portfolio and relevant experience.

jobs.title: Improve RTMP/SRT-to-UDP Interface
jobs.description:
I have a web-based React UI that lets users push RTMP or SRT streams and relay them out over UDP. The core streaming logic works well; what I need now is a smoother, more intuitive user experience.  

You’ll be working directly in the existing React codebase, tightening up layout, navigation and form handling so that broadcasters can set up and monitor their stream paths in fewer clicks and with clearer feedback. Stream status, error reporting and bitrate indicators should be immediately obvious even on a busy control screen, and the whole interface must stay responsive while high-bitrate traffic rolls in the background.

Feel free to suggest small bug fixes or incremental features if they naturally surface during the UX pass, but the primary deliverable is a polished, production-ready front end that makes configuring “RTMP/SRT in → UDP out” feel effortless for both desktop and tablet users.

Deliverables  
• Updated React components and styling  
• Any new hooks, context or state management additions documented in-code  
• A short README outlining setup steps and the UX changes implemented  
• Final build that passes a quick usability walkthrough with my test streams (Chrome and Firefox)

If this sounds like the kind of focused UI refinement you enjoy, let’s talk.

jobs.title: Niche Guest Post Backlinks
jobs.description:
I need a reliable partner who can secure guest-post backlinks for me exclusively on niche blogs that are genuinely relevant to my site’s topic. I am not interested in broad, general outlets; the closer the blog’s audience and content are to my niche, the better.  

Here’s what I expect as the final hand-off:  
• A live guest post on each agreed niche site containing one do-follow backlink to my page  
• Original, well-written content (800+ words) that blends naturally with the host blog’s tone  
• A short report with the URL, publication date, anchor text used, and basic metrics (DA, organic traffic) so I can track performance  

Please let me know how many placements you can deliver, examples of comparable posts you’ve secured, and your typical turnaround time for publication.

jobs.title: Ladakh Expedition Book Design & Editing
jobs.description:
Hi, I’m looking for a professional book editor and book designer/typesetter for a travel and motorcycle expedition handbook I have written.

The project is titled:

THE ULTIMATE LADAKH EXPEDITION
The Complete Rider’s Handbook

Uncharted Himalayas · Volume 1
Ladakh: Beyond the Passes
The Kora Expedition

The manuscript is currently handwritten in an A5 spiral notebook, and I need someone to professionally turn it into a finished, publication-quality book.

This is not simply an itinerary. It is a combination of a motorcycle expedition handbook, travel narrative, field journal, and photographic travel book, documenting my 12-day solo motorcycle journey through Zanskar and Ladakh.

What I need

1. Manuscript editing

Transcribe my handwritten manuscript into digital text
Correct grammar, spelling, punctuation and sentence structure
Improve readability and flow without changing my voice or personal experiences
Keep the writing authentic and personal
Fact-check obvious geographical/place-name inconsistencies where necessary
Maintain consistency in names, spellings, measurements and terminology throughout the book

2. Book design & page setup

Professional interior layout and typography
Consistent chapter/day layouts
Page hierarchy, headings, quotes, route information, ride statistics and field notes
Photo placement and captions
Maps/route graphics where required
Clean, premium travel-book aesthetic
Print-ready final files

The book is intended to feel closer to a premium adventure/travel publication than a conventional Word document.

I already have a fairly developed structure and visual direction, so I am not looking for someone to completely redesign the concept from scratch. I want a professional designer who can take the existing concept and elevate it to publication quality.

3. Cover design
I also need a professional front cover, back cover and spine, based on the existing Uncharted Himalayas / Ladakh: Beyond the Passes / The Kora Expedition branding.

Current project
Approximately 90 pages or less
A5 format
Travel/adventure publication
Solo motorcycle expedition
Photography from the actual journey
Manuscript and visual direction already prepared
Final output should be suitable for professional printing and potentially self-publishing

I am looking for someone who has actual experience designing books, particularly travel books, coffee-table books, adventure publications, magazines or similar editorial projects.

Please send me:

Examples of books you have designed
Your experience with editing handwritten manuscripts
Your proposed workflow for this project
Estimated timeline
Your total project fee
What files you will provide at the end, including editable/source files
Whether you can handle both editing and complete book design, or only the design/typesetting portion

•	Ensure smooth, on-cue transitions between the intro, ad reads, segments, and wrap-up.
•	Keep the conversation firmly on track in alignment with the provided run sheet.
•	Troubleshoot minor technical issues independently if they pop up during recording.
•	Maintain a consistently upbeat, professional tone from start to finish.

Technical & Environment Requirements (Must-Haves):
•	A dedicated, noise-free environment where you can sit comfortably and conduct distraction-free video interviews.
•	Proficiency with remote recording tools, specifically Riverside.fm (or identical browser-based studio platforms).
•	Own your own professional studio gear. You must already possess high-quality hardware. Please note: We do not supply or arrange hardware for this remote role.
•	Camera Resolution: Ideally a 4K camera setup, though a crisp, high-quality 1080p stream is acceptable.
•	Audio Quality: A high-quality, professional microphone setup with clean, broadcast-ready sound.
•	Studio Setup: Hands-on experience configuring your own studio lighting, framing your camera, and dialing in your microphone settings.

Business Knowledge Requirements (Must-Haves):
•	Deep Business Acumen: Good knowledge of SaaS, B2B, and Agency business models.
•	Startup Ecosystem Familiarity: Solid understanding of startup funding rounds (Seed through Series), venture capital (VCs), and growth metrics, allowing you to hold high-level, fluent conversations with industry founders and investors.

Workflow & Support:
We’ll supply the run sheet, guest bios, talking points, and all other relevant prep materials. For each episode, you will join a quick prep call, moderate the live recording, and then send us a brief timestamp sheet of any necessary edit notes immediately afterward.

How to Apply:
To be considered, please include:
1.	A short video or audio clip that demonstrates your natural U.S. accent, audio quality, and camera setup.
2.	A few lines about business podcasts you have moderated or hosted in the past.
We're excited to hear how you can keep our conversations lively, focused, and professional!

jobs.title: Admin Chat Layanan Pelanggan
jobs.description:
Saya membutuhkan tenaga remote yang mampu membalas pesan pelanggan melalui WhatsApp dan Telegram. Tujuan utamanya adalah menjaga kepuasan pelanggan—menjawab pertanyaan, membantu pemesanan, serta menyelesaikan keluhan secara ramah dan tepat waktu.   

Yang sudah tersedia:  
• Panduan serta skrip balasan untuk skenario umum.  
• Akses akun WhatsApp & Telegram bisnis.  

Tugas inti Anda:  
1. Mengikuti skrip yang ada sembari menyesuaikan nada agar terasa personal.  
2. Merespons setiap chat dalam waktu maksimal 5 menit pada jam kerja yang kita sepakati.  
3. Mencatat isu yang sering muncul dan meneruskannya ke tim terkait.  
4. Membuat rekap harian singkat (jumlah chat masuk, selesai, dan eskalasi).  

Kualifikasi yang saya cari:  
• Fasih berbahasa Indonesia tertulis dengan tata bahasa yang baik.  
• Terbiasa multitasking di aplikasi pesan instan.  
• Teliti, sabar, dan memiliki empati tinggi dalam menghadapi pelanggan.  

Beritahu saya ketersediaan waktu harian Anda dan pengalaman relevan menangani customer service chat. Saya menantikan kerja sama yang membantu pelanggan kami merasa didengar dan terbantu.

jobs.title: Urgent USPTO Renewal Filing
jobs.description:
My U.S. trademark renewal is due right away and I want the TEAS renewal paperwork filed correctly today for a flat A$150. I will supply the current registration number and any specimens you ask for, but I expect you to prepare the forms, check that every required interval (§8 and, if applicable, §15) is met, and lodge the filing through the USPTO portal.  

What I need from you  
• Draft and review the TEAS Section 8 (and Section 15, if eligible) renewal application  
• Confirm classes and goods/services wording remain compliant  
• Upload acceptable specimens or advise if new ones are needed  
• File through USPTO and send me the confirmation receipt plus the PDF of the final submission  

Acceptance will be based on the official USPTO email showing the filing fee paid and the renewal successfully submitted, together with a brief summary of next steps or possible office-action triggers.

Experience with USPTO filings and solid knowledge of TEAS is essential because timing is critical.

jobs.title: Corporate Instagram & Web Graphics
jobs.description:
I’m refreshing the visual presence of my Android app, its accompanying website, and our Instagram feed, and I need a designer who can create a cohesive suite of assets in a polished, corporate-and-professional style.  

The scope covers three concrete deliverables:  
• Banners for the website and in-app promos  
• Instagram post templates that align with brand guidelines  
• Instagram story graphics optimised for mobile ratios  

You’ll receive our logo, colour palette, fonts, and sample copy on day one. I’d like initial concepts within two weeks so we have time for a feedback round, and final, layered source files (PSD or AI) plus ready-to-publish PNG/JPG exports no later than one month from project start.  

Consistency across platforms is key, so please have an eye for typography and spacing, and feel comfortable preparing assets at multiple resolutions. If you’ve handled similar multi-platform brand work, include a link or two—seeing past banner, post, and story sets will help me decide quickly. I’m ready to start as soon as I find the right fit.

jobs.title: Automated Playing Card Alignment
jobs.description:
Looking for a reliable Photoshop freelancer to batch-layout a 44-card custom deck.
​All creative artwork, symbols, text, and a locked master.PSD template are 100% complete. This is strictly a repetitive production and alignment task—no original illustration or design creation required.
​Scope of Work:
​Insert the provided artwork and symbols into the master .PSD template.
​Ensure all symbols and images are the exact same size, uniformly scaled, and perfectly aligned across every single card.
​Maintain identical margins and borders across the entire deck.
​Apply the exact same text styling process (matching font, font size, tracking, and text positioning from the master template for every card title).
​Batch export the final deck to print-ready high-resolution files (300 DPI, CMYK PDFs/TIFFs) and return the updated layered .PSD files.
​Requirements:
​Proficient in Adobe Photoshop.
​High attention to detail with spacing, alignment, and consistency.
​A 2–3 card sample will be reviewed and approved first before completing the full batch.

jobs.title: Classic Ring CAD Modelling
jobs.description:
I have a set of ring designs in mind and need them converted into precise, print-ready CAD files. The look is unmistakably classic—timeless profiles, balanced proportions, and clean detailing—so the modelling must capture subtle curvature and stone settings with manufacturing accuracy.

Your task is to translate my sketches and reference photos into watertight 3D models suitable for direct resin printing and investment casting. I’m comfortable working in Rhino, MatrixGold, or similar jewellery-focused platforms, as long as the final deliverables meet professional tolerances.

Deliverables
• Editable source file (3DM or equivalent)  
• High-resolution STL ready for 3D printing  
• Rendered previews for approval

Acceptance criteria: dimensions match the provided spec sheet within ±0.05 mm; prong thickness, seat depth, and minimum wall requirements follow standard casting guidelines; all surfaces are manifold with no non-uniform scaling.

When you submit your bid, focus on your experience crafting production-ready ring models—screenshots or links welcome. No lengthy proposal needed; a concise overview of relevant projects and tooling expertise is ideal. I’ll share sketches, finger sizes, and gemstone measurements once we agree to proceed.

jobs.title: Transcribe Handwritten Notes to Word
jobs.description:
I have a collection of scanned handwritten pages that I now need in an editable Microsoft Word file. Every sentence, heading, and bullet must be captured accurately and laid out so the finished document is clean and professional—ready for printing or further editing.

You will receive high-resolution JPEG or PDF images of the notes. Simply type what you see into Word, preserving any underlining, basic headings, and line breaks. If you come across the occasional simple table, chart, or equation, lay it out in Word as faithfully as possible; if something is unclear, flag it with a comment so I can clarify.

Deliverables  
• A single, proof-read .docx file that mirrors the handwritten content  
• A brief list of any uncertainties or illegible sections you flagged  

Accuracy is more important than speed, but please tell me how many pages you can reliably handle per day and your estimated turnaround once you see the sample set.

jobs.title: Fast Data Entry Task
jobs.description:
A batch of raw information needs to be transferred from its current mixed sources into a clean, well-structured file that I can work with immediately. Accuracy, neat formatting, and a quick turnaround matter more to me than the size of the team or the tools you prefer, as long as the final file opens flawlessly in Excel or any standard CSV reader.

All fields must be entered exactly as they appear in the originals, with consistent date and number formatting throughout. Duplicates should be flagged, obvious errors highlighted, and any unreadable entries noted rather than guessed at. I will share the files and a short field-mapping guide once we agree on the start time.

Please include in your proposal:
• an estimated completion time for a typical 1,000-row batch,  
• the quality-control steps you normally use to ensure perfect copy, and  
• a quick note on the software you trust most for data validation—whether it’s Excel, Google Sheets, LibreOffice, or a Python script.

Deliver the finished, cleaned file plus your QC log, and the job is done.

jobs.title: AutoCAD Metal Flashing Detail Sketch -- 2
jobs.description:
I need a set of clearly annotated flashing details for several metal roofing and wall-siding profiles recreated in AutoCAD. The final file has to be a clean, layer-organised DWG that shows each break, bend, hem, and fastener location at a scale that will print legibly on 11"x17". All critical dimensions—overall lengths, leg heights, overlap zones, sealant beds, screw spacings—must be called out so our fabrication team can pull exact measurements straight from the drawing.

Source material will be PDFs and manufacturer cut-sheets; I will forward those as soon as we start. Line weights, text style (RomanS 3/32"), and colour coding need to follow the simple CAD standard I’ll share.

Deliverables
• One AutoCAD 2018-compatible DWG with all flashing details on individual layouts  
• An exported PDF sheet set for quick shop reference

I’ll review for dimensional accuracy, layer management, and overall clarity; once those boxes are ticked the job is done.

jobs.title: Commercial EV Charging Concept Schematics
jobs.description:
I’m upgrading five separate commercial sites to support more than five Level 2 electric vehicle chargers in each car park and need clear, professional concept plans to move the projects forward.

What I’m after  
• A site-specific concept drawing package for each property showing proposed charger locations, conduit routes, panel connections and a clean single-line schematic.  
• Basic load calculations and any transformer or switchboard upgrades that the concept requires.  
• A brief narrative per site explaining assumptions, code references and next-step recommendations so my facilities team can present the plan to local utilities and obtain detailed quotes.

File format  
PDF for easy sharing plus the editable source (AutoCAD or Revit—whichever you’re most comfortable with).

Acceptance  
Drawings must be legible at A3, reflect standard electrical symbols, and align with NEC/IEC guidelines for Level 2 commercial installations. I’ll review one property first; once that layout is approved, you can roll the logic into the remaining four.

Work needs to be completed by 3rd September, firm deadline. Thank you.

jobs.title: Multi-Floor Indoor Navigation Engine
jobs.description:
I need our raw CAD or PDF floor plans transformed into a structured 2D/3D indoor map that spans several levels of a very large venue. Once the mapping layer is ready, the next step is to build a positioning and navigation engine that relies on BLE beacons blended with the phone’s accelerometer, gyroscope and compass so users see their live position and heading with high reliability.

The core of the assignment is the SDK/API itself; later we will drop it into an Android app, so please architect everything with clean interfaces, documented calls and minimal external dependencies. Accuracy, fast initial fix, and smooth hand-offs between floors are crucial. Stairs, elevators, escalators, corridors, gates and individual rooms must all be routable, and the engine should always calculate the optimal path, then automatically reroute if a visitor strays.

Deliverables
• Parsed and structured multi-floor map (2D & 3D layers) generated from the supplied plans  
• BLE-sensor-fusion positioning module showing real-time location & orientation  
• Turn-by-turn routing with dynamic reroute logic across floors and vertical connectors  
• Well-documented SDK/API ready for integration into an Android project, including sample code and test data  
• Build/usage instructions plus brief report on achieved accuracy and recommended beacon layout  

I’ll provide all source plans and any additional environment details once we start; you package a robust, extensible indoor navigation solution that scales.

jobs.title: Vue 3 Node.js Full-Stack Build
jobs.description:
I’m launching a web application that will run on a modern Vue 3 front-end, a Node.js (Express) back-end, and a MySQL database. I already have the core idea and wireframes; what I need now is a developer who can take the project from “local prototype” to a production-ready release.

Here’s the scope as I see it:
• Set up the project structure, configure Vite (or similar) for the Vue layer, and establish a clean component architecture.  
• Build RESTful (or GraphQL, if you prefer) endpoints in Node.js, handling business logic, validation, and security best practices such as JWT or session-based auth.  
• Design and migrate the MySQL schema, create efficient queries, and help me plan for future scaling.  
• Integrate the three layers seamlessly so the front-end consumes your APIs with minimal latency.  
• Add unit and integration tests; a basic CI script is a plus.  
• Supply clear README-level instructions so I can spin everything up locally or on my chosen cloud host.

I’m hands-on and will review PRs daily. You can suggest libraries and tooling—as long as decisions are explained and documented, I’m flexible. Let me know your approach, a realistic timeline, and a link to code samples that show similar stacks.

jobs.title: Online Personal Assistant / 在线个人助理
jobs.description:
Personal assistant required for a foreigner living in China. 
需要一名私人助理，为在中国居住的外国人服务。
Pay per task completion use of online applications
按任务完成支付在线应用的使用费。

The candidate should be comfortable handling private/sensitive information

jobs.title: Spice Export Sales and Sourcing Specialist
jobs.description:
