jobs.title: Colorful Single-Page Support Website Build
jobs.description:
I need a vibrant, single-page site that makes it effortless for visitors to reach us and get the answers they need. The page’s core purpose is customer support, so every element should guide users toward real-time help or clear information.

Key features to include  
• Live-chat module linked to our support agents—fast, reliable, and styled to match the page’s colorful look.  
• Compact chatbot panel where users can type questions and receive guidance on our services and menu prices before choosing to start a full live chat.  
• Prominent “Tap to Call” button that instantly launches a phone call on mobile devices, sitting next to the chat trigger for an easy choice of contact method.  
• Dynamic menu section: visually appealing price cards that auto-update from a simple JSON or Google Sheet so we can edit prices without touching code.  
• Smooth, scroll-anchored layout with lively color accents, subtle animations, and responsive behavior across desktop, tablet, and mobile.  

I’ll supply branding colors, copy, and the menu data once we get started; you handle the design, front-end build, and live-chat integration. A quick hand-off document showing where to update prices and contact details finishes the job.

jobs.title: MVP Social App Development
jobs.description:
I’m ready to move from sketches and wireframes to a working MVP for a brand-new social networking app on both iOS and Android. The very first release is intentionally lean: the only functional pillar I need right now is a robust User Profile module.

Here’s what that profile must support from day one:
• Profile picture upload and display  
• A short bio or description field users can edit at any time  
• A Friends / Followers list that shows mutual connections in real time  

Access to the app will rely solely on a classic email-and-password flow—for now I’m not adding social logins or phone verification, but the codebase should be flexible enough to accommodate those later.

On the back end I’ll need secure user management, basic analytics hooks, and an admin panel that lets me view, search, and deactivate accounts. Everything should be wired for easy deployment to the App Store and Google Play once the MVP is approved.

Please tell me which cross-platform stack you prefer and how you would structure the database and API. A concise roadmap, milestone breakdown, and quick note on how you handle post-launch bug fixes will help me choose the right partner.

jobs.title: Google & Meta Ads Sales Boost
jobs.description:
My immediate focus is on turning Google Ads and Meta Ads into reliable sales engines. I already have active accounts and tracking in place, but results are flat. I’d like you to dive into the data, spot the wasted spend, and rebuild the structure so every rupee pushes us closer to a purchase.

What I need from you  
• A clear, performance-driven campaign structure in Google Ads and Meta Ads Manager that aligns with our sales targets  
• Compelling ad copy, creative variations, and audience setups tested and refined until cost-per-sale drops and volume rises  
• Conversion-focused landing page tips (or quick edits in WordPress if you’re comfortable) that ensure ad clicks turn into check-outs  
• Weekly Excel-based reports that highlight key metrics, wins, and next steps

Alongside the ads work, being able to hop into Google Analytics, pull insights, and suggest tweaks to our broader channels—SEO, social media, email—will be an advantage. Familiarity with Canva or Photoshop for fast creative edits, plus the occasional short-form video or reel, would make collaboration smoother, but the number-one priority remains sales growth through paid traffic.

Success looks like this: reduced acquisition cost, a steady climb in transactions, and crystal-clear reporting that shows how every change moved the needle. If you’re confident you can deliver that, I’m ready to get started right away.

jobs.title: AI-Powered Ticketing Platform Issue Fixes
jobs.description: Resolve approximately 200 issues on an AI-powered ticketing platform to make it production-ready. No new features are required, but additional issues encountered along the way should be addressed. The timeline is 4–5 weeks.

jobs.title: Minimalist Pendant Necklace CAD Modeling
jobs.description:
I am developing a clean, minimalist pendant necklace collection and need precise 3D CAD files that are ready for both renderings and manufacturing. The focus is on elegant geometry with no ornate flourishes—think subtle curves, balanced proportions, and smooth surfaces that translate well to precious-metal casting.

You’ll receive my hand-sketches and basic dimensions; your task is to translate them into a fully detailed digital model, refine tolerances for typical fine-jewellery production, and supply high-resolution renders so I can review every angle before we move to prototyping. I’m comfortable with you working in Rhino, MatrixGold, or another professional jewellery CAD package as long as the final files arrive in STL for printing and 3DM or STEP for any further edits.

Deliverables:
• Finished 3D CAD model of the pendant and integrated chain loop  
• STL file optimized for 0.03 mm print accuracy  
• Native design file (3DM or comparable) with clean, editable history  
• Two beauty renders (front and perspective) on a neutral background  

I’ll provide prompt feedback, so good communication and quick iteration turnarounds will be appreciated. Let me know your preferred software and any similar minimalist pieces you’ve modelled, and we can start right away.

jobs.title: Romantic Short Story Writer Needed
jobs.description:
I’m putting together a fresh, engaging romance short story and need a creative writer who can bring heartfelt characters, believable dialogue, and an emotionally satisfying arc to the page. The final piece should read smoothly from the opening hook to the closing line, leaving the reader feeling invested and uplifted.

Here’s what I need from you:  
• A complete, original short story in the romance genre (no excerpts or unfinished drafts).  
• A clear beginning, middle, and end with realistic stakes and a payoff that resonates.  
• Polished prose free of grammatical errors—ready for publication or immediate sharing.

If you enjoy crafting tender moments, subtle tension, and memorable characters, let’s collaborate. When you send your proposal, please include a short sample of previous romance work (or any creative fiction that shows your style) so I can see how your voice fits the tone I’m after.

I’m happy to discuss preferred length, sub-themes, or any specific twists you’d like to explore once we start. Let’s create something readers won’t want to put down.

jobs.title: Urgent Personal Notes Typing Needed
jobs.description:
I have between one and ten pages of handwritten personal notes that I need typed up as quickly as possible. Although the text itself is straightforward, several headings, underlines, and margin remarks must be preserved exactly as they appear on the page, so close attention to detail and accurate formatting are essential.

I will scan the pages and send them to you immediately after we start. You can return the work in Word or Google Docs—whichever you prefer—as long as the final file keeps the original structure intact and is 100 % error-free. Fast turnaround is my top priority; let me know how soon you can deliver once you receive the scans.

jobs.title: One-Day Modern Portfolio Website Build
jobs.description:
I need a developer who can replicate the clean, fast-loading look and flow of http://lummenmedia.com/ for me in just 24 hours. The site’s sole purpose is to showcase my portfolio, so every section should revolve around my work samples while keeping a modern, minimalistic aesthetic.

Essential features
• Responsive photo gallery that I can expand later  
• Space for client testimonials that can be edited from the back-end  
• Simple contact form routed to my email (with basic spam protection)

You’re free to use WordPress, Webflow, custom HTML/CSS/JS, or another framework—whichever lets you hit the one-day deadline without sacrificing polish. The finished product must load quickly on mobile and desktop, be SEO-friendly out of the box, and come with clear instructions for updating images, copy, and testimonials myself.

Deliverables
1. Fully functional website deployed to my hosting and domain  
2. All source files and assets handed over  
3. Brief hand-off guide (PDF or video) showing how to add new portfolio pieces, edit testimonials, and change contact-form settings

I’m ready to supply logos, images, and copy as soon as we agree to start, so we can move immediately. If you’re confident you can match the style of the reference site and deliver within a day, let’s get this rolling.

jobs.title: Large-Scale Shopify Store Build
jobs.description:
I’m ready to launch a Shopify site that will sell physical products, and the catalogue is big—well over 200 items from day one. All product images, descriptions, and prices are prepared; what I need now is a polished, conversion-oriented storefront and a back-end strong enough to handle bulk uploads and constant inventory changes.

The scope includes:
• Selecting or developing a fast, mobile-friendly theme  
• Setting up collections, filters, payments, taxes, and shipping rates  
• Importing every SKU without data loss and configuring inventory rules  
• Installing and configuring any essential apps to streamline operations  
• Optimising speed, basic on-page SEO, and reusable product/page templates  

When delivery is complete, the store must be live, fully populated, and ready to accept real orders on all devices. In your proposal, please share Shopify stores you’ve built that handle large physical-product catalogues and outline your approach to bulk data import, theme setup, and testing. And able to place order from manual order on application

jobs.title: 1000-Word SEO Healthcare Article
jobs.description:
I need a well-researched, 100 % human-written article for my healthcare site. The piece must land at roughly 1,000 words, read smoothly for the general public, and rank well in search engines.  

You will weave in the exact phrases “Health tips” and “Healthy lifestyle” naturally, applying basic on-page SEO practice—compelling H1/H2 structure, meta description suggestion, and keyword placement that never feels forced. Grammar, spelling, and flow have to be spotless, and the tone should remain friendly yet authoritative.

You and I will lock in the precise topic the moment the project starts; I’m open to your title ideas so long as they align with current healthcare interests and suit a lay audience.

Deliverables  
• One 1,000-word article in Google Docs or Word  
• SEO elements: title tag (≤ 60 chars), meta description (≤ 155 chars), and suggested URL slug  
• Grammarly score 95 + and Copyscape-clean screenshot  

Timeline  
Submit the finished draft within 2 days of acceptance so I have time for a quick review and any minor tweaks.  

If you can provide engaging, evidence-based writing without any AI assistance, I’d love to get this moving today.

jobs.title: Informational Site Redesign Needed
jobs.description:
I’m ready to give my existing informational website a modern, responsive facelift. The current build is functional but dated, so the goal is a clean redesign that loads fast, looks sharp on every device, and is easy for me to update later.

Scope  
The site remains purely informational—no e-commerce or blog functionality—so the focus is on presenting content clearly and professionally. The redesign must cover:

• Home page  
• About us  
• Contact page  

Content is already written; you will handle design, layout, and front-end build. I’m open to your preferred stack—HTML5/CSS3 with vanilla JavaScript, a lightweight React front end, or a streamlined WordPress theme—as long as it stays fast, SEO-friendly, and straightforward for me to maintain.

Key points  
• Fully responsive, cross-browser compatible design  
• Intuitive navigation with clear calls to action  
• Light animations or interactive touches welcome if they don’t slow performance  
• On-page SEO basics (title tags, meta descriptions, proper heading structure)  
• Handover of all source files plus a short guide for future text/image edits  

Timeline  
Initial mock-ups within a week would be ideal, with the final site delivered soon after design approval.

When you reply, it would help to see two or three live examples of informational sites you’ve recently redesigned and a note on how you ensured responsiveness and speed. Let me know if anything needs clarifying—I’m eager to get started.

jobs.title: Desktop Workshop Scheduling & Forecasting
jobs.description:
A Windows-based desktop application is needed to plan our workshop’s day-to-day jobs while also projecting capacity months ahead for quoting and production planning. The software must let me see, at a glance, whether today’s manpower can cover scheduled work and whether future orders will push us into overallocation or leave profitable gaps that can be sold.

Key capabilities I must see  
• Daily workshop scheduling  (Must be able to manage 50+ employees and 100+jobs with 1-500 tasks per job)  
• Long-term workload forecasting  
• Manpower allocation  

Functionally, the program should offer an intuitive calendar or Gantt-style view where tasks can be dragged to different bays or teams, automatically adjusting each operator’s load and flagging clashes. On the longer horizon, I need a forecasting module that rolls up confirmed and tentative jobs to generate lead-time estimates and highlight any weeks where capacity falls short or remains unused. Simple colour cues for overload/under-load, printable and exportable reports (CSV / Excel), and the option to tweak labour hours or shift patterns are essential.

The application will run exclusively on Windows, so a .NET (WPF/WinUI), JavaFX, or similarly robust framework is fine—whichever you are most effective with. A lightweight local database such as SQLite is adequate, though the design should leave room for a future networked upgrade.

Additionally, the tool must be simple, user-friendly, support multi-user editing, and allow simultaneous viewing by multiple users.

Deliverables  
1. Compiled Windows installer and clean, well-commented source code  
2. Brief user guide covering daily scheduling, forecast generation, and data backup  
3. Acceptance walk-through showing:   
   – a full week scheduled without conflicts,  
   – an over-capacity scenario correctly flagged, and  
   – a forecast report demonstrating projected lead-time for a new order.  

Let me know your proposed tech stack and any previous scheduling engines you have built so we can move forward quickly.

jobs.title: Video and Diamond Photography Specialist
jobs.description:
I'm seeking a skilled video editor and photographer for a project involving diamonds. 

Requirements:
- Event videography for a diamond-related event
- Promotional or documentary-style video as secondary options
- High-quality product photography of diamonds, specifically for social media use

Ideal Skills and Experience:
- Experience in event videography, with a portfolio to showcase
- Proficiency in video editing software
- Expertise in product photography, especially with high-value items like diamonds
- Ability to create visually stunning images tailored for social media platforms
- Attention to detail and creativity

Please provide samples of previous work in your bids.

jobs.title: AI Tools Website Development Consultant
jobs.description:
I’m preparing to launch a site whose main goal is “Ai tools,” and I need an experienced web-development mind to guide me from concept to build. Rather than handing the entire project over, I’m looking for a consultant who can sharpen my vision, outline the technical path, and keep the future development team moving efficiently.

Here’s what I’d like from you:

• Sketch high-level wireframes that capture core user flows around discovering and using the tools.

By the end of the engagement I expect a written spec, architecture diagram, lightweight wireframes, and a phased rollout plan I can hand to builders with confidence. If you’ve launched AI-driven products before, tell me about the hurdles you solved and the metrics you put in place. I’m ready to get started as soon as we align on scope and approach.

jobs.title: Website Toko Online Sederhana - 26/08/2026 01:23 EDT

jobs.title: Video Editing With Effects -BETTER' IN LOW

jobs.title: Editable Adobe Quotation Template
jobs.description:
I want to streamline the way we send quotes to clients in the construction-equipment hire / security space, so I need a reusable,  editable in some sections quotation template built in Adobe (InDesign or an interactive Acrobat PDF—feel free to recommend the best route).

The layout must clearly accommodate:
1) Cover page semi editable, can add customer location, date, sales person
2) A concise company-profile (1 page)  (locked info)
3) Product details of what I'm selling (one page) 6 products (locked info) 1 photo of each product and a description of the product and section at the bottom with some optional extras Starlink, Mesh Network, Security Desk, LPR Camera, Thermal Camera, monitoring, guard response
4) Customer information  - 1 page dedicated to the clients specific project (editable) headings - scope, recommendations, delivery process 
5) Customer information - 1 blank page to insert a site aerial photo to then superimpose the products and where the would be located on the site map  - ideally like to have icons we can use of the 5 products that we can position over the map to show location of item.
6) A final page where the client can electronically sign, date and formally accept the quote, terms and conditions linked to it.
The quote is generated in another SaaS platform and converted to a separate PDF document which will be sent with this document and the quote number will need to be referenced in the document 

Visually, the template should feel at home in a construction / machinery hiring environment—clean, professional and a touch industrial rather than overly corporate or minimalist. Think bold headings, easy-to-read pricing tables and room for photographs of the equipment.

Please set up all key text and price fields as editable styles or form fields so my team can update each quote without altering the core design. Include paragraph/character styles, colour swatches and any linked assets or fonts (licensed for commercial use).

Deliverables  
• Editable Adobe source file (INDD or alternative)  
• Print-ready and interactive PDF versions  
• Simple how-to notes so staff can update wording, insert product photos and export new quotes  

If anything is unclear just let me know—I’m happy to answer questions quickly so we can get this template live.

jobs.title: Cinematic Travel Log Video Editing
jobs.description:
I have several hours of raw footage from a recent trip and I want to turn it into a short, cinematic-and-dramatic travel log that puts my activities and adventures at center stage. Think sweeping color-graded shots, carefully timed cuts, tasteful speed-ramping, and a soundtrack that drives the story without overpowering it.

The footage is already organized by day. I need you to weave it together into a coherent narrative, polish it with cinematic transitions, stabilize where needed, add subtle motion graphics for location call-outs, and mix in royalty-free music and ambient sound so the final piece feels like a mini-documentary rather than a slideshow.

I’m interested in editors who can point to past work that shows real experience with travel or adventure projects—please link to examples and let me know which tools you used (Premiere Pro, Final Cut, DaVinci Resolve, After Effects, etc.). A brief note on how you’d approach pacing and color will help me understand your creative process.

Deliverables  
• A mastered 4K video (around 4-6 minutes) ready for YouTube and Instagram  
• A shorter 60-second vertical cut for Reels/Stories  
• All project files neatly organized so I can re-edit in the future if needed  

I’ll supply a download link to the footage and a rough storyboard once we start. Looking forward to seeing how you can bring these adventures to life.

jobs.title: AI Non-Fiction Book Publishing -- 3
jobs.description:
I need a detail-oriented helper to turn my step-by-step SOP into finished non-fiction books generated with AI and published online. You’ll receive full training—everything from the exact prompts to use, to checklists for uploading—so you can focus on accuracy and speed.

Each month you will:
• Input AI-generated text into our template, edit for clarity, and run originality and grammar checks.  
• Format the manuscript into a clean, platform-ready ePub or Kindle file with proper headings, front/back matter, and a clickable table of contents.

Acceptance criteria: zero typos, platform compliance, correct metadata, and on-time delivery.

If you enjoy structured creative work, are comfortable with tools like ChatGPT, Kindle Create, or any ePub converter, and can follow an SOP to the letter, let’s talk.

jobs.title: Airbnb & Booking.com Listing Optimization Specialist
jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced Airbnb and Booking.com listing optimisation specialist to review and optimise our existing short-term rental listings in Melbourne, Australia.

We currently manage multiple furnished apartments across Southbank and Melbourne CBD and want to improve listing visibility, search ranking, click-through rates and ultimately increase bookings and occupancy.

Scope of Work

The successful freelancer will review our existing Airbnb and Booking.com listings and provide practical recommendations covering:

Listing titles, descriptions and overall content
Airbnb and Booking.com search visibility/SEO
Cover photo selection and photo sequencing
Amenities, features and listing attributes
Pricing presentation, discounts and promotions
Minimum-stay and booking restrictions
Cancellation and booking settings where relevant
Competitor analysis against comparable properties in our market
Opportunities to improve click-through and booking conversion
Identification of missing or underutilised listing features
Recommendations to improve overall listing performance

We are not simply looking for someone to rewrite our descriptions. We want someone who understands how Airbnb and Booking.com platforms work and can identify the factors that may be limiting visibility or conversion.

What We Are Looking For

Ideally, you will have:

Proven experience optimising Airbnb and Booking.com listings
Strong understanding of short-term rental platforms and ranking factors
Experience analysing competing listings and local markets
Knowledge of STR pricing, promotions and booking strategies
Examples of listings you have previously optimised
Evidence of measurable improvements achieved for previous clients

Experience with PriceLabs and Hostaway would be an advantage.

Please include examples of your previous Airbnb/Booking.com optimisation work and briefly explain how you would approach auditing an existing listing before making recommendations.

We would initially like to optimise a small number of listings. If the results are successful, there is potential for ongoing work across our portfolio.

jobs.title: Family Memory Book Mobile App
jobs.description:

Core needs

• Secure photo and video uploads straight from the camera roll, with basic editing (crop, rotate, trim).  
• Built-in audio recorder so family members can add voice notes to any page or memory.  
• Private cloud storage with user authentication; everything must stay within the family group.  

Nice-to-have, if it doesn’t complicate the schedule, would be an interactive timeline view, but it is not mandatory for the first release.

Please outline:  
1. Your preferred tech stack and any similar apps you have shipped.  
2. A rough milestone plan covering design, development, testing, and store launch.  
3. How you will handle data security and long-term hosting.  

Final deliverable is a ready-to-publish mobile application plus source code and deployment documentation.

jobs.title: 3D Concept Explainer Video Creation
jobs.description:

When you reply, include a few links to comparable 3D explainer work you’ve completed, a brief outline of your production process, and an estimated turnaround time. I’ll review portfolios as they come in and move quickly to kick off the script phase with the right animator.

jobs.title: Meta Ads Traffic Campaign
jobs.description:

jobs.title: Comprehensive Electronics E-commerce Site Development

jobs.title: Affiliate Recruitment for AI Tools

jobs.title: Experienced Healthcare SEO Copywriter Needed

jobs.title: Polish Audio for 8-Min Video

jobs.title: .NET Angular Admin Dashboard
jobs.description:

• Manage users with multiple role levels (admins, editors, viewers, etc.)  
• View real-time and historical analytics & reporting pulled from our SQL data

You’ll connect the Angular front end to a clean RESTful API in .NET, build out the database objects and stored procedures in SQL Server, and wire in authentication/authorization so the role-based access works exactly as laid out in the designs.

jobs.title: Saudi Employer Review Content Creation

Before we begin, please send a short sample of any custom content or research-based marketing work you’ve done—just enough for me to gauge tone and authenticity.

Once your style is approved, we’ll finalize the following specifics: 
• List of targeted employers and total review count (30-40 required) 
• Formatting conventions and reference guidelines    
• Turnaround schedule (1 week completion expected)  

Payment is tied directly to volume at approximately five reviews per dollar. All copy must be original, pass plagiarism checks, and adhere to the brand tone specifications for immediate usability.

jobs.title: Dance Party Video Highlight

  - Prior experience with dance or music events.
  - Strong creative vision to make the footage engaging.

jobs.title: Squarespace Site Tweaks & Integrations

Second, one text block loses its alignment only on iPad. The copy is there, but it shifts off-center; please correct that so it matches the rest of the layout across all Apple tablet breakpoints.

Once the visual glitches are resolved, I’d like the site fully connected to Google Analytics and Meta. Set up the tags/pixel, confirm events are firing, and surface the basic traffic and conversion data I’ll need as a local service provider. If you have any other low-hanging integrations you routinely enable for local businesses—such as Google Search Console or call-tracking—let me know and, with my go-ahead, add them too.

Deliverables  
• Header and footer realigned for every responsive breakpoint  
• Text block properly aligned on iPad screens  
• Google Analytics and Meta Pixel installed, tested, and reporting  
• Brief notes or screenshots showing the fixes and the live analytics connections

I’m hoping for a clean, same-day turnaround. Let me know your estimated hours and any access you’ll need, and we can get started right away.

jobs.title: App Store Specialist
jobs.description:

Tendo (Customer) — for placing orders
Tendo Driver — for drivers accepting and fulfilling orders
Tendo Vendor — for vendors and service providers managing their listings

All three are Flutter apps with a Laravel/Firebase backend, already fully built and functional.

What's already done

This is not a from-scratch launch — most of the technical groundwork is complete:

Automated CI/CD (GitHub Actions) already builds signed .apk and .aab files for all three apps on every code push
Store listing copy, app icon, feature graphic, and phone screenshots are finished and ready to upload for Customer and Driver
Customer's first production release is already in progress in Play Console
Several Play Console compliance requirements have already been resolved for Customer and Driver, including foreground service permission declarations, content rating, and privacy policy
What we need help with
Finish Vendor's store listing — description, icon, feature graphic, and screenshots, following the same pattern already used for Customer and Driver
Complete remaining Play Console compliance items across all three apps — permission declarations, Data Safety form, target audience settings
Shepherd all three apps through Google's review process — monitor submissions, respond quickly and correctly to any rejections or policy flags
(Optional, separate scope) Extend the same process to iOS: Apple Developer Program enrollment, App Store Connect listings, and submission for all three apps
Scope boundary

This role is about store publishing and compliance, not app development. No Flutter, backend, or bug-fixing work is expected — our team handles the codebase directly.

What we're looking for
Proven track record publishing apps to Google Play (Flutter-built apps a plus, but not required)
Current, hands-on familiarity with Play Console policies — foreground service declarations, Data Safety, content rating, target audience rules
Comfortable working independently from screenshots/screen recordings and clear written instructions
Responsive communication — review rejections often come with tight windows to respond
Deliverable

All three apps live and approved on the Google Play Store. [Add: + iOS App Store, if included in scope.]

jobs.title: Drive Global Traffic via Meta Ads

jobs.title: Hospital Garment Vector Redraw

2. A short walkthrough—either embedded notes or a separate sheet—explaining how to refresh data weekly and customise alert thresholds.

jobs.title: Daily Livestream Clip Editor

3. Your typical turnaround time per clip and per long-form video.  

Once onboard, we’ll set up a simple workflow to share raw VOD links, select timestamps, and handle revisions quickly so we never fall behind the daily schedule.  

Looking forward to working with someone who can keep up the momentum and help the channel grow throughout this marathon stream.

jobs.title: Inventory Automation Website Build
jobs.description:

The site’s single purpose, for this first phase, is business automation: every intake, movement, reorder point and valuation report should flow through the browser without anyone touching a spreadsheet.

Here’s what I need the finished website to do:  
• Provide a clean, responsive interface that works just as well on a warehouse tablet as it does on a desktop.  
• Authenticate users securely, then show each role only the screens they need (admin, warehouse staff, finance).  
• Sync with our existing product database or a new one you recommend, then surface real-time stock levels, location tracking and low-stock alerts.  
• Fire off automated reorder e-mails or SMS when thresholds are reached.  
• Generate downloadable CSV/PDF reports covering valuations, movement history and out-of-stock periods.  
• Keep a searchable audit trail of every stock change.

Acceptance criteria  
1. All functions live on a test server I can access for hands-on QA.  
2. Source code delivered in a Git repo with clear documentation.  
3. Dashboard queries must respond in under two seconds with at least 10 000 items seeded.  
4. Core business logic covered by basic unit tests.

I’m flexible on the exact tech stack—feel free to suggest what you’re most productive with—but it should be stable, well-documented and easy for another developer to pick up later. Once inventory automation is solid, I may extend Ingenifnix into other areas like payroll or customer service, so think scalability.

When you respond, include a brief outline of your proposed stack, any similar inventory or automation projects you’ve shipped, and the timeframe you’d need to hit the acceptance criteria above.

jobs.title: Pine Script 3Commas V2 Upgrade
jobs.description:
My TradingView strategy is written entirely in Pine Script and, up to now, has been firing its buy-and-sell webhooks to the legacy 3Commas V1 endpoint. With 3Commas having moved to V2, none of those alerts reach my crypto bots anymore, so the script needs to be refactored to speak the new language.

What I need is straightforward: replace the old alert blocks with the correct V2 webhook structure and create the corresponding order-entry payloads so the bots can place and close cryptocurrency trades just as they did before. The core strategy logic, indicators and risk rules stay exactly the same; only the alert section and any helper functions that format the JSON must change to meet the new 3Commas V2 specification.

Deliverables I can test right away:
• A revised Pine Script file ready to paste back into TradingView.  
• Sample V2 alert JSON for both long and short entries, take-profit and stop-loss.  
• A quick note showing where to drop my secret key and how to map the pair placeholder for any crypto symbol.

Once I can fire a few test alerts from TradingView and see them land correctly in my 3Commas account, the job is complete.
The strategy on Trading View is "3C QFL Mean Reversal" by Kveie

jobs.title: Odoo 17 Enterprise Backend UI / Dashboard Redesign for Temple360

# Odoo 17 Enterprise Backend UI / Dashboard Redesign – Temple360

We are looking for an experienced **Odoo 17 developer** to redesign the backend UI/navigation of an existing **Odoo 17 Enterprise installation hosted on Odoo.sh**.

We are developing a branded temple-management solution called:

**Temple360 by Speartech – Powered by Odoo**

This is primarily a **backend UI/navigation customisation project**, NOT a complete ERP redevelopment.

## Current System

Our current Odoo backend uses the standard app launcher with grid icons for Accounting, POS, Inventory, Purchase, Events, Employees, Website, Helpdesk, Documents, CRM, etc.

We want to transform this into a more professional Temple360 interface.

## 1. Left Sidebar Navigation

Replace/supplement the standard Odoo app-grid navigation with a **permanent and collapsible left sidebar**.

Example structure:

### Devotee Services

* Devotees
* Prayer & Services
* Booking & Reservations
* Donations & Ubayam
* Events & Festivals

### Counter

* Counter Services / POS
* Service / Kitchen Orders

### Operations

* Inventory
* Purchase
* Documents
* IoT

### Finance

* Accounting
* Petty Cash
* Expenses
* Payroll

### People

* Employees / Volunteers

### Digital

* Website
* Appointments
* Subscriptions

### Management

* Dashboard
* Reports

### Support

* Helpdesk

### Administration

* Apps
* Settings

The final menu structure will be confirmed during development.

Sidebar requirements:

* Temple360 branding
* Maroon/gold/cream colour scheme
* Menu icons
* Expandable/collapsible categories
* Active-menu highlighting
* Collapsible sidebar
* Responsive design
* Smooth navigation between Odoo applications

The normal Odoo application should open in the main content area.

## 2. Existing Odoo Menus & Actions

The sidebar must integrate with Odoo's existing menu/action architecture.

We do NOT want fragile hard-coded URLs/action IDs where avoidable.

For example:

**Accounting → existing Odoo Accounting**

**Inventory → existing Odoo Inventory**

**Counter Services → existing Odoo POS**

The underlying Odoo functionality must remain intact.

## 3. Role-Based Navigation

The sidebar should respect existing Odoo access rights/security groups.

For example, Counter Staff may only see:

* Devotees
* Prayer Services
* Bookings
* Donations
* POS
* Events

Finance users may see:

* Accounting
* Donations
* Purchase
* Expenses
* Reports

Administrators can see everything they are authorised to access.

Users should not see menu items for which they have no access.

## 4. Temple360 Home Dashboard

We would like a branded **Temple360 Home** page instead of relying only on the standard Odoo app launcher.

Possible dashboard elements:

### KPI Cards

* Today's Prayer Bookings
* Today's Donations
* Today's Counter Transactions
* Upcoming Events
* Pending Items

### Quick Actions

* New Prayer Booking
* Record Donation
* Open Counter
* Register Devotee
* Create Ubayam
* Search/Print Receipt

Some KPIs may depend on our existing custom modules. Please specify what is included in your quotation.

## 5. Temple360 Branding

We will provide:

* Temple360 logo
* Brand colours
* Background artwork
* Other available branding assets

The backend should have a **professional, clean, modern Temple360 appearance**.

Where appropriate, user-facing terminology may also be changed, for example:

**Point of Sale → Counter Services**

**Events → Events & Festivals**

We prefer UI/menu-level changes rather than unnecessary modification of underlying Odoo models.

## 6. Top Navigation

Where practical, integrate the Temple360 design into the top navigation while retaining existing Odoo functionality such as:

* Organisation/company selector
* Search
* Notifications
* Activities
* User profile
* Existing systray functions

## 7. Development Requirements

Development should preferably be contained within a dedicated custom addon such as:

`temple360_backend_theme`

We do **NOT want Odoo core files directly modified** unless there is an exceptional reason that is discussed and approved beforehand.

Requirements:

* Odoo 17 Enterprise
* Odoo.sh compatible
* OWL/Odoo 17 web client compatible
* Desktop/laptop optimised
* Tablet/iPad responsive
* Good performance
* Compatible with existing custom/third-party modules where reasonably possible
* Maintainable for future Odoo upgrades

Development and testing must first be performed on an **Odoo.sh staging/development branch** before production deployment.

## 8. Third-Party Theme Option

We are open to using an existing Odoo 17 sidebar/backend theme as the foundation if it reduces development cost and time.

However, you MUST disclose:

* Theme/module name
* Cost
* Licence
* Odoo 17 Enterprise compatibility
* Odoo.sh compatibility
* Any recurring/per-database licence
* Whether it can be used in a commercial solution deployed to multiple customers

Do not introduce undisclosed paid dependencies.

## 9. Deliverables

Successful freelancer should provide:

* Temple360 sidebar navigation
* Temple360 Home dashboard
* Branding integration
* Role/access-aware navigation
* Responsive interface
* Odoo 17 Enterprise/Odoo.sh compatibility
* Complete source code for custom development
* Installation/deployment instructions
* Basic technical documentation
* Staging testing
* Production deployment assistance
* Agreed post-delivery bug-fixing period

## 10. Source Code / IP

Temple360 is intended to become a commercial Speartech solution.

All custom code specifically developed and paid for under this project must be provided to us upon completion.

Any third-party/proprietary code, themes, modules or licensing restrictions must be disclosed BEFORE development starts.

## Required Experience

Please apply only if you have good experience with:

* Odoo 17
* Odoo Enterprise
* Odoo.sh
* OWL
* JavaScript
* XML/QWeb
* SCSS/CSS
* Odoo Web Client
* Menu/action architecture
* Security/access groups
* Backend themes/dashboard development

Previous Odoo sidebar/backend UI experience is strongly preferred.

## When Applying

Please provide:

1. Years of Odoo experience
2. Odoo 17 experience

Acceptance Criteria  
• Sync is tight—no drift between narration and visuals.  
• Blue accents appear consistently for calls to action and key highlights.  
• Final file size and format ready for immediate upload to WordPress.

You will turn my notes into a polished pleading that:

• Sets out jurisdiction, venue, and the relevant federal and state consumer-protection statutes.  
• Details the misrepresentation of services and the platform’s nondelivery of purchased goods in a concise, fact-driven narrative.  
• Pleads the causes of action for fraudulent practices, articulating damages and equitable relief.  
• Includes a caption, parties, prayer for relief, and signature block formatted for federal filing.  

A Word document is fine; formatting that mirrors typical federal templates is ideal. Once delivered, I’ll review, add my signature, and file through PACER. If questions arise as you draft, I can supply additional facts promptly.

jobs.title: Swahili Audio to English Transcript
jobs.description:
I have several recordings spoken entirely in Swahili that I need converted into clear, well-structured English text. Your task is two-fold: first produce an accurate Swahili transcript, then translate that transcript into natural, idiomatic English. The dialogue is everyday conversation, so you won’t run into specialised jargon—just be mindful of correct spelling for common names and places that may come up.  

Please keep speaker tags and time stamps modest (every 30–45 seconds is fine) so the text can later be aligned to video if needed. I’m happy with delivery in either a clean Word document or an SRT/VTT file; let me know which you prefer. If you use tools such as Aegisub, Subtitle Edit, or Express Scribe, feel free, but the final output must read as if created by a fluent human translator.  

Acceptance criteria  
• Complete Swahili verbatim transcript  
• Corresponding English translation directly underneath or in a side-by-side format  
• Consistent time stamps that match the supplied audio  
• Proof-read, punctuation checked, ready to publish without extra editing  

If this sounds straightforward for you and you can turn around high-quality work quickly, I look forward to collaborating.

jobs.title: AI Workout Coach App & Web
jobs.description:
I’m building an AI-powered workout coach that runs smoothly both in a mobile app and a browser. The core of the product is an engine that can design strength-training and yoga sessions on the fly, then adapt them to each user’s current fitness level and stated goals. I do not need every biometric detail at launch; intermediate-level customization that factors in baseline fitness and objectives is perfect for version 1.

Here’s what I need you to put in place:

• A responsive front-end for iOS/Android and a matching web interface. The layout should feel native on phones yet remain fully functional on desktop screens.  
• A recommendation engine (Python, TensorFlow or similar is fine) that auto-generates daily or weekly plans for strength and yoga, adjusting intensity as users log progress.  
• Secure user accounts with cloud data storage so progress, preferences and goals sync seamlessly between devices.  
• Admin tools that let me upload new exercise videos, tweak difficulty parameters and view basic analytics on usage.

Acceptance criteria  
• Users can sign up, enter their fitness level and goals, and immediately receive a tailored workout calendar.  
• Each generated workout includes exercise name, reps/sets (for strength) or hold times/flows (for yoga) plus short video or GIF demos.  
• Adjustments after a completed session are reflected in the next recommended workout without manual refresh.  
• UI passes standard accessibility checks and loads in under two seconds on 4G.

If you have existing modules for exercise classification or progressive load algorithms, feel free to suggest them. Let me know which frameworks you prefer for the mobile wrapper (React Native, Flutter, etc.) and how you plan to keep the web client in sync. I’m ready to get started as soon as we lock in the technical approach.

jobs.title: Outdoor Family Portrait Session

Let me know your availability, a brief portfolio link to similar family sessions, and any questions you have about the location or timing.

jobs.title: Law Firm Visa Form App
jobs.description:
I’m building a mobile application that lets our immigration clients fill out U.S. visa forms quickly and securely from their phones. The app has to run natively on both iOS and Android and be engineered to SOC 2 standards end-to-end, because all files will be stored in the United States under strict data-protection guidelines.

Core workflow  
• Users sign in with two-factor authentication, then use an in-app scanner to capture supporting documents.  
• The scanner must export clean, high-resolution images as: PDF, JPEG, and PNG.  
• An OCR/​data-extraction engine pulls the required fields from those documents and auto-populates the latest government form (the app should check the official site on launch and fetch new form versions automatically).  
• Step-by-step guidance walks the client through anything the extraction misses, so the form is submission-ready when they finish.  
• All completed forms and uploads go into a free, encrypted repository inside the app so returning clients can reuse their data for future filings.  
• The build should be structured for three pricing tiers—free, paid, and premium upsell services—so in-app purchases can be switched on from the backend without code changes.

What I need from you  
– Cross-platform mobile development with clean, maintainable code  
– Integration of the scanner, OCR, and auto-fill logic  
– Cloud architecture that satisfies SOC 2 controls (logging, encryption at rest/in transit, secure key management)  
– CI/CD pipelines and store-ready builds for both platforms  
– Clear developer documentation so my internal team can extend features later

If you’ve shipped secure, data-heavy apps before—especially those requiring stringent compliance—I’d like to see your approach and timeline.

jobs.title: Online Rental Boyfriend Platform Development
jobs.description:
I’m ready to launch an “online rental boyfriend” service and need the complete platform built out as both a responsive website and companion mobile apps (iOS and Android). The core flow is straightforward: visitors browse available “boyfriend” profiles, check schedules, book time slots, and chat securely within the app—everything authenticated through phone-number verification to keep onboarding simple and fraud-resistant.

What I need engineered:
• A modern web front-end plus native or cross-platform mobile apps that stay visually consistent.  
• Profile management for the rental boyfriends—photos, bio, rates, availability calendar—and a public browsing grid with filters.  
• A real-time booking engine that blocks double bookings, handles cancellations, and sends SMS / in-app notifications.  
• An in-app messaging system (text first, with the architecture ready for voice/video add-ons later).  
• Admin dashboard where I can vet new boyfriend accounts, adjust fees, issue refunds, and pull usage reports.

Phone Number Verification must be the sole login method, integrating an SMS OTP provider such as Twilio or Firebase Auth. Data should be encrypted at rest and in transit; GDPR-ready consent screens are required because user data is sensitive.

A brief acceptance checklist:
1. Website and apps pass device-agnostic UI tests.  
2. Booking clashes are impossible under load.  
3. OTP login works globally and logs events.  
4. Messages are stored securely and delivered instantly.  
5. Source code, build instructions, and a staging URL / TestFlight build are provided for hand-off.

If you’ve built multi-platform marketplaces in React, Flutter, or similar stacks and can demonstrate clean architecture with scalable back-end choices (Node.js, Django, or Laravel welcome), let’s talk timelines and milestones.

jobs.title: India-Based Hospital Website Prototype — Next.js & Sanity
jobs.description:
We are seeking India-based developers for a genuine, smaller hospital website prototype and possible paid implementation. We welcome both experienced developers and smaller/emerging developers with relevant portfolio work. Proposals will be compared fairly based on demonstrated work, technical approach, communication, realistic scope, timeline, and total cost. The maximum budget range for this prototype is $100–$1,200 USD, depending on the proposed deliverables.

Prototype scope:
- One polished, responsive hospital landing page or a small 2–3-page prototype using Next.js, React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS.
- A basic Sanity CMS setup with a doctor-directory schema/prototype containing doctor name, photo, specialty, and short bio.
- A simple WhatsApp/contact action for appointment requests or general inquiries; no complex booking backend is required.
- Basic technical SEO: page titles, descriptions, semantic HTML, responsive performance, sitemap/robots guidance, and appropriate LocalBusiness or medical-business JSON-LD where suitable.
- Basic security and deployment baseline: sensible environment-variable handling, dependency hygiene, HTTPS/Vercel deployment guidance, and a short handover document.

Please propose a realistic scope that fits the budget. Clearly separate the essential prototype from optional additions such as extra pages, advanced animations, live Sanity preview, filtering/search, forms, email notifications, analytics, appointment booking, authentication, payments, medical records, custom backends, or future expansion work.

To make proposals comparable, please provide all of the following:
1. Approximate total fixed price for the prototype and the exact deliverables included.
2. Milestone plan with the price and acceptance criteria for each milestone.
3. Hourly rate and estimated hours, if you prefer hourly billing.
4. Realistic timeline, earliest start date, and your weekly availability.
5. Number of revision rounds included and the price of additional revisions.
6. Hosting and deployment costs, including Vercel or alternatives, domain, email, analytics, monitoring, backups, and any other recurring service costs.
7. Sanity CMS costs or limits that the client should expect, plus any third-party API or WhatsApp-related costs.
8. Maintenance and support options after delivery, including monthly or annual pricing, response times, security updates, dependency updates, backups, bug fixes, and content-update assistance.
9. Security practices included in this prototype, such as secret management, dependency scanning, form-spam protection, access control, backups, and incident response assumptions. Please provide a high-level description only; do not share confidential code or proprietary client information.
10. SEO work included, expected limitations, and optional prices for local SEO, structured-data improvements, performance optimization, and ongoing SEO support.
11. Handover details: source repository, deployment access, Sanity access, documentation, content-entry instructions, and ownership/licensing terms.
12. Any taxes, Freelancer fees, paid licenses, stock assets, or other costs not included in your quote.
13. One or two relevant portfolio examples and a brief explanation of what you personally built.

This is a genuine project evaluation, not a request for free detailed architecture or proprietary work. We may begin with a small paid milestone before deciding whether to proceed with later phases. Please state clearly what you can deliver within the selected budget and what would need a separate quote.

jobs.title: Optimize WordPress Mobile Layout
jobs.description:
My WordPress site displays perfectly on desktop, yet the mobile version struggles with images—some appear oversized, others shrink or break the grid. I need the layout and overall design tuned specifically for phones and small tablets so every picture sits where it should, at the right size, with balanced white-space around it.

The task centers on adjusting image sizing and placement in the existing theme without altering the desktop experience. This may involve tweaking CSS media queries, refining Gutenberg or Elementor settings, and tidying up any template files that dictate responsive behaviour. While loading speed and text already perform well, any quick wins you spot there are welcome as long as they don’t steal focus from the visual layout work.

Deliverable:
• Updated theme or child-theme files (CSS/JS/PHP) or page-builder settings that correct mobile image sizing and placement, tested across common iOS and Android resolutions.

I’ll provide WordPress admin access, theme documentation, and a list of pages exhibiting the worst issues. Once adjustments are complete I’ll confirm on my own devices; if everything snaps into place, the job’s done.

jobs.title: Retail Kiosk CAD Drafting

Acceptance Criteria

If this sounds like a project you can knock out efficiently, let’s talk timing and any clarifications you need.

jobs.title: Fix MySQL Query Syntax
jobs.description:
I have a short SELECT statement that throws “#1241 – Operand should contain 1 column(s).”  
What I want is simple: return nombre, apellido, especialidad1, especialidad2 and categoria from table nancy, but only for the rows whose (nombre + apellido) pair also appears in table visitas5. The final results must stay ordered by especialidad1 ASC and I am not asking for any new indexes or performance tweaks right now.

The task is to rewrite the query so it runs without errors and produces exactly that dataset. Please send back the corrected SQL (JOIN, EXISTS, or any other valid MySQL approach), along with a brief note explaining why the original version failed.

This is my current query:

SELECT nombre, apellido, especialidad1,especialidad2,categoria
FROM pamela
WHERE nombre  and apellido IN (SELECT nombre, apellido FROM visitas6) order by especialidad1 asc;

jobs.title: Monthly Website & Social SEO
jobs.description:
I need a specialist who can take full ownership of search optimisation for both my WordPress website and my Instagram, TikTok and YouTube channels on an ongoing monthly basis. The mandate is simple yet ambitious: drive more traffic, climb the search results and spark deeper engagement across every platform.

Here’s the flow I have in mind. You start each month with a quick audit, refine site structure and metadata, run fresh keyword research, then roll the insights into two long-form, keyword-rich blog posts. Those posts should be paired with short-form video concepts so the same topics can be repurposed as Reels, TikTok clips and YouTube Shorts. Titles, descriptions, tags, thumbnails and hashtags all need to follow current best practice for video SEO.

I expect white-hat link building, clean technical fixes, schema markup where it helps, and a smart hashtag strategy. Tools like Ahrefs, SEMrush, Yoast, TubeBuddy or similar are fine—use whatever gives us the clearest data. At month-end, send a concise report drawn from GA4, Search Console and the native social analytics that shows ranking movement, organic sessions and engagement gains, plus next steps.

Deliverables each month:
• Updated SEO audit with completed-action log  
• Two 1,000-word, search-optimised blog posts  
• SEO-ready assets (titles, descriptions, tags, thumbnails) for at least four short videos  
• Performance report with clear metrics and recommendations  

I’ll start with a one-month trial and scale to a long-term retainer if the numbers move in the right direction. When you reply, include any case studies or live examples that prove you can hit traffic, ranking and engagement targets on both websites and social channels.

Quality expectations:

To move forward, send me an email or DM with the exact phrase “Outreach Specialist.” I’ll reply with the brief application and a short test so we can see your voice in action.

jobs.title: NFPA 72 Fire Alarm Calculations
jobs.description:

The system centres on a hybrid fire-alarm control panel; at this stage only the panel data are locked in, with initiating and notification circuits still being finalised. Once you are aboard I will forward the panel cut-sheets, device counts and wiring topology.

Your task is to generate three items and place them into a clear, engineer-ready PDF:

• Battery sizing calculations that prove the panel will operate through its required standby and alarm periods (backup duration is open—show your working so we can adjust easily).  
• Maximum allowable circuit / loop / network lengths based on the panel’s published current limits and conductor gauges.  
• End-to-end voltage-drop calculations for each circuit, referenced to the worst-case load.

Each worksheet must reference the specific NFPA 72 clauses you apply, include formulas (not just final numbers), and cite all manufacturer data sheets you use. I will review the draft against our jurisdiction’s submittal checklist; once everything balances, I’ll need both an editable spreadsheet and the signed PDF.

jobs.title: Animated Birthday Seating Kiosk
jobs.description:

Here’s what I’m picturing: as soon as someone taps the screen, a colourful birthday-themed welcome animation plays. From there they can either type their name or scroll through an A-Z list. Once a name is selected, the seating chart zooms in on the correct table, lights it up with a short animation, and displays a friendly “Enjoy the party, [Guest Name]!” message. A secondary tab will let anyone glance at the evening’s schedule (cake cutting, speeches, dance floor opening) without leaving the seating view.  

Because this will run on a single touch-enabled Windows tablet plugged into a TV, I need the interface packaged as a standalone executable or a locally hosted web app that launches full-screen and works offline—no internet at the venue. Graphics can be playful and modern, matching typical birthday colours, but please keep all text editable so I can tweak last-minute changes.  

Deliverables  
• Touch-ready application or web bundle running 1920×1080, offline  
• Animated welcome screen, name search, seating map highlight, and schedule tab  
• Simple admin file (CSV/JSON) where I can update guest names, table numbers, and timetable events  
• One round of revisions after initial delivery to fine-tune colours, fonts, or animations  

Acceptance Criteria  
The final build must load in under five seconds, recognise every guest from the provided list, and display the correct table with a clear animation cue. All interactions should be smooth on a 55-inch touch monitor.

jobs.title: Personal Finance & Financial Forecasting App – iOS & Android

The product is designed to help users manage their income and expenses, understand their future cash flow, and create financial scenarios to see how different decisions may affect their financial position.

• Personal finance dashboard
• Income and expense management
• One-time transactions
• Recurring transactions with start/end dates
• Base financial plan
• Alternative financial scenarios

• Cash-flow forecasting

• Monthly and annual financial views
• Charts and financial reports
• Arabic RTL and English LTR
• SAR, USD, EUR, GBP and AED

• Secure authentication
• Data reset and export

• QA and UAT
• Production-ready iOS and Android builds
• App Store / Google Play submission support
• Complete source code and technical documentation

The forecasting and calculation engine must be deterministic, documented and independently testable.

The financial engine should be the single source of truth for all financial calculations and should be architected so that future Phase 2 functionality can be added without rebuilding the core engine.

PHASE 2 – FUTURE SCOPE

Phase 2 may include:

• Advanced forecasting
• What-if analysis
• Financial events
• AI Financial Assistant
• Financial intelligence
• Financial health / financial freedom insights

AI should not be the source of financial calculations. The deterministic financial engine must remain the source of truth.

PREFERRED TECHNOLOGY

• Flutter
• Python / FastAPI

We are open to alternative technologies if you can clearly justify your recommendation.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

• Strong experience with Flutter and mobile applications
• Experience with financial / fintech applications is highly preferred
• Strong backend and database experience
• Experience building forecasting or calculation engines
• Strong understanding of financial data and transaction logic
• Arabic RTL experience
• Strong QA and testing practices

10. Indicative approach and estimated cost for Phase 2

Please carefully review and read the attached RFP in full before submitting your proposal.

The RFP contains the detailed Phase 1 requirements, forecasting logic, financial calculation requirements, UX/UI expectations, technical architecture, acceptance criteria, deliverables, ownership requirements and commercial expectations.

We are looking for a long-term development partner, not simply someone to deliver code.

USD 2,000 – 5,000

Preferred: A team or company with a published Personal Finance or FinTech application.

jobs.title: Develop Secure Feature-Rich Webmail

The core of the job is straightforward: users must be able to send and receive mail reliably, have unwanted messages filtered out automatically, and manage a built-in calendar that lives right beside the inbox.

Three role tiers have to coexist smoothly. Admins oversee system and user management, standard users handle their own mail and calendar, and guests get a strictly limited, temporary view. Whatever stack you prefer—whether that’s React + Node, Vue + Laravel, or something else entirely—role-based permissions need to be airtight.

Deliverables  
• Responsive web interface and backend that cover basic email functions, live spam filtering, and calendar integration  
• Granular access control for Admin, Standard user, and Guest accounts  
• Server-side components (SMTP/IMAP, spam-filter engine) containerised—Docker preferred—for easy deployment  
• Clean, well-documented source code in a private Git repo, complete with test coverage

Acceptance criteria  
1. A new user can sign up, log in, send, and receive an email without errors.  
2. At least 95 % of known spam is quarantined in test runs.  
3. Calendar events sync instantly across sessions.  
4. Intercepted traffic remains unreadable thanks to end-to-end encryption.

Share the toolset you’d use, milestones you envision, and past projects that prove you can ship secure, high-quality webmail.

jobs.title: High-Converting, Premium Meta Ads Design
jobs.description:
# Freelance Graphic Designer Needed for Premium Wellness Meta Ads

We are looking for an experienced **graphic designer / performance creative designer** to help execute a full set of Meta advertising creatives for **Elevate Wellness**, a premium South African wellness brand.

The strategy, campaign structure, creative concepts, copy and design direction have already been developed. We now need a designer who can take the concepts and turn them into polished, high-converting creative that feels premium, modern and consistent with the Elevate Wellness brand.

## About Elevate Wellness

Elevate Wellness is a premium wellness and supplement brand focused on making everyday wellness simple, beautiful and realistic.

Our visual identity is:

* Premium
* Editorial
* Clean
* Modern
* Feminine without being overly soft
* Wellness-led
* Aspirational but still relatable
* High-end e-commerce
* Strong use of lifestyle imagery, product photography and elegant typography

The creative must feel more like a premium beauty or lifestyle brand than a traditional supplement company.

At the same time, these are **performance ads**, not simply organic social media posts. The work must be visually strong while still communicating the product, consumer problem, benefit and CTA clearly.

## Project Scope

We have developed a September Meta advertising strategy consisting of approximately **24 creative concepts** across:

* Collagen / Beauty
* Weight Management
* Gut Health
* Calm / Sleep
* Energy
* Founder / Brand Story
* Social Proof / UGC
* Retargeting
* Events
* Wholesale

The selected designer will receive a full creative strategy document that includes:

* Creative concept
* Product
* Headline
* Supporting copy
* Meta caption
* Campaign objective
* Format
* Design direction
* Recommended launch date
* Reference mockups

Your role will be to professionally execute these concepts.

## Deliverables

The final scope will include approximately **24 core Meta ad concepts**, with formats including:

* Static ads
* Carousels
* Story formats
* Reel/video layouts
* UGC overlays
* Product-focused creative
* Editorial lifestyle creative
* Retargeting creative

Primary sizes will include:

**Feed:** 1080 × 1350 px
**Story / Reel:** 1080 × 1920 px

Some concepts will require both format adaptations.

Editable source files must be supplied for all final creative.

Preferred software:

* Adobe Photoshop
* Adobe Illustrator
* Adobe InDesign where appropriate
* Figma
* Canva only if the work is sophisticated and fully editable

## What We Are Looking For

Please only apply if you have experience in at least some of the following:

* Meta / Facebook / Instagram ad design
* E-commerce creative
* Beauty
* Wellness
* Supplements
* Skincare
* Fashion
* Premium consumer brands
* Direct-response creative

You should understand the difference between:

**A beautiful Instagram post**

and

**A high-performing paid social advertisement.**

We are particularly interested in designers who understand:

* Strong first-frame hooks
* Visual hierarchy
* Product prominence
* Direct-response principles
* Mobile-first design
* UGC-style creative
* Premium editorial layouts
* Creative variation and testing

## Visual Direction

We want to combine:

**Premium editorial design + clear performance advertising.**

Our benchmark is not to copy competitors, but strategically we admire the creative discipline of brands such as Motherkind and Gloot.

We want Elevate to remain visually more refined and premium while adopting stronger direct-response advertising principles.

Think:

**Luxury wellness meets performance marketing.**

## Important: Proposal Test Creative

As part of your proposal, we require **one static concept design** to demonstrate how you would interpret the Elevate Wellness visual direction.

This should be supplied as a **watermarked, low-resolution preview only**.

You do **not** need to supply the editable working file as part of the proposal.

The purpose of this is purely to assess:

* Design quality
* Typography
* Layout
* Brand interpretation
* Product integration
* Visual hierarchy
* Understanding of premium wellness advertising

We will provide the selected concept/reference material required for this test.

Please clearly watermark the artwork with:

**SAMPLE / WATERMARKED**

We will not use proposal artwork commercially unless the designer is formally awarded the project and the artwork becomes part of the contracted scope.

## Test Concept

For the proposal creative, please design a static ad around the following:

### Product

Elevate Wellness Pure Collagen Slim & Glow

### Headline

**GLOW ISN'T ONLY SKINCARE.**

### Subheading

**Beauty starts from within.**

### Supporting benefits

* Skin
* Hair
* Nails
* Everyday Wellness

### CTA

**SHOP SLIM & GLOW**

### Creative Direction

Premium editorial wellness.

Think skincare campaign rather than traditional supplement advertising.

The product should feel elevated, aspirational and luxurious.

Use clean composition, elegant typography, strong product visibility and lifestyle imagery where appropriate.

Avoid clutter.

## What To Include In Your Proposal

Please include:

1. A short introduction about yourself
2. Relevant experience
3. Links to your strongest work
4. Examples of Meta / paid social creative
5. Examples of beauty, wellness or premium lifestyle work if available
6. Your estimated turnaround time for the full project
7. Your proposed project fee
8. Whether revisions are included
9. The software you work in
10. Your watermarked static test creative

Please do **not** send a generic proposal.

We are looking for a designer we can potentially work with on an ongoing basis, so strong creative thinking and attention to detail are important.

## Timeline

We would like to appoint the designer as soon as possible.

Once appointed, we will provide:

* Elevate Wellness logos
* Product packshots
* Brand references
* Existing creative
* Campaign strategy
* Copy
* Detailed ad-by-ad brief

Initial priority creatives will need to be turned around quickly, followed by the remaining campaign assets.

## Potential Ongoing Work

If the project is successful, there is potential for ongoing monthly work across:

* Meta campaigns
* Website banners
* Product campaigns
* Social content
* Promotions
* Influencer creative
* Email marketing
* E-commerce creative
* Seasonal campaigns

We are therefore looking for someone who can become a long-term creative partner rather than only completing one isolated project.

## Final Note

Please only apply if you are comfortable producing a **watermarked test static** as part of your proposal.

We will shortlist based on:

**Creative quality first, followed by experience, speed, communication and cost.**

• File submitted as a Word or Google Doc, along with separate notes containing source contact info and any supporting data spreadsheets.

Timeline is short—I’ll share exact dates once we connect, but expect research to start immediately and the finished draft within ten to twenty days of kickoff. It will be important to have a call with the think tank that is commissioning the work before the project is assigned.

jobs.description:

I’ll provide high-resolution photos, and the physical seal shipped to you for reverse engineering. Experience with rubber component design, tolerance stack-ups, and vacuum service considerations is essential.

Deliverables will be reviewed against the physical part; dimensions must sit within ±0.1 mm on critical sealing edges. Once approved, I’ll release final payment and can offer follow-on work for other chamber components.

jobs.title: Full-cycle B2B Sales Professional Needed - Prospect/Discovery/Close
jobs.description:
Hello there! We are a business solutions agency that leverages AI and automation to close operational gaps, recover lost leads, and capture revenue that would otherwise fall through the cracks.

We're looking for an experienced full-cycle B2B sales professional who can own the process end-to-end—from finding qualified prospects and cold outreach to discovery, follow-up, negotiation, and closing the deal. Please note that we are not looking for a generic appointment setter, but a narrower profile of someone who can prospect + cold call + conduct discovery + negotiate + close + manage GHL.

We want someone who is genuinely good at starting conversations with strangers and turning them into real business relationships. You should be **calm, confident, warm, consultative, and able to listen more than you talk—no aggressive or overly scripted selling.**

### What You'll Do

* Research and build qualified prospect lists based on our ICP.
* Conduct outbound outreach through **cold calls, cold email, LinkedIn, SMS/WhatsApp, and follow-ups**.
*Must be available to conduct outbound calls and prospect conversations during U.S. business hours.
* Identify and engage decision-makers including business owners, CIOs, IT Directors, VPs of IT, Customer Experience leaders, Operations Managers, and other key executives.
* Research prospects and personalize outreach, operational, and revenue challenges.
* Lead professional business conversations, conduct discovery, qualify prospects, and uncover pain points.
* Handle objections, **negotiate, follow up, and confidently move qualified prospects toward a close**.
* Own opportunities from **initial cold outreach through verbal commitment and proposal/offer**.
* Manage the entire pipeline in **GoHighLevel (GHL)**—notes, tasks, follow-ups, appointments, and stages from **Lead → Qualified → Proposal → Closed**.
* Track outreach, conversations, appointments, proposals, and closed business.

### What We're Looking For

* Proven **B2B SDR/BDR, outbound sales, and closing experience**.
* **Excellent spoken English is required.** You do not need a particular accent, but you must be fluent, articulate, clearly understood, and confident communicating with business owners and executives.
* Strong cold-calling, discovery, listening, **negotiation, objection-handling, and closing skills**.
* A **warm, positive, personable communication style**—professional and persuasive without being pushy.
* Able to write personalized cold emails and LinkedIn messages that don't sound generic. We will provide templates and snapshots for follow-ups (GHL)
* Experience with **GoHighLevel (GHL)** or a comparable CRM if that is what you have experience in (we are open to it)
* Self-motivated, organized, persistent, and comfortable working without micromanagement.

* **Experience selling AI, automation, technology, consulting, or business solutions is strongly preferred.**

### Compensation & Engagement

**Compensation: $12–$20/hour based on experience, approximately 20 hours/week, plus uncapped commission on closed business. Strong performance can lead to increased hours.**

This is intended to be a **long-term engagement**, beginning with a **2-week paid trial** to evaluate communication, prospecting ability, outreach quality, consistency, pipeline management, and results.

**Commission is uncapped. Exceed your targets and you earn more.**

We're a small, agile team. We move fast, trust each other, and **measure success by results—not hours sitting at a desk.**

Most importantly, we don't push technology just to make a sale. **We win when the client gets the right solution for their business.**

### To Apply

Please include:

1. A **60–90 second voice sample** introducing yourself and demonstrating how you would naturally open a cold conversation with a business owner or executive.
2. Have you previously cold-called and sold to U.S.-based business owners or executives? If yes, briefly describe the type of prospects, what you sold, and your results.
3. ** Briefly describe the a cold outbound prospect from initial outreach through closing?** 
4. Tell us about any experience selling **AI, automation, SaaS, technology, consulting, or business solutions**.
5. Your experience with **GoHighLevel (GHL)** or other CRMs.
6. Your typical results from previous roles—meetings booked, opportunities generated, deals closed, or revenue generated.

**Applications without a voice sample will not be considered.**

jobs.title: Desenvolvimento de Aplicação com Interface Gráfica para Geração Automática de Projetos no Tia Portal
jobs.description:
Desenvolvimento de uma aplicação com interface gráfica para configuração e geração automática de projetos no Siemens TIA Portal, utilizando a API TIA Portal Openness. A interface permitirá ao usuário modelar a planta de forma visual e tabular, cadastrar equipamentos, regras, fórmulas e bandeiras, definir a hierarquia do software e gerar o projeto sem editar códigos ou arquivos internos manualmente.

O sistema deverá criar e organizar FCs, FBs, DBs e OBs, incluindo OBs adicionais de diferentes tipos. As FCs poderão ser chamadas pela função de nível anterior da hierarquia ou diretamente por um OB. Para cada versão suportada do TIA Portal, serão aplicadas regras específicas de compatibilidade e geração.

Nas chamadas de FC, todos os parâmetros Input, Output, InOut e o retorno, quando diferente de Void, deverão possuir associação válida. Nas chamadas de FB, os parâmetros poderão permanecer sem associação, mas será obrigatória a definição da Instance DB. O sistema identificará se a FB utiliza acesso otimizado e, caso não utilize, permitirá configurar a retenção da Instance DB. Apenas FBs e DBs poderão possuir Optimized Access; nas DBs, Retain somente será permitido quando o acesso otimizado estiver desabilitado.

As entradas poderão receber variáveis diretamente ou, quando o resultado esperado for Bool, expressões com AND, OR, NOT e comparações. Saídas, InOut e retornos aceitarão somente variáveis diretas e graváveis, respeitando a compatibilidade de tipos.

A aplicação também oferecerá fórmulas reutilizáveis de preenchimento condicional, capazes de consultar valores da tabela por linha e coluna, e bandeiras como ::TAG, ::DESCRICAO e ::ID, substituídas conforme regras cadastradas. Antes da geração, serão validados campos obrigatórios, tipos, nomes, endereços, expressões, bandeiras, duplicidades e compatibilidade com o TIA. O resultado será uma estrutura padronizada, rastreável, repetível e pronta para compilação e complementação no TIA Portal.

jobs.title: Branding, AI Videos & UI/UX
jobs.description:
My project blends three creative streams—graphic design, AI-driven video production, and end-to-end UI/UX work—into one cohesive brand experience.

Graphic design comes first. I need a new logo in multiple orientations and file formats, a small package of marketing collateral (social banners, one-page flyer, basic slide deck template), plus a set of web-ready graphics that match the style guide we’ll refine together.

In parallel, I want to experiment with AI video creation. I don’t have the exact format locked in yet, so please be comfortable suggesting whether explainer, short social media snippets, or product-centric clips make the most sense once you see the storyboard and copy. I can supply script drafts and brand assets; you guide the prompt engineering, voice-over options, and post-production polish.

Finally, the website and companion mobile screens need a clean, intuitive UI/UX layer. Wireframes exist, but I need you to turn them into pixel-perfect Figma or Adobe XD mock-ups, complete with component libraries and responsive breakpoints.

Deliverables  
• Logo suite + mini brand guide  
• Marketing collateral (banner, flyer, slide template)  
• Web graphics in optimized formats  
• 2-3 polished AI-generated videos (length TBD)  
• High-fidelity UI/UX prototypes with asset library

Acceptance  

I’ll consider the job complete when:  
– Graphic assets pass an accessibility contrast check and export cleanly for print and web.  
– AI videos meet the agreed storyboard, stay on-brand, and render at 1080p without artifacts.  
– UI/UX files include clearly named layers, reusable components, and responsive testing notes.

Preferred tools: Figma or Adobe XD for UI/UX, Adobe CC for static graphics, and your AI platform of choice (Runway, Synthesia, Stable Diffusion, etc.) for video, provided source files or prompt logs are shared for iteration.

If this mix of branding, AI content creation, and interface design excites you, let’s sync and map out milestones right away.

jobs.title: Realistic Whimsical Fairy Illustrations
