Please provide samples of your previous work, particularly any related to children's literature or fantasy themes. Looking forward to your bids!

jobs.title: 1-Year Excel Budget Forecast Model
jobs.description:
I need a flexible Excel model that lets me plan and track our budget over the next 12 months. The workbook should generate a dynamic Income Statement, Balance Sheet, and Cash Flow Statement that link together automatically, updating whenever I adjust key drivers such as sales volume, pricing, cost of goods, operating expenses, and capital spending.

Core requirements  
• All three statements roll forward month-by-month for one full year and balance correctly.  
• Key assumptions sit on a single input sheet with clear labels and color-coding.  
• Built-in sensitivity toggles so I can test best-, base-, and worst-case scenarios without breaking formulas.  
• Clean, readable formatting: consistent decimals, thousands separators, and no hidden cells or hard-coded numbers in the calculation sheets.  
• The file must open flawlessly in the latest desktop versions of Excel (Office 365) without the need for macros; structured references and simple lookup functions are fine.

Acceptance criteria  
1. I can plug new assumptions into the input sheet and see all three statements update instantly.  
2. Each statement ties out (e.g., Net Income flows to Equity, ending cash equals beginning cash plus net change).  
3. No formula errors (#REF!, #DIV/0!, etc.) when assumptions are changed.  
4. Workbook passes a quick stress test with extreme inputs.

Please share a brief outline of your approach and an example of a similar model you have built so I can gauge fit and style.

jobs.title: Android Game Development
jobs.description:
I want to bring a new game to life on Android. The core goal is a fully functional mobile game, from initial concept refinement all the way to a build ready for release on Google Play.

What I need you to handle:
• Game design and mechanics: help shape or polish the gameplay loop so it feels engaging and replayable.  
• Art and audio integration: source or create graphics, animations, and sound effects that match the style we agree on.  
• Coding and optimization: build the game in Unity, Unreal, or another Android-friendly engine, ensuring smooth performance across common devices.  
• Basic monetisation hooks: integrate ads or in-app purchases if they fit the concept.  
• Testing and bug fixing: run device tests, iron out crashes, and prepare a release-ready APK/AAB.  
• Store-ready package: craft the store listing materials (icon, screenshots, short description) so I can publish without extra steps.

I’ll provide my initial idea and any reference games I like. From you I expect clear milestones, transparent progress updates, and source files on final delivery. If you love building Android games and can guide the project from concept to launch, let’s get started!

jobs.title: SVG Brochure Vector Conversion
jobs.description:
I have a two-page brochure sitting in SVG files and I need it rebuilt from scratch in CorelDRAW so every element remains fully editable. From that master .cdr file, please export a clean, press-ready vector PDF.

My goal is an almost pixel-perfect match to the original; the only changes will be minor tweaks such as tidying alignment or fixing some lines of text—nothing that alters the overall design language. The final PDF has to work for both high-resolution CMYK printing and lightweight digital sharing, so font handling and reasonable file size matter.

Deliverables  
• CorelDRAW (.cdr) file with organised layers and editable text  
• Vector PDF optimised for print and screen  

Acceptance criteria  
• Visual match to the SVGs within 1–2 px tolerance  
• All text, shapes, and colours editable in the CorelDRAW file  
• PDF passes Adobe Acrobat Preflight without warnings  

I’d like to wrap this up quickly; let me know how soon you can start and showcase any similar CorelDRAW conversion work you’ve done.

jobs.title: Sleek One-Page Transport Website
jobs.description:

Primary goal  
The page should focus on providing information about our services in a concise, visually appealing way. No multi-page menus or clutter; one scroll is all it takes.

Key content to include

• Prominent contact information and our depot’s location, ideally with an embedded map and click-to-call functionality

What I’d like from you

Acceptance criteria

2. Displays flawlessly on the latest versions of Chrome, Safari, Edge, and Firefox.  
3. All contact links and the map work as expected.

jobs.title: AI Anime Rom-Com Video Creation
jobs.description:

The storyline, voice-over and music are ready on my side; what I’m missing is the animated component—stylish, colorful, and unmistakably “anime” in look and feel.

Your job is to handle the full visual pipeline: prompt-crafting or fine-tuning the model, creating fluid motion, adding subtle character expressions, and delivering a final 1080p (or higher) MP4 that matches the timing of my audio track. If you prefer working in Stable Diffusion, Runway, AnimateDiff, or a comparable platform, just let me know; I’m flexible as long as the end product is smooth and on-model throughout.

To keep things organised, I’ll provide a rough storyboard and the voice track once we start. In return, I need:
• The completed 1–2 minute video, fully synced to my audio  
• Source project files or prompts for future edits  
• Two short (10-second) teasers trimmed from the finished piece for channel promotion  

Deliver on those three points and we’re good. Looking forward to seeing how you bring this rom-com concept to life with AI animation magic!

Send a Sample videos.

jobs.title: Multimedia Editing: Video, Audio, Photos
jobs.description:
I have a batch of raw assets that need a clean, professional polish across video, audio, and still images. Here’s the scope:

• Video – I’ll supply several short clips that simply need precise cutting and trimming so the pacing feels tight and engaging. After that, I want a cinematic colour grade applied to give the footage a consistent look across all scenes. I usually work in Adobe Premiere Pro and DaVinci Resolve, so files that remain compatible with those apps will be easiest for me to review.

• Audio – Each clip already has dialogue recorded; I just need a tasteful layer of background music mixed underneath it. Levels should ride naturally so voices stay clear while the music supports the mood. If you prefer Audition, Logic, or similar tools, that’s fine—just deliver the final stem as a high-quality WAV plus a version married to picture.

• Photos – I have a small set of images that need simple but accurate cropping to match specific aspect ratios. No other retouching is required this time.

Deliverables:
1. Final video file(s) in H.264 plus the editable project file.
2. Separate WAV music stem and a flattened audio-mixed video track.
3. Cropped JPEG/PNG images in the requested resolutions.
4. A brief changelog so I can see what you adjusted at a glance.

If you need any sample files up front, let me know and I’ll share a link right away. Looking forward to seeing your creative yet precise touch on this content.

jobs.title: Wix Studio + Wix Bookings Developer Needed for Custom Youth Program Registration System
jobs.description:
Wix Studio + Wix Bookings Developer Needed for Custom Youth Program Registration System

We are developing Kidletic Sports, a youth enrichment and sports platform, and are looking for an experienced Wix Studio developer with strong Wix Bookings and Velo experience to complete the program registration portion of our website.

The main marketing website and mobile designs are already substantially developed. This project is specifically focused on implementing a streamlined program discovery, registration, payment, and administration system using Wix Bookings as the core platform.

This is not a project to build an entirely custom booking system from scratch. We want to take advantage of Wix Bookings, Wix Members, Wix Payments, Wix CMS, and other native Wix functionality wherever possible, using Velo/custom development only where necessary.

The system will generally need to support parents being able to search for nearby programs, view program information, register a child, provide required participant information, accept/sign required waivers, pay online, and receive confirmation.

On the administrative side, authorized staff will need to create and manage programs, schedules, locations, capacity, registrations, rosters, attendance, and communications with registered families.

There will also be some custom functionality around the Program Finder, including location-based searching and filtering.

Developer We Are Looking For

We are specifically looking for someone with demonstrated experience in:

* Wix Studio
* Wix Bookings
* Wix Members
* Wix Payments / Wix checkout
* Wix CMS
* Velo
* Custom search/filter interfaces
* Mobile-responsive Wix development
* Wix roles and permissions
* Integrating custom front-end experiences with Wix-native backend functionality

Experience building registration systems for classes, camps, courses, sports programs, events, or similar businesses would be particularly valuable.

The approved mobile UI mockups have already been created. The goal is to reproduce the Kidletic customer experience closely while avoiding unnecessary custom development where Wix already provides reliable functionality.

IMPORTANT: Please do not propose moving the system to WordPress or another platform. We have already made the decision to build the MVP using Wix Studio + Wix Bookings.

When Applying

Please include:

1. Examples of Wix Studio projects you have personally developed.
2. Examples specifically involving Wix Bookings and/or Velo.
3. A brief explanation of your experience customizing Wix Bookings beyond its standard interface.
4. Your availability and approximate turnaround time for an MVP of this type.
5. Whether you are interested in ongoing Wix development work after this initial project.

Do not provide a final price based solely on this posting.

I will shortlist approximately 3–5 qualified developers. Those developers will receive our detailed Version 1.1 requirements document and mobile screen mockups and will then be asked to provide a final scope, timeline, and fixed-price proposal.

We are looking for someone who can not only complete this project efficiently, but potentially become our long-term Wix development resource as Kidletic Sports grows.

jobs.title: Budget Restaurant Concept & Elevations
jobs.description:
I am developing a cost-conscious yet memorable restaurant that combines three distinct experiences under one roof: an all-day dining area, a playful game zone, and a versatile banquet hall, capped by an inviting rooftop. I need a modern concept package that ties the whole property together while making each zone feel special.

Scope of work  
You will translate my functional brief into an integrated concept that includes:  
• A complete space-planning layout showing dining, kitchen, circulation, game zone, banquet hall, rooftop seating, services, and back-of-house.  
• Mood-board level interior concepts for every zone, clearly illustrating palette, finishes, furniture style, and accent features.  
• Exterior elevations that give the building a fresh, contemporary street presence.  
• A signature selfie point that encourages social-media sharing.  
• Strategies for unique, cost-efficient lighting and pockets of greenery that flow organically through the project.  

What I value  
Creativity is vital, but solutions must stay mindful of budget—smart material choices, modular furniture ideas, and multipurpose design moves will be key. The concept should feel cohesive from curbside to rooftop, offering guests a seamless “wow” moment at every step.

Deliverables & acceptance  
1. Annotated master layout (PDF + CAD).  
2. 3D perspective renders (minimum 2 per zone).  
3. Colored elevations (front and side).  
4. Material / lighting specification sheets with indicative costs or local equivalents.  
5. One hero rendering of the selfie point.  
Final files should arrive print-ready and editable.

If this sounds exciting, show me a concise portfolio sample that proves you can balance flair with frugality, and let’s create a destination our guests will love to photograph—and return to.

jobs.title: Elementor Builder for Ecommerce Website

jobs.title: Investor-Ready Farm Layout Design

Key features to map: expansive crop and field sections, well-organised livestock zones, and the main farmhouse with its supporting outbuildings. I’m leaning toward a calm, neutral palette to keep the focus on land use and ROI rather than flashy colours, so please avoid bright or cartoon tones.

When you send the first draft, I’ll review placement of each element against our acreage numbers and provide any tweaks. Final acceptance hinges on clarity, accuracy to my acreage notes, and the neutral colour harmony described above.

I can provide a map overview of the property with dimensions of placement of each building

jobs.title: Sales-Focused Promo Showcase Website
jobs.description:

Central to the build will be promotional content sections that spotlight each client’s products or services. Think hero areas with eye-catching imagery, concise copy blocks, and prominent “Buy Now” or “Book Today” buttons. I want these showcases to be easy for me to update later, so a user-friendly CMS (WordPress, Webflow or a lightweight custom admin) is preferred, provided it remains fast and mobile-responsive.

Key deliverables  
• Intuitive admin panel to add or edit promotional content without coding  
• Basic on-page SEO setup so new businesses gain initial search traction  
• Clear analytics integration (Google Analytics or similar) to track sales conversions  
• Launch support to ensure the site is live, error-free, and ready for traffic

If you have a proven track record turning promotional pages into measurable sales, I’d love to see examples. Let’s create a site that new businesses can rely on from day one.

jobs.title: Social Networking App for iOS & Android
jobs.description:
Full-Stack Mobile Developer / Development Team Needed – iOS & Android Social Networking App
Project Overview

We are looking for an experienced mobile app developer or development company to build a full-featured social networking application for both iOS and Android, taking the project from concept and UI implementation through development, testing, deployment, and App Store/Google Play release.

The app will focus on three core areas:

Social News Feed
User Profiles & Social Connections
Real-Time Messaging

We are open to working with either an individual senior developer, small development team, or established software development company with proven experience building scalable social networking or community-based applications.

Core Features
1. Social News Feed
Text, image, and short-video posts
Like, comment, and engagement functionality
Real-time updates
User-generated content
Feed pagination/infinite scrolling
Basic content reporting/moderation capabilities
Scalable architecture for future AI-powered ranking and moderation
2. User Profiles
User registration and authentication
Editable profile and bio
Profile/avatar image upload
Followers and following functionality
Privacy settings
Public/private profile options
User blocking and reporting
3. Real-Time Messaging
One-to-one private messaging
Group conversations
Real-time message delivery
Push notifications
Read receipts
Image/video/media sharing
Message timestamps
Basic chat management and privacy controls
Technology

We are flexible regarding the technology stack. You may recommend the best approach based on performance, scalability, development speed, and long-term maintainability.

Possible technologies include:

Flutter
React Native
Native iOS – Swift
Native Android – Kotlin

Backend can use technologies such as:

Node.js / Python / Java or equivalent
Firebase
AWS
PostgreSQL / MySQL / MongoDB or equivalent scalable database
Cloud storage and notification services

The architecture should be secure, scalable, well-documented, and ready for future AI integration.

Required Deliverables
Clickable UI/UX prototype for final approval
Fully functional production-ready iOS application
Fully functional production-ready Android application
TestFlight deployment for iOS
Google Play Internal Testing deployment
Clean and documented source code
Private Git repository
Backend APIs and database implementation
Deployment scripts and cloud infrastructure
Push notification and messaging infrastructure
Unit and integration testing
App Store and Google Play submission support
Technical documentation and project handover guide
Post-launch support for critical bug fixes
Acceptance Criteria

The completed application must:

Perform smoothly on current supported iOS and Android versions
Successfully support a closed beta of approximately 50 users for 14 consecutive days without critical crashes
Meet Apple App Store and Google Play requirements
Pass App Store and Google Play review
Follow secure coding and data protection best practices
Have a clean and maintainable codebase
Include appropriate unit/integration tests
Be scalable for future users and features
Be architected to support future AI-based recommendation, ranking, and moderation modules
Ideal Candidate / Company

We are looking for someone with:

Proven experience developing social networking or community applications
Strong experience with Flutter, React Native, Swift, or Kotlin
Strong backend/API development experience
Experience with real-time chat and messaging systems
Experience with push notifications
Experience with media uploads and cloud storage
Experience with Firebase/AWS or similar cloud infrastructure
Experience publishing applications to both App Store and Google Play
Strong understanding of mobile security and scalable architecture
Good communication and project management skills
Ability to work independently and meet agreed milestones
Bonus Experience

Experience with:

AI-powered recommendation systems
AI content moderation
Social media/news feed algorithms
Video processing
Analytics and user engagement tracking
CI/CD and automated mobile deployment
Proposal Requirements

When applying, please provide:

A brief introduction about yourself/company
Examples of similar social networking apps you have developed
Links to apps currently available on the App Store or Google Play
Recommended technology stack and why
Estimated development timeline
Estimated project cost or milestone-based pricing
Team members who will work on the project
Availability and expected weekly hours
Post-launch support terms
Any questions or recommendations regarding the project

Please do not submit a generic proposal. Applications without relevant mobile/social networking experience may not be considered.

We already have wireframes/project requirements available and are ready to begin the first sprint with the right developer or development team.

We are open to both individual freelancers and professional development companies.

jobs.title: Greek Tax Filing & Rectification
jobs.description:
I need a freelance accountant to handle a self-contained piece of work: an amended income tax return (τροποποιητική δήλωση) for tax year 2025.

The situation

An account with a Cyprus-based, CySEC-regulated investment platform, opened January 2025, was not declared on the original 2025 return. Roughly €6,750 of securities purchases and about €180 of interest and dividend income need to be brought in. The correction is voluntary, ahead of the DAC2/CRS exchange.

What I need someone comfortable with

Τεκμήρια απόκτησης on foreign securities purchases (Art. 32) and the coverage rules of Art. 34 §2
The dependent-child provisions of Art. 11 and the abolition of the €3,000 minimum objective expense under ν.5246/2025 Art. 7
Late δήλωση δωρεάς for family funds and the Category A exemption
Foreign interest and dividend income with withholding tax credits
DAC2/CRS reporting and what ΑΑΔΕ actually receives

What's ready

Complete broker documentation: annual statement, full activity statement with every trade itemised, year-end confirmation of holdings, and the transactions file. Purchase and sale totals are already computed to the cent. This is not a shoebox of receipts.

Practicalities

Small file, clearly scoped, no ongoing bookkeeping. Remote is fine. text-based communication acceptable. Coordination with a second amended return on the family side may be needed. I'd like to move fast.

Please quote a fixed fee for the engagement.

jobs.title: Micro-Influencer Campaign Manager
jobs.description:
I need a sharp virtual assistant who can jump in within the next 24 hours, scout the right micro-influencers, and keep a ten-day performance campaign running smoothly. The product line is technology gadgets, and the target audience sits squarely in the USA lifestyle space—think meme pages with heavy traffic and creators whose content feels native to everyday life.  

Platforms  
Your hunt should focus on Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok. I care far less about follower count or textbook engagement metrics than I do about real conversions; anyone who can reliably bring sales to the table is fair game.  

Goal & Timeline  
The campaign window is fixed at ten days, with a clear target of 500+ verified purchases. We’ll measure success through unique coupon codes or tracked links—whatever is easiest for you to manage and for me to validate.  

Core responsibilities  
• Compile and vet a roster of high-potential micro-influencers and meme pages.  
• Negotiate collaboration terms, secure posting dates, and supply them with trackable links/codes.  
• Oversee content scheduling, making sure each post goes live as planned.  
• Monitor daily performance, double-checking purchases against influencer links.  
• Provide concise end-of-day reports so we can tweak spend or creative on the fly.  

Deliverables  
1. A shareable sheet listing each influencer’s handle, niche, audience geography, engagement snapshot, agreed deliverables, and ready for performance based campagin
2. Outreach logs and confirmation screenshots for every secured placement.  
3. Daily performance tracker showing clicks, conversions, and cumulative verified purchases.  
4. A wrap-up report at day ten summarizing total sales, ROI, and recommendations for scaling.  

If you’re confident you can lock in the right creators and keep the numbers moving, let’s get started today.

jobs.title: Asesoría en Gestión de Servicios TI, ITIL, KPIs y Mejora Operativa -- 2
jobs.description:
Busco un consultor con experiencia en gestión de servicios TI, ITIL, operación de mesas o torres de soporte, gestión de incidentes, capacidad, productividad, indicadores y mejora continua.

Actualmente me encuentro gestionando un servicio TI y requiero asesoría para revisar y fortalecer el modelo operativo del equipo.

A alto nivel, necesito apoyo en los siguientes frentes:

Definición y mejora de indicadores de gestión del servicio.
Análisis de capacidad y dimensionamiento de recursos.
Evaluación de productividad y carga de trabajo del equipo.
Reducción de tickets reabiertos y mejora de la calidad de atención.
Gestión y transferencia de conocimiento entre analistas.
Definición de funciones entre supervisores, líder técnico y equipos senior.
Elaboración o revisión de matriz RACI.
Gestión de incidentes críticos y escalamiento.
Identificación de oportunidades de automatización.

Evaluación de posibles casos de uso de Inteligencia Artificial aplicada a la gestión de incidentes.
Aprovechamiento de información disponible en Power BI para mejorar la toma de decisiones.

Los detalles específicos del servicio, problemática actual, indicadores y estructura del equipo serán explicados durante la coordinación con los candidatos seleccionados.

jobs.title: 950 Product Images Sourcing & Upload
jobs.description:
My e-commerce catalogue holds 950 individual products, yet many of them are still missing a polished, on-brand image. I need every single SKU paired with a high-quality photograph that feels consistent with our current brand theme before being uploaded into the website’s product record.

You are free to pull legitimate product images from any reliable source—manufacturer websites, reputable stock libraries, even client-provided archives—so long as the final result is an accurate representation of the item and we have the right to use it commercially. Each file has to be optimised for web (reasonable weight, descriptive file name, alt text) and must display perfectly across desktop and mobile.

jobs.title: Resto Menu Pro Digital Designer
jobs.description:
## Resto Menu Pro – Motion Graphics & Digital Signage Template Designer

We are looking for a **creative Motion Graphics / Digital Signage Designer** to create **20 professional templates** using our own online design studio for **Resto Menu Pro**.

### About Resto Menu Pro

Resto Menu Pro is a digital signage and restaurant menu platform used for:

* Digital restaurant menu boards
* Advertising displays
* Promotional screens
* Video walls
* Multi-screen installations
* Retail and business signage

Our system can combine multiple screens into **one large synchronized display**, so some designs will span across several TVs as one continuous canvas.

You can see an example of a basic single-screen restaurant menu here:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LpkIxi35e-A

Our Designer Studio:

https://dashboard.restoscreen.ca/designers

Login credentials will be provided privately to the selected freelancer.

---

## What We Need

We need a designer who is comfortable with:

* Motion graphics
* Video editing
* Digital signage
* Menu board design
* Flyers and promotional graphics
* Figma or similar design tools
* Layer-based design
* Animating objects
* Working with video backgrounds
* Creating designs for unusual/wide screen resolutions

The work must be created **inside our Resto Menu Pro Designer Studio**.

We already created the projects, screen grids, orientations, and different canvas sizes for you. You will mainly focus on the actual creative design.

---

## 20 Template Categories

We want approximately 20 different professional templates, including:

1. Auto Showroom / Car Dealership
2. Ceramic Café
3. Barbershop
4. Warm Coffee House
5. Phone Repair / Technology Store
6. Burger Restaurant
7. Doner / Shawarma Restaurant
8. Fast-Food Restaurant
9. Falafel Restaurant
10. Convenience / Mini Market similar to 7-Eleven
11. Pizza Restaurant
12. Massage Therapy / Spa
13. Pharmacy / Drug Store
14. Vape Store
15. Tattoo Shop
16. Hotel
17. Photography Studio / Store
18. Fishing / Outdoor Shop
19. Government / Public Service Location
20. Religious / Community Location

We are open to creative ideas for each industry.

---

## Motion & Effects

Our designer supports video, images, text, menu items, layers, animations, and effects.

For example, you may use:

* Fire effects
* Smoke
* Steam
* Moving food
* Animated drinks
* Flying ingredients
* Animated promotional text
* Product transitions
* Moving logos
* Video backgrounds
* Object movement from one position to another

For example, you could place a **fire-effect video with a black background over a barbecue/grill layer**, remove the black background using our designer tools, and position the fire directly over the grill.

You can also animate content from one point of the canvas to another.

We want the templates to feel alive and professional without becoming distracting.

---

## Restaurant Templates – Important

For restaurant templates, you should use our built-in menu integration whenever appropriate.

Our Designer Studio allows you to select:

* A single menu item
* A category of menu items
* Multiple items
* Menu content from the restaurant database

For example, instead of manually typing the price and name of a burger, you should use the actual **Menu Item element** where appropriate.

This allows the restaurant to change the product name, image, price, availability, discount, etc. without redesigning the template.

This is an important requirement.

---

## Horizontal + Vertical Versions

Each design should be adaptable to both:

* **Horizontal / Landscape**
* **Vertical / Portrait**

The designs should remain visually consistent while being properly rearranged for each orientation.

Do not simply stretch the horizontal layout into a vertical layout. It should be redesigned intelligently for the available space.

---

## Multi-Screen Video Wall Design

A major part of Resto Menu Pro is our multi-screen system.

For horizontal designs, one of the important layouts will be a **three-screen video wall**.

Each TV is:

**1920 × 1080**

Three TVs side-by-side create one large canvas:

**5760 × 1080**

Your design should take advantage of the entire width.

For example:

**Screen 1 → Screen 2 → Screen 3**

An animation could begin on Screen 1, travel across Screen 2, and finish on Screen 3.

Food, cars, text, effects, backgrounds, or other objects can move naturally across the entire three-screen wall.

The three screens should look like **one large coordinated advertisement**, not three unrelated screens.

---

## Projects Are Already Prepared

You do **not** need to create all the screen sizes or grid projects yourself.

We have already prepared projects for the different:

* Screen sizes
* Orientations
* Industries
* Video-wall configurations

You can open the prepared projects and start designing.

---

## Style & Quality

We are looking for designs that look commercially usable in real businesses.

The templates should be:

* Modern
* Professional
* Attractive
* Easy to read from a distance
* Appropriate for large TVs
* Visually balanced
* Smoothly animated
* Not overloaded with effects
* Designed specifically for digital signage

Restaurant designs should make the food look especially appealing and appetizing.

---

## Deliverables

The initial project is for **20 template concepts** created in our Designer Studio.

Templates should include the required horizontal/vertical layouts and multi-screen versions according to the project setup we provide.

We will review the templates during development and provide feedback.

---

## Long-Term Opportunity

This is not necessarily a one-time project.

Resto Menu Pro customers can request **custom designs for their own businesses**.

If you produce high-quality work and understand our Designer Studio well, we would like to continue sending you paid custom-design projects from our customers.

We are therefore looking for someone interested in becoming a **long-term designer for the Resto Menu Pro platform**.

---

## When Applying

Please send:

* Examples of your motion graphics work
* Digital signage examples, if available
* Restaurant menu designs, if available
* Video advertisements
* Figma or similar UI/design work
* Multi-screen/video-wall work, if you have done it
* Examples of animated promotional content

Please also tell us which software you normally use, such as:

**After Effects, Premiere Pro, Figma, Photoshop, Illustrator, DaVinci Resolve, Canva, Blender, or similar tools.**

### Project Name

**Resto Menu Pro – Digital Signage & Motion Template Designer**

We are looking for someone with strong **creative design skills**, not only a web developer.

If you understand motion graphics, advertising design, digital signage, restaurant menus, and large multi-screen layouts, we would like to hear from you.

jobs.title: News Content Creators for Digital Channel
jobs.description:
Unfiltered Lokshahhi – Fast News Content Team

I am launching a new digital news/media channel called Unfiltered Lokshahhi and I am looking to build a small team of independent freelancers, rather than hiring one person to handle everything.

Because this is a news channel, speed is extremely important. I cannot wait several days for a news story to be edited and delivered. I want to create a system where multiple freelancers can work independently and take up news assignments according to their availability.

 Starting Budget – ₹500 Per News Story

As I am starting the channel, my current budget is limited.

My starting budget is ₹500 per completed news content package.

One news package will include:

1. 3-slide social media news post

- Instagram
- Facebook
- Branded Unfiltered Lokshahhi design
- Catchy headline + concise news content

2. 1 vertical short video

- YouTube Shorts
- Instagram Reel
- Same core video can be adapted for both platforms

3. 1 horizontal YouTube video

- Standard YouTube format
- News-focused presentation
- Suitable text, images/video clips and branding

The objective is to take one news story and quickly turn it into content for multiple platforms.

SPEED IS VERY IMPORTANT

This is the most important part of the project.

News cannot wait for days.

When I provide a news story, I want the assigned freelancer to start working on it and deliver the content as quickly as reasonably possible.

I am looking for freelancers who can handle same-day/rapid-turnaround news content, depending on the urgency of the story.

The exact turnaround time can be mutually agreed upon, but applicants should understand that this is news-media work, not a normal design project where delivery can take several days.

I WANT MULTIPLE INDEPENDENT FREELANCERS

I do not want to depend on one person or one agency/team.

I want to build a pool of multiple independent freelancers.

For example:

- Freelancer A – available in the morning
- Freelancer B – available in the afternoon
- Freelancer C – available in the evening
- Freelancer D – available for urgent/breaking news
- Freelancer E – additional backup

When a news story comes in, I can assign it to whoever is available.

This will allow Unfiltered Lokshahhi to operate continuously without depending on a single editor.
 IMPORTANT – EVERYONE MUST FOLLOW THE SAME BRANDING

Although I want multiple independent freelancers, the final page should look like it is produced by one professional media organization.

Therefore, I want all selected freelancers to work using the same applications, templates, fonts, branding elements and design language.

I will maintain a central collection of:

- Unfiltered Lokshahhi logo
- Fonts
- Brand elements
- 3-slide templates
- Reel/Short templates
- YouTube templates
- Intro/outro elements
- Thumbnail templates
- Other reusable design assets

The freelancers will be expected to use and update the approved templates rather than creating a completely different design every time.

SHARED TEMPLATES & WORKFLOW

I want to establish a shared workflow where freelancers can work on the same template system.

For example:

News received → Content prepared → Assigned to available freelancer → Freelancer edits using approved template → Final quality check → Published

If Freelancer A creates an improvement to a template, that template can be shared with Freelancer B, C and D.

This means that everyone gradually works from the same design system, even though they are independent freelancers.

PLATFORMS

The initial focus will be:

- Instagram
- YouTube
- YouTube Shorts
- Facebook

Later, I plan to expand the content operation and introduce more advanced graphics, photographs, motion graphics, voiceovers and professional video production.

THIS IS A LONG-TERM PROJECT

I am not looking for someone for just one or two assignments.

I want to build a reliable pool of freelancers who can receive regular work whenever they are available.

The channel is new, so the initial budget is tight. However, my intention is to gradually increase:

- Number of news stories
- Content quality
- Production value
- Work volume
- Freelancer compensation
- Number of people in the creative team

The people who join at the beginning and help establish the system can potentially receive regular long-term work as the channel grows.
PLEASE INCLUDE IN YOUR PROPOSAL

Please send:

1. Your portfolio
2. Examples of news/social-media content you have created
3. Your experience with Reels/Shorts/YouTube videos
4. Which editing/design applications you use
5. Your average turnaround time for a news story
6. Whether you are comfortable with the ₹500 starting package
7. Your availability – morning/evening/full day/occasional
8. Whether you can handle urgent/breaking-news assignments
9. Whether you are comfortable working with shared templates and a common brand system
10. Whether you are interested in a long-term association
What I Am Really Looking For

I am not simply looking for the cheapest editor.

I am looking for fast, reliable and creative freelancers who understand that news content needs to be produced quickly and consistently.

I want to build a network of independent freelancers working together under one common Unfiltered Lokshahhi design system.

jobs.title: NiTi Rotary File Deformation FEA
jobs.description:
I need a finite element analysis that concentrates on how nickel-titanium rotary files deform while they are cleaning and shaping root canals. The work revolves around capturing realistic clinical loading—torsion, cyclic bending and combined stresses—and converting those conditions into a reliable 3-D simulation.  

I will supply the CAD geometry I currently use chairside, plus any torque-speed data recorded from the endodontic motor. You would:

• refine or rebuild the mesh so the file’s variable taper and helical flute are accurately represented,  
• assign appropriate super-elastic NiTi material properties (including transformation strains),  
• apply canal-wall contact and a rotating-bending load path that mimics the shaping motion, and  
• deliver contour plots, quantitative deformation results and a concise written interpretation of where excessive flex or plastic strain is likely to initiate.  

The study is complete once I can compare predicted tip displacement and strain distribution against my empirical observations from high-speed video and discarded files. All modelling can be performed in ANSYS, Abaqus, COMSOL or a comparable solver—as long as the final files and a brief methods report are shared so I can replicate them later.

jobs.title: Expert Amazon Private Label Product Finder & Launcher
jobs.description:
AMAZON PRIVATE LABEL VA / PRODUCT RESEARCH & LAUNCH EXPERT – PROVEN RESULTS ONLY

NO BEGINNERS. NO TRAINING. NO EXPERIMENTS.

I am looking for an experienced Amazon Private Label expert/VA who has already successfully launched products on Amazon USA and can demonstrate actual results.

This is NOT a basic Amazon VA position where you simply upload listings, answer messages, or perform repetitive tasks.

I need someone who can take a product from research and sourcing through listing creation, launch, PPC, optimization, and sales.

RESPONSIBILITIES

1. PRODUCT RESEARCH

You will be responsible for finding profitable Amazon product opportunities.

Products should ideally have:

* Strong existing demand
* Manageable competition
* Selling price around $25–$50+
* Healthy profit margins
* Reasonable FBA fees
* Small/lightweight dimensions where possible
* Low return and breakage risk
* No complicated regulatory requirements
* Private-label potential
* Clear opportunities for differentiation
* Potential to expand into related products
* Sustainable demand rather than short-term trends

You must be able to explain WHY you believe a product has potential.

I do not want someone sending me dozens of random products and asking me to choose. I want you to conduct the research and recommend the products you would personally invest in.

2. COMPETITOR AND MARKET RESEARCH

For each serious product opportunity, you should analyze:

* Amazon search results
* Top competitors
* Estimated sales
* Revenue
* BSR
* Price
* Price history
* Number and quality of reviews
* Competitor weaknesses
* Listing quality
* Images
* Customer complaints
* Product differentiation opportunities
* Market size
* Seasonality
* Brand concentration
* PPC competitiveness
* FBA fees
* Estimated profit
* Estimated ROI

Recommendations must be data-driven.

3. PRODUCT SOURCING

Once we identify a promising product, you will:

* Find multiple suppliers
* Research Alibaba and Chinese manufacturers
* Compare supplier pricing
* Check MOQ
* Check customization options
* Check packaging
* Check certifications where applicable
* Negotiate pricing where possible
* Calculate estimated landed cost
* Identify opportunities to improve the product
* Recommend packaging and branding

I also have access to U.S. wholesale suppliers, so you should be able to determine whether a product should first be tested through a U.S. supplier before moving to China.

The goal is to validate products with minimal risk before committing significant capital.

4. PRIVATE LABEL AND BRANDING

You will help develop products into genuine private-label Amazon products.

This includes:

* Product positioning
* Brand positioning
* Product differentiation
* Packaging recommendations
* Product inserts where appropriate
* Branding
* Product variations
* Pack sizes
* Colors and styles
* Bundling opportunities

I am not interested in simply copying existing Amazon listings. I want products with a legitimate reason for customers to choose ours.

5. AMAZON LISTING CREATION

You will be responsible for complete Amazon listings, including:

* Keyword research
* Product title
* Bullet points
* Product description
* Backend search terms
* Product attributes
* A+ Content recommendations
* Image requirements
* Infographic concepts
* Lifestyle image concepts
* Comparison charts
* Conversion optimization

You should understand both Amazon SEO and conversion optimization.

6. PRODUCT IMAGES

You should be able to create a detailed image brief covering:

* Main image
* Product dimensions
* Features
* Benefits
* Lifestyle images
* Infographics
* Comparison charts
* Packaging
* Use cases

You do not necessarily need to personally design every image, but you must know what a high-converting Amazon listing requires.

7. AMAZON LAUNCH

You must have experience launching products from zero.

You should understand:

* Initial inventory strategy
* Launch pricing
* PPC setup
* Exact, phrase and broad campaigns
* Auto campaigns
* Keyword harvesting
* Negative keywords
* Bid optimization
* Budget allocation
* Organic ranking strategy
* Coupons and promotions
* Conversion-rate optimization
* Search-term analysis

I do not want someone who simply turns on automatic campaigns and lets Amazon spend money.

8. PPC MANAGEMENT

You will monitor and optimize Amazon PPC.

You should understand:

* ACOS
* TACOS
* CTR
* CVR
* CPC
* ROAS
* Search-term performance
* Keyword harvesting
* Match types
* Placement adjustments
* Budget allocation
* Campaign structure

9. ONGOING OPTIMIZATION

Once products are live, you will monitor:

* Sales
* Ranking
* Conversion rate
* PPC
* Reviews
* Competitors
* Pricing
* Search terms
* Inventory
* Customer feedback

You will continuously identify opportunities to improve sales and profitability.

10. INVENTORY MANAGEMENT

You will help forecast:

* Sales velocity
* Reorder points
* Lead times
* FBA inventory
* Supplier production times
* Shipping times
* Safety stock

The goal is to avoid both stockouts and excess inventory.

WHO I AM LOOKING FOR

I want a proven Amazon operator, not a beginner looking for their first opportunity.

Required:

* Proven Amazon Private Label experience
* Experience launching products from scratch
* Experience with Amazon USA
* Strong product research experience
* Proven PPC experience
* Listing optimization experience
* Experience sourcing from China/Alibaba
* Strong understanding of FBA economics
* Strong analytical skills
* Excellent written English
* Ability to work independently
* Ability to make recommendations and take ownership

MOST IMPORTANTLY, YOU MUST BE ABLE TO SHOW YOUR TRACK RECORD.

I want actual examples of products you have launched and the results achieved.

Screenshots are strongly preferred. You may hide confidential information, brand names, ASINs or sensitive client information.

DO NOT APPLY IF:

* You are new to Amazon
* You have only watched Amazon courses
* You have never launched a Private Label product
* You have only done listing uploads
* You have only provided customer service
* You cannot demonstrate previous results
* You cannot explain Amazon economics
* You have no PPC experience
* You have no product sourcing experience
* You cannot work independently
* You are sending a generic copy-and-paste proposal

APPLICATION REQUIREMENTS

Please answer every question below.

1. How many Amazon Private Label products have you personally launched?

2. Give me three examples of products you launched and the results. Include the product/category, selling price, approximate monthly sales, how long it took to reach those sales, and your specific responsibilities.

3. Give me an example of a product you personally researched that became successful. Explain how you identified the opportunity.

4. Give me an example of a product you rejected and explain why you rejected it.

5. What Amazon research tools do you use? For example, Keepa, SellerSprite, Helium 10, Jungle Scout, Amazon Product Opportunity Explorer, or other tools.

6. How do you determine whether a product is profitable? Show me the calculation you normally use.

7. What would your first 30 days look like if hired?

8. How do you identify opportunities where competition is high but there is still room for a new seller?

9. What is your approach to launching a brand-new product with zero reviews?

10. What is your experience with Alibaba and Chinese manufacturers?

11. How do you structure PPC for a brand-new product?

12. What is the biggest Amazon mistake you have made and what did you learn from it?

ROLE

This can become a long-term position if you prove that you can produce results.

I am looking for someone who can become my Amazon product research and launch specialist, not simply another VA.

If you perform well, there will be opportunities to launch additional products, manage additional products, increase advertising budgets, and take responsibility for a larger Amazon operation.

Performance and results matter much more than hours worked.

COMPENSATION

Please include:

* Hourly or monthly rate
* Preferred working arrangement
* Availability
* Time zone
* Whether you work independently or with a team
* Any additional software/tool costs

If you believe a fixed-fee or performance-based arrangement would be more appropriate, explain your proposal.

FINAL NOTE

I am not looking for someone to teach me Amazon.

I am looking for someone who already knows how to find, launch, optimize and grow profitable Amazon Private Label products.

If you have genuinely built successful Amazon products, prove it in your proposal.

If you are a beginner, please do not apply.

I will prioritize applicants with documented results, strong product research skills, excellent Amazon knowledge, and the ability to take ownership from product discovery through profitable sales.

jobs.title: Motion Designer — Redesign an Animated Web CTA Banner (SVG, Accessible, Multi-Variant)
jobs.description: About us We build ExpressCTA, a widget that car dealerships install on their website. It puts a "get your best price" call-to-action onto vehicle listing pages. We serve several hundred dealer sites in the US. The job One of our core assets is an animated banner we call "Blinky." It sits on the vehicle card and is usually the very first thing a shopper's eye lands on. It has never been redesigned and it looks it — it's a 2005-era flashing GIF. We want it reimagined as a small set of modern, lightweight, accessible animated banners. This is a design + asset production job. You will not touch our codebase; we handle the integration. We need finished, production-ready files. What exists today (so you know what you're replacing) 1024 x 350 px animated GIF, 308 KB, 20 frames 2.58 second loop: a ~750ms hold, then nine 60ms full-frame flashes — twice per loop Content is "GET YOUR BEST PRICE" over "CLICK HERE" with a purple arrow Live on roughly half our dealer accounts as the seeded default The dealers who replaced it mostly uploaded homemade ezgif.com exports, which tells us the single default isn't doing its job We'll send you the current file and screenshots of it in real dealer pages. The catch — real render size The source file is 1024 px wide, but it never paints at that size. Our widget caps it at max-height 200px, and on a typical vehicle card it lands around 350 px wide. So the current design is effectively a 1024px poster squeezed into a thumbnail. Your design must be built to be read at ~320–400 px wide first, and hold up as it scales up to ~590 px. Anything that only works at full size is a fail. Deliverables 4–6 named design variants. Dealers pick one in our settings UI, so they need to feel like a family but read as genuinely different options — not recolors of each other. Each variant delivered as a single self-contained animated SVG: 1024 x 350 viewBox (this is fixed — it must drop into the existing slot with no layout shift) Animation is CSS keyframes inside the file. No SMIL, no JavaScript. All text converted to outlines/paths. The asset is delivered through an tag, which cannot load webfonts. Live text will not render. No external references at all — no linked fonts, images, or stylesheets. Raster content, if any, must be embedded as a data URI. Under 60 KB gzipped, hard ceiling. Under 25 KB strongly preferred. A static PNG fallback per variant at 2x, showing the resting frame. Editable source files (Figma, Illustrator, or After Effects) with layers named and organized so we can produce further variants ourselves later. A single, clearly-identified accent color per variant that we can find-and-replace in the SVG, so we can optionally match each dealer's brand color. Animation requirements Motion must read as movement — a sweep, a slide, a reveal, a subtle pulse. No full-frame flashing or hard on/off strobing. That's the main thing we're fixing. Each file must contain a working @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { ... animation: none } block. Because of that, every animation must begin and rest on a fully legible static state. If someone has reduced motion on, or the animation is blocked, or the page is printed, the frozen frame must still be a complete, readable CTA on its own. We will test this by rasterizing your file with animation disabled. Loop should feel calm and repeatable, not frantic. Assume a shopper sees it for 30+ seconds while scrolling a listings page. Design requirements Must be legible on both a light and a dark vehicle card background. Please show every variant on both. Must survive being one of several elements on a busy dealer page — it needs to draw the eye without looking like a spam ad. Copy: you can keep, rework, or replace the current wording. The message is "click this to see the real price on this vehicle." Copy suggestions welcome. No stock clipart, no gradients-for-the-sake-of-it, no drop shadows on text. Process / milestones Concepts — 3+ distinct directions as static comps, each shown at true render size (~350px wide) on both a light and a dark card. We pick one or two. Motion — animate the chosen direction(s) as working SVG. One round of revisions. Variant set — build out the full 4–6 variant family, plus fallbacks and sources. Out of scope Any work in our codebase, CMS, or CDN Logo or full brand identity work Video, HTML5 ad formats, or GIF output (we specifically do not want GIF) To bid, please include Portfolio links, specifically anything with animated SVG or small-format web banners. Please say plainly if you have not hand-authored animated SVG before — it's the core skill here and a beautiful After Effects reel that can't be delivered as a 25 KB SVG doesn't help us. One sentence on how you'd approach the "must be readable at 350px" constraint. Your timeline and your price for the three milestones above. Copy-paste bids will be ignored. Please reference "350px" somewhere in your proposal so we know you read the brief. Budget: [fill in] · Timeline: [fill in] Skills tags: Graphic Design · Animation · SVG · Motion Graphics · Banner Design · Adobe Illustrator · After Effects · Web Design · Accessibility

jobs.title: RV motorhome EXTRA  Diseño Estructural exterior
jobs.description:
Para fabricar o replicar la estructura exterior (carcasa y paneles – pisos inferior y superior ) de un motorhome de doble piso con expansiones como el Iveco S800 de Fe翔房车 (Feixiang RV), 
(https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5tUktazNlXo)se necesitan materiales compuestos avanzados de alta resistencia, aislamiento térmico extremo y ligereza .
A continuación, se detallan las partes de la carrocería y los materiales específicos requeridos para su construcción:
Componentes de la Carcasa Exterior (Partes)
•	Cúpula frontal superior (Overcab): Zona aerodinámica sobre la cabina que aloja la cama matrimonial del primer nivel .
•	Paredes laterales fijas: Paneles principales que cierran los costados del vehículo.
•	Módulo de expansión lateral (Slide-out): Estructura móvil mecanizada que se extiende hacia afuera para ampliar la sala de estar .
•	Módulo de techo elevable (Pop-up de doble piso): Sistema electrohidráulico o de tijera que eleva el segundo piso completo hasta alcanzar los 5.1 metros en modo campamento .
•	Portones de bauleras y cocina exterior: Puertas exteriores con cerraduras herméticas y pistones hidráulicos para la zona de cocina exterior y almacenamiento .
•	Paragolpes trasero integrado: Con molduras para luces reglamentarias y protector de rueda de auxilio .
Materiales para la Fabricación de los Paneles (Sándwich)
•	Fibra de Vidrio de Alta Densidad (PRFV / GRP): Utilizada para la capa exterior e interior de los paneles por su resistencia a los impactos, ligereza y acabado liso.
•	Núcleo Aislante Térmico (XPS / PET): Poliestireno extruido de alta densidad o espuma de PET estructural. No absorbe humedad, aporta rigidez y aísla del frío/calor extremos.
•	Estructura Interna de Aluminio o Composite: Perfiles tubulares embutidos dentro del panel sándwich en puntos estratégicos para fijar muebles y dar soporte estructural.
Sistemas Mecánicos y de Unión
•	Perfiles de aluminio anodizado: Para la unión de las esquinas exteriores de las paredes y el sellado de los bordes.
•	Adhesivos estructurales de poliuretano (Sikaflex o similar): Clave para pegar los paneles entre sí y al chasis sin necesidad de tornillos expuestos, garantizando flexibilidad y hermeticidad.
•	Mecanismos de expansión hidráulicos/eléctricos: Brazos, rieles y motores de alta resistencia para mover la pared lateral y el techo elevable .
•	Burletes de doble labio con cámara de aire: Sellos de goma de alta ingeniería para evitar filtraciones de agua y viento en las uniones móviles (expansiones) .
•	¿Qué herramientas de corte y soldadura tenés disponibles?
Con esto puedo darte recomendaciones sobre técnicas de ensamblado seguro.
replicar el sistema de techo elevable. corte soldadura laser aceros aluminio
Para replicar el sistema de techo elevable y expansión telescópica (Pop-up/套滑式升降生层) del Iveco S800, la combinación de corte y soldadura láser en acero y aluminio es la mejor opción tecnológica. Te permitirá lograr la precisión milimétrica que exige un mecanismo móvil que debe encastrar perfectamente para no filtrar agua ni viento a 120 km/h.
A continuación, se detallan las partes mecánicas, materiales y configuraciones para fabricar este sistema:
1. Estructura y Componentes del Sistema Elevable
•	Columnas de Elevación Telescópicas (Actuadores): Cuatro columnas ubicadas en las esquinas internas del vehículo. Consisten en tubos concéntricos que se deslizan uno dentro de otro.
•	Marcos Guía Perimetrales: Dos anillos estructurales (uno solidario al chasis/primer piso y otro a la base del segundo piso) que garantizan que el techo suba perfectamente derecho sin torsionarse.
•	Tijeras de Estabilización (Pantógrafos): Brazos articulados en "X" que evitan el balanceo lateral del segundo piso cuando está desplegado a sus 5.1 metros de altura máxima .
•	Platinas y Bridas de Anclaje: Piezas de sujeción que vinculan los pistones hidráulicos o electromecánicos a la estructura del vehículo.
________________________________________
2. Especificación de Materiales y Procesos Láser
Para este sistema móvil, debés combinar la ligereza del aluminio (para la parte que sube) con la resistencia del acero (para el mecanismo que empuja).
Componente	Material Recomendado	Proceso de Corte	Proceso de Soldadura
Tubos telescópicos y guías	Acero Inoxidable AISI 304 o Acero Estructural de Alta Resistencia (Aleación ligera)	Láser de tubo (Fibra). Tolerancia menor a 0.2 mm para evitar juego mecánico.	Láser continuo con gas de asistencia (Argón/CO2) para evitar deformación térmica.
Brazos de tijera (Pantógrafos)	Acero al Carbono de alta resistencia (ej. Domex o similar, espesor 4-6 mm)	Láser de fibra por penetración (alta velocidad para evitar zonas afectadas por el calor).	Láser con aporte de hilo si el espesor es grueso, asegurando penetración total.
Marco perimetral del 2° piso	Aluminio AlMg3 (Serie 5000) o AlSi1MgMn (Serie 6000) para bajo peso	Láser de fibra con nitrógeno a alta presión (evita la rebaba y el óxido de aluminio).	Láser por pulso o Wobble (oscilante). El aluminio disipa rápido el calor; el láser oscilante estabiliza el baño de fusión.
Platinas de refuerzo y escuadras	Acero Inoxidable (espesor 3-5 mm)	Láser de fibra convencional.	Láser por puntos o costura continua según el esfuerzo de carga.
________________________________________
3. El Sistema de Sellado (Burletes)
El mayor riesgo de un techo elevable rígido (tipo sándwich) es la filtración en ruta o bajo tormentas. Al bajar, el techo debe encastrarse a presión.
•	Pestañas de Retención: Debés cortar con láser perfiles de aluminio en forma de "J" o "U" donde se alojarán los burletes.
•	Tipo de Burlete: Se utilizan burletes de caucho EPDM inflables (por compresión neumática) o burletes de doble labio con memoria geométrica. Al cerrarse el techo, el burlete debe aplastarse un 30% para asegurar estanqueidad total.
________________________________________

Elegir actuadores eléctricos sincronizados alimentados por una potencia 
en un sistema más eficiente de 48V como el que usa el Iveco S800 original) , tenés potencia de sobra para levantar una estructura sándwich de aluminio de un segundo piso, incluyendo el mobiliario liviano y los colchones .
A continuación, te detallo la configuración de ingeniería, los materiales y los puntos críticos para fabricar el sistema de elevación con tu equipamiento láser:
1. Arquitectura de los Actuadores Eléctricos
Para garantizar que el techo suba nivelado (sin cruzarse ni trabarse), debés implementar una configuración de 4 actuadores (uno en cada esquina) gestionados por un controlador central:
•	Tipo de Actuador: Actuadores lineales industriales de servicio pesado con vástago de acero inoxidable y caja de engranajes integrada.
•	Mecanismo Interno: Se recomiendan actuadores con tornillo de bolas recirculantes (en lugar de tornillo sin fin trapezoidal) debido a su altísima eficiencia mecánica y menor fricción.
•	Sensor de Sincronización: Cada actuador debe incluir obligatoriamente un sensor de efecto Hall o Encoder. El controlador electrónico leerá los pulsos de los 4 motores en tiempo real; si una esquina se retrasa aunque sea 1 milímetro por distribución de peso, el sistema frena o ralentiza los otros tres motores para mantener el plano perfecto.
________________________________________
2. Diseño del Mástil Telescópico (Corte y Soldadura Láser)
El actuador eléctrico va embutido dentro de una columna telescópica que fabricarás con tu láser. Esta columna absorbe los esfuerzos laterales (viento, movimiento de personas), protegiendo al actuador para que solo realice fuerza axial (hacia arriba).
•	Corte Láser de los Tubos Guía:
o	Diseñá tres secciones de tubos cuadrados concéntricos en Acero Inoxidable AISI 304 de 2 o 3 mm de espesor.
o	El juego libre entre tubos debe ser mínimo. Utilizá el corte láser de tubo para calar ventanas internas donde se colocarán patines de deslizamiento de Teflón o UHMW (Polietileno de ultra alto peso molecular) mecanizados, fijados con tornillos de cabeza fresada. Esto evitará el roce metal-metal.
•	Soldadura Láser de las Orejas de Anclaje:
o	Las platinas superiores e inferiores donde pivotan los actuadores reciben toda la carga de impacto cuando el vehículo agarra un pozo en la ruta.
o	Al soldar estas platinas de acero de 4-5 mm a los tubos guía con tu soldador láser, aprovechá la penetración profunda y la baja distorsión térmica del láser para realizar costuras continuas. Al no deformar el tubo, garantizás que el vástago del actuador permanezca perfectamente concéntrico y no sufra desgastes prematuros.

Necesito:  
• Memoria de cálculo y planos estructurales listos para presentar a la municipalidad.  
• Despiece y especificaciones de perfiles de aluminio/acero, así como la configuración de los paneles.  
• Lista de materiales con secciones, espesores y un estimado de consumos.  
• Recomendaciones de anclajes y uniones para garantizar durabilidad y facilidad de montaje.  

Entrego la información arquitectónica en DWG y PDF; espero los modelos en formato editable (preferiblemente Revit o Tekla) junto con los planos en PDF. Las normativas locales de cargas de viento y sismo deben quedar reflejadas en los cálculos.

Quiero un diseño optimizado, fácil de prefabricar y rápido de ensamblar en obra. Si dominas estructuras residenciales livianas y el uso combinado de aluminio, acero y paneles sándwich, me gustaría ver ejemplos de trabajos similares y tu tiempo estimado para la entrega del paquete completo.

jobs.title: Instagram & TikTok Lead Campaign
jobs.description:
I’m ready to kick-off a focused social marketing push on Instagram and TikTok with one clear objective: turn viewers into paying customers. To make that happen, I need someone to help me organize and optimize my existing content, guide me towards creating new content, and draft an organic and sponsored push strategy.

Here’s the picture  
• Platforms: Instagram and TikTok are the priority. If a winning idea naturally translates to Facebook later, I’m open to exploring it, but the launch must concentrate on these two channels.  
• Goal: Generate measurable leads or direct sales—vanity metrics alone won’t cut it. Every post, reel, or ad should move prospects closer to checkout or sign-up.  
• Core content: Short-form videos and eye-catching images. Think reels, TikTok trends, carousel graphics, and thumb-stopping thumbnails. No need for hands on editing, I have the help I need for that, but definitely welcome if possible. 

Deliverables I expect

jobs.title: Mobile Top-Down Action Game
jobs.description:
I’m building a fast-paced, top-down action game for iOS and Android and need the complete playable experience brought to life—from core mechanics to final polish. What the work involves

• Touch controls feel natural—no virtual joystick lag

jobs.title: Sophisticated Luxury Brand Logo
jobs.description:

• A refined, elegant colour palette chosen to elevate the brand rather than overwhelm it.
• Final artwork supplied in high-resolution PNG (transparent background) and JPG, ready for immediate use.

I’m open to your creative direction, yet the finished piece must be distinctive enough to serve as the cornerstone of my visual identity. If you excel at translating “luxury” into a simple, memorable mark, I’m excited to see your ideas.

jobs.title: Design Two Industry-Specific Brochures
jobs.description:
I need fresh, eye-catching collateral to showcase our construction expertise, and I want to tackle two market segments at once. The job is to develop two separate, fully designed brochures—each 10 to 12 pages—aimed squarely at promotion rather than education or internal use.

Brochure 1 will speak to decision-makers in healthcare construction: hospitals, clinics, and medical office developers who expect strict compliance, clean aesthetics, and a strong emphasis on patient-centric design and safety.

Brochure 2 targets owners and franchise groups in restaurant and retail construction, highlighting speed-to-market, brand consistency, and the inviting environments we build for customer-facing spaces.

Both pieces should feel like siblings in terms of overall brand tone yet have visuals, case studies, and messaging tailored to their respective industries. I’ll supply logos, branding guidelines, project photos, and rough copy; you transform it into polished, print-ready marketing material.

Deliverables  
• 10–12 page brochure for healthcare construction

If you’re comfortable working in InDesign, Illustrator, and Photoshop and can weave compelling layouts that sell our story, I’d love to collaborate and move quickly on this.

jobs.title: Spreadsheet Order Status Entry

jobs.title: Mobile Maternity Photo-Video Session
jobs.description:
I’d like a small, well-planned maternity shoot captured entirely on a high-quality mobile device. The feel I’m after is classic posed portraits—no candid or documentary angles—shot both indoors and outdoors so we can mix cosy home moments with a little open-air glow.

jobs.title: iOS & Android Social Network
jobs.description:

jobs.title: Photo-to-2.5D Crystal Portrait
jobs.description:

You’ll be working in a 2.5D cockpit setup, so I expect the finished file to suit that workflow—ideally a greyscale depth map or equivalent format that can drop straight into a laser software package without extra touch-ups. Facial features must read crisply; the rest of the figure can sit naturally in the depth field, with background simplified or minimized as needed.

Deliverables

I’ll supply the high-resolution source photo once we start. Let me know your preferred file type for delivery, the tools you’ll use (e.g., ZBrush, Reliefmod, Photoshop depth extraction, etc.), and your estimated turnaround.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Developer
jobs.description:
MiraModo Inc.

Prepared: August 2026

Senior Technical Developer
MiraModo Inc. • Product: Insara • Remote • Contract

Company Overview

MiraModo Inc. (Houston, TX, founded 2024) builds Insara, a project controls platform for capital construction. Insara replaces the spreadsheet-and-email toolchain that dominates megaproject oversight with a single system for earned value management, schedule analysis, field progress tracking, cost forecasting, and change management.

The platform is production-live with active enterprise deployments on major capital programs. It directly informs decisions worth millions of dollars, so data accuracy and reliability are table stakes. We're also building our own ML infrastructure: a custom fine-tuned LLM for construction project controls and a custom voice pipeline for field-facing AI interaction.


The Role

Title
Senior Technical Developer (Contract)

Commitment
25–40 hours / week

Location
Remote (global). US Central/Eastern timezone overlap required.

Scope
Full-stack development + ML/AI infrastructure

Reports to
Founder (direct collaboration, no management layers)

You'll be the founder's primary implementation partner, working directly in a production codebase that serves enterprise clients. The founder handles product direction, AI architecture, and client relationships. You own the building.

Growth Path
• Months 1–2 (Guided): Founder specs tasks. You design, implement, and submit PRs for review.
• Months 3–4 (Semi-Autonomous): You take broader briefs, propose architecture, handle production issues with less oversight.
• Months 5+ (Trusted Partner): You independently scope and deliver features and provide input on technical direction.


Technical Requirements
Detailed architecture and system documentation provided to selected candidates under NDA.

Core Stack

TypeScript (strict)
- 3+ years production; generics, discriminated unions, type inference
- Required

Python
- Production proficiency for ML pipelines, training, evaluation
- Required

React (latest)
- Hooks, server components, component architecture; shipped production apps
- Required

Next.js App Router
- Server vs. client components, route handlers, middleware
- Required

PostgreSQL (raw SQL)
- Complex queries, CTEs, window functions, schema design, migrations; no ORM
- Required

Type-safe APIs
- End-to-end type safety between client and server (e.g. tRPC)
- Required

Git workflow
- Clean commits, PR-based development, code review discipline
- Required


UI & Visualization

Tailwind CSS
- Utility-first CSS, responsive, data-dense layouts
- Preferred

Component libraries
- Headless / unstyled component primitives (e.g. Radix)
- Preferred

Data visualization
- Charting libraries, dashboards, S-curve and trend charts
- Preferred

Report generation
- PDF, Excel, Word, PowerPoint export
- Preferred


ML / AI Infrastructure

PyTorch & Hugging Face
- Model fine-tuning, PEFT/LoRA, Transformers library
- Preferred

Voice / speech ML
- STT, TTS, end-to-end voice pipeline development
- Preferred

GPU infrastructure
- Self-hosted GPU servers, CUDA, resource monitoring
- Preferred

Inference serving
- High-throughput model serving, quantization, optimization
- Preferred

Evaluation
- Standard and custom domain-specific evaluation harnesses
- Preferred


Infrastructure & DevOps

Docker
- Containerization, multi-stage builds, compose
- Preferred

CI/CD pipelines
- Automated build, test, security scan, deployment workflows
- Preferred

Self-hosted deployment
- VPS-based hosting, container orchestration, monitoring
- Bonus

Testing
- Unit and integration testing frameworks
- Preferred

Note:
Strong TypeScript + strong ML is a rare combination. A candidate with solid TS/React/SQL fundamentals and a demonstrated ML learning trajectory (personal projects, coursework, fine-tuning experiments) is an excellent fit. Aptitude and drive matter more than arriving with deep ML expertise.


Domain: Construction Project Controls

The professional domain is capital construction project controls: measuring, forecasting, and managing cost and schedule performance on large construction programs. You don't need prior domain experience, but you must be willing to learn it.

Concepts

Earned Value Management
- Industry-standard methodology for measuring project performance by comparing planned work, completed work, and actual cost.

Schedule Analysis
- Critical path analysis, schedule forecasting, delay identification, forensic scheduling.

Field Progress Measurement
- Objective methods for quantifying physical completion using predefined measurement criteria.

Cost Management
- Budgeting, cost tracking, forecasting, variance analysis, S-curve trend visualization.

Change Management
- Scope change tracking, information requests, deficiency management and their impact on cost/schedule.

Work Packaging
- Organizing construction activities into executable packages across engineering, procurement, and construction.

Each concept maps directly to platform features. Domain knowledge is trained during onboarding with documentation, guided tasks, and founder mentorship.


Working Model

Hours
- 25–40 hrs/week (close to full-time expected)

Timezone
- Global candidates welcome; must overlap US Central/Eastern daytime (~9 AM to 5 PM CT)

Communication
- Async daily (Slack/Discord) + video calls as needed for architecture discussions

Code workflow
- Feature branch ? PR ? founder review ? merge ? automated deployment

Tooling
- AI-assisted IDE, GitHub, Docker, PostgreSQL client


Ramp-Up Milestones

30 Days
- Environment running.
- 5–8 PRs merged.
- Can trace data from database to UI.
- Basic domain familiarity.

60 Days
- Independently implementing features.
- Writing SQL migrations confidently.
- Handling production bugs.
- First ML fine-tuning experiments.

90 Days
- Decomposing feature briefs into tasks.
- Proposing architecture.
- Full-stack comfort.
- Contributing to voice pipeline and ML infrastructure.



Candidate Profile

Must-Have Attributes
• 3+ years production TypeScript/[removed] strict mode, generics, type inference
• Python proficiency for ML pipeline work (training, evaluation, data prep)
• Production React experience. Must have shipped and maintained real applications.
• Next.js App Router understanding (server components, route handlers, middleware)
• SQL fluency with raw PostgreSQL; no ORM dependency
• Experience with (or strong interest in) LLM fine-tuning and ML infrastructure
• Clean Git workflow and PR-based development discipline
• Clear written English for code review, docs, and occasional client communication
• Can learn independently across a specialized domain and fast-moving ML engineering

Differentiating Attributes
• Hands-on PyTorch / Hugging Face model fine-tuning
• GPU infrastructure management (provisioning, CUDA, monitoring)
• Voice/speech ML: STT, TTS, or voice pipeline development
• Inference optimization (quantization, high-throughput serving)
• Data visualization and chart-heavy dashboard development
• Docker, CI/CD, and container-based deployment
• Construction, engineering, or industrial domain exposure

What We Offer
• Direct impact: Your code serves live clients on active capital programs
• Production ML: Fine-tune LLMs, build voice pipelines, manage inference. Real systems, not demos.
• Domain depth: Learn a specialized, high-value field most developers never touch
• Growth path: From guided implementation to trusted technical partner
• Modern stack: Current tools applied to real problems, not CRUD apps
• Founder-direct: No management layers, no ticket theater

How to Apply
1. Brief introduction (2–3 paragraphs): Who you are, why this role interests you, relevant experience.
2. Links to your work: GitHub, portfolio, or production application examples.
3. Availability: Weekly hours, timezone, earliest start date, rate expectations.


Screening Questions

SQL Question (required, 4–8 sentences):
You have a PostgreSQL table work_items (id, category_id, discipline, budgeted_hours) and a table progress_entries (id, work_item_id, milestone_index, completed_at, credit_percent). Write a SQL query that calculates total earned hours per discipline for a given category_id. Explain your approach.

ML Question (optional, 4–8 sentences):
You are fine-tuning an LLM for a specialized technical domain where the base model frequently produces incorrect terminology. Describe your approach: training data preparation, fine-tuning strategy, and how you would evaluate whether the model has measurably improved.

Selected candidates will receive detailed technical documentation under NDA during onboarding.

Insara is where full-stack engineering meets ML infrastructure meets a specialized domain that actually matters. We're building our own LLM and voice AI, not just wrapping APIs. If that sounds interesting, we want to hear from you. Construction and ML are both learnable.

What isn't optional is caring about getting it right.

jobs.title: English-Odia Report Typing
jobs.description:
I have a collection of reports that need to be re-typed with absolute accuracy in both English and Odia. Source material will arrive as scanned pages and occasional handwritten notes; your job is to convert everything into clean, well-structured documents in Microsoft Word and Google Docs.

I’ll send you a short set of formatting guidelines covering margins, heading hierarchy, font choices for each language, and basic table styles. As long as those rules are observed, you are free to use any workflow that keeps speed and fidelity high.

Because the reports contain mixed-script content, you must already be comfortable with Odia keyboard layouts or IME tools as well as standard English typing conventions. Consistency in diacritics, punctuation, and numbering is critical; I will spot-check against the originals before sign-off.

Deliverables  
• A Word (.docx) file and a matching Google Docs link for each report  
• Files named exactly as instructed so they slot straight into my archive  
• Work completed by the deadlines we agree at contract start

When you respond, attach a detailed project proposal outlining the tools you intend to use, any quality-control steps, a realistic turnaround time per report, and your availability for quick clarifications.

jobs.title: Precise Text Re-Typing Service
jobs.description:
I have a collection of digital files—mostly PDFs and a few existing Word docs—that need to be re-typed into clean, error-free DOCX files. Copy-pasting isn’t an option because some files contain locked or irregular formatting; I need each page keyed in manually, proof-read, and saved as a standard Word document.

You will receive the source files in batches. For each batch, simply replicate the original text, preserve basic headings and paragraph breaks, and keep an eye out for typos or spacing issues that may have crept into the originals. No complex layout or design work is required—plain, well-structured text is perfect.

Deliverables (per batch)  
• A single DOCX file that mirrors the source text accurately  
• Consistent naming: “FileName_clean.docx”  
• Turnaround confirmation once the batch is uploaded back to me

I’ll review every file for completeness and accuracy within 24 hours of delivery and release approval promptly. If you enjoy straightforward typing tasks and have a sharp eye for detail, this will be an easy, repeatable project.

jobs.title: Android Social Networking App Build
jobs.description:

Here’s what I have in mind so far:
• Core features: secure sign-up/login, personal profile pages, news-feed style timeline, photo/video uploads, likes & comments, and in-app messaging or chat.  
• Smooth performance on recent Android versions, with responsive layouts that adapt from small phones to larger tablets.  
• A lightweight back-end (Firebase, Supabase, or a comparable cloud service) for user management and push notifications—open to your recommendations as long as it keeps scaling straightforward.  
• Basic admin console so I can review user reports, moderate content, and pull usage analytics.

Deliverables I expect:
1. Source code organised in a clean Git repo with clear commit history.  
2. APK (or AAB) ready for Play Console testing.  
3. Brief setup and deployment guide so I can reproduce the build and roll out updates myself.  
4. A short walkthrough video or call at hand-off to clarify architecture decisions and future extension points.

If you have front-end design flair or past social-app experience, please highlight it. I’m aiming for a modern, uncluttered look that feels familiar yet fresh. Let me know the frameworks, libraries, and timeline you’d propose, and we can discuss milestones right away.
