jobs.title: AI Video Creator & Reels/Shorts Editor for Fashion & Lifestyle Brand
jobs.description:
SilkTatva is looking for a creative AI Video Creator & Short-Form Video Editor who can help us create visually striking content for Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts and other social platforms.

We are looking for someone who can take a product, image, concept or brief and turn it into engaging short-form videos with a CTA and a catchy hook, using a combination of AI-generated visuals, animation, motion graphics and professional video editing.

What You’ll Create

You will work on content such as:

- AI-generated product and lifestyle videos
- Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts
- Product showcase and promotional videos
- AI-generated models/scenes featuring our products
- Image-to-video animations
- Creative product transitions and visual storytelling
- Trend-based short-form content adapted for our brand
- Promotional videos for launches, collections and campaigns

The objective is not simply to edit existing footage. We want someone who can conceptualise and create videos even when we only provide product photographs, videos, references or a creative brief.

What We're Looking For

You should have experience with some combination of:

AI Video Tools: Kling, Veo, Runway, Hailuo, PixVerse, Pika or similar tools

AI Image Tools: Midjourney, Flux, ChatGPT image generation, Nano Banana or similar

Editing Tools: Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, CapCut, After Effects or similar

More importantly, you should have:

- A strong eye for aesthetics and visual storytelling
- Good understanding of Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts
- Ability to create strong hooks in the first 1–2 seconds
- Good sense of pacing, music, typography and transitions
- Ability to maintain visual consistency across AI-generated scenes
- Ability to make products look premium rather than obviously AI-generated
- Understanding of current social-media formats and trends

Important: Please Share Your Portfolio

When applying, please send:

1. 3–5 examples of your best short-form videos
2. At least 1–2 examples using AI-generated video or animation
3. The AI and editing tools you normally use
4. Your price per finished 15–30 second video
5. Approximate turnaround time per video
6. How many videos you can realistically produce per week

Applications without relevant examples may not be considered.

About SilkTatva

SilkTatva is a fashion/lifestyle brand focused on creating beautiful products with a strong visual identity.

We want to build a distinctive social-media presence using a combination of beautiful product imagery, creative storytelling and next-generation AI video production.

This can become an ongoing freelance engagement for the right creator.

If you understand both AI generation and what makes someone stop scrolling, we'd love to see your work.

jobs.title: Bedroom Blueprint to 3D Render

I will supply the blueprint PDF, rough furniture references, and a mood board once we start. Please let me know your usual turnaround time and any similar bedroom projects you have completed so I can gauge style compatibility.

jobs.title: B2B Technical Content Writer — Engineering Components (Ongoing)
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

Vahan Yantrons LLP is an engineering and contract manufacturing company based in Mumbai. We supply steering, suspension, wheel-end and axle components to trailer, agricultural, off-highway and marine equipment manufacturers across North America, Australia and Europe.

We engineer the component, control its manufacture at qualified partner plants, deliver it to the customer's line, and remain accountable for it in service.

WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS

Before any site visit or sample, every point of contact a buyer has with us is written. A web page, a quotation, correspondence, a label. The assessment he forms comes from that material, and it is formed before any technical discussion takes place.

Our readers are purchasing engineers, supplier quality engineers and owner-managers. They read closely and they verify what they read.

WHAT THE CONTENT HAS TO ACHIEVE

The objective is lead generation. Published material exists to attract qualified enquiries and to convert them into contact. Every page is assessed against that, not against how well it reads.

Four things have to hold at the same time.

- Search visibility. The words a buyer actually types belong on the page and in the heading. Customer terminology, not internal terminology.
- Answer engine visibility. Question-form headings, with the substantive answer inside the first forty words. Every sentence has to stand on its own, because an assistant will extract a single line and present it without the surrounding context.
- Sales establishment. The same material carries into quotations, capability statements and enquiry responses. It has to work inside a buying conversation, not only on a page.
- Technical integrity. None of the above at the cost of the engineering. Standard references, grades and tolerances stay in full.

It has to work across six markets. United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, United Kingdom and continental Europe. Units and conventions change by market. Terminology does not.

HOW WE WORK

We have a written standard covering tone, reading level, sentence construction, terminology, units and heading formats. It runs to nineteen pages and is issued to whoever writes for us, so a writer is not asked to work it out.

There is real scope in this role to shape what a page says, how it is structured and what evidence it carries. The construction conventions are settled, and we would ask a writer to work within them.

The emphasis throughout is on technical accuracy and on statements a reader can verify.

WHAT YOU WOULD WRITE

- Website pages across six product ranges
- Product family pages, written so that a general reader and a supplier quality engineer each find the level of detail they need on the same page
- Technical and quality content covering inspection, validation and material standards
- Quotations, correspondence and enquiry responses
- Content structured so that a search engine or an assistant can lift a meaningful answer

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- Experience writing for manufacturing, engineering or industrial clients
- Comfort working within a defined framework, and the judgement to ask rather than assume
- Confidence with technical terminology, material standards, grades and tolerances
- American English throughout, consistently
- Working knowledge of SEO and answer engine optimisation, and how they shape headings, opening lines and page structure

NOT REQUIRED

Brand storytelling, taglines, conceptual copywriting, design or layout. Prior automotive knowledge is not required, provided you can read a specification and ask precise questions.

YOU WILL NOT BE ASKED TO INVENT TECHNICAL FACTS

Every standard reference and material grade comes from a controlled internal document and is approved before release.

jobs.title: Tech-Focused Sales & Business Development Partner
jobs.description:
Technology Sales Partner / Business Development Representative

We are looking for a sales-focused individual who can bring qualified technology projects to our company.
Note: This job is purely commissions based and does not provide any salary.
The ideal person will have a strong network, understand business technology needs, and be capable of identifying companies that need software, web applications, mobile applications, automation, internal tools, integrations, or other technology solutions.

What We Offer

Commission of up to 20% of the total project sales value
* Projects must have a minimum value of USD 1000
* Higher-value projects can result in significantly higher commissions
* No fixed limit on the number of projects you can bring
* Opportunity to build a long-term sales partnership with a technology company

How It Works

1. You identify a potential client with a technology requirement.
2. You introduce the client/project to us.
3. Our team handles the technical discovery, estimation, proposal, and project delivery.
4. If the project closes, you receive up to 20% of the sales value, depending on the project and your involvement in the sales process.

Example

If you bring in a USD 5,000 software project, your commission could be up to USD 1,000.

If you consistently bring qualified projects, this can become a substantial recurring income opportunity.

Who We Are Looking For

This opportunity is suitable for:

* Independent sales professionals
* Business development representatives
* Technology consultants
* Freelance salespeople
* Agency/IT consultants with client networks
* People with strong SMB or startup connections
* Individuals who regularly interact with business owners and decision-makers

You don't need to be a developer.Your primary responsibility is to identify opportunities and bring the right clients to us. Our technical team handles the rest.

What Makes a Good Lead?

We are particularly interested in businesses that need:

* Custom software
* Web or mobile applications
* Internal business tools
* Business process automation
* CRM or workflow systems
* API and system integrations
* Data dashboards and reporting
* Cloud infrastructure and DevOps
* Legacy software modernization
* MVP development

Minimum project value: USD 1000.

We are looking for qualified business opportunities, not just contact lists. The stronger the lead and the more involved you are in helping close the project, the stronger the commission opportunity.

Bring the opportunity. We build the technology. You earn from the deal.

jobs.title: Precise PDF-to-Word Conversion
jobs.description:

jobs.title: Brand-Building Portfolio Website
jobs.description:
I’m Jelsyn D. Libre and I want a modern online portfolio that instantly tells visitors who I am, what I do, and why they should remember my name. The single most important outcome is stronger brand awareness, so every design and technical choice should reinforce a consistent visual identity and make it easy for people to share my work.

Scope

• Basic analytics setup (Google Analytics 4) so I can track traffic and engagement.

jobs.title: 5APROJECTAI
jobs.description:
I want to build an AI-driven platform that automatically drafts complete project proposals for European funding programmes. The system has to do two things equally well: analyse the territory where the entrepreneur plans to operate and judge whether the business idea itself can turn a profit.  

For the geographic side, the model must combine demographic, economic and infrastructure data, revealing opportunities or red flags specific to that region. In parallel, it should test the entrepreneur’s concept against market demand, cost structures and funding criteria so the final proposal is both realistic and attractive to evaluators.

My vision is a cloud-based solution with a simple interface: the user enters location and concept, presses “Generate”, and receives a ready-to-submit application plus an explanatory report. Python, machine-learning libraries (TensorFlow, PyTorch), NLP techniques for grant language, and a lightweight GIS component will likely be needed, but I am open to your preferred stack as long as accuracy and speed remain high.

Payment will follow a subscription model of 300 RON per month for five years, aligning our interests over the long term while keeping the service affordable for small businesses.

If you have experience blending data science, NLP, grant writing and web development, let’s talk about an MVP timeline, data sourcing strategy and incremental feature roll-out.

jobs.title: Squarespace Single-Checkout Subscription Integration
jobs.description:
I run a Squarespace store that sells software licence plans.  Each plan needs two charges: 

1. A one-time upfront fee that covers setup, the first month, and a reserve  
2. An ongoing monthly subscription billed through Stripe  

Squarespace’s native flow forces customers to press two different buttons and complete two separate checkouts, one for the upfront payment, another to start the subscription.  I want a single, seamless checkout where the shopper pays the initial fee and authorises the recurring charge in the very same flow.

The site is already connected to Stripe, and I’m happy to keep the standard Squarespace design; this is purely a functional/code change.  Your task is to inject custom code (custom checkout, Squarespace Commerce APIs, Stripe APIs or the best proven method) so a customer:
• selects a plan  
• reviews one combined order summary  
• completes one payment step that captures the upfront amount and activates the monthly subscription automatically  

Acceptance will be a live test transaction that shows both the correct upfront charge and the correctly scheduled subscription in Stripe, plus brief hand-off notes so I can maintain it in the future.

If you’ve built similar single-checkout subscription solutions on Squarespace (or have strong Stripe API experience) I’d love to see an example.

jobs.title: Experienced Intraday Traders for HYBERDZ

1. Accept a spoken command from my mic.  
2. Execute one live task in each of the three areas.  
3. Read back a confirmation of what it just did.

I’ll test on my side; once each use-case runs end-to-end without errors, the milestone is complete. If this sounds in your wheelhouse, let’s talk implementation details and timelines.

jobs.title: Customer Satisfaction Data Analysis
jobs.description:
I have an Excel workbook full of raw customer data and I need it turned into a clear customer-satisfaction report. The task is strictly data analysis and reporting: no data entry, no re-keying—just solid analytical work that helps me understand how happy (or unhappy) my customers really are.

Here is what I’m looking for:

• Clean and prep the customer records where needed so calculations are reliable  
• Run a customer satisfaction analysis using Excel tools such as PivotTables, charts, formulas, or Power Query—whatever you prefer, as long as the steps are transparent  
• Highlight key metrics: average satisfaction score, distribution of ratings, top pain points, recurring themes, and any noticeable trends over time  
• Deliver a concise dashboard or summary sheet inside the same file plus a short written summary (PDF or separate sheet) explaining your findings and recommendations

Acceptance criteria

jobs.title: Outbound Sales Specialist for Writing Studio
jobs.description:
Hi everyone,

We’re an early-stage independent writing studio producing original business blogs for lifestyle businesses. We work across real estate, travel & hospitality, home & living, beauty & personal care, and food & beverage.

We’re looking for a freelance sales representative to bring our $2,500 writing service to market through cold outbound sales.

Our standard client engagement is straightforward. We review a business’s existing body of blog content, determine four original articles we believe would be worthwhile additions, develop the concepts for the client’s approval, and then research, write, edit, and deliver all four articles. One reasonable revision round per article is included.

We don’t simply ask clients to give us four topics to write about. Part of our service is deciding what would actually be worth adding to what they’ve already built. We look at what their existing content currently gives the reader, what may be missing, and where there’s an opportunity to add something genuinely worthwhile. The four articles are determined after we’ve actually assessed the client’s existing work.

For our initial sales campaign, you’ll be selling to individual residential real estate agents in the United States who meet our targeting criteria.

Prospecting is handled separately by a dedicated researcher. You’ll receive a minimum of 100 researched prospects per week who have already been evaluated against our targeting criteria. If you can effectively work a higher volume, we’re willing to increase your prospect supply accordingly.

You’ll receive the information we’ve gathered and used to qualify each prospect, including their name, direct professional phone number, website, existing blog and publication history, along with the relevant information confirming that they meet our targeting criteria.

These are still cold prospects. We are qualifying them for fit, not purchase intent, budget, or willingness to buy. Figuring out whether there is a genuine sales opportunity is part of your job.

Before making contact, we expect you to briefly review the prospect and their existing content. From there, you own the prospect and the sales process from first contact through close.

That means cold outreach, discovery and qualification, positioning, objection handling, follow-up, managing your own calendar and pipeline, keeping prospect records current, conducting the necessary sales conversations, reviewing the service agreement with the client, getting it signed, collecting payment, and closing the sale.

We are not going to manage your calendar, tell you who needs to be followed up with, remind you when to call someone back, or organize your prospects for you. You’ll be given the prospects and the information you need to work them, and we expect you to independently manage what happens from there.

We do expect the pipeline itself to remain current and understandable. Prospect status, meaningful interactions, follow-ups, next actions, and final outcomes should be recorded as you work.

We do not currently have a standardized sales playbook or a word-for-word script. We’re looking for someone who already knows how to sell and can use their own judgment and experience from the beginning.

As we build the infrastructure for it, we’ll begin reviewing sales calls and working with you to identify what’s working, what isn’t, and what we should change. Over time, we expect to standardize more of the sales process based on what we actually learn from selling the service. You’ll be expected to apply those learnings as the process develops, and we also want candid feedback from the person actually doing the work.

Editorial assessment and fulfillment remain with us. You’re welcome to make observations about a prospect’s existing content and use them during the sales process, but you are not responsible for deciding what we should ultimately write for a client or promising a particular editorial direction during the sale.

This is a full-time, commission-only role. You’ll earn $400 USD for every completed $2,500 sale, with commissions paid weekly. Your quota is 10 completed sales per month, which is $4,000 USD at quota. Commission is uncapped. If you close more than 10 clients, you continue earning $400 for every additional completed sale.

If our immediate fulfillment capacity is full, we’ll give you the next available engagement start date. You can continue closing clients against future availability, and every additional completed sale earns the same $400 commission.

We’re looking for someone with demonstrated experience selling services through cold outbound outreach. Experience selling to small businesses, individual business owners, or real estate professionals is especially relevant.

You should be comfortable cold calling, conducting discovery, following up consistently, managing your own pipeline, and owning a sale all the way through close. This is not an appointment-setting role, and your responsibility does not end once someone expresses interest or agrees to another conversation.

You also need excellent spoken English and strong verbal communication skills. We care about more than basic fluency. You should be able to articulate ideas clearly, think on your feet, listen carefully, ask good questions, and communicate an offer naturally and persuasively without relying on a script.

We’re looking for someone who can treat this as their primary sales role and work consistently Monday through Friday on a full-time basis. You’ll manage your own daily activity rather than following a prescribed hourly call schedule.

You can be based anywhere, but you must be able to work consistently during U.S. business hours and make outbound calls during the appropriate local working hours for the markets you’re assigned.

The start date is Tuesday, September 1.

To apply, send me a private message with your location and time zone, a resume or professional profile, and an overview of your relevant cold outbound sales experience.

Tell me what you’ve personally sold, approximately what it cost, who you were selling to, what part of the sales process you owned, and what your typical activity and results looked like. Approximate numbers are completely fine.

Based on what you know about the role and service, I’d also like you to walk me through how you would generally approach selling it. From receiving and reviewing a researched prospect through first contact, discovery, qualification, follow-up, and close, how would you approach the sales process?

Our quota is 10 completed sales per month, and we guarantee a minimum of 100 new researched prospects per week. Based on your experience, how do you think about that target? Walk me through whatever assumptions you think matter, whether that’s activity, contact rates, conversion, follow-up, prospect volume, or something else.

Tell me what else you would want to know about the prospects, offer, or role before you’d be comfortable assessing the opportunity more precisely, and please be candid about any questions, concerns, or reservations you have.

Finally, let me know your current availability and confirm whether you can begin Tuesday, September 1.

If I’m interested in your written application, I’ll ask you to complete a short voice-recorded second step. There is no video requirement and I will not ask you to attend a live interview. I just need to hear how you communicate before hiring someone whose job is primarily speaking with prospects.

jobs.title: E-Commerce Growth Partner for Shadique
jobs.description:
Performance-Based E-Commerce Growth Partner Wanted — Commission Only

About Shadique

Shadique is a growing e-commerce brand being built with a long-term vision around strong brand positioning, customer experience, and scalable growth.

We are currently looking for an experienced E-commerce Growth / Digital Marketing Partner who is confident in their ability to generate measurable results and is willing to have their compensation directly connected to performance.

This is not a traditional fixed-fee marketing project.

We are looking for someone who is confident enough in their strategy to put their own performance behind it.

What We’re Looking For

We are open to working with individuals or small teams with proven experience in one or more of the following:

E-commerce growth
Performance marketing
Meta / Facebook & Instagram Ads
Google Ads & Google Shopping
SEO & organic growth
Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO)
Product positioning
Content & social media marketing
Email marketing & customer retention
Retargeting
Affiliate / influencer marketing
Multi-channel customer acquisition
E-commerce analytics and attribution

We are not necessarily looking for someone who does everything.

What matters most is your ability to identify an opportunity, execute a clear strategy, and produce measurable, attributable results.

The Opportunity

Your responsibility would be to help Shadique increase:

Qualified Traffic → Product Engagement → Conversions → Revenue → Repeat Customers

We are not interested in vanity metrics.

10,000 visitors with no purchases are less valuable to us than 500 highly relevant visitors who convert.

Your proposal should therefore focus on revenue and measurable business outcomes, not simply traffic numbers, followers, impressions, or engagement.

Performance-Based Compensation

There will be no upfront marketing/service fee for the initial collaboration.

We are open to discussing a commission structure based on verified incremental revenue attributable to your work.

Your proposal should clearly state:

Your proposed commission percentage
What revenue you believe should qualify for commission
How you would attribute sales to your work
The tracking methodology you would use
Your proposed initial testing period
The KPIs you would commit to
What happens if the agreed KPIs are not achieved

If you genuinely believe in your strategy, we are prepared to structure a long-term performance-based relationship around measurable results.

Strong performance can lead to a larger and longer-term engagement.

What We Expect From You

Your application should demonstrate that you understand the difference between:

“I can increase your traffic.”

and

“Here is exactly how I intend to acquire qualified customers, convert them, measure the results, and earn based on the revenue I generate.”

We expect you to explain:

Your proposed growth strategy
Target audience
Target geographic markets
Acquisition channels
Expected timeline
Expected KPIs
Conversion assumptions
Tracking & attribution methodology
Testing and optimization process
Your proposed commission structure
Proof of Experience

Please provide at least 2–3 relevant examples of previous e-commerce work.

For each example, include:

Store/business type
Your exact role
What you implemented
Starting situation
Results achieved
Time period
Revenue/traffic/conversion improvement where applicable
How the results were measured

Screenshots are welcome, but verifiable context is preferred.

We are interested in understanding what you personally did, not simply showing us a store you once worked around.

Security & Store Access

We take store security seriously.

No passwords, payment information, financial credentials, or unrestricted administrative access will be provided.

If access becomes necessary, it will be provided through the appropriate platform permissions and only after:

Your proposal has been reviewed
Your required access has been clearly explained
The specific permissions have been agreed upon

Your application should therefore specify exactly what access you would need and why you need it.

Requests for unnecessary or unrestricted access will not be considered.

Third-Party Tools & Expenses

If your strategy requires paid tools, apps, software, advertising platforms, subscriptions, or third-party services, disclose them before implementation.

Please specify:

Tool/service name
Purpose
Estimated cost
Why it is necessary
Who would be responsible for the cost

We will not purchase a tool simply because it is presented as “required.”

Any additional expense must be justified and approved in advance.

Important

We are not looking for guaranteed overnight results or unrealistic promises.

We understand that e-commerce growth depends on factors such as:

Product-market fit
Pricing
Competition
Demand
Traffic quality
Conversion rate
Customer behavior
Market conditions

However, we do expect a professional partner to be able to provide a clear strategy, measurable objectives, disciplined execution, and transparent reporting.

If you believe you can generate meaningful results, we want to hear how.

Application Questions — Please Answer All

To be considered, please answer the following questions directly in your proposal:

1. If you were selected today, what would your first 7 days with Shadique look like?

2. Which acquisition channels would you prioritize and why?

3. Who would you target, and which markets would you focus on first?

4. What specific KPIs would you commit to during the initial testing period?

5. How would you track and attribute revenue generated through your work?

6. What commission percentage are you proposing, and why?

7. What access would you require from Shadique? Please list the exact permissions.

8. Would your strategy require any paid tools, apps, advertising budget, or third-party services? If yes, list them and provide estimated costs.

9. Provide 2–3 relevant examples of previous e-commerce results and explain exactly what you personally contributed.

10. What would make you conclude that your strategy is not working, and what would you change?

11. Do you work independently or with a team? If with a team, who would have access to the store?

12. What makes your approach different from the typical “SEO + Ads + Social Media” proposal?

How We Will Evaluate Proposals

We will prioritize applicants based on:

Strategy > Evidence > Transparency > Attribution > Communication

We are not selecting the person who promises the biggest number.

We are looking for the person who can demonstrate the strongest understanding of how to achieve measurable growth.

If your proposal is specific, evidence-based, and commercially realistic, we would be happy to explore a performance-based partnership.

If you’re confident in your ability to produce results, show us how you would approach Shadique.

Shadique Team

jobs.title: Shopify SEO, GEO & AEO Expert Needed – Google & AI Search Visibility
jobs.description:
We are looking for a highly experienced Shopify SEO, GEO (Generative Engine Optimisation) and AEO (Answer Engine Optimisation) specialist to improve the organic visibility of our established live Shopify website.
PLATFORM: SHOPIFY
This website is built entirely on Shopify. We are NOT using WordPress, WooCommerce, Webflow or another CMS.
The freelancer must have strong hands-on experience with Shopify SEO, Shopify Technical SEO, Shopify Liquid, themes/templates, products, collections, pages, canonical URLs, redirects, XML sitemaps, schema, internal linking, Google Search Console and Bing Webmaster Tools.
This project is SEO/GEO/AEO ONLY. We are not looking for a redesign, a new Shopify store, paid advertising, social media management or general digital marketing.
MAIN OBJECTIVE
Our goal is to achieve the maximum realistically obtainable organic visibility across all relevant search queries connected to our products, services and business.
We want strong visibility across:
- Google Search
- Google AI Overviews
- Featured Snippets
- People Also Ask
- Bing
- ChatGPT Search
- Gemini
- Microsoft Copilot
- Perplexity
- Other major AI/search platforms
We understand that nobody can guarantee #1 rankings or inclusion in every AI answer. We want a specialist who can systematically maximise our visibility across traditional search engines and AI answer engines.
1. COMPLETE SHOPIFY SEO AUDIT
Audit the entire website for:
- Crawlability and indexability
- Googlebot/Bingbot accessibility
- Robots.txt and XML sitemap
- Canonical URLs
- Duplicate URLs/content
- Shopify-generated duplicate paths
- Products, collections and pages
- Redirects, 404s and broken links
- Orphan pages and crawl depth
- Internal linking
- Pagination and filter/query URLs
- Thin/duplicate content
- Titles, metas and H1 structure
- Structured data/schema
- Mobile SEO and Core Web Vitals
- Page speed and JavaScript rendering
- Shopify Liquid/theme SEO issues
- Image SEO
Classify findings as P0 Critical / P1 High Priority / P2 Improvement.
We do not want only an automated audit. Explain what is wrong, why it matters and what should be changed.
2. KEYWORD + SEARCH-INTENT RESEARCH
Research the full relevant search landscape, including:
- Commercial and transactional keywords
- Informational queries
- Long-tail keywords
- Product/service searches
- Category/module-specific searches
- Question-based searches
- Comparison queries
- Buyer-intent searches
- “Best”, “How”, “What”, “Where”, “Which”, “Can I” searches
- People Also Ask opportunities
- Featured snippet opportunities
- AI conversational queries
- GEO/AEO opportunities
For important query clusters identify:
- Search intent
- Search volume where available
- Keyword difficulty
- Current ranking
- Current ranking URL
- Correct target URL
- Main SERP competitors
- Content gap
- Cannibalisation risk
- Recommended action
3. KEYWORD-TO-URL MAPPING
This is a major requirement.
Every important query cluster should be mapped to the correct Shopify URL.
Identify:
- Which existing page should target each query
- Pages competing for the same keyword
- Keyword cannibalisation
- Incorrect intent targeting
- Commercial vs informational conflicts
- Pages requiring consolidation/improvement
- Genuine opportunities for new pages
Do not create unnecessary pages just to target slight keyword variations.
4. SHOPIFY ON-PAGE + TECHNICAL SEO
Review and improve:
- SEO titles and meta descriptions
- H1/H2/H3 structure
- Opening content
- Search-intent alignment
- Semantic/entity coverage
- Content completeness
- FAQs and direct answers
- Internal links and anchor text
- Image alt text
- Structured content
- Schema
You must understand Shopify-specific SEO issues including:
- /products/
- /collections/
- /pages/
- Collection/product alternate paths
- Canonicalisation
- Search/filter URLs
- Query parameters
- Pagination
- Liquid templates
- Theme-generated SEO issues
- Duplicate JSON-LD
- App-generated schema conflicts
- Navigation and breadcrumbs
- Sitemap behaviour
- Redirect management
IMPORTANT: This is an existing indexed live Shopify website. Do NOT change URLs, handles, canonicals, redirects, titles, H1s, schema or important indexed content without reviewing current performance and explaining the reason first.
We want to protect and improve existing SEO equity.
5. GEO – GENERATIVE ENGINE OPTIMISATION
We want our website to become a source that AI systems can understand, trust, cite and recommend where relevant.
Review and improve:
- Brand/entity clarity
- Service/entity relationships
- Factual consistency
- Direct-answer sections
- Definitions and Q&A formatting
- Comparison content
- Evidence and trust signals
- Citation-worthiness
- Structured data
- Semantic relationships
- Topical authority
- Internal knowledge structure
- Crawlability/accessibility
AI systems should clearly understand who we are, what we provide, which pages answer which questions and why our content is authoritative.
6. AEO – ANSWER ENGINE OPTIMISATION
Optimise appropriate content for:
- Featured snippets
- People Also Ask
- Google AI Overviews
- Conversational search
- ChatGPT Search
- Gemini
- Copilot
- Perplexity
Important questions should have clear, factual and concise answers followed by supporting detail.
7. TOPICAL + ENTITY AUTHORITY
Develop a strategy covering:
- Topic hubs
- Supporting content
- Missing query clusters
- Commercial landing-page gaps
- Informational gaps
- FAQs
- Comparisons
- Guides
- Parent/child relationships
- Semantic internal links
- Organisation/entity signals
- Brand consistency
Every proposed new page must have a clear target query, search intent and purpose.
We do NOT want mass-produced low-quality AI pages.
8. SCHEMA / STRUCTURED DATA
Audit existing Shopify schema for:
- Organisation
- Website
- Product
- Breadcrumb
- FAQ where appropriate
- Missing, invalid or duplicate schema
- Theme/app conflicts
Only use schema that complies with current search-engine guidelines.
9. COMPETITOR + SERP ANALYSIS
For important queries analyse:
- Who currently ranks
- Which URLs rank
- Why they rank
- Search intent
- Content depth
- Topical authority
- Backlinks
- Internal linking
- SERP features
- Featured snippets
- People Also Ask
- AI Overview sources
- Content gaps
- Competitor weaknesses
We need actionable recommendations to compete with current leaders.
10. GOOGLE SEARCH CONSOLE + BING
Analyse:
- Queries
- Impressions
- Clicks
- CTR
- Average position
- Indexed/excluded pages
- Sitemap
- Crawling
- Canonicals
- Core Web Vitals
Prioritise:
- Positions 4–10
- Positions 11–20
- High-impression/low-CTR queries
- Pages gaining or losing visibility
- Cannibalisation
Also review Bing Webmaster Tools and Bing-specific opportunities.
11. INTERNAL LINKING + CONTENT GAPS
Audit:
- Orphan pages
- Weakly linked important pages
- Crawl depth
- Anchor text
- Hub/supporting-page relationships
- Missing contextual links
- Missing commercial and informational topics
- Weak or cannibalising pages
We want a logical structure:
Homepage → Main Hubs → Commercial Pages → Supporting Content
12. BACKLINK + AUTHORITY ANALYSIS
Review:
- Existing/lost backlinks
- Competitor backlink gaps
- Brand and industry mentions
- High-quality authority opportunities
Do NOT use PBNs, link farms, spam directories, automated links, forum/comment spam or artificial link schemes.
13. AI SEARCH VISIBILITY
Where measurable, analyse our visibility across Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT Search, Perplexity, Gemini and Copilot.
Identify important queries/questions where competitors are cited but we are absent and recommend practical improvements.
14. REPORTING + IMPLEMENTATION
Establish a baseline and track:
- Organic impressions and clicks
- CTR
- Keyword positions
- Top 3 / Top 10 / Top 20 rankings
- Indexed pages
- Featured snippets
- PAA visibility
- AI Overview visibility
- AI citations where measurable
- Backlinks
We do not want someone who only sends a PDF audit. The freelancer should also be capable of implementing approved changes within Shopify, including metadata, content, internal links, schema, Liquid/theme SEO fixes and redirects where required.
IMPORTANT RESTRICTIONS
Do NOT:
- Change URLs unnecessarily
- Remove indexed pages without analysis
- Create hundreds of low-quality pages
- Mass rewrite content without checking existing rankings
- Create keyword cannibalisation
- Change canonicals without evidence
- Use spam backlinks
- Publish mass AI-generated content
Protect existing SEO equity while improving visibility.
WHEN APPLYING
Start your proposal with:
SHOPIFY SEO + GEO + AEO
Then answer:
1. How many Shopify websites have you personally optimised?
2. What Shopify technical SEO issues do you check first?
3. What experience do you have with Shopify Liquid?
4. How do you build keyword-to-URL maps?
5. How do you detect and fix cannibalisation?
6. How do you protect an already indexed Shopify website?
7. What experience do you have with GEO and AEO?
8. Have you worked on Google AI Overview visibility?
9. Have you worked on ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini or Copilot visibility?
10. How do you measure GEO/AEO performance?
11. Which SEO tools do you use?
12. Please provide Shopify SEO case studies with measurable results.
Applicants without strong Shopify SEO experience should not apply.

jobs.title: Robust Security for Freelance Platform

Here is what I need from you:

• A complete security architecture that covers end-to-end data encryption (in transit and at rest), hardened network infrastructure, and a resilient incident-response plan.  
• An authentication flow that supports multiple methods—two-factor, biometrics, email or similar—so I can enable, mix, or swap them without changing core code later on.  
• Secure coding guidelines or a review checklist my dev team can refer to, plus automated tests that prove the implementation is actually protecting personal, financial, and other sensitive records.

Acceptance criteria  
1. All user traffic is encrypted and any stored data is encrypted with unique keys per tenant.  
2. Vulnerability scans and penetration tests return no critical or high-severity findings.  
3. Authentication flow supports at least two configurable second-factor options out of the box.  
4. Documentation is complete enough for my in-house team to maintain without outside help.

If you can deliver this level of protection efficiently and clearly, I’d like to hear how you plan to approach it and what timeline you foresee.

jobs.title: CyberArk EPM Implementation and Integration
jobs.description: 1. Executive Summary This project aims to replace the current BeyondTrust PrivilegeManagementPolicyEditor elevation solution and GPO-based administrator controls with CyberArk Endpoint Privilege Manager (EPM). CyberArk EPM will help remove permanent local administrator rights and provide secure, controlled administrative access only when required through Just-in-Time (JIT) access. Listing templates/instructions

jobs.title: Stellar Project Non-Profit Logo
jobs.description:

jobs.title: High Accuracy KYC Verification System
jobs.description:
My goal is to deploy a secure, real-time module that blocks fraudulent sign-ups by matching a user’s live selfie against the photo on their passport, driver’s license, or national ID card. The engine must deliver high-accuracy facial recognition, run liveness checks to prevent spoofing, and extract document data with OCR so I can compare names, dates, and issuing authority automatically.

Scope of work  
The system should accept images or video from web and mobile sources, parse MRZ and PDF417 zones where available, and return a clear pass / fail payload to my platform within seconds. A lightweight admin dashboard is needed for manual review, audit trails, and adjustment of match-score thresholds. Please design the backend as REST or GraphQL APIs; Python (FaceNet, InsightFace), Node, or similar proven stacks are all fine as long as they meet the accuracy target and can scale.

Deliverables  
• Fully documented API with sample calls  
• Liveness detection and face-document matching model achieving ≥99 % true-positive rate at ≤0.01 % false acceptance  
• OCR pipeline covering passports, driver’s licenses, and national ID cards  
• Admin dashboard with search, review queue, and exportable logs  
• Deployment scripts (Docker/Kubernetes) and CI pipeline

Acceptance criteria  
A test suite with at least 1 000 mixed document/selfie pairs must run without human intervention and hit the accuracy benchmark above. Latency for a single verification should stay under 5 s on commodity cloud instances.

Include a brief note on how you will handle data encryption, GDPR/CCPA compliance, and future proofing for additional document types so I can evaluate long-term fit.

jobs.title: Deploy and Optimize TuneQueue Platform - 25/08/2026 10:32 EDT
jobs.description:
TuneQueue is currently a working prototype built in Replit for managing song requests and DJ queues at a single venue.
I need an experienced developer to take the existing TuneQueue codebase and turn it into a real, scalable commercial product.
The main problem
The current version is essentially designed around one venue. The architecture needs to be changed so TuneQueue can support many independent venues simultaneously.
Each venue needs its own:
Account/workspace
Users and staff
DJ/queue
Spotify connection
Settings
Customers/song requests
Subscription/billing status
Data
Data must be completely isolated between venues.
SaaS / subscriptions
TuneQueue needs to become a subscription-based SaaS product.
I need:
Subscription plans
Monthly/yearly billing
Online payment
Automatic subscription status
Trial period if appropriate
Upgrade/downgrade
Cancellation
Payment failure handling
Access restrictions when a subscription expires
Customer billing management
The architecture should make it possible to introduce different pricing tiers later.
Scalability
The application needs to be designed so that going from:
1 venue → 10 venues → 100 venues → 1,000+ venues
doesn't require rebuilding the application.
I need the developer to review the current architecture and identify anything that would prevent this from scaling, particularly:
Database architecture
Authentication
Tenant isolation
API architecture
Spotify OAuth/token storage
Backend state
Concurrent queue usage
Real-time updates
Caching
Hosting/deployment
Background jobs where necessary
The existing prototype currently has application state stored in memory, which is not suitable for a multi-venue production system. This needs to be replaced with proper persistent infrastructure.
Spotify
Spotify integration is a core part of TuneQueue.
Each venue should be able to connect its own Spotify account securely.
Spotify authentication/token storage therefore needs to be designed around multiple independent venues, rather than one global Spotify connection.
Mobile application / App Store
The final product needs to become a real mobile application distributed through the Apple App Store and Google Play Store.
I don't necessarily want the existing application completely rewritten.
The developer should determine the best approach for turning the existing frontend/backend into a mobile product, potentially using a technology such as React Native/Expo or another appropriate solution.
The mobile app should use the same production backend/API and support the TuneQueue functionality required by users and DJs.
I need:
Android app
iOS app
App Store submission preparation
Google Play submission preparation
Production builds
App icons/splash screens/basic store requirements
Secure authentication
Connection to the production TuneQueue backend
What I want from the developer
I already have a working prototype and don't want to start from zero.
The job is to:
Audit → Refactor → Productionize → Scale → Monetize → Mobile
I want the developer to reuse as much of the existing code as makes sense while replacing prototype-level architecture where necessary.
The end result should be a commercially viable TuneQueue platform where multiple venues can independently sign up, subscribe, connect Spotify, manage their queues, and use TuneQueue through web and mobile apps.
Priority: Get the existing prototype out of Replit and establish the production architecture as quickly as possible, while making sure the architecture doesn't need to be rebuilt again when the number of venues grows.

jobs.title: Licensed Japan Port Freight Agent
jobs.description:
I’m looking to partner with a licensed on-site agent who can represent my freight forwarding company at the ports of Tokyo, Osaka and Yokohama. The cargo mix you’ll handle is broad—perishable items, electronic goods, general merchandise, plus the occasional car, machinery or other specialised loads—so experience across multiple commodity codes and temperature-controlled processes is essential. If you already liaise regularly with the quarantine office and can book domestic trucking or rail at short notice, that’s exactly the skill set I need.

Acceptance criteria for this engagement:  
• Proof of your current Japanese port agent licence and any relevant customs accreditations  
• Clear outline of your service workflow for both FCL and LCL cargo  
• Contactable client references (international preferred)  
• Indicative turnaround times for import clearance at each listed port

Once I review your credentials we can agree on volumes, service fees and start date. Drop me a message with the requested documents and let’s move this forward quickly.

jobs.title: Minimalist Education Consultancy Website

jobs.title: E-Commerce UI/UX Redesign
jobs.description:

I’m looking for a designer–developer who can rethink the entire customer journey, translate that vision into intuitive wireframes, then build pixel-perfect, responsive screens that slot cleanly into my existing code-base.

Here’s what I have in mind:

• Deliver fully responsive pages (HTML, CSS, modern JS or a component framework if you prefer) ready for hand-off or direct deployment.

I value clear communication, quick iteration cycles, and pragmatic solutions over pixel-pushing for its own sake. If this sounds like a fit, tell me how you’d approach the redesign and link to two or three similar projects you’ve both designed and coded.

jobs.title: Collect & Organize Survey Data
jobs.description:
I need help collecting a large set of survey responses and entering them with perfect accuracy into an Excel workbook that I will supply. The task is squarely data-collection focused: every answer must be transferred, checked, and formatted so later analysis runs smoothly.

The surveys come from mixed sources—some arrive through an online form export, others as scanned paper sheets, and a few via email threads—so you should feel comfortable working with whichever format I forward. Once the data is captured, I also want basic descriptive statistics and clear pivot-tables or charts prepared inside the same file; nothing fancy, just the counts, averages, and percentages that let me see emerging trends at a glance.

Acceptance criteria:
• 99 % entry accuracy (I will spot-check).  
• Consistent formatting for dates, numbers, and multiple-choice fields.  
• A brief summary tab showing the key metrics generated directly from the raw sheet.

All work must be done in Microsoft Office—mainly Excel, with Word or PowerPoint only if you prefer them for the summary visuals. If you have handled survey data before and can deliver an initial batch of roughly 100 responses within 48 hours, let me know when you can start and share a quick example of similar projects you’ve completed.

jobs.title: Modernize WordPress E-commerce UX
jobs.description:

Key touch-points to tackle  
• Navigation menu – cleaner hierarchy, intuitive labels, mobile-first responsiveness  
• Product pages – bolder imagery, improved gallery/zoom, clearer call-to-action placement  
• Checkout process – fewer steps, distraction-free layout, trust-building micro-interactions

The visual direction is firmly Modern: generous white space, sharp typography, subtle animations, and colour choices that complement (not overshadow) the products.

Deliverables will include updated theme/child-theme files or page-builder templates, any custom CSS/JS, and clear notes on where changes were made so I can maintain them later. All work must remain compatible with current WordPress and WooCommerce versions and pass cross-browser/mobile tests.

Target turnaround: the whole revamp live within one month, with milestones for design mock-ups, staging implementation, and final hand-off.

jobs.title: B2B Lead Generation Specialist Needed
jobs.description:

If you’re comfortable building pro-looking tables or simple financial snapshots in Excel and dropping them into the document, that’s a plus. Deliver a draft that I can review within one week, then incorporate my feedback for a final version a few days later. If you need anything else from me—existing notes, rough financial assumptions, competitive intel—just let me know and I’ll supply it promptly.

jobs.title: WordPress Industrial Product Catalogue Site

jobs.title: Structural Integrity Review Needed
jobs.description:

Before I place any orders, I’d like a qualified structural engineer to verify the overall load-bearing capacity of the scheme. The review should concentrate on structural integrity,  general material selection, and specifically cover:

• Brick cavity walls  
• The oak-framed superstructure  
• The four steel columns supporting the lantern and flat roof

Please analyse the current member sizes, connections, and bearing details, flag any overstressed elements, and propose practical modifications if required. A short calculation report (PDF) plus annotated sketches or mark-ups that I can pass to Building Control will be the expected deliverables. I can supply layout drawings and sections in DWG or PDF as soon as we start.

If you work with tools such as Express Scribe, Subtitle Edit, or oTranscribe that is a plus, but you are free to use any workflow you prefer as long as the final result meets the criteria below.

Deliverables

• Time-coded SRT (or VTT) files aligning dialogue with the original audio so my animation team can import directly into the 3D scene.

Acceptance criteria  
• ≥ 98 % word-level accuracy when spot-checked.  
• Consistent speaker labels when multiple characters overlap.  
• Delivered within the agreed turnaround time; small batches are welcome so we can review as you progress.

jobs.title: Commission-Only Software sales development reps
jobs.description:
Commission-Only SaaS Sales Representative — 25% Commission
The Opportunity

I'm looking for an experienced B2B SaaS salesperson to sell our cloud-based software solution to qualified business prospects.

This is a 100% commission-only position with no base salary, but the commission is substantial: 25% of collected revenue on every new customer you close.

You do not need to generate your own leads. I'll provide the leads. Your job is to turn qualified prospects into paying customers.

Compensation

A: Initial Sale Commission

25% commission on collected revenue

For example:

$10,000 sale → $2,500 commission
$25,000 sale → $6,250 commission
$50,000 sale → $12,500 commission
$100,000 sale → $25,000 commission

The more you sell, the more you earn. There is no cap on commissions.

B: Recurring Commission

In addition to the initial sale commission, you will receive 1% of the customer's average monthly recurring revenue every month for as long as that customer remains active starting on the 8th month.

This gives you the opportunity to continue earning from the customers you bring in—not just from the initial sale.

Total Compensation

A + B

This means a successful salesperson can earn both a substantial commission when closing a new customer and ongoing recurring commissions from their existing customers.

What You'll Do

You'll manage the sales process from qualified lead to closed customer:

Contact provided leads through email and phone
Qualify prospects and understand their business needs
Conduct online product demonstrations
Explain the value of the software and answer questions
Handle objections and negotiate when appropriate
Follow up consistently with prospects
Maintain an accurate sales pipeline in our CRM
Close deals and help ensure the initial payment is collected

I'll provide the leads, product information, pricing, sales collateral, CRM, and demo access. You focus on selling.

What I'm Looking For

I'm looking for someone who:

Has demonstrated B2B or SaaS sales experience
Is comfortable conducting online demos
Knows how to sell value rather than simply explain features
Is confident handling objections and closing
Is organized and persistent with follow-up
Can work independently without constant supervision
Is motivated by a significant commission opportunity

Experience selling software, business services, workflow software, CRM, document management, or similar B2B solutions is a strong plus.

How Success Is Measured

Success is measured primarily by closed and collected revenue, not by the number of calls or emails you make.

You will have qualified leads to work with. We want someone who can take those opportunities and turn them into customers.

Why This Opportunity

A 25% upfront commission plus recurring monthly commissions creates significant earning potential for a salesperson who can close.

You're not starting from zero every month. The customers you bring in can continue generating commission for you for as long as they remain customers.

If you're a strong closer who would rather have uncapped earning potential than a fixed salary, this could be a very good opportunity.

If you have a proven sales track record, tell me about it in your proposal—including:

What you've sold
Your typical deal size
Your closing experience
Your experience selling SaaS or B2B software
The type of customers you've sold to

- Independently re-run DRC (JLCPCB constraints: 0.127mm min clearance/trace width, 0.2mm min via drill) and sanity-check the ~195 disclosed sub-optimal-but-passing clearance findings in saturated routing areas — confirm none of them are actually load-bearing risks.

- We've identified a genuinely IP67-rated, LCSC-stocked replG-SMT-TR-67 (LCSC C3197945) — a 24-pin USB 3.2 Gen2 shellthat's pin-compatible with our 16 used signals (8 unused SuperSpeed pins go no-connect).
- Needs: a new KiCad footprint authored from the real datashfferent pad pitch and THT-anchored shell legs vs. the currentpart), re-placement at the board edge (there's a pre-cut flat chord in the round outline for the connector), and DRC/clearance re-verification —
  including keep-out clearance to the MCU module's antenna a

3. Battery charger + fuel gauge PCB placement (open item)
- Two ICs (a Li-ion/LiFePO4 charger and an I2C fuel gauge) had their schematic symbols corrected to match their real chosen parts' full pinouts, but
  the PCB-side footprint swap is still blocked by genuine sp of the board — including a discovered short risk between one part's exposed thermal pad and a nearby power trace.
- Needs: a real placement/routing solution for both parts in(may require local re-routing of neighboring nets), verifiedDRC-clean, no compromise on the thermal pad clearance.

Deliverables

- Updated KiCad 10.x project (schematic + PCB) with both open items resolved
- A short written review note: anything you found or changed
- Updated BOM/CPL for JLCPCB reflecting any part changes
- Fresh DRC report showing the final state clean (or with ancitly justified)

What we're looking for

E-waste management is the proper collection, transportation, sorting, reuse, recycling, recovery and disposal of discarded electrical and electronic equipment such as computers, phones, televisions, printers and refrigerators. E-waste contains valuable materials such as copper, aluminium, gold and plastics, but may also contain hazardous substances such as lead, mercury and cadmium. Improper disposal, open burning and unsafe recycling can pollute soil, water and air and cause health problems. Effective management follows the waste hierarchy: reduce, reuse, repair, refurbish, recycle, recover and safely dispose. Important measures include separate collection, public awareness, safe storage, formal recycling facilities, worker protection and producer responsibility. In Rwanda, e-waste management is supported by national policies and regulations that promote environmentally sound collection, recycling, reuse and disposal. Proper e-waste management protects the environment, reduces health risks, conserves resources and creates employment opportunities.

jobs.title: Skilled Video Editor for Jewelry Brand
jobs.description:

We are looking for a creative and skilled Video Editor who can transform raw video footage into engaging, premium-quality content for social media, digital marketing, and advertising campaigns.

We will provide you with raw footage, product videos, jewellery shots, founder videos, and other creative assets. Your role will be to take these raw materials and turn them into high-quality, attention-grabbing videos that reflect the premium image of our jewellery brand.

We are not looking for someone who simply follows instructions. We want someone who brings ideas to the table, understands what makes content perform, and takes ownership of the creative process.

Key Responsibilities
Edit short-form videos for Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, Facebook, and other social platforms
Create videos for Meta Ads, Google Ads, and other digital advertising campaigns
Edit raw footage into engaging and visually appealing content
Create strong hooks and attention-grabbing openings for videos
Add transitions, text animations, motion graphics, sound effects, music, subtitles, and other elements
Create jewellery/product-focused videos that highlight design, craftsmanship, details, and luxury appeal
Develop different versions of videos for organic content and paid advertising
Edit founder videos, product videos, educational content, UGC, testimonials, promotional videos, and behind-the-scenes content
Create thumbnails and supporting visual creatives when required
Perform colour correction and enhancement to maintain a premium jewellery aesthetic
Keep up with current social media trends, editing styles, hooks, transitions, and content formats
Suggest new video concepts, editing styles, references, and creative approaches
Work closely with the marketing team to understand campaign objectives and target audiences
Organise project files and maintain proper editing workflows
Deliver content within agreed timelines
Required Software Skills

Adobe Premiere Pro
Main video editing, cutting, sequencing, audio editing, transitions, subtitles, and exports.

Adobe After Effects
Motion graphics, text animation, advanced transitions, product animations, visual effects, and creative compositions.

Adobe Photoshop
Thumbnail creation, image editing, image cleanup, jewellery/product creatives, and basic graphic design.

Adobe Lightroom
Colour correction, image enhancement, and improving jewellery/product photography.

CapCut
Fast-paced social media editing, trending formats, reels, subtitles, effects, and short-form content.

Canva
Basic social media creatives, thumbnails, presentations, and supporting marketing visuals.

What We Are Looking For
Strong understanding of short-form video content
Good sense of timing, pacing, composition, and storytelling
Strong understanding of social media content
Ability to create compelling first 2–3 seconds/hooks
Good understanding of music, sound effects, transitions, and visual rhythm
Excellent attention to detail
Ability to make jewellery look premium, luxurious, and visually appealing
Creative mindset with the ability to suggest ideas independently
Ability to understand the purpose behind a video rather than simply following instructions
Willingness to experiment with new formats and trends
Ability to work independently and manage multiple projects
Good communication and time management skills
Most Important: Creative Thinking

We want a video editor who can say:

“Here is another way we can make this video better.”

You should be comfortable suggesting:

Better hooks
Different editing styles
Trending formats
New content ideas
Alternative transitions
Better music or sound design
Different ways to showcase jewellery
New concepts for advertisements
Ideas based on what is currently performing on social media

We value creativity and initiative as much as technical editing skills.

Nice to Have
Previous experience working with fashion, jewellery, luxury, beauty, lifestyle, or premium brands
Understanding of Meta Ads and performance marketing
Experience creating videos specifically designed for conversions
Basic understanding of social media analytics and retention
Knowledge of AI video and creative tools
Basic photography or videography knowledge
What You Will Receive

We will provide:

Raw video footage
Product/jewellery footage
Images and brand assets
Content requirements and campaign objectives

You will be responsible for turning these assets into finished, platform-ready content.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is someone who is technically strong, creatively driven, trend-aware, and proactive.

If you are someone who doesn't just ask “What should I edit?” but thinks “How can I make this perform better?”, we'd love to hear from you.

How to Apply

Please share:

Your CV
Portfolio/showreel
Examples of Reels/Shorts you have edited
Examples of advertisements or performance-focused videos, if available

jobs.title: Dynamic Cambridge Promo Video
jobs.description:

• Style: fast-paced cuts, lively delivery, natural ambient sound with light background music if possible.  
• Content: mention our book’s name once, tie it to Cambridge’s reputation for excellence, and end with a call-to-action (e.g., “Find it on Amazon now”).

– Audio intelligible and free of heavy wind noise.  
– All video rights transferred upon delivery.

jobs.title: Lead-Generating Landing Page Copy
jobs.description:
I need fresh, high-impact copy for a landing page whose sole purpose is to capture leads. The business already has a clear value proposition and a defined target persona; now I want the words on the page to do the heavy lifting—grabbing attention, building trust fast, and guiding visitors toward the opt-in form.

Here’s what will make this project a success:  
• A concise, benefit-driven headline and sub-headline that speak directly to the prospect’s pain points.  
• Persuasive body copy that flows naturally from problem to solution, reinforces credibility, and overcomes common objections.  
• A crystal-clear call to action framed around the prospect’s gain, not my need.  
• Optional but welcomed: micro-copy suggestions for form fields, trust badges, and button text.

Tone: conversational yet authoritative, the way a knowledgeable friend explains why this offer is the smartest next step. SEO keywords are secondary to conversion, but weaving them in where they fit naturally will be appreciated.

I’ll supply background materials, audience insights, and any data you need. Please return the copy in an editable Google Doc along with a brief rationale for the key messaging choices so I can see your strategy at a glance.

Here’s how I picture the workflow. First, you listen to the song and pitch a storyline that reflects its message of hope and redemption. Once we agree on the concept, you’ll build a detailed storyboard and create it with AI tools you have access to, and finish with a polished edit ready to publish in 4K on YouTube. Visual pacing should follow the music naturally, and any text elements—titles, credits, scripture references if appropriate—should remain minimal so the narrative stays front and center.

jobs.title: Rebuild and Redesign of Financial Model
jobs.description:
Seeking a senior Financial Analyst / Modeler to perform a ground-up rebuild and complete visual redesign a multi-tab financial model. Scope of Work:
• Deconstruction & Analysis: Analyze the existing model to map out all underlying logic, drivers, assumptions, and required financial outputs.
• Ground-Up Rebuild: Recreate the entire financial model from a blank workbook. Build brand-new, robust formulas for all operational drivers, debt schedules, working capital, depreciation, and 3-statement financial integration.
• Calculation Cross-Verification: Run parallel output checks between the original model and the newly built model to flag, reconcile, and correct any underlying mathematical or logic errors from the legacy file.
• Best-Practice Architecture & Redesign:
o Structure the new model using financial modeling best practices (strict separation of Inputs/Assumptions, Calculations, and Output Statements).
o Apply an institutional, executive-ready design (standardized fonts, clear input/output color coding, clean layout, and auto-fitted grids).
o Build dynamic check tabs (e.g., Balance Sheet tie-outs, debt sizing checks) to ensure seamless ongoing use.

3. Payment gateway live-tested in test mode; orders flow through to confirmation email.

Deliver all files in native CAD format as well as STEP/IGES and PDF for downstream teams.  

The project is considered complete when:
• All models and drawings open error-free.  
• Critical dimensions and tolerances are annotated.  
• Material and treatment specs are documented.  
• A brief assembly guide confirms piston-to-cylinder clearance and ring placement.  

If you have experience with tight-seal or high-compression piston assemblies, let me know in your proposal and feel free to attach a sample drawing set.

jobs.title: Programme implementation
jobs.description:
The Scenario 

FIGURE 1 shows part of a control system used to maintain the water level in a 
sump between the levels high and low. Two transducers (HIGH and LOW) are 
used to monitor the level. The water is pumped out by two pumps, P1 and P2. 
The water level in the sump is to be controlled as follows: 
 If the level reaches high one pump will start to pump out.
 If the level does not reach low within about 30 seconds, the second pump
will come into action. If the level does reach low before 30 second
pumping should stop.
 If the level does not reach low within about 30 seconds of the second
pump starting, an alarm is given. The alarm is sounded until the level
reaches low. If the level does reach low before 30 seconds the pumping
should stop.
 The pumps will stop when low is detected.
 To give even loading of the pumps they are to be used alternately, e.g. if
on one pump cycle P1 starts first and P2 is the ‘back up’ then on the next
cycle P2 will start first and P1 is the ‘back up’.
The system is to be controlled by an Arduino microcontroller. The pumps can 
be mimicked by LEDs*. Switches can be used to represent the LOW and HIGH 
transducers. The program should inspect the input switches at regular intervals 
and take appropriate action. 

*If you chose to use the UnoArduSim then you can use its motor simulators to
model the two pumps. A further enhancement would be to use a potentiometer 
as a ‘level’ transducer so that, say, 10% travel is ‘low level’ and 90% ‘high 
level’.  

PROGRAM SPECIFICATION 
It is obvious that before starting to design and code a computer program, the 
programmer should have all the relevant information required to solve the 
problem. This information should include: 
• what operation the program is expected to perform
• details of input data that will be used
• an indication of the expected output
• any additional information such as mathematical formulae to be used, as well
as any hints that would help in the solution.
All this information forms the PROGRAM SPECIFICATION

jobs.title: Industrial IoT Sensor Hardware Development
jobs.description:
I need a hardware engineer who can take an industrial-grade IoT concept from paper to fully functioning prototype. • Stable wireless link in a metal-heavy environment at 30 m line-of-sight.  
optional PEO integration as well

jobs.title: I am looking for a pixel artist to create a 16x16 Top-Down Dungeon Tileset for my strict grid-based puzzle game.

I need a 16-piece modular wall system (corners, edges, center, etc.). Because we are not using transparency, the 'outside' or unplayable areas of the walls must fade into pure black (darkness), exactly like the attached reference image.

Top wall tiles: Must fade to pitch black at the top.

Bottom wall tiles: Must fade to pitch black at the bottom.

Left/Right wall tiles: Must fade to pitch black on their respective outer sides.

Center/Fill tiles: A wall tile surrounded by other walls on all 4 sides should be completely black (the void).

2. Specific Mechanics (Must also fit strict 16x16):

Base Floor: A standard dungeon floor tile.

Bridge: A simple bridge tile.

Fire Trap: A fire-shooting mechanism tile.

Floor Button: A pressure plate/button that is exactly the same color/texture as the base floor, but looks slightly raised (this will be used to trigger the fire trap).

3. Optional Additions:
If you have the time/budget, I am open to water tiles, doors, or teleport pads, but these are completely optional. My main focus and budget are going toward the flawless execution of the shadow-baked Wall System.

If you can execute this strict, no-transparency grid style, please let me know your price for this specific list!"

jobs.title: WhatsApp-Powered Travel Booking Platform
jobs.description:
I want a single, seamless flow that turns an incoming WhatsApp message into a confirmed travel booking. The conversation must run through Meta’s WhatsApp Cloud API, be orchestrated in n8n, interpreted by an AI layer (natural-language processing with full chatbot capability), and then routed to my travel backend where flights, hotels, activities, and cabs are sourced, priced, quoted, and finally paid for.

Here’s the path I need implemented end-to-end:

• Meta WhatsApp Cloud API: configure webhooks, templates, and session messaging so automated responses drive the chat.  
• n8n: build the workflow that catches each message, calls the AI service, branches the logic, and hits the relevant supplier or internal microservice.  
• AI layer: use NLP to understand intent, gather missing trip details, and hold a natural dialogue until the request is complete.  
• Travel orchestrator: connect to flight GDS/aggregator, hotel and activity suppliers, plus a cab partner; assemble results, feed them to the pricing engine, and return a clear quotation.  
• Booking & payment: on customer approval, push the reservation to each supplier, capture the payment, and send confirmation back through WhatsApp.  

Acceptance criteria  
1. A demo conversation in which a user asks for a weekend trip, receives flight, hotel, activity, and cab options, approves the quote, and gets a paid booking confirmation—all inside WhatsApp.  
2. Source-controlled n8n workflow, AI prompt/intent logic, and backend code with environment variables for keys.  
3. Setup guide so I can redeploy the stack on my own servers and switch suppliers or payment gateways later.

If you’ve already wired WhatsApp Cloud API to real-world services and can show an n8n flow or chatbot doing something similar, I’d love to see it.

jobs.title: TikTok Channel & Sales Funnel Creation for LUWEE

SHOP NOW

ORDER NOW

4. Different Video Concepts

Sports & Fitness

Gym, workouts, running, cycling, tennis and other sports.

Outdoor & Swiss Lifestyle

Hiking, mountains, skiing and an active lifestyle.

9:16 vertical format

TikTok Video → Click → Landing Page → Add to Cart → Checkout → Purchase → Revenue

Website Sales / Conversions

* Countries/markets
* Campaign structure
* Test budget
* Creative testing
* Retargeting
* Optimization
* Scaling successful creatives

We want to start with a controlled test budget.

Only when the videos and campaigns produce commercially viable results should the advertising budget be increased.

8. Reporting

We want to monitor:

* CTR
* CPC
* Landing page visits
* Add to Cart
* Checkout

The number of likes and followers is not our primary KPI.

Our objective is SALES.

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR
