jobs.title: Embedded Electronics + Custom PCB + Firmware + Offline Wi-Fi Web HMI for Motorized Gaming Target Retrieval System
jobs.description:
Project Overview

I am developing a battery-operated motorised target retrieval system for a shooting/training range.

The system consists of a motorised retrieval mechanism, BLDC motor with an encoder, Gaming target rotation mechanism using a servo motor, battery-operated electronics, and a Wi-Fi-enabled camera.

I am looking for an experienced **Embedded Systems / IoT / Robotics / Industrial Automation Engineer** who can develop the complete electronics, firmware and local web-based control system.

This is a product-development project. I am looking for someone who can take the system from prototype architecture through custom PCB, firmware, testing and a working prototype.

## Main Requirement

The complete machine must be operated from a tablet through a web browser.

The system must work **without Internet access**.

The machine itself should create its own Wi-Fi network.

Example:

**Tablet → Wi-Fi → Retrieval System**

The operator should connect the tablet directly to the machine's Wi-Fi and open the control interface through a web browser.

No cloud server, SIM card, external Internet connection or external Wi-Fi router should be required for normal operation.

## Main Hardware

The system will include:

1. BLDC motor for retrieval movement
2. Encoder connected to the BLDC motor
3. BLDC motor driver/controller
4. Servo motor for target rotation
5. Battery-powered power system
6. Battery monitoring
7. Wi-Fi-enabled embedded controller
8. Wi-Fi camera
9. Limit/home sensors
10. Emergency stop/safety inputs
11. Motor current monitoring
12. Position/distance monitoring
13. Status/fault indication
14. Appropriate industrial connectors
15. Custom PCB

The final electronics architecture can be proposed by the engineer after understanding the motor, encoder, servo and battery specifications.

## Motor Control

The controller must be capable of controlling the retrieval motor with encoder feedback.

Required functions may include:

* Forward
* Reverse
* Stop
* Variable speed
* Position/distance control
* Homing
* Encoder feedback
* Travel distance monitoring
* Motor fault detection
* Over-current protection
* Stall detection
* Limit switch detection

The engineer should propose the appropriate control architecture for reliable operation.

## Target Rotation

A servo motor will rotate the target.

The system should support:

* Rotate left
* Rotate right
* Preset angular positions
* Position feedback where applicable
* Controlled acceleration/deceleration if required
* Servo fault/status monitoring

The final servo interface and control method can be proposed by the engineer.

## Local Wi-Fi and Web Interface

The embedded controller should create its own Wi-Fi Access Point.

The tablet should connect directly to the machine.

The operator should be able to open the control interface using Chrome/Safari or another standard browser.

The web interface should initially include:

### Main Screen

* Machine status
* Battery status
* Wi-Fi status
* Motor status
* Current position
* Target status
* Fault indication

### Retrieval Control

* Forward
* Reverse
* Stop
* Home
* Set speed
* Set distance
* Go to position

### Target Rotation

* Left
* Right
* Preset angle
* 0°
* 90°
* 180°
* 270°
* Custom angle if technically feasible

### Camera

* Camera status
* Camera ON/OFF or trigger if required
* Video access/preview if technically feasible

### Diagnostics

* Battery voltage
* Battery percentage
* Motor current
* Encoder position
* Motor temperature if sensor is available
* Servo position/status
* Fault history
* System status

## Offline Operation

This is a critical requirement.

The machine must continue to operate when there is no Internet signal.

The system should use its own local Wi-Fi network and local web server.

All essential control functions must work locally without cloud connectivity.

## Electronics / PCB Requirements

The engineer should design a production-oriented PCB including appropriate:

* MCU
* Wi-Fi
* Power regulation
* Battery management/interface
* Motor-control interfaces
* Encoder interface
* Servo interface
* Sensor inputs
* Limit-switch inputs
* Emergency-stop input
* Current/voltage monitoring
* Protection circuits
* Communication interfaces
* Industrial connectors
* Test points
* Programming/debug interface

PCB should be designed considering:

* Electrical noise
* Motor EMI
* Grounding
* Power integrity
* RF/Wi-Fi performance
* Thermal management
* Reliability
* Manufacturability
* Serviceability

Preferred PCB software:

* Altium
* KiCad
* OrCAD

## Firmware

Preferred experience:

* Embedded C/C++
* ESP-IDF
* FreeRTOS
* ESP32/ESP32-S3
* Motor control
* Encoder processing
* Servo control
* Wi-Fi Access Point
* Embedded Web Server
* WebSocket/REST/local communication where appropriate
* Fault handling
* Watchdog
* Data logging

## Deliverables

The selected engineer/team must be capable of delivering:

1. System block diagram
2. Electrical architecture
3. Complete schematic
4. Component selection
5. PCB layout
6. PCB source files
7. Gerber files
8. BOM with manufacturer part numbers
9. Pick-and-place files if applicable
10. Firmware source code
11. Embedded web application source code
12. Wi-Fi configuration
13. Wiring diagram
14. Connector pinout
15. PCB 3D/STEP model if applicable
16. Prototype PCB
17. Assembled and tested prototype
18. Firmware flashing procedure
19. Testing procedure
20. Fault/error documentation
21. Final engineering documentation

## Development Approach

I prefer the project to be developed in two stages.

### Stage 1 — Functional Prototype

Demonstrate:

**Tablet → Local Wi-Fi → Embedded Controller → BLDC Motor + Encoder + Servo**

and prove reliable operation.

### Stage 2 — Production PCB

After successful functional testing, develop the final custom PCB and production-ready electronics.

## Candidate Requirements

Please apply only if you have real experience in:

* ESP32/ESP32-S3
* Embedded systems
* PCB design
* BLDC motor control
* Encoder feedback
* Servo motor control
* Robotics or industrial automation
* Battery-powered systems
* Local Wi-Fi
* Embedded web interfaces
* Firmware development
* Product prototyping

## Portfolio Requirement

Please provide at least 3 relevant previous projects.

I am particularly interested in seeing:

1. BLDC/servo/encoder/motor-control projects
2. Battery-operated ESP32 or similar products
3. Custom PCB projects
4. Local Wi-Fi/web-controlled devices
5. Robotics/industrial automation products
6. Complete hardware + firmware products

Arduino LED/sensor projects alone are not sufficient for this project.

## Important

I am looking for an engineer who can take responsibility for the **complete electronics and embedded control system**, rather than only designing the PCB.

The final objective is a reliable working product that can subsequently be manufactured in quantity.

Please include in your proposal:

* Your relevant experience
* Similar projects
* Portfolio
* MCU/platform you recommend
* Proposed system architecture
* Estimated development time
* Estimated cost
* Prototype cost

jobs.title: 5-Axis CNC Retrofit Engineer
jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced Industrial Automation / Mechatronics Engineer (preferably located in Albania, Kosovo, Greece, or Bulgaria for ease of travel) to lead a complete controls overhaul of a heavy-duty industrial CNC machine.We own a 1997 Reichenbacher 5-Axis Woodworking CNC 

Machine currently running an obsolete Siemens control system. Our objective is to completely strip the old electronics and upgrade the machine to a modern Syntec CNC Controller and Yaskawa Servo Drives/Motors.We possess the complete, original technical documentation and electrical schematics from Reichenbacher in PDF format.
The chosen engineer will guide us through a structured, milestone-based process split into remote planning and on-site integration.Phase 1: Planning & Bill of Materials (BOM) — RemoteReview Schematics: Thoroughly analyze our existing Reichenbacher electrical and mechanical PDFs.Component Specification: Calculate and specify the exact models required for the upgrade, including the Syntec controller unit, Yaskawa servo drive capacities (kW/torque matching), power supplies, I/O modules, safety relays, and limit/proximity sensors.
Deliverable: A complete, ready-to-order Bill of Materials (BOM) so we can purchase the hardware.

Phase 2: Electrical Design & Engineering — Remote / HybridNew Wiring Diagram: Create a clean, updated electrical schematic mapping the new Syntec controller and Yaskawa drives to the machine's existing chassis, pneumatic valves, and 5-axis head.I/O Mapping: Define all input/output allocations for the tool changer, safety interlocks, and spindle controls.

Phase 3: Physical Installation & Wiring — On-Site (Albania)Cabinet Demolition: Safely decommission and remove the legacy Siemens controller, old drives, and obsolete wiring.Cabinet Assembly: Mount and wire the new Syntec controller, Yaskawa drives, breakers, and auxiliary components into the electrical cabinet based on the approved schematics.Sensor Integration: Replace or rewire end-stops, home sensors, and pneumatic control switches.
Phase 4: PLC Programming & Parameters Configuration — On-SiteSyntec PLC Customization: Program the Syntec PLC logic to handle machine-specific functions (e.g., tool changer carousel, dust extraction hood, lubrication cycles, pneumatic clamps).Drive Tuning: Configure and tune the Yaskawa servo drives for optimal acceleration, deceleration, and loop stability.

Phase 5: 5-Axis Calibration & Final Integration — On-SiteKinematic Setup: Configure the 5-axis machine kinematics within the Syntec system.RTCP Calibration: Perform precise Real-time Tool Center Point (RTCP) calibration to ensure accurate simultaneous 5-axis interpolation.Testing & Commissioning: Run test codes, verify safety circuits (E-stops), check tool changing sequences, and execute a final test cut.
Requirements for the Freelancer:Proven experience retrofitting or building 5-axis CNC machinery.Strong working knowledge of Syntec CNC controllers and Yaskawa servo systems.Ability to read complex industrial electrical blueprints (German manufacturing standards).Proximity to Albania: Must be willing and able to travel to our facility in Albania for the physical installation, programming, and final commissioning phases (Phases 3, 4, and 5).

jobs.title: Handwritten Notes to PDF
jobs.description:
I have a collection of handwritten notes that I need converted into a clean, error-free PDF. All pages must be typed from scratch—no OCR shortcuts—so that the final document reads smoothly and matches the original content word for word.  

Accuracy is everything here: spelling, punctuation, and line breaks must reflect the source material. Once the text is complete, simply export or save it as a single, well-organized PDF for delivery. If you’d like to work in Word or Google Docs first, that’s fine; I only need the final version in PDF format.

Let me know your estimated turnaround time and any questions you might have about the handwriting or page count.

jobs.title: 80-Acre Villa Masterplan
jobs.description:
I have 80 acres (soon to reach 100) that I want turned into a clear, build-ready masterplan for three separate villa communities. Each community must sit on its own 25–30 acre parcel, all linked by a primary road that enters directly from the highway, weaves through the site and branches off to each parcel. 

Every parcel is envisioned for modern villas only—clean lines, generous setbacks, plenty of light and private outdoor space. Please organise the lots so each development can operate independently yet still read as part of one overall estate.

A fourth parcel of about 3 acres, positioned centrally for equal access, is reserved for a sports clubhouse. Its layout should comfortably accommodate fitness and gym spaces, outdoor sports fields and indoor recreational activities, so think about parking, noise buffering and short pedestrian links from all three villa projects.

I need a refined masterplan that shows:
• Scaled site plan with north arrow, road hierarchy and parcel boundaries  
• Typical villa lot arrangement, green corridors and utility easements  
• Clubhouse footprint and surrounding sports areas  
• Expansion strategy for the additional 20 acres we expect to secure

Additional Details:
- 3 x 25-30 Acre Parcels for Villa Projects (Each parcel will be its own project)
- 1 x 3-5 Acre Parcel for Sports clubhouse area for housing sports facilities, etc.

Please deliver a presentation-ready PDF plus the fully editable CAD (dwg/dxf) or GIS file so our engineers can take it straight into permitting. A brief written rationale explaining key design moves and phasing will help us present to stakeholders. 

If you have proven experience master-planning modern villa communities and can translate that skill into clear, buildable drawings, I’m ready to review your proposal.

jobs.title: Engineering Product Lead Gen Specialist

jobs.title: Manual Excel Data Entry
jobs.description:
I have a spreadsheet template ready in Microsoft Excel and a batch of records containing both numbers and text that must be keyed in accurately. Everything will be supplied as clear source files, and the task is purely manual entry—no automated scripts or formulas needed at this stage. Consistency in spelling, capitalization, and numeric formatting is important, so each row should match the sample layout I will provide.

Once the data is entered I will do a quick spot-check; if everything aligns with the template, the job is complete. Please be comfortable working quickly while still double-checking your own work for errors. That’s all that’s required.

jobs.title: Website Sales Growth Strategy
jobs.description:
I’m preparing to relaunch my website with one clear objective: drive more sales. Both consumer shoppers and business buyers need to feel the site speaks directly to them, so I want every page, message, and call-to-action optimized for this dual audience.

Here’s what I need from you:
• A concise discovery brief that distills our core goal—sales growth—and outlines how the site will meet the needs of both B2C and B2B visitors.  
• An audience snapshot: key motivators, pain points, and decision paths for each segment.  
• A conversion-focused site outline or wireframe showing where and how we guide visitors to purchase or enquire.  
• Practical recommendations on copy tone, visual hierarchy, and UX elements that can be implemented quickly without a full platform change.

Success looks like a clear, well-structured document (or slide deck) that my design team can use as a blueprint for the website update, complete with actionable next steps and measurable KPIs.

If you’ve planned sales-driven websites before and can translate marketing principles into concrete site actions, I’d love to collaborate.

jobs.title: Dynamic Excel Sales Dashboard
jobs.description:
I need an Excel-based dashboard that turns my raw sales tables into clear, at-a-glance insights. The focus is strictly on two areas: overall sales revenue and individual product performance; I’m not tracking customer demographics right now.  

Visually, I’m looking for a clean mix of bar charts to compare product lines side-by-side and line charts to show how revenue trends evolve over time. The workbook has to refresh smoothly every day, so please plan for an automated data pull or a one-click Power Query/Pivot refresh that keeps formulas and visuals in sync without manual intervention.  

Deliverables I expect:

jobs.title: UK Motorcycle Gear Backlink Partners Needed
jobs.description:

jobs.title: 15-Day Android Game Compatibility Testing
jobs.description:
My new Android game is about to roll out on the Play Store and I need a thorough 15-day compatibility review focused solely on real smartphones. The goal is to uncover crashes, performance drops, graphics glitches, or any feature that behaves differently from one handset, screen size, chipset, or Android version to another.

You will install the production-ready build from Google Play, play through all core levels and menus each day, and log anything that prevents a smooth, consistent experience. I am interested only in compatibility findings; functional or usability comments are welcome if you spot them, but they are not the priority.

Please work with as much device variety as you have access to (different brands, resolutions, OS versions), capture clear reproduction steps, and attach screenshots or short clips when possible. 

Deliverables (daily or consolidated at the end):  
• A spreadsheet or tracker listing device model, Android version, issue description, and severity  
• Crash logs or adb bug reports where crashes occur  
• Confirmation of retest results after I supply any hot-fix build

I will be on standby throughout the two-week window to supply updated APKs and clarify questions, so fast turnaround on retests is appreciated. Let me know the smartphone models you can cover when you place your bid, and we can get started right away.

jobs.title: Craft iPhone eBay Auction
jobs.description:
I’m putting my iPhone up for absolute auction on eBay and need a compelling, keyword-rich listing that pulls in the biggest possible crowd of bidders. The core of the job is to write polished copy that showcases the phone’s detailed specifications—model, storage, color, iOS version, battery health, unlocked status, and any standout features—so shoppers immediately know exactly what they’re getting and feel confident placing a bid.

I’ll supply all raw data about the device and any photos you might want for reference; you shape that information into an eBay-optimized title, subtitle, and description that reads naturally on desktop and mobile, highlights competitive advantages, anticipates buyer questions, and complies with eBay policy. A sprinkle of proven SEO keywords and smart formatting is key to maximizing visibility across search, “watch” lists, and promoted-listing slots.

Deliverables
• Auction title, subtitle, and full description ready to paste into eBay  
• Clean spec sheet inside the description for quick scanning  
• Suggested item-specifics, category, and shipping settings  
• One round of tweaks after I review

If you’ve crafted high-performing eBay listings before—especially for tech or smartphones—let me see a sample. I’m eager to post as soon as the copy is finalized so the phone can start attracting bids right away.

jobs.title: ESP32/ATmega328 Industrial PCB Design
jobs.description:
I’m consolidating an existing prototype into a single industrial-grade PCB that hosts an ESP32 module for wireless connectivity and an ATmega328 for deterministic tasks. The board’s main job is high-accuracy sensor data collection, but it must also drive several stepper motors, so clean analogue front-ends and rock-solid power electronics need to live happily beside 24 V motor drivers.

Scope  
• Schematic capture that merges the two MCUs, level-shifting and all necessary isolation between the low-noise sensor domain and the higher-current motor domain.  
• PCB layout ready for fabrication: four-layer minimum, controlled impedance where appropriate, wide creepage on the power stage, and industrial connectors (Phoenix-style) for field wiring.  
• Integrated 5 V/3.3 V regulators sourced from a 24 V rail, plus reverse-polarity, surge and ESD protection.  
• BOM with readily available parts and suggested alternates.  
• Manufacturing files: Gerbers, drill, pick-and-place and assembly drawings.  
• Brief bring-up firmware that shows sensor acquisition on the ATmega328, hands data to the ESP32 over UART/I²C, and drives a NEMA 17 stepper via a standard driver (e.g., DRV8825).

Acceptance  
The design should pass basic ERC/DRC, compile in KiCad 7 (Altium acceptable if you provide a tagged release archive), and be electrically reviewed through a quick design-for-manufacture report. I’m not on a tight clock, so we can iterate on the layout until it’s production-ready; quality and maintainability trump speed.

jobs.title: Input Data Teks Cepat

jobs.title: Handwritten Book to PDF
jobs.description:
My 200-page manuscript is still in its original handwritten form and I need it converted into a polished, searchable PDF. Every chapter must be clearly set off with its own heading and internal bookmarks so that readers can jump straight to any section from the table of contents.

• Apply a clean, consistent style—chapter titles, sub-headings, and page numbers—so the final file reads like a professionally typeset book.  
• Deliver a single PDF document (no loose images) that opens quickly, allows word search, and maintains the same page order as my handwritten copy.  

Basic spell-checking is expected, but I will handle any deeper copy-editing after delivery. You are free to use OCR, manual typing, Adobe Acrobat, InDesign, or any other reliable tool set, as long as the final PDF meets the criteria above. A short sample from the first two pages would help me verify accuracy before you proceed with the rest.

jobs.title: Social Media Pop-Up Video Creation
jobs.description:
I need a punchy pop-up style video that will serve as a marketing ad across Facebook, Instagram and Twitter. jobs.title: Short Film Edit Assistance
jobs.description:

jobs.title: Mobile App & Portfolio Website
jobs.description:
I’m building “Smile Code”, a small but ambitious project whose first priority is a polished mobile application available on both iOS and Android. Alongside the app I also need a clean, responsive portfolio site that shows the product, its features and future roadmap.

jobs.title: Plain Text Data Entry
jobs.description:

jobs.title: Brazil Smile.one API Integration

Acceptance criteria

jobs.title: Create 10 x Reels from Raw Footage

jobs.title: Tutorial Video Editing

jobs.title: E-Commerce Listing Specialist Needed

jobs.title: PDF Text Conversion to Word
jobs.description:

jobs.title: Bulk Student Information Entry

You’ll get high-resolution scans of the enrollment forms and a clean spreadsheet template (Excel or CSV). Accuracy is vital: proper spelling, consistent formatting, and every required field filled. I will spot-check for errors, so please work carefully.

jobs.title: Adobe InDesign Mystery Game Template
jobs.description:

The freelancer should:

* Recreate our existing layouts professionally in **Adobe InDesign**

* Prepare layouts for **digital PDF distribution**
* Create consistent paragraph, character and object styles
* Create reusable components for:

  * Headlines
  * Question sections
  * Answer fields
  * Checkboxes
  * Information boxes
  * Evidence labels
  * Photo/Polaroid elements
  * Stamps
  * Footer instructions
* Set up Parent Pages / Master Pages where appropriate
* Organize layers and assets clearly
* Make it easy for us to create **new Mystery Games and cases ourselves**

## Visual Style

The existing design uses a distinctive **detective / crime dossier / vintage investigation file** aesthetic:

* Aged paper
* Typewriter typography
* Black/red color scheme
* Stamps
* Polaroid photographs
* Paper clips
* Ink splashes
* Coffee stains
* Evidence-file aesthetics

Example artwork will be supplied as the visual reference.

## Adobe Illustrator Assets

Where appropriate, reusable graphical elements should be recreated as clean vector assets in **Adobe Illustrator**, for example:

* Stamps
* Icons
* Frames
* Labels

* Investigation/evidence elements

All source files must be included. We do **not** want flattened artwork only.

## Important: This Is a Template Project

We are specifically looking for someone who understands **document systems**, not only graphic design.

The objective is that after completion we can take the master template and use it for further projects while maintaining the same professional visual identity.

The structure should therefore be **modular, scalable and easy for another designer to understand**.

## Please Include in Your Quote

Please tell us:

jobs.title: Automotive restoration Showcase & Parts Shopify
jobs.description:

1 x 15 min video every week

jobs.title: Minecraft SMP Optimization & Futuristic UI

jobs.title: 12 Android App Testers Needed

jobs.title: Web Tutor Chat & AV Calls
jobs.description:
We run Xplooreze, a website (not an app) connecting students and tutors for live online tutoring sessions. We need to solve two problems:

Tutors and students sometimes miss sessions because they have no way to check "is the other side here/online" or reach each other if something changes.
We do not want to expose either party's phone number or email to the other — all contact must happen inside our website.

We need a booking-scoped chat + call feature, similar to how Freelancer.com or Upwork handle client-freelancer communication on their website: a single panel per booking with a text chat thread and audio/video call buttons, with no personal contact details ever shown.

Scope of work:

Chat thread tied to each booking/session (not a general inbox) — text messages + file/image attachment support.

Audio + video calling, fully inside the browser — no phone numbers or external apps involved.
Identity masking: only a display alias (e.g. first name or "Tutor #1234") is shown to the other party — never phone number, email, or full profile.

Time-windowed access: chat and call are only active from ~30 minutes before the scheduled session start to a couple hours after it ends. Outside this window, the thread should be locked/archived.

Presence indicator: simple "online / waiting to join" status in the chat header, so each side can see if the other has shown up before the session time.

Email/SMS/browser notification when a new message arrives or a call comes in (existing notification system can be reused if we have one — will share details).

Deliverables:

Working chat + call feature integrated into our existing website
Source code with clear documentation



Nice to have (optional, can quote separately):

No. of attendees from 1 to multiple can be decided by admin

Screen sharing during calls
Call/chat history retained for dispute resolution by our support team

Please include in your proposal:

What technology/SDK you'd recommend for this and why
Your estimated timeline and cost
Examples of similar website chat/call features you've built before

jobs.title: Node.js Real-Time App Development

The first milestone is a working proof-of-concept that lets multiple clients connect via WebSocket (Socket.IO or a comparable library), exchange events instantly, and expose a simple REST endpoint for health checks and authentication.

You’ll architect a modular, scalable codebase in Node.js 18+ (TypeScript preferred), wrap it in Docker for easy local testing, and document every step so I can spin it up with a single npm install && npm start. I want to see unit tests around the critical paths and a README that explains how to add new events or swap in alternate transports later.

Deliverables:
• Node.js project with WebSocket gateway and sample publish/subscribe events  
• REST health-check and auth endpoints  
• Dockerfile + docker-compose.yml for local runs  
• Jest unit tests covering connection, broadcast, and edge cases  
• Clear README with setup, env-vars, and extension guidelines 
. Project already available and created; just need a developer to launch it on the local website.

Acceptance criteria: After setup, I should be able to connect two browser clients, send a message from one, and watch it appear on the other within 200 ms on a local network, with /health returning 200 OK.

Experience with Redis pub/sub, scalable Socket.IO clusters, or AWS/GCP WebSocket services will set you apart, as these are on the roadmap for the next phase. Share a link or brief summary of a similar real-time project you’ve delivered, and let’s get started.

jobs.title: Commission-Based B2B Sales Representatives for NetSuite Consulting Services
jobs.description:
Nodric Tech is looking for experienced B2B sales professionals and lead-generation specialists to introduce our technical consulting services to companies using Oracle NetSuite.

This is a commission-only opportunity with no fixed salary or hourly payment. You will earn an agreed commission for every customer you successfully bring to Nodric. Commission terms will be agreed upon before starting and paid after the customer signs and makes their payment.

About Nodric

Nodric is a specialized NetSuite and ERP technical consulting company. We help businesses improve, extend, and optimize their NetSuite environments through:

NetSuite customization and SuiteScript development
Migration of legacy SuiteScripts to SuiteScript 2.1
REST, SOAP, and third-party system integrations
Performance and governance optimization
External portals and dashboards integrated with NetSuite
Solutions that reduce dependence on full NetSuite user licenses
Ongoing NetSuite technical support and strategic consulting

Your Responsibilities

Identify companies currently using NetSuite
Find and contact relevant decision-makers, including CIOs, IT directors, ERP managers, finance leaders, and operations executives
Conduct personalized outreach through email, LinkedIn, calls, or your existing network
Understand the prospect’s challenges and determine whether there is a genuine opportunity
Introduce Nodric’s services and arrange qualified meetings
Support the sales process until the opportunity becomes a paying customer

Who We Are Looking For

Proven experience in B2B sales, business development, or lead generation
Experience selling ERP, SaaS, software development, IT consulting, or professional services
Strong written and verbal communication skills
Ability to reach decision-makers rather than submit generic lead lists
An existing network of NetSuite users or ERP decision-makers is a major advantage
Self-motivated professionals comfortable working on a commission-only basis

We are not looking for scraped databases or unqualified contact lists. We want sales partners who can generate genuine conversations, qualified opportunities, and paying customers.

Compensation

Commission-based only; no fixed salary or hourly payment
Commission agreed in advance based on the value and type of engagement
Payment made for successfully closed and paid customer contracts
Strong performers may build a long-term partnership with recurring earning opportunities

To Apply

Please include:

Your B2B sales or lead-generation experience
The industries and geographical markets you cover
Any experience with NetSuite, ERP, SaaS, or IT consulting
How you plan to identify and approach potential customers
Your existing professional network, if relevant
Your expected commission structure

Please begin your proposal with the words “Nodric Sales Partner” to confirm that you have read and understood that this is a commission-only opportunity.

jobs.title: Create a Detailed 3D Pen Holder Design
jobs.description:
roject: Detailed 3D Miniature Model Design from Reference Image – Functional Pen Holder

I am looking for an experienced 3D artist / 3D CAD designer to create a highly detailed and accurate 3D printable miniature model based on a reference image that I will provide.

The model will be designed as a functional pen holder, while maintaining the appearance, proportions, shapes, and small details of the reference design.

Requirements
Create the complete 3D model based closely on my reference image.
The model should be highly detailed, accurate, and professionally designed.
Preserve the important shapes, proportions, textures, patterns, and decorative details visible in the reference.
The design should look like a proper miniature collectible/model, not a basic or simplified interpretation.
The model must function as a pen/pencil holder with an appropriate internal opening/cavity.
Ensure the model is suitable for FDM 3D printing.
Avoid unnecessary extremely thin or fragile elements that could easily break during printing.
The model should be designed with proper wall thickness and practical geometry for 3D printing.
The final model should be clean, manifold/watertight, and free from major mesh errors.
Details should be properly integrated into the geometry rather than simply appearing as flat textures.
Deliverables

I would like to receive:

Final high-quality 3D model.
STL file ready for 3D printing.
STEP / Fusion 360 / editable source file if possible.
Separate parts if the design needs to be printed in multiple pieces.
Basic preview renders/images of the completed model.
Important

I will provide a reference image after starting the project. The final design should closely follow the reference while adapting it into a practical and printable pen holder.

I am particularly interested in someone who has experience with 3D printing, miniature modeling, sculpting, product design, and creating detailed STL models.

Please include examples of your previous 3D printable miniature, figurine, decorative, or functional product designs in your proposal.

I am looking for quality and accuracy rather than a quick/simple model.

jobs.title: Fix Firebase Referral Commission
jobs.description:
The referral flow in my JavaScript-based Firebase back end has stopped rewarding the referrer. A new user can still sign up with a code or link, the record shows in Firestore, yet the commission field in the referrer’s wallet document remains unchanged and no error is thrown.  

My priority is the commission-crediting logic. I would like you to trace the current Cloud Functions (or client-side writes, if that’s where it lives), verify the database rules, and patch whatever is preventing the wallet balance from updating. The app itself is delivered as a mobile build, so please keep an eye on any latency or permission issues that might arise on that platform.

Acceptance criteria  
• When a user registers with a valid referral code or link, the referrer’s wallet balance reflects the commission instantly and persists after page refresh or app relaunch.  
• Your fix is committed with clear comments and a brief note explaining what was wrong and how you resolved it.  
• No other wallet or registration features break in the process; basic regression testing passes.

Tech in use: Firebase Authentication, Firestore, Cloud Functions, vanilla HTML/JS front end that compiles into the mobile build (Cordova). Access to the repository and Firebase console will be provided as soon as we kick off.

jobs.title: Freon HVAC Design & Management
jobs.description:
I’m overhauling a mixed-use facility’s cooling plant and need a refrigeration engineer who can take full ownership of our halocarbon handling—R513A is the primary gas in service. The heart of the job is precise refrigerant management: safe recovery, evacuation, and weight-based charging that meets EPA and local compliance standards while minimising losses.

To make sure the upgraded plant is sized and routed correctly, I also need rigorous system validation. Provide fresh thermal load calculations and walk me through the numbers, then overlay any changes on the existing blueprints so I can see exactly how the airflow, pipework, and control wiring tie together. If you prefer CAD, even better—send the annotated layouts so my onsite crew can build straight from your files.

Our equipment mix includes large-frame chillers, VRF strings, and a pair of variable-speed screw compressors tied into an automated electrical panel. If you spot lurking faults while you’re tracing the circuits, flag them and suggest fixes; I’ll schedule the maintenance window around your findings.

Deliverables
• Verified thermal calculations with assumptions and safety factors  
• Marked-up blueprints or CAD files showing any reroutes or additions  
• Step-by-step R513A recovery and charging procedure with weight logs  
• Fault list (if found) on chillers, VRF/VRV loops, or compressor controls  

I’ll be available for quick clarifications and can supply existing drawings, control schematics, and previous service reports the moment we start. Looking forward to working with someone who treats every gram of refrigerant as if it were gold.

jobs.title: NQ Futures Trade Execution Specialist
jobs.description:

You will act only when the system’s conditions fire, using the bracket template I supply, and you must never override, second-guess, or “improve” any rule on the fly. The only parameter you will actively manage is the pre-defined take-profit level; entry triggers, stop losses, and max-daily-loss rules are already locked in and should remain untouched unless my documented rule book specifically calls for an intraday adjustment.

Throughout the session you will:

• Monitor price action, submit the orders when the trigger appears, and manage them until filled, closed, or cancelled.  
• Stay within the stated risk limits and avoid discretionary trades completely.

At the closing bell, send me a short end-of-day log showing each ticket number, win/loss outcome, cumulative ratio, and running account performance. A simple spreadsheet or a clean screenshot with notes is fine as long as it is clear and timestamped.

Proven, hands-on experience with NQ, a track record of disciplined execution, and solid knowledge of leverage, margin, and bracket orders are non-negotiable. If you are comfortable living inside strict rules and letting the edge play out, let’s talk.

jobs.title: Setup Gmail Bisnis Menghasilkan Uang

Ruang lingkup pekerjaan:
• Membuat atau mengonfigurasi akun Gmail bisnis lengkap dengan nama domain, signature, dan keamanan 2-Langkah.  
• Menyusun struktur label, filter, dan template agar setiap pesan promosi tertata dan mudah ditelusuri.  
• Menghubungkan Gmail dengan platform email marketing (mis. Mailchimp, Sendinblue, atau solusi sejenis) untuk otomatisasi kampanye.  
• Merancang satu template email promosi ramah seluler, copy singkat yang menarik, dan call-to-action jelas.  
• Menyiapkan daftar pelanggan baru pertama kali (bisa impor CSV) dan menetapkan segmentasi dasar.  
• Membuat panduan singkat tentang praktik terbaik monetisasi melalui email marketing—termasuk frekuensi pengiriman, subject line yang efektif, dan tips menghindari folder spam.

Hasil akhir yang saya harapkan: akun Gmail bisnis siap pakai, terintegrasi dengan platform email marketing, satu kampanye contoh aktif, serta dokumen panduan agar saya dapat mengulangi proses ini sendiri untuk penawaran berikutnya. jobs.title: Informatica-Driven SAP HANA Migration
jobs.description:

jobs.title: Google Ads Campaign for Global Sales
jobs.description:
My existing Google Ads account needs a sharp, results-driven overhaul so that every click translates into measurable sales from customers around the world. The core objective is simple: structure and run campaigns that consistently convert, keeping cost-per-acquisition in check while scaling volume.

Here’s what the engagement covers:  
• Audit the current account and pinpoint wasted spend or low-quality keywords.  
• Build tightly themed search and, where relevant, Display or Shopping campaigns that align with a purchase-focused funnel.

• Optimise daily—pausing under-performers, adding negatives, and expanding winning segments—to keep ROAS positive.  

A weekly performance snapshot outlining spend, conversions, CPA, and next actions will serve as the acceptance criteria; if the numbers trend upward, we keep scaling, otherwise we pivot fast.

All work happens inside Google Ads and Google Analytics, with reports shared in Data Studio (Looker Studio) for transparency. Access to the account will be provided as soon as we agree on milestones, and I’ll supply any creative assets or landing-page URLs you need.

jobs.title: Eye-Catching Social Media Graphics
jobs.description:

jobs.title: Children’s Immune-Boosting Meal Plan - 25/08/2026 03:55 EDT
jobs.description:

jobs.title: Chemical AI Plant Identifier Assistant -- 2
jobs.description:
I am setting up an end-to-end AI lab assistant that will ultimately help me eliminate unwanted plant species and isolate promising alkaloids for cell, tissue, and rodent studies. The very first milestone is to teach the system how to identify plant species strictly from their chemical fingerprints.

Here is what I need you to build now:

• A model or pipeline that ingests raw or pre-processed data from techniques such as LC-MS, GC-MS, or NMR and matches the signature to the correct species.  
• Tight integration with reputable existing chemical databases so the model can cross-reference compositions in real time.  
• A lightweight interface (CLI, small web app, or notebook) that lets me upload spectra or tabulated peak data and returns the species name alongside a confidence score.  
• Clear documentation of the data schema, preprocessing steps, and every dependency so I can reproduce the workflow inside my own lab environment.

Accuracy and transparency are critical: please include the metrics you will track and the validation approach you will use so we can judge whether the identifier is trustworthy before moving on to the elimination and alkaloid-isolation phases.

If you have previous work in cheminformatics, spectroscopy analysis, or ML-driven taxonomy, link me to it and outline how you would tackle database integration and model training.

jobs.title: Omnichannel Brand Awareness Campaign
jobs.description:

jobs.title: 3-Month Lead-Gen Marketing Campaign
jobs.description:

jobs.title: AI Film Studio Backend Setup
jobs.description:
I am building ROLLCALL, an AI film/video-generation platform. The website/frontend already exists.

I need a senior GPU/ML infrastructure engineer to build a clean production V2 backend for Wan2.2 I2V A14B. This is not a website-design project.

We have already proven that Wan2.2 A14B can generate usable video on an NVIDIA A100 80GB. The previous prototype used RunPod, Python, PyTorch/CUDA, FastAPI/Uvicorn and FFmpeg, but I do not want to continue patching a fragile experimental environment.

The engineer may recommend RunPod, Lambda Cloud, CoreWeave, AWS/GCP/Azure or another appropriate GPU provider, but must justify the choice specifically for a large Wan2.2 A14B workload.

Required architecture:

ROLLCALL Website → API → Persistent Job Queue/Database → Disposable GPU Worker → Wan2.2 I2V A14B → FFmpeg/QC → Object/Persistent Storage → ROLLCALL

Requirements:

NVIDIA A100/H100-class production inference
Wan2.2 I2V A14B
Python/PyTorch/CUDA
reproducible Docker-based deployment
pinned/compatible dependencies
persistent model storage
model loaded once and kept resident between jobs where appropriate
FastAPI or equivalent production API
immediate job ID creation
queued/generating/processing/completed/failed states
persistent job/segment state outside disposable GPU compute
idempotent jobs/retries
GPU crash/OOM recovery
automatic restart/recovery
FFmpeg + ffprobe output validation
persistent/object storage for generated media
QC frames and production manifests
replacement GPU must resume incomplete work without regenerating completed segments
monitoring/logging
GPU usage/cost monitoring
automatic shutdown/scaling strategy
complete integration with the existing ROLLCALL website

The GPU worker must be disposable. If the GPU instance disappears completely, production state and completed work must survive.

First acceptance milestone:

ROLLCALL Website → Job Created → GPU Worker → Wan2.2 I2V → Real MP4 Generated → FFmpeg/QC Validation → Persistent Storage → Job Completed → Video Plays on ROLLCALL.

I want this first end-to-end workflow operating within the first 1–2 working days, followed by production hardening.

Final acceptance requires:

Real end-to-end video generation.
Worker restart/replacement recovery test.
No loss or duplication of completed segments.
Reproducible deployment from documentation/configuration.
Exact Python/PyTorch/CUDA/package versions documented.
ROLLCALL website successfully plays the generated output.

Screening question — start your proposal with ROLLCALL-V2:

Explain how you would make a Wan2.2 A14B GPU worker disposable while keeping the model warm during active operation. Explain where models, queue/job state, source images, segments and final MP4s would live, and exactly what happens if the GPU dies after completing 7 of 24 segments.

Also tell me:

which GPU/cloud provider you recommend and why;
A100 vs H100 recommendation;
expected implementation time;
fixed-price estimate;
and examples of large diffusion/video inference systems you have personally deployed.

I am looking for completion in days, not weeks.

Do not apply with a generic AI/cloud proposal.

jobs.title: Revit 3D Rebar Modeling Specialist Needed

jobs.title: Expert Photo Editing Services

Typical adjustments will include balanced color correction, subtle yet effective retouching, and, where appropriate, seamless background changes or removals. Please share a small portfolio that shows similar work and outline your usual turnaround time per image set. Consistency, attention to detail, and clear communication throughout the process will be key to moving forward together.

jobs.title: Engaging Product Description Copywriting -- 2
jobs.description:
I’m looking for a skilled content writer who can craft compelling product descriptions that convert browsers into buyers. The focus is purely on content writing—no design or coding is involved.

Scope
• Write clear, persuasive, and SEO-friendly descriptions for each product in my catalog.
• Capture each item’s unique benefits and key features in a concise, engaging tone.
• Optimize phrasing for readability and search visibility without keyword stuffing.

What I’ll Provide
• A list of products with basic specs, images, and any brand guidelines.
• Target audience insights and preferred style references.

What I Expect
• Original, error-free copy (no AI paraphrasing tools—human-driven creativity only).
• Consistent voice across all items.
• Two rounds of revisions to fine-tune messaging.

If you have a portfolio of previous e-commerce or product description work, please share it. Let’s collaborate to give every product the standout copy it deserves.

jobs.title: Urgent Notes Typing to PDF
jobs.description:
I need several pages of already-typed paper notes transcribed into a clean, searchable PDF right away. The content simply has to be re-keyed accurately and laid out with standard text formatting—no elaborate styles, just clear headings, normal body text, and consistent spacing.  

Please include both a header and footer on every page. I’ll supply the exact wording for each once we start; for now, leave placeholder text so you can keep moving quickly.

Turnaround is critical, so I’m looking for someone who can start immediately and return:

• A polished PDF ready for distribution  
• The editable source file (Word, Google Docs, or similar) for any last-minute tweaks  

Accuracy and speed are the priorities. Let me know how soon you can deliver and any questions you might have.

jobs.title: Pediatric Dose Calculation & Review
jobs.description:
I need reliable, evidence-based pediatric dosing support for infants, children, and adolescents who are being treated for chronic conditions.  Your main task will be to calculate precise doses using age, weight, and body-surface-area data, while also factoring in disease-specific considerations such as renal or hepatic impairment when they apply.  

Alongside the calculations, I expect you to:
• Select the most suitable medicine, dosage form, and route.  Liquid formulations, chewable tablets, and injections are the preparations we reach for most often, so practical knowledge of compounding, concentration limits, and stability is important.  
• Perform a quick but thorough prescription check before anything is dispensed—identify dosing errors, contraindications, drug interactions, and any red flags for adverse effects.  
• Provide clear counselling points that parents, caregivers, and the wider care team can follow easily at home or on the ward.  
• Flag anything that needs follow-up and outline simple monitoring parameters so we can track therapeutic response and spot adverse drug reactions early.  

I work in a busy pediatric clinic and will supply patient details case-by-case in a secure format.  In return, I need concise dosing sheets (preferably PDF or spreadsheet) plus brief written notes that justify each decision.  A quick turnaround on routine cases is highly valued; complex scenarios can take a little longer as long as you explain your reasoning.  

If you are a clinical pharmacist, pediatric pharmacologist, or have demonstrable expertise in pediatric therapeutics, let’s collaborate.

jobs.title: Micro-Influencer Sourcing & Management
jobs.description:
I’m launching a performance-based sales campaign and need a partner who can quickly line up the right micro-influencers and keep the whole program running smoothly. My targets are creators in the lifestyle space and meme pages with genuinely engaged followings in the USA, UK, and UAE.

Platforms & formats  
The influencers you recruit must already be active and proven on Instagram, TikTok, and Facebook. I’ll be asking them for sponsored posts plus supporting story features that feel native to their feeds.

Tracking & payouts  
Each creator will receive a unique affiliate link so we can see exactly whose content is converting and pay out on real sales rather than vanity metrics. You’ll set up the links, supply them to the influencers, and monitor daily performance.

What I need from you  
• Identify a vetted shortlist of micro-influencers that match my niche, audience location, and quality criteria  
• Handle outreach, negotiations, and onboarding under a clear performance-only deal structure  
• Coordinate content briefs, approval, and publication schedules  
• Deliver weekly reports summarizing clicks, sales, and ROI for every affiliate link  
• Optimise the roster—replace low-performers and scale high-performers as data comes in  

Acceptance criteria  
A minimum of 15 approved influencers live with content in the first 30 days, each posting both a sponsored feed post and at least one story feature, all tracked through active affiliate links. I’ll consider the project on track when we have verified sales attributed to at least 70 % of the active roster.

If you have existing relationships in these regions, solid negotiation skills, and can keep creators motivated on a pay-for-results model, let’s talk.

jobs.title: Order Status Data Cleanup
jobs.description:
I maintain an online database that tracks customer order status, and over time the records have become inconsistent—duplicate entries, miss-tagged statuses, stray characters, and occasional blank fields are all getting in the way of accurate reporting. I need a detail-oriented freelancer who can log in remotely and clean up these records without disrupting live operations.

You will work directly inside the web-based system, so no spreadsheets or offline tools are required. The work is strictly data cleanup: locate and merge duplicates, correct obvious typos, standardise status values to the approved list, and flag anything that looks suspicious so I can review it. Because this is an active database, please avoid changing timestamps or any fields not related to order status.

I expect you to commit a few hours each day on a part-time, flexible schedule until the backlog is clear. Communication can happen through chat or email; quick questions are welcome so mistakes don’t propagate.

Deliverables  
• All order-status fields normalised and free of duplicates  
• A brief log of records you changed or flagged for review  
• Confirmation that integrity checks inside the platform pass after your updates

If you have prior experience tidying large online datasets and can demonstrate an eye for precision, I’m ready to give you access and get started right away.

jobs.title: Bluetooth Motor Control App
jobs.description:
I need a straightforward mobile application that runs on both iOS and Android and pairs over Bluetooth with a small motor-driven mechanism. Once connected, the app will send simple commands to spin the motor clockwise to enlarge a box and anticlockwise to shrink it.

I do not yet have a specific Bluetooth module chosen, so I will rely on your advice for readily available, budget-friendly hardware that is easy to source and integrates smoothly with the mobile stack you prefer (e.g., Core Bluetooth on iOS, Android Bluetooth LE, or a cross-platform layer such as Flutter’s bluetooth plugin).

The interface can stay minimal—think two large on-screen controls (increase / decrease) and a visual indicator confirming the motor’s current direction or stop state. Stability, low latency, and a clean pairing flow are more important than elaborate graphics.

Deliverables  
• Source code for both platforms (native or cross-platform).  
• A brief setup guide covering the recommended Bluetooth module, wiring to the motor driver, and steps to build/run the app.  
• APK, IPA (or TestFlight build), and a quick demo video showing clockwise and anticlockwise movement triggered from the app.

If the above sounds clear, let me know your preferred framework and any additional questions about the motor specs so we can get started right away.

jobs.title: مطلوب توضيح فكرة مشروع
jobs.description:
لدي تصور أولي مختصر لمبادرة رقمية ورد في العنوان، لكنني لم أحسم بعد ما إذا كان الأنسب إطلاقها كموقع ويب، تطبيق جوال أو برنامج مستقل. أود العمل مع متخصص يساعدني على بلورة الفكرة، اختيار المنصة المناسبة، ثم صياغة متطلبات واضحة يمكن الاعتماد عليها لاحقاً عند التنفيذ.  

ما أحتاجه في هذه المرحلة:  
• جلسة استكشاف لفهم الأهداف والأولويات.  
• مقارنة عملية بين الخيارات المحتملة مع شرح مزايا وتحديات كل منها.  
• مخطط مبسط لهيكلية الحل المقترح (صفحات أو شاشات رئيسية، الخدمات الجوهرية، قاعدة البيانات إن لزم).  
• وثيقة متطلبات وظيفية مبدئية تصلح كأساس لأي عرض تطوير لاحق.  

أقدّر الأسلوب العملي والقدرة على تبسيط المصطلحات التقنية. إذا كانت لديك خبرة في تحويل الأفكار المبهمة إلى خطط تنفيذية واضحة، يسعدني التعاون معك وتحديد إطار زمني مناسب لإنجاز هذه الخطوة التمهيدية.

jobs.title: High-Impact Logo Design and Brand Identity
jobs.description:
A strong logo design proposal outlines clear direction, realistic scope, and measurable outcomes. Presenting distinct options based on design approaches helps align on expectations early.
| Proposal Concept | Best For | Core Focus | Key Deliverables |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1. The Identity Refresh | Established brands looking for modernizing existing visuals without losing brand equity. | Evolutionary design, subtle refinement, optimization for digital screens. | Updated logo, brand evolution story, logo usage guidelines, vector asset package. |
| 2. The Complete Ground-Up System | Startups or rebranded companies needing a full identity visual foundation. | In-depth brand discovery, visual positioning, comprehensive system design. | Primary logo, secondary marks, custom color palette, typography pairing, brand book. |
| 3. The Modular / Dynamic System | Digital-first products, apps, or multi-platform brands requiring flexibility. | Micro-animations, responsive variants, sub-brand visual hierarchy. | Responsive logo suite (stacked, icon, wordmark), SVG animation, dark/light mode variants. |
Recommended Proposal Outline
 * Project Overview & Objectives: Summary of the client's current visual identity and core goals for the redesign.
 * Scope of Work & Creative Process: Detailed stages covering Discovery & Strategy, Concepting (2–3 distinct initial routes), Refinement, and Final Delivery.
 * Deliverable Checklist: Explicit list of file formats (SVG, EPS, PNG, PDF), color profiles (CMYK, RGB, Pantone), and usage documentation provided upon completion.
 * Timeline & Investment: Phased schedule (e.g., 3–4 weeks total) alongside clear pricing tiers or flat-fee milestones.
Which specific industry or brand stage are you preparing this proposal for?

jobs.title: WordPress, Automation & Lead-Gen Website Specialist
jobs.description:
Project Title: WordPress Website Setup, Automation & Lead Generation Specialist

I am looking for an experienced WordPress developer and automation/lead-generation specialist to build and manage a professional website for my project.

Main Requirements

- Set up and customize my WordPress website with a modern, professional theme.
- Install and configure a suitable new theme and required plugins.
- Create a dedicated NGO page for my initiative “Soch”, which aims to provide audiobooks and educational/motivational content to NGOs, rehabilitation centres, old-age homes and similar organizations.
- Create pages and content structure for the finance and investment education section.
- The platform will focus on educating people about financial/investment scams, misleading practices, trading/investment risks and common ways people lose money.

Ideal Freelancer

Please share examples of similar WordPress, automation, AI-agent or lead-generation projects you have completed, along with your estimated cost, timeline and recommended technology stack.

jobs.title: Health Center App Development
jobs.description:
I want to turn the diagram attached in the brief into a working cloud-based application that puts our Total Health Center in every client’s pocket. The first release will be client-facing, with therapist and admin portals following later, so the UX has to feel effortless for everyday users while leaving room for professional tools behind the scenes.

Core functionality
• Exercise programs: cardio, strength training, swimming, plus full sports-and-spa service routines that I will supply in structured content files.
• Secure payments and subscription handling.
• Access control for membership tiers and facility check-ins.
• Wearable integration (Apple Watch, Garmin, Fitbit preferred but I’m open to other SDKs).
• Push and in-app notifications for session reminders and health tips.
• Progress tracking with visual analytics surfaced from the cloud data layer.

Tech expectations
The stack is up to you, but it must be cloud-hosted, scalable, and ready for iOS and Android from a single code-base (React Native or Flutter are both fine; if you have a stronger proposal let me know). Clean API design is essential because therapists and admins will eventually need their own dashboards.

Show me apps you have already delivered in health, wellness, or sports that prove you can handle this scope. I’m interested in solid experience over lengthy proposals—screenshots, links, or brief case studies are perfect.

If you have questions about the data model, wearable APIs, or the exercise content format, ask up front so we can keep momentum.

jobs.title: Porządek i integracja WooCommerce
jobs.description:
Obecny sklep działa, lecz wymaga gruntownej aktualizacji i uporządkowania. Szukam specjalisty, który:

• przejrzy konfigurację WordPressa oraz WooCommerce i wprowadzi zalecane usprawnienia,  
• wykona wszystkie niezbędne aktualizacje (core, motyw, wtyczki) z zachowaniem pełnej kompatybilności,  
• uporządkuje ustawienia cen oraz zasady cenowe tak, aby były przejrzyste i łatwe do dalszej obsługi,  
• zintegruje sklep z BaseLinker (BASE), uzgadniając z ich supportem wymagania techniczne i prawidłowe kroki konfiguracji,  
• zainstaluje i skonfiguruje dodatkowe wtyczki lub rozwiązania, jeśli okażą się potrzebne do realizacji powyższych celów,  
• przetestuje całość – od koszyka po synchronizację zamówień – i potwierdzi, że wszystko działa płynnie.

Nie doświadczam obecnie krytycznych błędów, jednak chcę uniknąć przyszłych problemów i uporządkować sklep raz a dobrze. Zależy mi na jasnej dokumentacji zmian i krótkim podsumowaniu wykonanych prac, abym mógł łatwo śledzić, co zostało poprawione.

Jeżeli masz doświadczenie w optymalizacji WooCommerce oraz praktyczną wiedzę o BaseLinker, zapraszam do współpracy.

jobs.title: PPC Expert for Meta & Google Ads
jobs.description:
Meta Ads + Google Ads Expert Required

We are looking for an experienced Digital Marketing / PPC Specialist to manage and optimize our Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram) + Google Ads campaigns.

What we need:

 Google Search & Display Ads management
 Facebook & Instagram (Meta) Ads
 Campaign setup, targeting & audience research

 Lead generation & remarketing campaigns

Weekly performance reports and actionable insights

Ideal Freelancer:

Long-term opportunity for the right professional.

Apply now with your portfolio and relevant case studies!

jobs.title: Pet Mascot Animated Series
jobs.description:
I need a month-long run of short, 3–5-minute cartoons built around my two brand mascots: Sniff the Dog and Sparkle the Cat. The goal is pure entertainment—each episode should feel like a self-contained, light-hearted adventure that keeps viewers smiling while quietly reinforcing that these two lovable pals stand for my Philippine-made line of pet perfumes and fragrances.

Here is the shape of the project. I want three fresh episodes every week for four weeks, for a total of twelve. I’m open on the visual style—2D, 3D, even stop-motion—as long as the final look is polished, colourful, and appealing to pet lovers of all ages. Strong story craft is the priority; gags, charm, and memorable situations matter more to me than deep product exposition. A gentle nod to how great our pets smell after a spritz is all the brand presence the stories need.

Core deliverables  
• 12 finished videos, 3–5 minutes each, delivered on a Monday-Wednesday-Friday rhythm  
• Full HD (1080p) MP4 files ready for social platforms  
• Original scripts, storyboards, animation, music and basic SFX/voice where needed  
• Simple end-slate inclusion of our logo and product line name

I’ll supply existing character art, logo files, and any brand guidelines you need on acceptance. Let me see a short sample or reel that proves you can capture upbeat, comedic storytelling, and tell me how you plan to manage the weekly turnaround. I’m excited to watch Sniff and Sparkle come to life!

jobs.title: Web CRM for Support Team
jobs.description:
I need a browser-based customer management system built specifically for my customer support agents. The application should let them quickly capture new customer records, pull up existing profiles, and see a clear timeline of every phone call, email, or chat the customer has had with us.  

Key deliverables  
• Customer data entry & secure storage  
• Customer interaction tracking that links calls, emails, and chats to each profile  

The workflow has to feel as fast as a modern SaaS dashboard, so a responsive interface (React, Vue, or similar) paired with a solid API layer is important. I will run this on our own server, so please structure the project so it can be deployed on a standard Linux stack—SQL or NoSQL database is fine as long as data integrity and backups are covered.

Access control is essential; only logged-in support staff should see customer details. An admin role should be able to add users and manage basic system settings.

Please outline:  
• The tech stack you propose  
• How you will handle authentication and role-based permissions  
• A rough timeline with milestones from prototype to hand-over, including testing

Once the final build passes a short UAT session with my support team and the code is handed over (Git repo preferred), the project will be complete.

jobs.title: Commission-Driven Client Acquisition Caller
jobs.description:
I need a self-starting sales professional who can turn raw data into paying customers. Your day will begin by scraping and compiling fresh lead lists, then moving straight into 30–40 focused cold calls aimed at retail and local shops, restaurants, hotels, real-estate firms, construction companies, salons & beauty studios, fitness centers, schools, healthcare providers, automotive businesses, small enterprises and e-commerce brands.  

The goal on every call is simple: introduce our services, qualify interest, and push qualified prospects toward conversion. When a prospect shows intent, you’ll nurture the relationship with timely follow-ups until the deal closes. Throughout the process you’ll keep our lead sheet or CRM updated so I can see real-time progress.

Compensation is performance-oriented: ₹1,000 fixed each month plus a 10 % commission on every client who signs. That commission has no cap, so the more deals you bring in, the higher your earnings climb.

Deliverables I expect:
• A clean, growing lead spreadsheet with contact details and industry tags  
• Daily notes on calls made, outcomes, and next steps  
• Weekly summary of conversions so we can release commissions quickly  

If you already have experience in cold calling, lead generation, or business development, you’ll hit the ground running. Let’s start closing new clients together.

jobs.title: Build Addiction Recovery Support Website
jobs.description:
I need a full-featured website devoted to people actively seeking recovery from addiction. Every page, feature, and design choice should feel welcoming, judgment-free, and easy to use, even for visitors who may be in crisis. The core experience must remain lightweight, mobile-friendly, and WCAG-compliant so that no one is excluded.

Key features required  
• Support forums – a moderated, searchable discussion area with user profiles and privacy controls.  
• Live chat with counselors – real-time text chat that lets verified professionals log in, set their status, and privately message visitors. Think HIPAA-level encryption and an audit trail for safety.  
• Resource library – a tagged, filterable collection where articles, worksheets, and external links can be uploaded and browsed quickly.

Primary audience: individuals in recovery. From landing page copy to navigation labels, wording should speak directly to them and avoid clinical jargon unless absolutely necessary.

Tech stack is flexible; WordPress, Laravel, or another secure CMS is fine as long as you can integrate the above features, manage user roles (visitor, member, counselor, moderator, admin), and keep page-load times low. Please include SSL, CAPTCHA on registration, and an admin dashboard with simple analytics.

Deliverables are: a fully deployed, production-ready site on my hosting, documented source code in Git, and a brief hand-off video showing me how to manage content and users. Acceptance is when all three key features work flawlessly on desktop and mobile, new users can sign up without issues, and automated nightly backups are running.

Timeline is negotiable, but I’d like to see an initial prototype within two weeks.

jobs.title: Corporate Product Demo Appointment Setting
jobs.description:
My immediate objective is to fill our sales team’s calendar with qualified product-demo meetings inside large corporations. Your agency will run a focused cold-calling campaign whose single KPI is the number of confirmed demo appointments secured with decision-makers.

You will handle everything from refining the script and sourcing accurate enterprise contacts, to making the calls, overcoming objections, and locking in calendar slots that suit both the prospect and our demo engineers. I will provide product training, a shared calendar, and CRM access; you bring the dialer, talent, and proven B2B calling process.

Deliverables (to be reviewed weekly):
• A mutually agreed target of verified demo appointments, booked directly in our calendar  
• Complete call notes and contact details entered in our CRM  
• Call recordings or concise summaries that help our sales reps prepare

Success is simple: steady, high-quality demo appointments that lead to revenue conversations. If your team thrives in the enterprise arena and can demonstrate past wins with similar campaigns, let’s move forward.

jobs.title: Animator Needed for 3D animation -- 5
jobs.description:
We are producing a 30–40 minute 3D animated video titled “Flood Size Comparison.” In this video, we will animate various floods of different sizes and intensities to visualize their impact and scale across a series of sequences.

You will be responsible for creating and animating the flood water, modelling the required environments, and integrating the water simulations into each environment to match the visual style and pacing of the video.

You will be provided with reference files, including ocean and environmental assets. However, most of the models and animation elements will need to be created from scratch.

Main Responsibilities
Modelling and animating flood water in different settings
Creating environmental elements including terrain, water bodies, buildings, and surrounding objects
Creating settings and physics simulations to achieve realistic flood behaviour and scale
Animating camera movements and water interactions
Ensuring animations sync with the pacing and narration
Creating realistic water flow, flooding, and environmental interactions
Video Structure

The video will follow a classic comparison format featuring floods of different sizes and intensities.

Camera pans and zoom-ins to showcase each flood
Flood animations showing different levels of severity, from small to moderate to catastrophic
Visual comparisons of flood heights against landmarks, buildings, and other known reference points
Camera flythroughs showcasing flood levels, movement, and impact
Smooth camera flyovers comparing multiple floods of varying sizes and intensities
Tasks Required
Modelling & Texturing

The main focus will be on creating realistic flood water and environments.

Limited texturing will be required for basic assets such as the sky, water, terrain, and buildings.

Modelling and simulating flood water from scratch will be crucial. This includes creating realistic water movement, flow, depth, and interactions with the surrounding environment.

Asset Breakdown:

Approximately 45 unique models, including:

Various flood water types and levels
Environmental assets
Buildings and structures
Landmarks
Debris and surrounding objects
Environment Creation

Build multiple environments for each flood scenario to interact with, such as:

Coastal cities
Urban areas
River deltas
Residential areas
Open landscapes
Low-lying regions

Additional requirements include:

Lighting and atmospheric effects
Clouds and weather conditions
Water reflections
Realistic terrain
Environmental details
Water simulation and interaction with structures
Animation

Animate the flood water with realistic physical behaviour, including:

Water flow
Rising water levels
Flooding
Water movement around structures
Impact on buildings and objects
Debris movement
Realistic water interaction with terrain

Ensure accurate scaling for each flood scenario relative to environmental assets.

Animations must also be synchronized with narration and scene transitions.

Apply zooms, camera movements, and slow-motion effects where specified to emphasize important moments, such as water reaching a city or flooding a large landmass.

Create seamless transitions between video footage and 3D animation where required.

Final Delivery

The final delivery should include:

Completed project files with all assets integrated
High-resolution rendered video sequences for each section
All working files
Textures
3D models
Scenes
Rigs, where applicable
Water and physics simulations
Animation files

jobs.title: 2D Healthcare AI Product Demo
jobs.description:
2D Healthcare AI Product Demo

We need a short, professional 2D animated product demo showcasing the key features and user experience of a healthcare AI platform.

The video should focus on demonstrating the product, its main features, and how it can be used in a real clinical workflow.

* Duration: 60–90 seconds
* Style: Modern, clean, professional 2D animation
* Languages: Arabic + English
* Format: Suitable for website, presentations, and social media
* Voice-over: Arabic and English
* Subtitles: English + Arabic

Main Storyline

Show a physician and patient during a short medical consultation.

The physician and patient naturally communicate in both Arabic and English, including common medical terminology.

1. Captures the clinical conversation.

The video should feel like a real product walkthrough, clearly showing the platform’s benefits and main features in a simple and engaging way.

jobs.description:
Quiero desarrollar un dron agrícola capaz de cargar 250 L de producto y trabajar sobre terrenos planos de forma completamente autónoma. El corazón de la aeronave será un motor bóxer de dos cilindros que funcione como generador híbrido (nafta + baterías) para garantizar  vuelo continuo con plena carga.  

Necesito que la estructura y los sistemas de a bordo estén optimizados para dos tareas principales: fumigación de cultivos y siembra de precisión. Ambos modos deben activarse y regularse desde la misma suite de control, con dosificación ajustable en tiempo real y registro de datos de aplicación.  

Busco un profesional o equipo que cubra:  
• Ingeniería y dimensionamiento del fuselaje, depósito de 250 L, brazos, rotores y tren de aterrizaje.  
• Selección e integración del power-train híbrido (motor bóxer, generador, controladores y packs de baterías) con redundancia y balance de peso.  
• Electrónica y software de vuelo autónomo (Pixhawk/ArduPilot, ROS, o equivalente) con planificación de misiones, geocercas y retorno seguro.  
• Sistema de fumigación y siembra intercambiable, calibrado y compatible con líquidos de distinta viscosidad y semillas de distinto calibre.  
• Planos 3D (SolidWorks o similar), lista de materiales, cálculos de resistencia y consumo, y manual de montaje para producción en serie limitada.  

Aporto especificaciones agronómicas y pruebas de campo; tú aportarás el diseño validado y la puesta a punto lista para prototipo funcional. Si dominas aerodinámica, CAD/CAM, electrónica de potencia y control autónomo, me gustaría avanzar cuanto antes.

jobs.title: Custom Shopify Store Setup
jobs.description:
I’m ready to launch a range of physical products and I want the entire shopping experience built on Shopify from the ground up. A standard theme won’t be enough for the brand, so I need a fully custom design that looks polished on desktop and mobile, reflects our visual identity, and is easy for me to update through the Shopify editor. 

Core requirements  
• Complete store configuration in Shopify, including domains, payments, taxes and shipping.  
• Bespoke theme design built with Liquid, HTML/CSS and any lightweight JavaScript needed for dynamic elements.  
• Seamless shopping-cart and checkout flow that you have fully tested for speed, accuracy and security.  
• Native-looking product review functionality (via Shopify’s built-in options or a reputable app) styled to match the theme.  
• Customer inquiry portal with live chat support and feedback/review collection.
• SEO-ready site setup to optimize search engine visibility.
• Integrated payment gateways for credit cards, PayPal, and Afterpay.

I’ll supply product images, copy and brand guidelines; you handle layout, UI/UX decisions and the technical build. If you can also advise on inventory apps, that would be a plus, though it isn’t mandatory right now.  

Deliverables will be:  
1. Custom theme installed and published.  
2. All required features functioning and QA-tested.  
3. A brief hand-off guide or video walk-through so I can manage products and pages myself.  

Timeline is flexible but I’d like to see the first design draft within a week of kickoff and go live shortly after revisions are complete. Let me know your experience with Shopify theme development, share two or three live stores you’ve built, and include an estimated turnaround time.

jobs.title: YouTube Channel Suspension Recovery
jobs.description:
My 10-year-old channel with a loyal base of roughly 10 000 subscribers was suddenly taken offline for a “Community guidelines violation.” I submitted an appeal right away, but YouTube rejected it without clarifying much beyond the boiler-plate message. I’m now looking for someone who genuinely understands the inner workings of YouTube’s policies, escalation paths and creator-support channels to help me overturn the decision and bring the channel back online with all videos and analytics intact.

You’ll need to analyse the strike notice, spot any weak points in YouTube’s reasoning, prepare a compelling second-stage appeal or legal counter-notification if appropriate, and guide me through any policy or content adjustments that can strengthen our case. Your proposal should be detailed—outline the steps you plan to take, the typical time frame you expect, and examples of previous channels you have successfully reinstated after a community-guidelines suspension.

Deliverable:
• Channel fully reinstated (or written confirmation from YouTube that the original decision has been overturned), plus a brief report outlining the actions taken so I can avoid future strikes.

If you have a repeatable method for navigating YouTube’s internal appeal layers, external mediator programmes or creator liaison contacts, tell me exactly how you’ll put it to work here. I’m ready to move quickly once I see a clear, well-structured plan.
