jobs.title: Responsive Portfolio HTML & CSS Project Smart college Evant Management Websits
jobs.description:
I have to hand in a self-contained mini project for my college class and I’d like you to build it from scratch using only HTML5 and CSS3. The topic is a personal portfolio site, and I want it to look polished, modern and—most importantly—fully responsive on mobile, tablet and desktop screens.

Scope  
• Pages: please include a Home page and a Projects page.  
• Style: clean, attractive visuals with smooth hover effects. Feel free to explore Flexbox, CSS Grid, custom fonts, and media queries to keep everything fluid.  
• Code quality: keep the file structure logical and comment key sections so I can talk through the decisions in class. Only HTML/CSS—no JavaScript.  
• Documentation: a short README (or PDF) explaining the layout, the main CSS techniques you used, and simple instructions on how to view the site offline.

Deliverables  
1. Zipped project folder containing all HTML and CSS files, images, and any assets you choose.  
2. Brief project explanation document.  
3. Two or three full-page screenshots that show the responsive breakpoints.

If any additional pages such as About or Contact would strengthen the flow, I’m open to suggestions, but the two pages above are mandatory. Let me know if you need anything else before you start; otherwise, I’m excited to see your creative approach.

jobs.title: Situs Unduh Game Berbasis Iklan
jobs.description:
Saya membutuhkan sebuah situs web yang memungkinkan pengunjung mengunduh game mobile sekaligus menghasilkan pendapatan iklan. Fokus utama proyek ini adalah monetisasi—setiap halaman unduh harus memiliki penempatan banner atau interstitial yang optimal tanpa mengganggu pengalaman pengguna.

Ruang lingkup inti:
• Halaman beranda yang menampilkan daftar game mobile terbaru, terpopuler, dan rekomendasi.  
• Halaman detail game berisi deskripsi, tangkapan layar, ukuran file, versi, serta tombol unduh.  
• Sistem manajemen konten sederhana agar saya bisa menambah, mengedit, atau menghapus game tanpa pengetahuan teknis mendalam.  
• Integrasi jaringan iklan (Google AdSense atau setara) pada posisi strategis: header, sidebar, dan dalam halaman unduh.  
• Fitur pencarian dan kategori untuk memudahkan pengguna menemukan game.  
• Desain responsif sehingga nyaman diakses lewat smartphone maupun desktop.  
• Optimasi kecepatan dan SEO dasar agar halaman cepat dimuat dan mudah terindeks.  
• Dashboard analitik bawaan atau terhubung ke Google Analytics untuk memantau performa iklan dan trafik.

Kriteria keberhasilan:
– Situs aktif dan bisa diakses publik tanpa bug kritis.  
– Iklan tampil sesuai penempatan yang telah disepakati dan tidak menutupi tombol unduh.  
– Proses unggah/unduh game lancar di perangkat mobile.  
– Dokumentasi singkat tentang cara menambah game dan mengganti slot iklan.

Saya membutuhkan penyelesaian secepatnya (segera). Silakan jelaskan pendekatan teknis Anda—apakah menggunakan WordPress, Laravel, atau framework lain—beserta estimasi waktu detail. Jika Anda pernah mengerjakan proyek serupa, sertakan tautan contoh agar saya dapat menilai kualitas kerja Anda. Terima kasih!

jobs.title: Exact PDF Layout in Word
jobs.description:
I need a clean, one-to-one transfer of a primarily text-based PDF into Microsoft Word. The goal is to mirror every line break, font choice, margin, header, footer, and page break so the Word file looks identical to the source.  

Only the visual formatting matters—full editability is not required—so you’re free to use text boxes, embedded fonts, or any other technique that locks the layout in place while preserving sharpness on screen and when printed. There are no intricate images, charts, or tables to worry about; the task is all about faithfully reproducing the text formatting.  

Once finished, send back a Word document that opens error-free in the latest desktop version of Microsoft Word and matches the original PDF page for page.

jobs.title: Corporate Event Inquiry Sales Calls STRONG IN ENGLISH ONLY GIRL
jobs.description:
Leads pour in daily from our expos, social media ads, and website forms, and I need someone who can jump on the phone, qualify each corporate-event enquiry, walk them through our pricing, available packages, and venue options, and ultimately secure the booking.  

Here is what the role looks like day-to-day:  
• Promptly call every new lead, ideally within one business hour of the enquiry landing in our CRM.  
• Hold a confident, consultative conversation that uncovers event needs, matches them with the right package, and presents clear pricing.  
• Address venue questions on the spot or coordinate a virtual walk-through if needed.  
• Drive for commitment on the call when possible, then schedule decisive next steps.  

After that initial conversation, I will rely on you to continue the follow-up cycle by phone—checking availability, sending any requested documents, and keeping the prospect warm until the contract is signed.  

Success for me means:  
1. A log of every call with outcome notes.  
2. Follow-up calls placed on the dates you promise the client.  
3. A steady uptick in confirmed corporate event bookings.  

If you’re persuasive on the phone, comfortable discussing numbers, and genuinely enjoy closing deals, let’s talk.

jobs.title: Chemistry Research Writing Profile Setup
jobs.description:
I need a new academic-writing account set up and fully optimised so it presents me as a specialist in Chemistry research papers. The platform can be any reputable marketplace or scholarly-writing site where clients seek Science papers; I am open to your suggestion as long as it allows clear portfolio uploads, rating collection and order management.

The profile has to underline my strength in the wider Sciences while making Chemistry the standout niche. This means choosing the right service categories, writing a concise bio that highlights peer-review familiarity, selecting suitable keywords, and uploading one or two sample Chemistry manuscripts (I will supply the drafts; you handle formatting and placement).  

Deliverables  
• New account created under the email I provide, with verified login credentials  
• Compelling bio and service description emphasising Chemistry research-paper expertise  
• Portfolio section populated with the sample files I send (properly referenced)  
• All notification, security and payout settings configured and ready for first order

Once done, send the login details and a brief walkthrough video or screenshots so I can see every setting. I will test the account and release payment when everything is accessible and reflects the focus on Chemistry research writing.

jobs.title: Android Spin & Win MVP
jobs.description:
I’m ready to launch a simple yet engaging “Spin & Win” game on Android and need a developer who can move quickly from concept to a playable MVP. The wheel is purely for entertainment—no complex reward logic or backend loyalty system—so the focus is on smooth animations, bright visuals, snappy sounds, and an overall casual, fun feel.  

Core flow is straightforward: users open the app, tap the wheel, watch it spin with a satisfying animation, and see where it lands. I’d like a lightweight settings screen where I can adjust the wedge labels and probability weights without rebuilding the app. Beyond that, the experience should be frictionless: instant load, no sign-up wall, and one-tap replay.  

I’m fine with either Kotlin or Java inside Android Studio; if you prefer a cross-platform engine like Unity for faster visuals, just package and optimise it for Android first. Whichever route you take, the finished APK must run smoothly on Android 8.0+ devices, respecting common guidelines for touch responsiveness, haptic feedback, and battery usage.   

Acceptance criteria – you hand over:  
• A signed (or signable) release-ready APK and a debug build for testing  
• Complete, well-commented source code in a public or private Git repo  
• A brief README explaining how to tweak wedge labels/odds and build the app  
• All original graphic and audio assets in editable form  

If you can also slip in basic analytics (Firebase events such as “spin_started” and “spin_completed”) that would be a plus, though not mandatory for this MVP. Looking forward to seeing how you’d bring a lively, casual spin mechanic to life on Android.

jobs.title: SpiceHub — Restaurant & Food Delivery Website -- 2
jobs.description:

jobs.title: Web CRM: Leads & Customers
jobs.description:
I need a custom, web-based CRM that lets my team capture leads, move them through a pipeline, and keep every customer interaction in one place. Day to day we log calls, emails, and social messages, so tight email and social-media integrations must be baked in from the start—automatic contact creation, threaded correspondence, and one-click replies right inside the CRM.

Core workflow
• Lead management: new-lead capture form, visual pipeline, drag-and-drop stage changes, task reminders, status filters, and basic role permissions.
• Customer relationship tracking: full timeline per contact, notes, deal value, and follow-up scheduling that syncs to the integrated email and social channels.

Because we are browser-first, all users—including remote reps—should access the same real-time data on any modern desktop or mobile browser. A clean, responsive UI is important, but I value clear functionality over heavy design flourishes.

Deliverables
1. Source-code repository with setup instructions (preferably Git).
2. Fully deployed web application on my cloud host (AWS or similar, I’m flexible).
3. Documentation covering database schema, integration keys, and a quick-start user guide.
4. Two weeks of post-launch bug fixing.

Acceptance criteria
• New leads entered via form appear instantly in the pipeline.
• Email threads sync bi-directionally within 60 seconds.
• Social DM replies can be sent from the contact’s timeline.
• Page loads <1.5 s on a 50 Mbps connection with 1000 concurrent records.

Preferred stack is open—Laravel, Node, or Django are all fine—as long as it’s maintainable and well documented. If you have demo links to similar CRMs you’ve built, share them so I can see your implementation style.

jobs.title: Modern Wedding Film Editing
jobs.description:
I’m ready to hand over all of my raw wedding footage so a skilled editor can mould it into a sleek, modern-style cinematic film. I’m picturing clean colour grades, smooth story-driven pacing, tasteful use of slow motion, and music that sits perfectly under the vows and speeches. The final piece should feel contemporary rather than traditional or documentary, with an emphasis on emotional punch and polished visuals.

You’ll receive multi-camera ceremony files, reception clips, audio tracks from lav mics and the DJ desk, plus plenty of B-roll. I need you to:

• Sync and cull the footage, selecting the strongest angles  
• Balance, EQ and mix the live audio with a licensed soundtrack  
• Colour-correct and grade for a consistent, cinematic look  
• Add titles, lower-thirds where useful, and subtle motion graphics  
• Deliver a mastered file (4K and 1080p) plus a short social-media teaser

I’ll keep communication quick and decisive so you can focus on the craft. If this modern approach fits your editing style, let’s talk timelines and get started.

jobs.title: Japan Agricultural Field Research
jobs.description:
I need a small team already based in Japan to carry out on-site agricultural investigations across several prefectures this growing season. Your role will span three main areas: detailed soil analysis, in-field crop assessment, and localized pest management observations. You must be comfortable working hands-on in active fields while integrating data from GPS mapping tools, drones for low-altitude aerial surveys, and portable soil-testing kits.

Data capture is expected in three parallel formats: concise manual field notes for contextual observations, structured digital data logs (tablet or smartphone is fine) for metrics, and periodic remote-sensing imagery collected via your drone flights. Consistency across these channels is essential so I can compare regions side-by-side.

Deliverables
• A weekly geo-tagged report for each site summarizing soil nutrient profiles, crop health indicators, and pest pressure.  
• Raw datasets exported in CSV (digital logs) plus annotated field notebooks scanned to PDF.  
• Aerial imagery stitched and compressed to <200 MB per field, delivered in GeoTIFF.  
• End-of-season synthesis document highlighting key trends and recommendations.

Acceptance criteria
1. All GPS coordinates must match the shapefiles I will provide before deployment.  
2. Laboratory-validated soil test results must fall within ±5 % of on-site kit readings.  
3. Drone imagery must achieve a ground sampling distance of ≤5 cm/pixel.  

Timeline and acreage details will be shared after NDA signature, but expect 6–8 field days per month until harvest. If your background aligns and you have your own gear, let me know your nearest prefecture and earliest availability.

jobs.title: Realistic 3D Car Models for Mobile Game

jobs.title: Agra Travel & Food Photography
jobs.description:
I need a photographer on the ground in Agra who can craft a cohesive visual story across three pillars: intricate architectural details of its monuments (about 70–80 shots), bright-and-colorful food imagery that celebrates local cuisine (around 30), and the energy of street life and markets to represent everyday culture (another 30–40).  

The final set will total roughly 150 images, professionally edited for print at high resolution. I may also request the accompanying RAW files for our archive, so please keep your workflow non-destructive. A detailed creative brief with reference boards will be shared once I have shortlisted candidates.

Because the images will move straight into a print layout, colour accuracy and clean post-production are essential. I’m drawn to photographers with a strong creative eye in architectural, travel, and food genres, and I’d love to see projects where you balanced these elements in a single narrative.

Deliverables (acceptance criteria)  
• 150 retouched, print-ready high-res JPEG/TIFF files  
• Matching RAW files on request, neatly organised by theme  
• Basic metadata and location info embedded  

To be considered, send a link to your portfolio—particularly any architecture, travel, or food work—and note your availability in Agra over the next few weeks. I’ll review submissions quickly and share the full brief with those who fit the aesthetic and schedule.

jobs.title: Full-Stack AI Builder Setup
jobs.description:
I have an AI-driven website-builder SaaS that needs a senior developer to get it production-ready and keep it running smoothly. The core stack is JavaScript/Node.js on both the server and client, so deep experience with modern Node, Express, React (or similar) and a solid grasp of ES-next patterns are essential.  

Your first task is to install the existing codebase on my cloud environment, resolve any dependency or build issues, and make sure the drag-and-drop builder, automated SEO routines, and library of customizable templates all compile and perform as intended. Once the platform is live, I need reliable payment-gateway integration (Stripe is the immediate priority, with the code structured so additional gateways can be added later).  

After the installation and debugging phase, I want ongoing support: patch new bugs, optimise performance, add incremental features, and keep the third-party libraries up to date so the SaaS stays secure and competitive.  

Deliverables  
• Clean installation with zero critical errors  
• Fully functioning drag-and-drop editor, SEO automation, and template system  
• Stripe (or equivalent) payments flowing end-to-end in test and live modes  
• Concise deployment notes so I can replicate the setup  
• Monthly code-health review and hot-fix response within agreed SLA  

If you have shipped production SaaS in Node.js, value clean, test-covered code, and are open to a long-term collaboration, I would like to start right away.

jobs.title: SCARA Robot Design and Development -- 2
jobs.description:
Design & Development of 3-Axis SCARA Robot – Mechanical, Electronics, Firmware & ROS2 Software

Project Description

We are looking for an experienced Robotics/Mechatronics Engineer or Robotics Development Team to design and develop a 3-axis SCARA robot based on the performance and functionality of an existing commercial SCARA robot such as the Oriental Motor OVR series.

The goal is to develop an independently engineered robot design, including mechanical design, electronics, firmware, control software and ROS2 integration. The final design should be suitable for prototyping and future commercial development.

Important: We are looking for an original/independently engineered design, not a direct copy of any manufacturer's proprietary CAD, drawings, firmware or software.

Target Specifications
3-axis SCARA robot
Approx. 400–450 mm working reach
Approx. 3 kg payload
2 rotary joints + Z axis
High repeatability target: approximately ±0.03–0.05 mm
24/48 VDC operation
Closed-loop motors with encoders
Industrial-quality mechanical construction
Modular and serviceable design
Scope of Work

1. Mechanical Design

Complete 3D CAD model
Base, arms, joints and Z-axis mechanism
Motor and reducer selection
Bearings, shafts and couplings
Cable management
End-effector mounting
Manufacturing drawings
Assembly drawings
GD&T and tolerances
Complete BOM
Design suitable for CNC/aluminium manufacturing

2. Electronics

Motor/actuator architecture
Motor drivers
Encoder interface
Main controller PCB
Power distribution
Limit/home switches
Emergency-stop and safety I/O
Communication interface such as CAN/CAN-FD or EtherCAT
Schematics, PCB files and BOM

3. Firmware & Motion Control
Develop complete firmware for the robot controller, including:

Motor control
Encoder feedback
Homing
Position control
Velocity control
Trajectory generation
PTP motion
Linear interpolation
Circular interpolation
Acceleration/deceleration control
Joint limits
Fault detection
Emergency stop
Communication protocol
Calibration

4. Robot Software
Develop software for:

Forward kinematics
Inverse kinematics
Joint-space trajectory planning
Cartesian motion
Robot calibration
Position teaching
Jogging
Program execution
Diagnostics

5. ROS2 Integration

The robot should be compatible with ROS2, preferably ROS2 Jazzy.

Required:

URDF/Xacro
ros2_control
Hardware interface
MoveIt 2
RViz
Simulation environment
Joint trajectory controller
Python/C++ API
Example ROS2 nodes

6. Robot Control GUI

Develop a basic "Robot Studio"-type application allowing the user to:

Jog individual joints
Jog in XYZ
Set speed
Teach positions
Save/load programs
Execute programs
View robot status
Control digital I/O
Home the robot
View errors/diagnostics
Visualize the robot in 3D
Required Deliverables

The freelancer must provide all source files, not only compiled/output files:

Complete CAD files
STEP files
Native CAD files
Manufacturing drawings
BOM
PCB schematic
PCB layout/source files
Firmware source code
Controller software source code
ROS2 packages
MoveIt configuration
URDF/Xacro
GUI source code
Communication protocol documentation
Electrical drawings
Assembly instructions
Calibration procedure
Testing procedure
Full technical documentation

jobs.title: Inspiring Health & Wellness Posts
jobs.description:

I’m open to any angle that energises people—physical fitness tips, mental-well-being strategies, nutritional insights, or a blend of all three—as long as the material stays evidence-based and upbeat.  

Feel free to experiment with different formats. Long-form articles, punchy listicles, or relatable personal stories are all welcome if they keep readers engaged and eager to take action. The tone should be friendly, conversational, and inspiring without drifting into preachy territory.  

You’ll propose post ideas, back your claims with credible sources where appropriate, and tailor each piece so it resonates with a broad adult audience. SEO best practices (strong headlines, clear structure, natural keyword placement) are important, but never at the expense of authenticity or readability.  

Deliverables  
• 4–6 original blog posts per month (800–1,200 words each)  
• Attention-grabbing titles and meta descriptions  
• Royalty-free images or graphic suggestions, if relevant  
• Brief summary of sources or studies referenced  

I’ll review the first article before green-lighting the rest of each batch. If your writing can inspire readers to take the next healthy step in their lives, let’s get started.

jobs.title: Google Ads Growth Campaigns -- 2

jobs.title: Traditional Wedding Album Layout
jobs.description:

El trabajo será 100 % remoto: no enviaré la placa física, de modo que la captura de detalles —ancho de pistas, huellas, serigrafía y posiciones exactas— debe hacerse con las herramientas de ingeniería inversa que ya domines (por ejemplo, KiCad, Altium, Eagle o similares).

Entrego material gráfico, despiece preliminar y el tiempo de conexión necesario para que tomes notas. 

Entiendo que para cerrar el proyecto debemos contar con:

• Esquemático editable  
• Archivos de diseño y sus Gerbers listos para fabricación (incluyendo taladros y máscara)  


Si algo de lo anterior no fuera viable de forma remota, indícalo de antemano para coordinar alternativas. Quedo atento a tu propuesta y a la estimación de plazos.

jobs.title: Gestionnaire Freelance pour 2 Plateformes : avant vente & ticketing
jobs.description:
# Annonce freelance — Gestionnaire de plateformes (Ticketing, Chat & Avant-vente téléphonique)

## Contexte

Dans le cadre de l'exploitation commerciale de deux plateformes complémentaires (l'une dédiée à l'accompagnement des entreprises sur les dispositifs d'innovation, l'autre à des contenus et services en neurosciences appliquées), une mission ponctuelle et récurrente de gestion opérationnelle est proposée, à volume horaire réduit et encadré.

## Description de la mission

Le prestataire assure, en toute autonomie et sans lien de subordination :

- La gestion et le traitement des tickets et conversations chat entrants sur les deux plateformes (support client niveau 1).
- La qualification et le traitement des appels téléphoniques d'avant-vente (prospects entrants, prise d'information, orientation vers une démonstration ou une souscription).
- L'explication pédagogique des principes généraux du dispositif d'innovation (mécanismes de base, logique de calcul, éligibilité sommaire) sans entrer dans le détail technique ou fiscal — le positionnement attendu est celui d'un premier point de contact, pas d'un expert.
- Le suivi et la mise à jour du statut des demandes dans l'outil de ticketing.
- Un reporting mensuel synthétique de l'activité (volume traité, délai moyen de réponse, sujets récurrents).

## Volume et calendrier

| Élément | Détail |
|---|---|
| Charge horaire cible | 1 heure par jour ouvré |
| Période | D'octobre 2026 à fin avril 2027 |
| Jours ouvrés estimés | Environ 148 jours (hors jours fériés) |
| Volume horaire total estimé | Environ 148 heures sur la période |
| Volume mensuel moyen | Environ 21 heures par mois |
| Créneaux | À convenir avec le prestataire (plage horaire indicative, non fixe, pour préserver le statut indépendant) |

### Répartition mensuelle indicative

| Mois | Jours ouvrés | Heures cibles |
|---|---|---|
| Octobre 2026 | 22 | 22 h |
| Novembre 2026 | 20 | 20 h |
| Décembre 2026 | 22 | 22 h |
| Janvier 2027 | 20 | 20 h |
| Février 2027 | 20 | 20 h |
| Mars 2027 | 23 | 23 h |
| Avril 2027 | 21 | 21 h |
| **Total** | **148** | **148 h** |

## Profil recherché

- Aisance relationnelle et rédactionnelle, à l'écrit comme à l'oral, en français.
- Capacité à traiter des demandes de support et des appels de prospection de façon autonome, avec un sens du service client.
- Intérêt ou capacité d'appropriation rapide de sujets techniques (dispositifs d'innovation, notions de neurosciences appliquées), sans nécessité d'expertise préalable poussée.
- Rigueur dans le suivi des tickets et le reporting d'activité.
- Disponibilité récurrente sur la période, avec une organisation autonome du temps de travail.

## Modalités

- Mission en freelance (indépendant), sur la base d'un contrat de prestation de services.
- Facturation par trimestre.
- Aucune exclusivité demandée, aucun lien de subordination : le prestataire organise librement son temps de travail et peut mener d'autres activités en parallèle.
- Les modalités précises de collaboration (outils utilisés, accès plateformes, reporting) seront définies avec le prestataire retenu.

## Candidature

Merci d'indiquer dans votre candidature votre disponibilité sur la période visée, votre expérience en support client ou avant-vente, et toute expérience préalable sur des sujets liés à l'innovation ou aux neurosciences appliquées.

jobs.title: Busco a mi mano derecha para editar mis videos de gaming :D
jobs.description:
La idea no es simplemente agarrar una grabación larga, cortarla y ponerle subtítulos. Quiero que cada video tenga ritmo, personalidad, humor y momentos clave.

Normalmente grabo sesiones largas, así que necesito a alguien que tenga buen ojo para encontrar esos momentos que quizá duran 5 segundos, pero que pueden convertirse en EL momento del video.

Me gustaria que manejes el idioma español !

¿Qué me gustaría que hicieras?

✦ Encontrar las mejores jugadas, reacciones, fails, momentos incómodos, gritos, tonterías y cualquier cosa que pueda hacer que el video sea entretenido.

✦ Darle ritmo a la edición. Cortes dinámicos, zooms, rótulos, transiciones, efectos de sonido… lo que tenga sentido para que el video no se sienta plano.

✦ Usar memes, clips, referencias y recursos que potencien el humor. Yo puedo proporcionarte parte del material, pero también me interesa muchísimo que tengas libertad creativa para proponer y buscar cosas que tú creas que funcionan.

✦ Cuidar color, audio, música y niveles para que, aunque el video sea un completo desastre de risas, la edición se sienta limpia y bien hecha.

✦ Entregar el video final en 1080p / 60 fps, listo para YouTube, junto con el proyecto editable en el programa que utilices habitualmente (CapCut, DaVinci Resolve, After Effects, etc.).

Pero hay algo MUY importante:

No estoy buscando que todos mis videos se sientan como una plantilla de edición de gaming.

Quiero que tengan mi esencia.

Estoy todavía construyendo mi estilo y explorando qué quiero hacer con mi contenido, así que también estoy abierta a que la persona que trabaje conmigo aporte ideas, proponga cosas y tenga libertad para experimentar.

Si ves un momento y piensas “aquí quedaría RIDÍCULAMENTE bien este meme”, quiero que puedas hacerlo.

Si tienes una idea de edición que crees que podría funcionar con mi personalidad, quiero que me la propongas.

Si algo puede ser más gracioso, hazlo más gracioso.

La única condición es que, aunque exista libertad creativa, podamos ir construyendo juntos una identidad que se sienta auténtica a mi contenido.

Busco a alguien que entienda el humor, tenga iniciativa, sea creativo y disfrute realmente editar, no solamente a alguien que sepa manejar un programa.

Y si además te gustan los videojuegos, tenemos medio camino ganado. JAJAJA.

¿Qué valoro?

• Creatividad y criterio propio.
• Buen sentido del humor.
• Que entiendas cuándo un meme suma y cuándo ya estamos haciendo demasiado
• Rapidez para encontrar los momentos importantes dentro de horas de grabación.
• Capacidad de trabajar con plazos relativamente cortos.
• Experiencia en la edición de contenido para YouTube, gaming o formatos similares.
• Que tengas iniciativa para proponer ideas y no tengas miedo de experimentar.

Si crees que podríamos hacer cosas muy buenas juntos, cuéntame un poquito sobre ti y, si ya tienes algún portafolio para poder ver también tu estilo, me gustaría.

Y si tienes un estilo que crees que podría encajar conmigo aunque no sea específicamente gaming, también quiero verlo.

jobs.title: **WordPress QA Specialist – Figma to WordPress Implementation Review www.kuralacoustics.com(Acoustic Panels Website)**
jobs.description:
***

## Job Title

**WordPress QA Specialist – Figma to WordPress Implementation Review (Acoustic Panels Website)**

***

## Project Overview

We have outsourced the development of a WordPress website to showcase a collection of **PET acoustic panels** for commercial and residential interiors. The **UI/UX design is complete in Figma**, and the site is being built in WordPress (likely with Elementor Pro and ACF).  

We need an experienced **WordPress QA freelancer** to:

- Quality-check the **WordPress implementation** (structure, performance, responsiveness, content editing experience).
- Verify **UI fidelity** against the Figma designs (layout, typography, spacing, states, responsiveness).
- Provide a clear, actionable QA report with screenshots and prioritized issues.

This is a **short-term, project-based role** with potential for ongoing QA work on future pages or microsites.

***

## Scope of Work

### 1. Figma → WordPress UI QA

- Compare the live/staging WordPress site against the provided Figma designs.
- Check for **pixel accuracy** in:
  - Layout and grid alignment
  - Typography (font family, size, weight, line-height, letter-spacing)
  - Colors and gradients
  - Spacing and padding/margins
  - Images, icons, and SVGs
  - Buttons, cards, sections, and other components
- Verify **responsive behavior** across:
  - Desktop, tablet, and mobile breakpoints as defined in Figma
  - Common browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge) and devices (iOS/Android)
- Validate **interaction states**:
  - Hover, active, focus states for buttons, links, form fields
  - Menu states (open/close, mobile menu)
  - Any animations or transitions specified in Figma

### 2. WordPress Implementation QA

- Review overall **site structure**:
  - Page templates, headers, footers, global elements
  - Use of reusable blocks/components where appropriate
- Check **content editing experience** in WordPress:
  - Ease of updating text, images, colors, and panel collections
  - Proper use of ACF fields (if applicable) for product data
  - No broken layouts when content is edited by non-technical users
- Basic **performance checks**:
  - Page load times on desktop and mobile (using tools like PageSpeed Insights or Lighthouse)
  - Image optimization (correct formats, sizes, compression)
  - Caching and minification setup (if within scope)
- Basic **SEO & technical checks**:
  - Proper heading hierarchy (H1–H6)
  - Meta titles/descriptions editable
  - Clean URLs and breadcrumbs (if part of design)
  - Schema markup (if specified in design/requirements)
- **Cross-browser & device testing**:
  - Identify rendering issues on major browsers and devices
  - Note any CSS/JS conflicts or layout breaks

### 3. Reporting & Communication

- Deliver a **structured QA report** including:
  - List of issues categorized by severity (Critical, High, Medium, Low)
  - Clear description of each issue with:
    - Page URL
    - Expected behavior (based on Figma)
    - Actual behavior (with screenshots or short screen recordings)
    - Suggested fix or notes for the developer
  - Summary of overall UI fidelity (% match to Figma, key gaps)
- Optional: A short **Loom/video walkthrough** highlighting major issues.
- One round of **re-check** after the developer addresses critical/high issues.

***

## Deliverables

1. **QA Audit Report** (Google Doc or PDF) with:
   - UI vs Figma comparison
   - WordPress implementation review
   - Prioritized issue list with visuals
2. **Screen recordings or annotated screenshots** for key issues.
3. **Final sign-off note** after re-testing critical fixes.

***

## Required Skills & Experience

- **5+ years** of hands-on experience with **WordPress** (custom themes, page builders, ACF).
- Strong experience in **QA/testing WordPress sites**, especially:
  - Figma → WordPress implementations
  - Elementor Pro / Gutenberg / ACF-based builds
- Solid understanding of:
  - Responsive design principles and breakpoints
  - Cross-browser compatibility
  - Basic performance optimization (images, caching, Core Web Vitals)
  - Basic SEO best practices for content sites
- Ability to read and interpret **Figma files** in Dev Mode:
  - Inspect spacing, colors, typography, components
  - Understand design tokens and component variants
- Excellent written communication in English; ability to write clear, structured QA reports.
- Experience working with **B2B or product showcase websites** is a plus.
- Familiarity with **interior design, acoustics, or building materials** websites is a bonus but not mandatory.

***

## Nice to Have

- Experience with **Elementor Pro + ACF** combinations.
- Past work auditing **design-heavy portfolio or product sites**.
- Basic understanding of **PET acoustic panels** or similar interior products (or willingness to quickly learn).
- Experience working with Indian clients or agencies.

***

## Project Details

- **Duration:** ~1–2 weeks (depending on site size and iteration cycles).
- **Engagement:** Fixed-price or hourly (please propose your preferred model and estimated hours).
- **Start:** ASAP.
- **Time zone:** IST-friendly communication preferred (Chennai/Bangalore time).

***

## What We Will Provide

- Access to:
  - Figma design files (with Dev Mode access)
  - Staging WordPress site (admin + FTP/SFTP if needed)
  - Any brand guidelines or design notes
- Clear point of contact for clarifications.
- Prompt feedback on your QA report.

***

## How to Apply

Please include in your proposal:

1. A brief summary of your **relevant WordPress QA experience**, especially Figma → WordPress projects.

• Present clearly labelled buttons and form fields for starting and stopping individual streams, plus a global control for all active sessions.

Deliverables
1. A responsive web UI (React, Vue, or Svelte—your preference) bundled and ready to deploy behind an Nginx reverse proxy.  
2. Integration layer (Axios/Fetch hooks) that consumes my existing /start, /stop, /status, and /config routes.  
3. Dockerfile and concise README so the whole stack spins up with one command.  
4. A short Loom or GIF demo proving start/stop, status updates, and error handling all work in real time.

Acceptance criteria: zero blocking bugs, page load <2 s on a mid-range laptop, and no console errors under Chrome, Firefox, or Edge.

• Browsing a catalogue of medicines by category, brand, or quick search  
• Adding items to a cart, adjusting quantities, and viewing real-time stock status  
• Checking out through digital wallets only (no cards or bank transfers for now)  
• Confirming orders, tracking their status, and reviewing past orders in a clear order-history screen  
• Managing a user profile that stores licence details, delivery addresses, and GST information

Design & UX  
I want a simple, minimalistic interface—clean lines, muted colours, plenty of white space—so the busy pharmacist can focus on the essentials. Please keep the number of taps from product search to checkout as low as possible.

Tech expectations  
A robust, secure back-end (language and framework are up to you) with APIs that the mobile app consumes. Push notifications, token-based authentication, and basic analytics hooks should be included. If you favour Flutter, React Native, or Kotlin/Swift pairs, let me know—performance and maintainability are more important than the specific stack.

Deliverables  
• Full source code for the iOS and Android apps  
• API documentation and back-end code  
• Figma or equivalent design files  
• A short hand-over guide so my internal tech team can maintain and scale it

Acceptance criteria  
1. I can install both builds, create an account, and place a test order end-to-end using a sandbox wallet.  
2. Order history shows the test order with correct status updates triggered from the back-end.  
3. The UI matches the agreed minimalistic mock-ups within reasonable pixel tolerance.  

If you have experience with pharmaceutical compliance or similar B2B flows, highlight it when you respond.

jobs.title: AI Story Video Maker Platform
jobs.description:
I need an end-to-end solution that lets users type a topic and receive a polished video story in minutes. The core flow is: topic → AI-written story (user can choose short, medium, long) → scene breakdown → image generation with character consistency → bilingual (English & Hindi) voice-over → automatic assembly into a video with smooth transitions.  

Scope  
• Two client surfaces: a responsive web app plus a dedicated Android build. The codebase can be shared (e.g., React + React Native or Flutter Web + Android) as long as the UX remains consistent.  
• Server side must orchestrate OpenAI (or similar) for text generation, a diffusion model for images, a TTS engine for voice-over, and a lightweight video compositor such as FFmpeg or Remotion.  
• Auth (email + social) with a simple dashboard where users can replay, download, or delete past stories.  
• Output: MP4 ready to download or share.  

What I’d like from you  
1. A concise proposal outlining the tech stack you recommend, why it fits, and any licensing considerations for the AI models.  
2. A realistic timeline broken into milestones (MVP, beta, production).  
3. Cost by milestone and payment terms.  
4. Any previous work that shows you have handled multimedia generation or complex AI pipelines.  

Acceptance criteria  
• Story and voice-over available in both languages on day one.  
• Scene images retain character identity throughout the video.  
• A five-minute story renders in under two minutes on a mid-tier cloud instance.  
• Clear, reproducible deployment scripts (Docker or similar).  

I’m ready to move quickly once I see a solid plan. Let me know if any part of the scope needs clarification.

jobs.title: Lead-Focused Homepage Copywriting
jobs.description:
I’m refreshing my site and need a persuasive, conversion-oriented Home page written from scratch. The copy should speak directly to visitors, quickly communicate our value, and guide them toward getting in touch or making a purchase—so every section must be crafted with lead generation in mind.

You’ll take whatever raw information, brand guidelines, and tone notes I provide and turn it into polished website content that feels confident yet approachable. Clear headlines, concise benefit-driven body copy, and a compelling call-to-action are essential. Please weave basic on-page SEO best practices throughout so search engines can find us without sacrificing readability.

The final deliverable is a single, ready-to-publish Home page document: text only, formatted to indicate headline hierarchy (H1, H2, etc.) and any CTA buttons or links. I’ll consider the job complete once the copy:

• Captures our voice and unique selling points  
• Flows logically from hero section to CTA  
• Includes strategic keywords naturally  
• Arrives error-free and ready for my developer to paste straight into the site

If you’ve written high-converting website content before—especially for lead-driven businesses—I’d love to see a sample or two when you bid.

jobs.title: Dance Class Ad Campaign
jobs.description:
I'm looking for an experienced social media advertiser to create and manage Facebook and Instagram ads for a weekly beginners dance class. The primary goal is to increase class sign-ups among older adults, while also reaching younger demographics such as post-college age individuals.

Requirements:
- Target older adults and younger demographics (post-college age)
- Compelling ad copy
- Engaging visuals (photos, graphics, etc.)
- Monitor and optimize ad performance
- Provide weekly reports on progress
- Offer strategic guidance to improve advertising effectiveness and achieve better attendance for first classes

Ideal Skills and Experience:
- Proven track record in social media advertising
- Expertise in targeting diverse age groups, including older adults and younger demographics
- Strong copywriting and design skills
- Experience with performance analytics
- Ability to educate clients on best practices for online advertising, including leveraging platforms like Instagram to reach younger audiences

Your expertise will help us reach and engage our target audience effectively.

Our dance classes run approximately quarterly (~12 week sessions) and only on Sunday afternoons, so we typically advertise in weeks prior to a new class start. We'd like to get 30-40 new dancers for each session. Here is a link to our Facebook page that we currently use: https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=100064711433662. We've been somewhat successful with advertisements in the past, but not as successful as I would like. I do not understand aspects of Facebook advertising and imagine that I could be more successful if I had help. The majority of people who attend a class will continue attending - but we need to get them to that first class!

jobs.title: Immediate start - Squarespace Mobile Layout fix
jobs.description:
My Squarespace site looks fine on desktop, but the mobile view is messy. Images overflow, text breaks at awkward points, and some buttons shift out of place. I need you to jump in right away, audit every mobile-only page state, and correct those layout problems so the site feels cohesive across devices.  

Alongside the mobile fixes, give the whole site a quick once-over—compress any oversized graphics, tidy unused blocks or styles, and make sure navigation and page speed stay consistent after your tweaks.  

Deliverables  
• Responsive adjustments for images, text, and buttons on all breakpoints  
• Cleaned-up style settings and unused elements removed  
• Final site tested on common iOS and Android screen sizes with screenshots as proof  

I’m on standby to provide editor access and quick feedback so we can wrap this efficiently. Let me know your estimated turnaround and any clarifications you need to get started today.

It it’s a single page design with a simple about and contact page

jobs.title: AI-Driven WhatsApp Client Support Development
jobs.description:
AI-Powered WhatsApp Customer Service Setup

We are looking for an experienced freelancer to build an AI-powered customer service solution for WhatsApp.

Requirements:

* Connect our WhatsApp number to an AI assistant that automatically responds to customer inquiries.
* Train the AI using our company information, services, and FAQs.
* Support both Arabic and English conversations.
* Provide natural and accurate AI-generated responses.
* Allow conversations to be transferred to a human agent when needed.
* Maintain conversation history and customer records.
* Preferably provide a simple dashboard for managing conversations.
* Use a simple and cost-effective solution, preferably WhatsApp Cloud API integrated with OpenAI or a similar AI service.
* Deliver a fully working system with basic documentation or training on how to manage and update it.

When Applying, Please Include:

1. The platform/technology you recommend.
2. One-time setup cost.
3. Estimated monthly running cost.
4. Implementation timeline.
5. Examples of similar WhatsApp AI projects you have completed.

Our priority is a simple, reliable, and affordable solution that can be expanded in the future.

jobs.title: Part-Time Reels & AI Editor
jobs.description:
Instagram is my main stage and I need a steady stream of eye-catching short-form videos that boost engagement. Each week I’ll supply a mix of raw vertical footage plus clips produced with AI tools such as Midjourney and Runway. Your task is to turn that material into polished Reels: quick cuts, on-trend music, dynamic text, captions, colour-graded, 1080 × 1920 ready to publish.

Typical flow  
• I upload footage and a basic outline to a shared Drive.  
• You edit, add transitions, motion graphics, captions, and any AI flourishes that elevate the story.  
• We review in Frame.io (or your preferred review platform) and you deliver the final MP4 along with the project file for future tweaks.

Core tools I already use: Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut, Descript. If you prefer DaVinci Resolve or another editor, that’s fine provided the final export meets Instagram Reel specs and keeps file sizes efficient for quick uploads.

Acceptance criteria  
• Final aspect ratio 9:16, 30–60 s length.  
• Hook in first three seconds.  
• Burned-in captions with accurate spelling.  
• Visual style consistent with the reference Reel I’ll share at project start.  

The workload is part-time: roughly 3–5 Reels a week, rising with performance. Quick turnarounds (24–48 h) keep the content calendar on track, so reliability is essential.

jobs.title: Custom Financial Data Entry
jobs.description:
I have a set of raw financial files—CSV exports, PDFs, and a few handwritten notes—that need to be consolidated into a single Excel workbook. Every number you enter must follow my custom layout: a fixed sequence of columns with exact header names that I will supply up-front. No default templates, please; the structure is tailored to match our accounting workflow.

Once the figures are in place, totals and subtotals should calculate automatically through the formulas already embedded in the sheet. Feel free to adjust cell references if you spot breakages, but keep the logic intact. Data validation, drop-down lists for account codes, and clean date formatting will help prevent errors, so apply them where useful.

Deliverables  
• One master .xlsx file containing all provided data, arranged in the specified column order with the given headers.  
• A brief change log noting any formula tweaks or data issues you had to reconcile.  

I will review by cross-checking random samples against the source documents and confirming that all built-in totals match my own control sheet. Let me know your estimated turnaround time and any clarifying questions as soon as you dive in.

jobs.title: UK Solicitor Draft Loan Agreement
jobs.description:
I’m looking for a qualified UK-based solicitor to prepare a clear, enforceable personal loan agreement between two individuals. I will provide the key commercial terms—principal, interest, repayment schedule, any security and default provisions—along with background information on the relationship of the parties.  

Your task is to turn those points into a professionally drafted agreement that complies with current UK consumer credit and contract law, gives proper notice of statutory rights, and is ready for signature without further editing. The final document should be delivered in Word format so I can make minor date or name adjustments if needed.  

Because this is an individual-to-individual arrangement, I need plain-English wording wherever possible while keeping all the necessary legal protections intact. Please factor in any registration or witnessing requirements that may apply and flag them clearly in the document.  

If you’ve drafted similar personal loan contracts before, let me know; a short example of previous work (with sensitive data redacted) would be appreciated.

jobs.title: Azure Python API Backend
jobs.description:
I’m looking for a skilled backend engineer to build a production-ready Python service in my Azure environment. The core task is API development: clean, well-documented endpoints that expose our business logic and data to web and mobile clients. I already have an Azure subscription and resource group waiting, so you’ll be able to focus on code, infrastructure-as-code, and automated deployment.

Here’s what I need from you:  
• A modern Python 3 codebase using a framework such as FastAPI or Flask—open to your recommendation as long as it is actively maintained and async-friendly.  
• Native Azure deployment: containerise the service and supply Bicep/ARM, Terraform, or equivalent scripts so the stack can be recreated in any environment.  
• Unit and integration tests with pytest, tied into a CI/CD pipeline (GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps).  
• Auto-generated OpenAPI/Swagger docs derived from the code.  

Deliverable: a Git repository I can deploy with a single az cli command, together with a concise README covering configuration variables and endpoint usage.

Acceptance criteria:  
• All endpoints return the expected JSON payloads and HTTP status codes.  
• 90 %+ test coverage; all tests pass in the pipeline.  
• Deployment script completes successfully without manual steps.

I’d like to see an initial working version within two weeks and I’m available for quick daily check-ins on Slack. While the first milestone focuses on the API itself, designing with future authentication or role-based access in mind will be highly valued.

jobs.title: Cinematic Vlog Footage Editor Needed
jobs.description:
I have a batch of raw clips from my latest personal vlog and I want to transform them into a polished, cinematic story. This means smooth pacing, thoughtful transitions, atmospheric background music, tasteful text overlays for locations or key moments, and consistent color grading that ties everything together.

I’ll share the source footage (4K, MP4) along with any reference tracks or fonts I’d like used. Your task is to cut the material into a concise episode that feels more like a mini-film than a traditional jump-cut vlog while still keeping the energy upbeat.

Please send links to past work that shows you can handle cinematic edits—especially projects that demonstrate music integration, color work, and elegant titling. If we’re a good fit, I’ll outline any final notes, you’ll deliver the mastered video (H.264 or ProRes) plus a version with project files so I can make tweaks later if needed.

Looking forward to seeing your reel and collaborating on something beautiful.

jobs.title: AI-Generated Informational Videos
jobs.description:
I'm seeking an AI video generation tool to create formal, informational videos for the general public.

jobs.title: Modern Family Memory Book
jobs.description:
I’m compiling our family’s journey into a beautifully designed book that combines photographs with heartfelt stories. I already have a collection of images and handwritten anecdotes; I need someone who can weave them together in a clean, modern layout that flows chronologically—from our earliest ancestors right up to the newest addition to the family.

Here’s what I’m looking for:
• Curate and organize the supplied photos in time order, touching up images when necessary.  
• Pair each photo with its matching caption or short memory, keeping the tone consistent and engaging.  
• Design a contemporary page template (fonts, colors, white-space balance) that feels modern yet timeless.  
• Deliver a print-ready PDF and a shareable digital version (e.g., interactive PDF or EPUB).  
• Provide one round of revisions after the initial draft so we can fine-tune captions, placements, and any last-minute details.

If you have experience creating photo books, coffee-table books, or family history albums, I’d love to see samples of your previous work along with a brief outline of how you’d approach this project.

jobs.title: Animator Needed for 3D animation -- 4
jobs.description:
We are producing a 30–40 minute 3D animated video titled “Flood Size Comparison.” In this video, we will animate various floods of different sizes and intensities to visualize their impact and scale across a series of sequences.

You will be responsible for creating and animating the flood water, modelling the required environments, and integrating the water simulations into each environment to match the visual style and pacing of the video.

You will be provided with reference files, including ocean and environmental assets. However, most of the models and animation elements will need to be created from scratch.

Main Responsibilities
Modelling and animating flood water in different settings
Creating environmental elements including terrain, water bodies, buildings, and surrounding objects
Creating settings and physics simulations to achieve realistic flood behaviour and scale
Animating camera movements and water interactions
Ensuring animations sync with the pacing and narration
Creating realistic water flow, flooding, and environmental interactions
Video Structure

The video will follow a classic comparison format featuring floods of different sizes and intensities.

Camera pans and zoom-ins to showcase each flood
Flood animations showing different levels of severity, from small to moderate to catastrophic
Visual comparisons of flood heights against landmarks, buildings, and other known reference points
Camera flythroughs showcasing flood levels, movement, and impact
Smooth camera flyovers comparing multiple floods of varying sizes and intensities
Tasks Required
Modelling & Texturing

The main focus will be on creating realistic flood water and environments.

Limited texturing will be required for basic assets such as the sky, water, terrain, and buildings.

Modelling and simulating flood water from scratch will be crucial. This includes creating realistic water movement, flow, depth, and interactions with the surrounding environment.

Asset Breakdown:

Approximately 45 unique models, including:

Various flood water types and levels
Environmental assets
Buildings and structures
Landmarks
Debris and surrounding objects
Environment Creation

Build multiple environments for each flood scenario to interact with, such as:

Coastal cities
Urban areas
River deltas
Residential areas
Open landscapes
Low-lying regions

Additional requirements include:

Lighting and atmospheric effects
Clouds and weather conditions
Water reflections
Realistic terrain
Environmental details
Water simulation and interaction with structures
Animation

Animate the flood water with realistic physical behaviour, including:

Water flow
Rising water levels
Flooding
Water movement around structures
Impact on buildings and objects
Debris movement
Realistic water interaction with terrain

Ensure accurate scaling for each flood scenario relative to environmental assets.

Animations must also be synchronized with narration and scene transitions.

Apply zooms, camera movements, and slow-motion effects where specified to emphasize important moments, such as water reaching a city or flooding a large landmass.

Create seamless transitions between video footage and 3D animation where required.

Final Delivery

The final delivery should include:

Completed project files with all assets integrated
High-resolution rendered video sequences for each section
All working files
Textures
3D models
Scenes
Rigs, where applicable
Water and physics simulations
Animation files

jobs.title: Friendly Chinese Voiceover for Radio Commercial
jobs.description:

jobs.title: Modern 3BHK Interior Design
jobs.description:
I have just taken possession of a 3-bedroom flat and want every corner to feel fresh, functional, and distinctly modern. My goal is personal enjoyment, so the design must suit day-to-day living while still feeling like a showcase apartment.

Scope  
• Complete concept and space planning for the living room, kitchen, and all three bedrooms, plus circulation areas and balconies where relevant.  
• A cohesive modern theme that balances clean lines with warm, comfortable touches. Natural light, smart storage, and durable finishes are priorities.

What I expect  
1. Two or three initial mood boards that capture colour palette, materials, and key furniture ideas.  
2. Scaled floor plans and furniture layouts (AutoCAD or equivalent).  
3. High-quality 3D and 2D visualisations or walkthroughs (SketchUp/3ds Max with V-Ray or similar) so I can “walk” the space before we build.  
4. Detailed working drawings: electrical, lighting, false ceiling, plumbing points for the kitchen, and wardrobe internals.  
5. A consolidated material and fixture schedule with brand/model suggestions that are locally available.  
6. Three revision cycle after seeing the full set of renders and drawings.

Acceptance  
• Layouts must comply with existing structural walls and building regulations.  
• Renders should match approved mood board in styling, colours, and proportions.  
• All drawings supplied in both editable (DWG/SKP/MAX) and PDF formats.

Timeline and communication  
I’m ready to start immediately and would like the concept phase wrapped up within two weeks, with the remaining documentation delivered over the following fortnight. I stay available on Zoom or Google Meet for quick design decisions and will respond to messages within 24 hours.

If you have a portfolio of modern residential work and can deliver the items above, I look forward to collaborating with you.

jobs.title: Uzbek Injection Moulding Tutorials
jobs.description:
I’m putting together a short-form Instagram series that teaches complete beginners in Uzbekistan how to operate an injection-moulding machine. Every video must be filmed in Uzbek, feature a young, camera-friendly male operator, and clearly demonstrate each step right on the real machine.

Here’s the flow I’m after: the viewer should open Instagram, watch a crisp 1- to 2-minute reel, and instantly understand one focused concept—whether that’s calibrating the barrel temperature, clamping the mould, or locking out power for safety. Visual clarity is key, so plan a tight vertical frame, good lighting on the control panel, and on-screen Uzbek captions that reinforce spoken instructions.

Deliverables  
• 6–10 vertical video tutorials (1–2 min each)  
• Spoken and captioned entirely in Uzbek  
• Topics split evenly across machine setup, operating procedures, and safety protocols  
• Clean edits, royalty-free backing track, branded opener/closer I’ll supply  
• Final files in 1080 × 1920 MP4, ready to upload

Acceptance criteria  
The machine steps are easy to follow, all Uzbek text is proofread, and each clip ends with a quick recap that fits the reel limit without rushing. When I can post a video straight to my feed and viewers comment that they tried the step themselves, we’re done.

jobs.title: Handwrite Nursing Assignments with Morning Call
jobs.description:
I will WhatsApp or email you clear photos of my nursing‐assignment questions. Your task is to copy each answer onto clean A4 sheets in legible handwriting, keeping spacing and headings tidy so I can place them straight into my file.  

Once everything is written, I only need a quick phone call in the morning to have you read each answer aloud and confirm the content matches what you’ve written—no need for a recording or video unless you feel it helps, but a standard voice call is my preferred method.  

Deliverables  
• Neatly handwritten A4 pages (retain them on your side; I just need to know they’re ready)  
• Morning phone call for verbal confirmation of every page  

If this fits your schedule and handwriting is your strong suit, let’s move ahead.

jobs.title: Fintech Social Lead Strategist
jobs.description:
I need a seasoned social media mind to shape a performance-driven lead-generation program for a fintech and mutual-fund brand that already has a modest presence but now wants scale. Your plan must live where our audience spends its time—Facebook, Instagram and LinkedIn—and stay laser-focused on one outcome: qualified leads that move smoothly from ad to WhatsApp, consultation and onboarding.

Here is what the assignment covers:

Strategy & Funnel  
• Map the complete journey: ad creative, audience targeting, landing or WhatsApp hand-off, nurturing touchpoints and the follow-up cadence my sales desk can execute.  
• Build campaigns that respect SEBI/AMFI and other financial-advertising guidelines while still sounding human and trustworthy.  

Content & Calendars  
• Propose an editorial mix of educational posts, timely promotional offers and social-proof-rich client testimonials; detail frequency, formats and creative hooks for each platform.  
• Supply sample copy and visual cues so my in-house design team can produce quickly, or flag assets you can create yourself.  

Performance Architecture  
• Set up Meta Business Suite and LinkedIn Campaign Manager structures the clean way—naming conventions, A/B groups, conversion events, retargeting pools.  
• Define the reporting dashboard, CPL targets and quality-scoring model we will use to judge success.  

Presentation & Handover  
• Walk me through the rationale in a concise deck I can share with the client.  
• Include a rollout timeline, weekly optimisation checkpoints and clear next steps so the plan can go live immediately.

Acceptance criteria  
The work is complete when I have:  
1. A platform-specific, guideline-compliant strategy document.  
2. A 30-day content and ad calendar with messaging pillars and KPIs.  
3. Funnel wireframes that show every user touchpoint.  
4. A performance-tracking template populated with sample data.  

If you have recent wins in BFSI or investment products and can present them convincingly, I would love to review your approach and get started right away.

jobs.title: Site Verifier Needed in Minneapolis
jobs.description:
Confirmis (www.confirmis.com) is a Singapore-based business information provider specializing in connecting businesses with global capabilities; comprised of industry veterans, Confirmis's business model is designed to overcome perennial lack of data (let alone quality data) to support effective decision-making, particularly in developing economies.

REQUIREMENTS: 

• Must be living in (or nearby) Medina Road, Plymouth, Minnesota, USA 

 

• Has a camera or phone/tablet of quality with a camera, internet access 

• Must be available during business hours (9 AM - 4 PM) on working days 

  

Please see the attached file for the site visit guidelines. You are only required to deliver the pictures, video & observations and are not expected to assemble a report like the Sample Report. 

  

Note: 

- 1 city can only be taken by one freelancer (on a first-come, first-served basis) 

- The milestone will be released the following week (Monday) after the site visit to give us time to organize the report and contact you if we need additional clarification

jobs.title: Mobile Application - 3
jobs.description:
I am looking for a Flutter developer to add two important features to an existing video player application: **media notifications** and **Picture-in-Picture (PiP) mode**.

The notification feature should provide a reliable playback notification while a video is playing, including the video title, play/pause control, previous/next controls where applicable, and other essential playback actions. The notification should work correctly when the application is minimized or running in the background and should integrate properly with Android media controls and the device lock screen.

The Picture-in-Picture feature should allow users to continue watching videos in a small floating window while using other applications. Users should be able to enter PiP mode when pressing the Home button or minimizing the application, where supported. Playback should continue smoothly without interruption, and returning to the application should restore the normal player interface correctly.

Both features must be implemented cleanly in the existing Flutter project without breaking current video playback, playlists, navigation, ads, or other functionality. The implementation should follow Android best practices, handle lifecycle changes properly, and be tested on different Android versions and screen sizes. Please also ensure the code is well structured and easy to maintain.

jobs.title: Kitchen Tool 3D Printable Models
jobs.description:
I need a series of original, print-ready kitchen tools that I can sell as finished prints. The focus is strictly on household items—more precisely, clever, functional gadgets for the kitchen. Think measuring aids, organizers, or cooking helpers that a home user can reliably print on a typical FDM printer with a 0.4 mm nozzle.

Here’s what I expect:  
• A small collection of unique designs (let’s start with two or three) delivered as clean, watertight STL files.  
• Native design files from your preferred software—Fusion 360, SolidWorks, Blender, or similar—so I can tweak dimensions later if needed.  
• Simple renderings that I can use for sales listings.  
• Files must slice without errors in Cura and PrusaSlicer and print support-free where reasonable. Part seams, tolerances, and wall thicknesses should suit PLA/ABS at 0.2 mm layer height.

Before final hand-off, I’ll test-print each model; acceptance is complete when the prints assemble or function as intended with no redesigns required. If you’ve created successful kitchen or household prints before, please mention them and include any portfolio links so I can gauge style and practicality.

jobs.title: Cerita Misteri Fantasi Bertema Cinta
jobs.description:
Saya mencari rekan penulis yang dapat membantu saya merampungkan sebuah novel bergenre misteri dengan latar dunia fantasi. Di dalam kisah ini, elemen utama yang harus menonjol adalah cinta terlarang—konflik emosional yang memperkuat teka-teki dan membuat pembaca terus menebak-nebak hingga halaman terakhir.

jobs.title: Proposal Weekend Video Creation

jobs.title: High-Converting Meta Ads Campaign
jobs.description:
I’m ready to ramp up sales through a focused Meta (Facebook & Instagram) advertising push and need an advertiser who can take the whole process off my hands—from strategy to optimisation. You’ll start by auditing the current account (or create one from scratch if it works better), research audiences aligned with the products I offer, then craft thumb-stopping creatives and persuasive copy. Once live, I expect you to monitor performance daily, refine targeting, adjust bids and budgets, and keep me updated with concise weekly reports that translate data into clear next steps.  

My priority is straightforward: profitable conversions. If you have a portfolio that proves you’ve scaled e-commerce or service-based brands via Meta Ads Manager, let’s talk results and timelines so we can launch quickly.

jobs.title: Trash Can Cleaning Promo Video
jobs.description:
I’m looking for a creative partner to craft a short, live-action promotional video that advertises my trash can washing/ cleaning service. The goal is to grab attention quickly, showcase the convenience and hygiene benefits of a professionally cleaned bin, and drive viewers to book an appointment on the spot.

We’ll need a script that gets straight to the problem (dirty, smelly cans), shows my service in action, and ends with a clear call-to-action. On-screen graphics, lower thirds, bold text highlights, and a branded intro/outro will keep everything on brand without drifting into animation—this piece must feel real, relatable, and trustworthy.

To make sure we can post everywhere—from our website to Facebook, Instagram Reels, and TikTok—I’ll need multiple cut-downs and aspect ratios, each delivered in crisp 1080p (or higher). Closed captions for silent autoplay are a must.

Deliverables:
• 30-45 second HD live-action promo (master edit)  
• Square (1:1) and vertical (9:16) versions  
• Branded intro/outro plus contact overlay  
• Hard-coded captioned version  
• All project files and royalty-free audio licenses

I can supply our logo, colour palette, and any service photos you need. suggest stock or creative work-arounds that still feel authentic.

Show me samples of past promotional pieces, especially service-based or cleaning industry work, and outline how quickly you can turn this around. I’m ready to get started right away—let’s give dirty bins the sparkling spotlight they deserve!

jobs.title: Australiab Qualified CPA ONLY-Backlog of DIscretionary Trust + PTY LTD Bucket Company Returns to Submit-  Expertise in negotiating with the ATO re Penalties + GIC
jobs.description:
I have a discretionary trust that distributes to two PTY LTD companies and we are currently under ATO review for several late lodgements. All core bookkeeping is done and I have draft financial statements for both the trust and the companies; however, I still need help with three key steps: finalising those statements so they meet ATO-ready standards, lodging the relevant returns through the tax agent portal, and negotiating any penalties or GIC that the review may trigger.

Here is the position so far  
• Draft completed – every balance is already mapped in a working paper file (Excel and Xero).  
• Supporting documents—bank feeds, loan schedules and distribution minutes—are organised and ready to share in OneDrive.  
• Time sensitivity—the ATO has issued a review notice with a tight response window.

What I need from you  
1. Technical polish: verify the draft figures, prepare compliant financial statements and tax returns for the trust and its PTY LTD beneficiaries, and generate all required schedules.  
2. Lodgement: use your registered agent access to submit the returns and confirm acceptance.  
3. Representation: craft the covering explanation for the late lodgements, communicate with the review officer, and actively pursue a reduction of penalties and GIC where possible.

You should already be comfortable working with discretionary trusts, PTY LTD company returns, and ATO reviews. Clear, proactive communication is essential because I want to stay involved and minimise costs by supplying any extra information you request quickly.

Deliverables (acceptance criteria)  
– Final signed financial statements and tax returns (PDF and editable files).  
– ATO lodgement receipts for each entity.  
– Copies of all correspondence sent to, and received from, the ATO regarding the review, penalties and GIC.  
– A brief completion summary noting any follow-up actions.

If you have recent wins in reducing ATO penalties, please mention them when you respond. I’m ready to move immediately and will upload the draft files as soon as we agree on scope.

jobs.title: High-Level Academic Legal Writer Required: 15-Page Research Proposal in Tax Law (India GST vs. Nepal VAT)
jobs.description:
Project Overview
Looking for an experienced legal scholar, tax researcher, or academic freelancer (LL.M./Ph.D. background preferred) to draft a 15-to-20-page Research Proposal. The proposal focuses on comparative indirect taxation, cross-border digital economy regulation, and policy reform in South Asia.

Working Title:
Taxing the Borderless Economy: Comparative Legal Frameworks for Regulating Non-Resident Digital Services Under India’s GST and Nepal’s VAT Regime

Key Requirements & Academic Guidelines
It must be written in formal, high-impact academic legal English, fully referenced, and formatted as a single continuous document without unnecessary chapter breaks.

Total Length: 15–20 Pages (Single-spaced text, 12pt font, 1-inch margins).  
Citation & Referencing Style: Bluebook (20th/21st Ed.) or APA 7th Edition. All in-text citations must match 100% with the reference list.  
Literature Base: Minimum 25–30 authentic, high-impact references (peer-reviewed journal articles, statutory provisions, tax treaties, OECD reports, and official government publications).

jobs.title: Conciliatory Show Cause Email Draft
jobs.description:
I need a clear, well-structured Show Cause response email drafted that addresses a legal matter raised by one of our customers. The goal is to outline our position, supply any requested information, and invite a constructive path forward, all while maintaining a calm, cooperative tone that protects the relationship and demonstrates compliance.

You will receive the relevant background facts, timelines, and cited clauses from me. From that material I want you to:

• craft a concise yet complete narrative that answers each allegation or concern  
• reference the appropriate contract or statutory points without sounding adversarial  
• close with a practical proposal for next steps so the customer feels heard and supported

Plain English is vital; legal terminology should appear only where it adds clarity or precision. The finished email must read naturally, flow logically, and be ready to send once I drop it into our letterhead.

jobs.title: XIRR Stock Valuation Software
jobs.description:
I need a computer system set up exclusively for my stock accounts, with one clear objective: precise stock valuation. My workflow relies on the XIRR method rather than the typical FIFO, LIFO, or weighted-average approaches, so the solution must calculate and report portfolio value using that exact formula.

Here’s what I expect:

• A ready-to-run machine (or a virtual environment) pre-loaded with accounting software capable of handling XIRR stock valuation out of the box.  
• Easy import of trade history in CSV or Excel and seamless export of the valuation results in the same formats.  
• Automated daily or on-demand valuation runs, plus a concise dashboard summarising current value, internal rate of return, and variance from cost.  
• Clear documentation outlining how to maintain the data files, trigger new valuations, and back everything up.

I am not looking for invoicing, payroll, or general expense modules; if your preferred platform includes them, they can stay disabled. What matters is rock-solid, reproducible XIRR calculations and an interface simple enough for non-technical staff to operate.

If you can configure such a system, outline the software stack you plan to use, how quickly you can deliver a working prototype, and any licences or recurring fees I should know about.

jobs.title: Interactive SharePoint/M365 Coaching urgent asap

jobs.title: Penulisan Novel Biografi Inspiratif
jobs.description:
Saya membutuhkan seorang penulis yang dapat membantu saya mengeksekusi kisah hidup menjadi sebuah novel biografi bergaya naratif. Buku ditujukan untuk menulis jalan hidup tokoh akademisi daerah yang populer secara lokal. Fokus ceritanya adalah tentang kesuksesan dan perjuangan—bagaimana tokoh utama berjuang hingga meraih pencapaian penting dalam hidupnya, dan menjadi inspirasi.

Hal-hal yang harus ada dalam naskah:
• Kejadian nyata yang relevan sebagai fondasi alur, disusun secara kronologis dan tetap menarik dibaca.  
• Kutipan inspiratif yang memperkaya setiap bab serta menggugah pembaca untuk merenung dan bertindak.

Ruang kreativitas tetap terbuka selama inti kisah, nuansa naratif, dan pesan inspiratif terjaga. Saya akan menyediakan rangkuman kejadian kunci, tautan referensi, dan beberapa kutipan awal; Anda memolesnya menjadi cerita penuh sekitar 10.000–20.000 kata, termasuk struktur bab, penggambaran latar, dan pengembangan karakter pendukung seperlunya.

Kirimkan:
1. Contoh tulisan Anda yang sejenis (biografi atau novel inspirasi).  
2. Garis besar singkat tentang cara Anda memetakan alur dan menyisipkan kutipan.  
3. Estimasi lama pengerjaan tahap draft pertama dan revisi.

Saya mengutamakan komunikasi terbuka, jadwal realistis, dan kemampuan menulis bahasa Indonesia yang mengalir. Apabila kolaborasi ini lancar, saya berencana melanjutkan ke proyek penulisan serial lanjutan.

jobs.title: Saudi Employer Review Content Creation
jobs.description:
I’m building a bank of illustrative reviews on major public- and private-sector employers across Saudi Arabia. These reviews will be custom-drafted based on carefully researched content to provide insightful overviews for marketing or informational purposes.

The overall voice must stay balanced with pros and cons while keeping each post concise—between 150-200 words per piece. I’m after high-quality, professional content that’s inspired by genuine employeeer experiences but not presented as actual user-generated reviews. 

Natural variation matters: local corporate terminology, typical Saudi office nuances, and relevant details should all appear organically so no two reviews feel identical.

Before we begin, please send a short sample of any custom content or research-based marketing work you’ve done—just enough for me to gauge tone and authenticity.

Once your style is approved, we’ll finalize the following specifics: 
• List of targeted employers and total review count (30-40 required) 
• Formatting conventions and reference guidelines    
• Turnaround schedule (1 week completion expected)  

Payment is tied directly to volume at approximately five reviews per dollar. All copy must be original, pass plagiarism checks, and adhere to the brand tone specifications for immediate usability.
