jobs.title: Fusion Contemporary Home Design Suite
jobs.description:
I’m developing a new residential space and need it captured in a complete fusion-contemporary language—clean modern lines softened with select traditional accents. The work begins with clear, scaled 2D floor plans and develops through photoreal 3D renders that let me review massing, light and material choices before we ever break ground. From there, I’ll rely on you to shape the interior design so every room expresses the same blended character, down to finishes, built-ins and furniture layouts.

Deliverables
• 2D floor plans ready for permit and construction  
• High-resolution 3D renders (day and night views)  
• Interior design package: mood boards, material & colour schedules, furniture placement  
• An overall architectural style guide so later consultants stay consistent  

Source files in CAD/Revit (for plans) and the native 3D format plus print-ready PDFs are expected. I’ll provide my rough sketches, site photos and measurements on award; weekly progress snapshots will keep the project on track. Final approval comes once dimensions match the brief, renders accurately reflect proposed materials and the interior palette aligns with the style guide.

jobs.title: Android WhatsApp Admin Chat
jobs.description:
I need a dedicated Android app that lets me handle customer conversations on WhatsApp without jumping between phones or the web dashboard. The core flow is straightforward: log in once with my WhatsApp Business credentials, see every open conversation in one place, and respond in real-time.

Key behaviours  
• Send and receive messages instantly through the official WhatsApp Business API (or a proven gateway you recommend).  
• Keep several customer chats open at once and let me switch between them with zero lag.  
• Push notifications for new incoming messages, even when the app is in the background.  

Deliverables  
• Full Android Studio project with clean, well-commented source code.  
• Signed APK ready for installation on my team’s devices.  
• Short setup guide covering API credentials, build steps, and Play Store deployment if I decide to publish it later.  

Acceptance criteria  
1. I can add the cloud/API keys, build the app, and start chatting within 30 minutes following your guide.  
2. Messages sent from the app appear in the customer’s WhatsApp thread instantly and vice-versa.  
3. At least three concurrent chat windows can stay open without crashes or noticeable slow-downs.

If something in the WhatsApp ecosystem limits any of the above, tell me upfront and suggest a workaround. I’ll be prompt with feedback and test builds as soon as you share them.

jobs.title: Healthcare Staffing Competitor Analysis
jobs.description:
I’m gearing up to expand my healthcare staffing agency and need solid, insight-driven market research focused squarely on competitive analysis. Your job is to map the key players in our niche—regional and national staffing firms that supply nurses, allied health professionals, and locum tenens—to reveal how they price, position, and win business.

Here’s what I need from you:
• A database (Excel or Google Sheet) of at least the top 15–20 competitors with contact details, service lines, geographic coverage, unique selling points, and recent growth moves.  
• A concise SWOT snapshot for each firm, plus an overall industry SWOT summarising where opportunity gaps sit.  
• Visuals—charts or infographics—highlighting fee structures, service differentiation, and marketing channels.  
• A short strategic brief (3-4 pages or a slide deck) translating the raw findings into actionable recommendations I can present to stakeholders.

Please lean on openly available data, industry reports, LinkedIn, and company websites; primary calling is welcome if you can secure extra detail. Cite every source so I can verify. I prefer the analysis delivered in two milestones: (1) raw data set, (2) polished insights and slides.

If you’ve completed similar work in healthcare, staffing, or professional services, that experience will be a plus. Turnaround goal is two weeks, but let me know if you need a little flexibility up front.

OS-specific implementations

Golang Development

jobs.title: Energetic Rock Concert Audience

Si les pido que piensen en la palabra generosidad, probablemente imaginen grandes donaciones, héroes rescatando personas, o un cheque con muchos ceros. La mente humana tiende a medir la generosidad por el tamaño de la cifra, por lo espectacular del gesto, por lo que puede fotografiarse y aplaudirse. Ese gesto minúsculo lleva dentro de sí la misma semilla espiritual que un donativo enorme, porque la generosidad no se mide por el tamaño de lo que das, sino por el tamaño del impacto que dejas en el corazón del otro.

jobs.title: MODULAR CHARACTER FACE - Animation Library
jobs.description:
ANIMATION PROJECT – MODULAR CHARACTER FACE

I am looking for an animator to create a modular animation library for a simple motorcycle-helmet character face.

I will provide the completed MASTER VECTOR CHARACTER ASSET, original character design/reference and a sample animation showing the general style and movement.

The animation system consists of 3 independent layers:

Eyes + Eyebrows
Mouth
Cheeks / Display

The layers must remain separate so they can later be combined and controlled by software.

The full list of required animations and individual offers is provided in the animation menu. Artists may choose individual jobs or groups of jobs.

TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS

24 FPS
1920 x 1080
Transparent PNG image sequences
MP4 preview of every completed animation
Editable source/project files
Identical canvas, positioning, scale and alignment across all layers

MASTER IDLE FACE

Every animation must begin with 1 frame of the supplied MASTER IDLE FACE and ultimately return to the exact same MASTER IDLE FACE.

This is essential so animations created by different artists can be combined seamlessly.

IDLE animations must also loop seamlessly.

TRANSITION FRAMES

All non-viseme animations may use up to 48 additional frames for transition into and/or out of the animation.

This is an allowance, not a requirement. The animator may use fewer frames if appropriate.

VISEMES

The mouth requires reusable A, E, I, O, U, M/B/P, F/V, TH, S/Z, K/G and L/R visemes.

Each viseme must start from 1 frame of the MASTER IDLE FACE, perform the viseme animation, and finish on the identical MASTER IDLE FACE.

No separate rapid talking, slow talking, happy talking or angry talking animations are required. Software will control the order, timing and playback speed.

ARTISTIC FREEDOM

The menu describes the desired result, not the exact animation method.

During the active animation frames, the animator has creative freedom to achieve the best visual result.

For example, a Heart animation could fade in, dissolve, pop, float, bounce, pulse, multiply or use another suitable technique.

Eyebrows may be rotated, reshaped or adjusted if that creates a better expression. Mouth shapes may also be altered during active frames where appropriate.

Cheek/display reactions have particularly broad artistic freedom. The requested result is what matters; how that result is achieved is up to the animator.

The first and final MASTER IDLE FACE frames must remain consistent.

MOUTH STYLE

The mouth is intentionally minimalist and robotic.

The supplied design uses a single orange curve as the resting mouth/lips.

Do not add teeth, tongue, throat, inner-mouth detail or conventional human/cartoon mouth anatomy.

Mouth movement should remain stylised and non-human. Happy or playful movement can be curved and exaggerated, while angry movement should feel sharper, straighter and more robotic.

The mouth may be reshaped during active frames when needed to achieve the best expression, but must return to the MASTER IDLE FACE position.

PROJECT PURPOSE

This is a reusable animation asset library, not a collection of finished character videos.

The goal is to create clean, professional animation components that can be mixed together in software to produce many different expressions, reactions and talking sequences.

The animator only needs to create the individual assets listed in the supplied menu.

DELIVERY

For every completed animation:

PNG image sequence
MP4 preview
Editable source/project file

Please keep files clearly organised by Eyes + Eyebrows, Mouth, Visemes and Cheeks / Display.

BUDGET

Maximum project budget: $120 AUD.

Individual prices are provided in the animation menu. Where two prices are shown, they represent a basic and more elaborate/fancy result.

DEADLINE

If a job is accepted, the agreed animation work must be completed and delivered within 7 days of acceptance.

Please apply only if you are comfortable creating clean, simple, expressive animation assets and providing organized production files.

jobs.title: Blind Assistive Navigation Software
jobs.description:
My goal is to build a reliable software layer that lets a blind or visually-impaired user move confidently in both indoor and outdoor settings. Meta glasses and similar wearables already give us a camera and basic audio, yet they fail when background noise masks instructions and when no haptic feedback is available. I need a programmer who can rethink that whole flow and write the logic that ties the sensors, recognition, guidance, and feedback channels together so the experience is truly usable.

Core flow  
• Real-time positioning: use camera, GPS, IMU and, where available, Wi-Fi/BLE beacons to pinpoint the user’s location and heading, whether in a shopping mall or on a city street.  
• Path planning & turn-by-turn guidance: generate concise, context-aware instructions that avoid cognitive overload.  
• Multimodal feedback: combine short audio prompts, optional bone-conduction output, and vibration/haptic cues to overcome noisy environments.  
• Robust obstacle awareness: fetch depth or stereo data (or infer depth with AI) so the user is warned about hazards at cane-length distance or overhead.  
• Extensible add-ons: hooks for voice commands, emergency SOS, text reading, object recognition, or any future computer-vision module.

I already have access to sample hardware (camera-equipped glasses and a tactile band), so you can prototype quickly with OpenCV, TensorFlow Lite, PyTorch Mobile or a stack you prefer. What I really need is the architecture, clean code, and demonstrable logic that meld everything into a smooth UX.

Deliverables  
1. Source code with clear documentation and build/run instructions  
2. A runnable demo (APK, executable, or Web build) that proves indoor & outdoor navigation on my test routes  
3. API or module descriptions so more features can be plugged in later  
4. A short technical report explaining algorithms chosen, sensor fusion method, and latency/accuracy benchmarks

Acceptance criteria  
• Navigation prompts stay under 1 s latency and within 2 m positional error outdoors, 1 m indoors  
• Obstacle alerts trigger at least 95 % of the time in my test scenarios  
• Audio and haptic feedback are never delivered simultaneously in a way that confuses the user  
• Full offline operation for indoor mode, minimal data use outdoors

If this sounds like the kind of challenge you enjoy, outline the toolchain you would use, any similar projects you have tackled, and how quickly you can put together a proof of concept.

jobs.description:

This is NOT a concept-design job. The shoe design already exists, and I can provide:

* Detailed design PDF and reference views
* Existing dimensions and engineering specifications
* EU43 sizing/fit target
* Outsole, rand, toe-rubber and heel-rubber specifications
* Upper/tongue/closure references
* Existing development/CAD reference files

The goal is to accurately build the complete shoe, including:

* Overall shoe/last geometry
* Performance climbing-shoe downturn and asymmetry
* Outsole and midsole structure
* Perimeter rand
* Toe-hook rubber
* Heel-hook rubber
* Upper, collar, tongue and closure
* Proper transitions between all components

Final files should be suitable for a footwear manufacturer/prototype factory.

**Required deliverables:**

* Editable 3D CAD/source files
* STEP and/or IGES
* DXF where required for patterns/components
* Clearly separated shoe components
* Manufacturer-ready dimensions
* Revision(s) to correct geometry if required

Experience with **footwear CAD, shoe lasts, soles/tooling, pattern engineering, Rhino, SolidWorks, Fusion 360, iCAD3D or similar software** is strongly preferred.

Please apply with:

1. Examples of footwear CAD you personally created
2. Software you use
3. Relevant footwear/manufacturing experience
4. Estimated completion time
5. Fixed-price quote

**Please do not apply with only generic 3D renders. I need someone who understands real footwear construction and manufacturing.**

jobs.description:

Next, I’d like two matching templates in Excel —one for invoices and one for receipts. Each should automatically pull in our company logo, contact details, full items list, and the calculated total so we can issue paperwork without re-typing the same fields every time fully detailed.

For quoting new projects, I need a Word template that already carries our branding and logo, includes construction-specific fields (think project address, site start date, materials breakdown, labour hours), and ends with our standard terms & conditions.

Finally, I want a simple A4 letterhead template for e-mails and PDFs that uses the same branding elements so every outward-facing document feels consistent.

• Password-protected income & expenditure Excel file

• Branded receipt template

If you can build each template so that colours, fonts, and logos are easy for me to update later, that would be ideal. Let me know your estimated turnaround and any questions you have, and we can get started right away.

jobs.title: Bilingual (Spanish/English) Tech Expert for GHL Implementation
jobs.description:
GoHighLevel Expert Needed — Fluent Spanish AND Good English — Client-Facing

We are NexusCai, an AI infrastructure company. We build AI receptionists, CRM systems and
automation for industrial and service businesses across North America and Latin America.

We have a client in Colombia — a heavy-equipment and crane service company. The owner speaks
Spanish only. Our team works in English. We need one person who sits in the middle: talks to the
client in Spanish, reports to us in English, and gets the system live.

The scope is three things: the website, the AI receptionist, and connecting both into our CRM.

------------------------------------------------
THE THREE THINGS THAT MATTER MOST
------------------------------------------------

1. REAL SPANISH AND REAL ENGLISH.
You will be on video calls and WhatsApp voice notes with the client in Spanish — understanding what
he needs, asking the right follow-up questions, explaining what you built. Then you turn around and
give our team clear written updates in English. Strong in one language and weak in the other does
not work for this role. Both are required.

2. PROBLEM-SOLVING INSIDE GOHIGHLEVEL.
We tell you the outcome we need. You figure out how to build it. When something breaks — a webhook
not firing, a workflow looping, a form not creating the contact — you diagnose it yourself and come
to us with the answer, or with a clearly explained blocker. We are not going to hand you
click-by-click instructions.

3. HANDS-ON EXPERIENCE WITH WEBSITES, AI RECEPTIONISTS, AND GHL WORKFLOWS.
Tell us honestly what you have done in each of those three areas. We would rather hire someone
strong in two and willing to learn the third than someone who overstates all three.

------------------------------------------------
THE WORK
------------------------------------------------

START: A DISCOVERY CALL WITH THE CLIENT, IN SPANISH
Join the kickoff call alongside our team and get clear answers on what he actually needs —
services, operating hours, photos, testimonials, how he wants leads to reach him. He is
Spanish-only, so you are the one holding that conversation. Come out of it with written answers in
Spanish and English, plus the files collected.

1) THE WEBSITE
- A site already exists. You will be making edits and updates to it based on what comes out of the
  discovery call
- Text, images, sections, buttons, forms, and basic layout and design changes
- Everything in Spanish — the client's market is Colombia, English is secondary
- Add the pages that are still missing once the client supplies the content
- Build the forms and make sure every one of them submits cleanly into the CRM

2) THE AI RECEPTIONIST
- We build the voice agent itself (Retell). You get it live and working end to end for the client
- Route the client's phone number to it correctly
- Make sure it captures what it needs on every call: name, company, phone, email, city, machine
  type, brand, model, fault description, urgency
- Price questions and urgent calls route straight to a human — the agent never quotes prices or
  promises timelines
- Test real calls yourself, in Spanish, before you say it works

3) CONNECT IT ALL TO THE CRM
- Inbound call creates or updates the contact automatically
- Push call summary, transcript, recording link and outcome into the contact record
- Auto-tag by call type and move the correct pipeline stage
- Website forms route into the right pipeline with the right owner
- Build the follow-up workflows and the messages that fire off them — Spanish first, English as a
  secondary branch
- WhatsApp is the primary channel, not SMS. This is Colombia; if your experience is US-SMS-only, be
  upfront about that
- Notifications go to the owner and to a backup contact, so nothing gets lost

FINISH: TEST, REVISE, HAND OVER
Test every form, workflow and webhook yourself before calling it done. Handle the client's revision
rounds in Spanish. Short walkthrough at the end — Spanish for the client, English for our team.

------------------------------------------------
REQUIREMENTS
------------------------------------------------

- Fluent, professional Spanish. Native or near-native. Neutral or Colombian Spanish preferred
- Good English. Clear written and spoken English for working with our team
- Proven GoHighLevel experience — building workflows and automations from scratch, not editing
  someone else's
- Comfortable making real website edits: text, images, sections, buttons, forms, basic layout and
  design
- Comfortable with triggers, custom fields, custom values, webhooks and the API
- Able to troubleshoot independently and communicate blockers clearly
- Business-hours overlap with Colombia (COT / UTC-5)
- You work inside OUR account. You do not sell to, invoice, or contract with our client directly

NICE TO HAVE
- Retell AI, Vapi or another voice AI platform
- WhatsApp Business API inside GoHighLevel
- Basic HTML/CSS
- Construction, heavy equipment, mining, oil & gas or field-service clients

------------------------------------------------
HOW TO APPLY
------------------------------------------------

Bids missing any of these are removed without reply:

1. Write your first paragraph IN SPANISH. Tell us about your GoHighLevel experience and why you can
   handle a client-facing project in Spanish.
2. Then switch to ENGLISH for the rest of your proposal, so we can see both.
3. Tell us your experience in each of these three, separately and honestly:
   - Websites — what have you built or edited?
   - AI receptionists / voice AI — have you connected one to a CRM? Which platform?
   - GHL workflows — how many have you configured from scratch?
4. Describe a GoHighLevel problem you had to solve on your own — something that broke or would not
   work — and how you fixed it.
5. Links or screenshots of 2 builds you personally did — one website, one set of workflows.
6. Your fixed price, your realistic timeline, your time zone and daily overlap with Colombia (UTC-5).

Copy-paste bids and AI-generated boilerplate are removed immediately.

------------------------------------------------
WHAT HAPPENS NEXT
------------------------------------------------

We shortlist, run a short video call — part in Spanish, part in English — and award a small paid
test task before the full build. Deliver well and there is ongoing work: we onboard new client
accounts every month and want a long-term builder on the team.

jobs.title: Fast Documentary-Style Video Podcast Editor | Ongoing Work
jobs.description:
I’m hiring a fast, reliable, creative video editor for Built To Host, a documentary-style video podcast filmed on location inside the spaces connected to each guest.

This IS a podcast, but it is NOT a traditional sit-down studio podcast. The interview/conversation is the backbone, combined with documentary storytelling, B-roll, natural interactions, environmental sound, humor, pauses, host moments, and cinematic visuals.

I need an editor who can watch the raw footage and help discover the story, not someone who needs exact timestamps for every cut.

Typical episode: 20–30 minutes
Budget: $100 USD fixed per completed episode
Turnaround: First rough cut within 5 days and completed episode within 7 days maximum, assuming revision feedback is provided promptly.
Potential: Consistent ongoing episodes for the right editor.

Editing should include:
• Strong cold open using the best moment(s) from the footage
• Built To Host official intro
• Interview/story structure
• Intentional B-roll
• Natural pauses, reactions, humor and imperfect moments when they strengthen the story
• Dialogue cleanup and audio mixing
• Music and sound design where appropriate
• Color correction/grading
• Clean text/lower thirds when needed
• Smooth, intentional transitions
• Professional final export

I do NOT want excessive zooms, flashy template transitions, constant captions, random effects, fake scenes, AI-generated performances, or hyperactive editing.

Authenticity matters. The people and moments are real. I want the finished episode polished while still feeling human.

Reliability is extremely important. I am actively producing episodes and need someone who communicates clearly and meets deadlines. I do not want to chase an editor for updates.

Please only apply if the stated $100 fixed rate and 7-day maximum turnaround work for you now.

When applying, please send your BEST documentary/interview storytelling example and your BEST cinematic long-form edit. Do not send a huge portfolio.

Also answer:

1. Can you accept $100 per completed 20–30 minute episode?
2. Can you deliver the first rough cut within 5 days and final within 7 days?
3. If I give you raw interview footage, B-roll and creative notes, can you identify and structure the strongest story yourself?
4. If hired today, what exact date would you deliver the first rough cut?

I’m looking for someone who can become a consistent part of the Built To Host editing workflow, not simply complete one job.

jobs.title: Cloud-Based Accounting & Report Automation
jobs.description:
I need to migrate all our internal quoting, order processing, invoicing and expense control to a single cloud platform so every step—from the first estimate to the final payment—lives in one place and feeds clean data into our books.

Core workflow
Right now quotes, purchase orders and supplier invoices are managed in separate spreadsheets. I want you to configure (or build) a cloud solution that lets me:
• create quotes automatically from predefined price lists,
• push accepted quotes straight into orders with a simple approval flow, and  
• keep a searchable history of every quote and order for quick reference.

Invoicing & expense capture
The same system must issue customer invoices, record supplier bills, and flag due dates so we stop missing payments. A simple screen for registering day-to-day expenses is essential; those entries should link back to the correct invoice or cost centre for full traceability.

Monthly reporting
Each month I expect three ready-to-download reports:
1. Income vs. expenses  
2. Paid and pending invoices  
3. Expenses broken down by category  

Numbers must reconcile automatically with the data entered during the month—no manual re-keying.

Deliverables
– Cloud platform selected (or custom build delivered) and fully configured  
– User roles and permissions set for sales, purchasing and finance staff  
– Automated quote → order → invoice workflow live and tested  
– Templates for the three monthly reports, pulling real-time data  
– Brief handbook or video walkthrough so my team can operate the system confidently

Acceptance criteria
The first monthly close executed through the new system should generate the three reports with zero spreadsheet work and match our external accountant’s figures within a 1% margin.

If you have hands-on experience with tools like Odoo, Zoho Books, QuickBooks Online or a comparable SaaS ERP, let me know; I’m open to whichever cloud route meets the workflow above most efficiently.

jobs.title: Co-founder Wanted for Startup Agency
jobs.description:
Hey, Let me explain the situation clearly so there’s no misunderstanding before we go any further.

The agency is still at the starting stage. I’m building it from the ground up, so I’m not coming to you as an established agency with an existing client pipeline. I’m currently working on the offer, positioning, systems and overall business side.

What I’m specifically looking for is a genuine co-founder/long-term acquisition partner, not a freelancer or an employee. I want someone who can take real ownership of client acquisition — prospect research, cold outreach, qualification, follow-ups, appointment setting and eventually helping move prospects through the sales process.

My responsibility would be the agency side: building the offer, marketing/branding, fulfillment, delivery, systems, client management and making sure we can actually deliver once clients come in.

Because we’re starting from zero, I can’t offer an upfront payment, hourly rate, monthly salary or fixed freelance fee. I don’t want to pretend otherwise.

My preferred structure is 100% performance/revenue based initially. If you personally bring in a client and that client generates revenue for the agency, you receive an agreed percentage of that revenue. So there is no fixed payment before results, but your upside is directly connected to the business you help generate.

I also don’t expect you to blindly work for months without knowing whether this can work. I’d rather start with a small trial, test one niche/offer, measure the outreach and appointments, and see whether we work well together.

If we start generating consistent revenue, I want the relationship to grow beyond a simple commission arrangement. The long-term goal is to build the agency together, with both sides having meaningful ownership of their responsibilities and upside.

So if you're looking for a normal paid freelance/appointment-setting role, I completely understand and I probably wouldn't be the right opportunity right now. But if you're genuinely interested in building an agency from the ground up as a long-term acquisition partner/co-founder, I'd definitely like to explore it with you.

If that sounds like what you're looking for, we can discuss the niche, commission structure and exactly how we'd run the first 30-day trial.

Use JM Bullion only as a functional reference for the overall e-commerce experience:

https://www.jmbullion.com/

Example:
https://www.jmbullion.com/gold/gold-bars/1-oz-gold-bars/

Do NOT copy JM Bullion’s branding, copyrighted content, images, code or exact design. All branding, UI, graphics and content must be original.

DESIGN

The website should have a premium US luxury/e-commerce appearance:

* Luxury/minimal design
* Professional typography
* Premium product presentation
* Clean product cards
* High-quality imagery
* Excellent mobile experience
* Fast loading
* Modern lightweight animations
* Professional checkout
* Plenty of whitespace
* Trustworthy appearance

It must not look like a cheap/template-based website.

PRODUCTS & CATEGORIES

Initial categories:

* Gold
* Gold Bars
* Gold Coins
* Silver
* Silver Bars
* Silver Coins
* Platinum
* Diamonds
* Jewelry

Admin must be able to create/edit/delete future categories and products without developer assistance.

Each product should support:

* Name
* Multiple images
* Description
* Weight
* Purity
* Manufacturer/Mint
* SKU
* Inventory
* Selling price
* Reference/market price
* Discount/savings
* Availability
* Specifications
* Reviews, if enabled
* Add to Cart
* Buy Now

PRICING

Version 1 can use manual pricing.

Example:

Market/Reference Price: $1,250
Our Price: $1,185
Savings: 5.2%

Admin must be able to change:

* Product price
* Sale price
* Discount
* Premium/markup
* Inventory

The architecture should be ready for future live Gold/Silver/Platinum market-price API integration.

SEARCH & FILTERS

Customers should be able to search/filter by:

* Metal
* Product type
* Weight
* Price
* Purity
* Manufacturer/Mint
* Availability
* Best sellers
* New arrivals

Search must be fast and mobile-friendly.

CART & CHECKOUT

Provide a professional US checkout supporting payment methods where legitimately available through the business’s payment providers:

* Credit/Debit Card
* ACH/eCheck
* Bank Wire
* Western Union, if legitimately supported
* Other approved payment methods

Payment methods must be configurable.

The admin should be able to configure different pricing/discounts by payment method.

Example:

Card: $1,000
ACH: $980
Wire: $970

No full card numbers, CVV/CVC, OTPs, banking passwords or other sensitive authentication data may be stored in the website database/email.

Use secure, PCI-compliant/tokenized payment processors.

ACH / eCHECK

Create a secure provider-based ACH workflow:

Customer selects ACH → authorizes payment through provider → order becomes Pending → payment confirmed → order becomes Paid/Payment Received.

Do not store online banking passwords.

BANK WIRE

Customer selects Wire → places order → receives order number and secure wire instructions → sends payment → admin verifies receipt → admin marks order Paid → order proceeds to processing/shipping.

WESTERN UNION

If legitimately supported, provide:

Customer selects Western Union → order created → payment instructions → customer completes payment → provides transaction/reference information → admin verifies → admin marks Paid.

Western Union orders must NOT automatically be marked as paid.

ORDER MANAGEMENT

Admin dashboard should support:

* View/search/filter orders
* Customer information
* Products and order value
* Payment method/status
* Order status
* Transaction/reference ID
* Shipping status
* Tracking number
* Internal notes

Statuses:

Pending Payment / Payment Received / Processing / Shipped / Delivered / Cancelled / Refunded

PRICE LOCK

The architecture should support future precious-metal price-lock functionality.

The actual product price applied at checkout must be recorded with the order.

Future Phase 2 can include payment deadlines, price locks, automatic/manual repricing and cancellation.

CUSTOMER ACCOUNTS

Customers should have:

* Registration/login
* Profile
* Order history/details
* Order tracking
* Saved addresses
* Wishlist
* Secure processor-based saved payment methods where supported

ADMIN PANEL

I must be able to manage the website myself.

Admin should control:

* Products
* Categories
* Prices
* Discounts
* Inventory
* Orders
* Customers
* Coupons
* Homepage products
* Banners
* Basic SEO
* Blog posts
* Payment/order statuses

HOMEPAGE

Include:

* Premium hero section
* Gold, Silver, Platinum and Diamond collections
* Featured products
* Best sellers
* New arrivals
* Current/reference precious-metal pricing section
* Why Buy From Us
* Payment methods
* Secure shipping
* Reviews
* FAQ
* Newsletter
* Professional footer

SEO

Website must be SEO-ready from launch:

* SEO-friendly URLs
* Editable meta titles/descriptions
* Proper H1/H2 structure
* Product/Organization/Breadcrumb schema
* XML sitemap
* Robots.txt
* Canonical URLs
* Image alt tags
* Fast loading
* Mobile optimization
* Google Search Console compatibility
* Google Analytics
* Google Tag Manager

Each product must have an SEO-friendly individual page.

MARKETING

Prepare integrations for:

* Google Analytics
* Google Search Console
* Google Tag Manager
* Meta Pixel
* Google Ads conversion tracking
* Email marketing
* Retargeting

SHIPPING

Include:

* Shipping options
* Shipping address
* Shipping charges
* Tracking number
* Order tracking
* Shipment status
* Shipping confirmation emails

Architecture should allow insured/high-value shipping options to be added later.

SECURITY

Include:

* HTTPS/SSL
* Secure admin authentication
* Secure payment processing
* Input validation
* Basic protection against common vulnerabilities
* Secure database configuration
* Backup strategy
* Performance optimization

TECHNOLOGY

I am open to:

* Shopify
* WooCommerce
* WordPress
* Another reliable e-commerce platform

Please recommend the best option based on security, payment integration, SEO, scalability, cost and ease of management.

I do NOT require completely custom-coded software if a reliable platform can provide the required functionality within budget.

FUTURE PHASE 2

The architecture should allow future development of:

* Live precious-metal price API
* Automatic pricing
* Advanced inventory
* Additional payment methods
* Mobile app
* Loyalty program
* Wholesale/dealer accounts
* CRM
* Email/SMS automation
* Advanced analytics
* International expansion

These are not required in Version 1 and should be quoted separately.

BUDGET

TARGET: ₹50,000–₹80,000

ABSOLUTE MAXIMUM: ₹80,000

Please do NOT quote above ₹80,000 for Version 1.

Clearly separate:

* Development cost
* Hosting
* Domain
* Premium plugins/apps
* Third-party API costs
* Payment processor fees
* Optional future features

No hidden development charges.

DELIVERABLES

Version 1 should include:

1. Complete working website
2. Premium responsive UI
3. Mobile + desktop versions
4. Admin dashboard
5. Product/category management
6. Manual/dynamic pricing
7. Cart and checkout
8. Supported payment workflows
9. ACH workflow where supported by provider
10. Bank-wire workflow
11. Western Union workflow where legitimately supported
12. Order management
13. Customer accounts
14. SEO foundation
15. Analytics/pixel integration
16. Shipping/order tracking
17. Deployment assistance
18. Admin access
19. Source/access credentials where applicable
20. Basic documentation/video for website management
21. Post-launch bug fixing

FREELANCER APPLICATION

Please provide:

1. 2–3 e-commerce websites you have built
2. Experience with US-focused e-commerce
3. Payment integration experience
4. ACH/bank-wire experience
5. Recommended platform/technology
6. Estimated delivery time
7. Fixed project price
8. Exactly what is included within ₹80,000
9. All third-party costs I must pay separately
10. Recommended payment providers
11. How you will handle website security and scalability

I am looking for a serious, professional US precious-metals e-commerce website, not a basic generic online store.

The goal is to create a premium luxury/minimal visual identity combined with professional e-commerce functionality, secure payment workflows, SEO readiness and scalable architecture.

This is Version 1/MVP, so Shopify, WooCommerce, WordPress or another reliable platform is acceptable. Avoid unnecessary custom development that pushes the project beyond the ₹80,000 maximum.

I want a clean, professional foundation that can be expanded in Phase 2.

jobs.title: Online Luganda Conversation Tutor
jobs.description:
I need a native-level Luganda speaker who is equally comfortable in English to guide adult beginners like me through live, conversation-driven lessons delivered online. My main goal is to build day-to-day speaking confidence, so each session should revolve around practical dialogues, real-life scenarios, correct pronunciation, and essential idioms rather than heavy grammar drills.

Here is how I picture the collaboration working: we meet on Zoom or Google Meet two or three times a week for 45–60 minutes; you introduce a topic (greetings, market bargaining, family, travel, etc.), model the vocabulary, then encourage me to speak as much as possible while you correct, re-phrase, and explain cultural nuances in context. Between sessions, you can share short audio clips or quick exercises that reinforce what we covered, but the heart of the programme must stay conversational.

I am starting from scratch, so patience and clear bilingual explanations are crucial. If you already use teaching aids—flashcards, slides, or apps—feel free to incorporate them as long as they keep the lesson interactive.

Deliverables  
• Live video lessons focused on conversation  
• Brief recap or practice material after each lesson (PDF, audio, or Google Doc)  
• Ongoing feedback on pronunciation and fluency progress  

If you enjoy coaching beginners and can make Luganda feel natural and fun, let’s connect and set up our first trial session.

jobs.title: Urgent Notes Typing to PDF
jobs.description:
I need a fast-turnaround transcription of my handwritten notes into a clean, professionally laid-out PDF. Accuracy is critical, but I do not want a scan-style replica; instead, follow the custom formatting guidelines I will supply once we start. These guidelines will cover items such as preferred font, size, possible headers or footers, and the placement of any embedded images or diagrams that appear in the original pages.

The final deliverable must be a ready-to-share PDF. Supplying the editable source file (Word or similar) as a secondary file would be appreciated, but only the PDF is mandatory.

Please be comfortable deciphering varied handwriting, applying consistent styling, and turning work around quickly. Let me know your typical typing speed and how soon you can begin, and feel free to flag any unclear sections in the notes so we keep the text error-free throughout.

jobs.title: Portfolio Site & Ad Campaigns
jobs.description:
I need a clean, professional business-portfolio website built from the ground up and then promoted through carefully targeted Google Ads and Meta (Facebook/Instagram) campaigns.

Website scope  
– Three core pages: Home, About Us and Contact.  
– I have a rough vision for layout, colours and imagery but nothing set in stone, so you’ll have room to suggest modern UI ideas that keep the look consistent and on-brand.  
– The finished site should load fast, adapt perfectly on mobile, and be easy for me to update later through a straightforward CMS.

Advertising scope  
Once the site is live, I want you to set up and manage paid campaigns on both Google and Meta. This includes writing ad copy, choosing audiences, installing tracking pixels, creating basic visual assets if needed and optimising performance for the first launch phase.

Deliverables  
• Fully functional responsive website, ready to go live  
• Admin access and brief walk-through so I can edit text and images myself  
• Integrated analytics (GA4, Meta Pixel)  
• Initial Google Ads and Meta campaign setups with at least two ad groups each, plus one week of optimisation and a short report on performance  

Please outline your proposed timeline, the CMS or framework you prefer, and any similar projects you’ve completed.

jobs.title: Canadian Finance CEO Leads
jobs.description:

For each lead, I only need the best-reach email address—no phone numbers or extra fields—yet that single data point has to be rock-solid: no bounces, no generic inboxes, no catch-alls. I’ll cross-check everything against LinkedIn Sales Navigator and Hunter, so please rely on comparable verification tools or techniques to guarantee deliverability.

Deliverables  
• A CSV or Google Sheet containing: Company name, Executive name (President or CEO), Verified email address, Province/City.  
• Bounce rate under 5 %.  
• Sources or verification screenshots for random spot checks.

Timeline is flexible within a week if the list is clean and complete. Let me know your approach, the platforms you’ll tap, and a quick sample of three Canadian finance executives to help me assess data quality before we kick off.

jobs.title: 8-Hour Giveaway Reel Edit
jobs.description:
The raw vertical footage for my upcoming giveaway is ready—I now need it transformed into a punchy, informative Instagram reel that grabs attention instantly. The goal is simple: spotlight the giveaway details so viewers understand the rules at a glance and feel compelled to take part, share, and tag friends.

Here’s what has to happen within the next eight hours:
• Add clear, high-energy text overlays that spell out the prize and entry steps.  
• Layer royalty-free music or impactful sound effects that match the beat of quick cuts.  I need someone very creative who can deliver asap, and have some examples!!!
• Work in tasteful visual effects, motion graphics, and smooth transitions to keep eyes glued from first frame to last.  

Deliver the finished reel in 1080 × 1920 (Reels/TikTok format) as an MP4 plus the editable project file (Premiere Pro, Final Cut, or DaVinci Resolve—whichever you use). Audio must be free for social use, and all text should remain readable on mobile screens.

If you’re confident you can hit the eight-hour turnaround while keeping the tone informative yet exciting, let’s do this—I’ll send the footage the moment you accept.

jobs.title: HTML to Custom WordPress website development -no theme builder
jobs.description:
WordPress Developer – Marketing website Development using Custom Theme Development from Existing HTML.

Please note this is no ecommerce site or users needing login, this is a simple website for a company but has to be done using HTML we have and not theme builder.

We are looking for an experienced WordPress developer/team to convert an already completed responsive website into a custom WordPress website.

What we already have:
•	Completed Figma designs 
•	Desktop, tablet and mobile designs 
•	Fully developed responsive HTML/CSS/JS 
•	Approximately 20–22 pages already implemented in HTML 
•	All current design/assets 

What we need:
•	Convert the existing HTML into a lightweight custom WordPress theme 
•	Preserve the existing design, responsiveness and UI 
•	Use Gutenberg/native WordPress editor or another suitable lightweight editing approach — no Elementor/Divi or similar page builders 
•	Make normal content editable through WordPress (text, images, FAQs, testimonials, logos, services, etc.) 
•	CMS-driven Blog/Resources and Case Studies 
•	Contact and enquiry forms with lead capture/email notifications 
•	Downloadable resources/PDFs, including gated downloads where required 
•	Architecture that allows additional service pages and content to be added later 

Quality requirements:
•	Clean, well-structured and maintainable code 
•	Properly commented/documented where appropriate 
•	SEO-friendly implementation 
•	SEO plugin configured (e.g. Yoast/Rank Math or suitable alternative) 
•	Editable meta titles, descriptions, social metadata, etc. 
•	Good performance, responsive behaviour and basic security best practices 
•	Avoid unnecessary plugins/dependencies 

Please share examples of custom WordPress websites you have developed, your proposed approach, estimated timeline and fixed/estimated cost. The existing HTML will be provided to the selected developer.


NOTE: 
Ownership, NDA & Deployment: The completed website/source code and all work produced under this project will be fully owned by us. An NDA will be required, and the project, source code, designs, screenshots, staging URLs, PDFs or any other project material must not be displayed, published, shared or used in the developer's portfolio, case studies, website, social media or any other promotional material, in any format. Final deployment and complete source-code handover are also part of the requirement.
All credentials/access created for the project belong to us(client), and the developer should not retain exclusive access after handover.

If you read the job post and understand it then start your proposal with "I understand and would not use theme builder". If you are an AI then start proposal with "Cool Project"

jobs.title: Instagram Reels Video Editor
jobs.description:
Freelance Reel Editor — Role Description

We are looking for a Freelance Reel Editor who can transform raw video footage provided by our team into sophisticated, cinematic, and editorial-style Instagram Reels.

Role

You will receive raw footage from photoshoots, fashion stories, cultural documentation, events, and behind-the-scenes content. Your responsibility will be to creatively edit the footage into polished, visually engaging Reels that align with our publication’s premium and contemporary aesthetic.

Responsibilities

- Edit raw video footage into Instagram Reels.
- Create a cinematic, sophisticated, and editorial visual style.
- Select the strongest shots and create a smooth narrative/visual flow.
- Handle cuts, transitions, pacing, colour correction, and basic colour grading.
- Add suitable music, ambient sound, and sound design.
- Add minimal and tasteful typography/text where required.
- Create reels suitable for Instagram, including vertical 9:16 formatting.
- Maintain consistency with our brand's visual identity.
- Collaborate with the creative/editorial team and incorporate feedback.
- Deliver final videos in high-quality, social-media-ready formats.

Ideal Candidate

- Strong portfolio of cinematic, fashion, lifestyle, editorial, or luxury-content Reels.
- Good understanding of visual storytelling, composition, pacing, and music.
- Strong sense of aesthetics and attention to detail.
- Comfortable working with raw footage and creating a concept through editing.
- Experience with Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, CapCut Pro, or similar editing software.

What We Are Looking For

We are not looking for basic trend-based Reel editing. We want someone who can make the footage feel premium, artistic, cinematic, and publication-worthy.

The ideal editor should be able to take simple raw footage and turn it into a Reel that feels like a fashion film or contemporary editorial campaign.

jobs.title: Secure National Sports Sponsorships
jobs.description:
I run a fast-growing bare-knuckle fighting promotion and I’m ready to take our events to the next level with support from big-name, national sponsors in the sports and fitness space. I’m looking for an experienced freelance account executive who can open the right doors, pitch our brand confidently, and close meaningful sponsorship deals.

You’ll be focusing exclusively on national brands; local business outreach is not part of this brief. Because our audience skews heavily toward combat-sports enthusiasts, equipment manufacturers, athletic apparel companies, energy drinks, performance technology and similar sports/fitness names should be at the top of your list.

What I need from you
• A clear outreach strategy: target list, contact approach, timeline, and projected deal values.  
• Compelling sponsor materials: pitch deck and one-sheets tailored to each prospect.  
• Active outreach and negotiation until at least three qualified brands are in advanced discussions or a minimum of one contract is signed—whichever comes first.  
• Weekly progress updates so I can track conversations in real time.

Success will be measured by tangible commitments (cash or in-kind) that directly offset event costs or elevate production value.

When you apply
Please include past work that shows you have landed national-level sponsorships for sports or entertainment properties. Numbers impress me—deal size, conversion rates, or notable brand names are all helpful. No lengthy proposals needed at this stage; results speak louder.

If you know how to combine hustle with strategic relationship building, let’s talk.

jobs.title: Farsi Instagram Video Editor
jobs.description:
I am looking for a fluent Farsi-speaking editor to turn my raw footage into attention-grabbing Instagram content. Each clip will need tight cutting, on-brand captions in Farsi, and well-chosen B-roll inserts that keep the flow lively.  

You need to find the footage, brief talking-points, and any branded assets (logo, fonts, colour palette). From there, please:  
• Trim and rearrange shots so the story lands fast and stays under 60 seconds for Reels.  
• Add crisp, readable Farsi text overlays and burned-in captions that match Instagram’s vertical 1080 × 1920 format.  
• Drop in royalty-free or self-shot B-roll that supports the message without distracting from the main speaker.  
• Export the final video in high-quality MP4 and include the project file in Premiere Pro, Final Cut, or DaVinci Resolve—whichever you prefer.  

I post regularly, so a quick turnaround and consistent style will lead to ongoing work. If you have sample Reels in Farsi, please share a link; it will help me see how you handle pacing, typography and transitions.

jobs.title: Finance Blog Author Required
jobs.description:
I’m looking for a seasoned writer who can become the by-lined voice of our site, delivering well-researched, informative and analytical blog posts on business, economics, finance and lending.  
You will be the author of our content. Your name full bio will be listed on the bottom of the content. 
You will get a monthly retainer for how many posts. You will publish, optimized and personalized each post as an author.

I’ll provide a content calendar outline and target keywords that you can post at an agreed frequency for a research term.. You’ll pitch angles, craft the narrative, add supporting charts (Excel, Tableau or similar) where it strengthens the analysis, and revise quickly when feedback comes in.  

If you thrive on digging into credit trends, SME lending models, interest-rate impacts and broader macro-economic shifts—and can explain them without fluff—let’s talk. 

Please share a brief note about your most relevant finance pieces and confirm you’re comfortable being credited as the author on our site. We're not opposed to well research AI work not just for text.

jobs.title: Pre-Employment Verification Needed in Luton
jobs.description:
1- The task is to visit Impellam Group Ltd - UK physically and take at least 8-9 geotagged photos of the name board of the institute, captured from outside the building and preferably inside too. Download the app for geotagged photos from the link below:

Android app link: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.gpsmapcamera.geotagginglocationonphoto 
iPhone app link: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/gps-map-camera-photo-timestamp/id1503116917?ls=1&utm_source=website&utm_campaign=Custom 

If you can't get the app, just note down the latitudes and longitudes of the location when you're there and get simple pictures.

2- Get the verification forms filled, signed, and stamped by the HR or relevant authority of these locations.

3- Get the details of the verifier, that is, their name, designation, department, and Contact.

Also get the details of any nearby business (name of person, business name, and contact who can tell you whether the institution existed or not)

6- Please ensure that the name on the document matches the name on the signboard of the authority you visit. If there is a different name, ask them for the reason for the discrepancy. Ask them to write a one-line explanation on the form or provide BRC.

7- Check the forms before leaving the site; ensure that the start date, end date, and designation are the same on both the form and the certificate.

8- Check that all the fields are properly filled on the form.

9- Stay in contact with me during the visit so we can guide you better according to the situation.

jobs.title: Cre8Virals AI SaaS  Video Creation
jobs.description:
Create 1 Video for an AI SaaS + Post on Instagram & X

I am looking for a content creator who can create one original video introducing or testing Cre8Virals, an AI SaaS for YouTubers and content creators.

This is a paid trial project — ₹500 for 1 completed video.

What you need to do

- Learn about Cre8Virals and its features
- Create 1 original video about the product
- Maximum video length: 1–2 minutes
- Edit the video yourself
- Post the completed video on your own Instagram account
- Post the same or adapted video on your X/Twitter account
- Share the final video file with me
- Share the links to both posts

Video Requirements

 - Length: 1–2 minutes maximum
 - Vertical format (9:16) preferred
 - Original content only
 - Clear audio and video
 - No editing-app watermarks
 - The video should feel natural and creator-made, not like a generic advertisement

You can choose your own style and concept.

For example:

“I just started a YouTube channel and I found this AI tool, so I'm going to test it and see if it actually helps me.”

jobs.title: Web Application Security Hardening
jobs.description:
# Freelance Cybersecurity Expert – Authorized Web Application Security Test

## Project Overview

I am looking for an experienced cybersecurity professional / penetration tester to perform an **authorized security assessment of my website**. The goal is to identify, validate, and document security weaknesses so they can be fixed before they are abused by real attackers.

## Primary Test Scope

The first vulnerability I would like investigated is **CVE-2025-2262**, including whether the affected component/version is present on the site and whether the vulnerability is actually exploitable in the current environment.

The assessment should determine whether this vulnerability could allow unauthorized access, privilege escalation, authentication bypass, or other meaningful compromise.

## What I Need Tested

Please perform a professional, controlled penetration test covering:

* Verification of whether **CVE-2025-2262** applies to the website, including affected software/version.
* Safe validation and proof-of-concept exploitation where appropriate.
* Authentication and authorization weaknesses.
* Attempts to determine whether an attacker could obtain **administrator-level access** through the identified vulnerability or related weaknesses.
* Testing for exposed credentials, authentication bypasses, privilege escalation, session weaknesses, and insecure access controls.
* Identification of any related vulnerabilities that could be chained with CVE-2025-2262 to increase impact.
* Testing should remain within the agreed website/domain and authorized scope.

## Important Security Requirement

This is an **authorized security assessment of my own website**. Please do not access unrelated systems, third-party accounts, or data outside the agreed scope.

Do not unnecessarily download, expose, or retain real user passwords or sensitive personal information. Where possible, use test accounts and sanitized proof-of-concept data.

## Deliverables

Please provide:

1. A clear description of whether CVE-2025-2262 is present and exploitable.
2. Evidence demonstrating the security impact, using a safe proof of concept.
3. A severity/risk rating for each confirmed issue.
4. Details of the attack path and affected components.
5. Screenshots or other evidence where useful, with sensitive information redacted.
6. Recommended remediation steps and configuration/code changes.
7. A final penetration-testing report suitable for a developer or website administrator.

## Ideal Freelancer

The freelancer should have demonstrated experience with:

* Web application penetration testing
* Vulnerability research and CVE validation
* Authentication and authorization testing
* Privilege escalation
* OWASP testing methodologies
* Secure proof-of-concept development
* Writing professional penetration-testing reports

Please include examples of relevant cybersecurity testing work, your preferred testing methodology, and your estimated timeline and fixed-price/hourly rate.
