Link building / backlink acquisition (current referring domains: ~24; competitors average ~68)
Ongoing WordPress maintenance and implementation of the above (we can implement basic fixes ourselves with guidance, but want to know your rates for full implementation too)

What we need from you:

A brief outline of how you'd approach this (audit method, tools used, timeline)
Pricing: one-time project fee vs. monthly retainer options
Examples of similar work (adult/wellness/local service niches preferred but not required)
Whether you're comfortable working with an adult services business (please confirm before bidding)

Budget is flexible depending on approach — please quote based on scope, not a fixed number. We're comparing several proposals before deciding.

jobs.title: Telehealth Patient Growth Marketing
jobs.description:
I run Blue Sky Psychiatry & Wellness, a solo tele-health practice, and I’m ready to scale the number of adults (18-64) who book an initial session with me. Search engines—Google and Bing—will be our primary acquisition channel, so I need someone who can build and manage data-driven campaigns that turn targeted clicks into confirmed appointments.

Here’s what success looks like from my side:
• Every ad dollar is tied to a clear, traceable path that ends with a new patient on my calendar.  
• Robust lead, conversion, and retargeting pixels are firing correctly, letting us optimise bids and creative in real time.  
• Geographic targeting keeps impressions focused on the states where I’m licensed.  
• Reports focus on the one KPI that matters most to me: number of new patients, broken down by source and keyword.  

Deliverables
1. Campaign strategy and keyword plan tailored to adult mental-health seekers.  
2. Google Ads & Microsoft Ads build-out, including responsive search ads, extensions and location layers.  
3. Tracking stack: GA4, Google Tag Manager, call-tracking and form-submission goals configured end-to-end.  
4. Retargeting audiences and ad sets to re-engage site visitors who don’t convert on the first visit.  
5. Bi-weekly optimisation cycles with concise performance summaries and next-step recommendations.  

I respond quickly to data and appreciate clear communication, so if you can demonstrate past wins in healthcare PPC and are comfortable owning the full funnel—from first impression to booked appointment—let’s talk.

jobs.title: Mid-Level Auto Insurance Closer
jobs.description:
I’m looking for a proven closer who can step straight into our auto insurance team and start turning qualified prospects into satisfied policyholders. You’ll receive a steady stream of warm leads generated by our marketing engine; your job is to guide each prospect through the quotation, underwriting, and policy-binding steps until the sale is firmly on the books.

I expect you to bring solid mid-level experience—enough to navigate objections confidently, explain coverage options in plain language, and keep compliance top of mind without slowing the conversation. You should already be comfortable with typical sales tech stacks (think CRM software, e-signature tools, dialers, and screen-share platforms) and know the basics of state insurance regulations.

Key deliverables:
• Consistently hit agreed-upon monthly targets for bound auto policies  
• Maintain accurate, real-time notes in our CRM so the service team can follow up seamlessly  
• Provide brief end-of-day summaries highlighting wins, hurdles, and any additional support you need  

If you’re ready to jump in, show me numbers from your last role that prove your closing power, and tell me how quickly you can be licensed in any additional states we cover.

jobs.title: Comprehensive eBay Store Management
jobs.description:
My eBay shop is still small—with fewer than 50 live listings—but it takes more time than I can give it. I want every aspect of the storefront handled for me so I can focus on sourcing new inventory.

Here’s what has to happen day-to-day:

• Listing & Product Management – Create, revise, and retire listings as stock changes. Use eBay Seller Hub (and your preferred research tools such as Terapeak) to craft keyword-rich titles, accurate categories, and compelling photos so each item is ready for the Best Match algorithm.  
• Customer Communication – Respond promptly and politely to all messages, offers, and return requests, keeping my seller metrics spotless.  
• Orders & Shipping – Process paid orders the same day, upload tracking, and coordinate with my carrier so parcels go out on schedule.  

Visibility is a priority, so every new or updated listing should be fully optimized for search and conversion: correct item specifics, competitive pricing, promoted-listing settings where it makes sense, and cross-selling where possible.

Acceptance will be based on:

1. All active listings showing green SEO scores in Seller Hub.  
2. 100 % on-time shipping over the first month.  
3. Response time to buyer messages averaging under 12 hours.  

I’ll grant full storefront access once we start, and I’m happy to schedule a quick onboarding call to walk through my current workflow. If you’re confident with eBay policies, search optimization, and customer service, this is a straightforward, ongoing gig with room to grow as the inventory expands.

jobs.title: Cross-Platform Dress-Up World Development
jobs.description:
I’m building an online dress-up universe inspired by classics like IMVU and MovieStarPlanet, only updated for today’s audience. The experience must run smoothly in a browser and as a dedicated mobile app so players can jump between devices without losing progress.

Core experience  
Players start by choosing a realistic 3-D avatar, then refine every detail. To make this feel truly personal, the avatar creator needs three fully supported customization layers:
• Clothing & accessories  
• Hairstyles & hair colors  
• Body features & skin tones  

Game loop & progression  
I’ll supply the creative direction and item lists; I need you to build the underlying systems: an inventory, a virtual shop, and a points/XP economy that rewards dressing challenges, social interactions, and daily log-ins. Achievements should automatically trigger level-up animations and unlock new wardrobe tiers.

Technical expectations  
• Single codebase that outputs WebGL/HTML5 for browsers and native builds for iOS/Android (Unity or a comparable game engine is fine)  
• Secure user accounts with cloud save and cross-platform syncing  
• Modular architecture so new clothing lines or events can drop in without patching the entire app

Deliverables  
1. Prototype with one gender-neutral base avatar, starter hairstyles, and twenty clothing items  
2. XP and leveling system tied to an on-screen progress bar  
3. Admin panel or script that lets me bulk-import new wearable assets  
4. Documentation covering build pipeline, asset specs, and how to expand the wardrobe

If you’ve shipped avatar-centric games before and can demonstrate clean, scalable code plus an eye for fashion detail, I’d love to see your approach and timeline.

jobs.title: Daily 20 Trending News Articles - Covering English & Indian Languages
jobs.description:
I need a reliable writer (or small team) who can file twenty fresh, well-sourced news stories every single day, for a total of 600 articles in one month. The brief is deliberately broad: anything that is trending anywhere in the world or India is fair game—politics, entertainment, tech, business, sport, science, lifestyle, and breaking emergencies included. Articles must be written in English and/or Indian languages such as Hindi and Telugu.

Here’s what I expect each day:  
• 20 standalone articles delivered on a rolling basis so I can publish while topics are still hot.  
• Each story 500-1000 words, written in clean, engaging English or any listed Indian language, completely plagiarism-free with no copyright issues including images.  
• Clear attribution for facts, quotes, and figures; I will run random fact checks.  
• Headlines and sub-heads that capture the angle without overselling.  
• A short meta description (140-160 characters) and 3-5 SEO-smart keywords per piece.  

Turnaround speed is critical. I usually flag the first wave of topics at 07:00 GMT and need drafts within three hours; the rest of the day you’ll pitch or pick up stories as they break.

jobs.title: Professional Sound Effects Design
jobs.description:
I’m putting together a project that needs a fresh library of original, production-ready sound effects. I don’t have a fixed genre or mood locked in yet, so I’m looking for a designer who can create a versatile palette—anything from nuanced ambient layers to punchy, single-shot impacts.

Here’s what I have in mind:

• Craft, record or synthesize a set of high-quality WAV (and optional MP3) files, delivered in 24-bit/48 kHz or better.  
• Organize and label each file clearly so I can drop them straight into my DAW or game engine.  
• Include a quick reference sheet that lists the file names, durations and any creative notes (e.g., what you layered or which plug-ins you used).

Acceptance criteria: every file must be noise-free, loop cleanly when intended, and be 100 % original (no stock libraries or unlicensed clips).

If you have previous reels or demo packs, feel free to share links so I can hear your range. Looking forward to collaborating and giving this project a unique sonic identity.

jobs.title: Classic Logo & Brand Awareness
jobs.description:
I'm seeking a designer to create a logo (short & long versions). 

Key requirements for the logo and ad design:
- The logo should be classic and traditional, appealing to a timeless aesthetic.
- Provide the logo in high-resolution files suitable for both print and digital use.
- Logo must have both White & Black versions & all color codes of logo must be presented.
- Must be delivered within 3 business days after the project is awarded to the designer.

Ideal candidates for this project should have a strong portfolio in logo design, particularly in the classic and traditional style. A keen understanding of incorporating various elements into ad design, ensuring a balanced and engaging layout, is essential.

jobs.title: Colorful Event Brochure & Flyers
jobs.description:
I need a bright, energetic suite of print pieces that will turn heads and leave a lasting impression. The core items are a tri-fold brochure, flyers, and a set of posters, all carrying the same colorful, vibrant style. Their job is twofold: build buzz for an upcoming promotional events and reinforce overall brand awareness.

Content to weave into the tri-fold includes our key business services, what we offer, the company name and contact information but no pricing.  The brochure will be infomational to build brand awareness about the business.

For the events flyers and posters, the main event details (editable).  I need to be able to edit fonts and photos. Visual consistency across sizes is important, so the colors, fonts, and graphic elements you choose for the brochure should flow naturally onto the flyers and posters.

Deliverables  
• Tri-fold brochure laid out for standard US-letter front & back  
• Flyers design (8.5 X 11) ready for quick resizing if needed  
• Poster design (11 x 17) that scales cleanly  
• Print-ready PDFs (300 dpi, CMYK) plus editable source files (Illustrator and Photoshop)  

For the flyers and poster I am looking for something that I can input the client's information in, then they can print them up and place them around the school, events, etc promoting the event.  That is why I need to be able to edit the flyer font and replace photos.  It is something like "The carnival is coming" type of poster.  I am looking for something that works for schools, corporate events, birthdays and fundraisers. It can simply be a poster and flyer that works for all of them, or a flyer for each individual user. If you are doing individual users, then I would be looking for something for schools, churches, corporate events, birthday and fundraising.

I’ll supply logos, copy, and any brand guidelines as soon as we kick off. If additional stock images or icons are required, please note that up front so we can secure them quickly. Let me know your estimated turnaround time and any questions you have about format or specs, and we can get started right away.

I am requesting PSD files in addition to Illustrator files, as I am good with Photoshop and as previously stated, I would like the ability to edit the files.  I need the photos, and text to be able to be edited. If you can create a Canva template as well, that's a bonus.

The company website is Fantastic Fun Fair (FantasticFunFair.com/hawaii). For additional ideas, you can also look at https://mainstreetcarnival.com but note, that is not my site.  Please let me know if you have any 
questions.

EDIT TO ADD:

Please let me know if you envision a single poster/flyer, multiple posters/flyers or one poster and flyer for each scenario.

STOP calling me and asking questions that are answered in the details.  NO I WILL NOT WORK OUTSIDE FREELANCER! All you are doing is guaranteeing that I will NOT work with you.

jobs.title: Drive Traffic via Instagram & SEO
jobs.description:
I need a marketer who can blend paid Instagram advertising with on-page and off-page SEO to push qualified visitors to my site. The single metric I will judge you on is traffic growth; every tactic you deploy—whether it’s an ad creative, a keyword cluster, or a backlink outreach email—should be aimed at getting more people to land on the page where my Islamic video is hosted and actually press play.

Here is what I expect: you will research the audience most likely to engage with faith-based content, build and launch conversion-focused Instagram campaigns, and continually test visuals, copy, and targeting until we hit consistent cost-per-click goals. On the organic side, I want a technical audit, keyword roadmap, and content tweaks that lift rankings for the primary search terms we identify together.

Deliverables I will sign off on:
• Live Instagram ad campaigns with tracking pixels firing correctly  
• A concise performance report after the first seven days, then weekly  
• SEO audit report plus an implementation sheet for all fixes and content additions  
• Clear evidence—via Google Analytics and Meta Ads Manager—that site sessions and video plays are climbing

If you already have workflows for Facebook or LinkedIn retargeting, mention them; I may expand once Instagram proves profitable.

jobs.title: Intermediate Arabic Reading & Writing Tutor
jobs.description:
I have a group of intermediate learners who already recognise the alphabet and basic sentence patterns; now they want to move beyond survival phrases into confident reading and expressive writing in Modern Standard Arabic. Your role is to guide them through short literary passages, news articles, and practical texts, then help them turn what they read into clear, correctly-structured paragraphs of their own.

Sessions should be interactive, built around discussion of meaning, word-formation and stylistic choices rather than rote drills. I rely on screen-sharing (Zoom or Meet) and collaborative documents in Google Docs or Microsoft 365 so students can annotate texts live and receive line-by-line feedback. After each class they expect a brief homework sheet plus personalised notes returned within 48 hours.

Deliverables
• Eight 60-minute live lessons focused on reading comprehension and composition  
• Weekly PDF homework with model answers  
• End-of-course progress report highlighting strengths and next steps  

If you enjoy nurturing intermediate readers into confident writers and can commit to punctual feedback, I’m ready to schedule the first session right away.

jobs.title: Urgent Flutter App Modification
jobs.description:
I need a skilled Flutter developer today to make a small but critical change inside my existing utility-style task-management app. The app already handles to-do lists smoothly, so the core codebase is stable; the only work required is updating specific document details that appear in several screens and their related models.

You’ll get the current Flutter project (Dart 3, Material 3 widgets) and a concise list of every field, label and model property that must be renamed or reformatted. I expect:

• Clean, commented edits to the relevant Dart files  
• Verification that each modified screen still compiles and behaves identically aside from the updated text/data  
• A brief changelog so I can track which classes and widgets were touched

Once the changes are complete and I confirm the new document details render properly on Android and iOS debug builds, the job is done. If you’re comfortable diving straight into an existing codebase and turning around a focused fix fast, this should be a very quick win for both of us.

jobs.title: On-camera vehicle inspection using smart glasses (US based, one day shoot)
jobs.description:
I run CrashLens, an app that walks people through a vehicle inspection. I need footage of someone actually using it, filmed from their point of view with Meta Ray-Ban glasses or similar.

What you'd do:

Walk around a car and inspect it while wearing the glasses., i want to see the phone in your hand and the car in the background. The app gives you prompts on your phone telling you what to photograph and from what angle. You follow the prompts, take the shots, and the glasses capture the whole thing from your perspective. The inspection itself will take less than 5 minutes. 

What I need from you:

You own Meta Ray-Ban glasses or comparable POV recording glasses (or a camera mounted to your body or head).

You have access to a US vehicle, please add the Year Make and Model to your offer. Existing dents and scratches are actually better.

You are comfortable on camera. You will be talking while you work, explaining what you are doing. Nothing scripted word for word, but you need to sound natural and confident, not stiff.

You are based in the US.

Deliverables:

Footage of the inspection, pretend you're a client inspecting your own car. We will use this footage in our marketing and to show clients how to do it. 

this cannot be an Ai video, we already have one and it sucks, that is why we need a real video done by a human. 

This is what we have: youtube.com/shorts/fQAgU3XnOec?feature=share 

If you can redo this for us (as a second job), we can pay more needless to say, we need full commercial rights to the footage. I am using this in marketing, on the website, in ads, etc.

The max budget is no more thn $250 for a delivered product, please do not send a low offer then try to renegoitate via chat. Thank you!

jobs.title: Développement Application Android Simple
jobs.description:
Je souhaite lancer la première version d’une application Android et j’ai besoin d’un développeur mobile expérimenté pour transformer mon concept en APK fonctionnel.

Objectif
Créer une application native Android qui me permette de tester rapidement le marché avec un prototype solide.

Fonctionnalités de base
- Écran d’accueil et inscription par e-mail.
- Tableau de bord affichant des données reçues d’une API REST.
- Stockage local minimal (Room ou SQLite) pour un mode hors-ligne léger.
- Interface propre, conforme aux règles Material Design.

Livrables attendus
• APK de debug et de production.  
• Code source complet (Kotlin ou Java) hébergé sur un dépôt Git.  
• Brève documentation expliquant compilation, configuration de l’API et publication Google Play.

Je suis concentré sur Android pour cette première phase, mais j’apprécierai vos conseils pour assurer l’évolutivité éventuelle vers iOS. Si tout se passe bien, une collaboration à plus long terme est envisageable.

jobs.title: Revit Construction Document Set Creation
jobs.description:
I am ready to move my project into the construction-document phase and need a clean, fully coordinated drawing set produced in Autodesk Revit. The focus is strictly architectural, so every sheet must communicate design intent clearly to the contractor and local permitting office.

Please deliver:
• Floor plans for all levels, annotated and dimensioned  
• Interior and exterior elevation drawings with material tags  
• Building sectional views that align with the plans and elevations  

The sheets should follow standard construction-document conventions, use consistent view templates, and be organized in a Revit file that opens without missing families or broken links. PDF exports matching the title-block sheet size are also required.

If you have recent experience creating architectural CD sets directly in Revit and can meet typical permit-submission standards, I look forward to collaborating.

jobs.title: DTF Shirt Image Transparency
jobs.description:
I have a single PNG photograph that will be printed via direct-to-film on T-shirts, and I need the background removed so the file sits cleanly on any fabric colour. I’m not yet certain whether a few elements should stay opaque, so I’ll rely on your professional eye to tell me if preserving subtle shadows or highlights will improve the final print.  

Please return a high-resolution transparent PNG ready for DTF production (300 dpi preferred). If you can also supply the layered source file, even better—I’d like the flexibility to tweak colours later if needed.  

Accuracy around hair or fine edges is essential because anything jagged will show once pressed. Let me know your expected turnaround and any questions you have about print specs.

jobs.title: TDA7379 Home Amplifier with MP3
jobs.description:
I’m putting together a small home-audio rig and need a compact two-channel amplifier that squeezes the full 38 W per channel from the TDA7379. The core requirements are straightforward:

• Audio section: clean 2 × 38 W into 4 Ω, low THD, proper heat sinking and speaker-protections already worked into the schematic.  
• Source section: an integrated MP3 player so I can drop in a USB stick or micro-SD card and play straight away—no external decoder boards.  
• Control: all main functions (power, volume, track skip, mute, EQ presets if available) operated through an IR remote control. Physical buttons on the front panel are optional; I’m happy to rely on the remote once everything’s tucked into the cabinet.  

I’ll be running it from a single 12 – 18 V DC brick, so onboard regulation and filtering are crucial. A compact, low-noise PCB layout coupled with a concise BOM keeps the build tidy; through-hole or SMT parts are fine as long as sourcing remains painless.

Deliverables I’d like from you:
1. Complete schematic in PDF or KiCad/Eagle.  
2. PCB Gerber files ready for fabrication, plus the layout file.  
3. Annotated BOM with part numbers that Mouser or LCSC actually stock.  
4. IR command table and, if you’re using a common off-the-shelf handset, a note on the exact model.  
5. Brief test report (photos or a short clip) showing both channels driven and the MP3 player under remote control.

Bluetooth or an LED VU meter might be nice extras for the future, but they aren’t part of this round; focus on getting the core amp, MP3 module, and remote working flawlessly.

If anything in the spec needs clarification, let me know so we can lock it down before you dive into the layout.

jobs.title: Minimalist Physical Storefront Design
jobs.description:
I need changes in my current storefront design. I don't have the source files but it is fairly simple. Need few changes. will be hiring in the next few minutes and it needs to be completed in an hour or two. No negotiations. 

$15 or $20aud budget fixed

jobs.title: Student Academic Content Writing
jobs.description:
The project centres on producing clear, accurate written pieces aimed squarely at students and other academic readers. I will supply the topic outlines; your job is to turn each outline into a concise, well-structured article that explains key concepts without dumbing them down.

Scope of the first milestone  
• 5–7 articles, roughly 1,000–1,500 words apiece  
• Each piece must open with an engaging overview, develop the idea logically, reference current research (APA 7), and close with a short recap or reflection prompt that helps readers test their understanding.  

Acceptance criteria  
• Zero plagiarism and verifiable citations  
• Tone remains scholarly yet accessible to under-graduates and post-graduates alike  
• Delivered as clean Google Docs ready for final proof

I will review the draft of the first article before green-lighting the remainder, so prompt communication and the ability to incorporate feedback quickly are essential.

jobs.title: Financial Model for Live-Streaming Startup
jobs.description:
# Freelancer Required: Startup Financial Modeling & Investor-Ready Financial Projections

## About MyArtist

MyArtistan early-stage **consumer social and live-streaming platform** being developed for the Indian market.

The platform will enable users to discover and interact with creators/artists through features such as:

* Live video streaming
* Virtual gifts using tokens/coins
* Reactions and paid engagement
* Private video/audio calls
* Group calls
* Creator monetization
* Interactive engagement features
* User and creator subscriptions/transactions where applicable

We are preparing MyArtist for an upcoming **seed fundraising round** and require an experienced financial-modeling professional to build a detailed, investor-ready financial model.

## Fundraising Context

Indicative fundraising assumptions:

* Funding requirement: approximately **₹5 Crore**
* Stage: Early-stage / MVP
* Initial target: approximately **5,000 users**
* Initial creators: approximately **100**
* Business model: Users purchase tokens/coins and spend them on creator interactions
* Creator revenue share: approximately **30% of eligible GMV**
* MITRO share: approximately **70% before applicable variable and operating costs**

All assumptions must remain editable in the final model.

## Scope of Work

The freelancer will build a comprehensive **3-year financial model**, with detailed monthly projections for at least the first 12–24 months.

The model should include:

### 1. User & Creator Growth Model

Model:

* Registered users
* DAU/MAU
* Paying users
* Paying-user conversion
* New users/month
* User retention/churn assumptions
* Active creators
* New creators/month
* Creator retention
* User-to-creator ratios

The model should support **Conservative, Base and Aggressive scenarios**.

### 2. Revenue & GMV Model

Build separate revenue assumptions for:

* Virtual gifts
* Reactions
* Private calls
* Group calls
* Live-stream engagement
* Fun/interactive features
* Other potential monetization

Include:

* Average revenue/spend per paying user
* GMV
* Creator payouts
* MITRO take rate
* Gross revenue/net revenue
* Revenue by feature
* Monthly and annual revenue projections

### 3. Unit Economics

Calculate:

* CAC
* ARPU
* ARPPU
* LTV
* LTV/CAC
* Creator economics
* Contribution margin
* Contribution margin per paying user
* Infrastructure cost per MAU
* Infrastructure cost per paying user
* Break-even analysis

### 4. Streaming & Technology Cost Model

The financial model must support inputs for:

* Agora/WebRTC streaming costs
* Public live broadcast
* Private video/audio calls
* Group calls
* Viewer/participant minutes
* Creator streaming hours
* Concurrent users
* CDN/bandwidth
* Video storage/recording
* PostgreSQL/database
* Redis/cache
* API/application servers
* Object storage
* Monitoring/logging
* Backup
* SMS/OTP/email
* Other cloud infrastructure

The model should allow us to test infrastructure requirements at approximately:

**5,000 → 10,000 → 100,000 → 500,000 → 1,000,000+ users**

Technical pricing assumptions will be reviewed with our engineering/cloud team.

### 5. Operating Expense Model

Include:

* Engineering payroll
* Moderators / trust & safety
* 24×7 moderation requirements
* Customer support
* Content team
* Creator operations/managers
* Sales/business operations if applicable
* Marketing
* Founder salaries
* Legal
* Accounting
* Compliance
* Software/SaaS
* Office/admin
* Recruitment
* Travel
* Other G&A
* Contingency

### 6. Marketing Model

Include:

* Monthly marketing budget
* CAC
* Paid acquisition
* Organic acquisition assumptions
* New users generated from marketing
* Conversion to MAU
* Conversion to paying users
* Marketing efficiency
* Revenue generated relative to marketing expenditure

We prefer a **CAC-driven user acquisition model** rather than simply assuming arbitrary monthly user growth.

### 7. P&L, Cash Flow & Runway

Prepare:

* Monthly P&L
* Revenue
* Cost of revenue
* Gross/contribution profit
* Operating expenses
* EBITDA / operating profit or loss
* Monthly burn
* Cash flow
* Opening/closing cash
* Funding inflow
* Runway
* Break-even month

### 8. ₹5 Crore Use-of-Funds Model

Clearly show how approximately ₹5 crore of investment would be allocated across:

* Technology/product
* Infrastructure
* Marketing
* Creator acquisition
* Moderation
* Operations
* Hiring
* Legal/compliance
* Working capital
* Contingency/runway

Include the milestones expected to be achieved using the funding.

### 9. Valuation & Cap Table

Include:

* Pre-money valuation
* Post-money valuation
* Investment amount
* Investor ownership
* Founder dilution
* ESOP pool
* Cap table
* Future-round dilution scenarios
* Conservative/Base/Aggressive valuation scenarios

Valuation assumptions should be clearly identified as assumptions and not presented as guaranteed company valuations.

### 10. Investor Dashboard

Create a clean executive dashboard showing important KPIs including:

* Registered users
* MAU/DAU
* Paying users
* Paying conversion
* Active creators
* GMV
* Revenue
* ARPU/ARPPU
* CAC
* LTV
* Contribution margin
* Monthly burn
* Cash balance
* Runway
* Break-even
* Infrastructure cost/user
* Creator payouts

## Required Deliverables

The final delivery must include:

1. **Fully editable Excel financial model (.xlsx)**
2. All calculations must contain working formulas
3. Assumptions must be clearly separated from calculated cells
4. 36-month financial projections
5. Detailed monthly model for at least the first 12–24 months
6. Conservative / Base / Aggressive scenarios
7. P&L
8. Cash-flow/runway model
9. Unit economics
10. Use-of-funds analysis
11. Valuation and cap table
12. Investor KPI dashboard
13. Assumptions/source notes
14. One review session explaining the complete model
15. Reasonable revisions after our review

**We do not want only a PDF, PowerPoint or static financial report. The editable Excel workbook with formulas is mandatory.**

## Preferred Freelancer Experience

We prefer candidates with experience in one or more of:

* Startup financial modeling
* FP&A
* Fractional CFO services
* Consumer internet startups
* Social-media/social-discovery applications
* Creator economy
* Live-streaming businesses
* Gaming/entertainment platforms
* Marketplace businesses
* Subscription/token/virtual-currency business models
* VC/angel fundraising
* Startup valuation and cap-table modeling

CA/CFA/MBA Finance qualifications are beneficial but **practical startup financial-modeling experience is more important**.

## When Applying

Please provide:

* Your relevant experience
* 2–3 examples of startup financial models you have previously created, preferably anonymized
* Experience with consumer/social/live-streaming businesses
* Your proposed approach for MITRO
* Project timeline
* Fixed project quotation
* Number of revisions included
* Whether you provide a model walkthrough after completion

Please also briefly explain how you would model the following flow:

**Users → MAU → Paying Users → User Spend → GMV → Creator Payout → MITRO Revenue → Streaming/Variable Costs → Contribution Margin → Operating Expenses → EBITDA/Burn → Cash Runway**

Generic applications without demonstrating an understanding of startup unit economics and financial modeling may not be considered.



## Budget

**Open to proposals based on experience and quality.**

Preference will be given to candidates who can demonstrate previous investor-ready startup models rather than simply offering the lowest quotation.

jobs.title: Gestión diaria de Instagram
jobs.description:
Necesito a alguien que asuma la gestión completa de mi cuenta de Instagram. Busco un profesional que, cada día, se encargue de:

• Crear contenido atractivo y coherente con mi marca (posts, stories y reels cuando aplique).  
• Interactuar activamente con la comunidad: responder comentarios y mensajes, dar “likes” estratégicos y fomentar conversaciones que impulsen el engagement.  
• Revisar las métricas clave en Instagram Insights y entregarme un breve informe semanal con los resultados y sugerencias de mejora.

Valoro la creatividad, la buena ortografía y el dominio de las tendencias actuales de la plataforma. Si ya manejas herramientas como Canva, Later o similares para programar y diseñar, mejor aún. jobs.title: Setup Medium-Term Savings Account
jobs.description:
I am opening a new account with one clear goal: saving money. The account’s day-to-day payment features can stay in the background; what matters is secure storage that lets my balance grow over the next few years. I therefore need a medium-term savings structure and, when rates make sense, the option to lock portions into a fixed deposit.

Here is what I would like from you:

If you have hands-on experience with savings account onboarding, fixed-deposit arrangements, or familiarity with Somali banking options, that will be a strong plus. Clear communication and accuracy are essential; I’m ready to move as soon as I receive your recommendations.

jobs.title: Fashion Clothing Description Copywriter
jobs.description:
I’m refreshing my online clothing catalogue and need persuasive, on-brand product descriptions that help shoppers picture the fit, fabric, and style the moment they land on the page. Each item requires a short, punchy headline plus a 100–150-word narrative that touches on silhouette, key details, care instructions, and a subtle call-to-action. Tone should feel friendly and aspirational—think modern boutique rather than big-box retailer—while still weaving in natural keywords for SEO.

You’ll receive product images, technical specs, and any existing brand voice guidelines so you can stay consistent with our current copy. If you’ve worked on fashion lines before, especially clothing (tops, dresses, outerwear, etc.), I’d love to see samples that show how you balance creativity with clarity. Familiarity with standard e-commerce platforms and basic HTML formatting is a plus, as the final text will be dropped straight into the CMS.

Deliverables

jobs.title: Modelado 3D Caricaturesco en Blender
jobs.description:

Por ello necesito controles faciales sencillos, deformaciones limpias en brazos y piernas y una jerarquía organizada que facilite la animación posterior.  

Para asegurar que todo quede claro, estos son los entregables:

Si ya tienes experiencia modelando caricaturas en Blender y te entusiasma darle vida a estos personajes, me encantará ver tu portafolio y avanzar contigo.

jobs.title: AI Video Engineer for ROLLCALL Backend
jobs.description:
Senior AI Video / GPU Engineer Needed – Wan2.2 + RunPod A100 + PyTorch/CUDA

I need an experienced AI/GPU engineer to finish and productionize an existing AI video-generation backend for a platform called ROLLCALL.

This is NOT a website design job. The website is already built. I need someone who specializes in GPU inference, Python, PyTorch/CUDA environments, AI video models, and production API deployment.

CURRENT SYSTEM

We already have:

RunPod
NVIDIA A100-SXM4 80GB GPU
Wan2.2 I2V A14B
Approximately 118GB of Wan2.2 model files already downloaded
Persistent /workspace storage
Python
PyTorch/CUDA
FastAPI/Uvicorn worker
FFmpeg
Existing website integration
Existing REST API running on port 3010

Current API routes include:

GET /v1/health
POST /v1/generate
GET /v1/jobs/{job_id}
GET /v1/files/{filename}

The website can communicate with RunPod successfully.

GPU health verification works.

The generation API successfully accepts a request, creates a real job_id, returns that job ID to the website, and allows the website to poll the job status.

CURRENT TECHNICAL PROBLEM

Wan2.2 is currently failing during Python startup because of a FlashAttention/PyTorch ABI compatibility problem.

Current error includes:

flash_attn_2_cuda...so: undefined symbol...

I do NOT want someone randomly reinstalling packages until something works.

I want an engineer who understands PyTorch, CUDA, NVIDIA GPUs, FlashAttention, compiled Python/CUDA extensions, ABI compatibility, and production AI inference environments.

YOUR JOB

First audit the complete existing environment before changing anything.

Determine the correct compatible combination of:

NVIDIA driver
CUDA
Python
PyTorch
torchvision/torchaudio where applicable
FlashAttention
Wan2.2 dependencies

Then repair or rebuild the Python runtime cleanly if necessary.

You must also:

Preserve the existing ~118GB Wan2.2 model files.
Preserve existing ROLLCALL project files and generated videos.
Verify Wan2.2 imports successfully.
Verify generate.py starts successfully.
Verify T5, VAE and Wan2.2 model checkpoints.
Verify A100 CUDA inference.
Verify FFmpeg.
Review and stabilize the FastAPI worker.
Verify generation requests immediately return a valid job ID.
Verify job status can be polled reliably.
Implement reliable queued, generating, processing/stitching, completed and failed states.
Return useful error information when a generation fails.
Ensure completed MP4 files are accessible to the website.
Verify image-to-video generation using Wan2.2 I2V A14B.
Test the entire system from the ROLLCALL website through RunPod and back.
Make the worker start/recover correctly after a pod/container restart.
Create a reproducible startup/deployment configuration so we do not have to manually repair the environment again.
Document the exact final Python/PyTorch/CUDA/FlashAttention/package versions.
IMPORTANT

Do NOT delete, replace or redownload the approximately 118GB Wan2.2 model unless there is a genuine technical reason and I approve it first.

Do NOT consider the project finished simply because the health endpoint returns HTTP 200.

DEFINITION OF DONE

I will consider this project complete only when this complete workflow works:

ROLLCALL Website → RunPod API → Job Created → Wan2.2 I2V A14B → NVIDIA A100 GPU Generation → MP4 Created → Job Completed → Video Returned → Video Plays Correctly on ROLLCALL Website

A real end-to-end video generation must successfully complete before final acceptance.

I also want the completed environment documented and reproducible so a future RunPod restart does not require rebuilding everything manually.

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

Please apply only if you have strong experience with several of the following:

Python, PyTorch, CUDA, NVIDIA A100/H100, RunPod, Wan2.1/Wan2.2, FlashAttention, Hugging Face, diffusion/video models, FastAPI, REST APIs, Linux, FFmpeg, Docker and production GPU inference.

Experience deploying large AI video models such as Wan2.x, HunyuanVideo, CogVideoX, Stable Video Diffusion or similar models is strongly preferred.

IMPORTANT SCREENING QUESTION

Start your proposal with:

A100-WAN22

Then answer this question:

If flash_attn_2_cuda.so produces an undefined symbol error when importing Wan2.2, what would you inspect before reinstalling FlashAttention?

Explain specifically how you would verify PyTorch version, CUDA compatibility, NVIDIA driver, Python version, FlashAttention build/wheel compatibility and ABI compatibility.

Do not simply answer “I will reinstall FlashAttention.”

Generic proposals will not be considered.

I am looking for someone who can inspect the entire stack, identify the root cause, make the correct repair once, and deliver a production-ready system.

jobs.title: Asesor de Marketing y Comunicación Política
jobs.description:
Estoy buscando una persona con experiencia en marketing digital, creación de contenido y comunicación política que pueda asesorarme estratégicamente en el desarrollo de contenido para redes sociales.

Mi objetivo es crear contenido político que sea claro, atractivo, actual y capaz de llegar a nuevas audiencias, utilizando estrategias que favorezcan el alcance orgánico y teniendo en cuenta las políticas y características de cada plataforma.

¿Qué necesito?

Analizar tendencias, formatos y comportamientos de las audiencias.
Dar recomendaciones sobre edición, ritmo, duración, textos en pantalla, títulos, miniaturas y llamados a la acción, sin necesidad de realizar directamente la edición.
Orientarme sobre buenas prácticas para cumplir las políticas de las plataformas y mejorar las posibilidades de distribución del contenido.
Analizar el contenido publicado y sugerir mejoras a partir de métricas y resultados.
Tener criterio propio y aportar propuestas concretas de contenido, no limitarse a ejecutar mis instrucciones.
Contexto territorial y derechos humanos

Es indispensable que la persona tenga conocimiento del contexto de la Costa Caribe colombiana, especialmente en temas relacionados con derechos humanos, participación ciudadana, asuntos sociales, diversidad, territorio y problemáticas de la región.

Busco a alguien que comprenda las realidades políticas y sociales de la Costa Caribe y pueda aportar ideas de contenido pertinentes para este contexto, evitando estrategias genéricas o desconectadas de la realidad local.

Perfil que busco

Comunicación política.
Creación de contenido para redes sociales.
Derechos humanos y contexto social de la Costa Caribe colombiana.
TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts y Facebook.
Copywriting y creación de guiones.
Análisis de métricas y comportamiento de audiencias.
Estrategias de crecimiento orgánico.

No estoy buscando necesariamente un editor de video. Lo que necesito principalmente es un asesor estratégico que me ayude a definir qué contenido hacer, cómo estructurarlo, cómo comunicarlo y cómo presentarlo para aumentar sus posibilidades de llegar a nuevas personas.

Propuesta de trabajo

Estoy abierto a comenzar con un proyecto de prueba para evaluar la metodología de trabajo y, si existe una buena dinámica, continuar con una colaboración de largo plazo.

Al enviar la propuesta, por favor incluir:

Ejemplos de cuentas, proyectos o campañas en las que haya trabajado.
Qué estrategia utilizaría para aumentar el alcance de una cuenta de contenido político.
Qué aportaría específicamente en la creación de guiones y propuestas de contenido.
Tarifa o propuesta económica.
Disponibilidad semanal.

Busco especialmente a alguien creativo, estratégico, actualizado con las tendencias, conocedor del contexto de la Costa Caribe y de derechos humanos, y capaz de aportar ideas propias.

jobs.title: Copy PDF Data to Excel

jobs.title: Mobile App Developer Required for Video MVP (YouTube-Style UI + Admin Panel)

jobs.title: TPE Part Design Review & Production-Ready Engineering Package
jobs.description:
I'm looking for an experienced mechanical engineer or product designer to review and update an existing CAD model and engineering drawing for a Thermoplastic Elastomer (TPE) component.
The goal is to create a production-ready engineering package that can be submitted directly to injection molding suppliers for tooling quotes and manufacturing.

Scope of Work
•	Review existing CAD model and engineering drawing.
•	Update dimensions, tolerances, material specifications, and engineering notes.
•	Evaluate the design for TPE injection molding best practices.
•	Recommend improvements for manufacturability, including draft angles, wall thickness, radii, and parting line considerations.
•	Identify potential molding issues such as warpage, sink, flash, knit lines, and undercuts.
•	Apply GD&T where appropriate.
•	Prepare a final engineering package suitable for supplier RFQs and tooling review.

Deliverables
•	Updated CAD files (native format and STEP).
•	Production-ready engineering drawing (PDF and native format).
•	TPE material specification and recommended Shore hardness.
•	Summary of design changes and manufacturing recommendations.

Preferred Qualifications
•	Experience designing parts for injection molding.
•	Experience with TPE materials.
•	Strong knowledge of DFM (Design for Manufacturability).
•	Proficiency in SolidWorks, Fusion 360, or similar CAD software.
•	Experience creating production-ready drawings and documentation.

Proposal Requirements
•	Your experience designing TPE or injection-molded components.
•	CAD software you will use.
•	Examples of similar projects.
•	Experience with GD&T and manufacturing tolerances.
•	Experience working with tooling suppliers or injection molders.

The objective is not prototype development. The objective is a tooling-ready CAD model and engineering package that can be sent directly to injection molding suppliers for quotation and production review.

Please note: I expect to spend approximately 1 to 2 weeks reviewing candidates and proposals before making a final selection. Preference will be given to applicants who can demonstrate relevant injection molding, TPE, and manufacturing documentation experience.

jobs.title: AI Full-Stack Developer/Support Engineer Wanted for AIFabrico.com
jobs.description:
AI-Powered Full-Stack Developer / Support Engineer for AIFabrico.com

We are looking for developers to help us grow AIFabrico.com, a platform where we build, publish, sell, and deploy software products.

This is not just a one-off coding task. We are looking for people who can potentially work with us long-term across development, maintenance, deployment, and customer support.

What you’ll be doing

Your responsibilities may include:

* Developing new applications and features
* Improving and extending our existing applications
* Fixing bugs and technical issues
* Reviewing and improving existing codebases
* Deploying applications and configuring production environments
* Helping customers install, deploy, configure, and customize purchased software
* Responding to technical customer questions
* Creating new products from specifications
* Testing applications before release
* Improving performance, security, UX, and code quality
* Maintaining existing products as dependencies and frameworks evolve
* Working with GitHub repositories, branches, pull requests, and issues

AI agent experience is required

A major part of our development process is AI-agent-assisted software engineering.

You should already know how to work effectively with tools such as:

* OpenAI Codex
* Claude Code
* similar autonomous/agentic coding tools

We are not looking for someone who simply copies code from ChatGPT.

You need to understand how to use coding agents professionally: give them good specifications, inspect an unfamiliar repository, plan changes, delegate implementation, review generated code, run tests, debug failures, iterate, and verify that the final result actually works.

AI should make you dramatically faster — it should not replace your engineering judgment.

Technical skills

Our projects may use different technologies, so you don’t need to know everything.

Experience with some of the following is valuable:

* PHP / Laravel
* JavaScript / TypeScript
* Vue / React
* Inertia.js
* Tailwind CSS
* Node.js
* MySQL / PostgreSQL
* Redis
* Docker
* Linux
* Git / GitHub
* REST APIs
* Stripe
* Cloud deployments
* CI/CD
* Three.js / WebGL
* Swift / SwiftUI for some projects

Strong general software-engineering skills are more important than knowing every framework on this list.

What matters to us

We want someone who:

* can work independently
* can understand an existing codebase quickly
* knows when AI-generated code is wrong
* doesn’t consider “the agent said it’s done” to mean the task is actually done
* tests their work
* communicates clearly
* can investigate problems instead of waiting for step-by-step instructions
* cares about shipping working software
* is comfortable working across multiple small and medium-sized products

Customer support

Some work involves helping AIFabrico customers.

A customer may say:

“I purchased this application but I can’t deploy it.”

We expect you to be able to inspect the problem, communicate with the customer, configure or modify the application where necessary, and help get it running.

So written English and the ability to explain technical issues clearly are important.

Long-term opportunity

We’re interested in finding multiple reliable engineers whom we can repeatedly assign work to as AIFabrico grows.

There will potentially be work involving:

support → bug fixes → customization → product development → new applications

Good developers can therefore receive ongoing work rather than a single project.

When applying

Please include:

1. Your GitHub profile or examples of software you’ve built.
2. Your main technology stack.
3. Your experience with Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, or other coding agents.
4. An example of a real project where you used an AI coding agent productively.
5. How you verify AI-generated code before shipping it.
6. Your hourly rate.
7. Your weekly availability.
8. Your timezone.
9. Whether you’re comfortable communicating directly with customers.

Please do not send a generic AI-generated proposal.

Start your application with:

AIFABRICO.COM

so we know you’ve actually read the brief.

jobs.title: Automatic 2S Li-ion Charger Control
jobs.description:
I’m building a small home-electronics product that runs from a 2-cell Li-ion pack (8.4 V when full). I need a proven control circuit that automatically disconnects a 9 V wall adapter – routed through a TP5100 module – once the pack reaches 8.4 V, then reconnects it when the voltage falls back to roughly 7.2 V.

The heart of the design will be a voltage-comparator stage. I’m fine with the classic LM393, but you may choose any pin-compatible or better device if it improves accuracy or power draw. The switching element can likewise be an N-MOSFET, P-MOSFET, or even a compact relay; I mainly care about low losses, no back-feeding into the adapter, and rock-solid hysteresis between OFF (8.4 V) and ON (≈7.2 V).

What I need from you  
• Complete schematic with all part values and reference designators  
• Simulation or verification files (LTspice, Proteus, Altium, KiCad, or similar) showing the turn-off/turn-on thresholds and no-oscillation behavior  
• Brief design note explaining how the hysteresis network, switching device, and protection components work together  
• A bill of materials that I can hand straight to a distributor  

If you can deliver a design that is compact, reliable, and ready for quick PCB layout, let’s get started.

jobs.title: Python Azure REST Integration
jobs.description:

• Return structured JSON responses with proper error handling and logging.  
• Fit naturally into our Azure DevOps pipeline for automated testing and containerised deployment.

Tooling & stack guidance:
– Python 3.10+ with FastAPI or Flask-RESTX.  
– SQLAlchemy (Core or ORM) or an equivalent lightweight driver.  
– Azure CLI / Bicep or Terraform scripts for repeatable resource provisioning.

Acceptance criteria:
1. All endpoints respond within agreed SLAs (<200 ms P95 inside VNet).  
2. Full CRUD functionality demonstrated against a staging Azure SQL Database.  
3. 90 %+ test coverage with passing CI pipeline.  
4. Detailed README and OpenAPI/Swagger docs autogenerated from code.

Experience with Azure Functions or Azure Storage is welcome but not mandatory; the primary focus remains tight, secure integration with Azure SQL Database through RESTful APIs written in Python.

jobs.title: Editor de vídeos YouTube para canal de actualidad y cultura — Veracidad Real

Añadir subtítulos o palabras clave en momentos importantes.
Incorporar efectos de sonido de forma profesional, sin sobrecargar.
Utilizar música de fondo adecuada cuando sea necesario.
Crear una introducción especialmente potente durante los primeros 20–30 segundos.
Evitar largos periodos de imágenes estáticas.
Mantener una buena progresión de tensión y curiosidad durante todo el vídeo.
Estilo que busco
Quiero una edición parecida a los canales modernos de comentario, actualidad y cultura, no a un documental televisivo lento.
El espectador debe sentir que siempre está ocurriendo algo visualmente.
La edición debe servir a la historia y aumentar:
CTR → retención → tiempo de visualización → comentarios → suscripciones.

Yo proporcionaré:
Guion.
Locución.
Dirección general del vídeo.
Miniatura.
Título.
El editor será responsable principalmente del montaje y construcción audiovisual.
También valoraré mucho que el editor pueda proponer mejoras si considera que una parte del montaje puede aumentar la retención.
Busco una relación a largo plazo
Actualmente estoy retomando el canal después de varios meses de inactividad y quiero construir un proyecto serio.
Si encontramos un editor que funcione bien, la intención es trabajar de forma recurrente en nuevos vídeos, no contratar solamente un proyecto puntual.
Para presentar tu propuesta
Por favor, envíame:
2–3 ejemplos de vídeos de YouTube que hayas editado personalmente.
Tu precio aproximado para un vídeo de 8–12 minutos.
Qué incluye exactamente ese precio.
Cuánto tiempo necesitas normalmente para entregar un vídeo.
Qué programas utilizas.
Si puedes realizar también la búsqueda de material audiovisual para el vídeo.

Si tienes experiencia editando canales de comentario, actualidad, entretenimiento, política, cultura o contenido similar, indícalo.

jobs.title: Bifold Wallet Design Needed

jobs.title: Greek Instagram DM Outreach Assistant

jobs.title: Tech Sales Partner for Project Acquisition

We are looking for a sales-focused individual who can bring qualified technology projects to our company.
Note: This job is purely commissions based and does not provide any salary.
The ideal person will have a strong network, understand business technology needs, and be capable of identifying companies that need software, web applications, mobile applications, automation, internal tools, integrations, or other technology solutions.

What We Offer

Commission of up to 20% of the total project sales value

2. You introduce the client/project to us.
3. Our team handles the technical discovery, estimation, proposal, and project delivery.
4. If the project closes, you receive up to 20% of the sales value, depending on the project and your involvement in the sales process.

Example

If you bring in a USD 5,000 software project, your commission could be up to USD 1,000.

If you consistently bring qualified projects, this can become a substantial recurring income opportunity.

Who We Are Looking For

This opportunity is suitable for:

* Independent sales professionals
* Business development representatives
* Technology consultants
* Freelance salespeople
* Agency/IT consultants with client networks
* People with strong SMB or startup connections
* Individuals who regularly interact with business owners and decision-makers

You don't need to be a developer.Your primary responsibility is to identify opportunities and bring the right clients to us. Our technical team handles the rest.

What Makes a Good Lead?

We are particularly interested in businesses that need:

* Custom software
* Web or mobile applications
* Internal business tools
* Business process automation
* CRM or workflow systems
* API and system integrations
* Data dashboards and reporting
* Cloud infrastructure and DevOps
* Legacy software modernization
* MVP development

Minimum project value: USD 300.

We are looking for qualified business opportunities, not just contact lists. The stronger the lead and the more involved you are in helping close the project, the stronger the commission opportunity.

Bring the opportunity. We build the technology. You earn from the deal.

jobs.title: Handwritten Notes to Word
jobs.description:

jobs.title: Data engineering Aws Plus Azure Data Factory Integration Project
jobs.description:

Your task covers designing the overall pipeline logic, setting up linked services, crafting parameter-driven datasets, and implementing any necessary transformations in mapping data flows. Monitoring, alerting, and basic cost-control settings should be baked in from the start so the solution is production-ready.

Because experience is crucial here, please draw on previous ADF projects you have delivered—think specifics such as incremental loads, schema drift handling, or CI/CD deployment through Git integration.

Deliverables I expect:  
• End-to-end Azure Data Factory pipelines with reusable parameterization

We will agree on milestones for design sign-off, build, and final acceptance once we start. Looking forward to seeing how your ADF expertise can bring this integration together smoothly.

jobs.title: Illustrative Animal Nature Logo Design

jobs.title: Action Scene VFX Paint Compositing
jobs.description:

The plates already carry basic grading; the remaining work centres on removing stunt rigs, patching set imperfections, fixing stray reflections and restoring continuity where practical effects fell short. Every shot will be delivered to you as 16-bit EXR files with embedded mattes, and I’ll expect clean plates (or merged comps) returned in the same resolution ready for the final online conform.

You may work in Nuke, Silhouette, Mocha Pro, Flame, or an equivalent paint-capable package—whatever keeps the grain structure intact and avoids colour shifts. I review at 4 K on calibrated monitors, so repairs must hold up under scrutiny and blend seamlessly into surrounding frames.

Please attach a detailed project proposal outlining:
• Your approach to the paint workflow, including preferred software.
• Turnaround schedule per shot and how you manage versioning.
• Examples or links to previous action-oriented paint or rig-removal work (if publicly shareable).

Acceptance criteria:
• No detectable artefacts at 100 % zoom and full-speed playback.
• Match move or grain rebuild exactly where original texture is lost.
• Consistent file naming and A/B versions for easy DI comparison.

Once your proposal is approved, I’ll supply the first batch of plates along with a shot spreadsheet so we can agree on milestones and deliveries.

jobs.title: Wooden House Scale Model
jobs.description:

Accuracy matters: walls, windows, doors, roof structure, staircases, and room divisions must follow the approved drawings exactly, and interior elements should be viewable by lifting a roof panel or through another clever cut-away solution. Subtle finishes such as façade textures, trim, and scaled furnishings are encouraged so the model tells the complete story of the space.  

Deliverables

jobs.title: 24/7 US Visa Slot Monitor
jobs.description:
I need a web-based application that watches www.usvisascheduling.com around the clock through a residential proxy and immediately alerts me when fresh appointment dates appear. The system must track several visa categories in parallel, scrape the available dates in real time, and write every result to a rolling CSV log so I can run later analysis.  

Inside the admin panel (protected by a straightforward username-and-password login) I want to:  
• choose the exact date and time window I care about,  
• set the polling to fire at randomised intervals to stay under anti-bot radar, and  
• define a custom delay before the tool forwards notifications to my Telegram channel.  

While the app is running it should both pop a loud on-screen alarm and dispatch the Telegram message the moment an open slot is detected.  

Acceptance criteria  
1. Web dashboard loads in any modern browser and shows live status of each monitored visa category.  
2. All scrape events are logged to a timestamped CSV file stored server-side and downloadable from the dashboard.  
3. Admin can add, edit, pause, or delete visa categories without restarting the service.  
4. Alarm sound and Telegram push both trigger reliably within the user-defined delay.  
5. Traffic is routed exclusively through the configured residential proxy; if the proxy fails the app stops polling and records the error.  

Suggested stack (open to alternatives): Python + Playwright/Selenium for scraping, Django/Flask for the UI, Celery or native async tasks for randomised scheduling, Telegram Bot API for messaging, Docker for deployment.  

Deliverables  
• Source code with setup instructions  
• Dockerfile or deployment script  
• Brief README covering proxy configuration, admin credentials setup, and environment variables for Telegram keys  
• One-week post-delivery support for bug fixes

jobs.title: 80% Schematic to Industrial-Grade final Electronic System
jobs.description:
******Milestone-Based Contract ******

—-Total project budget is 40- 60 USDs best offer within this budget wins—-

IMPORTANT: NO PLACEHOLDER BIDS. Generic automated proposals will be immediately declined and reported. To prove you have read and comprehended the complete engineering scope, your proposal MUST start with the exact phrase: HARDWARE-EXPERT --- PROJECT CONTEXT --- We are developing, an industrial-grade, 4-layer ESP32-S3 electronic system designed for continuous 24/7 outdoor operation (-10°C to +65°C ambient, up to 95% RH). NOTE: The schematic architecture and initial KiCad layout already exist (~80% complete). This project is strictly for schematic audit, protection/sensor circuit integration, PDN electrical simulation, 4-layer PCB optimization, 3D CFD thermal validation, and generation of a zero-error production release package. --- SCOPE OF WORK & DELIVERABLES --- ■ Milestone 1: Schematic Audit, Protection Sub-circuits & Electrical/PDN Simulation ($20) 1. Schematic Audit & Component Engineering: • Complete audit of existing KiCad schematic for signal integrity, power stability, and component lifecycle (active MPNs only on DigiKey/Mouser/LCSC; no NRND/EOL). • Power Architecture: Optimize power sequencing across e-Fuse, dual buck converters (12V to 5V & 3.3V), and LDOs to eliminate ESP32 back-powering. 2. Peripheral & Circuit Integration: • Audio Subsystem: Integrate WM8960 audio codec (2x Class-D BTL speaker outputs + 2x differential analog MIC connectors). Resolve ESP32-S3 GPIO mapping conflicts with bootstrapping/flash pins. • Protected JST Connectors: - 1x Illuminated ON/OFF Switch (N-Channel low-side MOSFET + RC debounce + TVS). - 4x Dry-Contact Sensor ports (2-Pin JST with 10k/100nF RC debounce + bidirectional TVS). - 2x Active Sensor ports (3-Pin JST with PTC Polyfuse + 100nF decoupling + TVS). 3. Electrical & PDN Simulation: • Perform transient load, startup analysis, and Power Delivery Network (PDN) impedance optimization using Siemens HyperLynx or LTspice. • Establish Galvanic Isolation strategy and Creepage/Clearance design rules. • M1 Deliverables: Native editable KiCad schematic files, custom libraries, clean ERC Report (0 critical errors), structured BOM with active MPNs, native simulation profiles (.hyp / .asc) with waveform reports, and Isolation Design Note. ■ Milestone 2: 4-Layer PCB Layout, 3D Thermal Simulation & Manufacturing Release Package ($40) 1. 4-Layer PCB Layout Optimization: • 4-layer stackup routing in native KiCad with strict galvanic isolation between AC/DC high-power and low-voltage RF/ESP32 logic. • Audio integrity: Solid continuous ground plane with strict spatial isolation (or dedicated AGND/DGND single star tie) for zero WM8960 noise. • ICT test points on critical rails/signals and auto-reset UART/USB programming interface. 2. 3D Thermal CFD Simulation & Reliability Analysis: • Full 3D Thermal CFD Simulation (ANSYS Icepak or Siemens Simcenter Flotherm) under continuous 24/7 full-load at -10°C to +65°C ambient. • Hotspot mitigation (thermal vias, copper pours, heatsinks). • Formal Component Derating & Arrhenius-based Lifetime Report validating 5+ years 24/7 operational lifespan. 3. Complete Manufacturing Release Package: • Complete Gerber Files (RS-274X/X2), NC Drill, ODB++/IPC-2581 dataset, IPC-D-356 Netlist, and Centroid (Pick & Place) files. • Assembly Drawings, Fabrication Notes (ENIG, IPC Class 2/3), Solder Paste Stencils, and final Production BOM (including 2x IPEX antennas). • Clean DRC Report with ZERO errors. • 3D STEP mechanical model of the fully populated PCBA. • Native thermal CFD project files, high-res simulation video demo, and PDF Thermal Report. • GPIO Mapping Sheet, Bring-up checklist, and Signed Manufacturing Release Checklist. • SI & Impedance Report: HyperLynx SI verification for differential pairs (90Ω USB, 100Ω RS485/HUB75, 50Ω RF). • Panelization & Documentation: Panelized Gerbers (fiducials/mouse-bites), Design Calculations PDF (TVS/fuse sizing, trace ampacity), and Bring-up / Flashing guide. • Design Revision Log & DRC: Formal KiCad revision log and exported HyperLynx DRC / KiCad DRC reports (0 errors). --- COMPLIANCE, IP & NDA --- • Full IP ownership and all native editable source files (KiCad, HyperLynx/LTspice, Icepak, STEP) transfer to the client upon milestone payment. • Formal NDA and standard Design-for-Compliance (DFC) quality warranty apply. Please submit your proposal with examples of past KiCad schematics, multi-layer layouts, and ANSYS/Flotherm thermal simulation reports.

jobs.title: Draft AAA Case Removal Notice

• Provide the final document in both editable Word format and a clean PDF, formatted to AAA standards and ready to submit without additional edits.

Acceptance criteria:
1. The jurisdictional argument is supported by specific contract language, quoted accurately.  
2. All required case identifiers, party information, and certificate of service sections are present.  
3. Tone is professional, concise, and free of legalese that a pro se filer might misstate.  
4. Delivery within two days of receiving the contract excerpts.

If you have experience drafting arbitration filings or similar jurisdictional motions, I look forward to working with you.

jobs.title: Need Indore Contract Dispute Lawyer
jobs.description:
I have just been served a civil summons in Indore, Madhya Pradesh for a contract-related dispute. The matter is only at the “notice received” stage, so nothing substantive has been filed yet. jobs.title: Hero/Villain Fashion Launch Models
jobs.description:
I’m gearing up to unveil my new designer clothing and accessories line and I need two confident faces to bring the launch campaign to life—one female model and one male model. The creative direction is “hero versus villain”: dramatic poses, bold attitude, luxurious backdrops. Think sleek sports car and a modern house that underline the power you feel wearing our pieces.

The shoot will happen entirely on location. We’ll capture both high-impact stills and dynamic video footage in the same session, so you’ll need to be comfortable switching quickly between photo and video work. Wardrobe, styling and refreshments are covered; you simply bring your energy, versatility and professional attitude.

Because this is a bootstrapped start-up, I’m looking for your most competitive half- or full-day rate. Please include:
• Your minimum rate and whether it covers both photo and video work  
• A link to your portfolio or show-reel that demonstrates strong character roles or luxury fashion vibes  
• Any scheduling constraints over the next four weeks

Deliverables I expect from the production team are:
• A minimum of 10 retouched high-resolution stills per model  
• A short, edited hero video (30–60 seconds) showcasing both models  

If you’re ready to play hero, villain (or a bit of both) and help set the tone for an ambitious new label, I’d love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Precise PDF-to-Word Conversion
jobs.description:
I have one—or perhaps a small batch—of PDF files made up chiefly of text and paragraphs arranged in standard headings and body copy. All fonts are the usual system faces, so font substitution should not be an issue, but I do want each page in Word to echo the source layout as closely as possible.

Here is what I need from you:

• Convert every page into live, selectable Word text, preserving headings, paragraphs, line breaks, page breaks and any existing styles.  
• Keep images anchored in their correct positions and leave them fully movable/editable.  
• Recreate any tables as genuine Word tables rather than static pictures.  
• Proof-read the result and correct obvious OCR slips so the document reads cleanly.  
• Let me know up front if you spot scanned pages, watermarks, unusual glyphs or anything else that might compromise accuracy.

The final deliverable is a neatly formatted .docx file (one per source PDF) that I can open in Microsoft Word and edit without restrictions. Accuracy and faithful layout reproduction matter more to me than turnaround time, so take the care you need to get it right.

jobs.title: Shopify UX Optimization Specialist
jobs.description:

Key Responsibilities
1. Shopify Store Development & Redesign
Set up and configure new Shopify stores based on business requirements.
Redesign and enhance existing Shopify stores to improve functionality and user experience.
Configure Shopify themes, navigation, pages, menus, checkout settings, and store features.

3. Custom Apps & Integrations
Develop or implement custom Shopify apps and functionalities.
Integrate Shopify with third-party applications and external business systems.
Work with APIs and webhooks to enable data exchange between Shopify and other platforms.
Troubleshoot and maintain existing integrations.

Set up and configure products, variants, collections, pricing, images, descriptions, and inventory-related information.
Configure custom product options, subscriptions, gift cards, and related Shopify functionalities.
Ensure product and collection structures are optimized for customer navigation and discoverability.
5. Troubleshooting & Support
Identify and resolve Shopify store errors, functional issues, integration failures, and performance problems.
Investigate issues across themes, apps, APIs, and third-party integrations.
Provide ongoing technical support and maintenance.
Conduct root-cause analysis for recurring technical issues.
6. Website Audit & Optimization
Conduct Shopify website audits covering functionality, performance, UX, SEO, and technical configuration.
Identify opportunities to improve site speed, conversion, usability, and overall customer experience.

Experience with Shopify themes and custom theme development.
Experience developing or integrating Shopify apps and APIs.
Knowledge of REST APIs, webhooks, and third-party system integrations.
Experience with Shopify product, collection, and catalog management.
Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
Understanding of e-commerce UX, website performance, and conversion optimization.
Experience with responsive web design and cross-browser compatibility.
Familiarity with Git/version control and software development practices.

Experience with Shopify Plus.
Experience with headless commerce or modern e-commerce architectures.
Knowledge of SEO and e-commerce analytics.
Experience integrating payment gateways, ERP, CRM, OMS, PIM, or other enterprise platforms.
Understanding of web performance optimization and Core Web Vitals.

jobs.title: Demo teaching plateform  -- 2
jobs.description:

Project Overview:
I want to build a comprehensive EdTech platform (Admin Panel + Student App/Web) focused all subjects. The core USP of this platform is AI integration for automated test generation and personalized student performance analysis.
1. Admin Panel Features:
Live Class Broadcasting: Integration of a reliable and low-cost live streaming SDK (like Agora or 100ms) for conducting live interactive classes.
Content Management: Upload and manage recorded videos, study materials, and PDFs.
AI Test Generator: An interface where I upload a text file or PDF, and the system uses an LLM API (Google Gemini 1.5 Flash or OpenAI GPT-4o-mini) to automatically parse the content and generate a complete Test Series (MCQs with options and correct answers).
Dashboard: Overview of student enrollment, active users, and global performance metrics.
2. Student App Features:
Authentication: Secure login/signup.
Live & Recorded Classes: Video player to watch live streams and access VOD (Video on Demand).
Study Material Section: Access to attached PDFs and notes.
Test Portal: Interface to attempt the AI-generated test series.
3. AI Student Analysis & Reporting:
After a student submits a test, the app must send their answers to the AI API.
The AI should analyze the results and generate a "Personalized Summary Report".
The report must specify exactly which chapter and which specific topic the student is weak in, based on the questions they answered incorrectly.
4. Recommended Tech Stack (for Low Cost & High Scalability):
Frontend: Flutter or React Native (for a single codebase for Android & iOS).
Backend: Node.js with Express OR Firebase/Supabase (for rapid, low-cost backend development).
Database: PostgreSQL or MongoDB.
AI Integration: Google Gemini API (preferred for large PDF contexts) or OpenAI API.
Video Streaming: Agora.io or 100ms

jobs.title: YouTube SaaS App & Admin
jobs.description:
I’m developing a YouTube–style SaaS product and now need the core software built: a cross-platform mobile application (iOS + Android) together with a lightweight web-based admin dashboard. 

Mobile side  
• The app must let creators upload videos from their device, attach basic metadata, and manage their existing uploads (edit titles, descriptions, thumbnails, set privacy, delete).  
• Secure user authentication is essential; feel free to use Firebase Auth, AWS Cognito, or a similarly robust solution, but it has to support email + password and social log-ins from day one.  
• Playback and recommended-feed logic already exist in our back-end API, so the focus here is on the upload/management flows and clean UI in either React Native or Flutter—whichever you’re fastest with.

Web admin panel  
A simple browser-based console is required for user management only: list users, search/filter, view account details, suspend/activate, and reset passwords. It can sit on top of the same back-end; Laravel, Node, or Django are all acceptable as long as you provide clear setup docs.

Deliverables  
1. Source code for the mobile app (iOS & Android build-ready)  
2. Source code for the web admin dashboard  
3. Environment/configuration files and a short README to get both running locally  
4. One hand-off call or screen-share to walk through deployment

Acceptance criteria  
• App uploads a video ≤1 GB over wi-fi without crashing.  
• Login/logout round-trip <2 seconds on average 4G.  
• Admin can disable a user and the change reflects instantly on mobile refresh.  

If something above is unclear, please ask—happy to refine the scope so you can quote accurately and deliver with confidence.

jobs.title: UK Letter Engagement Negotiator
jobs.description:

Here’s how I see the collaboration working: I supply my base template and the commercial details, you review it quickly, jump on calls or exchange emails with the client’s representative, and drive the discussion until we have clear, balanced terms that protect my position without jeopardising the relationship. Typical pressure points are scope creep, payment milestones, liability caps, confidentiality and IP. I expect a quick summary after each round so I can follow the changes without wading through mark-ups.

To keep things moving, a two-to-three-business-day turnaround on comments is ideal. Solid experience in UK contract law plus a confident, pragmatic negotiation style with SMEs is essential.  

Deliverables for every engagement:  
• Finalised, signed Letter of Engagement  
• Redline or change log showing agreed amendments  
• Brief rationale explaining key concessions or wins  

If this sounds like a good fit, let me know your credentials and how you typically charge for ongoing work of this nature.
