jobs.title: Creative Marketing & Social Media Specialist
jobs.description:
We are looking for a creative marketing specialist to help us market and grow BodyPower 2026, a major health, fitness and metabolic-health event taking place in London.

We are not looking for someone whose marketing strategy is simply:

“Post regularly and spend more money on ads.”

We want someone who thinks creatively about how to capture attention, generate organic reach, communicate strong messages and ultimately drive interest and ticket sales.

You should naturally look at a speaker, topic, trend, news story or audience problem and think:

“How can we turn this into an interesting marketing opportunity?”

What You Will Help With
Creative Marketing

We want you to continuously generate ideas for:

organic marketing campaigns
speaker promotions
workshops
event awareness
ticket campaigns
social-media series
collaborations
community engagement
storytelling
reactive/trending content
PR-style opportunities
creative promotional concepts

We particularly value people who proactively bring ideas rather than waiting for instructions.

Social Media

You will help plan and manage the creative direction of our social-media activity.

We already have an in-house team member who can coordinate publishing and account access, so direct access to every social-media account may not be required.

Your role will focus heavily on:

content ideas
content calendars
campaign concepts
hooks
captions
reels
stories
engagement
analysing performance
improving future content
Graphic Design

You should be able to create professional social-media graphics.

We specifically do not want generic AI-looking creatives.

We are looking for:

strong typography
good visual hierarchy
professional layouts
brand consistency
intelligent use of photography
premium-looking event creatives
graphics designed around an actual marketing idea

AI can be used as a tool, but the finished result should still look professionally designed.

Video Editing

You should be comfortable producing/editing short-form video content.

You do not need to be a high-end cinematic editor.

What matters most is whether you understand:

the hook, idea and message.

Content may include:

Instagram Reels
speaker clips
talking-head videos
promotional edits
event footage
subtitles
simple motion graphics
storytelling videos
Advertising

You should understand Meta and digital advertising.

However, paid campaigns must be strategically planned, not simply random social posts boosted with money.

We want someone who understands:

customer psychology
audience segmentation
hooks
objections
motivations
creative testing
retargeting
conversion
campaign structure

Advertising should start with understanding why someone would care, before deciding what ad to run.

Copywriting

You should also be comfortable writing persuasive and clear copy for:

websites
landing pages
forms
social media
ads
emails
brochures
documents
event promotions
speaker promotions

You must be able to take complicated information and make it simple, interesting and persuasive.

What Matters Most

The most important requirement is creative thinking.

We want somebody who brings ideas.

Someone who understands human behaviour and attention.

Someone who thinks beyond standard social-media templates.

Someone who actively looks for ways to generate organic attention before relying on paid media.

When Applying

Please send examples of:

social-media campaigns you have worked on
graphics you personally designed
short-form videos you edited
copy you have written
paid campaigns you have managed
organic marketing ideas/campaigns that performed well

Also answer this question:

Creative Test

Imagine you are marketing a health and fitness conference featuring expert speakers, workshops and hundreds of attendees.

Give us 5 organic marketing ideas you would try before asking us to increase the advertising budget.

The quality of your ideas will be one of the most important parts of your application.

​Attività 3 (Shop e Gameplay): Sviluppo dell'equipaggiamento di sopravvivenza, delle armi speciali e del minigioco del laboratorio alchemico.
​Attività 4 (Coinvolgimento e Fidelizzazione): Creazione di 4 tabelloni con classifiche in tempo reale, sondaggi interattivi e script di tracciamento dei giorni di accesso consecutivi (da 3 a 60 giorni).
​Modalità di Coordinamento e Comunicazione Operativa
​Per garantire la massima rapidità nello scambio di file di codice, materiali pesanti e aggiornamenti in tempo reale, la gestione operativa avverrà tramite canali di messaggistica istantanea esterni.
​Nota per i candidati: All'interno delle vostre proposte, dei vostri profili o dei portfolio personali, inserite un riferimento, un collegamento o un contatto diretto (come il link al vostro sito o a una chat professionale) in modo da poter spostare immediatamente la conversazione su un canale privato ed efficiente fin dal primo messaggio.
​Struttura della Collaborazione
​Fase Iniziale: Partenza con un budget iniziale strutturato per la prima fase, con ampi margini di crescita basati su una partnership a lungo termine.
​Requisito fondamentale: Consegna di un prodotto sicuro al 100%, testato, con tutti gli ID finanziari e i ricavi indirizzati direttamente al conto del proprietario. Si richiede massima serietà e velocità.

jobs.title: Licensed GC for Independence TI
jobs.description:
This commercial tenant-improvement project (approx. 1,000–5,000 sq ft) in Independence, Missouri, is already fully designed and will be built by separate trades. You will:

• Liaise with the city during plan review, address any comments, and schedule required inspections.  
• Provide periodic site visits to confirm code compliance and document progress for the permit record.

No on-site labor, material purchasing, or crew management is expected—just professional permitting and compliance oversight.

Please confirm that both licenses are current in Independence and outline your typical turnaround for permit submittal and inspection coordination.

jobs.title: Paid Ads Specialist Needed
jobs.description:
I need a hands-on specialist who can take full ownership of our Facebook, Instagram and Google Ads accounts, refine every element of the funnel and turn ad spend into booked revenue for our service-based business.  

Day to day you will build and iterate campaigns, write hooks that speak to our audience, test creative variations, tighten targeting and, most importantly, keep cost-per-click on a downward trend while scaling volume. I’m expecting someone who can log in, spot inefficiencies, split-test solutions and explain their thinking to me in clear English during my working hours so we can move fast together.

Direct collaboration matters here—please apply only if you are an individual freelancer, fluent in English, and available to sync in my timezone for quick strategy chats and live performance reviews.

Deliverables I’ll review each week:  
• Updated campaign structure with documented optimisations  
• CPC, CPA and ROAS reports pulled from Ads Manager and Google Ads  
• A concise action plan for the coming week based on data insights  

If you can combine creative flair with a revenue mindset and prove it with real numbers, let’s get started.

jobs.title: Accurate Handwritten Notes Transcription
jobs.description:
I have a collection of single-page handwritten notes that I need typed into a clean, editable Microsoft Word document. The writing is generally clear but you may have to slow down in spots where it becomes harder to decipher, so solid attention to detail and strong English spelling skills are essential.

You’ll receive high-resolution scans of each page. I would like the finished document to follow the original line order and paragraph breaks so it mirrors the source pages for easy cross-checking later. Simple headings, bullet points, and any underlining should be replicated with basic Word formatting—no fancy design work required, just an accurate, well-structured transcription.

Deliverable:
• One Word file (.docx) containing the full, proof-read transcription, laid out in the same sequence as the supplied scans.

Before handing over the final file, please double-check every page for typos or omissions; I need a clean version that’s ready to use without extra editing on my end.

If this sounds straightforward for you, let me know your estimated turnaround time and any clarifying questions.

jobs.title: WordPress Hotel Booking Website
jobs.description:
My hotel needs a fresh WordPress site that lets guests find a room, book it, and pay without ever leaving the page. The core of the project is a booking system, so the design must revolve around a clear availability calendar, secure online payment flow, and a public area where recent guests can leave ratings and comments.  

You are free to recommend the best-fit WordPress theme or build a custom child theme if that speeds things up, but the final result has to be easy for my staff to update—rates, room photos, seasonal offers, and policy text should all be editable from the WordPress admin panel.  

Key deliverables  
• Responsive WordPress site styled for a single-property hotel  
• Booking engine configured with:  
  – Real-time room availability calendar  
  – Integrated payment gateway of my choice (Stripe or PayPal preferred)  
  – Front-end customer review and rating display  
• Optimised page load speed and basic on-page SEO setup  
• One-hour hand-over call or video recording showing how to add rooms, change prices, and refund a booking if needed  

Acceptance criteria  
1. Test booking shows on the calendar instantly and triggers confirmation emails.  
2. Payment completes without console errors in both desktop and mobile browsers.  
3. A guest review submitted from the front end appears after manual approval.  

Please outline the plugins or custom code you intend to use, a rough timeline, and any past hotel or accommodation sites you have launched.

jobs.title: Simple Cross-Platform Mobile App
jobs.description:
I want to turn a straightforward mobile app concept into a fully functioning cross-platform application for both iOS and Android. The full feature set is ready to share once we agree on the collaboration, but the scope is compact and clear-cut.

You may use either Flutter or React Native—whichever you feel will serve performance, maintainability, and future scaling best. I’m happy to hear your reasoning on the framework choice.

What I need from you
• End-to-end development: coding, UI implementation from my wireframes, and integration of the modest feature set.  
• Thorough testing and debugging so the build runs smoothly on current iOS and Android versions.  
• App Store and Google Play submission, including help with certificates, assets, and compliance questions until the app is live.

Proposal instructions
Start your message with the word “AI” so I know you read this. Then briefly outline your experience on similar mobile projects and link to a few live apps you have shipped (store links preferred). I’m especially interested in your track record with App Store/Play Store publishing and any insights on avoiding common approval pitfalls.

Once we connect, I’ll provide the full spec, UI assets, and acceptance criteria. Let’s build something clean, reliable, and ready for real users.

jobs.title: Magento Digital Products Store
jobs.description:
I need a full-featured Magento site that lets me sell downloadable products—mainly PDF guides and short video courses—without any physical-goods functionality cluttering the catalog. The essential flow is simple: shopper browses, pays, and receives an instant, secure download link.  

Core requirements  
• Clean, responsive theme installed and lightly branded with my logo and colors  
• Product types set to “downloadable” with file upload, versioning, and license-key fields enabled  
• Stripe and PayPal payment gateways configured and tested in sandbox and live modes  
• Automatic e-mail with expiring download links after successful purchase  
• Tax set to “digital goods” rules (EU VAT compliant) and location-based currency switcher  
• Basic SEO setup—XML sitemap, friendly URLs, meta tags, and Google Analytics 4 connected  
• Admin tutorial (video or annotated screenshots) showing how I can add new digital files, update prices, and view sales reports  

Acceptance criteria  
1. A fresh Magento install on my VPS or preferred managed host, secured with HTTPS and reCAPTCHA v3.  
2. At least one sample product proving the full checkout-to-download process works end-to-end.  
3. PageSpeed Insights desktop score 90+.  
4. Delivery within the agreed timeline with all source files, credentials, and a short handover call.

jobs.title: Experienced Social Media Advertising Specialist Needed
jobs.description:
I need I am looking for a highly skilled Social Media Advertising and Marketing Specialist who has a proven ability to generate qualified leads across multiple social media platforms, including Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, and other relevant channels.

The right candidate must be able to:

Create and manage lead-generation campaigns across multiple platforms.
Identify and target the right audiences.
Develop compelling ad concepts, offers, copy, and creative strategies.
Build or recommend effective funnels and landing pages.
Track CPL, conversions, ROAS, and other important performance metrics.
Test and optimize campaigns to continuously improve results.
Demonstrate real examples of previous campaigns and results.
REQUIRED ZOOM PRESENTATION

If you believe you have the experience and skills to consistently generate qualified leads, apply with examples of your previous work and be prepared to present your strategy during a Zoom meeting.

jobs.title: WordPress Theme Migration Expert - Blocksy Theme

The project involves transferring approximately 400 blog entries and around 100 porfolio entries. Pages needs to be re-designed following a FIGMA layout. Ensuring all pages are preserved and functional post-migration. An autotranslation plugin for 3 languages has to be added. The website has to be fully speed and SEO optimized. Responsive behaviour has to be tested across browsers and devices. Attention to detail (link structure, SEO, slugs) and the ability to troubleshoot potential issues during the process are essential. jobs.title: Sci-Fi Novel Style Review
jobs.description:
I’m ready to share my completed science-fiction manuscript and would like a professional critique that zeroes in on how the writing itself comes across, with special attention to the way the characters speak. Please approach the job less as a beta reader and more as a stylistic analyst: I’m not looking for plot notes or a scene-by-scene breakdown, but rather a clear, actionable assessment of tone, rhythm, and overall readability, anchored by an in-depth look at the dialogue.

You’ll receive the full draft (about 80k words) in Word format. After reading, I’d appreciate a concise report that:  

• Highlights strengths and weak spots in my prose, focusing on dialogue authenticity, flow, and consistency  
• Points out any jargon or futuristic terminology that feels forced or unclear  
• Suggests line-level tweaks or illustrative rewrites where necessary (a handful of concrete examples is fine—I don’t need every line marked up)  
• Summarises the overall narrative voice and its suitability for the intended audience  

Please deliver a standalone critique document (PDF or Word) at roughly 4-6 pages. Inline comments inside the manuscript are optional; if you prefer leaving tracked changes for illustrative examples, that’s welcome.

Turnaround within two weeks is ideal, but let me know if you need a little longer. Confidentiality is a must. If this sounds like your wheelhouse, let’s talk.

jobs.title: E-Commerce Website Development

jobs.title: Productivity Business App UI/UX
jobs.description:

Here’s the landscape you will be designing for: the core workflows revolve around task scheduling, progress tracking, and quick data entry. Every screen should feel lean, intuitive, and immediately actionable so users can shave minutes—not add them—while they work.

Deliverables I expect  
• Low-fidelity wireframes that map the full user journey  
• High-fidelity mock-ups in Figma (or a comparable tool) for Android and web breakpoints  
• Interactive prototypes good enough for stakeholder walkthroughs and basic usability testing  
• A mini design system: colors, typography, iconography, component states, and reusable patterns  

Acceptance criteria  
• Layouts follow modern Material guidelines on Android and translate seamlessly to web  
• Key actions sit no more than two taps/clicks from entry points  
• All typography passes WCAG AA contrast on both light and dark modes  
• Final assets are organized, named clearly, and handed off in an editable format  

If the experience shines on these two platforms, I may extend the work to an iOS version later. Let’s create an interface that actually saves people time.

jobs.title: Sourcing Agent Required for High-Tech Manufacturers

jobs.title: Advanced Photoshop Image Manipulation

jobs.title: Meta Ads Lead Generation Manager

What I need from you:

• Creatives and copy that speak directly to each segment (I can supply raw assets; you handle the editing and ad copy)
• Continuous A/B testing of headlines, images/video, and calls-to-action
• Conversion tracking verified inside Events Manager so we can optimise for cost-per-lead, not just clicks

Acceptance criteria:

Let’s talk strategy and timelines so we can launch as soon as possible.

jobs.title: CA Exam Financial Accounting Notes
jobs.description:
I’m gearing up for my upcoming Chartered Accountancy exams and want concise, exam-oriented summary notes that focus exclusively on Financial Accounting. The goal is to condense the vast syllabus into clear, well-structured material I can revise quickly in the last few weeks before the paper.

What I need from you  
• A complete set of summary notes covering the full Financial Accounting syllabus prescribed for the CA course, organised by topic in logical exam order.  
• Each section should include key concepts, important standards, common journal entries, formulas, and quick tips for typical exam questions.  
• Bullet-point format wherever possible so I can scan and memorise faster, with short worked examples for complex areas.  
• A final revision sheet (one-pager) highlighting must-remember points and frequently tested adjustments.  
• PDF delivery, plus the original editable file (Word or Google Docs) for my own annotations.

Acceptance criteria  
1. Content matches the latest CA exam syllabus and terminology.  
2. No paragraph exceeds six lines; information is broken into digestible chunks.  
3. All calculations are accurate and demonstrate the correct treatment of standards.  
4. File is delivered error-free and ready for printing.

I currently only need Financial Accounting, but if this collaboration goes smoothly there may be scope to create similar notes for Taxation or Auditing later. Let me know your approach, timeline, and a brief sample outline so I can see your style before we start.

jobs.title: Experienced Wikipedia Editor Needed – AfC / BLP / Musician Biography
jobs.description:
I am looking for an experienced Wikipedia editor with proven experience in Articles for Creation (AfC), biographies of living persons (BLP), and Wikipedia sourcing policies to review and improve an existing draft about a professional classical musician.

The draft has already been submitted to AfC. The latest reviewer indicated that notability itself is not the main concern, but that the article needs significantly better referencing and independent reliable sources. A previous review also raised concerns regarding close paraphrasing/copyright.

I am a family member of the subject and am commissioning this work independently. I therefore need an editor who understands Wikipedia’s COI and paid-contribution disclosure requirements and will handle the project transparently and according to Wikipedia policy.

What I need

* Review the existing draft and all previous AfC reviewer comments
* Evaluate the existing references according to WP:RS, WP:BLP, WP:PRIMARY and related policies
* Research and find additional reliable, independent secondary sources
* Remove or modify information that cannot be properly supported
* Resolve any remaining close-paraphrasing/copyright issues
* Rewrite where necessary in a neutral, encyclopedic style
* Correct citations, structure and Wikipedia formatting
* Assess whether the draft is genuinely ready for another AfC submission
* Prepare it for resubmission if appropriate
* Comply with Wikipedia’s COI and paid-editing disclosure requirements

I am not looking for a general content writer or proofreader and I am not looking for promotional writing.

I also do not expect or want a guarantee of publication. The goal is to bring the draft into compliance with Wikipedia policies so that it can be independently evaluated through AfC.

Please include in your proposal

1. Links to 2–3 Wikipedia articles or AfC drafts you have personally worked on
2. Your Wikipedia username, if possible
3. Your experience with BLP and AfC
4. Confirmation that you follow Wikipedia’s paid-contribution and COI disclosure requirements
5. After looking at the draft and reviewer comments, 2–3 sentences explaining what you believe the main problems are and how you would approach them

Please only apply if you have genuine, verifiable Wikipedia editing experience.

Draft:
https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Draft:Mario_Bruno_(flutist)

jobs.title: AI Image Logo Design

jobs.title: Optimize MS365 Power Automate Workflow

The goal is a set of Power Automate flows that capture data as soon as it is entered (or updated) in Excel, push or pull the corresponding fields in Word templates, then store and version them in the correct SharePoint libraries—no duplicate typing, no missed updates. Security trimming and existing permissions inside the SharePoint site must stay intact. 

Please design, build and test the flows, document how each one works, and provide a short walkthrough so my team can maintain or extend them later. If there are connector limits or licensing considerations that affect the approach, flag them up front so we can make decisions early.

Acceptance criteria:  
• Optimized workflow eliminating inefficiencies and speeding up processes within minutes.  
• Successful integration of additional apps/features into the workflow.  
• Word documents generated or edited by the flow land in the right SharePoint folder with correct metadata.  
• A log in SharePoint or Power Automate clearly shows when each flow runs and whether it succeeded.

I’m ready to give you access to a sandbox site collection and sample files as soon as we agree on the plan.

jobs.title: Civil Engineering DTM/TIN Model Creation

Our process involves taking engineered 2D CAD/DWG files and engineered grading plan sets and using the elevations shown on the plans to elevate the applicable 2D linework and create accurate 3D surfaces.

The completed models are used by contractors in the field with GPS and automated machine-control equipment, so accuracy is critical.

Requirements:

Strong Autodesk Civil 3D experience
Experience creating DTM/TIN surfaces
Ability to read and interpret engineered grading plans
Experience elevating 2D CAD linework into 3D
Knowledge of feature lines, breaklines, spot elevations, contours, slopes, curbs, and roadway grading
GPS/machine-control modeling experience is highly preferred

Please provide examples of similar Civil 3D DTM/TIN or grading models you have completed and indicate whether your models have been used for GPS/machine-control applications.

Qualified candidates may be asked to complete a technical test using a CAD/DWG file and corresponding engineered plan set.

jobs.title: Revit Architectural Plan Creation

Deliverables

Solid Revit experience—especially with families, view templates and sheet layout—is essential. Familiarity with Twinmotion for future visualisation is a plus, though not required for this stage. Please outline your approach and a rough hour estimate so we can map out the milestones together.

jobs.title: Seamless Lightroom Catalog Merge

I’m not sure whether any collections or smart collections need extra care, so I’ll lean on your guidance there.  

What I need from you  
1. A clear, step-by-step workflow for creating the new catalog, upgrading the old one if necessary, and performing the two imports so nothing is lost or duplicated.  
2. Tips on using the external drive for temporary transfers and any recommended folder structure changes to avoid broken links.  
3. Verification steps I can follow to confirm that all edits, keywords, and collection memberships made the jump.  
4. Advice on cleaning up any orphaned previews or backups once everything is consolidated.  

If screen-sharing support is part of your service, let me know; otherwise thorough written instructions are fine. I simply want to end up with a single, healthy Lightroom Classic catalog on my newer MacBook, with zero loss in image quality, edits, or organization.

jobs.title: Revista Automotriz Web

• Latency, accuracy, and capacity benchmarks I can use to evaluate the design.  
• Security and compliance considerations for streaming copyright material.  
• A concise written explanation (4–6 pages) that I can hand directly to my engineering team.

Acceptance criteria  
1. Diagram is clear enough to guide implementation without additional clarification.  
2. All tech choices include a brief justification and at least one fallback option.  
3. End-to-end recognition latency target is specified and realistically achievable.  
4. Document is delivered in an editable format (draw.io, Lucidchart, or similar) plus PDF.

The output feeds an academic project modelled on recent work in the economics of innovation that maps patenting to geography — see [attached paper / link], e.g. the commuting-zone patent maps in Figure 13. That's the kind of geocoded output I'm after.
What you'll build
Pull US patent records for a set of search terms and CPC classes I provide, from PatentsView, Google Patents (BigQuery), or USPTO bulk data — whichever you can justify.
For each patent: patent number, title, abstract, filing and grant dates, assignee(s), inventor(s), and inventor/assignee locations.
Clean and disambiguate assignee names (e.g. collapsing "Corning Inc" / "Corning Incorporated" / "CORNING INC." into one entity).
Geocode inventor and assignee locations to city-level lat/long, preserving the raw address components (city, state, country as separate fields) so locations can later be mapped to US commuting zones.
Deliver as CSV + Excel, plus the Python or R script so I can re-run and extend it.
Workflow
Start with a sample of a few hundred patents, fully processed end-to-end, so we confirm the pipeline is correct before scaling to the full corpus. I'd rather get the sample exactly right than receive a large, messy dataset.
To apply, tell me briefly:
Which patent data source you've used, and on what specific project.
How you'd geocode inventor addresses to city level, and how you'd handle missing or malformed location data.
How you'd approach assignee name disambiguation.
A link to a past data project counts for far more than a written description. Exposure to the geography of innovation or innovation economics is a strong plus but not essential — clean, reproducible data work is what matters most.

The dataset build needs to be completed between now and 25 September 2026.

Deep Research: Go beyond Wikipedia. Dig into news archives, government demographic reports, and historical context. (Ability to navigate/translate Japanese primary sources is a massive plus).

Narrative Pacing: Structure the raw facts into a compelling 3-Act arc: A powerful Hook, the Historical Context/Investigation, and a thought-provoking Climax/Conclusion.

Visual Cues: Include brief bracketed notes for the Video Editor (e.g., [Visual: Map showing rural depopulation turning red in 1990]).

What We Are Looking For:

Proven experience writing long-form, highly researched YouTube documentaries (True Crime, History, or Economics).

Mastery of suspense, pacing, and retention-driven storytelling.

Flawless English grammar and an engaging, mature tone.

Note: AI-generated scripts are strictly prohibited. I have a background in scientific research and will run thorough checks for hallucinations, lazy logic, and AI cadence.

Budget & Future Scope:

Pilot Episode Budget: $50 - $80 (Fixed Price)

Long-Term Potential: We have a locked 52-week editorial slate. If your pilot script is exceptional, this will turn into a long-term, weekly/bi-weekly ongoing contract.

Briefly explain your research process.

Link 1 or 2 of the BEST YouTube documentary videos you have successfully written (do not send unrelated blog posts or copywriting portfolios).

jobs.title: 8-24- Full Website Restoration & Migration

We are seeking an experienced **LAMP (Linux, Apache, MySQL, PHP)** and **CodeIgniter** developer to restore our website from existing backup files onto a new testing domain.

This project requires an experienced developer who understands complete website recovery, CodeIgniter applications, database migration, server configuration, and source code verification.

### Project Scope

* Complete website backup files
* Database backup(s)
* Application source code
* Project files
* A new hosting account with cPanel
* A new testing domain

The new hosting environment will be configured to closely match our production server, including the same PHP version and related server settings.

* Restore the entire website from our backup files.
* Restore all databases and verify data integrity.
* Configure the application so it operates correctly on the new testing domain.
* Update all domain references throughout the application, configuration files, and database where necessary.
* Update email configuration settings to use the new testing domain and email addresses while maintaining identical functionality.

* Identify and resolve any issues discovered during the restoration process.
* Confirm that the restored environment is a complete 1:1 working copy of our production system.
* Review the codebase for any hard-coded paths, URLs, email addresses, or server-specific configuration that must be updated for the new environment.
* Ensure appropriate file permissions and application security settings are correctly configured after restoration.

### Verification & Testing

As part of our acceptance process, we will ask you to demonstrate that the restored source code is fully accessible and editable.

Specifically, during the project we may request:

* Up to **20 source code file requests** for specific pages or features so we can make minor modifications and verify that the changes appear correctly on the restored site.
* Up to **10 database-related changes or updates** to confirm that database access and application functionality are fully operational.

Please include these tasks in your bid.

### Deliverables

At project completion, we expect:

* A fully functioning website on the new testing domain.
* Complete restoration of all files, databases, images, uploads, and application functionality.
* Verification that the restored site matches the production environment as closely as possible.

* Full access to all source code and project files.

### Required Technical Skills

### Proposal Requirements

* A brief summary of similar restoration or migration projects you have completed.
* Your years of experience with CodeIgniter and PHP.
* Whether you have experience restoring large production websites from backups.
* Your availability during the project.
* Confirmation that you can complete the project within the required timeline.

### Requirements

We will only consider freelancers who have:

* A rating of **4.9/5 or higher**.
* Extensive experience with LAMP, PHP, MySQL, and CodeIgniter.
* A strong history of successfully completed projects with excellent client feedback.
* Excellent written English communication.

### Timeline

### Important

This is a **mission-critical project**. We are looking for a senior developer who has successfully restored complex PHP/CodeIgniter applications before. Accuracy is far more important than speed.

If you have successfully completed similar website restoration or migration projects, please include relevant examples in your proposal.

Elegante.
Visualmente atractivo.
Se pueden utilizar speed ramps, zooms, whip transitions, match cuts, cortes por movimiento, motion blur, motion graphics y otros recursos, pero únicamente cuando tengan sentido.

No quiero un video saturado de efectos. Cada recurso debe ayudar al ritmo, la narrativa o la comprensión del contenido.

Música y sonido
Música instrumental moderna, energética y premium, preferiblemente con estilo electronic/cinematic commercial.

Debe permitir cortes sincronizados con el beat.

También quiero sound design profesional, aprovechando sonidos relacionados con las imágenes: hielo, shaker, vertido de líquidos, cocina, impactos, whooshes, risers, etc.

Por ejemplo, si aparece hielo entrando en un vaso, sería ideal que ese sonido forme parte de la edición.

Textos
Textos muy breves y elegantes, por ejemplo:

EXPERIENCIA
GASTRONOMÍA
COCTELERÍA
FORMACIÓN

Con motion graphics limpios y profesionales, respetando la identidad visual de Saberes y Sabores.

Material
Yo proporcionaré el material bruto disponible.

Es importante que el editor tenga criterio para revisar todo el material y seleccionar por iniciativa propia los planos que considere más potentes, no limitarse únicamente a utilizar los clips que yo indique.

Precisamente buscamos que el editor aporte criterio creativo en la selección de recursos.

Formato
Vertical 9:16
1080 × 1920
Duración aproximada: 30 segundos
Optimizado para Instagram Reels / Facebook Ads
Textos dentro de zonas seguras
Resultado que buscamos
La sensación que debe generar el video es:

0–3 s: “Esto llama mi atención.”
3–10 s: “¿Quién es Antonio?”
10–20 s: “Tiene mucha experiencia y realmente sabe de esto.”
20–26 s: “Yo también puedo aprender de él.”
26–30 s: “Quiero conocer el curso.”

Presupuesto y entrega
Presupuesto: US$25
Entrega: 1 día

Es una primera pieza/prueba. Si el resultado encaja con la línea creativa que buscamos, existe posibilidad de continuar trabajando en más piezas de contenido.

Busco especialmente a alguien que tenga buen criterio de edición y narrativa, no solamente conocimientos técnicos de Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve o similares.

jobs.title: Modern Chocolate Bar Wrapper Design

jobs.title: Meta Ads & Google Ads Specialist for D2C Mobile & Car Accessories Brand (Shopify)
jobs.description:
We are RIGGEAR (www.riggear.in), a mobile and automotive accessories brand based in Bengaluru. We have strong, proven sales volumes on marketplaces like Amazon & Flipkart, and we are now scaling our direct-to-consumer (D2C) Shopify website.

IMPORTANT: Start your proposal with the word "RIGGEAR_SHOPIFY" so I know you read the full details. Generic automated bids will be ignored.

We have an in-house Listing & Graphic Design team handling all product listing images, ad graphics, and visual assets. We need a hands-on Performance Marketer to handle media buying, campaign architecture, and tracking across BOTH Meta Ads & Google Ads.

OUR INITIAL AD SPEND BUDGET:
• Meta Ads (FB & IG): ₹1,000 – ₹2,000/day (for cold audience testing & remarketing).
• Google Ads: ₹500 – ₹1,000/day (starting lean with High-Intent Search & Performance Max / Shopping Ads).
• Total daily budget: ₹1,500 – ₹3,000/day, gradually scaling up as ROAS and order volumes meet unit-economics targets.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:
• Meta Ads: Set up, run, and optimize conversion campaigns (CBO/ABO/ASC).
• Google Ads: Set up high-intent Search campaigns (brand + product keywords) and Google Shopping / PMax campaigns optimized for high-margin products.
• Tracking Setup Audit: Verify Meta Conversions API (CAPI), Google Ads Conversion Tracking (with Enhanced Conversions), UTM structure, and GA4 attribution on Shopify.
• Creative Strategy: Brief our internal design team on top-performing visual formats, ad angles, and banners needed for Meta and Google Display/Discovery.

IDEAL FREELANCER:
• Proven track record running Meta & Google Ads for Indian D2C e-commerce brands (experience in consumer electronics, mobile accessories, or automotive gear is a big plus).
• Deep understanding of Indian e-commerce metrics: Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC), Return on Ad Spend (ROAS), Cash-on-Delivery (COD) %, and RTO (Return to Origin) reduction.

TO APPLY, PLEASE ANSWER THESE 3 QUESTIONS IN YOUR BID:
1. Share 1 or 2 screenshots/case studies of Indian D2C stores where you managed BOTH Meta & Google Ads (mention niche, monthly spend, CAC, and ROAS achieved).
2. How would you allocate and structure a low starting budget of ₹2,000–₹3,000/day total across Meta Ads and Google Ads without over-fragmenting spend?
3. What is your flat monthly retainer fee for managing both channels at our starting spend level?

jobs.title: Vývoj Interního AI Asistenta pro Pohoda ERP
jobs.description:
Interní AI asistent nad daty z Pohoda ERP (SQL Server)

Poptávám vývoj/dokončení interní webové aplikace, která umožní zaměstnancům firmy klást v přirozeném jazyce (čeština) dotazy nad daty z účetního systému Pohoda a dostávat odpovědi, reporty a exporty.

Technický kontext:

Data: Pohoda (Stormware) na MS SQL Server, read-only přístup (db_datareader)
Část dat (obchodní zástupce u faktur) dostupná jen přes Pohoda mServer (XML API), ne přímo v SQL
AI vrstva: Anthropic Claude API (Messages API, ne ChatGPT/jiný model) s tool-use smyčkou — model si sám generuje a spouští SQL dotazy
Backend: Python (Flask/podobné), self-hosted na Windows serveru jako služba (NSSM)
Databáze appky: SQLite (uživatelé, konverzace, historie, logy)

Funkční požadavky:

Webové chatovací rozhraní, multi-user, s přihlašováním
Role-based přístup (min. 3 úrovně: admin / vedení / běžný uživatel) — každá role vidí jiný rozsah dat/nástrojů
AI agent generuje a spouští read-only SQL dotazy nad Pohoda schématem (desítky tabulek, nutná znalostní báze schématu/gotchas)
Kombinace SQL + mServer dat v jedné odpovědi
Export výsledků do formátovaného Excelu
Sdílený kontext/poznámky editovatelné vedením, viditelné pro appku při každém dotazu
Naplánované opakující se dotazy (denní/týdenní reporty bez zásahu uživatele)
Admin rozhraní: správa uživatelů, log všech dotazů, přehled chyb, přehled spotřeby/nákladů API
Optimalizace nákladů na API (prompt caching apod.)

Odhad rozsahu dat: cca 11 středisek, řádově statisíce dokladů ročně, víceleté historické archivy (samostatné databáze po ročnících).

Prosím o orientační cenu za vývoj (rozpad na fáze/moduly uvítám) a odhad časové náročnosti. Zkušenost s Pohoda/Stormware API nebo podobnými ERP integracemi výhodou, ne podmínkou.

jobs.title: Senior .NET 10 Blazor WASM Developer Needed for CRM & Razorpay Portal (10+ Yrs Exp)
jobs.description:
Project Overview:
We are seeking a highly experienced, senior-level .NET developer to build a custom CRM and customer-facing payment portal. The core objective of this application is to provide a seamless interface for customers to view, manage, and pay their invoices online using Razorpay.

Technology Stack & Coding Standards:

Frontend: .NET 10 Blazor WebAssembly (WASM)

Backend/Database: .NET 10 / SQL Server

Coding Standards: You must follow standard, straightforward coding practices. Do not use complicated, over-engineered, or overly abstracted layers of code. We expect clean, readable, and easily maintainable architecture.

Third-Party Components: If any third-party UI libraries or controls are required, you must strictly use DevExpress Blazor components. No other third-party UI frameworks are permitted.

DevExpress Licensing: During the development phase, the developer must use their own active DevExpress license or a trial/demo version. We will purchase and provide an official DevExpress license seat only after the project is fully completed and delivered, to be used for future support and maintenance.

Deployment: Must be architecture-agnostic (built to be hosted on either an in-house server or Microsoft Azure—final decision will be made post-development).

Core Features & Requirements:

Invoice Management & PDF Generation:

Customers must be able to view a complete list of their invoices.

Provide a 1-click option to download a fully formatted, GST-compliant invoice as a PDF.

Payment Processing:

Allow customers to multi-select pending or partially paid invoices for a consolidated payment.

Enforce a strict minimum payment limit of 1,500 INR (app-level logic).

Razorpay Integration:

Seamless integration with the Razorpay payment gateway.

Must follow the standard Razorpay flow (Server-side Order creation, JS Interop for frontend checkout).

Webhook & Database Logging:

Upon successful payment, the backend must listen for Razorpay Webhooks to confirm the transaction.

The system must then automatically pass an entry to a SQL Server table recording: Which customer made the payment, which specific invoice(s) were paid, and the exact amount paid.

Candidate Qualifications:

10+ years of proven software development experience. We are looking for a veteran developer.

Manual Coding Expertise (No AI): You must possess the foundational skills and discipline to write clean, secure, and optimized code from scratch without relying on AI code-generation tools.

Proven Razorpay & Blazor Experience: You must be able to demonstrate previous successful payment integrations.

Terms of Engagement & Payment Structure (Strict):
Please read carefully before bidding. By accepting this project, you agree to the following terms:

Payment Milestones:

5% paid after the completion and approval of Phase 1.

70% paid before the final project is hosted/deployed.

20% paid immediately after successful hosting, deployment, and final testing.

5% retained and paid after the 3-month support period concludes.

Failure & Refund Clause: If the developer fails to complete the project, abandons it, or fails to meet the core requirements, the developer is legally obligated to refund all amounts paid up to that point, plus a 15% interest penalty calculated from the exact day the project was initially accepted.

Post-Launch Support: The contract includes a mandatory 3 months of dedicated support related to this project for bug fixes and stability assurance.

jobs.title: Delivery Marketplace App MVP Development

jobs.title: Feed: game
jobs.description:
The Arrival (0:00 - 0:15)
Scene: The game opens in first-person view inside a beat-up sedan driving through heavy rain. The player controls Miles Ferro. He is talking to himself, practicing what he’s going to say to the bank. His voice is shaky and exhausted.

Action: The car parks outside a massive, decaying inherited house in the middle of nowhere. The player must grab a flashlight from the glovebox, get out, and find a way inside. The front door is locked. The player explores the porch and finds a spare key hidden inside a fake rock.

Atmosphere: Pitch black outside, illuminated only by lightning flashes and the weak yellow beam of the flashlight. The audio is dominated by heavy rain, tape hiss, and Miles’s nervous breathing.

The Mundane & The Discovery (0:15 - 0:35)
Scene: Inside the house. It smells like dust and old wood. The power is out.

Action: The player's first diegetic objective (checked via a text message to Miles's sister) is to turn on the breaker in the basement and pack up three specific boxes of his uncle's valuables.

The Turn: While moving a heavy bookshelf to get to a safe, the player uncovers a hidden, reinforced iron door. Entering it reveals a secret basement room.

The Lore: Inside, the player finds a massive Ledger on a desk. The pages are filled with names written in dried blood, dating back 30 years. On the wall, three rules are carved:

Uninvited guests pay the Rent.

Blood pays the Rent.

The deadline is midnight.

The Tape: The player finds a cassette player. Playing it triggers his uncle's voice—weeping, apologizing, saying he couldn't do it anymore, warning Miles to leave before "The Landlord" wakes up.

The Trap Closes (0:35 - 0:50)
Scene: Suddenly, the rotary phone on the basement desk rings. It’s impossible, as the lines are dead.

Action: The player answers. The voice on the other end is "The Landlord"—calm, professional, heavily distorted by static. It tells Miles to check his cell phone.

The Hook: The player pulls up Miles's phone. A notification pops up from his bank: $150,000 deposited. Debt cleared. His sister’s life-saving surgery is paid for. The Landlord speaks again: "The transaction is complete. The Rent is due tonight."

The Intruder: Before Miles can process this, headlights flash through the basement window. A car pulls up. Someone breaks a window upstairs. It’s Dara, a confident paranormal streamer breaking in to hunt ghosts for her channel. She is the "uninvited guest."

The Reverse Hunt (0:50 - 1:15)
Scene: The horror flips. The player is no longer exploring; they are hunting, but they are terrified.

Action: The player must navigate the dark house while Dara walks around talking to her stream camera. The player must gather tools (duct tape from the garage, a heavy wrench from the kitchen) without being seen.

The Tension: Miles is having a panic attack. If the player moves too fast or gets too close to Dara's flashlight beam, Miles's "Nerve" drains. He starts hyperventilating, screen vision blurs, and the player’s controller/mouse input shakes. If he drops an item, Dara hears it and comes looking.

The Climax & Branching Endings (1:15 - 1:30)
The player finally corners Dara in the master bedroom. The player is presented with a physical, in-world choice that determines the ending.

Ending A (Comply - The Canon Ending): The player chooses to attack. The game does not show a clean kill. The player must hold down the trigger buttons as Miles violently shakes. The screen cuts to black. We hear a muffled struggle, Dara screaming, and Miles crying, "I'm sorry, I'm sorry!"

Epilogue: Fade in on Miles at the sink, scrubbing blood off his hands with a dead, hollow stare. The phone rings. The Landlord says, "Good boy." The Ledger fills in Dara's name on its own.

Ending B (Refuse - The Punishment): The player chooses to drop the weapon and step into the light, warning Dara to run. Dara screams and flees the house.

Epilogue: The house doors violently slam shut. The walls begin to bleed a sickly dark red. The Landlord's voice booms, "Breach of contract." The camera violently whips around as an unseen force drags Miles screaming into the dark.

Ending C (Secret Confrontation): If the player found all three hidden cassette tapes during the game, they unlock a third option: burning the Ledger.

Epilogue: Setting the book on fire triggers a terrifying sequence where the house begins to physically distort (walls stretching, impossible geometry). The player must escape the house while avoiding manifestations of the Landlord before the house collapses into a void.

2. DETAILED GAMEPLAY MECHANICS (For the Programmer)
Tell your lead developer to build these specific systems:

1. The "Nerve" System (Float Value 100 to 0)
This is the core mechanic. Miles is not a trained killer; he is a nervous wreck.

State Machine: Create a background float variable starting at 100.

Drains: Nerve decreases when in total darkness for too long, when the Landlord is speaking, or when within a 5-meter radius of Dara.

Diegetic Penalties (What happens when Nerve is low):

Audio: At 50 Nerve, trigger a heavy breathing audio loop. At 20 Nerve, trigger a loud, erratic heartbeat that the AI can actually hear.

Visuals: At 30 Nerve, increase the camera's FOV (Field of View) slightly to simulate tunnel vision, and increase the Head-Bob multiplier by 2x to simulate trembling.

Interactions: If Nerve is below 40, picking up items has a 30% RNG chance to fail, causing Miles to drop the item with a loud physics CLANG, immediately alerting Dara.

Recovery: The player must hide in a designated "safe zone" (like a closet) and hold a button to do a "breathing minigame" (matching an expanding/contracting circle on screen) to calm Miles down and restore Nerve.

2. Dara's AI (Reverse-Stealth Logic)
Dara needs a robust state machine that reacts to the player's mistakes.

Vision Cone: Attach a Raycast cone to her flashlight. If the player’s hitbox intersects the cone, she enters the Investigate state.

Audio Listeners: Give Dara an audio detection radius. If the player drops an item, steps on a creaky floorboard (place trigger boxes on specific floor meshes), or if Miles's Nerve drops so low he starts gasping, she hears it.

Behavior States:

Patrol: Walking slowly, talking to her camera, investigating rooms systematically.

Investigate: Walks toward the source of a noise. Says things like, "Hello? Chat, did you hear that?"

Flee: If she spots Miles fully, she will scream and run toward the nearest exit. The player has a 10-second window to catch her, or it triggers a Game Over.

3. VISUAL & AUDIO BIBLE (For the Art/Sound Team)
Graphics & Engine Setup (The PS1 Look)
Resolution: Render the game internally at 320x240 resolution, then up-scale it to the player's monitor to force hard, pixelated edges.

Affine Texture Warping: This is crucial. PS1 hardware couldn't calculate perspective perfectly, making textures on walls "wobble" or "jiggle" when the camera moves. Use a custom shader to replicate this.

Vertex Snapping (Jitter): 3D models shouldn't move smoothly. Their vertices should snap to a grid, giving animations that choppy, retro feel.

Post-Processing: Apply a heavy CRT filter, VHS tracking lines that randomly appear at the bottom of the screen, and chromatic aberration (color fringing on the edges of the screen).

Audio Design
No HUD, No Menus: Everything is physical. The player reads text messages on a 3D phone model held in Miles's hand. The inventory is Miles looking down at his pockets.

The Master Hiss: Put a low-level analog tape hiss on the master audio mixer. It should never be perfectly quiet.

Voice Acting Direction: The actor playing Miles must NOT sound polished. Tell them to stutter, cut themselves off, take sharp breaths, and sound like they are on the verge of a panic attack. When he talks to himself, it’s a coping mechanism.

The Landlord's Voice: Do not use monster growls. Pitch a male voice down by 20%, add a slight robotic chorus effect, and deliver lines calmly.

jobs.title: Personal Mobility Prototype Development
jobs.description:
I am planning a brand-new mobility device aimed at personal transportation—think along the lines of an electric scooter, but potentially lighter, smarter, and easier to live with. To get there I need an electrical engineer who can take the idea from blank page to fully tested working prototype.

Here is what the assignment looks like on my end:

• Research & concept validation
– Analyse existing solutions and pinpoint realistic targets for speed, range, weight, and foldability.
– Produce a short report that weighs trade-offs so we can lock in the primary feature set.

• Electrical architecture
– Select motors, batteries, BMS, motor controller, sensors, and charging solution.
– Draft schematics, PCB layout, and provide BOM with sourcing info.

• Prototype build
– Assemble and wire the first unit, integrating the chosen components into a safe rideable chassis (mechanical help can be arranged if you specify requirements).
– Flash firmware / configure controllers, then bench-test and road-test for performance and thermal behaviour.

• Documentation & hand-off
– Update the research report with real-world data, complete test logs, and supply all design files (schematics, Gerbers, firmware source, CAD).
– Recommend next-step improvements for a pre-production run.

Key tools you are likely to touch: Altium or KiCad for boards, MATLAB/Simulink or similar for drive modelling, basic CAN/UART debugging, and standard lab equipment for validation. If you prefer alternate toolchains just let me know—flexibility is fine as long as files are exportable.

Acceptance criteria
1. Research report clearly justifies chosen performance targets and major components.
2. Prototype reaches agreed performance figures in independent tests.
3. All source files and documentation are delivered in editable form.

Timeline and milestone structure can be discussed once you see the initial scope. If you love solving practical mobility challenges and can turn solid engineering into something people can ride, let’s talk

Background

I need a reliable editor who can turn that single raw file into a full set of platform-ready assets every time, so I can focus on filming and posting rather than editing.

jobs.title: Unified Healthcare Management Platform (HMS, Pharmacy & LIMS)
jobs.description:
The Unified Healthcare Management Platform is a comprehensive, modular digital healthcare solution designed to help hospitals, clinics, diagnostic laboratories, pharmacies, and healthcare networks manage their day-to-day clinical and operational activities through a single integrated system.

Unlike a conventional website developed for one healthcare organization, the proposed solution will be built as a configurable healthcare platform that can be deployed, licensed, or white-labelled for multiple healthcare providers. Each hospital or clinic will be able to use the modules relevant to its operations while maintaining its own users, patients, departments, configurations, branding, workflows, and data.

The platform will bring together three major healthcare management areas:

1. Hospital & Clinic Management System

The Hospital Management module will support the complete patient journey and administrative workflow of hospitals and clinics, including:

Patient registration and unique patient identification
OPD and IPD management
Doctor and department management
Appointment scheduling
Consultation and clinical records
Electronic Medical Records / Electronic Health Records
Prescription management
Admission, discharge and transfer workflows
Bed and ward management
Nursing and clinical documentation
Billing and payment management
Insurance and corporate patient management
Operation theatre and procedure management
Patient history and longitudinal medical records
Administrative and management dashboards

This will provide healthcare institutions with a centralized system for managing both clinical and administrative activities instead of depending on multiple disconnected applications.

2. Pharmacy Management System

The integrated Pharmacy Management System will allow hospitals, clinics and standalone pharmacies to manage the complete medicine lifecycle, including:

Medicine master and catalogue management
Prescription-to-pharmacy workflow
Medicine inventory and stock management
Batch and expiry tracking
Purchase and supplier management
Goods receipt and stock movement
Pharmacy billing
Medicine issue and return
Low-stock and expiry alerts
Drug consumption reports
Integration with patient prescriptions and hospital billing

This integration will allow prescriptions generated by doctors to directly flow into the pharmacy workflow while maintaining complete traceability of medicine inventory and transactions.

3. Laboratory Information Management System – LIMS

The LIMS module will digitize the complete diagnostic laboratory workflow from test ordering to final report delivery.

It will support:

Laboratory test catalogue
Doctor or patient test orders
Sample collection
Barcode-based sample identification
Sample tracking
Department-wise laboratory processing
Result entry and validation
Pathologist / authorized-person approval
Diagnostic report generation
Digital report delivery
Historical patient reports
External laboratory integration
White-labelled diagnostic reports
Laboratory billing
Audit trails and turnaround-time monitoring

The LIMS will be directly connected with the Hospital Management System so that investigations ordered during a consultation can automatically appear in the laboratory workflow and finalized reports can become part of the patient's medical record.

Unified Patient Record

A major objective of the platform will be to maintain a single longitudinal patient record across consultations, admissions, laboratory investigations, prescriptions, pharmacy transactions and future healthcare services.

Instead of maintaining separate patient information in different systems, authorized healthcare professionals will be able to access a consolidated view of the patient's healthcare journey based on their roles and permissions.

Modular Platform Architecture

The solution will follow a modular and API-first architecture, allowing healthcare organizations to implement only the modules they require.

For example:

Small Clinic
HMS + Appointment + EMR + Billing

Clinic with Pharmacy
HMS + EMR + Pharmacy

Diagnostic Centre
LIMS + Billing + Patient Portal

Multi-Speciality Hospital
HMS + IPD + OPD + EMR + Pharmacy + LIMS + Billing + Administration

Hospital Group / Healthcare Chain
Complete platform with centralized management and individual branch-level operations.

Additional modules can therefore be activated as the healthcare organization grows without replacing the underlying platform.

Multi-Hospital and Multi-Branch Support

The platform will be designed to support multiple healthcare organizations and multiple branches.

Each organization can have its own:

Hospitals and branches
Departments
Doctors and employees
Patients
Laboratory
Pharmacy
Inventory
Pricing
Services
Workflows
Reports
Roles and permissions
Branding and configuration

A hospital group can also receive a consolidated management dashboard while individual facilities continue operating independently.

Role-Based Access and Security

The system will provide role-based access for different healthcare users such as:

Hospital administrators
Doctors
Nurses
Reception staff
Pharmacists
Pathologists
Laboratory technicians
Billing staff
Inventory managers
Management
Patients

Each user will only be able to access functionality and patient information permitted for their role.

The platform will incorporate secure authentication, encrypted communication, audit logs, access controls, data backups and healthcare data protection mechanisms to support enterprise healthcare deployments.

Integration Capability

The platform will expose secure APIs to integrate with external healthcare systems and services such as:

External laboratories
Existing EMR/HIS systems
Medical equipment
Payment gateways
Insurance systems
Government healthcare systems
SMS, WhatsApp and email services
Mobile applications
Patient portals
Third-party healthcare applications

This will allow the platform to function as the digital backbone of a healthcare organization rather than as an isolated software application.

Analytics and Management Intelligence

Hospitals and clinics will receive centralized dashboards covering areas such as:

Patient footfall
OPD/IPD statistics
Doctor utilization
Laboratory volumes
Laboratory turnaround time
Pharmacy sales
Medicine consumption
Inventory movement
Revenue
Outstanding payments
Department performance
Branch performance
Operational trends

Future versions of the platform can also incorporate AI-assisted analytics, clinical decision support, predictive inventory management and patient engagement capabilities.

Deployment Model

The platform can be offered as a Healthcare SaaS / Enterprise Healthcare Platform.

Healthcare organizations may subscribe to individual modules or deploy the complete ecosystem depending on their size and requirements.

The same core technology platform can therefore support:

Clinic → Diagnostic Centre → Pharmacy → Hospital → Multi-Speciality Hospital → Hospital Chain

without developing a separate application for every customer.

Project Vision

The vision of the project is to create a single scalable healthcare technology platform capable of becoming the operating system for hospitals and clinics.

Instead of healthcare institutions purchasing separate software for hospital management, laboratory operations, pharmacy, billing, patient records and reporting, the platform will provide these capabilities within one interconnected ecosystem.

The project therefore aims to create a B2B healthcare technology product that can be implemented across healthcare organizations, customized according to their operational requirements, integrated with existing systems, and expanded through additional modules as their digital healthcare needs evolve.

jobs.title: RC Low-Pass Filter Design
jobs.description:
I need a clean, passive low-pass filter designed around standard resistor-capacitor (RC) components. The target cutoff is comfortably below 1 kHz, so I expect calculations that clearly show the ‑3 dB point in that region and justify the chosen values.

Please deliver:  
• A schematic with labelled part values  
• The formula walkthrough that leads to those values (including impedance considerations)  
• A brief frequency-response plot or SPICE simulation screenshot confirming the roll-off

Keep the layout simple enough for through-hole assembly and aim for readily available E12 series parts. If you like working in LTspice, Multisim, or a similar tool, feel free—the files are welcome alongside a PDF or image of the final circuit.

jobs.title: Precise PDF-to-Word Conversion
jobs.description:
I need a clean, line-for-line recreation of my PDF—which contains both text and images—into an editable .docx file. Every paragraph break, heading style, table, bullet, and margin has to mirror the source precisely, so the finished Word document can be printed or further edited without anyone noticing it was converted.

Only a handful of the embedded images should stay. Once we start, I’ll point out which ones; the rest can be left out entirely. Please keep the retained images at their original resolution and in the same position on the page.

You may rely on Adobe Acrobat, FineReader, or any other OCR and layout-preservation tools, but the final text must be proof-read for stray recognition errors so it’s publication-ready.

Deliverables
• Editable .docx that matches the PDF’s formatting exactly  
• Selected images embedded, others removed as instructed  
• Error-free text, ready for immediate use

I’ll share the PDF as soon as we agree on timing and approach.

jobs.title: TDA2050 Home Audio Amplifier Design -- 2
jobs.description:
I want to build a clean-sounding, reliable TDA2050 power-amplifier stage for a home audio setup that will accept a purely digital source (e.g., DAC board, streaming receiver) as its input. The job is to create the complete circuit from scratch—nothing to troubleshoot or modify—so all design choices are in your hands, provided they meet the following essentials:

• Core device: single TDA2050 in class-AB configuration  
• Input: digital line-level signal coming from an external DAC (so any filtering or impedance matching you feel is appropriate should be included)  
• Output power: the typical 25–30 W into 4–8 Ω expected from the chip, with thermal protection and short-circuit safeguards fully implemented  
• Noise floor and THD figures suitable for hi-fi living-room listening

Deliverables
• Schematic ready for review (KiCad preferred, Gerbers acceptable if you layout in another package)  
• PCB layout files plus Gerbers and drill files, sized for easy home etching or low-volume fabrication  
• Annotated BOM with part numbers that can be sourced from Mouser or LCSC today  
• Brief notes on PSU requirements, heat-sinking calculations and any optional add-ons (mute, soft-start, speaker protection)

Acceptance will be based on successfully opening the schematic and board files, a logical signal path from DAC to speaker terminals, and clear evidence that component values and thermal design match the TDA2050 data-sheet limits.

jobs.title: Exhibition software & Support -- 2
jobs.description:

The task is strictly software integration—no extra module installations or feature redesigns—so your focus will be getting data flowing smoothly between the two systems and then providing brief post-go-live support.

The exact CRM will be confirmed on our first call; expect one of the mainstream options such as Salesforce, HubSpot, or Zoho CRM. Whichever it is, the work will revolve around their public REST APIs, webhooks, and OAuth-based authentication. You should already feel comfortable mapping fields, handling rate limits, and writing lightweight error handling so that contacts, deals, and a handful of custom objects sync reliably both ways.

Deliverables
• Production-ready integration code or configuration (language or iPaaS of your choice, as long as it’s easy for us to maintain)  
• A concise setup & rollback guide  
• A quick test script or Postman collection demonstrating each API call  
• Up to two weeks of light support for bug fixes or questions

Acceptance Criteria  
1. All agreed fields sync automatically with no duplicates.  
2. Round-trip time for data updates is under five minutes.  
3. No unhandled errors appear in the application or CRM logs during a 48-hour test window.

I value clear, asynchronous communication, so please tell me which tools or SDKs you prefer and any assumptions you need me to confirm before you start. Looking forward to getting this rolled out quickly and painlessly!

jobs.title: Simple Pant & Shirt 3D Models
jobs.description:
I’m looking for a straightforward 3D build of one pair of pants and one shirt. The goal is a clean, low-poly representation—just the basic shape and form, no intricate folds, stitching, or photoreal textures.

I’ll be working with the files inside Blender, so please supply the final deliverable as a native .blend file (an .FBX or .OBJ export alongside it is fine, but not required). Standard adult male sizing is enough; no custom measurements are needed.

Key points for the hand-off:
• Geometry must be manifold and logically named (e.g., Pant_LP, Shirt_LP).  
• Keep the polycount lean but smooth enough for simple subdivision if I choose to refine later.  
• Assign a single flat material to each garment; UVs can be automatic—no texture maps are expected.  

Once I confirm the meshes open correctly in Blender and match the brief, the project is complete.

jobs.title: Social Media Engagement Assistant
jobs.description:
Instagram, Facebook and Twitter form the core of my online presence. All three channels need a steady flow of eye-catching content—text, images and short videos—paired with captions that sound authentic and spark conversation. The primary objective is to expand brand awareness, so every post, reply and story should feel on-brand and encourage followers to share, comment or click through.

Day-to-day work involves:

• Designing or sourcing visuals (Canva, Adobe Express or similar tools are fine).  
• Writing concise, engaging captions with relevant hashtags.  
• Monitoring comments and messages, then interacting in a friendly, timely manner.  
• Tracking basic metrics (reach, impressions, follower growth) and sending a brief weekly summary so we can see what’s working.

Success is measured by consistent posting, noticeable growth in organic reach and an active, conversational community around the brand accounts. Everything can be handled remotely; reliability and creative flair matter more than location or time zone.

jobs.title: Source Sub-$5k Toyota Cars in Melbourne
jobs.description:

• I review your shortlist within 24 hours; once I green-light a vehicle, you arrange a convenient viewing time with the seller (or hand off contact details if preferred).  

Acceptance criteria:
1. Minimum five qualified listings per week.  
2. All listings located within a 100 km radius of Melbourne CBD.  
3. Vehicles must be drivable immediately with no known engine, transmission or structural issues. No cars needing panel beating or major cosmetic repairs.

jobs.title: Healthcare Data Security Application Review

jobs.title: High-Ticket B2B Sales Closer - Therapist Tools

jobs.title: TDA7388 Sub-Mid Amplifier Design
jobs.description:
I’m putting together a compact home audio system that runs a sealed-box subwoofer and a pair of midrange drivers from a single TDA7388. My plan is to feed the two bridged channels through a JRC4558 low-pass network for the sub, while the remaining two channels stay full-range for the mids. The source will be an MP3 player, so the input stage must accept that signal level cleanly; if you can leave room for RCA, 3.5 mm, or even a small Bluetooth add-on later, all the better.

Here’s what I need from you:

• Complete schematic showing the TDA7388 output topology, the JRC4558 filter (cut-off around 80 Hz, 12 dB/Oct preferred), power supply filtering, and protections  
• PCB layout ready for fabrication, sized for a small desktop enclosure and routed for minimal noise between sub and mid paths  
• Bill of materials with part numbers that are easy to source locally or on Mouser/Digi-Key  
• Brief build notes—heat-sink requirements, gain settings, and any calibration steps to balance the mids against the sub  

I’ll test the board on my bench with a sealed 10″ driver and bookshelf mids; stable, hum-free playback at moderate home-listening levels is the acceptance criterion. If this sounds straightforward to you and you’re comfortable with TDA7388 thermal design and op-amp filter math, I’d be happy to see your proposal and timeline.

jobs.title: Offshore Untraceable Trading App
jobs.description:
This project centres on building a mobile trading application that remains completely offshore and invisible to Indian networks. All servers, domains, databases and ancillary services must be provisioned in jurisdictions outside India so that no traceable logs, WHOIS records or routing paths point back here. The app itself will allow users to deposit a minimum of ₹5,000 and receive a fixed 6 % return every 24 hours, so reliability and clarity in the profit-tracking logic are essential.

Core requirements  
• Cross-platform mobile build (Android and iOS preferred) with a sleek onboarding flow.  
• Real-time market data streaming inside the trading screen; latency must stay under one second.  
• A privacy-focused, untraceable blockchain payment gateway for deposits, withdrawals and automated daily profit distribution. KYC must be optional and no Indian banking rails can surface anywhere in the process.  
• Back-office dashboard for me to monitor wallets, user balances and transaction history.  
• Automated interest calculation that credits users exactly 6 % of their active stake every day at a fixed UTC time.  
• Fully redundant offshore hosting stack (VPS or bare-metal) with documented steps to re-deploy if a provider ever asks takedown questions.

Acceptance criteria  
– APK/IPA builds plus full source in a private repo.  
– Proof of successful deployment on non-Indian infrastructure (screenshots, traceroute logs).  
– Testnet demonstration of the gateway showing deposit, interest credit and withdrawal in one cycle.  
– Clear hand-off documentation covering server IPs, domain registrars and wallet addresses.

I prefer teams that already have experience integrating real-time data feeds, blockchain wallets and offshore DevOps, but I’m open to any proposal that can meet the above deliverables without compromising user anonymity or uptime.

jobs.title: Cross-Platform Mobile App for Coffee Shop

jobs.title: LM257 Boost Converter to 12V

jobs.title: Informational Company Website Development

On social media, LinkedIn will be the primary focus, supplemented by any other networks you feel can reach business audiences efficiently. For email, I already have a segmented list; you will refine it, build a short drip sequence in Mailchimp (or a similar platform you prefer), and monitor performance. Search engine work will concentrate on Google Ads and organic optimisation to make sure prospects researching comparable products find us first.

I’ll supply product specs, past creative assets, and access to existing analytics. You’ll shape a coherent strategy, create or adapt the copy and visuals, launch the campaigns, and iterate based on results.

Deliverables  
• A channel-by-channel launch plan with clear KPIs  
• All creative assets and copy ready for approval before go-live  
• Live campaign management for the first month, including bid/budget tweaks  
• Weekly performance reports highlighting leads generated, cost-per-lead, CTRs, and suggested optimisations  

If you have proven B2B growth wins on LinkedIn, email sequences that nurture, and search ads that convert, I’d love to see examples and start quickly.

jobs.title: Leady B2B przez Email Marketing

Potrzebuję wsparcia w systematycznym generowaniu leadów i pozyskiwaniu nowych klientów B2B. Skupiam się na email marketingu jako głównym kanale dotarcia. jobs.title: Crafllal Premium Logo Design
jobs.description:
My brand “crafllal” needs a fresh, premium-quality logo built entirely by your own hand—no AI generators, stock icons, or automated presets. I’m after a clean, minimalistic mark that relies on bright, engaging colors to stand out. Please keep the solution purely graphic; no text or lettering should appear in the final artwork.

The logo has to feel modern yet timeless, with smooth geometry or a smart abstract symbol that captures a sense of craft and originality. Because the work will be used onscreen and in print, it must scale perfectly from a tiny favicon to large signage.

Deliverables I expect:
