I value clear communication, so walk me through your creative thinking as you iterate. If this sounds like the type of craftsmanship you enjoy, I’m ready to see what you can create for crafllal.

jobs.title: Wellness Book Editing, Typesetting & Back Cover Designing
jobs.description:
Project: Professional Editing, Book Formatting, Typesetting & Back Cover Design for a Health & Wellness Book
Project Overview
book will be published on Notion by self publishing

I have completed the manuscript of a health and wellness book focused on weight management, healthy living, yoga, lifestyle, Ayurveda, movement, sleep, stress, healthy ageing and sustainable habits.

The manuscript is already substantially written and structured into chapters. I am now looking for an experienced book editor and book designer/typesetter to take the manuscript to professional publishing standard.

This is not a ghostwriting project and I am not looking for someone to rewrite the book from scratch.

The work involves final proofreading, professional interior book design, typesetting, formatting, and completion of the back cover. The manuscript is substantially finalized and does not require major rewriting or structural editing.

The attached manuscript will be provided to shortlisted freelancers.

What I Will Provide

I will provide:

Complete manuscript
Final chapter structure
Front cover design
Author photograph
Back-cover text
Any required author information
Photographs/images where required
Existing design direction/brand preferences

The freelancer will be responsible for turning these materials into a professionally finished book ready for publication.

1. Editorial Review & Proofreading

The manuscript requires a final professional editorial pass.

Please review for:

Grammar
Spelling
Punctuation
Sentence flow
Awkward wording
Repetition
Inconsistent terminology
Typographical errors
Capitalization
Formatting inconsistencies
Chapter heading consistency
Subheading consistency
Paragraph consistency
American English usage
Overall readability

The writing style is intentionally:

conversational
simple
warm
accessible
non-academic
engaging
suitable for general readers

Please preserve the author's voice.

Do not turn the manuscript into an academic textbook or make the language unnecessarily sophisticated.

Minor rewriting for clarity and grammar is welcome, but major rewriting, removal of the author's personality, or changing the overall message is not required.

2. Content Consistency Check

Please check the complete manuscript for internal consistency.

This includes:

Chapter numbering
Chapter titles
Chapter subtitles
Heading hierarchy
Repeated terminology
Inconsistent spellings
Repeated explanations
Obvious contradictions
Incorrect cross-references
Formatting inconsistencies

If you identify something that appears factually questionable or requires author confirmation, flag it rather than silently changing the meaning.

3. Professional Interior Book Design

I need the book to look like a professionally published health/wellness book, not like a Word document.

Please create a clean, elegant and highly readable interior design.

The design should be:

Minimal
Premium
Warm
Modern
Calm
Professional
Highly readable
Appropriate for a health/wellness book

Please avoid:

Overly decorative layouts
Excessive graphics
Flashy colours
Fitness/gym-style design
Excessive visual elements
Complicated typography

The book should feel trustworthy and premium without looking expensive or intimidating.

4. Typesetting & Page Layout

Professional typesetting is required, including:

Page size appropriate for the final book
Margins
Gutters
Paragraph spacing
Line spacing
Indents where appropriate
Chapter-opening pages
Heading hierarchy
Subheading hierarchy
Page numbering
Running headers/footers where appropriate
Consistent typography
Widow/orphan control
Proper paragraph breaks
Consistent spacing throughout
Image placement
Captions where required
Blank pages where technically necessary
Print-safe layout

The final result should look like a professionally typeset published book.

5. Chapter Design

Each chapter should have a consistent visual identity.

For example:

Chapter Number

Chapter Title

Subtitle

Then the chapter content.

The freelancer may recommend improvements to the visual treatment of chapter openings, typography, spacing and section headings, but the overall design should remain simple and readable.

6. Images / Photographs

Where photographs or illustrations are supplied, they should be:

Properly cropped
Properly positioned
High enough resolution for print
Consistently formatted
Integrated naturally into the page design

I may also provide photographs specifically intended for the book.

Please do not distort or unnecessarily manipulate supplied photographs.

7. Back Cover Design

I already have the front cover.

I will provide:

Author photograph
Back-cover text
Relevant author information

The freelancer needs to design the back cover so that it visually belongs to the same book as the front cover.

The back cover should include appropriate space/design treatment for:

Back-cover description
Author photograph
Author bio
Author name
Publisher information if required
ISBN/barcode area if required

The freelancer should maintain visual continuity with the supplied front cover rather than creating an unrelated design.

8. Complete Cover / Print-Ready Cover

After the interior page count is finalized, the freelancer should prepare the complete print cover where required:

Front + Spine + Back

The spine width will depend on the final page count and paper specifications.

The freelancer should therefore prepare the final cover according to the specifications of the intended printer/publishing platform.

9. Deliverables

I expect the following final files:

Interior
Print-ready PDF
Editable source file
High-resolution images embedded appropriately
Final formatted manuscript
Cover
Print-ready complete cover PDF
Editable cover source file
Front + spine + back cover
Web/marketing version of the cover if recommended
Optional / if applicable
EPUB/eBook version
Reflowable eBook formatting
Separate high-resolution front-cover JPG/PNG

Please specify in your quotation which of these formats are included in your price.

10. Technical Quality

The final files must be suitable for professional printing.

Please ensure:

Correct bleed
Correct margins
Correct colour mode
Correct image resolution
Embedded fonts where required
No missing fonts
No accidental RGB/CMYK issues
No low-resolution images
No text outside printable areas
Correct page sequencing
Correct spine alignment
Print-safe PDF export

If you have experience preparing books for Amazon KDP, IngramSpark or Indian printers, please mention this in your proposal.
around 200 pages

jobs.title: Short Video Editing Needed
jobs.description:

The end product should:

• Be delivered in an H.264/MP4 file, 1080p

I’m open to your creative ideas on pacing, visual flourishes, or subtle effects as long as they enhance clarity without distracting from the core content. Please include a link to comparable work you’ve completed so I can gauge your style. Quick turnaround is a plus, but quality comes first—let me know your realistic timeline when you submit your proposal.

jobs.title: Advanced AI & 3D Rendering for Blender
jobs.description:
Project Title: AI-Driven 2D-to-3D / Video Generation Pipeline in Blender (Photo-real, 3D Cartoon, Anime Styles)
Category: 3D Animation / Blender Scripting / AI Integration
Description:
We have a working baseline Blender automation pipeline (built using Kiki K3) that generates basic 3D videos from 2D images. We're now looking to upgrade this into a more advanced system capable of true volumetric depth and multi-style rendering.
Core Problem:
Our current pipeline projects 2D images onto image planes, which results in a flat "paper-cut" look. We need to solve this by adding real volume, depth, and multi-view consistency (front/side/back/top) so outputs hold up from multiple camera angles — not just a flat cutout facing the camera.
What We Need:
Integration of AI models/APIs for depth estimation and/or 3D mesh generation (e.g., depth-to-mesh, NeRF/Gaussian Splatting, or similar neural rendering approaches) into our existing Blender + automation workflow
PBR-ready texturing for realistic material/lighting response
Support for three output styles: photo-realistic, 3D cartoon, and anime
A functional prototype demonstrating the upgraded pipeline end-to-end
Deliverables Requested from Applicants:
A brief technical feasibility assessment — how you'd approach integrating AI-based 2D-to-3D volumetric workflows with Blender
Estimated cost/fee structure for building the initial prototype
Expected timeline and proposed resourcing/team structure for execution
Ideal Skills:
Blender Python API / scripting & automation
Experience with depth estimation, photogrammetry, or 3D generative AI models
Neural rendering (NeRF, Gaussian Splatting) or mesh reconstruction pipelines
PBR texturing/shading workflows
Prior work on stylized (cartoon/anime) 3D pipelines is a plus
Please respond with your relevant portfolio/past work, feasibility notes, and a rough quote before we schedule a discussion.

jobs.title: PHP E-commerce to WordPress
jobs.description:
I need my custom PHP-based store rebuilt on WordPress so I can manage everything through WooCommerce. The current site only handles products, and every SKU, image, description, customer record, and order history must come across intact.

The finished WordPress build has to support:

• A fully-configured payment gateway (I’m using Stripe and PayPal now, but I’m open to a comparable solution)  
• Native product reviews shown on each item page and reflected in the overall rating

Beyond those essentials, please keep the existing design language, preserve all current URLs or set up proper 301 redirects, and ensure the new theme is responsive and quick to load.

When you reply, focus on your experience handling similar PHP-to-WordPress migrations. I’m especially interested in examples where you dealt with large product catalogs, custom checkout logic, or tricky data imports.  

The hand-off I expect: a live WordPress site on my server, a documented child theme or custom plugin codebase, and a short walk-through video so I’m comfortable managing products, orders, and reports on my own.

jobs.title: Engaging Promotional Email Newsletter
jobs.description:
I’d like you to craft a recurring email newsletter that promotes our own company and keeps our audience actively engaged. The content should centre on business-focused marketing messages rather than general news, always aiming to spark conversation, clicks, and repeat interaction.

Key deliverables:
• A clean, responsive template that renders perfectly in major clients (Gmail, Outlook, Apple Mail, mobile apps).  
• Compelling copy for the first edition, balanced between promotional highlights and value-adding insights.  
• A short content plan outlining subject-line ideas, send frequency, and engagement tactics (personalisation, clear calls-to-action, light segmentation).  

Success will be measured by open rate uplift and click-through engagement on the initial send. All assets should be provided in editable formats so my in-house team can continue the series after launch.

jobs.title: Interior Design Lead-Gen Meta Ads
jobs.description:
I need a results-driven specialist to plan, launch, and continuously optimise Meta advertising that brings qualified interior-design leads straight to my inbox. Campaigns will run on Facebook and Instagram only, and every asset must be purpose-built for lead generation rather than simple reach.

Creative production is part of the brief. I want eye-catching AI-generated images and short video snippets that feel on-brand for high-end interiors. Whether you prefer Runway, Midjourney, Firefly, or another tool is up to you—as long as the final ads look polished, scroll-stopping, and are ready to upload in Meta Ads Manager.

Because lead quality matters more than sheer volume, I expect you to handle audience research, funnel setup, A/B testing, pixel or Conversion API configuration, and weekly performance tweaks so we can hit an efficient cost per lead. I’ll supply brand guidelines, past client photos, and any real project footage you might weave into the AI outputs.

Deliverables  
• Campaign structure and targeting plan  
• 4–6 AI-generated image ads and 2–3 short video ads for initial launch  
• Full ad copy and headlines tailored to each creative  
• Ongoing optimisation report every seven days with clear next steps  

Acceptance criteria  
• All assets delivered in Meta-approved sizes/formats  
• Campaigns live within one week of project start  
• Cost per lead trend-line falling or stable after the first optimisation cycle

jobs.title: CapCut Reels & Shorts Editor
jobs.description:
I shoot short-form content for Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts and now need a creative editor who can turn my raw clips into the kind of punchy 30-60 second videos you see from Ali Abdaal or Iman Gadzhi. • Royalty-free or trending music synced perfectly

Ready to make content go viral? Show me what you’ve got and we can start on the first batch immediately.

jobs.title: Meta Ads Specialist for Jewelry Brand
jobs.description:

jobs.title: Basic Python CSV Data Cleaner
jobs.description:
I have a small CSV file that needs a quick clean-up using nothing more than the Python standard library. The task is to write a single, well-commented .py script that  

• reads the original CSV,  
• applies a handful of common cleaning actions (duplicate removal, simple missing-value handling, trimming stray whitespace, and normalising line endings), all driven by clear function calls or flags so I can switch steps on or off later, and  
• writes the result to a new file while preserving the original column order.

Please keep external dependencies out of the solution—csv, re, datetime or similar built-ins are fine, but no pandas or third-party packages. A short README or docstring showing command-line usage is all the documentation I need.

Acceptance: running “python clean.py input.csv output.csv” on my machine (Python 3.10) completes without errors and the output file reflects the cleaning steps above.

jobs.title: 30-Second French Betting Commercial
jobs.description:

To keep things visually fresh, I want a playful blend of live-action moments—think quick shots of celebrations, winning tickets, or casino tables—intercut with bold, dynamic animation that highlights odds, jackpots, and the bonus offer. Broadcast specs: full-HD 1920×1080, ready for TV playout, with clean stereo mix and a separate music-only track. Sync licensed music and SFX that match the energy; I’ll supply the platform logo and brand colours as soon as we kick off.

• Moroccan French-language script and storyboard for approval  (storyboard in English)
• Final 30-second master video (H.264 MP4 and ProRes)  
• Separate audio stems (VO, music, SFX)

jobs.title: Literal English-Hebrew Prophecy Translation
jobs.description:
I am preparing a study edition of key prophetic passages and require them rendered between English and Biblical Hebrew in a strictly literal, word-for-word style. Because the text touches on themes vital to both Jewish and Christian theology, I need a scholar who is at home in both traditions—someone able to respect Masoretic vocalisation, recognise Septuagint nuances where relevant, and still hear the echoes a modern Christian reader will expect.

The assignment is straightforward yet demanding:

• Translate the selected prophecy excerpts literally, preserving every syntactic turn and idiomatic nuance even when it sounds awkward in modern idiom.  
• Maintain verse numbering exactly as supplied.  
• Flag unavoidable interpretive choices in concise footnotes; no commentary beyond what is necessary to justify a lexical decision.  
• Deliver in an editable Word document and parallel PDF, with Hebrew right-to-left layout correctly formatted.

I will supply the source text and any reference scans once we start. Accuracy, textual reverence, and clean formatting are the benchmarks for acceptance. If your background straddles both Tanakh scholarship and New-Testament-aware theology, I look forward to working with you.

jobs.title: Editores de Video para Contenido Digital para redes sociales y YouTube
jobs.description: Editores de video de habla hispana para trabajar el contenido del creador @pepetrucker. Necesitamos dos perfiles: editor de videos cortos para Instagram reels y Tiktok. En ambos casos se valorará mucho que tengan portfolio real de redes sociales, especialmente trabajando con creadores de contenido, marcas personales o canales de YouTube. jobs.title: Female Hindi Educational Narration
jobs.description:
I’m recording a Hindi-language educational audiobook aimed at teenagers and I’d like a warm, friendly female voice to bring the text to life. jobs.title: Daily Text Captcha Typing
jobs.description:

jobs.title: Modern Minimalist Logo Design

jobs.title: 3D Interior Design for 2BHK Apartment

jobs.title: Yüksek Otoriteli Haber Backlinkleri

jobs.title: Strategic MENA HR Recruiter
jobs.description:
I need a freelance HR partner who can take full ownership of recruitment and talent acquisition across the MENA region. The immediate mandate is to source, screen, and secure professionals for a renewable energy business unit that is ramping up quickly.  

Success in this role hinges on three things: a solid track record in human resources, a deep understanding of local labour law and cultural nuances throughout the Gulf and world.

Here’s how I see the collaboration working: you work closely with me to define each role profile, map the market, identify passive as well as active talent, run first-round behavioural and technical interviews, and present a vetted shortlist ready for final interviews.

jobs.title: Implement SEO/GEO/AIO  Files & Indexing
jobs.description:
I have prepared all the technical SEO/AEO assets for my WordPress site and now need them put in place correctly. You will be working inside a WordPress install where I have full-access credentials and the All in One SEO Pack plugin is already active.  

Here’s what needs to happen:  
• Upload robots.txt, llms.txt and sitemap.xml to the public root so they are reachable at the standard URLs.  
• Drop four JSON-LD schema blocks (supplied) into their respective pages and check that they render only once per page in the source.  
• Register and submit the sitemap in both Google Search Console and Bing Webmaster Tools, then trigger URL inspection / indexing for the key pages.  
• Insert product text Headers and Footers" (by WPCode) 

When finished I should see the files live, the schema validating in Structured Data Testing, and both search consoles showing the sitemap as “successfully fetched”.  

Please let me know the estimated turnaround time and any quick questions you have before starting.

jobs.title: Modern Interior Transformation Reels
jobs.description:
I run an interior-design studio and need a creative partner who can turn my raw photos and clips into engaging 60-second reels that spotlight dramatic before-and-after transformations in a clean, modern style. 

Here’s what I’m after:
• Each reel opens with the “before” space, then smoothly reveals the finished room, keeping the viewer hooked right through the reveal.  
• A crisp, contemporary look—think balanced lighting, sleek typography, minimal graphics—so the visuals stay true to a modern aesthetic.  
• Tight pacing for the full 60 seconds, using trending audio (or royalty-free tracks if you prefer) that enhances rather than distracts.  
• Light on-screen text: room type, key materials, and one takeaway design tip—nothing cluttered.  
• Color correction, stabilization, and subtle motion graphics where helpful.  
• Final delivery in 1080×1920 MP4 plus the editable project file (Premiere Pro or After Effects work best for me).

I’ll supply all footage, stills, and style references; you add the storytelling, edits, and energy. If this first batch clicks, I’d love to roll these out on a regular basis.

For ur reference https://www.instagram.com/reel/DblGdhCJ3rD/?igsi=Y2wydXc3MjQ2emE1

jobs.title: Developer for Children's Meditation App

jobs.title: Urgent IR Research Paper

jobs.title: Android Gaming App Development
jobs.description:
I’m ready to turn my game idea into a fully-playable Android title and need a developer who can guide the project from first pitch to Google Play release. The exact genre is still open, so I value someone comfortable brainstorming mechanics, polishing the core loop, and advising on what will engage players on Android devices.  

You’ll handle coding, art or asset integration, UI/UX, testing, and deployment, making sure the final build meets current Android SDK requirements and runs smoothly across popular screen sizes. Whether you prefer Unity, Unreal, Godot, or native Kotlin/Java, I’m flexible as long as performance remains solid and the code base is clean and well-documented.

I’d like regular playable builds, clear communication on milestones, and guidance on Play Store submission (store listing, signing, versioning, and post-launch updates).  

Deliverables:  
• Production-ready APK + full source  
• Brief technical documentation and build instructions  
• Assistance with first live release on Google Play  

If you’ve shipped Android games before and can demonstrate polished gameplay and stable FPS, let’s discuss timelines and your recommended tech stack.

jobs.title: Podcast Editing With Music Enhancements
jobs.description:
I have raw podcast recordings that need full-service, advanced editing. Beyond the standard clean-up of stumbles or awkward pauses, I want the episodes to come alive with well-timed music beds, tasteful stingers, and spot sound effects that fit the conversation. You’re free to suggest royalty-free tracks or other legal options you trust; I care most about mood and smooth integration rather than any specific catalogue.  

Audio should be balanced, leveled, and mastered so it sounds consistent across headphones, car speakers, and smart devices. I’m flexible on final delivery format—MP3 is usually fine, but if you think WAV or AAC preserves quality better for my workflow, let’s talk.  

Deliverables  
• Fully edited, mixed, and mastered episode ready for publishing  
• Separate intro/outro music files if created from scratch  
• Brief notes listing any music or SFX sources used  

I’ll share the raw multitrack files once we agree on timelines. Looking forward to hearing how you can elevate the show.

jobs.title: Graphic & Creative Designer - 2x Minimalist Promo Email Templates  - Ad designs  - AUD $20
jobs.description:
I need 2 promotional email templates built in a minimalist, clean style. All brand assets—logo, colour palette, product shots and rough copy—will be shared as soon as we start, so the focus is on translating them into a polished, conversion-oriented layout that looks great on every major email client and device.

Both templates should:
• Be fully responsive and coded in editable, standards-compliant HTML so I can drop them straight into platforms like Mailchimp or Klaviyo.  
• Use the provided images and copy efficiently, keeping typography sharp, whitespace generous and calls-to-action unmistakable.  
• Render perfectly in Gmail, Outlook, Apple Mail and popular mobile apps (Litmus or Email on Acid testing preferred).  

When you send your proposal, please outline the structure you have in mind for each email, any optimisation tactics you’ll apply (for example, inline CSS, lightweight imagery, fallback fonts) and a concise timeline for delivery. A link to one or two past minimalist campaigns will help me understand your approach.

Final deliverables: the two HTML files, any supporting assets optimised for email, plus a brief hand-off note detailing editable sections and image dimensions.

jobs.title: Canva & CapCut Hindi Course
jobs.description:
I need a complete beginner-level course in Hindi that walks learners through Canva and CapCut step by step. The outline, topic sequence, and a short brief for each lesson will come from me; your task is to turn those notes into 30 concise video tutorials and matching written scripts.

Each lesson must include:  
• A talking-head introduction in clear Hindi (so students see the presenter and feel guided).  
• On-screen walkthroughs of the relevant Canva or CapCut feature, recorded in real time.  
• A closing recap that reinforces the key take-away for absolute beginners.  

Scripts should be delivered in a clean text document—one file per video—mirroring exactly what is said on camera so that captions and future translations are easy for us to generate.

Keep the teaching style simple, friendly, and strictly focused on the fundamentals; extra case studies or advanced examples are not needed. If you already use tools such as OBS, ScreenFlow, or Camtasia for capture and light edits, feel free to stay with them as long as the final output is 1080p MP4 and sound is crisp.

Deliverables  
1. 30 finished MP4 tutorial videos (1080p, Hindi audio, talking-head + screen share)  
2. 30 corresponding Hindi scripts in text format

Once the first two modules are approved, we’ll proceed in weekly batches to keep feedback tight and the momentum steady.

jobs.title: TikTok Manager & Creator
jobs.description:
I’m looking for a seasoned TikTok specialist to take full control of the Dr Phil Aesthetics account. The profile is already live; what I need now is one person (or a tight-knit duo) who can handle everything each month—from ideation to posting to answering DMs.

Scope of work  
• Create 15–20 TikToks every month, split 50/50 between two styles:  
  – Trend-led, comedic “character” pieces in the spirit of @drmiami  
  – Street-interview makeover arcs: stop someone, ask “Would you improve your smile if you could?”, show an instant digital mock-up, then film the chairside transformation through to the final reveal—all as one continuous story.  
• Build and maintain the content calendar, write punchy captions, schedule uploads and keep our posting cadence steady.  
• Monitor comments and messages daily, replying in brand voice to grow the community.  
• Suggest and implement your own workflow; I’m not tied to Hootsuite, Buffer or Sprout Social (I currently use none).  
• Film and edit with your own gear—smartphone, professional camera, lighting, mics—whatever delivers crisp vertical video ready for TikTok.  

What success looks like  
• Consistent delivery of 15–20 high-quality videos every month  
• Engagement handled within 24 hours  
• Steady growth in reach, followers and UGC

The engagement covers filming days, editing, posting and community management. If this end-to-end ownership sounds like your playground, let’s talk timing and your creative plan.

jobs.title: Retail POS & Report Suite
jobs.description:
I need a full-featured POS application tailored for a retail store environment. The system must let me ring up sales quickly, track inventory in real time, reward returning shoppers through a built-in loyalty program, and oversee staff activity from one dashboard.

Core functionality  
• Inventory management that deducts stock automatically at checkout and alerts me when levels run low.  
• Customer loyalty tools—simple point or tier setup with the ability to issue rewards and view each shopper’s history.  
• Employee management: individual logins, role-based permissions, and shift or sales tracking.

Reporting  
The software has to generate clear, exportable reports on:  
• Daily, weekly, and monthly sales  
• Current inventory status and valuation  
• Employee performance (sales per associate, hours vs. revenue, etc.)

Deliverables  
1. Installable or cloud-hosted POS application ready for retail use  
2. Documentation covering setup, user roles, and routine operations  
3. Source code or access credentials, depending on your deployment approach  
4. One training session so my team can hit the ground running

I’m open to the tech stack—whether you prefer Java, .NET, Python, or a modern web framework—as long as the final product is stable, intuitive, and easy to maintain. Please outline your proposed architecture, timeline, and any similar work you can point me to, and I’ll get back to you quickly.

jobs.title: Professional Crime Video Thumbnail
jobs.description:
I'm looking for a skilled designer to create a professional YouTube thumbnail for a crime-themed video. The design should be bold and colorful to grab viewers' attention.

Ideal skills and experience:
- Expertise in graphic design
- Experience with YouTube thumbnail creation

jobs.title: Kampala Apple Store Website
jobs.description:
I need a full-featured website built for my Apple products shop in Kampala, Uganda. The site should reflect the clean, premium feel of Apple while still speaking to our local audience. At minimum it must let visitors browse the latest iPhones, Macs, iPads and accessories, see clear pricing, and contact or locate us easily. If you can integrate secure online checkout as well, even better; I’m open to your recommendation on the best e-commerce platform for our market.

I will provide product photos, descriptions and pricing. You will handle everything else—from selecting and customizing a responsive theme, through setting up hosting, to going live. A simple, intuitive admin panel is essential so my team can add new devices or run promotions without needing a developer each time.

Core deliverables
• Design & develop a modern, mobile-friendly site branded for “Apple Shop Uganda”  
• Product catalogue pages with high-resolution images and spec tables  
• Store information section with Google Maps embed, phone/WhatsApp contact and opening hours  
• Basic SEO setup, speed optimisation and security hardening  
• Walk-through on how to update products and manage orders (video or live session)

Once the site is deployed and tested, I’ll need a brief period of support in case anything breaks during the first month. Please share relevant Apple- or tech-retail sites you have built so I can gauge your style and quality.

jobs.title: Informative UGC Video for Supplements
jobs.description:
I’m looking for a creator who can shoot and edit a user-generated-style video that showcases the health benefits of my nutritional supplement line. The finished piece should feel like authentic UGC while still carrying an informative, professional tone—think clear explanations, clean visuals, and confident on-camera delivery rather than a casual “vlog.”

Here’s what I have in mind:
• Length: 30–60 seconds, filmed vertically (1080 × 1920) so it can be dropped straight into TikTok, Reels, or Shorts.  
• Content focus: Brief intro of the product, a concise walkthrough of its key ingredients and the specific wellness benefits they provide, and a quick demonstration of how to take it.  
• Look & feel: Bright, well-lit home or lifestyle setting, steady framing, minimal props—let the bottle or sachet hold center stage.  
• Assets to deliver: Final MP4 file, burned-in captions, royalty-free background track, and the raw footage so I can create future cuts if needed.

I’ll provide the product, a short benefits sheet, and brand color codes. You handle script tweaks, filming, voice or on-screen narration, editing, and light color correction to keep everything consistent with our brand palette.

If you’re experienced in health or wellness content and can present scientific points in an engaging yet trustworthy way, let’s talk timings and shipping details so you can get started.

jobs.title: Commission-Only Monetisation Partner Needed
jobs.description:
I’m looking for a driven sales and marketing partner on a short- or long-term basis who will take full ownership of turning every aspect of https://www.nickdalephotography.com into a stronger revenue generator. All products and services are in scope—limited-edition wildlife prints, workshops, courses, one-to-one lessons and my books—so you’re free to focus wherever you see the quickest upside.

Here’s the deal: you work entirely on commission, and we split every pound of net revenue you bring in 50/50. I already sell via my own website and social channels and occasionally through art galleries. However, I haven’t scratched the surface of possibilities such as targeted email funnels, paid social, influencer collaborations, affiliate programmes or wider online marketplaces. You’ll be expected to find and cultivate those new channels, build your own lead lists and close the sales.  

Deliverables I need from you:  
• A clear go-to-market plan outlining which channels you’ll pursue first and why  
• Regular performance reports showing traffic, leads generated, conversion rates and revenue booked  
• Ongoing optimisation suggestions so we keep scaling what works  

If you thrive on performance-based rewards, have a track record of selling creative products online and relish the freedom to run with your own strategy, drop me a line and tell me how you’d boost my wildlife photography income.

jobs.title: كتابة مقالات تقنية PDF
jobs.description:
أريد تحويل أفكاري التقنية إلى مقالات عربية مُحترفة تُنشر بصيغة ‎PDF‎. كل مقال يجب أن يكون مكتوباً بلغة عربية سليمة وواضحة، يغطي الموضوع بعمق مناسب، ويقدّم للقارئ قيمة عملية مدعّمة بالأمثلة أو الإحصاءات الأحدث إن توفرت. يهمني أن تُراعى عناصر التنسيق الأساسية داخل الملف من عناوين فرعية، فهرس مبسط، وروابط قابلة للنقر عند الحاجة، مع إخراج نهائي نظيف وجاهز للتحميل أو الطباعة.

سأسلّم لك العناوين الرئيسية ونقاطاً تمهيدية لكل موضوع، وأعتمد عليك لبحث التفاصيل التقنية، صياغتها بأسلوب جذاب، ثم إعداد ملف ‎PDF‎ مصمم بشكل متناسق (يمكنك استخدام Word، ‎InDesign‎ أو أي أداة تفضّلها ما دام المنتج النهائي ‎PDF‎ عالي الدقة).

إذا كان لديك خبرة سابقة في تحرير المحتوى التقني بالعربية وإخراجه كوثيقة ‎PDF‎ احترافية، فسيساعدني الاطلاع على نموذج من عملك. سأراجع كل مقال للتأكد من الأصالة والدقة التقنية قبل اعتماده، ثم أرسل الملاحظات إن وُجدت لإجراء أي تعديل أخير.

jobs.title: Sustainability & Environmental Management

Sustainability and Environmental Management Project

jobs.title: Engaging Self-Improvement IG Copy
jobs.description:
I’m looking for a copywriter who can craft conversational, self-improvement themed captions that spark meaningful interaction on my Instagram feed. Each post should feel like friendly advice from someone who’s been there, blending practical growth tips with a warm, motivational tone that invites comments, shares, and saves.

Here’s what I need from you:  
• Punchy hooks that stop the scroll and frame a relatable challenge or insight.  
• Clear, actionable take-aways delivered in everyday language—no jargon.  
• Natural prompts or questions that encourage followers to join the conversation.  
• A voice consistent across every caption so the audience instantly recognizes the brand.

I’ll provide basic topic ideas and brand guidelines; you transform them into polished captions ready to pair with my visuals. If you’re comfortable weaving storytelling, psychology, and a dash of humor into concise Instagram copy, let’s talk and keep my community engaged.

jobs.title: Poster Promosi Produk Menarik
jobs.description:
Saya ingin sebuah desain grafis berupa poster untuk promosi produk. Poster ini akan dipakai di media sosial dan cetak, jadi tampilannya harus tetap tajam dalam kedua format.  

Rincian kebutuhan:

• Ukuran akhir A3 dengan versi rasio 1:1 untuk feed Instagram.  
• Sertakan ruang untuk logo, headline utama, deskripsi singkat, dan call-to-action.  
• Warna, gaya ilustrasi, dan tipografi harus selaras dengan identitas merek yang akan saya berikan setelah proyek dimulai.  
• File akhir: .ai atau .psd berserta PDF siap cetak dan PNG untuk web.  

Saya menghargai kreativitas, jadi silakan usulkan konsep visual yang segar namun tetap profesional. Setelah saya memilih konsep, mohon siapkan dua kali revisi ringan untuk memastikan hasil akhir sesuai harapan.

jobs.title: Square Magnetic Tile CAD Design
jobs.description:
I am developing a new magnetic-tile toy and need a clean, production-ready 3D model of a single square tile. I will supply the exact outer dimensions, wall thickness, magnet recess size and placement as soon as the project starts; your task is to translate those numbers into a precise STP file that can go straight to tooling.

Essential details  
• Shape: Square (no alternative shapes required)  
• Format: STEP (.stp) only—model must open flawlessly in SolidWorks / Fusion 360.  
• Functionality: internal cavities must accommodate standard neodymium magnets while maintaining uniform wall thickness for injection moulding.

Deliverables  
1. Parametric STP model of the square tile.  
2. A quick screen capture or PDF showing basic dimensions so I can double-check before sign-off.

Acceptance criteria  
• All edges perfectly align, with no gaps between shell and magnet pockets.  
• File passes import without errors in SolidWorks “Import Diagnostics.”  
• Dimensions match the figures I provide to within ±0.1 mm.

If you routinely design toy parts or have experience with magnetic-core plastics, let me know—otherwise solid CAD proficiency and an eye for manufacturability is all that’s required. Looking forward to collaborating on this simple but important piece of the set!

jobs.title: Blog Site Review & Strategy
jobs.description:
I have a live proof-of-concept blog at https://blog-nine-phi-30.vercel.app/ 

aimed squarely at the general public. Before I invest time and money turning it into a fully polished product, I want a fresh set of expert eyes to walk through every screen, note what works, what doesn’t, and spark ideas I may have missed.

Your first task is to explore the site in depth—structure, performance, UX, visual hierarchy, accessibility, and search-engine readiness. Because the blog format will remain the core feature, I’m especially interested in ways to make articles more engaging, scannable, and shareable while keeping load times low.

Once you have a clear picture, we’ll hop on chat so you can present your findings and brainstorm enhancements: new content angles, growth tactics, potential monetisation models, or even pivots such as layering in light user interaction down the road. I’m open to bold concepts as long as they stay true to a public-facing information hub.

Deliverables
• Written critique covering design, UX, performance, SEO, and content strategy  
• A concise action plan prioritised by impact vs. effort  
• A live chat (or recorded call) walking me through your recommendations

If you know your way around modern blog stacks—Next.js, Vercel, headless CMS, on-page SEO tools—your insight will be invaluable. I’m ready to start as soon as you are and keen to see where we can take this project together.

jobs.title: Professional Home Goods Descriptions
jobs.description:
I’m looking for a skilled copywriter to craft clear, engaging product descriptions for my line of home-goods items. Each description should:

• Highlight key features and benefits in a concise, reader-friendly way  
• Use a consistently professional tone that fits a quality home-living brand  
• Include naturally integrated keywords for basic on-page SEO without sounding forced  
• End with a subtle call-to-action that encourages purchase confidence

You’ll receive product details, photos, and any technical specs; your task is to turn that information into original copy that helps shoppers understand, trust, and ultimately buy the product. If this first batch goes well, I may expand the scope later to website content or blog posts, so clarity and reliability matter.

Please share a brief sample of similar work or a short excerpt that demonstrates your style for home décor or lifestyle products.

jobs.title: Construction Site Management App
jobs.description:
I need a cross-platform mobile application that works seamlessly on both Android and iPhone to keep every aspect of our construction sites in one place. Four clear user roles must be built in—Admin, Manager, Employee and Site Incharge—so each person only sees the tools and data relevant to them.

Core modules  
• Daily Site Activity: users create and assign tasks, see progress in real time and raise issues on the spot, complete with photos or notes.  
• Attendance & Wages: quick clock-in/clock-out with optional GPS tag, automatic wage calculation at day-end.  
• Monetary Tracking: record expenses, advances and any other cash movement against a project or task.  
• Inventory: log materials in and out, receive low-stock alerts and view current balances at a glance.

A single sign-on should take each role straight to its own dashboard while Admin retains full control over permissions, data export and basic analytics. Clean, intuitive screens are important because most users will be on site with limited time.

Deliverables  
• Production-ready Android (APK/AAB) and iOS (IPA/TestFlight) builds  
• Complete, well-commented source code and database schema  
• Basic admin panel or API documentation to manage data, users and roles  
• Short user guide so we can roll the app out quickly

Acceptance criteria  
• All four roles can log in and perform their specific actions without seeing restricted data.  
• Task scheduling, progress updates and issue reports sync correctly across devices.  
• Attendance entries feed directly into wage calculations with no manual edits.  
• Monetary and inventory records can be exported (CSV or Excel) for accounting.

I’m open to the framework you prefer—Flutter, React Native or similar—as long as the final product is stable, lightweight and easy for our team to maintain.

jobs.title: Website & Digital Marketing Package
jobs.description:
I’m ready to move my business online and I’m looking for a partner who can handle both the build and the promotion in one seamless project. First, I want a modern website—whether that ends up being a clean static site, a dynamic portal, an e-commerce store, or something completely custom, the key is that it looks great on every screen and loads fast. You’re free to choose the stack that best fits the brief; I’m comfortable with WordPress, Shopify, custom PHP, React, or any other proven framework so long as the final product is responsive and easy for me to update.

Once the site is live, I need an integrated digital marketing roll-out. Organic search rankings, social media visibility, Google Ads, Meta Ads, compelling content, and solid lead-gen funnels all matter to me. If you can plan the strategy, set up the tracking (Google Analytics, Search Console, Facebook Pixel, etc.), create the campaigns, and keep refining them for performance, we’ll be a great fit.

Deliverables I expect:
• Complete website design and development, fully tested and launched  
• On-page SEO fundamentals in place (meta tags, schema, speed optimisation)  
• Initial content or product uploads so the site goes live fully populated  
• Digital marketing strategy deck with timelines and KPIs  
• First wave of campaigns activated (SEO, chosen ad platforms, social channels)  
• Clear training or hand-off documents so I can manage minor updates myself

I’m aiming for quick iteration, transparent communication, and measurable results. If your portfolio shows solid builds and marketing wins, let’s talk timelines and milestones so we can get this rolling right away.

jobs.title: Customer Support Portal Build
jobs.description:
I need a web-based customer portal focused entirely on support so that both our existing and new customers can reach us quickly and track any issues in one place. The core of the portal will be two interactive features:

• Live chat that lets visitors speak with an agent in real time (please suggest proven chat SDKs or frameworks you have integrated before).  
• A ticket system where users can open, view, and update cases, with automated email notifications keeping them informed.

The look and feel should match our current branding, be fully responsive, and work smoothly on all modern browsers. Secure login, password reset, and basic role management for customers vs. agents will be required. I also want an intuitive admin area so our support team can assign, escalate, and close tickets without touching code.

Deliverables  
1. Deployed portal (front-end + back-end) on our chosen host.  
2. Source code in a Git repository with clear setup instructions.  
3. Brief hand-off guide showing how to add FAQ articles later, manage agents, and pull ticket reports.

If you have experience blending live chat and ticketing in one streamlined UI, include a link or screenshots in your proposal.

jobs.title: Modern Minimalist Logo Needed
jobs.description:
I’m launching the Jennifer  and need a sleek, modern-minimalist logo. Clean lines, restrained colour palettes and strong scalability are essential so the mark works everywhere—from tiny social-media avatars to large-format print.

Please submit:
• Primary logo in vector format (AI, EPS or SVG)  
• Horizontal and stacked variations  
• Black-on-white and white-on-black versions  
• A short note on fonts and colour codes used  

I’ll give fast, constructive feedback throughout the contest. The winning design must be 100 % original, versatile and production-ready for both digital and print use. I’m excited to see your best ideas!

jobs.title: Florida Residential Drainage Plan
jobs.description:
I need a sealed drainage plan that will satisfy Florida residential permitting requirements for a single-family lot. The parcel is in Florida, so the design must reference the relevant county stormwater ordinance, Florida Building Code, and any applicable FEMA flood-zone considerations.  

The end product should integrate cleanly into the overall site plan, showing surface grading, proposed inlets, pipe sizes, discharge points, and runoff calculations that demonstrate compliance with the allowable post-development flow rates. If you prefer to start from my survey and architectural footprint, I can supply the CAD files; if your workflow is different, let me know what formats you need and I will arrange them.

Deliverables I will need:
• Signed/sealed drainage plan sheet in PDF (24"×36") plus the native CAD file  
• Supporting hydrologic/hydraulic calculations in PDF  
• Brief memo summarizing assumptions, design criteria, and maintenance notes  

Please confirm your familiarity with Florida residential stormwater standards and give me an estimated turnaround time for the first draft and any expected revisions.

jobs.title: Plywood CNC Laser STEP Design
jobs.description:
I’ve sketched a small project that I’d like to run on a CNC laser cutter and now need a clean, production-ready STEP file. The material will be plywood, so you can assume the layout should suit laser-cut sheet stock and account for typical kerf on wood.  

You’ll take my rough dimensions and translate them into a single, accurate 3D model with every profile closed and ready to nest. I’m happy to provide a PDF or hand-drawn diagram—whichever makes it easiest for you to nail the geometry. Once done, you’ll send back:

• The finished STEP file, organised on one plane for laser cutting  
• A quick preview image so I can confirm everything before I head to the shop  

Please keep corner fillets, tabs, and any recommended joinery in mind for plywood. If you spot a tweak that would improve strength or cut quality, let me know—I appreciate the insight.

jobs.title: Transcribe Handwritten Notes to Word
jobs.description:
I have a set of handwritten notes that need to be recreated inside Microsoft Word. Every page contains both standard text and mathematical symbols, so the finished file must mirror the original layout line-for-line while faithfully rendering each equation.  
Accuracy is critical: spacing, headings, underlines, and any other visual cues should appear exactly as they do on the paper copy. You are free to use Word’s built-in Equation Editor (or MathType if you prefer) as long as the result remains fully editable within the .docx file.

Deliverable  
• One Word document (.docx) that precisely reproduces all pages, including every mathematical symbol, with no loss of formatting.

jobs.title: Website Enhancement and SEO Imrovement
jobs.description:
Need a Web Designer & SEO Expert to Improve My Website

MY WEBSITE https://blog-nine-phi-30.vercel.app/

I already have a website, and I am looking for an experienced freelancer who can make my website more professional, modern, attractive, and user-friendly.

Work Required

Improve the overall website look and feel

Improve colors, typography, spacing, buttons, cards, and sections
Make the website fully responsive for mobile, tablet, and desktop

Freelancer Requirements

jobs.title: Resolve WP Real Estate Plugin Conflict
jobs.description:
My WordPress real-estate site is acting up after the last update to the page-builder plugin, and I need an experienced hand to track down and clear the conflict so everything runs smoothly again.

Here’s what I know so far: the front-end property pages sometimes fail to load, widget areas vanish in the editor, and a few shortcodes no longer render. Disabling the page-builder restores basic functionality, so the clash is clearly between that plugin and either the active real-estate tools or my custom theme tweaks. I’m not after a temporary band-aid—I want the underlying compatibility issue identified, fixed, and future-proofed.

What I’d like from you:
• Clone the site to a staging environment, reproduce the problem, then isolate the conflicting files, hooks, or scripts.  
• Fix the product detail page information just like realtor.com by aligning and adjusting width. Need to make the site responsive
• Add translation english/thai/japan/middle east/ Russian- wpml
• Fix signup/login to be used on mobile 
• Update all plugins, page builders, PHP, WP, etc. 
• Make sure that admin can upload product  and search is linked 
• Patch or refactor as needed (child theme edits, plugin settings, or custom code overrides) without disrupting existing listings, search filters, or lead-capture forms.  
• Optimise and retest page speed once the conflict is resolved so the fix doesn’t introduce new performance hits.  
• Hand back a concise change log and any recommendations for version-locking or safe update workflows.

Please reply with a brief rundown of similar WordPress troubleshooting you’ve done—especially if you’ve wrangled page-builder conflicts in a real-estate context. I’m ready to give immediate access to the server and expect quick turnaround, so let me know your earliest availability.

jobs.title: Data entry
jobs.description:
I am looking for a freelancer to assist with a data entry project. The ideal candidate should have experience in creating a format or template for data entry tasks. 

Specific requirements for the project include:
- Creating a format or template for data entry
- Entering textual data into the provided format or template
- Handling a medium-sized dataset, which consists of 500-1000 entries

Skills and experience required:
- Proficiency in data entry and data management
- Attention to detail and accuracy in entering textual data
- Ability to create a format or template for data entry tasks
- Experience in handling medium-sized datasets

If you are interested in this project, please provide examples of your previous work in data entry and your proposed approach for creating the format or template.

jobs.title: Custom Website Development Needed
jobs.description:
I’m looking for a skilled developer who can take my vision for a fully custom website and turn it into a polished, production-ready reality. The site must be built from the ground up—no off-the-shelf templates—so that every page, component, and interaction aligns perfectly with my brand.  

Key expectations  
• Modern, responsive layout that performs smoothly on desktop, tablet, and mobile  
• Clean, well-documented code that I can maintain and extend over time  
• Scalable architecture, leaving room to add features such as user authentication, a CMS, or online payments when the business grows  
• Fast load times and solid SEO foundations (semantic HTML, meta tags, schema where relevant)  

Deliverables  
1. Working website deployed to my hosting environment  
2. All source files and assets in an easy-to-navigate repository  
3. Brief hand-off guide covering build tools, framework versions, and update procedures  

Once the final site is live and verified across major browsers, I’ll sign off on the project. If this sounds like a build you’re confident handling, let’s discuss the tech stack, timeline, and milestones.

jobs.title: Malaysia Pharma B2B Sales Closer
jobs.description:
I am preparing to launch a high-value line of pharmaceutical products into the Malaysian market and need a proven B2B seller who can turn board-room interest into signed purchase orders. Our buyers sit inside hospitals, private medical centres, group purchasing organisations and large pharmacy chains, so you must already understand how decisions are made in Malaysian healthcare and be comfortable navigating tender procedures, formulary committees and multi-step approval flows.  

Your day-to-day work will centre on identifying the right decision makers, opening conversations that focus on clinical benefit and cost efficiency, handling every objection, and ultimately closing contracts worth six and even seven figures. Fluency in Bahasa Malaysia and English, plus an existing network in hospital procurement, will let you hit the ground running. CRM discipline, clear weekly pipeline updates and tight follow-through are essential, because our internal team will use your data to plan stock and regulatory activity.  

Deliverables  
• Weekly report summarising outreach, active opportunities and next actions  
• Minimum five new qualified hospital or GPO opportunities added to the funnel each month  
• Signed supply agreements or purchase orders that meet the agreed quarterly revenue target  

I can provide full product dossiers, clinical papers, and price structures; you bring the relationships and closing skills needed to make this launch a commercial success.

jobs.title: Animated Mental Health Awareness Video Series
jobs.description:
We are Techfest IIT Bombay — Asia's largest science and technology festival — building a free animated mental health awareness video series called SPEAK for Indian students aged 16 to 26, launching on World Mental Health Day, October 10.

We need an animator or doodler to produce 4 short animated episodes of 3 to 4 minutes each. The videos address mental health awareness — breaking stigma, recognising signs, and guiding students toward help. The tone is warm, casual, occasionally humorous, and India-specific. Think explainer animation meets relatable storytelling — not clinical, not corporate.

What we are looking for:

Experience in 2D animation, motion graphics, whiteboard animation, or doodle-style explainer videos
Ability to create visually engaging, story-driven content for a youth audience
Familiarity with Indian cultural context
Clean, modern visual style with character animation capability
Hindi or Hinglish friendly visuals are a bonus

What we will provide:

Complete scripts and storyboards
Brand colours and style references
Clear feedback at every stage

This is a meaningful social initiative with IIT Bombay's backing. Your work will be seen by 50,000+ students across India on launch day. Credit and portfolio rights included.

 Please share your portfolio and a brief note on your animation style when applying.

jobs.title: Data Preprocessing & Model Development
jobs.description:
I have several CSV files filled with raw text that need to be transformed into something my business can actually use. First, I need a solid data-cleaning and preprocessing pipeline: removing noise, normalising case, handling missing or corrupt rows, tokenising, and producing features that make sense for downstream modelling. Once the data quality is reliable, I want a working machine-learning model built on top of it—preferably in Python using well-established libraries such as pandas, scikit-learn, spaCy or a comparable NLP stack.  

Here is what will let me sign off on the job:

• A reproducible script or notebook that takes the original CSV files, cleans them, and outputs a tidy, feature-ready dataset.  
• A trained text-based model (classification or clustering—I'll decide with you after an initial review of the data) with clear performance metrics and a brief explanation of how you tuned it.  
• A short read-me or comments in the code that explain each step so I can maintain or extend the pipeline later.

If you can turn messy text in CSVs into an accurate, well-documented model, I’m ready to get started.

jobs.title: 4-Page Promotional Brochure
jobs.description:
I need a four-page brochure that promotes our brand to potential customers. The piece should feel energetic, modern, and immediately communicate who we are, what we do, and why we matter—using mostly company information I will supply.  

Layout & design
• Page flow: front cover, inside spread, back cover, all visually cohesive  
• Colour palette and typography must match our current brand guidelines (fonts, HEX codes and a recent style guide will be provided).  
• High-resolution imagery, iconography and subtle graphical accents are welcome where they strengthen the story.

Content
Final text is almost ready; it profiles our history, mission, and key capabilities. Product descriptions or customer testimonials might be added in a future revision, so leave room for small copy blocks that can expand or contract without breaking the grid.

Technical specs
• Print-ready PDF, CMYK, 300 dpi, 3 mm bleed and crop marks  
• Editable source file (InDesign .INDD preferred; Illustrator .AI acceptable) with linked images and fonts packaged

Timing & hand-off
First draft layout within five days of project award, followed by two rounds of refinement. When the final file passes my pre-press check, the project is complete.

If you have recent brochure samples that demonstrate clean, promotional layouts aimed at new customers, that will help me gauge fit quickly.

jobs.title: Excel Order Status Entry
jobs.description:
I have a running list of customer orders and need a dependable pair of hands to mark each one as “Order received” in an Excel file I’ll share. Every afternoon I’ll email you a simple table that contains the day’s new order numbers; your job is to copy those numbers straight into the spreadsheet and tick the corresponding status column.  

Accuracy is everything—each line has to match exactly so our downstream processing stays clean. Turn-around should be same-day (within a few hours of my email) so the team always has an up-to-date view. If this first phase goes smoothly, I may extend the work to include further stages such as “Order processing” or “Order shipped,” but for now the scope is limited to the “Order received” flag only.  

Deliverable:  
• Updated Excel file returned (or saved to the shared drive) with every supplied order correctly tagged “Order received.”

jobs.title: Multi-Platform Personal Profile Revamp
jobs.description:
I want to walk away with a set of fully refreshed public profiles that all tell the same story—clearly, confidently, and with a look that feels unmistakably mine. My current pages on LinkedIn, GitHub, Instagram, and Facebook are active but inconsistent. I need you to weave them together into one coherent presence by:  

• rewriting and refining the bio sections so they align in voice and key messaging  
• tightening profile details (headline, job titles, skills, contact links) for easy scan-ability and SEO value  
• recommending a lightweight personal brand guide—tone, colour palette, fonts, image style—to keep every platform visually in sync  
• polishing layout and media placement so each page looks inviting at first glance  

Please deliver updated copy in an editable format, a short branding cheatsheet, and a single set of resized profile/cover images ready to upload. I’m looking for a balance of professionalism and creativity, so showcase past profile makeovers or brand-tone projects if you have them. Let’s make my digital first impression unforgettable.

jobs.title: Website Build with Integrations
jobs.description:
I’m ready to get a brand-new website online and need the full build handled for me—from setting up the pages to wiring in the tools that keep a modern site running smoothly.

The non-negotiables:
• Payment gateways must be fully integrated so visitors can check out without friction, including test transactions before launch.
• Live social-media feeds (Facebook, Instagram, X, or whichever API you recommend) should stream directly onto the site, updating automatically.
• My email-marketing platform needs to connect to every relevant form, triggering the correct list, tag, or automation.

I’m flexible on the overall design and CMS; if WordPress, Shopify, Webflow, or something else suits the brief better, let’s discuss why. What matters is a responsive, quick-loading site that I can update easily once you hand it over.

Deliverables
1. Complete website build on the agreed platform, fully responsive and SEO-ready.  
2. Working integrations for payments, social feeds, and email marketing, demonstrated on a staging link.  
3. Post-launch support window to catch any integration hiccups.  
4. Clear hand-off: admin credentials, documentation, and a quick walk-through video.

If you have a portfolio that proves you’ve connected these exact pieces before, even better. Let me know your proposed tech stack, timeline, and any questions you need answered to lock down scope, and we can kick things off right away.

jobs.title: Sales-Focused Facebook Ads Campaign
jobs.description:
I need a complete Facebook Ads strategy that turns clicks into paying clients for my professional-services business. The objective is straightforward: measurable sales growth, not just traffic or likes.

You will take the campaign from concept to continual optimisation. That means researching high-intent audiences, structuring campaigns inside Ads Manager for maximum conversion, writing persuasive copy that speaks to decision-makers, and pairing it with scroll-stopping creatives. Conversion tracking through the Meta Pixel and event setup is essential so every ad dollar is tied to real revenue.

Deliverables I expect:
• Audience research summary and proposed targeting  
• Campaign build (ad sets, ads, conversion events) ready to launch  
• Two rounds of creative/copy revisions before go-live  
• Ongoing optimisation reports with ROAS, CPA and recommendations for scaling

Success is defined by consistent cost-per-acquisition that meets or beats current figures and a clear uplift in booked services.

jobs.title: สร้างเนื้อหาและทันสมัย
jobs.description:
ฉันต้องการงานสองส่วนที่สอดประสานกัน ได้แก่  

1. งานเขียน – ข้อความสั้น ๆ ที่จะใช้สื่อสารตัวตนของแบรนด์ เช่น สโลแกน เกริ่นนำ “เกี่ยวกับเรา” หรือข้อความโปรโมตหน้าหลัก ให้ภาษากระชับ ชัดเจน และเข้ากับกลุ่มเป้าหมายยุคใหม่  

2. งานออกแบบโลโก้ – โลโก้สไตล์ทันสมัย โดยกำหนดให้ “สีดำ” เป็นโทนหลัก สามารถผสานเฉดเทาหรือเว้นที่ว่าง (negative space) เพื่อเพิ่มมิติได้ตามความเหมาะสม

jobs.title: Live Chat Support Specialist Needed
jobs.description:
I need a reliable representative who can sit at the frontline of our website and handle all incoming customer questions through Zendesk Chat. Your sole focus will be to greet visitors, understand what they need, and give clear, concise answers in real time.  

You’ll be working inside our existing Zendesk workspace, so prior familiarity with shortcuts, macros, and tagging is highly valued. Speed and accuracy matter: customers expect a first reply in under one minute and a complete, helpful solution in the same conversation whenever possible.  

The role does not involve phone calls or email tickets at this stage, but I appreciate a candidate who is flexible enough to expand into those channels as we grow. For now, success is measured by chat satisfaction scores, resolution rate, and your ability to keep the knowledge base up to date when you notice gaps.  

Typical shift coverage is 9 am–5 pm GMT, Monday to Friday. If you already have experience juggling multiple chats at once and can write friendly, mistake-free English, you’ll fit in perfectly. Let me know about similar Zendesk Chat projects you’ve handled and how you maintained high CSAT scores; that will help me make a quick decision.

jobs.title: Consumer Electronics Battery Troubleshooting
jobs.description:
I need a seasoned electronics professional to methodically test and troubleshoot a consumer-grade device that is showing persistent battery-related problems. The unit fails to hold charge consistently and occasionally shuts down without warning, so I want a clear diagnosis of the underlying circuitry and a practical repair or redesign recommendation.

Here is what I expect:  
• Bench-level testing of the power stage, charging circuit, and protection ICs  
• Identification of faulty components or design flaws causing the battery issue  
• A concise report summarising test procedures, measured results (voltage, current draw, ripple, thermal behaviour), root-cause analysis, and proposed corrective measures  
• Optional: firmware review if the fault points to power-management code interactions

You may use oscilloscopes, multimeters, electronic loads, battery analysers, and any other specialised tools you deem necessary. Deliver all findings in an editable document plus annotated schematics or scope captures where relevant. If replacement parts or layout changes are required, specify them clearly so I can authorise the next step quickly.

Timely communication, precise measurements, and evidence-based conclusions will be the key acceptance criteria for this engagement.

jobs.title: Printful Setup: 3 Products, 5 Designs
jobs.description:
I need somebody who can jump straight into my Printful dashboard and publish three distinct products—caps, hoodies and T-shirts—each in five design variations. All artwork is ready to upload and combines graphics with text, so there’s no design creation required; this is purely a setup job.

Speed matters. I’d like the listings configured today if possible, with clean mock-ups, correct sizing and colour variants, and any necessary tweaks to ensure they push live without errors.

Deliverables:
• 15 finished product variants (3 products × 5 designs) in my Printful account  
• High-quality mock-ups auto-generated for each listing  
• Confirmation that every item is active and visible in the store dashboard

If you’re already comfortable navigating Printful, this should be a quick win. Let me know your turnaround time and we can get started right away.

jobs.title: Education Guidance Website Development
jobs.description:
I am looking for a professional web designer/developer to create a modern, responsive and trustworthy website for our Education & Career Guidance initiative.

Our purpose is to provide students with educational guidance, career guidance, exam information, study resources and general consultation. We want the website to look professional and trustworthy for both students and parents.

Required Pages:

1. Home

* Attractive hero section with a clear headline
* Introduction about our initiative
* Education and career guidance highlights
* Popular career/course categories
* Student resources
* Why choose us
* Call-to-action for students/parents
* WhatsApp/contact button

2. About Us

* About our organization
* Our purpose and mission
* What kind of guidance we provide
* Why students can trust us

3. Guidance / Services

* Career guidance
* Education/course guidance
* Exam guidance
* Study planning and resources
* General student consultation
* Each service should have a clear description

4. Resources / Study Materials

* Notes and study materials
* Important questions
* Previous-year questions
* Exam-related information
* Content should be easy to update in the future

5. Contact Us

* Phone number
* WhatsApp
* Email
* Contact/inquiry form
* Social media links
* Location/map if required

Design Requirements:

* Modern, clean and professional design
* Student-friendly appearance
* Fully responsive for mobile, tablet and desktop
* Fast loading
* Easy navigation
* Professional animations where appropriate
* SEO-friendly structure
* Secure and well-organized code
* Easy to maintain and update
* WhatsApp integration

Important:
We currently provide guidance and consultation to students and do not charge students any fees. The website should clearly present us as an education and career guidance initiative and should not create any misleading impression.

Deliverables:

* Complete 5-page responsive website
* Modern UI/UX design
* Mobile, tablet and desktop layouts
* Contact/inquiry form
* WhatsApp integration
* Basic SEO setup
* Source code/files
* Final testing and bug fixing
* Deployment assistance
* Easy-to-maintain structure

Please provide:

1. 2–3 examples of similar education/career guidance websites you have designed.
2. Total project cost.
3. Estimated completion time.
4. What hosting/domain requirements we need.
5. Whether you will provide the source code and admin/content editing option.
6. Any additional maintenance charges.

We are looking for a professional website that can be expanded in the future as our student guidance platform grows.

jobs.title: Advanced Cross-Platform Content Editor
jobs.description:
I’m building an all-in-one content editor that lets users create, edit, and preview text, images, and video from the same interface. The application must run smoothly on both desktop (Windows/macOS; think Electron, WPF, or Qt) and mobile (iOS + Android via React Native, Flutter, or native SDKs). A future web version is possible, so clean, modular code is important.

Core text capabilities need to feel professional: real-time syntax highlighting for multiple languages, rich-text formatting (headings, links, tables, inline media), and an unobtrusive spell checker with multi-language dictionaries. Image tools should cover basic crop, resize, and metadata editing. Video handling can be limited to trimming, thumbnail capture, and playback preview for now.

Deliverables
• Source code and build instructions for desktop and mobile targets  
• A polished UI/UX that mirrors features across platforms  
• Documentation and an API or plugin system so new content types can be added later  
• Quick test suite or demo scripts showing syntax highlighting, formatting, and media editing working together  

Acceptance criteria
1. Editor opens a mixed-content document on desktop and mobile without feature loss.  
2. Syntax highlighting, rich-text commands, and spell check respond in <100 ms on a 10-page document.  
3. Image crop and video trim export correctly and remain linked in the document.  
4. Code passes linting/tests and compiles with one command per platform.  

If something in the scope seems unclear, highlight it early so we can refine before development starts.

jobs.title: Reddit Promotion Text Post & Comment
jobs.description:
I want to put my offer in front of the right Reddit audience without sounding like an ad. What I need from you is a well-crafted text post whose primary purpose is clear, subtle promotion, plus a natural-sounding top-level comment that helps the thread gain early traction.

Here’s what will make the work a success:
• A text post (title + body) written in Reddit’s conversational style, tailored to the tone of a relevant subreddit.  
• One engaging follow-up comment that I can drop under the post to spark discussion and keep the promotion organic.  
• Copy that stays within Reddit rules—no spammy phrasing, no hard sells—while still highlighting the offer’s value.  

I’ll provide product details, target subreddit(s), and any links I need included. You hand back the ready-to-paste post and comment, plus a brief note explaining your approach so I understand how best to deploy them.

jobs.title: YouTube Business Case Study Editor
jobs.description:
I'm looking for an experienced YouTube editor to create engaging business case study videos. 

Key Requirements:
- Edit videos specifically for business case studies
- Incorporate data analysis insights, real-world examples, and visual aids like charts and graphs
- Craft a professional, polished final product suitable for a business audience

Ideal Skills and Experience:
- Proficiency in video editing software (e.g., Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, DaVinci Resolve)
- Strong understanding of data visualization and analysis
- Experience in creating content for a professional or business-oriented YouTube channel
- Attention to detail and ability to work within a specified budget

jobs.title: Personal Web Development Project
jobs.description:
PHP & Web Developer Needed for Personal Project
Project Overview
I’m looking for a talented and reliable PHP Developer / Web Developer to help me build and improve a personal project.

This is not a job for an agency. I’m looking for an individual freelancer who can collaborate directly with me and, if we work well together, potentially build a long-term working relationship.

The project will be built from the ground up with a focus on creating something useful, fast, secure, and scalable. The project may involve new features, ongoing improvements, maintenance, and performance optimization over time.

What I Need Help With
PHP Development
Core PHP / OOPs
Laravel / CodeIgniter preferred
MySQL / Database design
API development and integration
Bug fixing and performance optimization
Web Development
HTML, CSS, JavaScript, jQuery
Responsive and modern UI development
WordPress / Custom websites
Theme / plugin customization
Third-party API integrations
What I’m Looking For
I’m looking for someone who:

Clearly understands project requirements and communicates well
Writes clean, maintainable, and well-structured code
Delivers work on time and provides regular updates
Can suggest improvements and solutions based on their experience
Is reliable, responsible, and detail-oriented
Is interested in a potential long-term collaboration
Experience and good suggestions are always welcome. I value a freelancer who can bring their own expertise to the project rather than simply following instructions.

About the Project
This is a personal project that I’m building from the ground up. The goal is to create something useful, fast, secure, and scalable.

The project may include new features, improvements, integrations, bug fixes, and ongoing maintenance as it develops.

Working Relationship
I believe in respect, trust, transparency, and fair pay.

If we’re a good fit, you can expect consistent work and on-time payments.


Please send me:

A short introduction about yourself
Your experience and key skills
Links to your previous work / portfolio
Your hourly rate or preferred project rate
Your availability
A brief explanation of why you think you would be a good fit for this project
I’m looking forward to finding the right freelancer to build something awesome together!

jobs.title: Swahili Audio Transcription Project
jobs.description:
I have a batch of recordings in Tanzanian Swahili that must be transcribed verbatim as part of “Project PW.” All work is fully remote; you simply download the audio, deliver clean, well-formatted text, and upload it back to the shared drive.

Accuracy is critical. Conversation fillers, pauses, and speaker changes need to be captured precisely, and any inaudible sections should be time-stamped so I can review them later. I will provide a short style guide before we begin so you know exactly how to mark timestamps, speaker labels, and background noise.

Deliverables  
• A separate UTF-8 text or Word file for each assigned recording  
• Verbatim Swahili transcript with correct spelling and punctuation  
• Timestamps for any unclear or inaudible portions  

Before assigning the full batch, I will send one short file (about three minutes) to confirm we are on the same page stylistically. Once that sample is approved, I will release the remaining audio in manageable sets and keep a rolling deadline schedule so the workload stays predictable.

If you are a native-level Swahili speaker with solid transcription experience and a reliable internet connection, let’s get started.

jobs.title: Reddit Community Engagement Assistant
jobs.description:

Deliverables

jobs.title: Marketing Expert for Roblox Game Promotion

jobs.title: Salon App Ad Tracking Setup
jobs.description:
I need a specialist who can take my salon’s mobile app from zero tracking to fully-optimised acquisition. The core goal is simple: more confirmed bookings. To make that happen, you’ll create new ad accounts for Facebook, Instagram and Google Ads, connect them properly to the app, and prove that conversion events are firing.

jobs.title: Survey Participants: Digital Ad Trust

jobs.title: 2D/3D Kitchen Drafting Partner
jobs.description:
I’m looking for someone who can slip straight into my workflow and turn kitchen & joinery concepts into fully documented construction packages. You’ll be preparing dimensioned plans, elevations, sections and occasional 3D views that a cabinetmaker can send straight to the floor.  

Experience with auto as/palletCAD is a bonus  so fluency in either (or both) is essential for smooth file exchange. If you prefer to rough-out ideas in SketchUp or Revit first, that’s fine as long as the final deliverables arrive in clean, organised DWG/DXF format.  

Most of the projects follow Australian cabinetry standards—shared panels, 16 mm carcasses, adjustable kick heights etc.—so prior experience with local hardware and clearances will give you a head start. When that’s missing, solid drafting fundamentals and the ability to absorb my reference packs quickly will work just as well.  

Here’s how we’ll collaborate: I provide site measurements, appliance schedules and a design brief; you return a set of shop drawings ready for CNC, plus an itemised parts list when requested. Turn-around is typically three to five days per kitchen, and there’s a steady pipeline waiting for the right drafter.  

When you respond, focus on your relevant experience—particularly any built-in or custom joinery you’ve detailed in AutoCAD or PalletCAD. A couple of drawing samples that show your annotation style and level of detail will help me gauge fit immediately.  

If you value clear communication, reliable deadlines and ongoing work, let’s talk.

jobs.title: Youth Mental Health Awareness Booklet

jobs.title: AdSense Approval for Business Website

jobs.title: Social Media Ad Campaign Creation -- 2

jobs.title: SEO Health Blog Writer Needed -- 2
