jobs.title: Bittersweet Forbidden City Romance
jobs.description:
I’m commissioning a complete romance manuscript set in a present-day cityscape. The core of the plot must revolve around a forbidden love—whether the barrier is cultural, professional, or rooted in family expectations is up to your creative angle, but it needs to feel believable and grounded in today’s urban life.  

Please keep the tone suitable for a general audience (PG-13 at most). I want layered, relatable characters whose choices carry genuine emotional stakes, crisp dialogue that reflects modern sensibilities, and vivid city details that make the setting feel alive without overshadowing the romance. The story should close on a bittersweet note: hope mingled with loss, so readers feel both satisfaction and an ache that lingers after the final page.  

Deliverables  
• Full story manuscript in an editable format (Word or Google Doc).  
• A short marketing blurb (150–200 words).  
• Optional chapter titles if you structure the narrative in sections.  

Acceptance criteria  
• Clear modern-day city setting woven naturally into scenes.  
• Central relationship fits the “forbidden love” theme and drives the plot.  
• Bittersweet ending—no full tragedy, no neat fairy-tale wrap-up.  
• Proofread prose, free of major grammar or spelling errors.  

If you have samples in the contemporary romance genre, feel free to share so I can get a sense of your voice before we begin.

jobs.title: Lead-Nurture Call Support

If you have samples of previous beauty-related posts, especially copy written in more than one language, include the links so I can see your style. I’m aiming for a long-term collaboration with someone who understands the nuances of skincare, makeup, and the Instagram algorithm.

jobs.title: Technical Co-Founder / Backend Ops for Growing Consultation Business — Profit Share Model

Meta Pixel / conversion tracking accuracy

jobs.title: Indoor Navigation System Development
jobs.description:
Hi, I’m looking for a developer/team who can help us build a **real-time indoor navigation system**.

The main requirement is:

* Convert existing **CAD/PDF/floor plans into a structured 2D/3D indoor map**
* Support **multiple floors**
* Implement **BLE beacon-based indoor positioning**
* Use **BLE + accelerometer + gyroscope + compass** for accurate positioning
* Show the user’s **real-time location and direction** on the map
* Provide **turn-by-turn indoor navigation**
* Calculate the best route between two points
* Support **stairs, elevators, escalators, gates, corridors, rooms, etc.**
* Provide **dynamic rerouting** if the user moves away from the planned route
* Develop the navigation engine/API/SDK so it can later be integrated into an **Android application**

This is intended for a large indoor environment  so accuracy, scalability, multi-floor navigation, and real-time positioning are important.

Please let me know:

1. Have you worked on similar indoor navigation projects?
2. What technology/SDK would you recommend?
3. How would you implement BLE positioning?
4. What accuracy can you realistically achieve?
5. What information/data would you need from our side?
6. Estimated development timeline and cost?

I can share the detailed technical requirements and floor plans once we confirm the approach.

jobs.title: Reliable Long-Term Virtual Assistant

- Honest, dependable and trustworthy

jobs.title: Publish Company Page on Wikipedia

jobs.title: Vendedor Odoo con cierres efectivos bajo comisión por venta

jobs.title: Dark Fantasy Artist for Trading Card Game
jobs.description:
Fantasy / Creature Artist Wanted for Original Trading Card Game
About the Project

I am currently developing an original physical trading card game and am looking for an artist who would be interested in becoming the main artist behind the game's creatures and visual identity.

The project is currently in the prototype and playtesting stage, and I am now beginning to develop the artwork and visual direction for the game.

I'm looking for someone who enjoys dark fantasy, monsters, creatures and atmospheric environments and would be excited to help develop an original world from the ground up.

This is intended to be a creative collaboration/commission-based project, rather than a traditional employment position.

The Art Style

I'm looking for artwork with a strong dark fantasy / gothic fantasy atmosphere.

Some general references for the level of visual quality and presentation I'm interested in would be the creature artwork seen in games such as:

Pokémon TCG
One Piece Card Game
Magic: The Gathering
Legends of Runeterra

These are references for quality and presentation only. I am looking for an original artistic style and do not want existing artwork copied.

The artwork should ideally feel:

Dark
Mysterious
Atmospheric
Magical
Slightly unsettling
Creature-focused
Detailed but visually clear

I'd like the creatures to feel as though they belong to the same world, while still having their own personality and identity.

The Creatures

The game will contain a variety of original creatures inspired by dark fantasy mythology and folklore.

Some examples include creatures such as:

Hydra
Gargoyle
Pixie
Other original fantasy creatures

There will be a much larger roster developed over time, so I'm particularly interested in an artist who enjoys creature design and illustration.

I'm also open to an artist bringing their own creative ideas to the designs rather than simply illustrating exactly what I provide.

What I'm Looking For

I would primarily need finished creature illustrations that can eventually be used on physical trading cards.

The artwork should generally:

Be portrait-oriented
Have a strong focal point
Include an atmospheric environment/background
Work well when placed inside a trading-card frame
Be high enough resolution for physical printing

I will provide the creature concept, references and general direction for each piece.

However, I would love to work with an artist who can interpret the concept creatively and add their own artistic personality to it.

Starting With a Test Illustration

I would like to begin with one creature illustration.

This is simply to see whether our artistic styles and ideas work well together.

If everything works out, I would like to continue commissioning additional creatures for the game.

The project will eventually require artwork for a larger collection of creatures, cards and promotional material.

Who I'm Looking For

I'm especially interested in artists who:

Love drawing monsters and creatures
Enjoy dark fantasy
Have experience with TCG or fantasy artwork
Can create atmospheric environments
Have a strong personal art style
Are comfortable developing original creature designs
Are interested in contributing creatively to a growing project

You don't necessarily need previous TCG experience if your creature artwork is excellent.

If You're Interested

Please send me:

1. Your portfolio

Especially creature, monster, fantasy or dark-fantasy artwork.

2. A little about yourself

Tell me what kind of artwork you enjoy creating and what inspires you.

3. Your preferred working process

I'd like to understand how you normally approach a commission, from concept → sketch → final artwork.

4. Your availability

This isn't intended to be a full-time position. I'm looking for someone who would enjoy working on individual pieces as the project develops.

jobs.title: WooCommerce Orders & Customers Migration

jobs.title: Build a Complete Airbnb/Booking.com Direct Booking Website with PMS & Channel Manager Integration

NOMA III – Smart Urban Stay
Tirana, Albania

Real-time availability calendar.

Number of guests.
Automatic price calculation.
Direct reservation from the website.

Automatic notification to the administrator.

Visa
Mastercard

Secure payment gateway integration.
SSL/HTTPS.

Prices
Seasonal prices
Availability
Minimum stay
Photos
Property description
Amenities
Website content
Promotions/discounts
Reservations
Guest information

I am not a developer, so after completion the website must be manageable without editing code.

5. Languages

The website must initially support:

English + Albanian

6. Property Pages

The website should include:

Home
Accommodation / Stay
Gallery
Amenities
Location
About NOMA
Direct Booking
Contact
FAQ
House Rules
Privacy Policy
Terms & Conditions
Cancellation Policy

The website should include:

WhatsApp button
Contact form
Automatic booking confirmation email
Pre-arrival information
Check-in instructions capability

The website should therefore be built so that I can easily replace/add professional property photos when they are ready.

9. Mobile & Performance

The website must be:

Fully responsive
Mobile-first
Fast loading
Optimized for iPhone/Android
SEO-friendly
Optimized for Google
Google Analytics ready
Google Search Console ready

Basic technical SEO should be completed before delivery.

10. Domain & Hosting

I need assistance with:

Domain configuration
Hosting
SSL certificate
Professional email setup if required
DNS configuration
Website deployment

I want the website fully deployed and working, not simply source code/files delivered to me.

Important

jobs.title: sh7play SEO Overhaul

jobs.title: Web-based Digital Twin 3D Visualization
jobs.description:
Hi Dear,

I’m looking for a web-based 3D Digital Twin / interactive 3D visualization POC for a cloud-based BMS platform.

The client already collects HVAC data through BACnet/IP, Modbus, MQTT and LoRaWAN, and exposes normalized data to northbound applications through REST API or MQTT.

Initial POC: AHU

We need a detailed AHU 3D model rendered inside a browser using Three.js/WebGL or an appropriate web 3D technology, preferably optimized GLB/GLTF.

The model must be data-driven, not just a static 3D viewer.

The BMS JSON contains:

* Supply/return/mixed/outdoor air temperature
* CHW supply/return temperature
* Humidity, filter DP, duct static pressure, CO₂
* CHW/heating valve position %
* Supply/return fan VFD speed
* Outdoor/return/exhaust damper position
* Fan ON/OFF status
* VFD faults
* Smoke/freeze/filter alarms
* Fan start/stop and damper commands

Required behaviour

JSON values must dynamically control the 3D model.

Examples:

VFD speed → fan animation speed
Valve % → valve position
Damper % → damper angle
Fan status → fan ON/OFF
Alarm/fault → visual alarm state
Temperature/pressure/humidity/CO₂ → live UI values

For the POC, simulated JSON is sufficient, but the architecture should later support the client's REST API/MQTT.

Reusability

This must be designed as a reusable framework for:

AHU, Chiller, Cooling Tower, Pumps, VAV, VRF, STP and other HVAC/Energy/Water equipment.

We want parameter-to-object/animation mapping to be configurable wherever practical rather than hard-coded for one AHU.

POC deliverables

1. Browser-based interactive 3D AHU
2. GLB/GLTF support
3. JSON-driven parameter mapping
4. Dynamic values and animations
5. Fan, valve and damper movement
6. ON/OFF and alarm states
7. Basic BMS-style UI
8. Clean reusable code architecture
9. Documentation for extending the framework
10. Working demo ready for future API/MQTT integration

The main validation is:

JSON → Parameter Mapping → 3D Model → Dynamic Values/Animation

Please provide:

1. Recommended technology/architecture
2. POC cost
3. Timeline
4. What you need from us
5. Examples of similar Digital Twin/IoT/real-time 3D projects

Please quote the AHU POC separately first. If successful, this can become a larger recurring project covering multiple equipment and projects.

jobs.title: Football Coach Recruitment MVP Platform

* First Aid

* Other relevant qualifications

4. Checks & Verification

* Working With Children Check
* Working With Vulnerable People Check
* Police Check
* First Aid
* Other safeguarding requirements

The system should display whether documentation is:

Pending / Verified / Expired

5. Coaching CV

Coaches should be able to:

* Upload existing CV
* Create CV within the platform

6. Jobs / Vacancies

Level: NPLW

Qualification: AFC C minimum

Experience: U18/Women’s football

* Competition level
* Availability

9. Applications

* Send a message
* Track applications

Clubs should be able to:

* View applicants
* Shortlist applicants
* Reject applicants
* Contact applicants

Basic private messaging between:

Club ↔ Coach

11. Notifications

Basic notifications for:

* New job matching preferences
* Application received
* Application status
* New message
* Shortlisted
* Profile verification

12. Admin Dashboard

Admin should be able to:

* Manage coaches
* Manage clubs
* Approve accounts
* Verify qualifications/checks
* Approve/reject job advertisements
* Suspend users
* Delete users
* Manage reported content
* View basic statistics

⸻

FUTURE FEATURES

AI Coach Matching

A club could enter:

U18 Women’s Head Coach
Sydney
AFC C
WWCC
$8,000–$12,000

94% Match — Coach A

Based on:

* Qualifications
* Experience
* Location
* Availability
* Salary
* Age group
* Gender
* Coaching level

Premium Club Accounts

Potential future subscription model:

* Professional
* NPL/Elite

Verified Coach Badge

Example:

With verified:

Analytics

Coaches:

Clubs:

* Candidate views

⸻

DESIGN

The platform should look:

Professional + modern + football-specific

It should NOT look like a generic job board.

Reference points:

* LinkedIn
* SEEK
* Football recruitment platforms

The interface should be simple enough for a junior coach to use but professional enough for an NPL/A-League organisation.

Responsive web design is required.

⸻

TECHNOLOGY

I am open to recommendations from the developer.

• Minimal front-end dashboard (vanilla JS or React) that consumes the invoice JSON served by the backend

jobs.title: AI Receptionist Reels Video Editing
jobs.description:
I need a video editor to finish 6 short-form reels for my AI receptionist business.
Everything is in one Google Drive folder: the raw footage, the animation clips, and
the script for each reel.

Budget strictly: $30-40  ($30 fixed and $10 ready for bonus if great minimalistic work delivered)

The footage is me talking to camera, uncut. I re-read the script and say lines over
again, so you'll need to pick the best take and cut the rest — the pauses, the
stumbles, the second attempts. Keep it tight but don't chop it so hard it sounds
rushed.

Then cut me out and place me on a plain white background. Clean edges matter, I
don't want a grey halo around my shoulders.

Each reel is a 1080x1920 frame split in half. My cutout sits in the bottom half, the
animation clips go in the top half. Both halves are white so there's no visible line
between them.

The animations come as numbered clips per reel, and the script tells you which line
each one belongs to. Start the clip when I start that line, then freeze its last
frame and hold it until I finish. Then the next clip. That's the whole rhythm.
Subtitles: one or two words at a time, bold white, sitting around my chest. No
boxes, no colours, no karaoke highlighting.

No flashy editing at all. No zooms, no whooshes, no transitions, no stock footage.
The animations are doing the visual work and anything extra fights them.

Deliver 1080x1920 MP4. If you want a reference for the look, search Jeremy Haynes
on Instagram, same split-frame idea, different brand.

I need this done within 24 hours and it's honestly less than 2 hours for a good professional.

Deliverables for each image:
• Layered PSD (so I can review every adjustment)
• 16-bit TIFF or high-res JPG ready for print and web  
• A brief note of the key steps you took, so I can keep the look consistent on future shoots

If you can maintain texture while achieving flawless complexion, finesse background distractions without halos, and keep tones realistic across different skin types, let’s get started.

jobs.title: Fun Vlog Video Editing Needed
jobs.description:
I’ve shot a raw vlog and now need a skilled editor to shape it into a lively, viewer-friendly story. The main work involves precise cutting and trimming to tighten the narrative, then layering in fun, playful transitions and motion graphics so each segment flows with energy.  

The original footage is already organized in sequence, so you’ll receive clearly labeled files along with any music beds and image assets I want integrated. Once the first pass is complete, I’ll provide timestamped notes for a single round of revisions aimed at perfecting pacing, transitions, and overall vibe.  

Deliverable: a high-quality 1080p (or better) vlog ready for YouTube upload, rendered in H.264 plus the project file so I can archive it. If you work in Premiere Pro or Final Cut, great—just let me know your setup so we keep the workflow smooth.  

I’m excited to see how you can bring the footage to life while maintaining its casual, conversational tone. Let’s make this vlog pop!

jobs.title: Authentic Google Reviews with Images
jobs.description:
I want to strengthen customer confidence in my business by growing the number of genuine Google reviews that include both written feedback and accompanying images. The emphasis is on authenticity—every review must come from a real customer experience so the trust I earn is lasting and compliant with Google’s policies.

Here’s the help I’m after:
• Design and execute a review-generation strategy focused on text reviews with images.  
• Provide practical assets (email copy, QR codes, on-site prompts, etc.) that make it easy for happy customers to share their stories and photos.  
• Monitor results and adjust tactics so the volume, tone, and photo quality stay consistent with my brand voice.  
• Supply clear progress reports showing review count, star trend, and customer sentiment.

If this sounds like a fit, send me a detailed project proposal outlining
– your step-by-step approach,  
– any tools or platforms you plan to use,  
– an estimated timeline with milestones, and  
– examples of similar campaigns you have managed.

I’m ready to move quickly once I see a plan that balances effectiveness with ethical best practices.

jobs.title: 웹 품질진단 자동화 프로그램 개발
jobs.description:

3. 결과 저장: 제가 사용하는 기존 Excel 체크리스트(검사결과·판정·오류·증빙·점수 입력란 포함)에 셀 단위로 자동 기록되도록 해주세요.

5. 납품물: 실행 파일(또는 스크립트), 전체 소스코드, 간단한 사용 매뉴얼.

jobs.title: Marriage Divorce and Intimacy in Islamic Studies. -- 2

jobs.title: Restore Suspended LinkedIn Account
jobs.description:
My LinkedIn profile has been fully suspended—this is not a simple connection or messaging limit, but a complete lock-out triggered by a clearly identified violation of LinkedIn’s Terms of Service. I need practical, policy-aligned help: research the exact rule set I breached, craft a persuasive appeal that directly addresses that violation, and lay out any screenshots or documentation I should attach. Just as important, walk me through preventive steps so the same issue never jeopardises the account again.

Deliverables  
• A ready-to-send appeal letter/email tailored to LinkedIn Safety & Policy.  
• A concise checklist of evidence (posts, activity logs, or settings) that strengthens the case.  
• A short prevention plan highlighting relevant LinkedIn policies and best-practice usage limits.

Acceptance criteria: LinkedIn responds with an “under review” confirmation rather than an automated rejection, indicating the appeal has been formally opened.  

Once I have an actionable appeal and future-proof workflow, we’re done.

jobs.title: YouTube Automation Expert Needed: Horror Animated Stories Channel Setup & Production (Targeting US/Tier-1 GEO)

>

jobs.title: Expert-Level Professional Deliverable Creation (Multi-Occupation, AI-Assisted)

jobs.title: 3D Animated Classroom Video Series
jobs.description:
I want to breathe life into the Class 9 and Class 10 textbooks by turning each chapter—starting with the English lesson “A Letter to God”—into a fully-realised, AI-assisted 3D animated video.  

Here is the experience I’m after:  
• 3D Animation sets the visual tone, keeping characters and environments true to the text yet cinematic enough to hold a teenager’s attention.  
• The mood balances education with entertainment; factual concepts must stay intact, but humour, expressive acting, and dynamic pacing should keep viewers engaged.  
• Text overlays and captions highlight key quotes, vocabulary, and take-away points without crowding the frame.  
• Background music and well-timed sound effects support the narrative flow, rising and falling with the dramatic beats.  
• Character dialogues and voiceovers drive the story, so clear lip-sync, natural performances, and clean audio mixing are essential.

Scope of work  
1. Script breakdown: distil each chapter into a concise screenplay while respecting the textbook’s learning objectives.  
2. Storyboards / animatics: visual plan approved before full production.  
3. 3D modelling, rigging, and animation: stylised yet relatable characters and settings.  
4. AI tools: feel free to integrate tools such as Stable Video, Runway, or similar to accelerate backgrounds, lighting, or crowd scenes—so long as final output remains coherent and high-quality.  
5. Post-production: edit, grade, and master the video; embed captions; mix music, SFX, and voice tracks; deliver in HD (16:9) and mobile-friendly formats.

Acceptance criteria  
• Final runtime per chapter roughly 8–12 minutes unless the text demands otherwise.  
• Accurate representation of textbook content with no factual drift.  
• Smooth 3D animation at 24 fps or higher, free of artefacts.  
• Captions perfectly synced; audio clear at −3 dB peak max.  
• One round of revisions included after first draft.

If this pilot episode works well, there is a full series of chapters waiting. Let me know your approach, preferred pipeline, and a sample (or link) that demonstrates similar work.

jobs.title: Elegant Cursive Lecture Notes
jobs.description:
I have more than twenty-one pages of typed lecture content that I want transcribed by hand in an elegant, formal cursive style on standard A4 paper. Every page should look neat, consistent, and ready to be either scanned or physically archived in a binder without extra trimming or resizing.

What matters to me most is visual harmony: balanced margins, clear line spacing, and uniform letterforms throughout the set. Section headings and sub-headings can be slightly larger or underlined for quick reference, but the overall feel should remain refined rather than decorative.

Deliverables
• Hand-written originals on clean, uncreased A4 sheets  
• High-resolution scans (300 dpi or higher, PDF preferred) of each page, correctly ordered  

Once the draft pages are complete, send a few sample scans so I can confirm the cursive style before you proceed with the full batch. We can arrange secure shipping for the originals after final approval.

jobs.title: Senior On-Page SEO for Conversions
jobs.description:
My immediate objective is to turn existing traffic into measurable revenue gains. To do that, I need an expert who lives and breathes on-page SEO—someone able to fine-tune content, keywords, and meta data so my product and landing pages rank for purchase-intent terms and guide visitors straight to checkout.

The work centres on:  
• Deep keyword research focused on commercial intent  
• Rewriting or expanding copy so every section answers buyer questions and nudges them toward conversion  
• Crafting compelling, compliant title tags, meta descriptions, headers, and schema markup  
• Strengthening internal linking and topical relevance across product and landing pages  
• Spot-checking page speed, Core Web Vitals, and mobile presentation to remove any friction in the buying journey  
• Setting up tracking in Google Analytics 4 and Search Console so we can attribute each lift in sales to specific page updates

I rely on tools such as Ahrefs, SEMrush, Screaming Frog, and SurferSEO; if you have equivalent favourites, that’s fine, but show me how they’ll help hit the end goal: higher sales.

Deliverables must include:  
1. A keyword-to-page mapping sheet with search volume and intent notes  
2. Optimised copy (Google Doc) ready for direct upload, with meta tags in a separate tab  
3. Before-and-after performance benchmarks after 30 days, drawn from Analytics/Search Console

If you have a proven track record turning clicks into customers through disciplined on-page work, let’s move forward.

jobs.title: Desktop Asset Tracking Application
jobs.description:
I need a desktop-based asset management system with inventory tracking at its core. The program must handle both physical and digital assets from acquisition through retirement, and it has to work fast enough for day-to-day use on an office workstation without relying on a web browser.

The tracking module is non-negotiable: it must support barcode scanning for quick check-in/checkout, display quantity and status changes in real time, and let me extract detailed reports (CSV or PDF) covering movement history, current location, and any custom fields we decide to add later. If you prefer a particular tech stack—whether .NET, JavaFX, Electron, or Python with PyQt—let me know; I’m open as long as the final installer runs smoothly on Windows 10/11.

Deliverables  
• Installable desktop application  
• Full, well-commented source code  
• Simple user guide showing how to set up scanners, generate real-time dashboards, and pull the reports mentioned above  

I’ll test by loading a mixed set of hardware, software licences, and media files, scanning barcodes, and confirming that inventory counts and reports update instantly. If that workflow runs without hiccups, the milestone is complete.

jobs.title: Basic VLSI Circuit Design -- 2
jobs.description:
I’m looking for a VLSI-savvy freelancer who can take a simple circuit concept and turn it into a clean, ready-to-fabricate design. The task is firmly in the “basic” range, so I don’t expect multi-million-gate SOC complexity—just a well-thought-out block that follows good layout and timing practices.

Here’s what I need:
• Capture the schematic from my written spec (a brief netlist and functional description will be supplied).  
• Produce a layout that meets foundry DRC/LVS rules; Cadence Virtuoso, Mentor, or an open-source alternative is fine as long as you state the PDK you’re comfortable with.  
• Supply simulation results that verify the target functionality and basic timing. SPICE, Spectre, or ngspice are all acceptable.  
• Provide a concise hand-off package: schematic files, layout GDS/OASIS, simulation decks, and a short report explaining assumptions, corner cases, and any trade-offs made.

I can answer questions quickly and will review each milestone within 24 hours, so communication should be straightforward. If you bring accuracy, clear documentation, and a collaborative spirit, this should be an easy win for both of us.

jobs.title: Tally-Inspired Accounting SaaS Platform
jobs.description:
I need a complete, production-ready accounting suite that feels as familiar and robust as Tally, yet runs as a modern web and mobile application so I can handle my own books and later license the service to other businesses.

Core scope  
– All day-to-day accounting workflows you’d expect from Tally: voucher-style invoicing, double-entry ledgers, expense capture, bank reconciliation, and drill-down financial statements.  
– Advanced modules switched on from day one: real-time inventory valuation, payroll with statutory deductions, and built-in GST/VAT compliance (return generation and e-filing hooks).  
– Multi-tenant architecture with role-based access so I can onboard multiple client companies under a single cloud deployment and manage subscriptions.  
– Two front ends: a responsive web app (React, Vue or similar) and companion mobile apps for Android and iOS built with a shared codebase (Flutter, React Native, or an equivalent framework).  
– Central REST/GraphQL API, secure authentication (JWT/OAuth), and an admin console where I can configure features, pricing plans, and white-label branding.  
– Data portability features: CSV/Excel import from Tally, one-click backup, and export to common formats for auditors.  

Deliverables  
1. Source code in a private repository, fully documented.  
2. Staging server for acceptance testing plus deployment scripts for a scalable cloud stack (AWS, GCP, or Azure).  
3. Mobile binaries ready for store submission.  
4. User manual and API documentation.  
5. Post-launch support window for bug fixes and knowledge transfer.

Acceptance criteria  
• I can replicate a full Tally workflow (create a company, post vouchers, run a balance sheet) through the browser.  
• Inventory, payroll, and GST functions operate without errors for at least three test companies.  
• Web and mobile apps share the same live data and pass basic security tests (OWASP top 10).  

If you already have a Tally-like engine or a SaaS framework that can be customized quickly, let me know; I’m open to proven shortcuts as long as ownership and licensing are clear.

jobs.title: QR-Driven Conference Treasure Hunt
jobs.description:
I’m designing an employee conference for a global electrical-manufacturing client and want to turn each delegate’s badge into the key for a digital treasure hunt. The QR printed on every name tag should unlock step-by-step challenges as participants move through the venue, earning points, surprise perks or swag, and a live-updated leaderboard on the main screen.

What I need from you  
• A fresh, end-to-end concept for a QR-based interactive game, with the treasure-hunt mechanic at its heart.  
• A concise flow diagram that shows how each scan triggers the next clue, mini-game or location hint.  
• Copy suggestions for clues, hints and surprise rewards that feel on-brand for an electrical-tech audience.  
• Tech stack recommendation – for example, a lightweight mobile-web app built with HTML5/React, a Firebase or AWS backend for real-time scoring, and a simple CMS so we can edit clues onsite. If you prefer another stack, pitch it.  
• Badge layout specs and any dynamic print variables required so the QR codes map cleanly to each unique player profile.  
• Onsite deployment checklist covering Wi-Fi, staff roles, fallback options and data-privacy notes (GDPR compliant).  
• A quick demo or clickable prototype illustrating the player experience from first scan to final prize claim.

Acceptance criteria  
1. Players need no downloads; scanning the QR should open instantly in a mobile browser.  
2. Game must handle 500+ concurrent users with real-time score updates.  
3. All copy, UI and reward logic supplied in editable format (Figma/Google Sheets).  
4. Handover one week before the event so we have time for dry-run testing.

Hit me with your idea, sample screens or past work links, and let’s create something memorable for this conference.

jobs.title: Corporate Manufacturing Site Redesign
jobs.description:
I need our existing 3D-printing and on-demand manufacturing website reshaped into a professional, corporate-style experience that drives more customer inquiries. The core of the brief is a full UI/UX overhaul: cleaner navigation, intuitive page structure and a contemporary visual language that still feels industrial and trustworthy.

Priority areas

Key tasks

• Source or create high-quality banners, process diagrams and application photos that reinforce our brand.  
• Implement on-page SEO best practices (meta tags, schema, image optimisation) during the build.

Tools are up to you, though experience with WordPress or Webflow plus Figma/Adobe XD for prototyping will be valued. If you have portfolio pieces from industrial, engineering or broader B2B sectors, please share the live links along with an estimated timeline and fee breakdown by milestone.

I’ll be available for quick feedback loops and can supply all existing text, brand colours and logo files on day one. Looking forward to seeing how you can elevate the site and turn traffic into qualified leads.

jobs.title: Conversational Self-Improvement Copywriting
jobs.description:
I need clear, engaging copy that speaks directly to people who care about mental health and personal development. The material will appear across my blog, email sequences, and social channels, so every piece must feel like a supportive conversation rather than a lecture.  

The focus is twofold:  
• Mental health – approachable explanations, practical tips, and stigma-free encouragement.  
• Personal development – growth mindsets, habit building, and everyday strategies that keep readers moving forward.  

All writing should adopt a friendly, conversational tone that motivates without sounding preachy. Strong headlines, smooth storytelling, and naturally integrated calls-to-action are essential, as is an eye for SEO best practice so posts remain discoverable over time.  

I will provide broad outlines and key points; you turn them into polished copy that educates, inspires, and invites readers to act.

jobs.title: SSL, Email fixes & Homepage improvement
jobs.description:
My WooCommerce store currently sits behind a blank padlock because the server can’t locate the SSL certificate, and customers never receive any of the order-related emails. On top of that, the homepage could use a quick refresh to align with the rest of the site.

Here’s what I need handled:

• SSL restoration  
  - Locate or install a new certificate, tie it to the correct domain, force HTTPS everywhere, and confirm an A rating on SSL Labs.

• WooCommerce email repair  
  - Track down why transactional emails aren’t leaving the site (likely SMTP or host configuration), configure a reliable mailer (WP Mail SMTP, Postmark, SendGrid—open to the best fit), and prove successful delivery to my inbox.

• Homepage touch-up  
  - Clean up layout, tighten hero copy, and ensure images are optimised so the page loads fast without disrupting existing branding.

I’m on WordPress + WooCommerce with typical cPanel access and will supply logins immediately. Once the SSL lock shows green, test orders trigger real emails, and the revamped homepage passes Google PageSpeed’s basic thresholds, we’re done.

jobs.title: Incorporating Phononic Metamaterials into the Design of VTOL Aircraft
jobs.description:
I’m advancing a thesis that investigates how phononic metamaterials can be woven into the structure of next-generation VTOL aircraft to curb cabin noise without adding unwanted mass. My chief interest is noise reduction, and within that broad field I’m zeroing in on acoustic performance analysis rather than the preliminary material-selection stage or high-level structural layout.  

To achieve this, I need a simulation-driven study. Finite-element or boundary-element modelling in tools such as COMSOL, ANSYS, Abaqus, Actran, or a comparable acoustic solver will be central. The work should replicate—or, if possible, improve upon—state-of-the-art approaches to modelling phononic band-gap behaviour, quantify insertion loss across target frequency ranges, and translate those findings into practical design recommendations for VTOL cabin panels or airframe sections.  

Deliverables  
• A validated simulation model (geometry, material cards, boundary conditions, solver settings) capable of predicting the acoustic transmission loss of proposed phononic metamaterial inserts.  
• A concise technical report summarising methodology, key results, and design implications for VTOL architecture, including visual outputs such as dispersion curves and SPL maps.  
• Recommendations for prototype fabrication or follow-on experimental testing so that the study can transition from purely numerical analysis to a mixed numerical/empirical phase.  

Acceptance criteria: The model must resolve at least the first three relevant band gaps, provide convergence evidence, and demonstrate a minimum 6 dB predicted noise reduction in the 200–800 Hz range that dominates passenger-perceived cabin noise.  

If you have a strong background in aero-acoustics, metamaterial research, and advanced numerical simulation, I’d be glad to collaborate and integrate your findings into my thesis.

jobs.title: Facebook Content Writer Needed
jobs.description:
I run a small page aimed at fellow high-school students and need a steady stream of fresh, engaging Facebook posts. Because writing is the core of this project, I want someone who can craft short-form social content that sounds natural to teenagers, keeps them interacting, and subtly encourages them to keep following the page for study tips, school-life hacks, and light entertainment.

Scope of work  
• You will create at least ten Facebook-ready posts each month.

• Tone should be friendly, motivating, and authentic—never lecture-like.

jobs.title: QAD Adaptive ERP & Manufacturing ERP Fundamentals – Corporate Training
jobs.description:

Training Mode: Virtual Instructor-Led Training (VILT)
Participants: 15 software developers
Audience: Developers who are new to the ERP domain
Engagement: Corporate training
Preferred Expertise: QAD Adaptive ERP + Manufacturing domain
Key Training Topics

The trainer should be able to cover the following:

1. ERP Fundamentals
Introduction to ERP and its purpose
Core ERP concepts and terminology
Role of ERP in modern organizations
Business impact of ERP systems
2. Manufacturing Industry & Processes
Manufacturing industry overview
Common manufacturing processes
Manufacturing lifecycle and workflows
Relationship between business functions and manufacturing operations
Manufacturing ERP ecosystem
3. ERP Modules & Integration
Overview of common ERP modules
Finance
Procurement/Purchasing
Inventory
Sales & Distribution
Manufacturing/Production
Supply Chain
Interaction and dependencies between ERP modules
Business impact of integrated ERP processes
4. QAD Adaptive ERP – Preferred

Candidates with hands-on QAD Adaptive ERP experience are strongly preferred.

The trainer should ideally provide an overview of:

QAD Adaptive ERP
QAD's role in manufacturing organizations
Key modules and business processes
Manufacturing workflows in QAD
How QAD supports manufacturing operations
QAD ecosystem and integrations
Relevant real-world use cases
Preferred Trainer Profile

We are looking for trainers/SMEs with:

Strong QAD Adaptive ERP experience
Hands-on manufacturing ERP experience
Understanding of manufacturing business processes
Experience with ERP implementations or consulting
Ability to explain technical/business concepts to developers who are new to ERP
Previous corporate training / mentoring / knowledge-sharing experience
Strong communication and presentation skills
Alternative Profiles

If QAD Adaptive ERP expertise is not available, we will also consider experienced Manufacturing ERP trainers/SMEs with strong knowledge of:

ERP fundamentals
Manufacturing processes
ERP modules
Supply chain/manufacturing ecosystem
Enterprise application integration
Deliverables

The selected trainer will be expected to:

Prepare/provide a structured training agenda/TOC
Deliver live virtual instructor-led sessions
Explain ERP and manufacturing concepts using practical examples
Provide relevant QAD Adaptive ERP overview where applicable
Conduct interactive discussions and Q&A
Share any supporting training material, if applicable
To Apply

Please share the following with your proposal:

Updated trainer profile/CV
Relevant QAD Adaptive ERP / Manufacturing ERP experience
Previous corporate training experience
Proposed training approach/agenda/TOC
Availability
Commercials/cost estimate
Any prerequisites or assumptions
Relevant certifications, if applicable
Confirmation that you can deliver the training virtually

Priority will be given to candidates with hands-on QAD Adaptive ERP experience and a strong manufacturing domain background.

Please apply only if you have relevant QAD/Manufacturing ERP expertise and can independently deliver an instructor-led corporate training program.

jobs.title: E-Commerce Google Ads Campaign
jobs.description:
I need a specialist who can plan, build, and optimise a Google Ads campaign that drives real product purchases on my site. The objective is crystal-clear: more sales, not just clicks. You’ll start by analysing my store, the current traffic sources, and the competitive landscape. From there, create a campaign structure that separates branded, non-branded, and high-intent keywords, ensuring each ad group speaks directly to purchase-ready customers. Accurate conversion tracking is essential; I want to see which keywords, ads, and audiences actually lead to completed checkouts.

Deliverables  
• Campaign strategy document outlining target keywords, ad groups, extensions, and daily budgets  
• Full build-out in Google Ads (Search, and Shopping if you recommend it)  
• Custom conversion tracking set up through Google Tag Manager and Google Analytics 4  
• At least three compelling ad variations per ad group, including headlines and descriptions tailored to physical product buyers  
• A brief optimisation plan covering bid adjustments, negative keywords, and A/B testing for the first month

Acceptance criteria: the account must pass Google’s policy checks, all tracking must fire correctly, and the initial ads should be approved and ready to run.

If you have a track record of turning search intent into e-commerce revenue, I’d love to see how you can put those skills to work here.

jobs.title: UK Solar Leads Google Ads

All ads—text, display and video—have to be produced by you from scratch, including scripts, storyboards and static designs. We’ll launch with a modest daily budget to test variations, identify a winning formula, then scale aggressively once cost-per-lead targets are met. If you’ve run successful UK solar campaigns before, show me the metrics that prove it: conversion rates, CPL, ad examples, landing pages—whatever best demonstrates your track record.

Deliverables upon each milestone:
• Full Google Ads account structure ready to go live

jobs.title: Zapier Workflow Automation Expert Needed
jobs.description:
I want to replace the manual busy-work in my current processes with clean, dependable automations built in Zapier and organised in Notion. The priority is to remove repetitive data entry, push real-time notifications, and handle file moves or uploads automatically while also preparing the flow for future payment-related triggers.

Current stack  
• Google Sheets holds most of the raw data  
• Slack is our day-to-day communication channel  
• Trello tracks tasks and status  
• Notion is where I document the entire system  

Scope of work  
1. Map the existing steps for data capture, updates, alerts, file transfers and eventual payment events.  
2. Create Zaps that sync Google Sheets ↔ Notion, post conditional alerts to Slack, move or rename files as needed, and update Trello cards without human input.  
3. Set clear naming conventions, filters and error-handling so each automation can be audited quickly.  
4. Document every Zap in Notion with screenshots, links and a short “how it works” note.  

Acceptance criteria  
• All data updates reflect in Sheets, Notion and Trello within a minute of the trigger.  
• Slack messages fire only on the defined conditions—no noise.  
• File moves run without permissions issues and produce a success log.  
• No Zapier task overruns in the first week of live testing.  

Preferred profile: someone comfortable with the India time zone so real-time hand-off is easy, and who has already connected these exact apps on Zapier. Once this foundation is solid we can extend the setup to payment gateways and additional tools, so I’m looking for a partner who can grow the automation suite with me.

jobs.title: Email Customer Complaint Resolution Support
jobs.description:
My customer inbox receives a steady flow of complaints that must be handled quickly, politely, and in line with our brand tone. The task is straightforward: open each ticket, understand the issue, craft a clear solution, and follow up until the customer confirms satisfaction.

You will log in to our shared email workspace, triage messages, and draft responses that turn frustrated users into loyal advocates. When a case requires information you don’t have, tag the right internal contact and keep the thread moving so no one is left waiting. Every reply should be error-free, empathetic, and sent within our agreed-upon response window.

Deliverables
• Daily monitoring of the support inbox during the assigned hours  
• Full resolution of every customer complaint received that day, documented inside the thread  
• A short end-of-day summary highlighting trends, escalations, and any process gaps you noticed  

Acceptance criteria
• Average first-response time under two hours  
• Resolution rate of 95 % or higher without manager intervention  
• Zero spelling or grammar errors in outgoing emails  

Microsoft Outlook (or any IMAP-compatible client) and basic spreadsheet skills will be useful for tracking metrics, though the heart of the job is communication: clear writing, patience, and sound judgment. If you excel at turning tense situations into positive experiences, this support channel is ready for you to own.

jobs.title: Object Detection Model for Disease
jobs.description:
I'm seeking an expert in deep learning and computer vision. You'll work with publicly available datasets to develop an object detection model targeting disease.

Key Requirements:
- Expertise in PyTorch and Transformers
- Proficiency in XAI (Explainable AI)
- Strong background in computer vision

Ideal Skills and Experience:
- Proven experience in building object detection models
- Familiarity with relevant publicly available datasets
- Ability to explain and interpret model predictions

Looking forward to your bids!

jobs.title: Nursing Thesis Writing Support
jobs.description:
I’m in the middle of drafting my nursing thesis and need targeted help to make three sections solid and cohesive.

What I need right now
• Literature Review – locate and weave in the most recent peer-reviewed studies, pinpoint research gaps, and connect them clearly to my study aims.  
• Research Methodology – fine-tune the design, sampling strategy, data-collection tools, and ensure all ethical considerations are sound and well documented.  
• Data Analysis – advise on the best analytical approach, run the analysis, and present the findings in clear, thesis-ready language. Quantitative, qualitative, or mixed methods are all on the table, so let me know if you prefer SPSS, R, NVivo, or other tools.

Extra polish
Beyond content, I want the entire draft edited for structure and flow so the arguments build logically from chapter to chapter while meeting standard nursing-journal conventions and APA guidelines.

Expected deliverables
1. Revised Literature Review (tracked changes + clean copy)  
2. Updated Methodology chapter with clear rationale and ethical protocol details  
3. Data analysis outputs with concise, well-explained interpretation  
4. Inline structural edits across the draft and a short change log summarising improvements  

We’ll collaborate in Word or Google Docs, with weekly check-ins to keep momentum. If you have a strong background in nursing research and can point to similar theses you’ve shaped, I’d love to hear how you can help bring this project to completion.

jobs.title: SEO Fashion & Wellness Articles
jobs.description:
I’m commissioning a series of SEO-optimised articles that weave fashion trends together with practical health insights, all tailored to a young-adult readership. Each piece must subtly promote our clothing and wellness lines, so clear yet unobtrusive product mentions and persuasive calls-to-action are essential.  

The writing style should remain professional and formal throughout—think industry-grade analysis rather than chatty blog posts—while still staying fresh enough to hold a twenty-something’s attention span.

Key deliverables:
• 5–7 original articles (1,000–1,200 words each)  
• Focus keyword, secondary keywords, meta title, meta description, H1–H3 headers and internal/external links provided within each draft  
• Smooth product placements that comply with Google’s Helpful Content guidelines  
• Grammarly-clean copy, 100 % originality (Copyscape/Turnitin pass)  
• Final files in Google Docs and export-ready HTML snippets for quick upload

I’ll supply brand guidelines, a keyword list, and product details once we start. Articles will be reviewed for SEO score (Yoast or SurferSEO), factual accuracy and tone consistency before approval.

jobs.title: Creative Video Editor for Gaming Channel
jobs.description:
# Video Editor — Long-Form & Shorts Gaming Content
Channel Video first project video: https://youtu.be/yGLruiCb4dM?t=1196

I’m looking for a **good gaming video editor** who can take **long, raw gameplay/VOD footage** and turn it into engaging content for YouTube.

I recently played **Moo? on release** and have long gameplay footage that needs to be edited into either **long-form YouTube videos or Shorts**.

## What I Need

The most important skill is being able to **watch long gameplay footage and find the best moments yourself**.

You should be able to:

* Cut long raw VODs into **8–15+ minute YouTube videos**
* Find funny, exciting, unexpected and memorable moments
* Remove boring/repetitive gameplay and dead time
* Create a good flow and story from hours of footage
* Turn the same long VOD into **multiple Shorts**
* Identify moments that work particularly well as short-form content
* Create strong hooks for both long-form videos and Shorts
* Understand pacing and viewer retention

## Editing Style

I want the editing to feel **entertaining and natural**, not overloaded with effects.

Good:

* Strong cuts
* Great pacing
* Funny timing
* Useful zooms
* Good sound effects
* Music when appropriate
* Captions/text when they add value
* Memes/reactions when they actually make the moment funnier

The editor should know **when NOT to edit** as well.

## Most Important Requirement

**You must be comfortable editing LONG gameplay recordings.**

I don't want to provide timestamps for every single moment.

I want someone who can watch the footage, understand the gameplay, recognise what is entertaining, and make good editing decisions independently.

### You should be able to turn:

**1–3+ hours of raw gameplay → 8–15 minute long-form video**

AND/OR

**1–3+ hours of raw gameplay → multiple strong Shorts**

## Who I'm Looking For

* Experienced gaming/YouTube editor
* Good understanding of long-form content
* Good understanding of Shorts
* Strong sense of humour and timing
* Can find good moments independently
* Understands YouTube retention
* Can work with large VODs
* Reliable and consistent
* Interested in a potential long-term editing relationship

## When Applying

Please send:

1. Your best **gaming editing examples**
2. Examples of **long-form videos** you've edited
3. Examples of **Shorts** you've edited
4. Your price
5. Your turnaround time
6. What editing software you use

**If you can turn a boring/long VOD into something people actually want to watch, I want to see your work.**

Thank you!

jobs.title: ASAP Corporate Promo Video Edit
jobs.description:
I need my raw footage, logos, and brand guidelines turned into a polished promotional video with a professional, corporate feel. The project is time-critical, so I’m looking for a first cut within the next day or two and a fully approved master shortly after.

The final piece should flow smoothly, reflect our brand personality, and be ready to publish in both 1080p and 4K. Clean transitions, subtle lower thirds, tasteful motion graphics, consistent colour grading, and balanced audio are essential. A royalty-free music bed that fits a corporate tone is also required.

I’ll supply:
• All source clips, graphics, and fonts  
• A rough outline of the message order  
• Brand colours and typography specs  

You will:
• Edit in Premiere Pro (or equivalent), with any motion graphics created in After Effects if needed  
• Provide an editable project file, plus a high-quality MP4 render  
• Keep file names tidy and organised for hand-off

Please confirm you’re available to start immediately and link me to a couple of recent corporate promos you’ve edited so I can see your style.

jobs.title: Lead-Generating B2B Facebook Management
jobs.description:
I want to turn our B2B Facebook presence into a steady source of qualified leads. The page is already live; what I need now is a specialist who can plan, execute, and optimise a strategy that guides prospects from first touch to enquiry.

Scope of work  
• Audit the current page, content, and analytics to spot quick wins and longer-term improvements.  
• Build a content calendar tailored to decision-makers in our industry, pairing original thought-leadership posts with curated material and eye-catching creatives.  
• Set up and manage lead-generation campaigns—organic and paid—using Facebook Lead Ads, retargeting, and look-alike audiences.  
• Monitor performance weekly, then refine copy, visuals, and targeting based on data.  
• Report monthly on KPIs that matter to the sales team: cost-per-lead, conversion rate, and lead quality.

What to send me  
A detailed project proposal outlining your approach, the specific tools you will use (e.g., Meta Business Suite, Ads Manager, Hootsuite, Canva, HubSpot), a draft timeline, and examples of B2B Facebook work where you have demonstrably increased lead volume or lowered CPL.

Acceptance criteria  
1. A three-month content and campaign plan approved before launch.  
2. Weekly dashboard links or PDFs showing key metrics.  
3. A minimum 20 % uplift in qualified inbound leads by the end of month three, benchmarked against current figures.

While my immediate focus is Facebook, experience with LinkedIn or Twitter can be an added advantage for future phases, so feel free to mention it briefly—but keep the proposal centred on Facebook lead generation.

jobs.title: FreePBX-Dinstar SIP Registration Fix
jobs.description:
My Dinstar GSM gateway needs to register cleanly to FreePBX so that any call hitting the SIM in the gateway is forwarded to a MicroSIP client already registered on the same LAN. At the moment the gateway refuses to register, and every sign points to a network-level configuration problem rather than authentication or timeout issues. All three devices—FreePBX, the Dinstar gateway and MicroSIP—sit on the same subnet, so I would like a fresh set of eyes to trace, correct and document whatever is blocking the SIP handshake.

Here is what I need from you:  
• Join me through AnyDesk or TeamViewer for live troubleshooting and configuration.  
• Adjust FreePBX trunk settings, Dinstar SIP parameters and any required NAT / firewall rules until the gateway registers and call flow works end-to-end (SIM ➜ Dinstar ➜ FreePBX ➜ MicroSIP).  
• Prove success with a test inbound call and, if possible, an outbound call from MicroSIP via the GSM channel.  
• Provide a concise step-by-step document of every change you make so I can replicate or reverse it later.

Tools in play include FreePBX (latest stable), Dinstar gateway web GUI / CLI, MicroSIP, and basic network utilities such as ping, traceroute and packet capture should they be needed.

Acceptance criteria:  
1. Dinstar gateway shows “Registered” status in both its own interface and FreePBX.  
2. Incoming GSM call rings and is answered on the MicroSIP client with two-way audio.  
3. Delivered documentation clearly lists settings altered on FreePBX, Dinstar and the network.

If you have solid SIP troubleshooting skills and are comfortable working live over remote desktop, this should be a straightforward engagement.

jobs.title: Wedding Video Editing & Effects
jobs.description:
I have raw footage from a recent wedding that now needs to be shaped into a memorable, flowing story. The priority is to cut and trim the material so every moment feels intentional, then weave in tasteful transitions and light effects that match the couple’s style.  

No heavy colour work is required right now, but if you feel a subtle grade would elevate certain scenes I’m open to suggestions—just keep the romance and authenticity intact.  

Deliverable:
• A polished, ready-to-share wedding video file (1080p or higher), complete with smooth cuts, cohesive pacing, and elegant transition effects.  

I’ll supply all source clips via cloud link along with a rough timeline of key moments. Let me know your turnaround time and any similar wedding reels you’ve edited so I can gauge fit.

jobs.title: Modern Clothing Brand Logo Design
jobs.description:
I'm seeking a modern logo for my clothing manufacturing business. The logo should incorporate both text and an icon.

Requirements:
- Modern style
- Logo to include both text and icon
- Suitable for all garment types (casual, formal, sportswear)

Ideal Skills and Experience:
- Proven logo design expertise
- Strong portfolio with modern style
- Experience in the fashion industry
- Creativity in combining text and icons

Please provide sample works and a brief concept idea. Looking forward to your bids!

jobs.title: Handwritten Notes to Word Conversion
jobs.description:
I need a clean Microsoft Word version of a set of handwritten notes. The pages contain a mix of regular text, proper tables, and bulleted lists, so please recreate those elements with Word’s native formatting tools—not pasted images.  

Any word, number, or symbol you cannot read should be highlighted for my review instead of guessed.  

Deliverable  
• One .docx file that mirrors the layout of the originals, with tables and bullets formatted accurately and all unclear portions clearly highlighted.  

Accuracy is the priority; let me know your expected turnaround and any clarifying questions you might have once you see the material.

jobs.title: WordPress Site Migration
jobs.description:
I need my existing WordPress site moved from its current hosting environment to a new server. The site should remain exactly as it is—no content edits, design tweaks, or plugin changes are required. From my side you will receive full login credentials for both the source and destination servers, so you can handle files, databases, and DNS or domain-pointing tasks without delay.

Everything on the site runs on standard plugins and components; there are no special add-ons that demand extra configuration. I simply want a clean, secure transfer that avoids downtime and preserves all settings, links, and SSL certificates.

Deliverables  
• Complete migration of WordPress core files, themes, plugins, database, and SSL  
• Verification that the site loads correctly on the new server (front-end and wp-admin)  
• DNS or domain update guidance (or execution, if you prefer)  
• Brief hand-over summary of steps taken and any credentials or paths that changed

jobs.title: Data Evaluation & Benchmark Modeling
jobs.description:
I need a compact framework that lets me evaluate a data-driven model, benchmark it against reasonable baselines, and then roll those findings into a lightweight “sudo” (pseudo) prediction routine I can run or extend on my own.  

The job breaks down into three clear pieces:  
1. Design an evaluation pipeline that captures the usual classification/regression metrics and can be adapted to new datasets with minimal code changes.  
2. Wire in a benchmarking step so I can see how alternative algorithms or configurations stack up side-by-side—speed and accuracy both matter.  
3. Deliver a working prediction script or notebook that reproduces the best-performing setup from the benchmark and outputs predictions in a clean, documented format.  

I’m comfortable with either Python (scikit-learn, Pandas, Jupyter) or R (caret, tidyverse) if those are your preferred tools; custom code in another language is acceptable as long as it’s well commented and easy to run.  

Acceptance criteria  
• Reproducible code base with clear instructions  
• Metrics summary and comparison table for each model tested  
• Final prediction routine and sample output to confirm correctness  

If you’ve built similar evaluation or benchmarking suites before, especially ones that remain readable after the hand-off, I’d love to see an example.

jobs.title: Modern Responsive Business Website Build
jobs.description:
I’m ready to launch a fresh business website and need someone who can take it from blank screen to live, production-ready site. Above all, the finished product must feel clean, modern, and effortlessly usable on any device.

Speed and usability come first. Every page should load fast, scale perfectly from phone to large desktop, and flow with intuitive navigation. I also want a contemporary UI/UX aesthetic—think balanced whitespace, clear typography, and purposeful color—that encourages visitors to explore and contact us.

Tech flexibility is fine. Whether you prefer a hand-coded HTML/CSS/JavaScript stack, React, or WordPress, choose the approach you know will deliver both performance and easy maintenance. Design work can begin in Figma (or your preferred tool) so I can sign off on the visuals before development starts.

What I expect from you
• High-fidelity, responsive design mock-ups for approval  
• Pixel-perfect front-end build backed by well-structured, reusable code  
• Basic SEO and accessibility best practices baked in  
• Final deployment to my hosting plus a short hand-over walkthrough

Once we kick off, I’ll supply branding assets, copy, and any product photos. Show me two or three business sites you’ve recently delivered, note which stack you used, and outline your estimated timeline for design, development, and go-live.

If you excel at creating fast, modern, user-friendly business sites, let’s talk.

jobs.title: Equipment Finance Investor Pitch Deck
jobs.description:
I need an institutional-grade investor presentation that will anchor a Regulation D 506(c) raise for my U.S.–based equipment financing and leasing platform. Our strategy is pure asset-backed finance, placing income-producing assets—primarily construction and mining equipment—into lease or finance contracts that generate predictable cash flow and attractive depreciation benefits.  

The final deck must convince sophisticated, accredited investors by laying out four things with absolute clarity:  
• our business model and market positioning  
• the detailed transaction structure of each lease/loan pool  
• five-year financial projections with key metrics and downside cases  
• the tax-advantaged depreciation profile that boosts after-tax yield  

I will supply the underlying assumptions, term sheets, and model outputs once we agree on scope. From you I expect a polished, data-driven slide narrative (PowerPoint or comparable editable format) plus any supporting graphics or appendices that reinforce due-diligence readiness. Institutional tone, coherent flow, and clean visual hierarchy are mandatory acceptance criteria.

jobs.title: Pre-Employment vetting project, Bogota - Colombia
jobs.description:
I need reliable, on–the-ground assistance in Bogotá to verify a candidate’s employment history as part of my pre-employment vetting process. The task is limited to employment verification only—no background, reference, or drug checks are required.

Here’s what I’m looking for:
• Contact the previous employer(s) provided by me.  
• Confirm the individual’s job title(s), department or role, and start/end dates.  
• Collect the verifier’s name, position, and preferred contact details for audit purposes.  
• Supply a concise written report (PDF or Word) in English, including your verification notes, date/time of calls or emails, and any supporting screenshots or signed letters you obtain.

All communication with the employer must comply with Colombian employment-law norms and company privacy policies. The final report will be deemed complete when the above points are documented clearly and verifiably.

jobs.title: Cross-Platform Food Delivery App
jobs.description:
I’m building a food-delivery application that must run smoothly on both iOS and Android from a single codebase. The core audience is end-customers, so every screen and interaction should feel polished, intuitive, and fast.

Key functionality I need implemented:
• Real-time order tracking that shows customers exactly where their meal is from confirmation through delivery.
• Secure, seamless payment gateway integration supporting the major card networks and Apple/Google Pay.
• A simple way for customers to rate orders and leave written reviews, with basic moderation tools on the back end.

I will supply brand guidelines, wireframes, and API endpoints for menu data and logistics once we kick off. Your job is to turn those assets into a production-ready mobile app, handle submission to the App Store and Google Play, and provide clean, well-documented code that I can maintain in-house after launch.

If you have solid experience shipping cross-platform apps (React Native, Flutter, or comparable) and can demonstrate secure payment implementations and real-time mapping in past work, let’s talk about timelines and milestones.

jobs.title: PDF Text Updates Needed
jobs.description:
I have an existing PDF that is otherwise perfectly laid-out; it just holds outdated information that now needs to be replaced. Your task is to open the document, locate the specified text passages I will point out, and update them accurately while preserving every element of the original formatting and design. 

The result I expect is a clean, press-ready PDF that looks exactly like the original—only with the new wording in place. Please return both the revised PDF and, if you use an editable source file during the process (InDesign, Illustrator, or Acrobat Pro), that source file as well so I can make future tweaks in-house. 

If you’re comfortable making precise text edits inside a PDF without disturbing fonts, alignment, or graphic integrity, this will be a quick win for both of us.

jobs.title: Hindi Novel Manuscript Compilation
jobs.description:
I have a complete Hindi novel scattered across several Word documents. Each file already contains properly typed Devanagari text and chapter-level styling, and I need everything merged into one seamless manuscript without losing a single heading, font choice, page break, or italic nuance.  

The task is purely copy-paste and careful sequencing, yet accuracy is critical: paragraph spacing, indentations, footnotes, and any embedded page numbers from the originals must appear exactly the same in the final file. I will supply all source Word documents, clearly named by chapter, so you can follow the intended order.

Because I want the original formatting preserved rather than standardized or simplified, please be comfortable working inside Word (latest .docx) and checking that special Hindi characters render correctly after every paste. Minor typos that occur during merging can be fixed on sight, but no editorial intervention is required.

Deliverables  
• One consolidated .docx containing the full novel, perfectly matching the look of the individual sources  
• Brief change log only if conflicts between chapter styles force a small adjustment

I will review by comparing random pages side-by-side with the originals, so fidelity is the acceptance criterion. Let me know how soon you can turn this around.

jobs.title: System Integrator Website - Gatsby
jobs.description:
I need a modern, fast-loading company website built with Gatsby from the ground up. The site will represent a system-integration firm and should end up with roughly six pages: Home, Service, Product Listing, an additional Services detail page, plus a combined Contact & About Us section.

What I expect on each page  
• Service and Product Listing pages must showcase detailed descriptions paired with high-quality images and allow visitors to leave customer reviews and star ratings.  
• The Home page should open with a concise company overview, followed by rotating client testimonials and a small “Latest News / Updates” area I can keep fresh.  
• Contact & About Us should feature an easy-to-use form, our location, and a short company story.

Design & branding  
I don’t have any existing style guide, so I’ll rely on you to craft the complete visual identity—colour palette, typography, iconography, even guidance on a logo treatment if you see fit. The look needs to feel professional and trustworthy while staying lightweight enough to score well on Lighthouse.

Content & SEO  
Alongside the build, I’ll need SEO-focused copy for every page. Please weave in industry keywords naturally, set proper meta tags with gatsby-plugin-react-helmet, generate an XML sitemap, and structure headings for optimal search visibility.

Development expectations  
The code should use the latest Gatsby version, React 18, GraphQL for data handling, and Sass or styled-components for styling—whatever keeps performance high. Optimise images with gatsby-plugin-image and ensure each page remains fully responsive.

Deliverables  
1. Complete Gatsby source in a Git repo  
2. Compiled static site ready for Netlify or similar  - we can discuss further on it
3. All written page content in markdown or MDX  
4. A brief style guide (colours, fonts, imagery guidelines)  
5. Deployment instructions and a quick hand-off call or document

I’m looking to start quickly and would like clear milestones for design mock-ups, content drafts, initial build, and final QA. If this sounds like your wheelhouse, let’s discuss timelines and any questions you have.

jobs.title: Lebanese-Accented Phone Sales Support
jobs.description:
I need a friendly, articulate rep who can handle incoming and follow-up sales calls in a clear Lebanese accent. The goal is simple: when a prospect rings, you greet them with warmth, answer product questions, and guide them to a confident purchase decision.  

You will be the first voice our customers hear, so fluency in Arabic with a distinctly Lebanese tone is essential. Solid conversational English is a plus because some calls may switch languages mid-stream. A working knowledge of basic sales techniques—probing, objection handling, and soft closing—will help you thrive.

I’ll route calls to you through our cloud phone system; all you need is a quiet workspace, a reliable headset, and a stable internet connection. After each call, log the outcome and any next steps in our simple CRM. At the end of every shift, send me a quick recap so I can track pipeline health.

Deliverables  
• Real-time phone support for sales inquiries  
• Accurate call notes entered in our CRM immediately after each interaction  
• End-of-shift summary report highlighting hot leads, closed sales, and outstanding follow-ups

If you have prior phone-based sales or customer service experience and love the Lebanese way of engaging people, let me know. I’m ready to get started this week.

jobs.title: Handwritten Notes Typing
jobs.description:
I have a collection of handwritten notes that need to be converted into clean, editable text. The job is straightforward—type each page exactly as written, keeping spelling and punctuation true to the original, but with no extra styling beyond plain paragraphs. Headings, bullet points, or custom layouts are not required; standard text is all I need.

You’ll receive high-resolution scans of the handwritten pages. Simply transcribe them into a Word document (or Google Docs if you prefer) and return the files, one document per source bundle.

Accuracy is paramount, so please proofread your work before submission. If any portion of the handwriting is unclear, flag it for me with a brief note so I can clarify. A quick turnaround is appreciated, and I’m happy to answer questions along the way to keep the process smooth.

jobs.title: Bangalore Field Sales Intern Needed
jobs.description:

We’re at an **early stage of the startup**, which means this is a great opportunity to work closely with the founders, take ownership, and grow with the company. We’re also currently in discussions with investors as we prepare to raise funding and expand the team.

### What you’ll do

* Visit businesses and generate new leads
* Speak with founders, business owners and sales teams
* Give product demos and follow up with prospects
* Help early customers onboard and use the CRM
* Collect customer feedback

**Strong and confident communication is the most important skill.** Previous sales experience is helpful but not required.
