– see an active plan,  
– receive a notification,  
– pay through any UPI app only after entering the username in notes.

Demo SS attached for the app expectation look after being finished.

jobs.title: Into the Wild Credibility Analysis
jobs.description:
I have to submit a short paper that breaks down five key quotations from Jon Krakauer’s “Into the Wild” and uses them to judge his credibility as narrator. The instructor specifically wants me to focus on Krakauer’s own qualifications—his background, experience, and any personal stake he brings—and on the thornier issue of whether he truly has the right to speak for Chris McCandless.  

All evidence must come straight from the text or from the primary documents Krakauer cites; no outside biographies, think-pieces, or film adaptations. I will also upload a photo of the full assignment sheet so you can mirror the required structure and tone.  

What I need from you:  

• Identify five quotations that best reveal Krakauer’s authority (or lack thereof) to tell this story.  
• For each quote, craft a concise paragraph that explains how it supports or challenges his credibility, tying the discussion back to his qualifications and his position as narrator.  
• Close with a brief synthesis paragraph (3-4 sentences) that answers the big question: does Krakauer earn the right to speak for McCandless, based on the evidence you just analyzed?  

Please keep the language clear and academic, cite page numbers, and format everything so I can drop it straight into a double-spaced Word document.

jobs.title: Resolve iCloud Email Delivery Issue
jobs.description:

I need someone to trace and eliminate whatever is triggering iCloud’s refusal. That likely means checking SPF, DKIM, and DMARC records, evaluating the sending reputation of the Gmail relay, and fine-tuning any headers or content flags that could be causing Apple’s filters to bounce the mail. If rate limits or SMTP errors are involved, I’ll need clear guidance on throttling and retry logic inside the application as well.

Deliverables  
• Diagnosis report outlining the exact rejection reason(s) from iCloud  
• Updated DNS records (or verified existing ones) for SPF, DKIM, DMARC  
• Any Gmail-side or application-level configuration changes required  
• Proof of successful delivery to multiple @icloud.com test addresses  

Acceptance criteria: confirmations land in an active iCloud inbox without warnings, and the final report documents all changes so I can maintain them long term.

jobs.title: Training video Editor (long form)    (Remote, Australia-wide)

jobs.title: AI Task Prioritization App -- 2
jobs.description:

I need the mobile front-end for both iOS and Android, a resilient backend (Node, Python, or a language you can justify), and the connective tissue—APIs and webhooks—to keep everything synchronized. Tasks must be created in natural language inside the app, scored by the AI model, scheduled automatically on the user’s Google Calendar, and stored so that any change on one surface is reflected everywhere else almost instantly.

jobs.title: Enhance EUDR-compliant Farm Mapping Mobile App
jobs.description:
Title: EUDR Farm Mapping Mobile App – Bug Fixes, Backend Enhancement & Offline Sync

We have developed a farm mapping and field data collection platform designed to support EUDR compliance requirements. The system includes a mobile application used by field officers to register farmers, capture farm information, collect GPS coordinates/polygons, and synchronize collected data with a web-based administration platform.

The platform is already developed and functional, but we are currently experiencing some bugs and require an experienced developer/team to review, stabilize, enhance, and improve the existing solution.

Main Scope of Work

- Review the existing mobile application and backend architecture.
- Identify and resolve existing bugs and stability issues.
- Improve overall application performance and loading speed.
- Optimize the backend, APIs, database queries, and synchronization processes.
- Improve GPS and farm polygon capture functionality.
- Strengthen validation of farm mapping data.
- Improve handling of farmer profiles and farm records.
- Improve reliability when collecting large numbers of farm records.

Offline Farm Mapping – Major Requirement

One of the most important enhancements is offline-first functionality.

Field officers frequently operate in remote farming communities where mobile internet connectivity may be unavailable or unstable.

The application should therefore allow users to:

- Log in and access necessary previously downloaded data when offline.
- Register farmers without internet connectivity.
- Capture farmer and farm information offline.
- Capture GPS coordinates and farm polygons completely offline.
- Save photographs and other required field information locally.
- Queue records securely on the device.
- Continue mapping multiple farms without a network connection.
- Automatically detect when internet connectivity becomes available.
- Synchronize pending records with the central server.
- Prevent duplicate records during synchronization.
- Handle interrupted or partially completed synchronization.
- Clearly show records as Synced, Pending Sync, or Sync Failed.
- Allow users to manually retry failed synchronization.

EUDR-Related Functionality

The platform is intended to support farm-level information required for EU Deforestation Regulation (EUDR) compliance, including:

- Farmer registration
- Farm registration
- GPS/geolocation capture
- Polygon mapping
- Farm area calculation
- Mapping date and enumerator information
- Farm-level compliance/risk information
- Administrative review of mapped farms
- Map visualization of registered farms

This project focuses primarily on farm mapping, field data collection, system stability, backend improvement, and offline synchronization. It is not a complete supply-chain traceability project.

What We Are Looking For

We prefer a developer/team with experience in:

- Mobile application development
- Offline-first mobile architecture
- GPS/GIS and polygon mapping
- REST APIs
- Database optimization
- Data synchronization
- Conflict resolution and duplicate prevention
- Backend development
- Web administration dashboards
- Agricultural or field data collection applications
- EUDR, GIS, forestry, or geospatial systems would be an advantage

The selected freelancer will be given access to the existing source code and technical environment after engagement.

Important: Because this is an existing institutional project, detailed information regarding the organization, country of implementation, source code, server credentials, and internal system architecture will only be disclosed to the selected freelancer where necessary.

We are looking for someone who can first audit the existing system, identify the major technical problems, recommend improvements, and then implement the agreed fixes and enhancements.

jobs.title: AI Task Prioritization App

Scope of work  
The project spans the full stack. I need the mobile front-end for both iOS and Android, a resilient backend (Node, Python, or a language you can justify), and the connective tissue—APIs and webhooks—to keep everything synchronized. Tasks must be created in natural language inside the app, scored by the AI model, scheduled automatically on the user’s Google Calendar, and stored so that any change on one surface is reflected everywhere else almost instantly.

Key requirements  
• Platforms: native or Flutter/React Native builds that ship simultaneously to iOS and Android  
• AI layer: Gemini calling your task-ranking logic and returning ordered tasks with confidence scores  
• Calendar integration: secure OAuth flow with Google, two-way sync, conflict handling  
• Auth: classic email-and-password signup/login with best-practice security (bcrypt, email verification, forgot-password flow)  
• SaaS foundation: tenant isolation, usage metering endpoints, and easy tier upgrades  
• DevOps: containerised deployment and CI/CD that can be handed over without guesswork

Acceptance criteria  
1. A user creates three tasks; the AI returns a prioritized list within 2 seconds.  
2. Selecting “schedule” inserts tasks into the correct Google Calendar slots and reflects the event IDs back in the app.  
3. Updating a task on one device (or via Calendar) propagates to all signed-in devices in under 5 seconds.  
4. Sign-up, sign-in, and password reset workflows are fully functional and tested.  
5. Code and infrastructure are documented well enough that another developer can spin up the project locally in <30 minutes.

If this end-to-end build—from mobile UI to SaaS backend and AI integration—matches your expertise, let’s talk timelines and milestones.

Cruise bargains are especially valuable when they involve seasonal promotions, repositioning sailings, fare-posting errors or any other unforeseen opportunity that creates a standout price. For flights I’m after the same: genuine error fares, sharp seasonal sales, repositioning flights and any surprise flash deal that slips through for a short window. Scope of work

Delivery cadence

Preferred format
A Google Sheet (shared) works best for ongoing tracking, with a brief email or Slack ping highlighting the day’s standout offer. Screenshots of fare calendars or OTA pages are helpful for error fares that may disappear quickly.

Acceptance criteria
• Every entry must link to a live, book-able fare at the time you log it.  
• Cruise and airline deals must clearly satisfy at least one of these: seasonal promo, repositioning, fare error, or other unforeseen rate drop.  
• No duplicated or already-expired offers in the daily/weekly file.

That’s the whole mandate—keep me ahead of the curve on irresistible travel deals and make sure the information arrives while the window to book is still open.

jobs.title: Excel Intelligence Dashboard – Update, Validation & Enhancement -- 3
jobs.description:
Excel Intelligence Dashboard – Update, Validation & Enhancement

I am looking for an experienced Excel Dashboard / Data Visualization specialist to help me finalize and improve an existing offshore operations and well-monitoring dashboard.

The dashboard is already approximately 90% completed. I built most of the structure, formulas, sheets, and the modern overview myself, but I currently do not have enough time to thoroughly review everything, compare the latest data, update the new wells, troubleshoot some formulas, and complete the remaining work.

3. Latest/up-to-date operational files/data – Use these to verify and update the Intelligence Dashboard.

About the Project

This dashboard is used for offshore operations and well monitoring. It tracks multiple wells and operational activities, including well status, running/shutdown wells, new wells, workover wells, monitoring information, operational logs, PM checks, pending items, and daily operational activities.

You should be highly experienced with Excel, formulas, dashboards, data validation, data consistency, and professional dashboard design.

Experience with industrial, engineering, oil & gas, offshore, or operational dashboards is a strong advantage.

⸻

Main Scope of Work

1. Update the Intelligence Dashboard

The Intelligence Dashboard is the main file you need to work on.

It is already around 90% complete, so I am not looking for someone to build a dashboard from scratch.

You need to:

* Review the entire dashboard.
* Compare it with the old/original dashboard.
* Compare it with the latest operational data.
* Identify missing or outdated information.
* Add all new wells.
* Update existing wells where required.
* Make sure new wells are reflected throughout all relevant sheets.
* Verify statuses and operational information.
* Check consistency between sheets.
* Verify that formulas are working correctly.
* Preserve the existing logic and formulas wherever possible.

New wells may need to be added to multiple sheets, including:

* Overview
* Monitoring
* Status
* Logs
* PM Check
* Other relevant sheets

⸻

2. Formula Review & Troubleshooting

There is a sheet called “Monitoring Sheet”.

Most formulas are working correctly, but some wells have issues, particularly with the ROR-related formula/calculation.

I need you to:

* Review the existing formulas.
* Identify why the formula works for some wells but not others.
* Compare working formulas with problematic ones.
* Understand the existing logic.
* Fix the affected formulas properly.
* Make sure the fix does not break the formulas that are already working.
* Check for similar issues elsewhere in the workbook.

Important: Do not simply hard-code the results. The dashboard should remain dynamic and formula-based.

⸻

3. Compare Old Dashboard vs. Intelligence Dashboard

Use the old dashboard as a reference and carefully compare both files.

Check for:

* Missing wells
* Missing information
* Missing formulas
* Missing statuses
* Missing logs
* Missing PM information
* Differences in calculations
* Differences in well information
* Any information available in the old dashboard that has not yet been transferred

The final Intelligence Dashboard should contain all required information while maintaining the improved/new structure.

⸻

4. Modern Overview Sheet

The first sheet is the Overview. I already designed it as a modern dashboard and like the general direction.

I want to add the following:

Last 5 Shutdown Wells

Add a section showing the last 5 wells that were shut down.

Ideally, this should be dynamic and automatically update based on the latest available data.

Pending Items

Add a professional section/table showing current Pending Items, for example:

Well Number | Pending Item

The objective is that someone can open the Overview and immediately see:

* Which wells have pending actions?
* What is pending?
* Which wells require attention?

If you have better ideas to make the Overview more modern, professional, interactive, clean, and management-friendly, I am completely open to them.

⸻

5. Monthly Shift & Work Summary

I also want to add a new sheet to summarize our daily shifts and operational work.

Our offshore operation normally has:

* Day Shift
* Night Shift

So normally there are 2 shifts per day.

However, sometimes work is affected by:

* Rough weather
* Operational restrictions
* Shutdowns
* Other circumstances that prevent work from being completed

I want a professional monthly summary showing, where applicable:

* Date
* Month
* Day Shift
* Night Shift
* Number of shifts completed
* Work completed
* Wells worked on
* Work not completed / reason
* Weather-related delays
* Monthly total shifts
* Monthly completed work

I am open to your recommendation for the best structure and visualization.

⸻

6. PM Check Sheet

I am not completely satisfied with the current PM Check sheet.

Please review it and suggest improvements.

I am open to:

* Redesigning the layout
* Improving usability
* Improving the visual presentation
* Adding useful calculations
* Adding status indicators
* Better tracking of completed/pending PM activities

If you have a better concept for the PM Check sheet, I am open to changing it.

⸻

7. Data & Quality Check

This is very important.

I need someone who will actually review the workbook carefully, not just make cosmetic changes.

Please verify:

* Well numbers
* Well status
* New wells
* Workover wells
* Shutdown wells
* Running wells
* Monitoring information
* Logs
* PM information
* Formulas
* References between sheets
* Calculations
* Data consistency
* Missing or incorrect information

The final workbook should be internally consistent and reliable.

⸻

8. Preserve Existing Logic

The Intelligence Dashboard already contains significant work and formulas that I developed.

Please do not rebuild everything unnecessarily.

The preferred approach is:

Understand → Compare → Validate → Fix → Improve

If the existing formula/logic is correct, keep it.

If something is wrong, fix it properly.

If you see an opportunity for a significant improvement, I am open to your recommendation.

⸻

Expected Final Deliverable

The final Intelligence Dashboard should:

* Contain the latest wells and information.
* Match the latest operational data.
* Have properly working formulas.
* Resolve the Monitoring Sheet/ROR formula issues.
* Include new wells across all relevant sheets.
* Have an improved modern Overview.
* Show the last 5 shutdown wells.
* Show pending items by well.
* Include a monthly shift/work summary.
* Have an improved PM Check sheet.
* Maintain consistency across all sheets.
* Be professional, modern, and easy to use.
* Maintain dynamic formulas rather than unnecessary hard-coded values.

⸻

Ideal Freelancer

I am looking for someone highly experienced in:

* Advanced Excel formulas
* Excel dashboards
* Data analysis
* Dynamic formulas
* Excel tables
* Conditional formatting
* Power Query, if applicable
* Data visualization
* Professional dashboard design
* Troubleshooting complex formulas
* Large/linked Excel workbooks

Experience with industrial, engineering, oil & gas, offshore, or operational dashboards is a strong advantage.

Most importantly, I need someone detail-oriented who will carefully review and validate the entire workbook.

Important

The priorities are:

Accuracy + Data Validation + Formula Integrity + Functionality + Professional Design

The dashboard is already approximately 90% complete. I mainly need an experienced person to review it carefully, compare it against the old dashboard and latest data, complete the remaining work, fix the issues, and make the final product highly professional.

I am also very open to your ideas and recommendations if you see better ways to improve the dashboard.

Please include in your proposal:

1. Your experience with advanced Excel dashboards.
2. Examples of similar dashboards you have created.
3. Your experience troubleshooting complex Excel formulas.
4. Experience with operational/industrial dashboards, if any.
5. Estimated completion time.
6. Fixed project price.

I am looking for quality, accuracy, and attention to detail, not simply the cheapest proposal.

jobs.title: Merge Two Foil STLs Seamlessly
jobs.description:
I have two STL files of a mechanical foil profile that were originally split only to fit a smaller build plate. I now need them combined into one uninterrupted, watertight body while preserving every millimeter of the original geometry. All dimensions and tight tolerances must stay exactly as they are, so any blend between the two halves has to be perfectly smooth with no change to the air-foil contour.

Here’s what I’m after:  
• Stitch both parts together, eliminate the split line, and return a continuous surface that will pass all mesh-integrity checks (no self-intersections, non-manifold edges, or holes).  
• Maintain the existing reference dimensions; target deviation should be under 0.05 mm across the joint when compared to the source files.  
• Supply the final, print-ready STL plus the editable CAD file from whatever software you work in—SolidWorks, Fusion 360, or an equivalent high-precision tool.  
- Remove cavities from the top and lower foils used to attache the two pieces together.
- Create cavities for attaching the foil to the skid.
- Add additional screw holes (4 on each skid and elongated foil)) to attache the foil to the skid.

I’ll run a section-by-section overlay in my own QA, so please keep the final model clean and well-layered for inspection. If anything in the original files looks inconsistent, flag it before you proceed so we can agree on the fix.

Turnaround is flexible but sooner is better. Let me know if you need any other data from me and what software you plan to use, and we can get started right away.

jobs.title: Sell GetGovWork to Small Trade Contractors ($150/signup + Hourly)
jobs.description:
Category: Sales & Marketing › Lead Generation / Business Development
Budget: Negotiable hourly + $150 commission per paying signup
Project Type: Ongoing / Part-time

About the Opportunity
GetGovWork (getgovwork.com) helps small trade contractors — HVAC, plumbing, electrical, roofing, and more — find and win U.S. government contracts. The federal government is legally required to award billions of dollars per year to small businesses, but most contractors don't participate because the process is confusing. GetGovWork solves that: we find the contracts near them, explain them in plain English, and write the bid.

We're looking for a motivated closer to get paying customers on the platform. This is a ground-floor opportunity with a product that has real market pull, a clear value proposition, and a price point that's 3–5x cheaper than our nearest competitors.

The Product
What it does: Matches government contract opportunities to a contractor's trade, geography, and certifications — then generates a complete bid proposal in minutes

Who it's for: Small trade contractors (HVAC, plumbing, electrical, roofing, painting, flooring, etc.), typically 2–25 employees

Pricing: $250/month

Differentiators:
Trade-specific — not generic, built for the shop owner who's never done government work
$250/mo vs. $707–$5,000/mo for competitors
Free bid draft as an ongoing proof-of-value hook
Daily contract alerts, executive summaries in plain English, bid written in minutes

Your Commission
$150 per new paying customer you sign up (tracked via signup attribution)
Negotiable hourly rate for outreach time, prospecting, and follow-up
No cap — the more you close, the more you earn
Paying customer = someone who subscribes at $250/month; not a free trial

Who We're Looking For
An experienced B2B or B2SMB sales rep who can work independently
Comfortable calling and emailing small business owners (contractors, shop owners, tradespeople)
Persuasive but not pushy — the product sells itself when positioned correctly
Able to explain a simple value prop clearly: "We find the government jobs near you and write the bid. It's $250 a month."
Familiar with cold outreach (calls, email, LinkedIn, Facebook groups) and following up

Nice to have:
Experience selling to tradespeople, contractors, or blue-collar businesses
Background in SaaS sales, HR/payroll tools for small biz, or any tool sold to trades
Knowledge of government contracting (useful but absolutely not required)

What We'll Provide
Full product walkthrough and Q&A before you start
Sales talking points and objection handling guide
Access to the live platform to demo
Outreach lists and guidance on where to source leads (industry associations, Google Places, Facebook groups, LinkedIn)
Existing email templates that have been tested in our campaigns

The Market (Why This Works)
The U.S. federal government spent ~$774B on contracts in FY2024; $117B+ went to small businesses via set-asides
Federal law mandates 23%+ of eligible contracts go to small businesses — agencies are actively graded on this and motivated to award
Contracts in the $15K–$350K range are automatically reserved for small businesses by law — this is the exact range most trade contractors can execute
Most HVAC and trade shops have never heard of SAM.gov — this is a discovery sale, not a crowded market
First confirmed customer (Josh, Superior Heating & Air) won a government contract using GetGovWork. That's the story you're selling.

Pitch That Works
"Federal agencies in your area are required to give contracts to small businesses — and right now they're spending their year-end budgets. GetGovWork finds those jobs near you and writes the bid in minutes. It's $250 a month and the first contractor who shows up usually wins. Want to see what's available near you?"

What's Not Required
You don't need to understand government contracting law
You don't need to generate the bids — that's the platform's job
You don't need a large existing network — this is a cold outreach role

How to Apply
Please include in your application:
A brief description of a similar sales role you've done (product sold, who the buyers were, how you generated leads)
Your preferred outreach method (calls, email, social, or a mix)
Your proposed hourly rate
Any relevant experience selling to tradespeople, small businesses, or contractors

This is an ongoing engagement. Top performers will have the opportunity to expand scope, earn higher hourly rates, and grow with the product.

jobs.title: Casual 3D Watch Design
jobs.description:

Key focus areas  
• Watch face: balanced proportions, easy-to-read markers, subtle detailing that communicates everyday versatility.  
• Strap: the design must integrate a metal bracelet—think brushed stainless or similar—with links that complement the case geometry.

Scope of work  
1. Create a fully detailed 3D model of the case, dial, hands, crown, and metal bracelet.  
2. Provide photorealistic still renders (front, side, angled) plus a simple 360° turntable animation to showcase the piece.  
3. Supply editable source files (preferred formats: STEP or IGES for solid geometry, plus the native file from your software—Fusion 360, SolidWorks, Rhino, or similar).  
4. Deliver production-ready STL/OBJ exports for rapid prototyping.

Acceptance criteria  
• All dimensions and tolerances called out in the final drawing set.  
• Meshes must be watertight and free of non-manifold edges.  
• Renders should depict realistic metal finishing, proper reflections, and neutral studio lighting.

If you have a portfolio of previous watch or jewelry models, I’d love to review it to ensure our aesthetics align. I’m ready to start as soon as I find the right collaborator and will be prompt with feedback throughout the process.

jobs.title: Android Lucky Jet Prediction App

jobs.title: Full-Stack Developer Needed for Existing SaaS Platform – Apple Wallet / PassKit Experience Required
jobs.description:
Title

Full-Stack Developer with Apple Wallet / PassKit Experience – Existing SaaS Project Takeover

Project Description

I am looking for an experienced Full-Stack Developer with strong Apple Wallet / PassKit experience to take over an existing SaaS platform.

The project is already developed and includes:

* iOS application
* Android application
* Web-based business dashboard
* Admin dashboard
* Backend
* Database
* Apple Wallet integration
* Google Wallet integration
* Loyalty cards / stamp cards
* QR functionality
* Business and customer accounts

This is NOT a project to build from scratch.

The first phase will be a complete technical takeover and audit of the existing system after the current development company completes the project handover.

Phase 1 – Technical Takeover & Audit

The selected developer will be required to:

* Review the complete source code
* Review iOS, Android, backend, dashboard and admin systems
* Review the database structure
* Review hosting/server configuration
* Review repositories and deployment setup
* Verify that all required project assets and credentials have been properly handed over
* Confirm that the project can be independently built, deployed and maintained
* Identify bugs, technical debt and architectural issues
* Provide a clear technical audit before starting major new development

Priority Apple Wallet Work

Strong Apple Wallet / PassKit knowledge is essential.

The current Wallet implementation must be reviewed, particularly:

1. Wallet Cards per Business

This is a multi-business platform.

Each business must have its own properly separated and branded Wallet experience.

The developer must review the current implementation of:

* passTypeIdentifier
* serialNumber
* groupingIdentifier
* Pass generation
* Pass signing
* Pass Type IDs
* Certificates
* Business-specific branding and configuration
* Pass update infrastructure

The goal is to ensure Wallet cards belonging to different businesses are implemented and separated correctly.

The developer should also be familiar with the App Store Connect API, including Pass Type ID and certificate management.

2. Loyalty Stamp Icons

The current loyalty stamp design must also be reviewed.

Stamp icon:

* Size
* Spacing
* Padding
* Alignment
* Visual appearance

should be configurable correctly within Apple Wallet requirements rather than unnecessarily restricted by the current implementation.

Additional System Review

The developer should also review:

* Customer registration flow
* Business account structure
* Loyalty card creation
* Customer IDs
* QR code logic
* Push notifications
* Apple Wallet updates
* Google Wallet implementation
* API integrations
* Dashboard configuration
* Optional/required customer fields
* Duplicate card prevention
* Subscriber/customer status logic
* Security and access control
* Production and testing environments

Required Experience

You should have strong experience with:

* Full-Stack Development
* Apple Wallet / PassKit
* .pkpass
* Pass Type IDs
* Apple Developer / App Store Connect API
* Wallet certificates and signing
* REST APIs
* Backend development
* Databases
* Web dashboards
* iOS
* Android
* Firebase / Push Notifications
* Git / GitHub
* Cloud hosting and deployment

Experience with Google Wallet and multi-tenant SaaS platforms is highly preferred.

Important

I am looking for a developer who can first understand and audit an existing codebase, not immediately rebuild the system.

Please do not apply if your Apple Wallet experience is limited to simply generating basic .pkpass files.

I need someone who understands the complete Wallet architecture, certificates, identifiers, APIs, updates and multi-business implementation.

When Applying

Please include:

1. Your previous Apple Wallet / PassKit experience
2. Examples of Wallet projects you have developed
3. Whether you have worked with the App Store Connect API
4. Your experience with Pass Type IDs and certificates
5. Your experience taking over existing projects from another development team
6. Your preferred backend technology/framework
7. Your availability for ongoing development after the initial audit
8. Your proposed price and timeframe for the initial technical audit and takeover

Please begin your proposal with:

“WALLET PROJECT”

so I know you have read the full project description.

This may become a long-term development role after successful completion of the initial takeover and audit.

jobs.title: Analyse tendances ventes infreeventaire
jobs.description:
J’ai besoin de déléguer une analyse de données focalisée sur nos stocks.  
Mon objectif est clair : identifier les tendances de vente afin d’orienter plus finement nos décisions d’approvisionnement et de merchandising.

Ce que j’attends de vous :
• Nettoyer et structurer l’ensemble des données d’inventaire que je fournirai (CSV et exports ERP).  
• Construire des tableaux croisés et visualisations (Python-pandas, Excel Power Query ou Power BI, au choix) pour faire ressortir : produits à rotation rapide, variations saisonnières, ruptures récurrentes.  
• Produire un court rapport synthétique expliquant les tendances mises au jour, leurs causes probables et des recommandations exploitables (ajustement de seuils de réapprovisionnement, gamme à étendre ou à réduire, etc.).  

Critères de réussite : analyses reproductibles (script ou fichier source partagé), graphiques clairs, livrables livrés dans le format natif + PDF.  
Si vous avez déjà travaillé sur l’optimisation de niveaux de stock ou la prévision des ventes, mentionnez-le ; cela sera un réel atout.

jobs.title: Expert Chinese-English Translation Needed
jobs.description:
Several ongoing assignments require clear, faithful translation between Mandarin Chinese and English. The bulk of the work is general in nature, yet it often branches into specialised pieces such as:  
• marketing materials  
• personal documents  
• social media posts  
• journalistic copy  

For every file I provide, I need the meaning, context, and register carried over seamlessly so the English reads as naturally as the original Chinese (and vice-versa). A neutral tone is essential unless the source text dictates otherwise. Terminology must be consistent, idioms handled with cultural sensitivity, and the final draft free of anything that looks machine-generated.  

You will receive editable source files and a brief style guide. Once translated, please return:  
1. a clean, publication-ready version, and  
2. a tracked-changes file highlighting any queries or terminology decisions.  

Deadlines are firm but reasonable; open communication is important, so flag issues early and I will do the same. If you have proven experience in Chinese–English translation, attach one or two short, relevant samples (links or PDFs are fine) so I can see your style. Looking forward to collaborating on precise, natural translations delivered on time.

jobs.title: Revit High-Rise Structural Model
jobs.description:

The emphasis is on accurate structural detailing, so every beam, column, foundation element, and roof structure must be modeled to realistic dimensions and ready for analysis.  

MEP integration is essential: please route mechanical, electrical, and plumbing systems throughout the building so clashes can be checked immediately once the file is returned.  

Deliverables  
• One native Revit model (.rvt) with all structural components fully defined  
• Coordinated mechanical, electrical, and plumbing systems within the same file  
• Sheets or 3D views that clearly show the structural frame, foundations, and roof assembly for quick review  

I will supply any preliminary CAD plans and load assumptions as soon as we start. Let me know which Revit version you prefer so I can match it on my end.

jobs.title: Mağaza üçün Android tətbiqi
jobs.description:

Sadə, sürətli və responsiv interfeys vacibdir. Backend API hazırdırsa inteqrasiya, hazır deyilsə təklif etdiyiniz stack ilə qurulması barədə də açığam. Android Studio, Kotlin və ya Java ilə yazılmış, Play Store-a yüklənməyə tam hazır kod, test planı və quraşdırma təlimatı yekun təhvil paketinə daxildir.

İş planınızı, istifadə edəcəyiniz texnologiyaları və təxmini vaxt qrafikinizi qısa şəkildə izah edin ki, detalları müzakirə edib sürətli şəkildə başlaya bilək.

jobs.title: Animated Product Promo TikToks

For every video you create, weave in music or sharp sound effects that complement the visuals and follow current TikTok trends. The finished piece should feel cohesive, on-brand, and ready to post with no additional tweaks needed on my end.

I’ll supply the footage, product shots, and any reference clips as soon as we start; you bring the creative flair and fast turnaround. If this sounds like your kind of edit, let’s make these promos pop.

jobs.title: Pelacak Konsistensi Spreadsheet

jobs.title: Dynamic Video Motion Tracking

jobs.title: Text Model Training & Optimization
jobs.description:
I’m building a natural-language application and need advanced AI/ML support to take my text-based model from promising prototype to production-ready asset. The core of the assignment is training and rigorously optimizing the current model so it reaches reliable, repeatable performance on real-world data.

The work revolves around text data only. All preprocessing pipelines are in place; the immediate need is to refine the model architecture, tune hyper-parameters, apply efficient training strategies (mixed precision, gradient accumulation, distributed training if helpful), and benchmark the final checkpoints. Familiarity with Hugging Face Transformers, PyTorch or TensorFlow, Weights & Biases, and modern optimization techniques such as learning-rate schedulers, early stopping, and model pruning/quantization will be essential.

Deliverables  
• Fully trained, optimized model files (with version tagging)  
• Reproducible training scripts/notebooks and environment files  
• Evaluation report covering metrics, confusion matrices, and error analysis on the provided hold-out set  
• Brief implementation document explaining major decisions and how to fine-tune or extend the model later

Acceptance criteria  
• Meets or exceeds the target accuracy/F1 score defined at project start  
• All code executes end-to-end on my cloud instance with a single command  
• Clear, concise documentation that a new engineer can follow without hand-holding

If this aligns with your AI/ML expertise, I’m ready to provide the dataset, baseline model, and access to the training environment so we can get started right away.

jobs.title: Social Media App Architecture Design
jobs.description:
I’m mapping out a new social platform that will debut on both iOS and Android. Core features include user profiles and timelines, real-time messaging and chat, rich media sharing for photos and videos, in-app games, plus peer-to-peer sharing. To launch smoothly and scale fast I need a seasoned software architect who can translate these requirements into a complete, future-proof technical blueprint.

Scope  
You will own the high-level and low-level architecture: selecting the most suitable tech stack, defining backend services, data stores, and crafting a secure, resilient server and network topology. I already have a shortlist of preferred languages and frameworks and will share them once we connect, but I’m open to your rationale on each layer—from mobile client frameworks through API design (REST or GraphQL) to infrastructure choices such as AWS, GCP, or hybrid setups.

Key deliverables  
• Architecture document covering component diagrams, data flow, and integration points  
• Scalable database schema and storage strategy (SQL and/or NoSQL)  
• Network and server topology with security zones, load balancing, and CDN recommendations  
• Deployment and CI/CD pipeline outline (Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform or equivalents)  
• Cost-aware scaling plan with capacity estimates and monitoring hooks  
• Risk list and mitigation strategies, especially around media storage, chat latency, and P2P traffic

Acceptance criteria  
The documentation should be detailed enough for a development team to begin implementation without re-architecting. Diagrams must be clear, all assumptions stated, and every technology choice justified against performance, cost, and maintainability.

If you have a track record architecting social or high-traffic mobile products and can back it up with portfolio examples or whitepapers, I’d love to review them and get started.

jobs.title: Ongoing SQL Server DBA Support
jobs.description:
I am looking for an experienced SQL Server DBA who can step in daily and keep our production environment running smoothly on SQL Server 2019. The databases you will touch are all relational and mission-critical, so deep, hands-on knowledge of T-SQL, SSMS, DMVs and standard performance-tuning techniques is essential.

Your focus areas will be:  
• Database maintenance and optimization – index and statistics management, query tuning, health checks, baselining and alerting.  
• Backup and disaster-recovery planning – setting up and validating full and differential strategies, log shipping or Always On availability groups, and running periodic restore tests.  
• Database security and user management – hardening surface area, managing roles and permissions, auditing changes, and enforcing compliance with our existing security policies.

I will provide VPN access to the servers, an agreed task list each morning, and a shared dashboard to track completed work. Expected response time during business hours is under 30 minutes for critical alerts, with non-urgent tasks finished by end of day. Clean documentation of every change in our Git-tracked runbook closes each task.

If you have a proven track record as a SQL Server 2019 DBA and are comfortable owning the areas above without constant supervision, let’s talk and set up a brief technical screening.

jobs.title: Gold E-Commerce Marketing Boost
jobs.description:
I run an online bullion and precious-metals store and need a marketer who can move the sales needle through three levers: Instagram-driven social media marketing, Google pay-per-click campaigns, and solid white-hat SEO.  

First, we’ll work together on a paid one-month test project ($300–$600) to prove traction and communication flow. If the results look good, we can roll straight into a monthly retainer in the $500–$1,500 range that scales with ad spend, or switch to an hourly setup at $8–$20 (capped at 10–15 hours per week). I’m flexible as long as the ROI is clear.

Core scope  
• Instagram: plan and schedule posts, craft ad creatives, refine audience targeting, and report weekly on engagement and conversions.  
• Google Ads: build and optimize search/shopping campaigns, manage negative keywords, A/B test ad copy, and track ROAS through Google Analytics & Tag Manager.  
• SEO: conduct keyword research geared to bullion buyers, tune on-page elements, secure high-trust backlinks, and deliver a prioritized action list so the dev team can implement technical fixes.

Success for me means higher qualified traffic, lower acquisition costs, and measurable growth in transaction value. You’ll have full access to current analytics and previous campaign data so we can hit the ground running.  

If you know this niche and can demonstrate wins in competitive e-commerce spaces, let’s talk.

jobs.title: Asesoría Certificación Salud DarwinLand
jobs.description:
Dirijo DarwinLand, nuestra escuela online, y quiero reforzar nuestro programa de preparación para exámenes de certificación profesional en el área de salud y medicina. Busco a un asesor educativo que domine estas pruebas y sepa transformar sus contenidos en experiencias digitales de alto impacto.  

Lo que necesito que desarrolles:

• Diagnóstico inicial: identifica temarios, estándares y competencias que exigen las principales certificaciones sanitarias.  
• Ruta de estudio: diseña el plan paso a paso con objetivos semanales, recursos recomendados y métricas de progreso.  
• Material didáctico clave: guías de repaso, bancos de preguntas tipo test, casos clínicos interactivos y simulacros con retroalimentación.  
• Estrategias de evaluación continua: propone cómo integrar quizzes, rúbricas y sesiones en vivo para asegurar la retención.  
• Recomendaciones de plataformas y herramientas e-learning que optimicen la entrega (LMS, cuestionarios automáticos, analítica de aprendizaje).  

Valoraré que aportes experiencia previa preparando a profesionales sanitarios, conocimiento actualizado de normativas y un enfoque pedagógico basado en evidencias. Si ya dispones de ejemplos de contenido o métricas de éxito, inclúyelos en tu propuesta.  

El entregable final será un paquete estructurado listo para implementarse en DarwinLand, junto con una breve guía de puesta en marcha. Espero tu propuesta y tiempos estimados de entrega.

jobs.title: Humorous Cartoon Birthday Life Story
jobs.description:
I’m putting together an 8–10 minute 2D animation that celebrates someone’s life in a light-hearted, funny way for their upcoming birthday. The look should stay fully cartoonish—not realistic or abstract—because I want the visuals to feel playful and warm throughout the story.

Here’s the flow I have in mind: we open on childhood memories, glide through standout moments—school pranks, first job mishaps, quirky hobbies—and wrap up with a cheerful birthday finale. I already have key anecdotes and photos you can reference; you’ll be free to embellish the comedy as long as the facts remain recognizable.

Core needs  
• A polished storyboard so I can sign off on pacing and jokes before full production.  
• All artwork, rough to final, created in a consistent 2D cartoon style (Adobe Animate, Toon Boom, or similar).  
• A clear, well-timed voice-over narration woven into the animation which will be provided.
• Smooth editing, sound mixing, and delivery of a single HD file ready to play at the party.

Optional extras like background music or on-screen captions are welcome if they enhance the humor, but the voice-over is the must-have element.

Let me know your approach, any previous cartoon storytelling you’ve done, and a realistic schedule for turning this around. I’m eager to make this birthday tribute both memorable and laugh-out-loud fun.

jobs.title: TikTok Shop Setup & Scale
jobs.description:

• Ad campaign management – plan, launch and fine-tune conversion-focused Spark Ads/Video Shopping Ads, including creative suggestions, audience targeting and performance tracking inside TikTok Ads Manager.

Success will be measured by:  
1. Shop approved and publishable without policy flags.  
2. At least five products uploaded, each passing the in-app quality review and ready for purchase.  
3. First ad set launched with clear ROAS tracking and an initial sales benchmark we set together.

If you have a proven record of opening TikTok Shops and scaling new accounts from zero activity to profitable campaigns, I’d love to collaborate.

jobs.title: Video-Call Rental Boyfriend Platform
jobs.description:
I want to launch a simple, polished service where clients can book time with an “online rental boyfriend” and interact solely through live video calls. The entire flow—from browsing available time slots to paying and connecting—needs to feel seamless on both mobile and desktop.

Here’s what I have in mind: a responsive landing page that explains the service, a secure sign-up/login system, a calendar for real-time availability, integrated payments, automated reminders, and a built-in HD video room (or a smooth hand-off to a trusted third-party video provider if that shortens development time). I’m flexible on the underlying stack as long as sessions are private, stable, and easy for non-tech-savvy users to join.

Deliverables
• Public website and user dashboard  
• Booking & payment workflow wired to the video call module  
• Admin panel to view bookings, adjust pricing, and pull basic usage stats  
• Clean, modern UI/UX with brand-ready placeholder graphics  
• Deployment to a production server plus a quick hand-off guide

I value clear communication, maintainable code, and a realistic timeline. If you’ve built tele-consultation, tutoring, or virtual event platforms before, I’d love to see what you’ve done and discuss how we can adapt your expertise to this niche concept.

jobs.title: Mobile Bingo Game UI Design

Program Procedures

Page size and margins

Typography
Spacing

Checkboxes

Page numbering
Colors
Alignment

Tables splitting incorrectly
Headers/footers moving
Large blank areas appearing
Horizontal scrolling
Content extending outside the page
Elements overlapping
Different page layouts appearing when the document is opened in Word

The Word document should look like the approved Figma design at normal 100% page view and when printed/exported to PDF.

Properly functioning editable fields

Clean and stable layout

Ideal candidate

Advanced Microsoft Word
Complex multi-page document formatting
Word tables
Headers and footers
Page breaks and pagination
Editable Word forms
Checkboxes/form fields
Document templates
PDF conversion
Maintaining fixed layouts in editable Word documents
Reproducing professional designs from Figma/Adobe/InDesign/PDF into Word

Please do not apply if your experience is primarily graphic design or basic Word formatting.

2 examples of complex Word documents you have created, preferably contracts, agreements, proposals, financial documents, forms, or similar professional documents.
Examples where the Word document contains multiple pages and complex formatting.
Briefly explain how you prevent Word documents from changing layout when users edit the text.
Confirm that you can work using standard Microsoft/Windows fonts without requiring users to install fonts.
Confirm that you can deliver both editable DOCX and matching PDF versions.
Please provide your fixed price or estimated price and turnaround time for all 4 documents.

jobs.title: Promotional Social Posts & Video Edits

jobs.title: Clinical Textbook Review Needed
jobs.description:
I have a clinical-practice medical textbook written for medical students that now needs a professional, chapter-by-chapter review. The manuscript is complete at roughly 700 pages, including texture mind map, figure , other text, case senrio ,mnemonic  it book for 5 stage medical student written   Based on the principles of cognitive neuroscience, this curriculum offers rapid comprehension and easy memorization with minimal cognitive effort and significant time savings, while ensuring access to a vast amount of information. It is an advanced method and style of information presentation. Dual coding, Feynman's principle, and an exciting array of tools make the learning process enjoyable.

Your task is to read the entire work with two lenses: accuracy and teachability. I want every diagnostic algorithm, drug dose, and guideline checked against current evidence; at the same time, the flow, clarity, and level of detail should remain appropriate for a student encountering the material for the first time. Where explanations feel rushed or overly advanced, please flag them and suggest edits.  

Specific deliverables  
• A marked-up copy (Track Changes in Word or comments in PDF) highlighting factual corrections, ambiguous sentences, and layout glitches.  
• A summary report that covers overall structure, pedagogical strengths/weaknesses, and any clinical content that requires deeper revision or updated references.  
• Verification that all references, tables, and figures are labelled consistently and cited correctly.  

Acceptance criteria  
– No unaddressed factual inaccuracies remain in the text.  
– Feedback is specific enough for me to enact revisions without follow-up questions.  
– The tone and depth consistently match the knowledge base of third- and fourth-year medical students.  

Familiarity with current clinical guidelines, strong editorial skills, and an eye for didactic design will be essential for this assignment.

jobs.title: Minimalist Color-Specific Logo Design
jobs.description:

Here’s what I’d like handed over at the end:

Two or three rounds of refinement should be plenty; the main goal is a logo that feels timeless, scales well, and looks just as strong on a business card as it does online. If that sounds like your forte, I’m ready to see your ideas.

jobs.title: Commission-Based Website Sales Agent

jobs.title: Softr Specialist for Business Directory Completion

jobs.title: Expert Price Trend Analyst for Industries

jobs.title: Set Up GA4, GTM & Google Ads Conversion Tracking with GCLID – Cashfree/Razorpay Payments
jobs.description:
I am looking for an experienced Google Ads conversion tracking specialist to review, improve, and implement a reliable full-funnel conversion tracking system for my webinar business.

My funnel works as follows:

Google Ads → ₹9 Webinar Purchase → Optional ₹199 Purchase → ₹5,000/₹10,000 Main Program Purchase

The main objective is to give Google Ads complete and accurate funnel/revenue information, so that over time I can optimize campaigns based on users who generate higher revenue rather than only optimizing for the cheapest ₹9 webinar registrations.

Current Setup

I currently use:

- Google Ads
- Google Analytics 4 (GA4)
- Google Tag Manager (GTM)
- Cashfree
- Razorpay
- Pabbly Connect
- Google Sheets
- GCLID capture/storage

Cashfree and Razorpay are used for collecting payments.

Currently, some conversion tracking depends on browser/page-based tracking. I want successful payments to be tracked reliably even if the customer closes the browser, does not reach the Thank You page, or purchases the main program later through a separate payment link.

Tracking Requirements

1. ₹9 Webinar Purchase

Every successful ₹9 payment should be reliably sent to Google Ads with the appropriate:

- GCLID / attribution information
- Conversion value
- Currency
- Transaction/order ID
- Conversion timestamp

Tracking should preferably use successful payment confirmation/webhook data rather than relying only on the Thank You page.

2. ₹199 Optional Purchase

Some webinar customers also purchase an optional ₹199 product.

Google Ads should receive this purchase and its value while maintaining attribution to the original ad click/customer wherever technically possible.

3. ₹5,000 / ₹10,000 Main Program Purchase

This is the most important downstream conversion.

A customer may purchase the main program hours or days after the original ₹9 webinar registration, sometimes through a separate Cashfree/Razorpay payment link.

I want this revenue to be connected back to the original Google Ads acquisition wherever possible, using stored GCLID and/or appropriate first-party customer data.

The purpose is for Google Ads to eventually understand which campaigns, ads, and users are generating actual high-value customers.

Reliability & Deduplication

The implementation should prevent duplicate conversions if the same transaction is received through multiple sources such as:

- Payment gateway/webhook
- GA4
- GTM/browser tracking
- Thank You page

Proper transaction/order IDs and deduplication logic should be implemented.

I do not want Google Ads to count the same payment twice.

Conversion Structure

I would also like the freelancer to advise and implement the appropriate Google Ads conversion structure, including:

- Primary vs. secondary conversion actions
- ₹9 initial purchase
- ₹199 bump purchase
- ₹5,000/₹10,000 main program purchase
- Conversion values
- Enhanced Conversions where appropriate
- Offline/data-import conversions where appropriate

The final architecture should be designed so that Google Ads receives useful signals for revenue/value-based optimization, not simply the maximum number of low-cost ₹9 purchases.

Freelancer Must Have Experience With

Please apply only if you have practical implementation experience with:

- Google Ads conversion tracking
- GCLID capture, storage and matching
- Google Ads offline/data import conversions
- Enhanced Conversions
- GA4
- GTM
- Payment gateway/webhook conversion tracking
- Conversion value tracking
- Transaction ID and conversion deduplication
- Multi-step funnels
- Delayed/offline upsell attribution

Experience with Cashfree, Razorpay and Pabbly Connect will be strongly preferred.

Before Implementation

Before making changes, I would like you to audit my existing setup and clearly explain how you plan to connect:

Original Google Ads Click → ₹9 Purchase → ₹199 Purchase → ₹5,000/₹10,000 Purchase

Please explain:

1. How GCLID/attribution data will be captured and stored.
2. How successful Cashfree/Razorpay payments will trigger conversions.
3. How Pabbly/webhooks will be used, if required.
4. How delayed ₹5,000/₹10,000 purchases will be matched with the original customer/ad click.
5. How duplicate conversions will be prevented.
6. What conversion actions should be Primary vs. Secondary in Google Ads.
7. How the setup will remain reliable even when the Thank You page is not opened.

Expected Outcome

At the end of the project, I want Google Ads to reliably understand not just:

Who purchased the ₹9 webinar?

but also:

Which Google Ads-acquired customers later generated ₹199, ₹5,000 or ₹10,000 in revenue?

The ultimate goal is to provide Google Ads with better-quality conversion and revenue signals so campaigns can eventually be optimized toward customers with higher business value.

Please briefly describe your proposed technical approach when applying rather than sending a generic proposal.

Automation can rely on a headless WinOLS instance or the WinOLS automation API—whichever you have proven experience with.

Acceptance criteria

There will be no advance payment.

There will be no setup fee.

jobs.title: CFD Simulation Engineer for Filtration Plants
jobs.description:
Looking for a CFD simulation engineer to simulate filtration plants. The process involves air-to-solid-particle separation. Since the particles are considered suspended, the simulation only needs to be single-phase.

You should have experience conducting the same or similar simulations in the past. You can use any tool, such as Ansys, STAR-CCM+, or OpenFOAM.

The simulation specifications are as follows:

* Single-phase
* Steady RANS
* With porous media
* Fluid: Air (and, in different simulations, water) at 23°C
* Volume flow rate: 5,000 m³/h
* Objective: Understanding flow distribution and accurately estimating pressure drop
* Plate footprint: The total volume of the plant is roughly 9.5 m³ and will result in 2–4 million cells (polyhedral)

I will provide the filter element CAD and pressure-drop curve, so that you can derive and use Cr1 and Cr2. The filtration plant CAD will also be provided.

If you are interested, please be prepared to provide a rough quote.
