jobs.title: Brick Foundation First Layer Construction
jobs.description:
I need the very first course of a brick foundation set accurately and ready for the rest of the build. The job starts at ground level, so you will handle everything from establishing a true, level base to laying that initial row of bricks with clean, even joints.  

The priority is precision: the line must be perfectly straight, the bricks plumb, and the mortar beds consistent so the next layers can rise without correction work. If you normally take care of the prep—light excavation, compacting, and damp-proof course placement—feel free to include that in your approach; I’m open to whichever method ensures a stable start.  

Please tell me:  
• Your process for verifying level and square before laying.  
• How long you’ll need on-site from set-out to final check.  
• The materials and brick-laying tools you prefer.  

I’ll have clear access to the site and prompt delivery of bricks, mortar, and any base materials you specify. Let’s get this foundation off to a flawless start.

jobs.title: Company Achievements Celebratory Film
jobs.description:
I want to produce a short, highly-polished film that captures the story of our recent milestones and communicates them in an inspirational way. The primary focus is to highlight achievements, so the narrative should celebrate key wins, showcase growth metrics and convey the energy that got us here.  

You will have access to footage from our latest corporate event, and those event highlights should sit at the heart of the piece—cutting between speeches, crowd reactions, product demos and any standout moments that visually reinforce our success. If you feel a brief voice-over or on-screen text can tighten the story arc, I’m open to creative input, but the end result must remain upbeat, forward-looking and motivational.  

Deliverables  
• A final 1 –5-minute film in 1080p (MP4) ready for internal screens, social media and client presentations  
• A separate 30-second teaser cut for quick shares  
• All project files and raw footage neatly organised for future edits  

Acceptance criteria: the film must follow brand colours and typography, include approved logo animations and receive sign-off from our communications team after a single round of revisions. Basic colour grade, tasteful motion graphics and a rights-cleared music bed are expected parts of the package.  

Please outline your proposed workflow, timelines for each stage (concept, rough cut, final cut) and any similar achievement-driven films you’ve produced so I can see how your style fits our vision.

jobs.title: Convert Handwritten Notes to Word
jobs.description: I have a collection of handwritten pages that I need transcribed accurately into a clean Microsoft Word document. All spelling, punctuation, and line breaks should mirror the originals, and the final file must be fully editable—no scanned images or text boxes. If any words are unclear, highlight them so I can review later. Please quote for the entire job and let me know your expected turnaround time.

jobs.title: 1-Day Excel Sales Report
jobs.description:
I have a set of sales figures ready to go and I need them turned into a clean, easy-to-use workbook within 24 hours. The core goal is straightforward data management: enter the raw numbers, format the sheets for readability, and embed the key formulas—SUM, IF, and VLOOKUP—so I can spot totals and lookups instantly.  

Once everything is structured, create a simple pivot-table report that summarises sales by product, date, and any other obvious dimension that helps me track performance at a glance. Please work in Microsoft Excel (desktop) and keep the file compatible with Office 2016+.

Deliverables:  
• Neatly formatted data sheet with my existing sales data  
• Tested formulas (SUM, IF, VLOOKUP) in place  
• Pivot-table sales report on its own tab  
• Short hand-off note explaining your steps and any assumptions  

I’ll be available online for quick answers so you can meet the one-day turnaround.

jobs.title: Craft Full-Time Finance Vacancy
jobs.description:
I’m getting ready to bring a new full-time professional into my finance team and I need a polished vacancy announcement that will attract the right talent the first time.  

Here’s what I’m after: once I share my rough notes about the role, you’ll turn them into a clear, engaging job ad that highlights the position’s mission, day-to-day responsibilities, required credentials, and the growth opportunities we offer. The copy must read naturally to finance specialists while staying inclusive and compliant with standard employment-ad guidelines.  

Must-haves  
• A single-page announcement formatted for quick posting on LinkedIn, Indeed, and our company site (Word + PDF).  
• Three attention-grabbing headline options so we can A/B test.  
• A set of social snippets (≈50 words each) that we can drop into Twitter, Facebook, and internal newsletters.  

Acceptance criteria  
• Tone matches professional finance culture yet feels welcoming.  
• Keywords for common finance roles woven in without stuffing—think “risk analysis,” “financial reporting,” “regulatory compliance.”  
• Delivered ready-to-publish within two business days of receiving my notes; one revision round included.  

If you’ve written job ads for the finance industry before and can show samples, I’d love to see them. Looking forward to collaborating and launching this announcement quickly.

jobs.title: Social Media, Community & Outreach Specialist – Long-Term
jobs.description:
I’m looking for a reliable and proactive Social Media, Community & Outreach Specialist for a long-term collaboration supporting two businesses:

1. A software development studio/agency
2. A Japanese language/JLPT teaching business

This is a hybrid role combining social media management, content creation/posting, community engagement, inquiry handling, lead generation, and personalized outreach.

### Responsibilities

**Social Media & Content**

* Help manage Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, Telegram, Messenger, and Reddit.
* Create/publish approximately 3–5 original content pieces per week.
* Repurpose content appropriately across different platforms.
* Create basic graphics, carousels, or short videos when needed.
* Respond to comments, DMs, Messenger messages, Telegram inquiries, and other social interactions.

**Community Engagement & Promotion**

* Find and participate in relevant Facebook groups, Reddit communities, LinkedIn communities, Telegram groups, and other relevant online communities.
* Regularly interact with people, answer questions, join discussions, and build relationships.
* Promote our services/classes where appropriate and permitted by community rules.
* Identify communities that generate useful engagement, leads, or student inquiries.

I do NOT want spam or mass posting that violates platform/community rules. Genuine participation and relationship building are important.

**Software Business Outreach**

* Research startup founders, early-stage companies, SMEs, entrepreneurs, and business owners.
* Find potential clients through LinkedIn, Facebook, Reddit, TikTok, communities, and other appropriate channels.
* Start personalized conversations with relevant prospects.
* Follow up consistently.
* Identify potential business needs and qualified opportunities.
* Bring interested/qualified prospects to me for deeper technical discovery and proposals.

Our software services may include custom web applications, business systems, workflow automation, websites, SaaS development, AI integrations, and related software solutions.

**JLPT / Japanese Education**

* Help promote our Japanese-language/JLPT classes.
* Find communities containing Japanese learners and potential students.
* Publish educational/promotional content.
* Respond to prospective student inquiries.
* Communicate with interested students and follow up.
* Help convert social-media engagement into genuine class inquiries.

### Who I’m Looking For

Ideally, you have experience with some of the following:

* Social media management
* Community management
* Lead generation
* LinkedIn outreach
* B2B prospecting
* Facebook group marketing
* Reddit community engagement
* Content creation
* Canva/CapCut or similar tools
* Social media DMs and inquiry handling
* Prospect research
* Follow-ups
* CRM/lead tracking

You do not need to be an expert in every area.

I care more about someone who is active, reliable, organized, comfortable communicating with new people every day, willing to learn, and able to work independently.

### Important

I am NOT looking for someone who only gives me a spreadsheet containing hundreds of leads.

I want someone who actually participates:

Research → Find people → Engage → Outreach → Communicate → Follow up → Qualify → Bring interested people to us.

There will also be ongoing content and community-management responsibilities.

### Long-Term Opportunity

This is intended to become an ongoing collaboration.

However, I would like to begin with a small PAID trial/pilot. If your work, communication, outreach quality, reliability, and results are good, we can continue long-term and gradually increase responsibilities and working hours.

### When Bidding

Please answer:

1. Which platforms have you personally managed?
2. What experience do you have with social media/community management?
3. Have you done LinkedIn or B2B outreach? Please give an example.
4. Have you used Facebook groups for community engagement or business promotion?
5. Do you have experience using Reddit for genuine community engagement?
6. Can you create basic social-media graphics or short videos? Which tools do you use?
7. How would you find potential clients for a small software development agency?
8. How would you find potential students for JLPT/Japanese classes?
9. How many hours per week are you available?
10. What hourly rate would you expect for a long-term collaboration?

Please avoid sending a generic proposal. Tell me briefly how you would approach these two businesses.

jobs.title: Realistic AI Clone Video
jobs.description:
I have a short-form script ready, along with a clean voice track that I can supply if it helps. What I need from you is a high-quality, realistic AI clone of myself that performs the script word for word and mirrors the exact gestures and expressions I describe.  

The finished clip will be used on social media, so it must look natural, loop smoothly, and be delivered in a feed-friendly format (1080p MP4 preferred). Feel free to build the clone in whatever platform you trust—whether that’s Synthesia, D-ID, DeepBrain, or a custom Unreal/MetaHuman pipeline—as long as the end result is photorealistic, lip-synced to my audio, and motion-tracked to the cues in the script.  

Once complete, hand over:  
• The final rendered video  
• The project source files or settings so I can iterate on future scripts  

If you have any questions about reference photos, voice timing, or scene layout, let me know and I will supply what you need right away.

jobs.title: Modern Business Website Development
jobs.description:
I need a skilled web developer to build a small-to-medium business website that looks modern and stays clean and uncluttered throughout. The site should showcase our services in an easy-to-browse listing and include a fully functional contact form that routes enquiries to our team email.  

A responsive layout is a must so the design adapts gracefully to phones, tablets, and desktops. I’m open to WordPress, Webflow, or a lightweight custom stack—choose whichever you feel will deliver fast load times, solid security, and simple content management once the project is handed over.  

Deliverables:  
• Pixel-perfect, modern interface consistent across major browsers  
• Service listing section that we can update ourselves (no hard-coding)  
• Contact form with spam protection and email notifications  
• Basic on-page SEO setup and submission to search engines  
• Final site migrated to our hosting and a short hand-off guide  

Please outline your proposed tech stack, timeline, and any similar work you’ve done so I can get a feel for your style before we get started.

jobs.title: Colorful Mobile App UI Design
jobs.description:
I need a full set of 20 high-fidelity mobile screens designed in a colorful, vibrant style. The app’s core palette is already defined, but no formal brand guidelines exist yet, so the engagement begins by translating that palette into a concise style guide that will steer every screen, component, and interaction.

Three elements are non-negotiable: custom icons and illustrations that feel native to the color scheme, smooth interactive animations that reinforce key user actions, and typography that remains consistent across device sizes. I’m happy to supply product flows and rough wireframes; you’ll turn them into pixel-perfect screens in Figma or Sketch and deliver motion examples via After Effects, Lottie, or a comparable tool.

Share a brief cost breakdown along with links to recent projects that show mastery of vibrant color work, iconography, and micro-interactions. Final hand-off should include:

• 20 production-ready screen files  
• Icon & illustration set (vector)  
• Animation prototypes (or Lottie JSONs)  
• Mini style guide built from the provided palette

Please mention your estimated timeline and any questions you have so we can lock the scope quickly.

jobs.title: App móvil para Movilpax
jobs.description:
Necesito desarrollar una aplicación móvil básica nativa para iOS y Android.

Alcance principal, ver archivo adjunto.

jobs.title: Facebook Memories Digital Album
jobs.description:
I need every photo, post image, and tagged shot that’s ever appeared on my Facebook profile pulled down, cleaned up, and placed into a single, easy-to-share digital photo album. The images must appear strictly in chronological order—from my very first upload right through to today—and each one should carry its original Facebook caption so my daughter can understand the context behind every memory without having to log in.

Here’s what matters most to me:

• Complete extraction: wall posts, mobile uploads, tagged images, “On This Day” memories—anything visual that tells the story.  
• High-resolution quality: no compression artifacts from Facebook’s download; please source the highest version available.  
• Chronological flow: oldest to newest, clearly separated by year (or month if that feels more natural after you see the volume).  
• Captions preserved: copy them verbatim beneath each image inside the album layout.  
• Final format: a self-contained digital photo album (a shareable .book or .album file, or an interactive PDF—whatever tool you prefer so long as the viewing experience is smooth and offline-friendly).

I’m undecided about adding background music because a slideshow isn’t my main priority right now; if you have an elegant way to weave music in later, we can discuss it after the album is complete.

Hand-off package: the polished album file plus an organized folder of the raw, date-named images for future printing.

Once this job is done I’ll be closing my Facebook account for good, so accuracy and completeness are non-negotiable.

jobs.title: Video Editor Wanted for Family Lifestyle Channels
jobs.description:
Looking for an experienced Video Editor for my YouTube channel and Instagram.
Content will mainly include family daily vlogs, lifestyle, travel, road trips, and short-form reels.
Responsibilities include cutting raw footage, arranging clips, transitions, music, sound effects, color correction and basic color grading.
Create YouTube long-form videos with good storytelling, pacing and audience retention.
Create Instagram Reels/YouTube Shorts with fast-paced editing, hooks, captions and trending editing styles.
Add subtitles, animated text, zoom-ins, B-roll, sound effects and suitable background music wherever required.
Good understanding of Indian/Hindi + English content and family-vlog style is preferred.
Should be able to identify boring/unnecessary footage and remove it without requiring detailed instructions for every cut.
Editor should have a good sense of storytelling, timing, humor and emotional moments.
Ability to create different versions/formats for YouTube, Instagram Reels and Shorts.
Should be comfortable working with raw footage from mobile phones, GoPro/action cameras and DSLR/mirrorless cameras.

jobs.title: Urgent Notes Typing to PDF
jobs.description:
I need a fast-turnaround transcription of my handwritten notes into a clean, professionally laid-out PDF. Accuracy is critical, but I do not want a scan-style replica; instead, follow the custom formatting guidelines I will supply once we start. These guidelines will cover items such as preferred font, size, possible headers or footers, and the placement of any embedded images or diagrams that appear in the original pages.

The final deliverable must be a ready-to-share PDF. Supplying the editable source file (Word or similar) as a secondary file would be appreciated, but only the PDF is mandatory.

Please be comfortable deciphering varied handwriting, applying consistent styling, and turning work around quickly. Let me know your typical typing speed and how soon you can begin, and feel free to flag any unclear sections in the notes so we keep the text error-free throughout.

jobs.title: Fix Wireless Printing & PDFs
jobs.description:
I need someone who can jump in remotely and sort out two nagging problems for me:

1) My laptop refuses to talk to the wireless printer. The network sees other devices just fine, yet every time I try to print nothing goes through. I’d like you to check drivers, Wi-Fi settings, and the printer’s own network configuration so the machine shows up reliably and accepts jobs without a hitch.

2) PDFs are displaying incorrectly on both my laptop and my iPhone. Files stored in iCloud Drive and OneDrive sometimes open with missing characters or shifted formatting. The aim is to have every document render the same way on both devices, whether I view them in Acrobat, Preview, or the native Files app.

Deliverables  
• A stable wireless connection between the laptop and printer, confirmed with a successful test print.  
• Correctly rendered PDFs on the laptop and iPhone—including those synced through iCloud Drive and OneDrive—with a brief note on the changes you made so I can keep things working.

If you’re comfortable troubleshooting Wi-Fi printers, cloud storage sync, and PDF readers, let’s get this wrapped up quickly.

jobs.title: Publicités vidéo IA réseaux sociaux
jobs.description:
Je souhaite lancer une série de publicités destinées aux réseaux sociaux – TikTok, Instagram et Facebook – en m’appuyant sur des personnages générés par intelligence artificielle. L’objectif est de présenter notre produit de façon dynamique, moderne et parfaitement alignée sur l’image de la marque.

Ce que j’attends :
• Concept créatif et storyboard bref adaptés à chaque plateforme, en respectant les formats recommandés (TikTok 9:16 ≤15 s, Instagram 1:1 ≤30 s, Facebook 16:9 ≤30 s).  
• Génération et animation de personnages IA qui incarnent notre ton (je fourni les grandes lignes de persona).  
• Intégration d’une voix off naturelle, de textes accrocheurs, d’une piste musicale libre de droits et d’effets visuels légers pour renforcer l’impact.  
• Une première version pour validation, puis ajustements jusqu’à obtention du résultat final.  
• Livrables : fichiers MP4 optimisés pour chaque réseau + fichier source du projet.

Je reste ouverte à vos idées sur la manière de tirer le meilleur parti de l’IA pour capter l’attention de notre audience. Merci de joindre à votre proposition quelques exemples comparables, votre méthode de travail et le délai estimé.

jobs.title: Aide recherche emploi domicile
E-Ticaret Canlı Destek Temsilcisi
jobs.description:
E-ticaret mağazamda müşterilere canlı sohbet üzerinden hızlı ve çözüm odaklı destek sunacak bir temsilciye ihtiyacım var. Görevlerim net:  

• Gelen soru ve talepleri anında karşılamak, doğru bilgiyle yönlendirmek.  
• İade ve değişim süreçlerini sistemim üzerinden sorunsuzca yönetmek, müşteriye adım adım rehberlik etmek.  

İletişim tonum samimi ama profesyonel; markamın güvenini yansıtmanı bekliyorum. Deneyimliysen ve online müşteri memnuniyetini artırma konusunda kendine güveniyorsan, detayları konuşalım.

jobs.title: Stylized Hero Animation Set
jobs.description:
I’m ready to bring a new hero into Unity, but I need a complete suite of stylized animations before the character can hit the scene. You’ll receive the rigged model, rig specs, and video reference for timing and attitude. From there, I’m looking for polished, game-ready clips that feel snappy and heroic while remaining 100 % retargetable to my humanoid rig.

What I need you to create  
• Idle (loop)  
• Walk (loop)  
• Run (loop)  
• Jump up, in-air loop, and land  
• Light and heavy attacks (root motion where it sells the move)  
• Hit / stagger reactions

Unity-specific setup  
Once the clips are finalized, export them as clean FBX files, import them into Unity, and wire everything into a single Animator Controller with sensible parameters and blend trees so I can drop the prefab into a scene and press Play. All loops should be seamless; any root motion clips must track correctly at the origin; pivots need to be consistent across all files.

Acceptance check  
• No visible pops or foot-skate on loops  
• Animator Controller plugged into a demo scene showing each state transition  
• Files named logically and organized in a Unity package

If you thrive on stylized motion and know Unity’s mecanim system inside out, I’d love to see your reel and discuss timing.

jobs.title: Healthcare Web App Development
jobs.description:
I plan to launch a secure, responsive web application focused on healthcare workflows. The platform will serve three user groups—patients, healthcare providers, and administrative staff—so every interface must be intuitive and role-based access must be built in from the start.

Core features required
• Appointment scheduling – real-time slot selection, automated reminders, and calendar sync.  
• Patient records management – HIPAA-compliant storage, audit trails, and granular permissions.  
• Telemedicine functionality – HD video consults, in-session chat, and the ability to share files or images securely.

Deliverables
• Fully functioning web app deployed to a cloud environment of our choosing.  
• Source code in a Git repository, clearly documented.  
• Setup instructions and brief user guide for each role.  
• One month of post-launch support for bug fixes or minor tweaks.

Acceptance criteria
1. Each core feature operates smoothly across modern browsers and mobile devices.  
2. All data transmissions are encrypted end-to-end; sensitive information is never exposed in logs.  
3. Patients, providers, and staff can sign up, sign in, and navigate only the modules assigned to their role.  
4. Video consultations maintain stable performance on typical broadband connections.  
5. Tests (unit and basic end-to-end) cover critical paths and pass in CI.

I am open to the stack you recommend—whether that’s React, Vue, or another front-end framework paired with Node, Django, or similar on the back end—as long as the finished product is robust, maintainable, and ready for iterative upgrades.

jobs.title: Full CPSR for Essential Oil Blend
jobs.description:
I’m ready to take my essential-oil blend to market and need a Full Cosmetic Product Safety Report to clear the final regulatory hurdle. I have the full formulation, each ingredient’s safety data, and the recommended usage instructions prepared and will forward them straight away.

Using that material, please compile Part A (toxicological profile, exposure, margins of safety, etc.) and Part B (your professional safety assessment and conclusion) so the file meets current EU/UK Cosmetic Regulation 1223/2009 requirements. If any additional tests or refinements are necessary, list them clearly so I can arrange them without delay.

Deliverables
• CPSR Part A & Part B in PDF format  
• Supporting calculation sheets or software outputs  
• Brief note on any remaining compliance actions

I’m aiming for a turnaround of about two weeks. When you reply, let me know your safety-assessor credentials and a couple of similar reports you have produced so I can move forward quickly.

jobs.title: Ambient Study Music Composer -- 2
jobs.description:
I’m looking for an artist who can craft a single, seamless ambient track that supports study and concentration. The piece should run between 15 and 30 minutes and maintain a neutral, steady mood—no dramatic transitions, lyrics, or distracting elements.

Here’s what I need:
• Original composition in WAV and high-quality MP3.
• Consistent tempo and subtle texture shifts to keep the listener engaged without breaking focus.
• Light mastering so the track is playback-ready on headphones and standard speakers.

I’m happy to share reference tracks once we connect. If you produce in Ableton, Logic, FL Studio, or similar, just let me know your workflow so we can align on file formats.

jobs.title: Whatnot Viewer Automation Development
jobs.description: I'm seeking an expert in automation tools to help me with a specific project involving Whatnot auctions. The tool should have the following capabilities:   - Account Creation: The tool should be able to generate usernames and use temporary email addresses for creating accounts. - Viewer Management: It should point these accounts to a stream of my choice, stagger entrance of the viewers, and set a specific number of viewers I desire. - Direct Stream Access: Viewers should be directed to the stream using a direct URL.  This project requires a strong understanding of automation software, account generation, and viewer management systems. Experience with auction platforms, particularly Whatnot, would be a significant advantage. I'm looking for someone who can deliver a reliable and efficient tool for this purpose.

jobs.title: Excel Sales Data Reporting
jobs.description:
I have a collection of raw sales figures that need to be transformed into meaningful insights. The focus is squarely on analysis and reporting—not simple data entry—so I’ll rely on your strong Microsoft Excel skills, from advanced formulas and PivotTables to charts and, if helpful, Power Query or simple macros.

Here’s what I’m aiming to see in the final workbook:

• Sales performance broken down by region, visualised clearly so out-performing and under-performing areas stand out at a glance.  
• Month-by-month sales trends that reveal seasonality and growth patterns.  
• Product-level performance analysis, highlighting best-sellers, slow movers and any anomalies worth further investigation.

Clean formatting matters: dynamic ranges, slicers, and clearly labeled tabs will make the file easy to refresh with new data later on. Please document any calculated fields or assumptions directly in the sheet so the logic is transparent.

If you’ve built similar sales dashboards before, feel free to reference them; otherwise a quick outline of your proposed structure will help me confirm we’re on the same page. Once we agree on the layout, I’ll hand over the raw CSV exports so you can get started right away.

jobs.title: PineScript Ichimoku Algo Trading
jobs.description:
I already have a complete PineScript strategy that reads Ichimoku-cloud signals and, in particular, fires when my custom cloud rules and Chikou-span crossovers align. Now I need that strategy to place live trades automatically.

Scope  
• Brokers: First choice is Kotak Neo and Master Trust; if an identical flow is not possible on those, I will fall back to Upstox.  
• Markets: The code must route orders for every NSE stock-futures contract as well as all actively traded MCX futures.  
• Logic: Use my existing PineScript exactly as written so the entry, exit and risk filters remain untouched. Your job is to listen to its alerts (or refactor the core logic to another language if it improves reliability) and translate them into market/limit orders with correct quantity, product type and stop-loss/target.  
• Execution quality: I expect rapid order acknowledgement, automatic error-retry, position reconciliation at session close and basic logging I can read in plain English.  
ensure proper risk management , i prefer exectuin using free server but needs opions how it will be executed
Deliverables  
1. A live, broker-authenticated execution module (Python, Node or any stable stack) deployed on my VPS or your recommended cloud instance.  
2. Step-by-step documentation so I can change API keys, add new symbols or adjust quantity rules without touching the core logic.  
3. One trading day of guided live-market testing to prove orders are placed, modified and squared off exactly when the Pine alerts occur.  
4 with proper dashboard 
5. well aware of market structure .
6. i want clarity if its possible to scan and execute properly using any free server or how you will suggest me to execute  
Acceptance criteria  
• No manual clicks once the system is armed.  
• All fills and rejections echoed back to a log file and Telegram/Slack notifier in real time.  
• Position size and margin checks handled before every order to prevent rejections on the broker side.  

If you have prior experience with Kotak Neo or Master Trust APIs, let me know—otherwise show me how you plan to bridge TradingView alerts to these brokers securely. I’m ready to start immediately and will provide the PineScript upon award.

jobs.title: Engaging Interviewer wanted for Music Artist
jobs.description:
We're a Major Record Label (Caroline Believe SAS) searching for an English-speaking native to conduct an interview with our 22 year old artist about his debut in rap as well as his rap album. 

We need someone who can ask thoughtful questions, dive deeper into answers, keep the conversation natural, and help turn the interview into a compelling piece of promotional use. Please share relevant experience with interviews, content creation, or music-related projects.

You’ll be given a set of brand-safe questions, but I want you to ask them naturally in your own manner so the conversation feels fluid, genuine, and entertaining. You can reword questions where needed. No graphic, insensitive, or controversial topics.

You will be paid up to 80% more as a bonus depending on the type of content you generate during this interview. Going above and beyond, having background knowledge & creating viral moments are all things that will contribute.

This interview will be used as promotional content across social media for the album in perpetuity, so please be comfortable sharing your image online.

jobs.title: Modern Minimalist Website Build
jobs.description:
I’m looking to launch a lightweight, professional website with a distinctly modern and minimalist feel. The entire interface should work seamlessly in a monochrome palette—black, white, and greys—so the design must rely on clean typography, balanced spacing, and subtle visual hierarchy rather than heavy graphics.

Core requirements  
• Build a responsive site that loads quickly on both desktop and mobile.  
• Structure pages for text-based content and blog posts, with an intuitive CMS or markdown workflow so I can add and edit articles on my own.  
• Apply a consistent minimalist theme throughout, ensuring the monochrome color scheme never clashes with future imagery or embedded media.  
• Include essential SEO tags, logical heading structure, and accessibility best practices (contrast, alt tags, keyboard navigation).  

What I’ll provide  
• Final copy for each page and blog category.  
• Logo files and any supporting assets.  

What I need from you  
• Wireframe or mock-up for approval before development begins.  
• The finished site coded, deployed to my hosting, and handed over with clear instructions for updating content.  
• A brief post-launch window (about a week) for small tweaks or bug fixes.  

If you have a portfolio of similarly minimalist sites—especially ones optimized for speed—share the links so I can see your approach. Let’s discuss timeline, preferred tech stack, and any questions you might have to get started.

jobs.title: Complete Website Overhaul for Engagement
jobs.description:
My current site feels dated and, more importantly, isn’t turning visitors into active users. I’m ready for a complete overhaul that puts user engagement front and center.

Scope of work  
I want every page re-imagined—from the information architecture through to pixel-perfect visual design. The new experience should guide visitors intuitively, keep them browsing longer, and encourage more clicks on key calls-to-action. To get there, I need:

• Streamlined navigation and rock-solid usability so anyone finds what they need in two clicks or less.  
• A fresh content layout with modern visuals, balanced white space, and consistent typography that supports the brand story.  
• Interactive features (micro-animations, subtle hover states, dynamic sections, etc.) that add delight without slowing the site down.

I’m happy to collaborate on wireframes and approve high-fidelity mock-ups before you move to development. Please use the design tool you feel most comfortable with—Figma, Adobe XD or Sketch are all fine—and keep responsiveness in mind from day one.

Deliverables  
1. Site-wide UX audit summary (current pain points + proposed structure)  
2. Low-fidelity wireframes for desktop & mobile breakpoints  
3. High-fidelity, brand-ready designs for all core pages  
4. Style guide covering fonts, colors, iconography, and reusable components  
5. Handoff package with assets and specs ready for developers (Zeplin, Figma Inspect, or similar)

I’ll provide brand assets, access to the existing site, and timely feedback. If you’ve transformed similar sites and can share live links or case studies, I’d love to review them.

jobs.title: Dropshipping Instagram Page Manager
jobs.description:
Instagram & Dropshipping Page Manager
About the Job

We are looking for a creative and responsible Instagram Page Manager to manage our dropshipping brand's Instagram account.

The person will be responsible for regularly uploading the product content we provide, researching trending products and advertisements, and helping us grow the Instagram page.

What You Will Do
Manage our Instagram page on a regular basis.
Upload product images/videos provided by us.
Write engaging captions for posts.
Add relevant hashtags and keywords.
Research trending dropshipping products.
Find and analyze successful product ads and marketing creatives.
Research competitors and their Instagram strategies.
Suggest new content ideas.
Maintain a consistent posting schedule.
Help improve Instagram engagement and reach.
Monitor comments and basic customer interactions.
Track which posts/products perform well.
Give us regular updates about page performance.
What We Will Provide

We will provide:

Product images/videos
Product information
Brand details
Pricing information when required
Access to the Instagram account
Any other necessary information

You will mainly handle the research, posting, content management and day-to-day Instagram operations.

Requirements

We are looking for someone who:

Understands Instagram and social media marketing.
Has basic knowledge of dropshipping/e-commerce.
Can identify trending products and advertisements.
Has good research skills.
Can write simple and engaging captions.
Is consistent and responsible.
Can communicate clearly.
Previous experience managing an e-commerce Instagram page is a plus.
Important

This is not just a posting job.

We want someone who can actively manage the page, research what's working in the dropshipping market, suggest improvements and help us grow the account.

Work Process

We provide products/content → You research → Create/manage posts → Research ads & trends → Monitor performance → Suggest improvements → Repeat

To Apply

Please send us:

Your previous Instagram/social media management experience.
Examples of Instagram pages you have managed, if available.
Your experience with dropshipping/e-commerce.
How you would grow a new dropshipping Instagram page.
Your expected monthly/hourly rate.
Your availability per day.

We are looking for someone interested in a long-term working relationship if the performance is good.

jobs.title: PHP Google Instant Indexer
jobs.description:
I need a compact PHP-based tool that lets me paste a URL, hit submit, and have Google pick it up within minutes. The workflow is simple: enter one or more URLs, the script calls the Google Indexing API, and I immediately see a status message that confirms whether the request was accepted or if it needs to be retried. A small dashboard that logs previous submissions and their current index status would be ideal, but the primary goal is speed and reliability.

The code must be written in PHP, cleanly commented, and easy for me to deploy on a standard LAMP stack. Please include clear setup instructions (API credentials, rate limits, cron recommendations for any background checks) and keep external dependencies to a minimum. I’ll test by submitting a handful of pages and verifying that the API response shows ‘URL notified’ without errors.

Deliverables:
• Fully functional PHP indexing tool (single-page form or lightweight admin panel)  
• Source files and README with step-by-step installation and usage guide  

Once everything works as described, I’ll release final approval.

jobs.title: Luxury Organic Logo Design
jobs.description:
I’m ready to elevate my brand with a logo that feels unmistakably premium. The overall style should read luxe and refined—something elegant rather than overtly minimalist, vintage, or hyper-modern. I picture an organic-inspired symbol, with flowing, nature-driven lines that balance sophistication with approachability.

Colour palette is set:  
• Navy blue as the dominant tone  
• Crisp white for contrast  
• Subtle gold accents for highlights and detail  

Please craft a primary logo lock-up plus a reversed/light version and a simple favicon or social icon. Final files need to include the editable vector source (.AI or .EPS) alongside high-resolution PNGs and JPGs on transparent and solid backgrounds. I’ll use the artwork across print and digital, so clean scalability is essential. Let me know if you need any additional brand context before getting started.

jobs.title: AI Agent for MARG ERP
jobs.description:
I need an AI-driven assistant that can sit on top of MARG ERP, listen to customers in real time, convert their spoken orders into data, and post those orders as Sale Challans through the standard human UI. The same agent must also be able to pull the resulting numbers from the Sales Invoicing and Reporting modules so that daily summaries can be produced automatically.

Key points you should know  
• Input method: voice only—no manual typing should be required once the call begins.  
• Interaction layer: the agent must navigate the existing windows and dialog boxes of MARG ERP exactly as a person would, not through database back-doors, so screen-automation reliability is critical.  
• Core scope: create, save, and confirm Sale Challans; generate the corresponding sales report on demand or at scheduled intervals.  
• Extensibility: design the workflow so that additional inventory or analytics automations can be plugged in later with minimal re-work.

Deliverables  
1. Fully functioning AI agent installed on one workstation and demonstrated end-to-end: voice call → Sale Challan saved → report exported.  
2. Setup script or step-by-step install guide.  
3. Brief user cheat-sheet for our operators.

I’m flexible on the underlying stack—whether you prefer GPT-4, Dialogflow, or Watson—as long as latency is low and accuracy in recognising Indian names and product codes is high. Show me a short proof-of-concept clip or live demo and we can move quickly to full roll-out.

jobs.title: Professional Blog and Website Copy
jobs.description:
I’m updating my site and want a cohesive, professional voice across both the marketing pages and our ongoing content. Specifically, I need:

• Two core pages rewritten: the Home page and the Services page  
• A series of fresh, well-researched blog posts (number to be agreed once we scope topics)

Everything should read crisply and credibly, with clear calls to action and SEO-friendly structure—think logical H1/H2 hierarchy, natural keyword placement, and meta descriptions ready to drop into WordPress. Tone must stay professional throughout, matching an expert B2B audience.

I’ll supply brand guidelines, background on our services, and preliminary keyword lists. Your copy should be original, pass Grammarly and Copyscape checks, and arrive in an editable Google Doc. I’ll review once, send consolidated feedback, and expect a clean final draft after revisions.

If that workflow sounds straightforward, let’s set milestones, lock topics, and get words flowing.

jobs.title: Single Color Vector Conversion
jobs.description:
I have a concept design saved as a PNG/JPEG that now needs to be rebuilt as a clean, one-colour vector. The final artwork should follow a strictly minimalistic approach—no gradients, no extra details—so it can be sent straight to a vinyl cutter without any additional editing on my side.

The current file shows the shapes and proportions I want, but the edges still look a bit rough when enlarged. Your task is to trace or redraw the design, tighten every curve, align any symmetry, and make sure all paths are properly closed. Please keep the artwork in a single solid colour so the cutter software can read it as one layer.

Deliverables:
• Fully editable vector file (AI or EPS)  
• SVG optimised for vinyl-cutting software  
• High-resolution PDF preview for quick proofing

I will provide the original PNG/JPEG as soon as we start. Let me know your turnaround time and any questions you may have about stroke weight, negative space, or cut lines.

jobs.title: Instagram & YouTube Stock Market Content
jobs.description:
I need a hands-on partner who can both manage my Instagram and YouTube accounts and build engaging stock market videos entirely from scratch. Your role will start with researching timely market topics, scripting concise explanations, then editing the final “Stock market” videos so they are fast-paced, visually clear, and sized correctly for each platform.

For Instagram you’ll handle feed posts, Reels, Stories, and daily engagement; on YouTube you’ll publish the longer cuts, write SEO-friendly descriptions, and create eye-catching thumbnails. Every piece should feel cohesive across both channels, always reflecting current market moves and my brand voice.

You will:

• Plan a weekly content calendar covering news recaps, trading tips, and evergreen fundamentals  
• Write scripts or bullet outlines, source or design supporting graphics, and record voice-over if needed  
• Edit the footage with clean motion graphics, captions, royalty-free music, and on-screen data pulls  
• Deliver one vertical and one horizontal version of each video, optimized for Instagram and YouTube respectively  
• Track performance in platform analytics and suggest tweaks for higher reach and watch time

Please share links to Instagram or YouTube accounts you currently manage, along with two “stock market” (or similarly data-driven) videos you have edited from scratch. Familiarity with tools such as Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, Photoshop, and a social scheduler like Hootsuite or Later will be important.

I’m ready to start as soon as I find the right fit, and I’m open to refining the cadence once we review initial results.

jobs.title: Twitch Live Streaming Videography
jobs.description:
I’m planning a professionally-run live stream on Twitch and need a videographer who can take the entire broadcast workflow off my plate—from camera setup through the final sign-off. Because I’ve chosen Twitch as the platform, familiarity with its ingest settings, bitrate recommendations, and chat-interaction tools is important. There’s no hard deadline, so we can discuss dates that align with both of our schedules and allow proper pre-production testing.

Your role will cover:

• Capturing and switching between camera angles in real time  
• Managing on-site audio so levels stay consistent throughout the stream  
• Encoding and streaming to Twitch at a stable, platform-approved bitrate  
• Handling basic graphics or lower thirds if needed (OBS, vMix, or similar)  
• Providing me with a clean recording of the broadcast once we wrap

If you’ve previously streamed events or productions to Twitch, share a link or two so I can see your style. I’m open to creative suggestions on equipment or workflow improvements, and I’ll supply venue details once we connect. Looking forward to a smooth, glitch-free stream together.

jobs.title: Realistic 30-Sec Jedlik Delivery Promo
jobs.description:
I need a tight, 30-second 3D animation that captures the buzz of an IPL evening when every house on one street keeps tapping “Order Now.” In the first beat we see a conventional two-wheeler rider juggling only two food bags per trip; the queue of orders grows, customers frown, and the kitchen dashboard flashes red.  

Cut to the same scene played back with our Jedlik last-mile electric vehicle: one sleek run, the entire street served in a single round. Doors open, steaming meals appear instantly, neighbours exchange smiles and high-fives. The contrast must feel real, energetic and emotionally satisfying—efficiency and customer happiness are the twin messages I want viewers to feel in their gut.

Style & quality  
• Fully realistic 3D look—materials, lighting and motion close to live action.  
• Cinematic but punchy pacing suitable for social feeds and B2B presentations.  
• Subtle graphical overlays (order counter, delivery time) that reinforce the efficiency gain without distracting from the emotion.

Deliverables  
1. Script and storyboard reflecting the IPL-night narrative for sign-off.  
2. All modelling, texturing, animation, lighting and compositing assets.  
3. Final 30-second master in 1080p (mp4) plus clean version for localisation.  
4. Still frames and a 5-second teaser loop for social snippets.

Acceptance  
The promo is approved when the side-by-side before/after clearly shows Jedlik cutting delivery time, and the final shot leaves the viewer with a palpable sense of relief and satisfaction on the customers’ faces.

If you excel at realistic product animation and fast-moving storytelling, I’m ready to move quickly on this.

jobs.title: Website Penjualan Layanan Cepat

jobs.title: Complete E-Commerce Website Development

• Admin panel access with clear documentation for day-to-day management

If you’re comfortable owning both front-end and back-end work and can advise on best-fit technologies, I’m eager to collaborate and move quickly.

jobs.title: Part-Time STAAD Pro Engineer
jobs.description:
I’m looking for a mid-level engineer who is comfortable working in STAAD Pro on a flexible, part-time basis. Your day-to-day involvement will revolve around three core activities:

• Running accurate structural analyses on models I provide or that you create from my sketches and drawings.
• Tweaking member sizes, load cases, and parameters to achieve sound, economical design optimisation.
• Compiling clear calculation notes and concise STAAD-generated reports that I can forward directly to clients and reviewers.

Project types change from assignment to assignment, so you should be adaptable and ready to discuss geometry, codes, and load requirements with me before each new task kicks off. I handle all client communication; you focus solely on the technical work and clean documentation.

Turnaround is generally a few days per task, and we’ll agree milestones and delivery dates in advance. If you have a reliable internet connection, solid mid-level experience in STAAD Pro, and can communicate progress promptly, let’s begin.

jobs.title: Daily Automated Customer Data Entry
jobs.description:
I need a reliable workflow that takes the spreadsheets my team exports each evening and feeds the information straight into our live customer database before the next business day begins. The sheets always contain three kinds of records—customer contact information, purchase history, and any new or updated support tickets—so the automation must map every column correctly and ignore blank rows.

Source format is always Excel (.xlsx). As soon as a file drops into a designated folder, I want the script to validate it, import the data, flag duplicates or conflicts, and generate a short log I can review in the morning. The whole cycle has to run automatically every single day without someone triggering it manually.

Deliverables:  
• A working script or low-code workflow (Python, Power Automate, Zapier, or similar) that pulls the daily Excel file and inserts/updates records in the database I specify (MySQL).  
• Clear configuration file or variables to change field names if the sheet layout changes.  
• Error-handling and a concise log/report saved to a “logs” folder and optionally emailed to me.  
• Brief setup guide so I can redeploy it on another server if needed.

I’ll provide a sample spreadsheet, database schema, and test server credentials once we start. Completion is confirmed when the job runs unattended for two consecutive days without data loss or mismatches.

jobs.title: Virtual Assistants Needed Urgently

* Identify individual creators who match our provided criteria.
* Verify that profiles are active and authentic.
* Research publicly available professional/business contact information where available.
* Record creator names, usernames, profile URLs and audience information.
* Identify relevant public social-media profiles connected to each prospect.
* Remove duplicate, inactive or unsuitable prospects.
* Maintain an accurate Google Sheets/Excel database.
* Add concise notes explaining why each prospect meets the qualification criteria.
* Assist with initial professional outreach when requested.
* Maintain confidentiality and handle prospect information responsibly.

 Required Skills

* Lead generation
* Web research
* Social-media research
* Data entry
* Google Sheets / Excel
* Prospect qualification
* Strong attention to detail
* Good written English
* Reliable communication

Experience with **creator/influencer research or talent sourcing** is a strong advantage.

 Initial Test Project

We would like to begin with a small paid test batch.

The successful applicant will receive our detailed prospect criteria, target platforms and required spreadsheet format.

* Platform
* Profile URL

jobs.title: Full-Stack E-Commerce Site Build

jobs.title: Handwritten Notes Data Entry -- 3

jobs.title: 15-Day Social Media UI Testing
jobs.description:

This is not a general functionality or performance sweep—it is a focused user-interface review that zooms in on colours, typography, icon placement, spacing, and overall consistency from screen to screen.

Here is how I picture the engagement:

• You install the current Play Store build and use the app as an everyday social user would, navigating every major screen, dialogue, and pop-up.  
• Whenever you notice a visual quirk—misaligned elements, pixelated assets, unreadable text, dark-mode glitches—you capture a screenshot, annotate it, and log the exact device, Android version, and reproduction steps.  
• Each evening you send a short status message plus the day’s screenshots so I can triage right away.  
• On day 15 you package everything into a concise report that groups findings by severity and suggests quick UI tweaks where obvious.

Acceptance criteria  
1. At least 10 unique Android device/OS combinations covered.  
2. Daily annotated screenshot bundle and issue spreadsheet shared before 22:00 UTC.  
3. Final report delivered within 24 hours of the test window closing.

The APK is already compliant with Google guidelines; no code access is required—just keen eyes for design detail and the ability to communicate clearly.

jobs.title: Copy website and all from given website

jobs.title: Cut & Trim My Vlogs

jobs.title: Spring Web App Development (MySQL)
jobs.description:

Source control will be on GitHub with frequent, well-documented commits. Once the application launches locally and all tests pass, the deliverables are considered complete and ready for deployment to our staging server.

jobs.title: Bangkok Storage Packing & Shipping items
jobs.description:

I need someone on-site to open the unit, carefully repack everything into Thai International postal boxes, photograph each item (many can be photographed in groups, i.e. same items). List each piece into a spreadsheet format I will provide for the customs mandate.

Once all the boxes are packed, then to be sent to my shipping address (UK) from the post office with all the list and pictures ready. (We may finally decide on using Fedex, DHL or just international Thai post service). 

You would:  
• Visit the facility at a mutually convenient time (I will arrange access in advance).  
• Inspect, photograph, and confirm the exact items with me via chat or video call before packing.  
• Purchase standard boxes from ThaiPost, bubble wrap, tape, and print any needed customs forms.  
• Select a reputable courier service, obtain the tracking numbers, and send me digital copies of the waybills and receipts.  

All expenses—packing supplies, transport to the unit, and shipping fees—will be reimbursed. The job is complete when the tracking shows the parcels in transit and I have clear photos of the packed boxes and paperwork.  

If you are based in Bangkok, comfortable handling small international shipments, and can communicate quickly over Line or WhatsApp, I look forward to working with you.

jobs.title: Agenda de Reservas en Power Apps
jobs.description:

Alcance principal

La aplicación será para uso personal, no empresarial, por lo que valoro una interfaz limpia y un flujo de trabajo fácil de mantener.

Entregables esperados

2. Conexiones necesarias (SharePoint, Dataverse o Excel en OneDrive, según recomiendes).  
3. Breve guía paso a paso para que yo pueda agregar campos o modificar textos en el futuro.

jobs.title: Certified TEFL Kids English Tutor
jobs.description:

Here’s how I picture the workflow:

Acceptance criteria  
– Lessons feel like natural conversation, not drills.  
– Materials are age-appropriate, colourful, and safe for screen sharing.  
– You hold an accredited TEFL or TESOL certificate and can demonstrate previous success with young learners.  

If this sounds like your teaching style, let me know your availability and a quick example of an interactive activity you love to use.

jobs.title: Italian Direct-Response Video Editor

jobs.title: Edición de Videos Sociales

jobs.title: monday.com Project Management Setup

jobs.title: Nuxt.js Admin Dashboard with Laravel
jobs.description:
I need a corporate-grade admin panel built on a Nuxt.js template styled with Vuetify, talking to a Laravel REST API backed by MySQL. The project is frontend-first: clean, component-driven pages that feel consistent with a professional SaaS back-office.  

Core screens and widgets to design and wire to the API include:  
• User management  
• Analytics dashboard with charts and key metrics  
• Content management (CRUD, status toggles, rich-text)

• Admin roles & permission matrix  
• Product adding and importing functionalities 
• A few smaller utility pages (settings, profile, logs)

Visual direction: polished, corporate, and professional—balanced whitespace, tidy typography, understated colour accents, responsive layouts. Re-usable Vue components, well-named props, and scoped SCSS are expected so future modules drop in easily.

Technical expectations  
• Nuxt 3 composition API, Vuetify 3, TypeScript optional but preferred if you already work with it  
• Axios (or ofetch) for API calls; endpoints will follow REST conventions I’ll supply  
• Vue-Router guards tied to the permissions returned from Laravel Sanctum/JWT  
• Localisation scaffolding (i18n) prepared, even if only English strings are filled initially  
• Git commit history that’s logical and readable; feature branches and pull requests

Acceptance criteria  
1. Each feature listed above reachable from a sidebar menu, fully responsive down to 320 px.  
2. Dummy API integration shown for all CRUD flows; later I’ll point it to prod endpoints.  
3. Lighthouse performance score ≥ 85 on dashboard route.  
4. Code passes ESLint/Prettier rules provided at project start.  
5. Clear README with setup, .env sample, and deployment commands.

Hand-off will be a Git repository plus a short walk-through call.

jobs.title: Comparative Equity Growth Modeling

• Easy-to-read visualisations (static or interactive) that highlight relative out- or under-performance over selectable periods.  
• A brief read-me explaining data connections, libraries used, and instructions for extending the coverage universe.

Acceptance criteria  
The code must run end-to-end with sample tickers supplied by you, produce consistent figures when rerun, and remain configurable so I can swap in new instruments or data vendors without structural rewrites.

If you are comfortable building quantitative equity tools and can deliver clean, reproducible code with concise documentation, I’d like to see a short outline of your proposed approach and any similar work you have shipped before.

jobs.title: U.S. Trademark Attorney For Automotive Brand

Unfortunately, the previous application later became abandoned because the required response was not submitted within the deadline.

I now need an experienced attorney to review the full situation and advise on the best strategy moving forward.

I need help with:

* Reviewing the previous USPTO application and complete prosecution history

* Advising whether filing a new application would be the better option
* Conducting a fresh trademark clearance search
* Advising whether we should file the word mark, logo/design mark, or both
* Selecting the correct trademark classes and goods descriptions
* Preparing and filing the application
* Handling USPTO correspondence and Office Actions
* Advising on the strongest long-term protection strategy for the brand

The brand is actively used in the automotive aftermarket parts industry, and we plan to expand the product range significantly.

Please apply only if you have strong experience with USPTO trademark applications and Office Actions.

In your proposal, please tell me:

1. Are you a U.S.-licensed trademark attorney?
2. How many USPTO trademark matters have you handled?
3. Do you have experience with abandoned applications and revival/refiling strategy?
4. Do you personally handle the USPTO filing and correspondence?
5. What is your professional fee?
6. What government fees should I expect?
7. Does your fee include basic Office Action responses?

Full trademark details and documents will be shared privately after I review your qualifications.

• Código cargable en el control del brazo (ABB, KUKA o FANUC; acepto tu recomendación).

• Simulación offline o vídeo demostrativo antes de la puesta en marcha.  
• Manual breve de ajuste y copia de seguridad del programa.

Aceptarémos la entrega cuando el sistema trabaje ocho horas continuas, sin dañar bobinas y manteniendo la cadencia solicitada.  Si ya has implementado celdas de paletizado similares, me encantará revisar tu propuesta y tiempos de entrega.

Timing is critical—please be ready to start almost immediately and propose a schedule that lets us move quickly while keeping quality high.

jobs.title: Comprehensive B2B Supply Chain Platform
jobs.description:
B2B Commerce & Distribution Management Platform

Project Overview

I am looking to develop a scalable B2B Commerce & Distribution Management Platform that connects the complete supply chain:

Manufacturer → Distributor → Wholesaler → Retailer

The objective is to create one integrated platform for B2B product ordering, wholesale transactions, payments, credit management, digital billing, transportation, stock management and business reporting.

The system should automate pricing, order processing, payment calculations, credit/ledger management, transaction records and transportation options.

1. User Types

The platform will support four primary business users:

* Manufacturer
* Distributor
* Wholesaler
* Retailer

Each user type should have a dedicated dashboard and role-based features.

2. Retailer → Wholesaler Ordering

Retailers should be able to:

* Browse products available from wholesalers
* View product details, pricing and availability
* Add products to cart
* Place orders directly with wholesalers
* View order status and history
* View transaction details
* Track paid, pending and credit transactions

Wholesalers should be able to:

* Receive retailer orders
* Accept, modify or reject orders
* Update order status
* Manage pricing and discounts
* Process and fulfil orders

3. Automated Pricing & Billing

The system should automatically calculate:

* Product quantity
* Product price
* Discounts
* Applicable taxes
* Transportation charges
* Current order amount
* Previous outstanding amount
* Total payable amount
* Credit amount

Before final confirmation, users should see a clear Order Summary / Digital Bill.

4. Payment Options

The platform should support:

* UPI
* Bank / Account Transfer
* Credit

Wholesalers should be able to manage their UPI/bank payment details.

For credit transactions, the system should automatically calculate:

Previous Due + Current Due = Total Outstanding

The outstanding balance should be visible to both parties.

5. Credit & Digital Ledger Management

The platform should maintain a complete digital credit history between buyers and sellers.

Users should be able to view:

* Previous outstanding balance
* New credit transactions
* Payments received
* Remaining balance
* Payment dates
* Credit history
* Total outstanding amount

This should function as a digital B2B ledger/accounting record between businesses.

6. Transportation Management

Transportation should be integrated into the ordering workflow.

Users can select either:

Option A – Transportation Included

* Transportation cost is included in the order
* Wholesaler arranges delivery
* Transportation charges are included in the bill

Option B – Transportation Excluded

The retailer can arrange transportation separately through the platform.

The retailer should be able to:

* View available vehicles
* Compare vehicle options
* Select vehicle capacity
* View transportation charges
* Book/hire a vehicle
* Track delivery

7. Stock / Inventory Management – Optional Module

We also want to implement Stock & Inventory Management as an optional module.

Depending on the business requirement, Manufacturers, Distributors, Wholesalers and Retailers should be able to manage:

* Available stock
* Stock-in / stock-out
* Product quantities
* Low-stock alerts
* Inventory history
* Purchase and sales stock
* Warehouse/stock locations
* Stock adjustment

The inventory module should be designed so that it can be enabled or disabled depending on the user’s business type and requirements.

8. Business Dashboard & Reports

Retailers, Wholesalers, Distributors and Manufacturers should have role-specific dashboards showing:

* Monthly purchases/sales
* Total sales
* Total purchases
* Order history
* Transaction history
* Credit transactions
* Outstanding payments
* Paid transactions
* Pending payments
* Transportation expenses
* Stock/inventory summary
* Periodic business reports

9. Transaction Management

Every transaction should maintain a complete digital record, including:

* Order ID
* Buyer/Retailer
* Seller/Wholesaler
* Products
* Quantity
* Product price
* Discount
* Tax
* Transportation charges
* Payment method
* Paid amount
* Credit amount
* Previous due
* Current due
* Total outstanding
* Transaction date
* Payment status

Users should be able to access their complete transaction history at any time.

10. Admin Panel

A powerful web-based Admin Panel should be developed to manage:

* Users
* Manufacturers
* Distributors
* Wholesalers
* Retailers
* Products
* Categories
* Orders
* Transactions
* Payments
* Credit accounts
* Transportation
* Vehicle providers
* Stock/inventory
* Commissions/platform fees
* Reports
* Notifications
* Platform settings
* User verification and account management

11. Expected Platforms

The platform should be developed for:

* Android App
* iOS App
* Web Application
* Web-based Admin Panel

The architecture should be scalable so additional modules and business categories can be added in the future.

12. Important Requirements

I am looking for an experienced development team/freelancer who can:

* Understand the complete business workflow before development
* Create a professional UI/UX design
* Develop a scalable backend and database
* Implement secure authentication and role-based access
* Build reliable payment and credit/ledger functionality
* Implement transportation integration
* Implement optional stock/inventory management
* Develop APIs and integrations where required
* Provide proper testing and bug fixing
* Provide source code and deployment support
* Provide post-launch maintenance/support

13. Future Scope

The platform should be built with future expansion in mind, including:

* Manufacturer → Distributor ordering
* Distributor → Wholesaler ordering
* Wholesaler → Retailer ordering
* Multi-level B2B commerce
* Advanced inventory/warehouse management
* Logistics marketplace
* Business analytics
* Accounting integrations
* AI-powered business insights
* Vendor/supplier management
* Subscription and commission-based monetization

What I Expect From Freelancers

Please share:

1. Your experience developing B2B commerce/distribution platforms
2. Similar projects you have previously developed
3. Your proposed technology stack
4. Estimated development timeline
5. Estimated total cost
6. UI/UX design process
7. Development milestones/phases
8. Payment milestone structure
9. Post-launch maintenance and support policy
10. Links/screenshots/demo of similar applications you have developed

Please do not submit a generic proposal. I prefer freelancers/teams who have experience with B2B commerce, marketplace, distribution, inventory, accounting/ledger, payment and logistics-related platforms.
